reviews.comment: Cambre is so nice and wants his students to do well. The blame is more on the department (& cox curve) rather than on him. The final for this class is impossible no matter which professor you take. He truly tries his best to make lectures entertaining but with the nature of the class topics, the lectures are an absolute snooze fest

Be ready to self teach, come in with excel, sql knowledge. The lecture is so fast. Every one cheats on quiz & assignments. Does nothing about it. Blames cox curve and said itom department forced him to make the final exam hard to reduce the amount of student getting A. Should've done better to prevent cheating, instead of giving impossible final.

He's impossible to communicate with; emails are blatantly ignored. Zero empathy/understanding for real-life issues, makes a hard class more stressful. Lectures are dull & add no value, waste of time sitting through them & not learning anything. For the amount this class costs, the lack of support & quality of teaching is honestly unacceptable.

Overall I'd say he's a pretty good dude and chill professor. A lot of homework does take hours outside of class and it's A LOT of work, attendance is also mandatory for his class as well. He doesn't really grade anything because all the stuff is graded by a machine. I can see how people wouldn't like his class but I'd take his class again tbh.

TONS OF HW that takes hours, it hard and he will not teach you how to do it. Even if you go to every class and listen to everything he says you will leave confused. ITOM itself is a class that is hard so I think that is part of it but def try and find another prof for this class. Hes even unclear on what you will even be tested on..
Honestly not a great professor, gives hours of homework that are so tedious and you don't learn how to do them in class. Would not take this class if you have other options.

He is nice, but attendance is required for a boring class that doesn't help at all for your hours of homework, which is graded BY A MACHINE. The machine grading system is very harsh and screws over your test and homework grades. I wouldn't recommend.
No matter how frequently you visit during office hours, will never present you with questions that are close to those on tests. Talks a lot about personal life.

Funny professor. He gives out scratch-n-sniff stickers for engagement. The assignments are classic Cengage Excel modules, which I enjoy. There are also quizzes during class, and you can only take them if you attend.
she literally does nothing all class but yap
I was in her UNIV class, most amazing professor. She really cares about her students and makes it known.

Loved shortgen!! she was so easy and all we did was hang out, talk, and gossip every class for like 30 min then she'd teach a short lesson the last 10 of each class and that lesson would be the exam! we loved her sm!!

She is wonderful! So awesome, I am coming back on here as a senior who took her as a sophomore to say that she is by far one of my favorite professors at SMU! Very sweet, material is understandable, and she is so accessible in and out of the classroom!

She is truly the most caring professor at SMU. She is real and actually wants to get to know you and your goals for your life. She shares life stories and real-world examples that make her lessons come to life, and she lets you take assignments in the way you want to display your ideas. She is super easy to work with and if you can TAKE HER COURSE.

Class was ok. I like the professor's personality, but that's also the problem... She seems preoccupied in trying to win over students as allies rather teaching. That being said, what her department did to her was wrong on so many levels bc she is one of the few teacher who care ab us and not grades

Schortgen truly is one of the most caring/inspiring teachers I have ever had. She had amazing stories that fit into her lectures from her real-world experiences. She gives three main assignments that help you gain critical nonprofit skills in grant writing and fundraising and presents the projects/assignments in broken-down parts to be manageable.
She's changed, do not recommend.

I was recommended by my friend to take Prof Schortgen's nonprofit org, her lectures are casual and chill, and super caring about students. Don't be absent for that class will bring her a good impression and she's willing to help you on academics, or anything out of classes.

She is very easy going professor & doesn't assign much work so you have do well on everything or a grade will drop your grade. A little all over the place in lecture and the only thing i didn't like how she talks badly about others in the department which i found unprofessional. Lectures are sometimes seem unprepared ahead of time but they are fun!
my favorite smu professor

I LOVE Dr. Schortgen- she personally cares about students and will go a mile for you if you show up and try to understand. She is very knowledgeable and takes student feedback seriously. She also is willing to offer student project feedback before the deadline on most major assignments- this means you can polish papers with her before they are due.

I have taken multiple classes with her now, and she is one of the best professors I have had. She respects her students and takes feedback/advice. Not too much homework and her classes are pretty interactive.
friendly professor but no clear instruction on attendance her test questions did not feel fair because she doesn't use class time to teach them and she was impossible to contact outside of class

You literally learn nothing but she is the sweetest lady! There aren't a lot of assignments which can hurt your grade fast, classtime is a little boring and repetitive but she is fun and make morning classes easier to take. My main issue is there aren't enough assignements to boost your grade and she can be a little hard to reach outside of class.

A very nice lady but her course is unstructured and you don't really learn anything but then her tests are hard even though she didn't do anything to teach the material. Tests come from nowhere. Attendance doesn't matter until it does and she lectures you about consequences of attendance. Very uneven experience, not what i expected.
Super nice and friendly. Earlier reports of a super easy A are greatly exaggerated, or no longer true. Class isn't particularly difficult though, just show up to class and read and you'll do well!

I love profesor schortgen so much! This is a great class for people interested in nonprofits. The hardest part is that it is graded only by a few things, which lowers the overall grade. She really does care and is very available outside of class! Graded by 4 reading quizzes, participation, 2 tests, and a project.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Shortgen is such a sweet lady! Her class is mostly lecture-based, but the lectures are interesting and helpful! She does not give many assignments or tests, and it is not difficult to be successful in her class. She has a lot of knowledge about the nonprofit sector. She offers multiple options for office hours, so definitely go talk to her!
Very knowledgeable about the sector

GPA boost with a nice lady who wants to be your friend. Don't know why people stress about cancel classes cause you don't need to be there anyway. No attendance, no reading, fair grading, review is test, highly reccommend for easy option.

Such a sweet lady, loves talking with and getting to know students. She doesn't cancel class as much as other reviews say but still a few times. There is a few open note take home reading quizzes, 1 test, 1 presentation, 1 paper. The test review was literally the test. highly recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You don't need to be in college if you don't make an A in this class
The best professor at SMU.

Schortgen is one of the nicest profs I've had at SMU, she cares if you do well and tries to get to know students she has in class. If you need help she will make time for you, however the class material is very easy, if you go to lectures and read for quizzes (open book/note) you'll do well. Take her if you can!!

Ok, so super easy and nice, yes but caveats. Easiest A youll get at SMU which is why your surrounded by athletes in class. Course is like 5th grade reading comprehension simple, assignments canceled/made extra credit, & everyone likes canceled classes but this amount was ridiculous. If you want to learn about nonprofits take CCPA3380 instead.

Schortgen is a terrific professor who knows a ton about nonprofits. Here's the deal: if you want an easy class this is for you. There's almost no effort required to get a good grade. When COVID forced us online she pretty much threw in the towel and made the class brain dead easy. COVID-free, it still would have been ridiculously easy.

Probably the best teacher I have had at SMU. She cares so much about her students and is so well connected in the nonprofit sector. The class was not too difficult, and her lectures are straightforward. If you can take her, do it! Not only is she an amazing resource to have, she is fun too!

I can't believe Schortgen doesn't have more reviews. She is by far the best prof I have ever had. 3321 is really interesting and v easy - 2 papers (4 pg) and 2 written exams (you can bullet point). go to class and you won't need to read Prof S. is incredibly caring and fun to just sit and talk with - you can tell she truly cares about her students

"She's lovely and a real gem"- former student Class is graded on minimal work worth a decent amount of points. Everything she says in her lectures is basically what is on the test. test format is all short answer but manageable. Overall amazing!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Dr. Schortgen is by far one of my favorite professors ever! I wish I could take more classes with her. She teaches you material you can USE, especially in the evolving field of philanthropy. This class was amazing. We experienced/learned firsthand what the community needs and is doing to mitigate pressing social issues. Highly recommend!

She is a nonprofit guru! Her syllabus has a lot of work but she usually drops half or makes things worth extra credit instead. It is hard to get an A but not hard to get a -A or B+ without doing much work.

Favorite teacher! She is always willing to go out of her way to meet with you and is a sweetheart! She is really funny too and knows so much about the reality of the nonprofit field. She teaches because she loves her students and is passionate about nonprofit studies! She is very understanding and a great connection to have bc of her back-round!

This class moves super fast and she cold calls. She is super accessible outside of class and tells you exactly what is going to be on tests and quizzes. Prob one of the better ACCT professors, just make sure you show up to class and pay attention. She takes attendance by role call. Also gives lots of partial credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The course workload was unreasonable compared to what was actually taught. Instructions changed every week, deadlines appeared suddenly, and exams covered material never discussed in class. Communication was  unclear, and often contradicted the syllabus entirely.
Great teacher, very accommodating and transparent on content. Cold calls are literally free points. Come to class, or you'll miss important stuff.
She is a hard teacher but my favorite teacher at SMU. She is very organized and very straight forward with what she is testing you on.

Fine ACCT teacher but she cold calls for participation points and you have to answer correctly to get the points. She tells you exactly what you need to study for tests and quizzes and has a clear grading criteria. Helpful outside of class. If you are struggling go to her office hours!!! Sooo much more helpful in office hours than in class.

Best accounting professor at SMU for financial. She gives you packets to work through each week. 4 exams. Make friends in class, will help for getting problems correct. Cold calling was the worst, constant anxiety. Other than that, put the work in and you will get an A.

Do not listen to the negative reviews. Amy Altizer is the BEST teacher i've had at SMU. For "cold calling" she lets people do practice problems with neighbors then asks for answers, but basically everyone gets it right, so dont let that scare you. No screens, but I've never learned so well from any teacher in my life. quizzes and tests are easy.
She is the best teacher at SMU by far! Super clear grading expectations and very fair exams that are representative of what we learned in class!

Terrible teacher. Talks at students, not with them. Doesn't encourage participation, stifles creativity through endless monotone lectures nobody can pay attention to. Avoid this class if you value your education.

Very fair class. No screens allowed, and she does cold call, but you learn so much that class goes by fast. Tests were also very doable, and she will push them back if you are not ready. Extremely accommodating, and makes the subject easy to study and understand. I hardly had to open the textbook outside of class because she taught so well. 10/10.
Worst instructor ever. Spends class time on tangents and cold calls to make you uncomfortable.
This professor is a disaster. Can't keep track of assignments. Gives conflicting instructions. Shows favoritism, ignores others. Avoid this class if you can.

Shes a nice lady but pretty strict. She makes the class very straightforward simple, and you get cold called. If you just do what your supposed to do and go to class, then it should be a pretty easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is much more tolerable in managerial than financial, but the material is much easier too. She is a strict prof overall, but just pay attention and show up. If you don't understand, go to office hours she is much nicer and super helpful. Very straightforward of what to expect on exams and what you should study. Find/make friends in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: i suck at accounting but she is a great prof. cold calls randomly every class for participation points so do the problems and pay attention. very accessible outside of class. she prints out note packets for every class which is so nice and easy. 3 midterms and a final so be ready bc those are most of the points in her class. awesome prof and person

AWFUL, her personality is all over the place, as is her teaching, and she can go from "understanding" to pissed off in one second flat if someone asks the wrong question she doesn't want to stop her lectures for.

She is AMAZING!!! Adorable teacher. She's so sweet and will work with you if you're struggling. I genuinely enjoy her lectures and she makes acct interesting. I also like that she prints the lecture to follow along and hands on. The cold calling isn't bad at all it makes you put your knowledge to action and helps you actually learn and do well!

Be ready to teach yourself everything cause nothing she "teaches" is on the exams, needs to find another job. Confusing lectures, never in office hours, hard exams at the end of the semester so you can't complain on her university evals, no structure in lectures, worst course I have ever taken, tanked my GPA. Rude and a lousy experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: In order to succeed you need to show up to lectures and take notes. this will be so helpful when studying for tests and quizzes. She is not the type of professor to be your best friend, but you will definitely learn in her class. As long as you study for quizzes and exams and follow her reviews, you will do generally well in her class.

naively expecting a manageable experience, only to be met with sheer incompetence in teaching, she ceaselessly drones on nonsensically, completely divorced from any relevance to test material. Displays a remarkable lack of insight into the subject she purportedly teaches, punctuating discourse with unprofessional and baseless comments about others

Do not take Altizer. Every person ik in this class either dropped or wishes they would have dropped. Her class is very lecture heavy and she goes through the lessons very fast. She grades participation based on cold calling people to give answers to practice problems, and if you get the wrong answer, you get a 3/5 on participation. tests are v hard

Hard class and she is a no nonsense, strict professor. Be prepared to try in class because she cold calls as part of your grade. Takes attendance every class, but it forces you to learn the material and show up. It was hard but I learned a lot. I am taking her again for managerial accounting. She doesn't curve her exams. MyAcct lab homework sucks.

I wish I had taken Professor Altizer for Financial Accounting. Her class can be boring as it's all lecture and she doesn't allow laptops in class. However, she teaches you everything you need to know in class and her lecture setup forces you to pay attention. Quizzes and Tests were easy because she prepares you so well.

She reads and goes through the material way too fast in class that nobody can comprehend it. Then, after teaching it way too fast, she expects us to know it and be able to do a problem on our own and calls on us for participation points.

Very straight forward class. Need to pay attention and do your work but there won't be that many curveballs on tests and she'll have taught you everything you need to know. If you stay up on notes, go to class, and study the practice problems before the test you can definitely fall in the A range.

Definitely a hard class. She'll teach you very well and make sure you understand the content but if you don't put work in you'll struggle to succeed. A lot of stuff to understand and very hard tests that require you to know the content in and out but she's pretty good with partial credit.

Altizer is a nice professor and is helpful when it comes to office hours and teaching. All notes are provided by her. Multiple choice on tests is always tricky and worth a lot. Quizzes are also worth a lot of your grade as well. Overall ok, but there are easier professors and also worse professors
Easy A if you pay attention and attend her lectures.

I highly recommend taking Altizer if you show up to class and listen to the lectures. She is very clear cut, the lecture is printed out for you and is extremely easy to follow along with. People shy away from her class bc of the cold calling but it's only 4 times, very much worth it to take her and actually understand the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Altizer is the most straight forward out there. She gets right to the point in her notes and gives you the exact types of problems that will be on the test. If you do the homework problems, read the book, and go to class, you will pass. The tests are decently hard, but she gives a lot of partial credit!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Really try not to miss class because attendance and participation are graded, so if you are absent and she calls on you, you're out of luck. She very clearly defines what you will and will not need to know on exams and quizzes in the reviews. ALWAYS do the homework problems. The tests are literally the HW problems but with different numbers.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Altizer isnt a bad teacher. However, her grading system is extremely rigid. Getting an A is near impossible. No study guides for the tests (there are practice problems available). Final is cumulative and there is no study guide.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Altizer was a very clear professor. Her lectures were based off the textbook and were very straight forward, and the tests reflected her lectures and the homework problems. Homework is not mandatory, but definitely helps to make a better grade. She does participation points, but honestly very good to stay on top of the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Apparently she's become much tougher than these reviews claim. Every single quiz and test is a trick and unlike what you've learned to do in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Really good prof, would highly recommend. Participating is a huge part of class but her questions are really easy if you even slightly follow her notes. Test are not bad at all and quizzes are really easy.

I took her for financial, and Im going to take her again for managerial. She gives you a review before each test that tells you exactly what will be on it. She does cold calls in class, which suck, but shes a teacher that teaches and well prepares you for the rest of the accounting classes. LHR may be easier, but youll be lost later on.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She's had a rep for being an easy teacher so it seems like she's trying to change that. Tests are tricks and like nothing you'll have seen before (from her examples and the book's), final is cumulative with an average score of 80%, and she does cold calls for participation points. Went into final with a B+ came out with a C+. Take another prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is tough. If you can grab another prof do so. Her exams are nothing that you have seen in class. The third exam people did horribly. Participation is easy just , show up to class. The case study is pointless and odds are you wont get a good score on it. Overall, I wish I switched to another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Definitely recommend. Don't underestimate the first test (which is why I ended up with a B). She gives a study sheet for exactly what is on the test. Study that and make sure you can do it and the class is no big. She does cold calls in class so don't miss but she gave people who did miss extra choices at the end of the semester. The final is hard.

If you attend class and pay attention, this class is easy. She never shows up on time, so there's a plus. She does not manage her time well and will sometimes go over her time, which is annoying. Calls on you in class for participation, so make sure you pay attention. Homeworks are all easy.

Pay attention in class and do all the homework problems she assigns and you'll do fine. She has a strict grading system out of 500 points. 470/500 is an A and if you fall below that, there is no coming back. No extra credit. Calls on you in class for participation points and attendance is mandatory (with 4 excused absences no questions asked).

Take her for accounting!!! She is very straight forward. She prints out all the notes for you and walks through examples. She tells you exactly what to study for tests and won't test you on things she didn't teach. Calls on you 4 times for participation points. If you are willing to put in the effort to learn the material, it is easy to make an A.

Professor Altizer is a really good accounting professor. She isnt very friendly or particularly nice (so if you like a sweet, happy teacher take LHR.) Altizer is serious about her teaching which can be nagging at times but she wants you to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: It was tough, you have to put a lot of time but definitely learned a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: If you have to take this class, take this professor! she provides you all of the tools you need. In Fall 2016 she typed out notes for every lecture to follow along, gave a lot of examples, and hw solutions worked out in detail. BUT you're penalized for participation if you get a question wrong. She's really efficient and organized
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Altizer is great on providing you with organized slides and information that you will need to get through her class. You should go to class and pay attention because she will explain the handouts well. After that, it is on you to do the homework a bunch of times and understand the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Tests are very straight forward. You get a few multiple choice that check how thorough you study the notes packets she gives and then the long answer questions are exactly what you expect. Go to class, do the extra credit, and you can get an A. She says read the textbook but I got an A just attending class and studying the notes.

Altizer makes it clear from the beginning- if you put in the work (3-6 hours a week outside of class), you will succeed. Essentially, if you read the chapters ahead of class, and do the homework when assigned, you will have no problem in this class. However, as a Cox class, it requires the mean grade is  a B, so the final is very tough. Go to class
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Makes the first test easy then makes the following increasingly hard. Seems willing to help but does not explain things in depth and assumes you understand them. The class itself is hard and Altizer is fine, but if you have other options that work in your schedule I would not take her.

She is the definition of crystal clear. She literally gives you a review sheet of what to study, gives PLENTY of practice problems. Don't text in class or your grade will silently go down. Review every problem on the study sheet and you'll do fine on the tests.
Very organized class. She can be somewhat strict with grades but for the most part is fair. Tests are not bad, quizzes can catch you off guard. If not pregnant, hot

Super organized, talks fast, but makes dry ACCT somewhat interesting. Even tho you never have to actually turn in the hwk exercises, DO THEM! Super imp to learn the material. Pop quizzes so pay attn in class & get notes from friend if you miss. Final is RIDICULOUSLY hard - went into it w an A & ended class w a B. Go to office hrs & sit in front
Professor Altizer was a good instructor for the course. Not too hard, but make sure you don't skip class. If you do, get notes from someone. Ask for help and you'll get it. Overall, good class.

Altizer is extremely organized and a bit OCD about sticking to the schedule. In that sense she is very clear about deadlines and guidelines for projects and assignments. I worked my ass off, but got an A in this class. She passes out her full powerpointalready outlined notes which makes class very easy to pay attention too. Recommend!
Very organized, straightforward, wants you to succeed. Definetely great at teaching. ACCT 2301 isn't easy in general, but she is probably your best bet.

Just don't. You'll do fine, probably great, on her tests and case studies, but she gets some weird pleasure from ruining your grade with her final. She'll take everything you thought you knew about accounting, and destroy it with her final. If you need a decent grade in this class for Cox, just give up. Went into her final with an A, left with a B+
Very good teacher. Go to class, pay attention, and do the homework. She wants you to do well, but is not easy. Test questions are pulled straight from class notes and quizzes. You will learn a lot.

I learned so much from this class. Altizer is a great teacher and was always available for office hours. Expectations are clear and it is easy to see where your grade stands at every point in the course. However, the final was much harder than I expected it to be!
Her notes were very clear and she really knows her stuff. However, I found her a bit condescending. Overall pretty good class.
She's not easy but if you go to class and pay attention she's very clear and tells you exactly what she expects.

She is very helpful and always has office hours, however this semester she made her tests so much harder. Especially the final it took most of the class 3 hours and she gave us an extra 30 minutes it was hell

Altizer is not the teacher that I thought she was going to be when I signed up for classes. I was told she was the easiest and nicest of the accounting 2301 teachers, that was false information. She was not helpful, she was not nice, and her tests were very difficult.

Altizer is not as easy and as nice of a teacher as she used to be. In past years she was considered one of the easiest accounting teachers for 2301, but not anymore. She has made her tests harder and the overall class more difficult. Whenever I go in for help she is not very nice . She treats you like you are dumb for asking questions
Altizer for both intro accounting courses.  Great teacher, very accessible for extra help and great teaching style.  Tests are very straightforward.  Go to class and put in the work and it's an A.

She was extremely helpful. her style made it sooo easy to learn accounting. she drops several of your lowest hw and quiz grades. the quizzes are right out of what we have been doing in class, just diff #s. the tests are straightforward and same as all of our examples and hw problems. Did the hw, went to class, easy A.
Took her for managerial acct.  awesome teacher easy a.
Very Helpful
Good teacher!  She gives you examples that are exactly like the problems on the test.  Very clear in the classroom and available for extra help if you need it.  Definitely take her class.

Love this guy. He tries so hard to make class interesting and to keep everyone engaged. If you pay attention in class you should be fine. Just do the practice that he tells you to. He is very clear about what you need to do and know to pass the final.

Gwinn is a very good teacher, and this is an easy class. The grade is based on homework and other practices. He made the final harder this year, but it actually was not hard. We got to use AI on the final, which made it easy. Definitely take Gwinn over the other ITOM professors from what I have heard.

Likes to cold call in class especially if you don't have your name tag out or are distracted. Funny guy and is genuinely super interested in what he's teaching. Lots of time-consuming homework, aka the excel cengage assignments and the SQL points so give yourself a lot of time to do before his 10pm deadlines (not midnight). Let's you use chat tho
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He has a huge attitude, but the class is so easy. Nothing to prepare us for workload but its an easy A or B if you do the class work.
Engaging teaching, cengage can be rlly annoying

How could you not love Gwinn. Yes, he goes off on the most random tangents, but that is what makes the class so fun. Nobody wants to be learning excel or SQL, so might as well break it up with story dumping. He makes you feel comfortable and wants everyone to succeed. Super understanding of personal matters and will work with you! TAKE GWINN!!

This guy is a GOAT! Class is essentially excel prep. He is fun and quirky but also very good at what he does. He mixes in the correct amount of jokes and memes throughout the class so its palatable to sit for 80 minutes. Have fun but don't get distracted by his light up tie! Take him!

Prof Gwinn is an amazing professor. All the business school professors seem to be good but Prof Gwinn is the best I have taken at SMU even though he can be difficult to follow at times. But he is the best.
Gwinn is a great professor. ITOM is pretty boring but he makes it fun to learn. The Excel part is pretty difficult but SQL is actually amazing.

Excel and definitely SQL are not my strengths. Prof. Gwinn made it understandable at least. I am not sure I will recall it in a couple of years but I can probably figure out what I need to know. That being said this is one of the best courses I took at SMU. Others have said it is boring and maybe it is, but it is useful.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Gwinn's class is the first real technology class I took. He can stray off topic but it helps because if you aren't into technology you get a break. It is sort of like a core math class. It is boring at the time but you are glad you had it when you need it.
Not great teacher, talks a lot, tells you about his accomplishments too often.

Gwinn is pretty unique but he got me interested in computers as in work. I had been finance but switched to BASCM mid way through the semester. I guess it was Python that really got interesting. It isn't for everybody but it is interesting to some.

I am writing this a year after taking 2308. Gwinn is the best prof at SMU. I had a hard semester when I took the class bc of medical issues. He understood from the beginning and empathized with me. He saw that I gave everything I could to succeed and ensured I was rewarded for such since the beginning. Stay on the waiting list. Amazing person.

Could not say enough good words about Gwinn. He cares so much about his students and wants you to succeed. 100% take him. It is a requirement is to pass the excel expert exam, which was pretty difficult took multiple tries to receive a passing score
Hands down BEST professor I have EVER taken. TAKE HIM!!!!!
Gwinn is a good professor. I wish he taught all the ITOM courses because they can be boring. Gwinn makes them fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He makes learning Excel fun. He is the best choice for ITOM.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Gwinn is the best professor I had at SMU. On the first day of class he says he teaches things you actually will use. That was literally an understatement. I am in my first job and Excel and SQL are all i use. This was the best course I took

I think this is a duplicate but Dr. Gwinn is amazing. On the first day of class he said his class focused on the job you could get when you graduated. Professors say lots of things but he was right and even before I graduated I got an internship because of what I learned in ITOM. Amazing class. Take him for ITOM.
Gwinn is literally the GOAT. So kind, so funny, I occasionally go hang out with him during office hours just to ask questions and chat. Probably my favorite teacher I've ever had. TAKE GWINN!!

One of the funniest professors I have every had! The class is not hard itself, first semester is excel work and second half is SQL. If you do not go to class or understand the HW you will not do well on the Excel certification exam. If your good at excel/tech this class will be an easy A for you. HW was long but very helpful and keeps the grade up!

Gwinn is just an iconic teacher. He really is knowledgeable, and if you put the time and energy into learning and working at Excel and SQL then you will succeed. Also, he always has the funniest and more out-of-pocket stories, so you never really fail to be surprised listening to him speak.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is the best prof to take for the 1st itom. The class is brain numbingly boring, but he is so random and quirky and keeps the class on their toes. Talk to him and laugh at his dumb jokes and he will take an interest in your success. You must pass the Excel expert test and complete the SQL certification as the main assignments of the class.

The most arrogant professor ever. Makes Kanye sound humble. He talks for ages about anything except the class. It is hard to not get a 100 if that is what you want to take him. If you don't want to hate every second of this class, take someone else.
He is the goat of SMU. Don't even think about other options and take his ITOM 2308 class!

You will have to take the Excel expert exam for 20% of your grade and the associate for 5%. Just study and practice the modules he gives you and you should pass. His lectures consist of excel, date and talking about sql. Have not taken the final exam yet. But it is over SQL. The class has been fairly easy and not too stressful. Kind professor.

Ok, these reviews need to chill a bit. Yes he's quirky, but it's nothing annoying, and his classes aren't a waste of time. DON'T DO HOMEWORK DURING THEM! He won't yell at you, but if you pay attention, it'll make the class 100x easier. BEST ITOM PROFESSOR!!!
Acts like the classroom is his club treehouse when he should be teaching like a professional. Not good, past his prime if he had one.
nice buy but he loves to make his lectures like his own personal stand up comedy show and waste our time
epitomizes "waste of time"
Lots of busy work, but it's easy. No major exams except the final which is also easy lol. Very entertaining lectures, if a bit aimless. Would def take him again.
Not a good professor at all; can't explain things well, talks all class period about personal issues, you won't learn anything.
mid

Great professor. Tries to help as much as he can. Homeworks are easy and lectures help to understand the concepts. Pass the excel tests as soon as you can, will take multiples tries. Group project is easy and the SQL stuff isn't that hard. Is fun and engaging. An easy A.
So easy compared to the other ITOM professor. Great for learning excel, getting intro to SQL. Super funny and knows a ton related to data science and technology in general.

Gwinn was fine, my only complaint was how difficult the Excel Expert exam was to pass. Not his fault, just changes on Microsoft's end to make it more difficult. Most people I knew had to take it 3+ times for a passing score, but Gwinn gave an extension to pass by the end of the semester.

gwinn is easily the best option for an itom professor. the class has a ton of homework but that isnt avoidable. he makes learning excel and sql really easy and wants you to do well in the class. he will hold you accountable if you miss assignments or slack off. really funny guy and i enjoyed going to his class. made excel interesting
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Super funny professor! ITOM no matter what prof is a hw heavy class, so there was a lot of work outside, but I definitely learned a lot. He gave us all an extension to pass the Excel Expert certification and opportunities to improve. One group project, one paper, one final, but LOTS of homework when we were learning excel at the beginning of sem.
Weird dude, lectures are impossible to follow, and not really needed for your success, there is an incredible amount of homework

I switched my major to business analytics because of Professor Gwinn. I got a job after graduation because of my SQL skills and found a better job because of my skills. Thank you prof Gwinn! Go BASCM!

Most homework I've had in a college class by far but it is very doable. Basically get ready for a few hours a night twice a week but this makes up for having no tests until the final (with SQL data camp you can get out of, highly recommend doing). You do learn a lot which is why the hands on practice is good. Also he's great guy,

Gwinn saved my mental sanity this semester. If you go to class and stay on top of deadlines (especially with the excel exams), you're very likely to get an A. He has a great sense of comedic timing and does well to make ITOM more interesting. Most of all, he's a teacher who really cares about students succeeding and is easy to contact for help.
Awesome professor, definitely take him for ITOM. You'll have a decent amount of homework at the beginning but I promise it's worth it.

Gwinn is the funniest and most caring professor at Cox. He is extremely tech-savvy and is accessible outside of class. He tells the funniest stories and keeps the class engaged the entire time. He provides tons of opportunities to ask questions and is able to identify tech issues almost instantly. He's also extremely helpful outside of class.

Professor Gwinn is my favorite SMU professor. He is knowledgeable and funny, and he really wants everyone to do well in his class. I thought excel and SQL were interesting and he actually gives assignments that help you learn it. Take him!!!
Gwinn is the easiest choice for ITOM. Basically a free A if you do all the work. He is also a funny dude who is very quirky. Makes the boring subject not as bad.

Gwinn by far has been one of my favorite professors at SMU. He truly cares about his students and tries to make the content he teaches interesting. He is such a great resource out of the classroom and extremely understanding. Do not get on his bad side and reach out to him outside of class. I'm so thankful I took his class.

1 of my favorite professors. Quirky, knowledgeable, understanding, kind, and respectful. Cares for his students. Highly recommend! Clear and Fair with expectations & grading. Tedious course. Lots of homework (Excel, Boring Book, SQL). Certifications in Excel Associate & Expert. 1 group project & 1 paper. Final only covers SQL

absolute icon. a man of the people. He is knowledgeable and passionate and is always ready to answer any question on slack. No tests during the year, just a few take-home quizzes and a group paper. He jokes a lot during class and is just the best guy. king.

Had him for a Tuesday Thursday class. On the last Tuesday of the semester (the Tuesday that follows a Monday schedule) he literally still held class, even though we all had our Monday classes conflicting. Also makes us learn SQL but doesn't even teach it in class, instead spends time talking about useless topics.

Professor Gwinn is amazing. He is very knowledgeable and helps you understand the material. He is always available after hours for any questions you have. I learned a lot from his class, and I would gladly retake another one of these classes. I learned SQL because of him. Amazing professor.

This is hands down one of the best professors at SMU. He takes his time to learn the students and connect with them outside of class. This course is going to be hard no matter the professor, but he makes it very manageable. His teachings affected me as a student across the board in my other classes. He is well known among students and hilarious.

This was my second time taking the course and was going to drop it again after the mid term but after talking to him decided to stick it out. He used to help me with material every week during office hours. Happy to say I passed the course because of him.

Graded on 3 exams, 5 quizzes, 2 excel assignments, and online homework. Poorly constructed lecture slides and not a great lecturer as he can be hard to understand and follow at many times. Difficult exams and quizzes with some questions being nothing like done in class. Large curve, as many students struggle in his class. Nice guy, but bad teacher.

I find this guy hilarious, constantly poking fun at students. However, as much as the class is funny, he is not a good teacher. He solves every problem on his own, providing no opportunity for practice outside of the online Pearson HW. It's a do-it-yourself kind of class, but he will curve.

Asif is a great guy who is always willing to help. He is literally always in his office outside of class so you can pop in whenever to ask questions. Each test and quiz requires hours of studying, but its not more than any other FINA class. Take Asif if you are genuinely willing to put in the work.
helps students who truly want to do well
You honestly just need to go to his office hours. Tests are so similar to the quizzes. He wants his students to succeed but you have to make an effort too.

DO NOT TAKE. No idea when any assignments/exams are because they aren't in the syllabus, and he tells you less than a week before. Grades for participation, but you can't even participate because he doesn't ask questions. Genuinely the worst class I've taken at SMU.

tests are insanely difficult. Has a weird obession with A.I too.... brags about this class being based on an MBA level coursework but does an bad job at teaching. Literally any other professor is better

I understand Finance is not an easy subject to teach and one of the harder ones for students to understand but it seems like a joke to him. Office hours are no help, there is always many people trying to speak with him but he just seems annoyed and doesn't even explain back. Students currently have no clue where they stand in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Nearly impossible to get a good grade in this class.
Not the best at all. He can be unhelpful at times and a little rude. He mumbles a lot which makes it hard to follow and can be rude when trying to answer questions. I wouldn't reccomend to take.
Sloppy handwriting, unorganized, not accommodating or understanding!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof. Schwartz is a beacon of light in the PLSC department. Extremely knowledgeable, caring, and great at lecturing. Be ready to write.
Very rude and says rude things to certain groups of people. Doesn't teach well. Mean spirited.

great professor all around. cares about his students and is always accessbile. lecutres are thorugh which is great because the content of the readings can be difficult but he helps explain it well. partioation matters but he gives easy opportnites (reading off slides) i really recommend him and his class.

Professor Schwartz is an absolute gem! His lectures are incredibly engaging, breaking down complex topics effortlessly. He cares about his students' success, always available for questions and providing constructive feedback. His enthusiasm makes learning enjoyable. Take his class!
Gave harsh, vague feedback with little guidance ans made a horrible comment about religious people in class. Created a hostile environment. Would not recommend.
If you want to learn then take his class. Do not take if looking to cruise by

Not sure why people had a problem with his lectures, since I found them really good. In all honesty, if you pay attention to the lectures and take notes, it's not that necessary to do all the reading since he goes over everything anyway. The tests were manageable as well. Not an easy class or anything, but just an all-around great professor.

His lectures feel like he's more focused on getting validation from students half his age than teaching the material. It's embarrassing to watch and frustrating to sit through. Bad teacher, even worse grader.
He's actually an amazing professor, he's quizzes are  easy if you read the content he gives to you. Besides that he just want his students to succeed
Professor Schwartz is awesome! He is very helpful and wants you to succeed! He is such a kind professor and he makes slides with his lectures which makes it easy to follow along.

Not a good professor but thinks he is and takes so much pride in himself that he tries to censor our voices if criticism rather than learn from them. Tests in VERY specific things and you're grade on stuff that he never covers. What a joke.

Prof. Schwartz was incredible! His lectures are interesting, discussion is promoted, and the class balances big and small assignments well. Participate!! It will improve your experience in the class and make it easy to succeed. Prof Schwartz & this class are a really great introduction to Poli Sci at SMU.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Inspirational

reviews.comment: She is mean and comments on your looks, shames the girl's bodies, and so many of her students leave their lessons crying and wanting to quit. Maybe she was good years ago now she doesn't even teach she just gives you a ton of music and then yells at you for not doing it perfectly the first time.
Vindictive and ineffective professor who creates disturbing studio dynamics that reward suck ups and punish those who express mental or bodily needs.

RECOMMENDED. Prof isn't the easiest teacher on the block but if you want to walk away from school a better singer, musician and person, Professor Hill Moore is the person for you. She gives tough love and is not afraid to tell it like it is. She's also the sweetest, most caring teacher I've ever had. I know she always has by best interests in mind.
Tough, tough, tough.

I'm sorry, but I don't get the big deal. Yes, she has ample performance experience. But she makes you feel so inferior, especially if you come to class unprepared. She makes you nervous in the studio, which obviously works against you when trying to sing. She's super "nice" outside of class, but in your lesson, she's ruthless if it's not perfect.
PROF YOU ROCK!!!!!!!!!!!

she thinks she's making a difference. during the final she would shake her head when a student would submit their exam. shed stare at the computer in the front and make comments to the other one who's just as bad. average was below a 50. joke.

We just randomly in the last week of school got 2.5 points removed off our first midterm we had months ago. You already made the class ridiculously hard because we have to teach ourselves basically, class is no help, the least you could do is give a curve. 2.5 is not a curve in the first place.

Its may and we just got 2.5 points taken from our midterm exam 1 grade. its like they purposely dont like students and try to make their lives harder. They should be giving a bigger curve not 2.5 and they STILL took that away

I wish the biology department offered more professors for this class. I would 1000% percent take any other professor. Stares at you when youre trying to take a test, doesnt know how to answer any questions, takes no accountability, her exams make no sense. If 1/4 of the class is failing it is 100% the professors fault. She is not a real professor

Instead of taking feedback negatively, own up to it and LEARN from your mistakes. Stop blaming students for not doing well on exams because we're "not studying correctly" when in reality 1/4 of the class is failing because of your lack of ability to teach. A bit unfair no? We pay thousands for you to read off slides? Own up for once

This class was meant to be an easy A for non-majors, but it didn't meet expectations. Despite studying a lot and making detailed cheat sheets, I consistently got Cs in exams. She wasn't very understanding and offered minimal extra credit. Not the worst teach, but disappointing, especially since it was my only B.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: What a waste of money. the fact we have to pay this much for a professor who can't teach is absurd and wrong. If students complain to the department, it'd be nice if they actually considered the reason why so many students feel this way. Our grades suffer for her lack of ability to teach, just wrong.

First exam was actually laughable. I don't understand how there's no other assignments to boost our grade. And we only get her as an option for this class when I would gladly take any other professor. Like reviews don't lie and she clearly doesn't know anything. My friends who had this class 4 years ago warned me of how bad a professor she is

Will become your evening nighhare. I still can't sleep because of this class. Worst professor in the world and seems to dislike students innately. Will start class complaining about rmp reviews and blame us for making her reputation what it is. Zero accountability and refuses to listen to criticism.

What a joke, she might be the only exception when I say there's no one worse than jones' genetics class. Reviews don't lie, I know multiple students who are bringing this up with the dean. Like every person I know who has taken this unfortunate class has complained about her and said they hated going. Imagine making your students HATE your class.

Avoid. She takes no accountability and blames the students for her lack of basic teaching skills. It's hilarious how a grown adult blames 19 year olds for not understanding her 5% effort slides. A literal gym coach could teach this class 100x than her and probably put in more effort in making sure students are actually comprehending everything

I'm calling it from now, all my friends told me she's going to start the class saying everyone on here complains about the course material and difficulty. That's not true at all. you can clearly see it's solely about her teaching methods, her attitude towards students, the blandness of her class, weird smile after every sentence, laughable exams
Difficult to follow, talks super super slow, its hard to know what her test questions are going to be like because it feels like minute details she tests for.

Loved this professor! She was super inspirational and smart and I learned a lot! I appreciate her care and connecting with students and her teaching was to the point and loved how she connected everything with the universe! The class was test heavy but you get to use notes and if you show up on time and turn in the work you will be okay!

Baffling how she's even a professor at this school. She can't admit to herself her teaching methods are horrible, only reads off slides, and her tests are unbearable and ridiculously hard. Like this isn't the only class students take. Having only tests in a cell bio class is hilarious, where are the other assignments? Homework should be worth more

She is the biology department's biggest joke. Absolutely no respect for students, just because you crack a couple jokes doesn't mean you're a good professor. There's no good reason we shouldn't have other assignments to help our grades considering how embarrassing this class is. Thinks her class is the only one students are taking. No extra credit

She thinks her class is the only one students are taking like get a grip. Bring your ego down, worst professor I've had in my entire life. Every one I've met in general just meeting new people even have something to say about her. No one likes her for good reason. Not sure how she's allowed to teach with that kind of attitude towards students.

She manipulates herself into thinking she's a real professor. There's a reason she has a 2.6/5 rating. A gym coach could teach this class better than her. Homework should weigh more, an essay would be a great opportunity, she truly wants students to fail because she makes the tests unbearable. Wouldn't be surprised if the good reviews are from her

She's going to start the class saying everyone on rate my professor complains about the course material and difficulty. If you actually used your eyesight you can clearly see it's solely about her teaching techniques, her rudeness towards students, the blandness of her class, and the stupidly ridiculous tests she expects 19 year olds to know 100%.

She is the worst biology professor at smu. Biggest joke, waste of my time. Does this creepy smile after every sentence, truly has little respect for students. Ridiculously hard for no reason, there's no reason we shouldn't have other assignments to help our grades. Test- based class and she makes it impossible. Then stares at you the entire test

She's okay. She cracks jokes, which is nice. She takes forever to get through lectures and her exams are very specific and more application than memorization, which is hard since this class has like no assignments aside from the very easy homework. Her content is not hard, just boring and most of her content is better explained by the textbook/yt

Batista is nice and she has some charisma to her. Worded things very straightforward and in a clear manner. However both batista and glasscock could do better with lectures. Most stuff I taught myself and just didnt go to class lol.
Part of the reason why the Pre-Medicine/Pre-Health is a joke at SMU

I LOVED LOVED LOVED Dr. Batista!! She is an amazing lecturer and makes tons of jokes, which keep the class entertaining. Cell bio is a difficult upper-level bio class, so don't expect not to put in work, but she makes it more enjoyable (she's better than Glasscock, especially when it comes to making the exams).

Batista's section is slower but also full of details that you will have to attend lecture or watch the online lecture to know. The details will be on the exams. There is textbook homework that cushions your grade. 3 exams and 1 final. This is a very detailed biology class, so be prepared to put some hours of studying in, especially for exams.

I think she's great and the course is bearable if you really pay attention to what she says during lectures. Make sure you clarify all of the context of what she's talking about; really understand the random details and she's also a little silly which is nice.

Starts by telling the class the main complaint people would say on here is that this class has so much material and difficult to memorize. Literally that's not what the complaints are about. She is very judgmental and does not lecture well at all. Makes lectures hard to stay awake

Prof Batista moves slower through content and her slides are more organized than Glasscock. You MUST pay attention during lecture and write down what she is saying since it will appear on tests. Her tests were difficult and the homework was short and easy. My only con is that you can tell she dislikes students which makes her unapproachable.
Can be pretty rude when answering questions. Tests are very specific. Must take good notes and pay attention to do sort of ok in this class.

Whenever I see her face, it ruins my day. She shouldn't be an educator. Apart from her teaching skills (!), she is also very rude and mean. She either needs to retire or stay at home for the students' well-being. As a 4.0 student, I know a good professor when I see one no matter how tough they are, and she is nowhere near a decent one.

Lacks teaching skills. Does not teach subject properly. Doesn't explain concepts to help students apply the knowledge. Belittles students, classes are one way, asks students if they have questions and without giving them time to ask, moves from one topic to another. The worst
She is one of the worst biology professors at SMU.

This was supposed to be an easy 'A' and it just was not.

Her lecture slides were screenshots of the textbook, and so boring. The homework assignments were difficult, and the tests seemed to not reflect any of the information we were learning in class.

I feel like I would of enjoyed the intro class for Biology majors more.

Very nice lady! She teaches the class well but her test questions are hard. My way to success was studying the PowerPoint slides over and over and over and to diagram everything. She pushes for the textbook readings but they don't help. The one test I got 100 in was the one I didn't read the textbook for. Overall, decent professor for a hard class.

Batista might get a bad rep for being bland with her teaching, but she gets the job done. I took her for the May term; it was a lot of work but definitely doable. You get a cheat sheet for your tests as well as the final. Your lab grade also boosts your grade. Take her for May term to get your CC science credit out fast!

Batista is really nice lady and a really good professor. She only tests on what she talks about in lecture so its a good idea to go. Her exams aren't that difficult if you know the material the question are very straight forwards. Only downside is she like to cram stuff in right before a test. Batista is definitely in the top 3 for best bio profs
The worst. First C I've gotten in my life. Boring lectures. Not helpful. Rude and doesnt gaf about anyone or anything. She's on earth to make your life hell. avoid.

Participation matter but it also matters that you get the questions she asks correctly, not just that you participated. Not an understanding teacher, I begged her to round my grade up 1 point and she wouldn't do it, even after I offered to do extra credit. Was supposed to be an easy science credit for me and was far from it. Don't recommend.

I liked her teaching but the tests seemed to be very difficult even though everything is open note. Its mostly a time constraint so I would recommend at least knowing where everything is in the powerpoints before the test. My biggest issue with her is that she grades attendance based on if you get the in class question correct which felt unfair.

Dr. Batista is a good lecturer and makes her class entertaining. Make sure to attend class because she will test you over things she says in class. Tests are difficult but not impossible: you HAVE to know the material well and be prepared to apply it instead of just regurgitating facts. Good test-taking skills are crucial for this class.

So monotone in her lectures that I would almost fall asleep every class. Attendance is mandatory and if you get the question of the day wrong, you are counted as absent. The test comes around and we've never heard of any of it even though it is an open note exam. Took the class for an easy A and did not get an A.

Dr. Batista moves so slowly through the lectures it's amazing to me how we finish chapters. However she at least tries to make the lectures interesting with memes and jokes and is pretty nice. Tests are on very specific details from the reading though
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her lectures are extremely boring and it is very hard to pay attention. Her exams (though open note on LockDown Browser) are very difficult. I printed out every lecture for open notes and still got a C? The test questions were much harder than material taught in class. Take another professor, trust me.

Took 2 courses with Batista and am literally flabbergasted by her lack of consideration towards students. Have you ever seen a bio prof speed through a chapter on the last class day and put it on the final (3350)? She also sped through a chapter in like 2 days for 3370 and I felt like half the test was on it & not the chapter we spent 2 weeks on :)

TRUE PREREQUISITE! Material learned is useful for rest of classes in bio degree. Exams are based off her TALKING. Use the slides to note everything she says, and then memorize that. I really struggled in this class. I took notes during class and had to rewatch every lecture prior to each exam. Good luck, she's nice but no BS. If I can pass, u can!
If you want to get depressed and cry everyday like me, take her!
Avoid at all costs. She makes the hardest tests to make sure no one is cheating and forgets about the fact that we are here to learn and need good grades to enter health professions.

Taught with 2 professors w/ Batista teaching 1st half and Glasscock the 2nd. As long as you know everything including all the small details mentioned in lectures and on ppt's you should be able to get an A-/A. Write everything down & definitely make flashcards. HW's - easy & boost grade. She makes lectures interesting by adding some memes too!

Skip at all costs, unless you're stuck with her because you are a biology major. In that case, my condolences. She has almost as much interest in this class as SMU does in renovating the old dorms. Can you blame her? It's cell biology! get ready for some confusing tests that she spends years on to make so that everyone has their unique little copy!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Do not buy the textbook, I made that mistake. You will never use it. Took this class for my science credit and was not bad at all. Just show up and look alive and you will be just fine. Mainly graded off of homework each week, the lab grades, and tests for the chapters. I recommend this class for sure.

Do not buy the textbook unless you just want to read for fun. Tests are based off the PowerPoints in lecture and the homework assignments. If you show up, pay attention, and participate, it is not a bad class at all. I took this for my science credit and highly recommend this class.

Dr. Batista is great! She was always super understanding. You do have to study from LECTURE. My advice is relisten to the lectures and take better notes because live lecture goes pretty fast. Her tests are really hard but studying well makes it all ok. DO NOT PROCRASTINATE. I never used the book and did well. She has some extra credit and curves.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Tests are all based off lectures, but the test questions are ambiguous. Lectures are recorded, but extra credit is offered every class. She drops 1 exam grade and is willing to help if you reach out to her. Print out lecture slides!!! Go to lectures and office hours. She has her own grading scale which is nice and a fun sense of humor.

Tests come straight from her lectures. Write down and memorize every word she says and you'll do great. She records her lectures so you can skip class, but she gives out extra credit points in class. She explains things pretty well; the book can be helpful for cofusing topics but definitely listen to her lectures. Test questions are very specific.

Pretty poor abilty to teach effectively. Her slides are next to useless on their own and her lectures are just as confusing. She unable to answer any questions outside of the slides. She'll repetitively explain a certain concept but her tests often test on a detail she mentions as an aside. Continued to teach new material 2 days before final.

Dr. Batista means well, however her tests are poorly written, with several grammatical errors, and meant to trick you. If you have a question during lecture, she either won't know or her answer won't help you. Everything on the tests is in the lectures, no book necessary. However, you must have complete and total knowledge of every small detail.

Dr. Batista is an incredible professor. She explains the material well, and she posts her lectures on Canvas, so students can listen to them again for review. She posts practice tests, gives extra credit for attendance, and has lots of office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Her tests questions are not only very detailed but very tricky. She doesn't explain things well in lecture as well. She made us take the final which was very difficult. The EC was not even that helpful. Please do your best on the previous exams and if you can try to take this class with someone else!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Her tests have both really easy questions and very detailed questions from annotations in diagrams in her slides. She made us all take the final this year, and there were 1 or 2 questions that were not explicitly taught/said in class. If you just remember all the slides, you should get an A. It's not that bad of a class overall.

During her lecture, she only reads off the slides. If you try to ask a question about something not explicitly on the slide, you're screwed because she won't be able to give you a good answer. Her tests are filled with trick questions, material not covered in class, and poor wording which puts a person who knew the information in the B range.

Always reads off of the slides and can be pretty monotone. When asked a question during lecture that cannot be answered from the slide, her answer is convoluted and seemingly unreliable. Exams filled with trick questions and grammatical errors which throw off your answer. Only saving grace for my grade was her (in-class) extra-credit opportunities.

Go to class, she gives out extra credit for attendance and participation. Memorize her slides, no need for the book. Get good grades on the term exams, you can skip the final if you have a grade you like. Pretty standard bio teacher for SMU, I enjoyed the class and the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I got an A on my third exam/final, but I failed the first exam which kept me from getting an A- in the class. Textbook diagram explanations helped. Rewrite the entire lectures (using given audios) while cross referencing slides. Annotate practice exams early on before taking actual exams. Use Garland MC/go to her office hours. Get ALL extra cred.

Batista is a good professor. She covers everything that she expects you to know in class and makes attendance extra credit. Never even bought the textbook. Make sure you get good grades on the exams so you can skip the final, which is always super-detailed and killer.

reviews.comment: Dr. Batista is an accommodating and kind professor. She often tries to lighten the lecture by throwing in jokes. The tests are solely PowerPoint-based, but there's a lot of information, so get your biology memorization skills ready. In-class "quizzes" can give you a bit of extra credit. Do well early in the class so you can skip the final.

Pay attention in class, take good notes, memorize her power points, and start listening to her recorded lectures at least a week before the tests and you'll be fine. Cell Bio is a very in depth subject and Batista does a good job of explaining everything, but don't complain when the tests are specific. The subject is hard, so don't wait to study.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I honestly really like Dr. Batista!! She does test over the details, but honestly that's part of the class. If you take really good notes in lecture you should be fine. I had to relisten to most of the lectures to cath everything she says because we cover so much info. She is very nice in office hours also.

Batista is one of the worst professors I've ever had. All she does is read off of the slides and just expects you to understand what's going on with little to no explanation. The test questions are over the most minute details and don't pertain to the big picture. She had a child in early April, so Dr. Romeo took over, who is much better.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She takes the most minute details to test you over. She doesn't test you to see if you understand course content but rather again those small minute details that are so trickily worded that you can't be sure.

I took her cell bio class over the summer, and loved it. I think cell bio is very boring, BUT she made it interesting and VERY easy to understand. Her lectures are very organized, and she speaks clearly/in layman's terms. Her tests are SOLELY off of her lecture, so listen well and study her pwrpt hard! And she does care about you, just talk to her!

She is a horrible professor. She does not teach the material very well and merely goes through the powerpoint slides. My biggest issue with her is that she shows no ounce of compassion towards her students. She is rarely willing to help students in need, and her tests are bad too. It contains questions over the littlest and most irrelevant details.

She records all her lectures which is nice because sitting in lecture is super boring. Take really good notes and study the powerpoints. A lot of questions come from the little details. Take the practice questions as an exam and read the questions carefully.  She curves the tests a little and theres pop quizzes that are extra credit!

Batista is a difficult teacher but if you literally just memorize her lectures for Cell Bio, you can make A's on the first tests and not need to take the final which is the difficult test. If something isn't clear you can refer to the Textbook easily.

Her tests are over her lecture+lab, so there are many ppts. to memorize!! She sometimes forgets what she is talking about  in lecture. Her tests are split in multiple choice, fill the blanks,short answer questions. The short answer questions are more in depth than her ppts & eventhough you think you might know it base on ppt, its still wrong!!!

Batista has very scattered lectures, and is very difficult to follow in class because she often uses vague words like "woosh" and "magic" to explain biological concepts. Her tests often pick out very slight details on the slides and are difficultly worded. It is definitely possible to do well on the tests but be prepared to memorize a ton of slides

Her exams were based on the smallest detail. For example, how is Ras attached to the plasma membrane. Flippase is an enzyme in which organelle? What toxin will keep microtubules from shrinking ? Overall, the material is not hard to learn but her test are! You really have to memorize every detail on each slide. Each chapter has over 50 slides.

Batista is straightforward in a sense. Everything she says in class will be on the exam, and don't bother buying the textbook for the class (I never opened mine). Make sure to listen to all her lecture recordings, read the slides, and take detailed notes. If you don't, she has random specific detail questions on her exam that will be your downfall.

Reviews here are a little too harsh in my opinion. Batista is pretty clear about what you need to know and the class isn't particularly difficult. Tests are straightforward. I made high A's on the first two tests so far with little studying. Textbook use and attendance is by no means necessary. Just read the PowerPoint!

Her lectures are kind of clear (I think) and you feel like you grasp every aspect of the lectures, but her exams are tricky or kind of hard (for me at least. I got 60 on each exam) The class average is 80 in every exam. She gives a lot of curving points (5-8 points) Many people said her exams are hard. READ BEFORE CLASS CUZ THERE'S TOO MUCH INFO!

No idea what she's saying the whole lecture time. Not even to the first test yet and I can already tell this class is going to be a drag. Clearly doesn't understand the material when she lectures and she's failed to competently answer a single question any student has answered this entire month. Not very fun.

Her cell bio class is about average. When I took it she was very pregnant so she was a little scatterbrained. Her lectures were straightforward and followed the book. You could get an A without reading much, just look at her lectures. Good attendance will get you a curve or exempt from the final.

She was disorganized, but of course she was with my class being the first one she taught at SMU. However, she did curve the class at the end. Final wasn't insane, and it pulled my grade up a full letter grade. Go to class or get signed in.

She was absolutely AWFUL! DO NOT..I REPEAT DO NOT take this class! The class was awful, and the tests were impossible. I made a D and I have only made B's and A's in my other biology courses. SHE'S AWFUL!

Worst professor I've ever had! Her class is so hard and the tests are IMPOSSIBLE! I had to drop the class. She should be teaching at the graduate level because thats what she expects and the types of research questions she asks. If you did not get an A in BIO 1 and 2 FORGET IT!

I was incredibly disappointed with this professor. She was disorganized and honestly had no idea what she was talking about. She was not helpful at all when it came to questions and could not answer them due to her cluelessness about the subject. I would not recommend this professor.

No good. She's more concerned about what people think of her and being "fun" in class than making tests that make ssence and match her lectures. Cheat sheets don't help when the material taught has nothing to do with the exams.

Worst teacher. Lectures are slow and horrible, teacher makes the class very boring, and no one wants to participate. Do not take this teacher.
You hear different things and it's because she's the best of the worst possibilities. Doesn't teach well but tests are online so easy A with that and extra credit.

She's okay, lots of extra credit plus the tests aren't hard so easy A, but if you actually want to learn econ she's not for you. Definitely one of the better econ professors on campus, but that doesn't say much. Two homeworks due every monday and you get three attempts.

The best teacher in the Econ department at SMU

Grades do not align with effort or intellect
extremely boring class, professor is rude and dismissive when you contact about attendance/due dates and treats the class like they are elementary schoolers with attendance.
An objectively terrible professor.

reviews.comment:
The workload, overly harsh grading, and utter lack of teaching quality was completely inappropriate for

This professor is all the wrong. Fake nice only to lure you in then slams you at the end enjoying your suffering when you can't get into cox bc of her one grade. Sporadic teaching, impossible exams that don't match, and horrible, painful lecture ALL DAY that you're forced to attend.

Watch out comments are disappearing again cause she's more obsessed with her reputation than her teaching. Can't teach worth jack s and your grade will suffer for it. Nothing on the exams line up to her lectures and she baseless accuses people of cheating

DO NOT TAKE THIS TEACHER. None of her lectures match up with anything on tests, I just relied on the book, and even when doing that, the tests still had nothing to do with what she told us to read. Being better than ther other crappy options ain't quite the compliment. She never stops talking and it's so annoying. Cheat sheets no help because she doesn't teach what's in the exam so you have to put the whole book on them which is impossible. Extra credit is built into the course to make her the “good guy” at end of semester. This is known.
Long boring lectures but better than alternative professors. She is willing to work with students. allows a cheat sheet on tests. 1 group presentation. lots of extra credit.

I never thought I would post a review until I had the displeasure of taking this professor. Lectures are nearly incomprehensible. reviews.comment: The problem with Mia is that she's all a façade. She fails to teach the subject in terms of what will be on the exams, wastes our time with her clapping/rallying antics trying to distract us from our grades so we still "like" her, then bombs the scores at the end so she can meet the department requirements.
