She was a bad teacher this past semester and I was so disappointed as I thought she was supposed to the better one. Regret not taking another Professor.

There is no point being in class and nobody pays attention, which is even more distracting as she has no classroom management with her being so people-pleasing. Self study the book then do al the extra credit. That's the only combination that makes As in her class. Better, take Li.

The cheat sheet for her test should be all the information and examples from her lecture slides. Little words and phrases will be referenced so dont overlook any of the info even if it seems unimportant.

Don't even bother trying to guess the exam questions, it won't work, and you'll just end up dropping the class or failing. If you actually study, you can do really well. She's super understanding and helps a lot. If you need extra help, definitely go to her review sessions!

The material isn't hard but lectures are slide heavy, her antics get old really quick and you have to show up. Tests cover 3-4 units with bonus questions which are mostly unrelated to the material. Most students use chatgpt or don't pay attention. Take advantage of extra credit chances, there are lots. You can also use cheat sheets on the tests.

reviews.comment: Great overall professor, made the learning process so simple even though the course material was extremely long and difficult. I would recommend going to ask for help directly, after class or just by sending an email if you begin struggling. She helped me a lot with any of my questions in or outside of class.

Truly not a good professor when you consider what she teaches and what she tests. The complaints of these two critical fields not aligning are fair. She then supplements her poor teaching with massive extra credit right as evaluations come out so we don't bomb her in them. It worked for years, now we're trying to warn all others. Take BW I you can.

Professor Ahlberg is kind and approachable. If you face difficulties in class, reach out to her—she's always willing to help. The course is challenging, but if you attend class and complete the assignments, you can do well. She also gives small bonuses for good attendance to improve your overall score.

Reads her notes to you, that's the class. She grades so badly that she has to offer extra credit to get us to pass and tests are all vocab literally written word-for-word from her texts. Just write everything she reads down and get someone who already took her to help with quizzes/exams.

She lectures non-stop, with a focus on trying to be cute and clever and liked by students a quarter of her age. Clearly, she does not teach so be prepared for her lecture to be an unorganized mess and chaotic with no point and nothing on the exam to be spoken of.

I enjoyed taking her class as I found it to not be that hard. She lectures a lot, but I never really paid attention. Her tests do have hard questions, but as long as you write down information from her slides on your cheat sheet, you will be fine. She gives a lot of extra credit, which will boost your grade a lot.

Mandatory attendance in this day and age when we're paying 90k/yr is ridiculous, especially if, as a professor, you utterly refuse to teach anything that is going to be in the exam. Either we self-teach and get the freedom necessary to do so or you do your gd job. Can't have it both ways MiA.

Do not take Mea's class. She doesn't teach, and her tests are ridiculously tough. The attendance policy is unfairly strict. She's disorganized and often unprepared. If you value your GPA and sanity, stay far away from her courses.

reviews.comment: Forces us to come to class when there

Pretty straighforward if you just attend class, and review the slides before exams. Don't really even have to pay attention during class, but be there for attendance. One group project, but nothing too difficult. Lots of extra credit offered. One of the better Econ professors.

Forces you to attend the most nauseating lectures known to man, and never lets you out early. The "cheat sheet" is useless cause the exams are all from a bank she never teaches, then she whips out all the extra credit as instructor evaluations are being completed so you don't bomb her, then your GPA tanks. Because she does not make her own test, the material given on an exam is much more different than what we learn in class. The professor will often provide examples for problems which are not viewed on the tests.

I LOVE MEA AHLBERG!!! I was so excited to go to her class every day. She lectures every class for the whole time, but if you complete the problems & applications/do work outside of class you will do well. She offers lots of extra credit (2 points - perfect attendance, 2 points - extra credit discussion boards, 2 points - high activity on Mindtap)
Lectures are obscure. Wording on exams was confusing. Avoid if possible.

I loved her. She's the goat. So many extra credit points available if you are willing to be all in. Its not an easy class though, and probably was the most work for me. I ended with an 89 before extra credit, then a 96 after credit was applied! she never failed to make me laugh and be engaged

She does an awful job of instructing and never holds office hours. You are expected to teach yourself everything as what she talks about has nothing to do with the exams. She tries to be cool and cute but instead comes off as desperate to be liked by undergrads when she should be spending that time teaching like the adult she is. None of the econ profs are any good though so good luck with that.

reviews.comment:
Do not take this professor. Really interesting material but he does a very poor job of teaching it. Tests 
are inconsistent with lecture material and he is incredibly hard to meet with outside of class.

Has a really bad attitude about teaching and toward students. I asked why she couldn't make test questions herself rather than using a test bank and she pounded her fists down on the table angrily and said she has many priorities. Guess teaching isn't one of them, maybe she's here for research, but just avoid her lest your GPA suffers.

I was able to handle econ so I figured I would give this a try, well I could never have been more wrong. I have never dropped a course at SMU before until I took her, hands down STAY AWAY. reviews.comment: Very enthusiastic! Interactive slides and lectures. Weekly homework with only 4 major tests. Use Cengage Test prep questions to prepare for the test, and you'll be fine. NO FINAL!! Do the discussion boards for extra credit.
She is a great teacher; study from cengage and you will do very well. Do the HW and quizzes on time.

Tons of drama with limited instruction. To succeed you must teach yourself everything in the book or you will not succeed. She does not teach anything on the exam, does her song and dance to distract us from this fact, while also forcing attendance compliance when that time could otherwise be used to self-teaching. Needs to go and NOW. Hate her sm

One of the most time consuming courses at SMU. The homework is unhelpful (get Chegg), and even Mea struggles with solutions. Notes are allowed for tests, but with 20 random questions from a 400+ bank, they're pointless. Lectures are irrelevant to the tests, and attendance is mandatory with no exceptions for illness.

Am a 4.0 student and I have never gotten grades like these even looking it up and you find your answers are correct and marked wrong. She spends more time trying to be "cute" with her mannerisms and demeanor than she does teaching, then tries to distract you with her clapping bit, meanwhile slams your gpa at the end after evaluations close, trust.

She tries to distract you with all her antics like the flying pig in San Marcos, meanwhile creating tests that have no bearing with lectures cause she uses old stock material since she doesn't put any effort in on her own. Then, tries to regain our sympathy with false curves toward the end so we don't bomb her evals, while still bombing our grades.

Does these "clapping" antics as a way to distract you from the C.

Prof Alhberg is incredible! She is very accessible for office hours, provides extra credit to nearly every exam and final grade for perfect attendance and "green level" in Mindtap (the textbook), worth up to three bonus points all together. The two semesters I had her were truly rewarding and the class is engaging and well-organized.Take her 100%!!

Dr. Ahlberg puts a lot of passion into her lectures to make them interesting and fun. Participation is required, but she gives some leeway and is very communicative. This was hands-down the absolute worst course I have ever taken, and she was hands-down the least helpful, and worst profs I have ever had the displeasure of meeting. Do not take any classes with her. She yaps nonstop ab nothing to do with the class then her clapping antics try to distract you from her not doing her job. Wish I could give a 0.

Plays the same games she does in 1311/12 with ridiculous exams then extra credit at the end to save her rmp page and student evaluation. If you want to take a class where you are completely on your own for studying and still ruin your GPA then look no further you have found her.

It doesn't matter how much you study tests are impossible.. Horrible and militant about attendance for no reason as coming to class does no good. More obsessed with attendance and cheating than running a good fair course. Terrible teacher, terrible experience, any other option is better, take it from me as I have had both now.

Prof. Ahlberg is the best Econ prof I have ever taken.She's so sweet and care about her students.Helps us in anyway to succeed in her courses. Handwritten cheat sheets are permitted during exams.

Professor Ahlberg is smart, empathetic, charismatic, and funny, making her lectures interesting. However, the class is challenging, especially in a short term. Obsessed with attendance but definitely not her own teaching.

Avoid at all costs though none of your options are good here.  She makes the hardest tests to make sure no one is cheating and forgets about the fact that we are here to learn and need good grades to enter cox.

very scattered lectures, and is very difficult to follow in class because she often uses vague words to explain concepts. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Online Savvy

Tests come from a bank of about 300 questions or so but none of them are on what she taught because she draws them from the text bank rather than lectures

She changes her mind quite often throughout the semester. And while she will respond to your questions, she does not give clear responses.When we do well on tests she makes the next test completely impossible to do well on. None of her information from lectures will be on the exams.

By far one of the most difficult classes I have taken. Study for hours and never got higher then B on the exams, usually Cs. There are only a few exams and attendance is mandatory. Its all lectures so you attempt to pay attention only to find that nothing in lecture will be on the exam. Terrible professor, terrible class.

Test heavy. Lectures awful and useless, confusing with no clear outline and an hour of her just reading slides. The tests are just ridiculous. The class only gets more infuriating further down the semester. Good luck if you get stuck with her.

Dr Ahlberg is the best professor in the Economics department at SMU. Fun and engaging teaching style. She deeply cares about her students' learning and performance. She has inspired me to become an economist. I will be declaring Economics in Spring 2024

Ms. Ahlberg was hands-down the rudest, least available, least helpful, and worst profs I have ever had the displeasure of meeting. Do not take any classes with her. Our class averages for exams were all below -60%. Wish I could give a 0.

Cannot teach for the life of her, most boring lectures read from her prefabricated slides, then you test on entirely unrelated prefabricated questions she takes from Mindtap A+ test prep but never taught.
She is not a good teacher and does not even try to help you learn what you will be tested on. She curves your grade at the end but you study the whole semester for no reason.
amazing professor. she is the goat.

Professor is rude beyond belief. She is overly strict to a degree that is entirely unnecessary and does not aid students in the way that a professor should. She also shows very little respect for her students. Grades are by whim and whimsy depending on how much you are likely to complain, so complain a lot if you get stuck with her.

Worst teacher I have had at SMU. Tests are impossible, no matter how much you study.  Very pointless class, makes it unnecessarily difficult then tries to deify herself by curving everyone's final grade an insane amount so you don't complain. Worked for a while but now that we all know, we are pissed that we don't just have a good teacher instead.
If youre reading this and wondering if you can take this class and put in a decent amount of effort and thus do decent in the class, you are wrong.

Look I think she is a nice person but does not do a good job at teaching. She does not teach what is on the exam so everyone is blindsided by them and does poorly. Then, to save her own skin so don't poorly review her (she watches these constantly), she hands out all these bonus points and final curve. Went from a B- to a B+ overnight but stressful

Did not enjoy this course at all, forces you to be in class but doesn't bother teaching the material you need to know. Acts like she knows the topics until you question her when she gets very defensive and can't answer your questions. Not a good teacher and I notice that when she has a ton of bad comments, there are a pile of sudden good comments.

Worst course experience I have had at SMU with a bad professor who randomly assigns grades with the wind. Find someone who can teach or else take your chances not know what grade you will end up with.

I think her class is super fun, but I definitely could have done better. You can attend her lectures during another class period if you can't make ur scheduled time for any reason. I did pretty badly on 1 or 2 tests and still ended with a decent grade. She also lets you have a front-and-back notes sheet for tests and gives plenty of extra credit.
Great teacher for political econ, really cares about her students and wants you to win.

reviews.comment: One of the best teachers at SMU!! So much fun. NEED TO TAKE!

Unsupportive and unreliable, a detriment to students' learning. You will stress all semester not knowing your grade until it is randomly bestowed upon you. Makes no sense. Avoid this class if possible.
Instructor is incredibly difficult to deal with and a stressful experience. No class plan, no interest in hearing other opinions, and no set method for grading.

She is the worst.  Now, at the end and after finals, we are entering her reverse-the-villain-arc where she unprofessionally, unreliably, unpredictably increases grades at the very end so you don't poorly review her. You know what would be even better? Teaching the material so we can reliably EARN our grades. The pain and nonsense of not knowing.
The master of gaslighting, fails to teach what is on the exams, then pretends to not understand why we all don't do well on them.

There is no point in coming to class because she doesn't teach what is going to be on the test, but she militantly enforces attendance even though most of us are upperclassman. I do not understand how she received the "good" professor reputation as I have found her lazy in her teaching but maybe it is because all the others are just that bad.
She always try to do everything she can to help you succeed with the class. Great teacher that really cares about her students.

The course includes 4 tests, 1 group project, plenty of homework, quizzes, and assignments. Attendance is strictly enforced (class beg & end). Tests are textbook-based, not lecture-based, but handwritten cheat sheets are allowed.  100% attendance, green color in textbook, & discussion board participation for extra credit(+5%). A is manageable

Refuses to actual teach a real course despite the majority of her students doing poorly. Instead relies on crap textbook resources she stands there and reads literally verbatim to us every day in the most boring way possible, then uses crap tests she copies from the book but specifically those not covered. Horrible.

All the recent reviews are what you will experience: random unrelated teaching, tests of no taught content, sarcastic clapping to distract you from your poor performance and evaluations.

reviews.comment: She's worthless in lecture, doesn't teach anything useful and just reads straight from the slides, seems unprepared daily about what she is going to say, then expects us to be sudden economists on the exam. My biggest regret, don't make the same mistake.

She puts on this fake nice act, but its all a facade. I mean the average test scores speak for themselves - they're abysmal. And just when you're about to give her a bad evaluation, she suddenly offers extra credit to save her own skin. It's manipulative and sickening.

She rushes through lectures that don't even show up on the tests, and guess what? I got my lowest grade ever last semester. Save yourself the trouble and steer clear of her class. Seriously, I wish someone had warned me but I believed what other people had said about her being the better option. SHE IS NOT THE GOOD OPTION.

She contradicts herself left and right, her tests are ridiculously hard, and she expects us to do online homework in class instead of actually teaching us anything. Nothing lines up, and it's a miracle if you come out of this course with a decent grade. My GPA took a hit because of her, and I'm still bitter about it.

reviews.comment: This class is an absolute disaster, It's the worst I've ever taken. After two years, I got my lowest grade. The teacher doesn't even bother to teach, just regurgitates textbook stuff that doesn't match her lectures or tests. And if you dare criticize her, she gets defensive real quick.
Her grading? Totally subjective! You could know all the material she teaches and still end up with a lousy B. I'm used to straight A's, but thanks to her, my GPA's taking a nosedive.

Mea is one of the best profs Ive had out of the 2 semesters Ive been here. Up to 5 points added to your final grade if you do all the extra credit (thats insane). If you question shes happy to help, you can tell she really cares about her students. Overall if you come to class and pay decent attention while keeping up with the HW you will do fine.

Stay AWAY, at least the other teach while she apes a performance through reading slides alone. She is horrible and I can't warn you hard enough to STAY AWAY. Then, after the most lackluster performance in teaching, she starts up with the "nice" act and rains extra credit so you don't hurt her teaching evals, all she cares about.

Her sycophants need to stop lying about her because they whole reason we are in this position having signed up for her class is because we believed the good reviews. We were wrong. Stay away from this one if you even value your GPA, SHE IS THE WORST.

Dr. Ahlberg is the single most caring professor I have ever had at SMU. Economics is hard, but Dr. Ahlberg makes it possible to succeed. You have to work hard, learn the material, and you cannot cheat your way through the class, but Dr. Ahlberg wants her students to succeed and does everything she can to help them. TAKE HER!!!!!!!!!!!

Worst professor of my life, lowest grade of my life, worst course experience i can't believe we pay for this. Cannot teach for the life of her, the most boring lectures read from her prefabricated slides, then you test on entirely unrelated prefabricated questions she takes from Mindtap A+ test prep but never taught.

Everything you may have heard about her being the "easier" or "better" one is absolutely BS. She has changed and apparently in order to grade more evenly to the other sections. The difference is that at least the other sections have a professor who actually tries rather than standing there reading off the slides and no one can even bear to get thru
Among all the professors I've had, this one stands out as the absolute worst.
DO NOT BE FOOLED.  She is a terrible professor and and so is her course, entirely made up of textbook resources that she doesn't even teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Some people complain about tests because its easy to get HW answers online and get As on the hw without learning anything but if you do this then you will be less prepared for the test. If you at least half try and study a a little you will be fine. On each test you get a full 8.5x11 note sheet, and there are plenty of extra credit opportunitie

DO NOT TAKE HER!! I heard that she was a really easy teacher but that's not true. Her tests are impossible and the cheat sheets won't even help you. All the information on her slides are not even on the tests. Her lectures are so boring and she just reads off the slides while no one pays attention. This class was my lowest grade of my entire life.

She is an inaccessible professor who doesn't do her job teaching us the things we need to know to be successful. Tests have gotten ridiculously impossible and make no sense with trick questions you've never seen before, prof hostile to questions. If you hate yourself, take this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor used to be good but she is no longer and is to be as avoided as the other unnamed one, there is one remaining decent mac/mic prof and you are not looking at her profile, take ew if you want someone who is a skilled professor at teaching the material and has fair exams. This woman ruined my entire semester.

She is a very unskilled lecturer, does not teach to the test, leaves students confused as she is inconsistent and defensive when you ask questions in class, She prides herself on being one of the best teachers of the department and school yet is among the worst i have ever had as you learn nothing in class and have to teach yourself everything.

She does nothing but lecture on unrelated materials that will have nothing to do with her exams, and you will not do well on them becuase you have no idea what to study for. Lowest grade I ever received from her class. She is also extremely defensive to criticism on here and clearly tries to spin damage control, also onstantly contradicts herself.

Her exams are a tough because she basically makes the questions up, they are not over materials she teaches and you learn nothing in class that will help. There is no alignment between course material and exams, she is obsessed with her reputation on here more than she is with her teaching ability. Used to be easier but now just as hard as tania.
Absolute worst. If you get her switch out as soon as possible. good luck to whoever is in her class.

She does offer extra credit and is relatively nice, but her lectures and tests do not align. You practically have to teach yourself entire units, and pray that you get a C on the exam. She's really the only feasible option first year econ, which is why people like her over tania or wheaton.
Terrible.

Class time is totally wasted and she forced you to be there, her tests will absolutely decimated your gpa but she does it in a sneaky way so you are too far along to drop. There are no good options here but she somehow makes it the worse with her smiling and clapping like a gd seal as she does it. I regret fighting to take her, advice: Wheaton

Great teacher, has great lectures and cares about her students. She offers extra credit to help students out. The tests aren't the easiest, but if you study and do your work she is the teacher you want to have for econ.

Painfully unclear when in her emails and directions when asked for clarification, like she didn't even bother to hear or read what you were asking, runs through lectures that never show up on the tests, lowest grade of last semester and by far. Stay away and take someone else, you've been warned.

She cares deeply about her student's success and is always willing to help as long as you don't wait until the day before the exam. Her class is lecture-heavy and she moves pretty quickly, but all around she's a great professor and wants you to do well.

She was a super confusing teacher who constantly contradicted herself, tests were a lot harder then they needed to be, homework is online and she makes us do that in class instead of actually teaching, the work in class won't match the tests which will mess up your grade like it did mine, overall just really really bad course that hurt my gpa

Worst class I had to date, by far lowest grade I received after two years of classes taken here. She does not teach at all, uses textbook materials rather than creating her own so they never line up with her "lectures" and neither will her tests, very opinionated on topics she should be mentioning in class and, highly defensive to criticism
Vvery was an excellent teacher and was very helpful to the entirety of our class, which enabled every one of us to try our best.

Professor Ahlberg was very communicative about what would be in tests and quizzes throughout the semester and even gave many opportunities for extra credit. Her lectures were very effective and I enjoyed her class a lot. MUST take her micro and macro classes if your a freshman.

the GOAT of micro and macro econ courses at SMU, one of my favorite professors to date, and overall a very genuine and caring person. I would retake her class in a heartbeat. Plenty of extra credit opportunities.

she is over the top about attendance and her tests do not AT ALL match what she lectures on cause she uses premade materials rather than creating her own, used to be okay but she has definitely gotten harder to the point i regreted taking her
Professor Ahlberg was awesome to have. She made lectures fun and was very understanding whenever an issue came up. She is a great teacher and the concepts were very easy to understand with her help.

This class ruined my 4.0. Tests make up nearly all of your grade and her lectures do not help in preparing for them. Notes are littered with unnecessary details that won't be on the test and are completely unorganized. Be prepared to teach yourself and spend a lot of time reading the textbook. I took her because of what I read below & regret it.
I loved Professor Ahlberg as a person and the class itself was pretty easy but the tests are nothing like what she teaches.

Delivers an unrelenting barrage of opinion that has nothing to do with her exams, which you will do poorly on like i did. Lowest grade I ever received was in this course and she is extremely aversive to criticism, clearly, and constantly contradicts herself leaving us all confused. Take literally anyone else but her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: If you ask for help she just confuses you more and tells you to do online exercises. Lack of clear instructions and material, gets extremely offended if you make any suggestion at all, cannot take any suggestions for improvement at all. When lecturing makes constant mistakes, provides incorrect info repeatedly.  Avoid this professor do not take.

Professor Ahlberg was really good at keeping in mind everyone that was apart of her course. She expects students to offer their feedback and advice good and bad and uses it to make the course better even though it was an amazing experience with great lectures and even better teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors at SMU! Professor was great at providing the class with important details we should keep in mind ahead of exams. She really cared about the well being of the class and expects everyone to show up with a great attitude.

WAAAAYYY too much work for the payout, confusing, nonsensical lectures that aren't connected to what you get graded on and she does not connect concepts during class and leaves us all confused. Did not provide any feedback so you don't know how to do better and irritatingly disorganized course. Strongly do not recommend taking her for anything.

Economics of Human Resources was a great class with Professor Ahlberg. She brought a positive energy and great lectures to each and every class. She did not read off any notes and her visual presentations were tremendous in learning about different topics. I would highly recommend her for any economics course!

Professor Ahlberg was an excellent teacher to have as a freshman entering college. Her support and feedback to students makes her one of the best lecturers for both Micro and Macro Economics. She offers several opportunities of extra credit that allow students to improve their grades by a whole letter if willing to do a little extra work.

Naw skip her, this was not a good course nor professor and I took her based on her rating. Doesn't teach what she tests on, uses trick questions, makes the tests harder if any of us actually do well, painfully unclear when students ask for clarification  Lowest grade of semester and by far. Stay away and take someone else. Consider yourself warned

The worst experience of my life, totally unflexible and reads her notes to you, that's the class. She grades so badly that she has to offer extra credit to get us to pass and it's all literally lecture from her poorly read notes. I don't know how she has such high ratings but it is not because she can teach. STAY AWAY FROM HER.

Horrible. Run now before its too late. Mea is all over the place in her lectures, they make no sense, and nothing on the tests does she cover. She refuses to help when students have questions by acting like she didn't understand the question, is severely opinionated, angry towards students. Blames students for "not studying" if they ask a question.

The best professor, if you can take her for Econ I highly recommend. She truly wants you to do well in the class and makes meeting with her extremely easy. Helped me with my grade when I wanted to see what I could do to improve for next time. As long as you go to class, do the work, and show effort you will do well in the class. Highly recommend!

Mrs. Ahlberg is a very good professor. She gives many extra credit opportunities to increase your grades and explains concepts well if you pay attention in class. She genuinely cares about helping you do your best in her class and I would definitely retake her. I strongly suggest that you take her if you are doing Micro.

Took her because of her ratings but they can't be for real. She's the most incompetent professor I have had to date and more like a community college prof with her nannying style of teaching and incessant yapping. They're all so bad at this school so good luck.

Not the best teacher but an easy class to succeed in. Tests are pulled from a bank of the quiz questions and test sheet allowed. Make a shared google doc with about 20 people in the class to create the question bank. Def take her for econ over anyone else.

Decent prof, except nothing she teaches is on the exams. Be sure to buy Chegg for homework help, and clear your weekend to study for exams. You have to use a cheat sheet, but the questions come from a question bank, so you get some really random ones. The class requires too much out of class effort, which is most people's complaints.

Dr. Ahlberg is the absolute best. Her real passion for teaching really shows with her great attitude and kindness she has for everyone. She is super understanding and a true beam of light. She offers extra credit that helps and is a must-take if you are taking economics at SMU. She is the best. Put in the work and you will get an A.
I really enjoyed her class. She is an amazing teacher. I highly recommend her has a economics professor.

Blowoff class, you don't learn anything in the lectures and homework can easily be done with Chegg. Exams are super easy with a good notes cheat sheet. Just copy friends every time. Loads of extra credit opportunities. If you want an easy class, I would highly recommend taking this course. If you actually want to learn econ take another prof.

Professor Ahlberg was super helpful outside of the class. She gives out tons of Extra Credit and you get note sheet on Exams. You will do well if you utilize your note sheet correctly. Definitely one of the better options for ECO 1311.

Professor Ahlberg was my saving grace freshman year. If you are taking micro and macro your freshman year you HAVE to take her class. She offers so many opportunities improve your grades and is very understanding of any issues you may have outside of class that interfere with it. Seriously the best.

Ahlberg is very caring and passionate about her role as a teacher, but her class does not set up students for success and to learn. People will tell you to take her because she is easy and gives extra credit, which is true for the most part, but in the long run it will not be worth it. Studying is time consuming and you just study to take the test.

Genuine good person! Wishes for her students to succeed in her class and provides many feasible extra credits to improve their grades. Tests are easy if you use your cheat sheet correctly, her PPTs and Canvas quizzes are extremely helpful for the tests! It is by no means an easy class, prepare to study and weekly work.

She's an awesome person and is caring but she teaches straight out of the textbook. All our tests and HW assignments are also all out of the textbook. Her lectures are also quite literally straight out of the textbook. BUT she offers a ton of extra credit opportunities and is so accessible outside of the class to help you and is super kind.

Don't be fooled by these reviews you have been warned. I don't know why these are so high other than the other econ chocies are somehow worse but i would take one of them over this one. She lectures nonstop on stuff that won't be on the exams, too lazy to create her own materials and uses mindtap, which is why nothing aligns. Take someone ELSE.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Nice lady, and offers lots of extra credit opportunities in her class. Decent teacher, but grades you off MindTap hours, and the program often glitches/has issues, so be ready for that. Test questions were either really hard or really easy, so grades will widely vary from test to test. Tests are also open note.

ahlberg=goat. she's awesome and super funny. she goes through the content fast but if you pay attention you should be able to understand. minimal homework and it helps reinforce understanding very well. tests are 25 questions and pretty straightforward + there's practice tests you can do which are very similar to the test. 100000% would recommend
Solid choice

Her class is very lecture-heavy and uses a lot of mindtap for grades and textbook stuff. She gives ample opportunities to earn extra credit and provides students with many ways to be successful in the class.

I was fooled by the ratings so I'm speaking out so you do not have to be. Impossible tests that don't align with her lectures, over hyper and brags about what a good teacher she is when she's only the more popular one because all others are somehow even worse options.

She's excellent to just chat with, above being a great professor. Took her for both 1311 and 1312 I would say to definitely find a study group so you can be prepared for the tests, which take questions from the Canvas quiz question bank-I did not do that so my grade was not stellar.

Overall, amazing professor!

Dr. Mea Ahlberg is a great professor and is very passionate about her subject. She teaches very well and cares about students. Beware of her tardy and absence policy and complete homework on time as these ended up dropping my grade due to incomplete homework and absences. Great teacher overall and very personable and knowledgeable.

Absolutely love Mea. Took her for a 4 week summer course because I failed Tania's class last spring... she was able to teach so much more content in such little time and cares about your understanding of the material and your well-doing in her class. Attendance is important but she is very understanding and doesnt expect you to be a perfect.

She is mainly lecture based but she does her best to make them enjoyable. I learned a lot in her class, she really tries to give real world examples with everything so you can better understand everything you are learning. A lot of quiz questions can be recycled on the exams except the essay questions, but she will help give a little prep for those

Good lectures, gives extra credit and helps students try to get an A. Attendance is mandatory but you can do other work while she teachs. The lectures are posted on Canvas. The quizzes are easy and the HW isn't too hard. The main 4 exams are what you should definitely study for.
there are a lot of lectures, sometimes the lectures didnt match up with the tests which were hard, but she does offer a lot o extra credit and overall cares a lot about her students

Mea Ahlberg is an extremely caring professor who is clearly passionate about economics. 
Summary:
- Mindtap significant portion of grade (Easy, but stay on top of work)
- Generous extra credit opportunities (Nearly 7 points added to my final grade)
- Cheat sheets worked for half of the semester, but I recommend studying as the questions changed

Professor Ahlberg is absolutely amazing! Took her for ECO3355 and immediately enrolled in her summer course as well as I really enjoyed her lecture style and class format. could have easily gotten an A as the class is not difficult, but you do have to work for your grade. She is understanding and cares for each and every student. CHOOSE HER!

Professor Ahlberg is amazing! She has helped me so much in Econ and I know so much more about the subject because of her! I still remember a portion of her class with Inelastic and Elastic graphs from 6 months ago! She is amazing!

the only professor to take for 1311 + 1312. hands out a ton of extra credit (I got 5 points added to my final grade). you absolutely have to attend class, as you only get 2 skips. ECO1311 and ECO 1312 are Instructor Staff on my.smu so make sure you pick the MoWeFr in umph 241 to get her as your prof

Dr. Ahlberg is really passionate about the course material during lecture and provides lots of resources to study ahead of exams. Attendance, weekly homework and quizzes keep you engaged with the class; as long as you stay on track, you should be just fine and get a good grade. Would definitely recommend Dr. Ahlberg, especially for ECO majors!
Really nice!!!!!!!!!

Dr. Ahlberg is one of the best professors here at SMU. I have had her for two semesters now and her class was always engaging. Her lectures are funny and insightful and the online textbook we used helped reinforce what we learned in class. I am going to miss not taking her class. Best ECON professor out there.

Dr. Ahlberg is one of SMU's best professors. While the class I was in was just created during Spring 2023 and needs a little changing this has been the third class I have had with her. She genuinely cares about her students and brings such a positive light and energy to class. Her Macroeconomics and Money & Banking classes are great to take.

Mea Ahlberg is the nicest human on earth. She will do whatever you need to help you do well. Use the textbook and make sure you do all the activiites so you can get into green for mind tap (textbook). Tests arent too hard,not too much work, attendance is mandoatory bnut if you miss your section that day you can go to another section! Take her!!!

Professor Ahlberg is very kind. Tons of extra credit. She is lecture heavy but is very interactive in class. It is very easy to stay engaged and understand material. I advise buying chegg if you end up taking Prof Ahlberg. It will help you get assignments done and understand material. Bottom line, give some sort of effort and you will do well.

Mea Ahlberg is an absolute GOAT. You have 4 exams and no final. Attendance is mandatory, but take it as a study hall if you need it. The tests come directly from a test bank and she gives plenty of extra credit opportunities though discussion board questions and textbook engagement level. If you do your work, you will be rewarded with an A no doubt

Professor Ahlberg is a great professor. In a course whose design makes it difficult to control the format of the tests, Prof Ahlberg offers lots of room for growth despite not doing well on a major assignment. She is a teacher who deserves your respect, because she will respect you even if you make her life difficult.

Professor Albherg structured the class with two lectures a week and one work day. The lectures were fast and covered lots of material, but she did a good job of emphasizing the most important aspects. Handed out TONS of extra credit, she just wanted her students to succeed and get good grades! Best prof for 1312

Honestly mea ahlberg is one of the best teachers I have had at SMU. I felt like she truly cared about me and wanted everyone to do as well as they could. She gave so many options for extra credit and doing better in the class. As long as you listen to the lectures and take notes you will do well in this class.
The best con teacher at smu

Dr. Ahlberg is a great lecturer. There are four exams and no final. She pulls some of her test questions from the take home quizzes. You are also allowed to have a cheatsheet. Do not completely rely on the past quiz questions. Many of the students who did worse relied heavily on the past quiz questions. Make sure to understand the material.
Easy enough if you figure out how the class works. Attendance is taken in every class, and even family emergencies are not excused. If you take this class- Buy Chegg.

Mea Ahlberg changes her mind about her syllabus quite often throughout the semester. She responded to her emails pretty quickly, but does not give clear responses. If student do very well on tests, she will make the next test almost completely impossible to do well on. None of her information from lectures will be on the exams.

Ahlberg is a very energetic and caring professor, but her class is lecture heavy. The probs and apps, and outside quizzes are easy and help with points! Her exams are from a test bank but have gotten harder over time and are on lockdown browser now. She takes attendance every class, so you do have to be there, but always the same lecture format.

Dr. Ahlberg is an interesting professor who cares about her students. You'll clap for random things but play along, it's a nice stress reliever. Only piece of advice: get a shared doc together with the HW quiz answers. They are from the exam banks and, once you have enough answers, your A is almost guaranteed.
this woman is amazing and get ready to clap for random stuff.

She is the BEST TEACHER EVER! If you need to take economics at SMU Professor Ahlberg is the way to go. Only four tests and homework is fairly easy if you stay on top of it. For the tests I recommend getting in groups with your friends and look over all your guys quizzes and make sure you understand each answer in the quizzes she gives you!

Professor Ahlberg cares about her student's success and is available for support.  Required disciplined daily work, class attendance, and stretched my learning skills; it was a very good experience.  I would enroll again in any of her classes.

Prof. Ahlberg was amazing. Loved her class so much. I do have to say that you will definitely need to spend some time outside of the class to complete work but it's not too bad. The textbook is easy to understand. Once you figure out how to take her tests (she literally tells you how you can ace them) you will do well on all of her tests.
Professor Ahlberg is very sweet. Course is very straightforward, and if you are interested in money and banking systems you will learn a lot. Didnt receive an A due to attendance.

Professor Ahlberg is caring and accommodating. She clearly believes in her students and wants them to succeed. She puts a lot of effort into making all of her lectures engaging, even when the content itself might not seem really interesting to most. You still do need to spend a lot of time studying. Excited to take ECON 1312 with her next semester!
The Professor is very understanding and will work with you outside of class. Quizzes are very helpful for test in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Ahlberg is truly my favorite teacher I have taken at SMU so far. This International trade class is full of great content yet the course load is extremely manageable. There are extra credit opportunities and she is always listening to students feedback about how to improve the course. I highly recommend this class!

Dr. Ahlberg is my favorite teacher I have taken at SMU. Money & Banking seems like a daunting course however her engaging lectures and clearly defined class structure allows students to perform as well as they would like. A must take class!!

Ahlberg is a great prof, but I struggled with the subject itself. Econ either comes to you easily or it doesn't. To combat this, be sure to do the extra credit assignments because that is the nudge that got me an A-. The physical textbook is not required, but you have to purchase MindTap to complete hwk. Chegg is helpful for hwk assignments.

Professor Ahlberg is easily one of the best teachers I've ever had. I had taken Economics previously, but she was able to explain it in a way that kept every student engaged and allowed us understand and remember key portions of the class. Do whatever you can to take Professor Ahlberg!
Professor was great, would definitely take it again.

Dr. Ahlberg is so nice and definitely cares about her students. As long as you do the work outside of her class, you will get a good grade. The tests can be difficult, but she only uses quiz questions and you get a cheat sheet which helps a lot. She is also very understanding and willing to work with you if you need help.
Prof Ahlberg has to be the biggest chiller in Econ department
great professor! lectures can sometimes be a bit long but overall not bad. tests are super easy and you can definitely get an A in this course.

Such a kind person, super approachable and always willing to help her students. For the course, tests are straightforward. You will have seen most of the questions beforehand. One downside of the course is that attendance is mandatory. After 2 unexcused absences your grade will drop. You can make this up, however, with easy EC. One of my favorites.
Best microecon Prof at SMU. Not an easy A, but if you put in the work that is required for the course, you will get one no problem. Would highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great class, well-structured.

This is one of the easiest classes I have taken high school are college. Ahlberg is a little goofy, but she keeps her lectures short and to the point. She is very friendly and accessible outside of class if needed although I can't imagine any scenario you would because the class is absurdly easy.

Very easy class! The lectures are hilarious but at times convoluting, so just read the textbook beforehand and come to class to relax. 4 tests - cheatsheet, same bank as on the weekly quizzes (2 attempts). 3 attempts on weekly homework. Up to 4 extra credit points to your final grade. Attendance matters - only 2 free absenses

THE BEST PROF. Attendance is mandatory, she takes the first 10 min of class to do it. 4 exams and quizzes every week. The exams are literally the quiz questions so write as all of them down on your cheat sheet. Also get your friends in the class and combine them to get more. Overall she is incredible and if you wanna take econ, TAKE MEA

Attendance is mandatory and she takes 10 minutes of class to take attendance in a class of 75. Homework due every week (chapter quiz and problems & applications) worth 40% of your grade. Mindtap is annoying but if you keep up you should be good. There are 4 exams worth 60% of your grade and you can have a cheat sheet. best out of all eco teachers
Chiller and has a good time during lectures

GOAT LEVEL TEACHER. Definitely my favorite teacher at SMU since I got here. She is hilarious and actually teaches you economics in a way that relates to real life. She makes everyone pay attention by clapping and being a super positive teacher.

Ahlberg only gives out two assignments a week, but it's annoying that she's super strict on attendance (such as spending the first 10 minutes of class doing roll call for over 100 students). She's so easy to talk to and helpful, and she's available outside of office hours.

Dr. Ahlberg is a phenomenal professor who cares about her students her teaching style is creative and fun. Dr. Ahlberg uses a lot of pop culture and jokes in her presentations and examples which makes her lectures fun to follow along. The assignments and exams are very manageable and easy to study for with the resources she gives you.

Amazing professor! This was the easiest A I have ever had. She gives the opportunity for a full FIVE points of extra credit to your final grade!! Just participate on the MindTap and you're good. The slides she presents from are straight from the book so if you read you don't really need to pay attention. Would absolutely take again!
Best econ teacher at SMU, Get to know her when she teachers you! Makes the classroom environment enjoyable! You know what work there is! If you show up to class, and do the homework you will be good!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Ahlberg for International Trade in Summer 2022 and loved her course. Would recommend in Summer, Fall, or Spring. She has amazing energy, is a fair grader, and her quizzes and tests aren't too bad if you study and are prepared. If you love Econ, she's a fantastic choice.

assignments were kind of confusing, she contradicted herself very very often, kept us after class (like 10-15 minutes after) very often, quizzes were a lot harder than they should have been, insane about attendance (like you absolutely can not miss)
I had Professor Ahlberg for both ECON 1311 and 1312. She is very accessible outside of class and cares about her students.

Professor Ahlberg is a great professor. She has a wide spread availability throughout the week for zoom meetings outside class. She is hilarious and uses straightforward analogy to retain our attention and help us understand. She thinks hard of ways to help her students. There is one class per week to study on our own and catch up with the lectures

Ahlberg as a prof is simple but also complicated. She is a bit wild with some things, but it's manageable. She goes pretty fast through slides in lecture, but you'll end up reading the book during "labs" once a week when you don't have class but are required to go to. Overall, pretty easy class. Weekly quizzes and homework online. Easy tests.

If you go to class at least 2/3 times a week and have a chegg account there is no way you won't get an A. The tests are open note. While I didn't learn much because the class is absurdly easy, you should easily get an A. Miles better than Tania Jordan.
She is a great professor and really wants to help your grade. The course is easy if you do the homework.
Lectures can be dry at times but overall she's really nice and class is pretty easy.

Professor Ahlberg is good but she requires attendance and you must to the work of her class. The homework isn't hard but it is a couple hours worth a week. Tests aren't too bad either, but the lectures are sometimes a little boring since the book is being repeated back to you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Ahlberg is a good teacher. The class doesn't take much effort but the reading and textbook assignments are mandatory to pass and do well in the class. The lectures are entertaining as she tries to keep them engaging but they are a little tedious to sit through.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The tests are easy, yes, but the lectures are annoying to sit through and hardly help understand any concepts. The homework is all through mind tap and if the system messes up, you could be in jeopardy with low grades or not even be allowed to access the test if you don't have enough hours. I got a fine grade but wish I took a different teacher.

Great Econ professor. I'd say if she is an option, take her. Tests are all online and her course objectives/syllabus is easy to follow. Just stay on top of the stuff that is required of you (attendance, homework, online quizzes, etc) and you'll almost certainly get an A. Professor Ahlberg is also great with communication! Take her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Ahlberg is amazing. She genuinely cares about her students success and learning the material. I found Mind Tap and the Study Guide's review questions to be particularly helpful in seeing the big picture of the material which is a "must" if you hope to do well on her tests.

Very straightforward. Test questions are mainly theory based not many definitions.

That said, Wheaton makes clear what you need to know, gives pretty well organized notes, and is very willing to help outside of class. Nice and funny woman who cares about students. Graded hw, but online and you can redo it until you get 100%.

3 tests, 20 questions each to judge your knowledge of Microeconomics. It is not a fair system and she gives up on students easily. If you are looking for a teacher who cares about students and will help, DO NOT TAKE HER!

Grades extremely hard. You better know the material like the back of your hand. Miss a few small details and you'll be in for a surprise when you get your test back. Lecture is very to the point. Class almost always gets out early.

She is very passionate about her teaching and she knows what she's talking about, but you kind of either get it or you don't. Lets you out of class 20 min early every class.
