Test questions are hard to study for and she requires you to buy an online textbook for $150 so she doesn't have to grade any homework. Extremely inconvenient and difficult to study for with online textbook.

Wheaton is a good lecturer but her 3 tests are extremely difficult (20 multiple choice theory questions which makes up 20% of your grade). She is very willing to help and has review sessions before each test. Overall a good professor but studying is necessary

Tests are all short answer and graphs. Grades very meticulously on graphs but lenient on short-answer questions. tests are not easy. you have to study hard and have to go to class to do well in the class. final project is a grade booster but tests are dfficult. if you skip class your grade will suffer. know your graphs. shes a toughy

Dr. Wheaton is a good lecturer, but the rest of her class is not. You have to pay for an online service to do the required homework. Also, her tests are incredibly frustrating. They are 20 convoluted multiple choice, so missing even two can have a big impact on your grade. Also, she deducts .5 of a point for every class you miss.

I had her for micro and for macro and her class is great! There's online quizzes every week that make up 25% of your grade, and 3 tests (including the final) that are each 25%. The tests are 20 MC questions based on theory. You really can't mess up on any of the tests if you want an A & she takes 1/2 a point off your final grade for every absence!

Tests are all short answer and graphs. Grades very meticulously on graphs but lenient on short-answer questions. Presentation is easy but grading system for presentations are tournament-based, so your grade is a complete crapshoot.

Had her for Micro.. pretty good teacher especially for such a large class. Take notes! And do some book/aplia review for the tests and you will succeed. Not really hard class. GO TO CLASS. She takes 0.5 off your final grade for each class you miss (up to 10 classes max). I recommend her

Professor Wheaton's class has changed my major. If that doesn't speak loud enough for my respect and adoration for her then nothing can. She is the best economics teacher I have ever had. She is brilliant and so interested in the subject and her students its hard not to look forward to her class every day. I will now be majoring in economics.

Loved this professor. Not easiest in the econ faculty, but her method of teaching is straightforward and relatable. She will help you if you ask, and will review anything with you. Some stuff on Aplia she didn't cover, but again she would help. 20 Q MC tests, all theory; I liked, but some didn't, still had to study. Really neat lady.

BEST ECON TEACHER EVER! Her explanations were so clear and her teaching style is laid back and so easy to understand. Lecture is required and if you don't go you will be sorry because she is so helpful and you will need your notes for the exam reviews and hw. She's super nice too. Her classes fill up fast so hurry!

Wheaton is a wonderful and helpful lady. Her tests are 20 question multiple choice, which is difficult for most. Was willing to help, but her class was difficult. If you enjoy economics she's great, otherwise I would not recommend.

She is a interesting, passionate teacher and she makes the class interesting for the class.  I thought the tests were not terribly hard and I enjoyed my homework and studying for this class because of how much she made me love the class and subject matter.  I would recommend her to anyone who actually tries in school!

Wheaton is an incredible lady and really cares about her students.. and the world at large. That being said, I'm pretty sure she's one of the most difficult econ teachers. Her tests are wordy multiple choice, so even if you know a lot on the subject, it may be hard to choose the right answer for each complicated question.
Very good teacher, really does want the best for her students and is a really funny teacher.

I agree with the person right below me. In theory her teaching is great, but then she reads right from the book and cannot apply her lesson to real life scenarios. Her grading was skeptical. She provides a helpful review sheet to the test. So.. take her if you like the concepts of economics, avoid if you like the mathematics of econ!

Wheaton was okay, I liked the theory of how she wanted to do the class but she was pretty useless as a teacher. She basically read the book to us in class and wrote definitions on the board. Tests are weird too, such obscure way of grading, she took off points for random things. I wouldn't take her again.

Good professor. As some others have said, margin of error is slim with each test question worth 5 points and only three tests, but she uses a very concise online textbook and if you just read the chapters carefully you will do well.
Impossible tests.  I even went in to talk to her about studying techniques and how to improve my test scores and all I got was a blank stare.  Not helpful at all.

The tests are ridiculous. 20 MC questions over 5 chapters. Very Hard. Her class is extremely boring and she handwrites everything on the board. The way she teaches this class made me feel like I was back in 4th grade again. If you like really hard tests this class is for you.

Take Wheaton. She really cares about the students, and whether you actually understand the material. She lays out the notes beautifully and grades everything fairly. You WILL learn something in this course and you are given fair warning about every approaching deadline. Definitely recommended.
Prof Wheaton is a great teacher, she cares for her students and wants everyone to do their best. Highly recommended. Test are theory only so no calculations. A fair course.

Professor Wheaton is easily one of the best professors I have had at SMU so far. If you go to class, take notes, and put the time in to study you can do really well in the class. She cares about her students and she makes Economics interesting. She really is an awesome teacher and I highly recommend her.

Prof Wheaton is an awesome professor but her class is so difficult. She has three tests which are 20 questions each, covering 4-6 chapters each test.  In this case, if you miss 2 questions, you already  have a 90%. That was the hardest part of the class.

tests are theory based getwkbook.. so actual class lectures do not reflect tests. lectures are application based and for aplia.tests are nothing like aplia.aplia is relatively easy, ALWAYS GET HELP if your not sure b/c you want a good overall grade. A lec is awesome! really study theory to do well on test. good prof. but def. don't expect a curve.

Dr. Wheaton has been one of the more cooler professors I've had.  Grades consist of attendance (5%), Aplia quizzes (20%)--which are EASY! and three exams (25% each), non-cumulative.  She's friendly and funny.  Easy class, great teacher.  Make sure you take her notes; it's a lot easier than reading out of the book. Textbook isn't even required.
Dr. Wheaton is the ideal professor.  Enough said.

She's really good! Makes off the wall comments which are really funny at times. Very clear in her explanations. Treats you as a grown-up. No overwhelming homework. Course may seem to be going slowly but is not.Do the Aplia problems. If not enough problems, find some more on the Net. If you have problems - ask her, she'll answer! A Very Good Prof!

Very cool teacher. Used aplia for quizzes, which were pretty easy and very helpful. Two tests and a final. Takes role from time to time and sometimes makes class optional. Typical college class, come to class and take notes or just read the book and do the online quizzes.

Aplia was used. Take all practice homeworks on aplia then take the grades assignments. Questions are almost identical. This method allows you to consistently get a high grade on the Aplia assignments. As for tests, retake the practice aplia assignments for the given chapters. Tests are nearly identical to the Aplia questions.
All of her notes are right from the textbook pretty much.  But it is alot easier if u go to class then read the book.   Tests are somewhat hard but not too bad if u know material and like econ

Wheaton is very diligent on note-taking. The textbook is hardly ever used, so going to class is really necessary. She makes it worthwhile, as she really "gets" college kids. She'll make jokes about weekend excursions and late-night fun. She can teach the subject and still have time to connect with the students, even with a class of 50.

The content of this course was very easy but the workload is so time consuming. The weekly quizzes were hyperspecific from several long readings/videos and the grading on presentations was unclear. He knows most ppl in the class have no intentions of ever becoming a coach but acts like the course is curing cancer. Not worth the time
Thinks very highly of himself for reasons unknown. Glorified high school couch who got a local PhD online and now thinks he's a scholar. Easy a but not worth the pain to sit though.

APSM 2340. Class is fun. Interesting topics of discussion and group project focused. He wants you to do well. The Final is light work and if you do work on time with care you will do well. Fist bump Friday was a highlight.
What a joke. He obviously knows so little that he loads his class with games to hide the fact that he's basically your gym coach teaching you about babies.
DOESN'T KNOW HOW TO TEACH, LIKE TAKING A COACH FOR HEALTH IN HS. NO REVIEW GUIDES, BAD LECTURES, DO NOT TAKE, WORST PROFESSOR EVER<<<<
APSM 2340! This is an all-lecture, no midterm. No review guide for the final. Not my favorite.
Course is useless and so is the instructor. People only take him for the free As but they're doing a disservice to the field and make me embarrassed to say I'm a major as everyone sees us as a joke.

I really don't think he even prepares for class, it is seriously like your high school coach teaching about health - absoltuely incompetent, not trying to be mean, but he doesn't have or deserve a place in college if he can't manage the material. You have to take him though, so good luck.

Great guy, but terrible class structure. I think he is making it up as he goes along. He's inconsistent, so some things are trivial and some things difficult. Hard to prepare. Would never take a class with him if I could avoid it, but if your major is SPL, you are trapped to take a semester's worth of classes with him.
A joke and a rube, no one knows why we have to take his courses as they are a complete waste of our money.
Easiest class ever. Quizzes are on the weekends, but they're so simple. Would 10/10 take again.
Jan Term winter sports 3 assignments and your done, just show up, coach warren is the best and chill guy.
Had for APSM. Probably my favorite teacher I've had at SMU. Super easy to talk to and actually cares. 10/10 would take again.

This teacher is the worst teacher I have ever had, he thinks he is funny but is far from it. His course is boring and he is like a coach from a high school rather than an SMU teacher. His replies on emails are bad. He has pop quizzes every week and at one point it took him 2 months to grade work. He is rude when you ask him a question out of class.

He's not really a professor but a coach and old high school teacher, and you can tell. Tries to be liked and "popular" with us rather than be a real role model and professor of sports. Obviously an easy A.
Mid.

I took his PRW class in May in Taos. It was seriously so much fun and just an absolute blast. We went hiking in Colorado at the Sand Dunes, & Zapata Falls. Then, we went rock climbing. We also went white water rafting in the Rio Grande. Finally, we went fly fishing and it was so cool and beautiful. Pushes you out of your comfort zone. TAKE HIM!
super easy A, you can only miss class twice before it affects your grade but it's a light work class
Easiest A I've ever gotten
this class was very easy, it gives you the oral communication credit, professor warren was great. take it if you are looking for a low effort class
LOVE HIM. he is king of dad jokes. i made over a 100 in the class just by completion. he really cares for his students well being. absolutely take him.

I enrolled in a summer course taught by this professor. Speaking in front of others or giving presentations often makes me anxious, but his encouragement and support were invaluable. Unlike many professors who have high expectations without considering individual comfort levels, he understood my hesitation and provided the necessary assistance.
The Goat. Work every Sunday but does not take long. Again GOATED

A gem! He truly cares about each one of his students and makes each class interesting. The class is a breeze if you put in effort and stay on top of assignments- there can be quite a few some weeks. Always puts the students first and is so willing to help in any way he can.

Coach Warren is such a nice guy. The course is very simple and just requires you to be in the gym for class. You don't want to miss many classes because attendance makes up the biggest portion of your grade.
Super easy class. There were 4 assignments and a final exam. Easy A.

Coach Warren cares about his students. The class is not hard, all you have to do is show up to class and do your workout. He has a handful of graded assignments throughout the semester. All of them are relatively short and can be easy A's. The end-of-semester exam is a bit difficult but the powerpoint slides he provides are very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Bradley is super chill and genuinely cares about his students. I got injured twice during the semester, and he always came to check on me and talk with me about my recovery. I love this guy and I will certainly take more classes with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Coach Warren is great for weightlifting, he focuses on making sure you leave his class knowing your way around a weight room and what you should do to stay active in the future. The midterm and final are quick and painless youll be more than prepared. Just be sure to post discussions on Sunday and youll be golden.
Warren is just such a good guy. Hell push you to do better but is super understanding. He always wants to make sure hes giving us what we need. Show up and do the few assignments and youll do fine.

I took him for PRW and he's literally the most wholesome person ever. He genuinely cares about each and every one of his students. He literally wants everyone to succeed. Just show up and that's all he asks.

Coach Warren is the most caring person ever. This class is basically full of people required to take the course, but he makes it worth your time. You see him once a week, but he learned everyone's names and truly cared for our well-being. He is an amazing man who inspires everyone to have his same outlook on life. Take him, you won't regret it.
Show up, turn in work, pass the class, easy as that. Cool dude to have for this class.
Very basic class. He makes class entertaining and is overall a nice, family class. Just show up, turn in your work and you pass.
Chill dude. Three mandatory essays with all the PRWs that can be annoying at times but he gives really good feedback and you can see he truly cares about his students. I recommend!
He truly cares about his students. He will actually read the papers you write and give good, insightful feedback. He really tries to help his students.

Love this guy. I feel like his PRW is less work than others. 4 one page papers and a 4-5 minute oral presentation or whatever about you. No PowerPoint or anything. Everything is pass if you do the work. Great guy. Very caring. Definitely get to know him as a person if you can. Gonna miss him.

The nicest professor I've ever had. Very inspirational and sweet. He will teach you the most out of any of your classes. Learned very important life skills that I can use for the rest of my life from him.
This guy is the man. Really cares about his students a ton. Do not even think about taking another teacher for this class, you will be missing out!

Coach is such a great guy... like such a great guy. I hope to be as good of a person as he is one day. He cares about his students so much and makes the material he has to teach interesting. Take his class for PRW!! The class is so easy but I always look forward to it even though my class was at 8 AM... which should say a lot. Just turn in OCE's.
Coach Warren is extremely nice and a great person. I actually look forward to coming to this class.

Warren is a caring teacher and is very passionate about what he teaches. He is not afraid to get personal in class yet makes sure everyone is comfortable with the subject matter. Bought the textbook, didn't need it. Easy professor for a mandatory class.

Took him for basketball. Chiller. Dude gets it. If you miss too many classes he will give you the option to make them up so he can still pass you. Class consists of pickup games with a test at the very end that every prw2 teacher has to give.

Coach Warren is such a good guy and is so passionate about teaching. He could literally be having the worst day but come into class with the best attitude. He makes the things that he requires to teach us, such as alcohol awareness, actually interesting. HIGHLY HIGHLY RECOMMEND!! Best professor I've had so far.
Super nice guy. I took this at 8 am and had a 9 am across campus. He lets you out 10 minutes early so was never late to my next class
such a chill guy, show up and pass, plus after OCE's he gives you the next class off
Not a good professor

If you study you will do great on the tests. She gives you a study guide which is exactly the test. She also has quizzes every week but they are super easy if you pay attention. They are more just to keep you on track. Definitely take her.

Dr. Bowen had extremely interesting lectures that went in depth about a ton of interesting sub-points that she ties back to the main piece of information so it gives you a deeper contextual meaning. Extremely flexible on helping students outside of class and accommodating for any outside circumstances they have

I took her may session and it was doable as long as you can lock in for those 11 day. She makes class more bearable for how long it was by showing videos, museum assignment, and an assignment over a movie the last day. If you need the credit take her!
I took may session. Quiz every day for participation. Hard class but overall extremely doable for a two week class she is nice and gives students her time
Bowen goated

She's awkward and blunt but more introverted than rude. She answers questions, sometimes with funny snark. I had both classes with her, the 3000 one being the most difficult. Chill class vibe—I was late every day. Not super social, but not as bad as some reviews say. Tests and quizzes can be tough though. Write from the heart and review notes.
She is nooooooo good.

prof bowen is honest a very consistent lecturer. her class is organized in a specific way that isn't hard to decipher. as long as you come to class, pay attention, and study stuff a little outside of class, you'll do great. the only thing is her lectures may seem a little monotone, but if that's a dealbreaker for you, then just dont take the class.
Literally has NO idea how to teach and READS you the slides like you're five years old. Grading is a joke, course is useless, do not take unless you want to waste your time.

Dr. Bowen is a sweetheart who teaches effectively. Even though she reads her slides verbatim in a quiet voice that kind of lulls you to sleep, she includes fun pictures and surveys to keep engagement. Do every study guide, read through the lecture before quizzes, and you'll do well. Super chill and wants you to succeed!

Quite a few online quizzes, but they really aren't tricky and do not consist of very detailed questions. Two tests - she makes you a study guide for each literally outlining what TO study & what NOT to study (which is more helpful that you think!) Three mini papers graded by a nice TA. papers aren't even "essay-style." Recommend!
Dr. Bowen is amazing. You don't even have to come to class to get an A. Just do the study guide before the tests and she literally tells you what is going to be on the exams.
Dr. Bowen is an amazing lecture teacher, and she really cares about her students. Best way to know her is to talk after class and she'll help with anything!

Professor Bowen is very knowledgeable and is great at explaining everything. Lectures could feel monotonous but that is to be expected with longer class times. She gives study guides which are very helpful and accurately depict the exam material. The essays are all fairly easy but require you to reflect on your own life experiences and feelings.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: PSYC 4339 - She reads word-for-word off of the powerpoints, which makes you feel a little silly for waking up and coming to her class. The material is interesting, but does get very repetitive. She has her TA grade the essay assignments, which is frustrating, and for a 4000 level course it feels a little juvenile. However, she is really nice.

Had her tuesdays and thursdays at 8am. Took her because of her reviews but her tests are hard, and you need to understand the material thoroughly to get a good grade on them. She is very caring though and always able to help. Plus she has other assignments to help boost your grade if you are not the best test taker. Overall she is average.
Best professor ever !!!!!!!!

I never thought I would get excited to go to an 8am ever Tuesday/Thursday, but this class proved me wrong. I major in psychology and have never had such an organized lecture. Not to mention the lectures are actually so fun and engaging after the first couple of weeks. Show up every day, try your best, and you will get a good grade.

Fantastic class and professor! This is by far one of the best classes Ive had in college thus far! I highly recommended it. Fair with coursework and clear lecture material. Overall it has been more enjoyable and interesting material than anything else! I would 100 percent recommend Dr. Bowen for this class.

She is awesome. She does not require you to read the textbook and teach you everything you need in the slides during lectures. Great class especially if you have heavy schedule and need a lighter class.

Bowen only teaches with powerpoints (like you don't have to read the textbook) & it's all straightforward material. She gives quizzes every other class ish for completion grades + participation, don't miss these. 3 homework assignments are important and probs hardest part of class but she gives a lot of time and info on them. Tests are super easy.
please get someone else lol
get someone else
Terrible. She literally doesn't teach, just reads off the slides

Easily one of the worst classes I've ever taken in my life. Save yourself and take a different class. Doesn't respond to emails and kind of patronizing tbh. Doesn't even give full class time for the exams. Class is an hour and 30 but only have 45 minutes to do an exam, then she releases the class after that. Why not just give us the full exam time?
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Will not reply to your emails. Tests are nothing like the class material. Good luck.
Everything's not only arbitrary and made up but test questions are very particular about the nuances of said concepts

Don't take this class. I thought Professor Demith was unapproachable and sometimes even rude to students. The class involves a lot of busy work/group work. The tests are harder than you'd think for a marketing class and I thought the lectures were unclear, unorganized, and confusing.
Don't take this

never written a review before but I love Professor Demith. She lets you take exams and quizzes if you miss them. Attendance is loose. People say her tests are hard but if you study her guide she post they are just off of that- its more that you need to really understand because the test are not a lot of time for how many questions. shes great

The questions on the test are made up, but the class is so easy if you halfway pay attention. Get in a good group during the first week of class or get friends to take it with you bc 70% of the class is group work with the same group the whole semester. tests are on lockdown and multiple choice. There is 2 presentations but in groups of 4-6 people
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take her. She pretends to be so nice and helpful but is really rude. She doesn't listen and appears to think students are very below her. She is very unorganized with due dates and makes guidelines very confusing for assignments. The tests and quizzes are pretty impossible no matter how much you study.

She explains everything so poorly. Nothing makes sense in this class even the group project that you work on all semester is so un organized. At least for quizzes she'll let you take it twice and give you the average score and she gave a couple opportunities for extra credit but other than that if you care about your grade don't take her.

She is the worst professor I have ever had. Gives her students attitude and is rude to them. She is incredibly unclear and unorganized. No one ever understands what's going on in her class. Also, quizzes and tests are very confusing, no matter how much you study.

This is the worst Proffesor I have ever had. She is constantly rude to her students and treats them like they are less than her. She is terrible at being a Proffesor and no one should ever take her course.

You have to work HARD to earn a good grade. I had a great experience with her despite my hesitancy signing up for her class. Read the textbook, take advantage of office hours and slideshows, and show interest in her class in class discussions and group projects. She is a tough but fair grader and shows mercy if you work hard and show interest.

INCREDIBLY lecture heavy/memorization. Test reviews are just all the presentations grouped into a big 200 pg slides. A couple group projects which are mostly easy. Some of her test questions are hard but presentations can help bolster your grade and you take quizzes with 2 attempts, open and closed note. 3 main tests. Not bad but not amazing
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She's nice, lol just dry humor. The reviews make her look bad, she's not mean lol take Sommers then you will see she's not bad!

We can't miss a test or class because it is "unprofessional," even though she was late several times, canceled class, and was 20 minutes late to our final. The day after the final, she took away all of our extra credit because she claimed it went toward our participation/attendance grade (she did not tell us that once and never took attendance).

The class itself is not hard, but I will tell you why you won't like it. The test are weird because you only have 50 minutes for 49 questions and within those questions there are short responses. She doesn't offer extra credit (except presentations for credit which is heinous). Total grade is based off of point system (580 points): nothing averages

Prof Demith is a very sweet lady and very understanding. Class is pretty straight forward, she goes over the PowerPoints in class and then whatever is on the PowerPoints is on the test, we also have group projects which arent too bad if everyone does their work.

Pf. Demith for marketing is really not too bad, but yes she does just read off the lecture deck. The material is not hard, just a lot of memorization for the exams. Two presentations that were very simple. I found her to be really nice, so I am pretty surprised people found her rude. However, the final was kinda BS....

Just a terrible teacher. She only reads off the slides and does not teach anything very well. She also loudly talks during every test so its impossible to even focus. She is rude and does not care about her students.

The tests are hard and her "study guides" are 200 slides of random lectures. Everything is on lockdown and will call you out in the middle of class if she thinks you're cheating. She will not answer emails and is very heard to reach out of class. I would not take her again if she was the last professor available.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: this class was so hard . she  goes very fast, doesn't explain things in class very well, and you do a project pretty much the whole semester that doesn't really help you understand the content. she has been rude to students in class. her tests and quizzes are so hard, she does not give any direction on what or how to study. do not recommend!
she's a cox professor and she grades like we're in cox. i'm not in it for a reason
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: genuinely worst professor i've ever had. currently failing my entire class and the class work counts for 0 points. the tests are hard even if you study. does not give excuses for attendance for any reason.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: So incredibly mid of a teacher. The reason I have confirmed my lack on interest in marketing which is why I did bad in her class. Just reads off deck. Rude to students who ask questions even tho its about typos on her tests, tests with questions I think she just pulls from textbook or some bc class feels like common sense yet exams are hard.

the only annoying part about this class is the new curve  added by the department- top 20%=A, next 20=A-, etc. people cheat on the exams and quizzes, so it totally ruins the idea of having a curve and could potentially round you down to an A- even if you have a 94. I think she will be monitoring this better now. just a lot of memorization

I promise she's not as bad as she sounds. She can be a little rude and snarky at times, but it's whatever. She does only read off slides for lectures, so that kind of sucks. But the class itself is not hard. Just study the PowerPoint slides for the quizzes and tests and you'll be 100% fine. Should not be a very difficult class at all.

She just read off slides, imposible to take notes. Her tests are hard if you dont study.  Quizzes are in class now. 

Make sure to work on your Written work for your presentation, and tests. 

Do not take her

It's tough to get a good feel for Demith. She seems like a nice, kind lady, but at the same time, sometimes you talk to her and she's super cold and rude. Class is manageable, just make sure you stay on top of your big group project. Four quizzes and three big tests too, that's pretty much the whole class.

There are take-home quizzes which are easy, and an in-person midterm and final. The answers are basically from the take-home quizzes, so just make flashcards and review the PowerPoints that she posts. There's a group project, but it's relatively easy. Take her if you can.

Prof.Demith is nice and seems to really enjoy teaching marketing.Class is mostly lectures from slides. There's a group project that sums up most of the class. Quizzes are take-home (open book/notes). Closed book midterm and final, which is difficult because she gives a lot of info. If you do everything it's easy to get an A and there's extracredit.

I don't think that Marketing Research is the most enjoyable/engaging class of all time. That being said, Prof Demith is very knowledgeable about the research process and you can definitely learn a bit from her if you pay attention.

Prof Demith does not help you study for exams. For the midterm and the final, they are closed notes, but the notes are from huge slide decks, so you don't know what to study. Find someone else for marketing!!!
She reads 60 slides per class and them hands them out as the only way to study. Everyone struggled with the midterm and final. I would not take again.

To understand Prof. Demith, you have to realize that MKT3340 is just really really boring. It's a lot of random definitions and not at all conceptual, so it's not really her fault that the class is boring. Prof. Demith tries to engage students through group work and videos, and is very kind and approachable in and out of class.

Professor Demith reads directly from the slides in every single class. Everyone is so disengaged and class is repetitive and lacks substance. Slide decks are 45+ slides per chapter covered. Quizzes are take-home, except for the midterm and final which everyone struggled on. I highly recommend taking a different professor for this marketing course.

Professor Demith is one of the most disappointing professors i've had at smu. She was not willing to meet with students and when you were able to catch her before or after class, you could tell she didn't care one bit. She also just read off the slides and the class was not engaging.

She's a good professor, she's really passionate about her field but the class can be so boring at times. You'll mostly be lectured whats on the power points. A lot of slides, like 55-80 per lecture. Projects are pretty open, so you can choose what brands to cover and make it something you like.

Professor Demith is such a sweetheart. I have had her for two marketing classes now, and she is consistent and caring. If you do your work and noticeably put in effort, you will do great. She allows a lot of freedom when it comes to choosing brands for projects, which I love. I would take her for any marketing class.

She does read directly from the slides, but it's a 50 min class and not as boring as people complain that it is. Quizzes are open note, and if you even half pay attention you'll breeze through. Her methods may be frustrating sometimes but there's no reason to be worried about this teacher or this class. You don't need the textbook at all.

Quizzes are take home, open book, open notes and she is very nice about letting you redo them/keeping them open for longer times. Goes through assignments step by step, tells you exactly what she expects, provides examples from previous students. Allows a whole paper cheat sheet for tests. Group projects are 40% of total grade and she grades SUPER easy. I liked the class but wish it was less group-based. Every 15 minutes she wanted people to discuss the topics in small groups which got annoying when there's not a lot to discuss. Her lectures were just her reading off the slides.

I have had a few classes with Carney; she is not a bad teacher. She is a little awkward when having discussions. Classes are easy, you just need to do the readings and participate. She is liberal leaning.

I can understand why so many people have written negative reviews for Dr. Carney's classes. My recommendation is to take her for smaller classes such as Topics in Political Comm and Principles of Political Comm. In a smaller class setting she is great. She truly values participation and will raise your grade if you show up to class.

Incredibly rude person, reads off the slides during lectures, and does not have any clue what she is doing or saying and seems aggressive and socially awkward at the same time which isn't useful when you're teaching a 50+ person lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's a really fun prof, especially if your class is a talkative one. She enjoys hearing her students simply getting to know each other better and will actively engage in casual conversation when she can. She doesn't let that get in the way of her teaching, too, you will certainly learn Spanish with her and learn it well. Couldn't recommend more.
Great professor! Makes learning a new language very easy
Sweetest professor ever, cares about everyone and is also very understanding when you have other stuff going on too.

Best teacher I had all semester! She is super caring and listens to her students. There is HEAVY participation in this class so make sure to come prepared to speak out loud. There is daily homework online through the course but very manageable. Just make sure to practice and you'll be fine. You get the grade you work for.
Very understanding and helpful when it comes to learning. If you study a little before things you can get a good grade. Very accommodating to different learning techniques.
Avoid this professor like the plague. Can't explain concepts, blames students for confusion. Doesn't respect student opinions. Waste of time and energy.

I tested into 1402 and was super nervous. Thankfully more of it came back to be than expected, but when I was lost, prof was always there to help clear things up. Stay after class and ask questions. Go to her office hours!!! She is a great (and forgiving) prof, and an INCREDIBLE human. Get to know her if you can!!
this class will put you to sleep but you can get away with just doing the readings and not even showing up and still pass the class.

LOVE CONCHITA. She makes Spanish so fun. She will joke around with you and have a good time but also make sure everyone is following the lesson. I thought Spanish was very approachable thanks to her! Take Conchita if you can!!!

One of the best teachers I have ever had. She cares so much about students and genuinely wants you to succeed. At the end of the semester, our entire class was trying to get into her SPAN 1402 class because we all loved her. Amazing professor who truly goes above and beyond. I had never spoken Spanish before and she truly wants to help you learn.

It was my first Spanish class in five years and she was extremely helpful and understanding in helping me review some of the basic concepts I'd forgotten. Extremely sweet teacher as long as you participate in class and give a genuine effort. We also had a field trip near the end of the semester to the museum for class.

literally the sweetest! my favorite span prof so far- she's so helpful and passionate about her culture and goes out of her way to make sure everyone understands. I will say it was very difficult to understand her in both English and spanish for a while- she has a thick spanish accent that I wasn't used to hearing spoken. amazing all the way around

Professor Conchita Villar-Martin is very patient and understanding. She's a native speaker from Spain, so she teaches "vosotros" conjugation but doesn't test you on it. Participation and attendence is mandatory each class, because she calls on everybody to answer questions, but it is very helpful practice. She is very accessible and willing to help

She's very nice and genuine, she shows LOTS of grace. She's a native speaker but is good at explaining the content There is a lot of work but it's due to the SMU Span dept. not her, no way around Participate! it helps you a lot Exams are exactly what was covered, no random topics, very easy Just show up, participate, DO THE HW and you'll be good
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: A knowledgeable professor who clearly cares about her students. However, since this is a COVID year, it seems that all Spanish teachers taught the same curriculum. This resulted in numerous assignments that got tedious over time. Test averages seemed to be quite low this semester as well. Overall, still a solid choice to knock out CC requirements.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Villar-Martin was by far the best professor I've had at SMU. The content of the class will be as difficult as you make it, as long as you participate in the daily exercises and have an open attitude she's very kind and understanding. There is daily online homework that can be a pain, but by far her teaching outweighs it.

This is one of my favorite professors I've had at SMU. I knew a lot of the material coming in so I didn't go to office hours much, but when I did for the final she was very helpful and we enjoyed talking most of the time. Very fair and her tests are not hard if you look over the material. Online homework is almost every day which isn't her choice.

This professor is a great choice for the language requirement. She goes over homework and content in class so you always can review last night's homework. If you do the review the tests are easy. There are lots of grades for a college course so it's manageable if you don't do well on one assignment. Doesn't speak great English but that's it.

Conchita Villar is hands-down the best Spanish teacher in the department. She makes Spanish an easy subject to comprehend and helps the students who have difficulty understanding the concepts. Tests and quizzes are relatively easy very similar to her in-class reviews. If Villar were teaching the upper-level courses, I would definitely take them.

A really nice teacher! One of the nicest professors I've had. Wasn't a big fan of Spanish again, but I could definitely seem myself taking more semester of Spanish with her. Really accommodating, helpful, nice, and funny!

Conchita Villar is extremely compassionate and helpful. I couldn't think of a better professor to take Spanish from. I'm not a Spanish major, but I would definitely take the next few levels of this course if she were teaching it. If you have to take Spanish, GET this professor.
She is the best professor. You should take from her and you will not be disappointed. She is the nicest person in the world and I would take as many courses from her if I could.
The best ever.

Honestly, at the beginning of the semester I loved her. However, this changed when I was struggling with health problems at the end of the semester. She was not accommodating and this resulted in me not being able to pass the class. She would not take late homework assignments to bump my grade 1% but for a different student she bumped her to an A-.

Conchita Villar is a genuine professor with a true interest in seeing her students succeed. She will work alongside each student to ensure that they understand the material adequately. The course was not difficult, but required participation and effort. Will be taking her again for the second semester of beginning Spanish.

One of my favorite professor and one of the best person that I have met in my whole life. I have never learned Spanish before but now I fall in love with it. I will definitely take her SPAN1402 next semester.

I was dreading taking Spanish but in the end, it was my favorite class. Professor Villar-martin really cares about her students and tries to help you out if you are struggling. She is super nice and an easy grader. I learned more in her class than I did in 3 years of Spanish in high school. She made me want to continue with Spanish.

My favorite teacher at SMU hands down! She is so sweet and really cares that her students succeed in the class. Will help in any way she can to help her students not only do well in the class but enjoy learning the language. Definitely recommend
What a wonderful person!  Professor Villar-Martin is joyful and makes class so enjoyable, even though there was a lot of material to cover.  She will work with you and considers every option to help.

All my homies LOVE Professor Lujan. His summer class saved my GPA. I promise you as long as you go to his office hours and actually try, YOU WILL PASS!!! He is (so far) the BEST math professor I have had at SMU. TAKE HIS CLASS! His score should be much higher.

The best math professor I have ever had, especially at SMU. I have had to take this course multiple times, and he is by far the best. Speaks fluent English with no accent, easy to understand, extremely available during office hours, and a cool enough guy to make you want to actually show up and succeed. Please take this guy if you get the chance.
5/5. Best calc I professor I had.

Impossible to fail unless you don't care about your grade. Homework does not follow a schedule neither do quizzes but doing it ensures you'll know what you're doing for the quizzes. Quizzes are 1-2 questions every week. There are 4 exams including final they're not difficult if you take the time to study. He is worth taking.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's honestly chill and appreciates it if you engage with the content by answering questions. His quizzes are on the harder side, but his tests are easy. He posts lecture notes on Canvas and is willing to be flexible if you talk to him

He is so sweet, and genuinely cares about his students and learns everyone's names. The class isn't too hard, but I think that was because I had taken AP Calc. Lectures are sometimes confusing but he answers questions well. Tests aren't too hard, and not too much homework. Quizzes are normally at least once a week.

Professor Lujan is a good teacher but has some flaws. He does not post a lot of things on canvas which can be hard to keep track of and the quizzes can be annoying sometimes. Otherwise, he is a great teacher and person who cares about what he teaches and his students. He is also very open to giving help when need. I would definitely take his class.

Take this professor if you are bad at math. he gives so many points as long as you show your work. I've never failed an exam in this class and math is my weakest subject. my favorite part is that he memorizes everyone's name.

I think he wants what is best for his students and he made it clear he has struggled with math and he gets it is hard. he does not post ANYTHING on canvas. if you were not there or weren't listening, you have no clue when homeworks are due and are quizzes. Also he  vocalizes dislike for students; "SMU is privileged careless rich kids".
He doesn't put assignments on canvas. He can be so rude. He doesn't tell you what will be on the quizzes. He makes them so much harder than the lectures.

Professor Lujan cares about what he teaches unlike a lot of teacher. He also cares about his students. I find it insane that people do not like his personality either as he is kind and understanding. Some of the quizzes can be frustrating but they prepare your for the test.

Very enthusiastic and engaging! Homework that he gives us teaches you if you are confused after lectures. Usually assigns a quiz once a week, but he makes sure to let you know the week before so it isn't a pop quiz, just study the night before. The test is multiple choice and pretty straightforward as long as you do the homework.

He truly made me love math again. I have never seen someone teach as enthusiastically as Lujan. I am grateful to be his student, and he has impacted my perspective on math forever. He makes everyone feel welcome, and there is never a dull moment in his class. Btw, bad quiz grades mirror your class engagement. I have bad grades, but ik it's MY fault

Had him for business calc. He is nice and actually does care about what he teaches. Sometimes explains things weird but he is super helpful in office hours. Also its business calc you can literally teach yourself everything with chat.

Awesome prof.
Just a bad teacher. His lectures are bed and you end up teaching yourself all the material. Trys to be cool but just isnt. and his pop quizzes are just unnecessarily hard.

Favorite professor this semester. Great guy who can always help one on one during office hours

bad teacher

I'm not using this comment for the professor. I'm just going to inform you in general that if you are taking advertising for an easy ‘A' then you're in the wrong place. There are over 60 different terms to memorize per chapter.

rather boring class where professor just reads off of the textbook for 50 minutes and several annoying homework assignments that are due 20 at a time. Tests are online and can be taken out of class but he allows the option to take them in class.

This class was so boring, he just read us the textbook. Lots of homework all due at once and then not again for a while. He was hard to access and did not always respond to emails. Attendance was mandatory.
Good professor, easy A if you do the extra credit opportunities
Very easy to get an A in the class because of all the extra credit. Most of the exams are take home and they are easy because he gives you a study guide.

WORST PROFESSOR EVER

Professor Lawrence is extremely thoughtful about his students. Would encourage taking his class, because I developed much better emotional intelligence and communication skills.

Professor Dan Lawerence is an amazing professor. He teaches meaningful and engaging material, and genuinely cares about both the class as a whole and each of his students individually. Honestly, Dr. Son is the GOAT. It upsets me that he actually has some negative reviews on here. Son is a fantastic teacher! It's not his fault he teaches extremely difficult material! Regardless, he does a great job of making the material as easily understandable as possible. tough to get an A, but if you do, it's extremely rewarding! Great prof!!!

He records his lectures which is nice if you missed class, but they don't really help much. he is really good at being there for you when you need him, but our class had about 130 people. your grade is basically just 4 exams and he does curve. I failed exam 1 & 2 so he told me I should drop the class and take it once I finish other harder classes.

Terrible professor, arrogant and very rude to his students. Pre-med students are the smartest people at SMU and so many people had to drop because of his poor teaching. DO NOT take him if you can because he WILL NOT help you come in for help when you are struggling. I went to every lecture, watched videos, did the homework and still failed tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Son is amazing! Do all of the problems that he assigns and don't be afraid to go see him in office hours for help. If you do everything he asks of you you'll be fine!! He teaches a tough class, but when you finish it you will surprise yourself with how much you know! He did a reverse class this year and it was awesome! Do it! you wont regret it

Dr. Son is an inspiring professor, who truly loves teaching his students. You should be prepared to do lots of homework to earn an A. I don't have any regret after taking his course!! One of the best course I took at SMU

Dr. Son has been, by far, my favorite professor at SMU. He knows SO much, and he actually makes organic fun with his jokes and funny stories. There's a lot of material, but if you do all the problems and make sure you understand them you will definitely do well. Attend his online review sessions, they're super helpful in preparing for test!

Dr. Son is one of the best professors I've ever had. He is so clear and organized. If you utilize his office hours he's a great person to talk to. I was fearing this class before coming in but now I have no regrets! It was not easy (had to do the book problems at least twice) but very rewarding at the end. Just don't fall behind!

Dr. Son is a great professor and a great lecturer. He knows this so he makes his exams really difficult. For this class you must study a lot of hours every week just to pass and even more to get an A. Textbook use is very low because most of the material comes from his lectures, of which he makes audio and video recordings available.

Dr. Son is a wonderful professor. As long as you do your part, he is more than willing to help. I had him for two semesters, and got an A both times. I couldn't have had a more organized and clear professor. However, you should be prepared to work hard. Take the time to do the homework and ask for help when you don't understand something.

Tests are extremely straightforward - straight from the beginning-section problems.  To do well, just be sure you understand what he went over in lecture (his recordings help a lot here), and do the beginning problems in the book.  Additional problems (usually numbered 80+) aren't necessary, but I suppose they'll help.
Tests are IMPOSSIBLE and teacher is extremely condescending. doesn't care about his students, only about the numbers.
I had him for Jterm and he was great! The only teacher who could have kept my interest for 8 hours a day, and extremely fair. The only decent teacher I have had for chem so far.

Dr. Son is the worst chemistry teacher I've had at SMU. His teaching style is terrible; his notes are disorganized and inconsistent. He teaches Organic at a level much higher than sophomore students should be expected to know. His tests cover obscure concepts and do not match his lectures. Avoid at all cost.

Good luck.  Tests are impossible.  The only way you will make a decent grade is if you drop everything else and soley concentrate on ochem.  He explains things well...despite feeling prepared for an exam, the class prior to the exam he will make you feel as though you haven't prepared at all.  Good luck. Good riddence.

Dr. Son is an extremely intelligent person and is very well prepared for class with easy to follow outlines.  The tests are no joke, but if you actually put in the time, you will be satisfied with your grade. NOT FOR SLACKERS

horrible teacher. doesnt really know how to answer your question. chem 2 is all math! and to top it all his tests are all mpc, too long, no partial credit, and EC is useless! makes it sound simple in class, quizes are not bad, but his tests are hell. :(
Agreed, very well prepared, and great outlines!  Hard material, but he's always very helpful!

He prepares outlines for his lectures and falls it pretty consistently. If you have any problems with the assigned homework or understanding the lecture he is always available to answer your questions...
Getting a good grade on lab reports is tough because a lot of thought is necessary.  Dr. Son does not grade them.  He will explain anything a student requires.

Really good lab professor.  Knows what he's talking about and is willing to explain.  Easy to be around, not uptight at all.  As far as lab reports go, he's not the one even grading them (the TA's are). You do have to work hard - he's not just going to hand out good grades.
this lab is not for the faint at heart.  be ready to get bad lab grades over and over.
He's a great instructor and advisor. He's really good at explaining and very helpful and approachable.
lol take someone else

I took an accelerated 12 day course and appreciated his teachings. tough class but I felt he explained everything well. The second test was the toughest. The first and final were easier. Will have to study regularly and an entirety of two FULL days of prep for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Better than the other teachers and has extra credit. He is not the best teacher but he is very accessible outside of class.

Don't be fooled by the ratings, last term he gave out a ton of extra credit, which is why his reviews look good. This term about 40% of the class dropped. Grading is harsh, lectures are hard to follow due to a heavy accent and unclear explanations. Office hours left me more confused than when I walked in. Avoid if you can.
Emails often went unanswered, office hours were rushed, and lectures lacked structure. Even simple assignments became stressful because instructions were incomplete or contradictory.

Had him for STAT4340. He's great at teaching probability/simple intro concepts (which is why people in STAT2331 like him) but non-sensical when it comes to teaching calculus based concepts. Extremely hard grader. Tests are long and tough to finish in 50 minutes. Pop quizzes average grades of 30%. Probably still better than the other guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Assigns a lot of homework and at home reviews. The exams can be difficult so definitely study for them and do the practice exams that he gives because they are very similar to the actual exam.
Nice guy who seems to care. Class is naturally hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The class is lecture heavy but the overall grading criteria very straightforward. He is a new professor and super open to feedback to improving and giving extra credit opportunities to students. I enjoyed this class and I think prof saah is a good guy, would recommend this class for a “easy” stats cred.
Nice guy but lectures were super boring wasn't an engaging teacher. Keep up with HW and Labs and you will get a solid grade.

He's new so not great at actually teaching. Mostly reads off slides and boring lectures. Keep up with the homework, exams, and thankfully extra credit opportunities and you'll get a good grade. Very strict with attendance and catches on to students tricks so be careful. Overall he was nice, not my favorite but def not bad.
A really good professor. very nice and respectful even tho extra credit stuff were like 5 points 🙂.

Professor Saah primarily teaches through lectures and does a good job communicating course materials. The class is straightforward, and getting an A is easy so long as you complete homework on time and pay attention in class. He gives a ton of extra credit on his exams and drops your lowest exam grade. Definitely would recommend his class.

He is so nice and curves AND gives extra credit for every midterm on top of dropping the lowest grade out of them. His class does have a decent amount of homework but its manageable. He is a really nice professor who genuinely cares about student success. As someone who hates math this class is very manageable, take him!!

I was dreading taking statistics as someone who's bad at math, but his class is pretty easy and he has a lot of methods to make it easy and accessible for everyone. He even offers some extra credit, which turned my midterm from a 60 to an 88! A great option for your mandatory statistics class.

I think it's unfair to say that the class was easy because I did IB math, but overall, I think he's the best professor here if you have to take intro to stat. He tries his best to make the material engaging and I admire his effort even when students are not respectful/don't pay attention/etc. It's an easy class if you show up and pay attention.

reviews.comment: Please stay away!
Hes funny once you get to know him but this class hard affff
The course material is dense but he condenses it and puts it in practical use. Would be beneficial of having some understanding of RStudio beforehand (Intro to Data Science). 10/10 would do it again.

reviews.comment: monotoneeeeeee
Doesnt answer emails professionally, give no advice and does not have students best interest in mind. Emails are as redundant as class is
If you dont like people why are you a professor. if you dont answer questions and clearly show you dont care and give attitude why are you a professor

Its very simple, if you clearly dont want the best for students, and you take no accountability for the fact you cant teach and thats reflecting over 1/4 of the class failing, then maybe you should not be a professor.

The disrespect towards students is odd. how do you expect respect from us when you make class excruciatingly boring and then show no interest in questions that students clearly have. If I ask you something and you clearly see I care, I expect a normal, respectful response back. If you dont want the best for your students why be a professor

Office hrs are pointless. Ya have a better chance of talking to a wall than ya do of communicating with him. Very dry, doesnt answer your questions at all, and then will try to make you feel small. I dont understand, why be a professor if youre gonna show no compassion towards students or passion towards the subject you literally teach for a living

He doesnt even curve which is hilarious. How are you not curving the third exam? You make the class exams have 93% weight, WHAT? Other biology classes give more options like essays, more weighted homework, not whatever this is. Cell biology should not be this chaotic Professors at A&M actually care and it shows

Had much higher expectations for a Biology class, then again the bio department is not that great here. He's listed as an advisor, you have a responsibility? Turns students away
Take some accountability. Doesnt even seem happy to teach, every class we are talked to as if he's bored

Tells us to change our study methods when that isnt even the problem. I know people who study over 14 hrs a week for this 1 class even though they have 5 other classes they're taking. People are doing poorly on our 93% weighted exams because we cannot learn from someone reading off a screen. thats not teaching
So you tell us that 36 people are failing and dont think youre the problem? That makes 0 sense. A gym coach could teach this class better.
36 people are failing this class right now. Just told us 1/4 of the class is in the D/F range and proceeded to put the blame for it on us.
If you respect him, he will respect you, just go to class and do the work and you'll be fine.

The biology department doesnt assign their students to a specific advisor opposed to business majors. So when I try to get an advisor appointment, maybe it's because I need an advisor for my schedule next semester. He is listed as an advisor. I got told no find someone else. Emails are answered very harshly

Definitely a much better professor than Batista, however, he has the most monotone lectures. He stands in the same spot for 50 mins, often takes up the entire class time past the 50 min mark. I have another class after that I should not have to run to. Taking a test in this class is like being in prison, they take it way too seriously. just no
Such a nice professor!!! the class is just a hard one tbh.

reviews.comment: I liked glasscock more, his slides were perfect. I did better on his exams as well. Just rewrite your notes for him and watch some youtube videos regarding his content and you'll be good. I probably would have ended the courses with a higher grade if it was just him and not batista.

If he hadn't messed up exam three, I would've ended the class with an A- without a doubt. He also responds to emails so rudely and straightforwardly.

Glasscock was better than Batista imo. His slides were word-heavy sometimes, but just as clear as the textbook. Only tests on lecture material which is nice. Didn't like having to purchase access to the homework but it's for a grade so you have to. Tests weren't too bad, but there is a lot of info that you have to remember, so be prepared to study.

Lectures are pretty boring, but honestly I liked Dr. Glasscock way better than Dr. Batista. He is a lot nicer and his lectures are easy to follow. Will let you know what you do and don't need to know and his tests are not as hard as Batista's.

Although he may have the personality of a ham and cheese sandwich, he's an excellent professor! He gives off very clear and thorough explanations during his lectures, where he'll tell you what you need to know vs what you don't. Not everyone will get an A because it's a hard class, but he teaches it well for those who study hard.
I do not like this person at all. Avoid if you can.

Dr. Glasscock is chill and does a good job explaining what you need to know for the course. Make sure to read the textbook: pairing my textbook notes with the slides was super helpful. Be prepared to study a lot for this course: tests have very specific questions and are more application-based instead of pure memorization. Super nice guy overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Glasscock and Baptista both have similar issues in that their lecture style and presentation organization is terrible. Most professors who have difficult tests  are often good lecturers. This is proportional. But this class simply is not that. Poor, boring, and unorganized lectures in addition to extremely meticulous exams. Good luck.

Had no idea it was possible to talk for 50+ hours without changing the tone of your voice, however Glasscock proved me wrong. Very lecture heavy and tests are extremely hard and soooooo specific. You have to KNOW everything just to be tested on a fraction of the material. Unfortunately, you have no choice but to take him at SMU. Good luck Charlie

Others complain because she keeps the cheating at bay, unlike other teachers. She's good at her job and will make you learn. Detests cheating and gets tons of complaints for it even kids going to the dean. If you want to learn, she's the best there is. If you want to cheat take the others.

I don't usually write profesor ratings (this is my first ever) but she was just that HORIBLE I would love to warn others. I have LOVED all my other teachers in my two years at this school so that should say something! She is not understanding at all, very unhelpful and honestly very rude. She could careless about you or anything to do with you
I really enjoyed her class, she's really nice but also expects work.

She got better near the end of the semester, but she was extremely rude and not understanding when it came to absences. She gave me a 0 for something she SAW ME DO, but I couldn't turn it in online for weird tech issues. She didn't let me print it out, and it dropped my grade to a 40. Don't take her class if you know what's good for you!

Mandatory attendance every day, and if you go over 12 absences, you fail, even if it's excused. I went over the limit and she didn't change my grade or tell me, so I went to classes the rest of the year even though I already failed.
i had to withdraw from her class thats how bad it was i could take her i had no idea what was going on. dont get me wrong she can be nice lady but needs to retire!!
She is a very bad teacher. She is not experienced. She talks a lot. She changes her mind very fast. Some day you can be her best student. Someday her worst one. She has no constant decisions.
This professor makes me want to jump off something tall and land on something sharp! She made me hate Spanish, and I'm Mexican!!!

reviews.comment: Do not take her class if there is another option! She is awful at teaching. I only did ok because of my tutor and vhl videos from the homework. She is not accessible outside of class. She rarely responds to emails, and even then, usually not in a timely manner. Attendance is mandatory. She would not round my grade but did for others so good luck!

The professor teaches the content in a way that helps the students best understand the material.  The homework load involves going through activities in the online textbook, which is decently heavy and a bit tedious.  Writing assignments and tests are not too hard, and the professor takes time during class to make sure students are prepared.

Love MD. She is actually the sweetest and funniest prof ever. Attendance is mandatory and classwork is all graded. It can really help or hinder your grade if you choose not to do it. Online homework every day but it's so easy, 2 exams and a final, and 2 talk abroad convos. She's a pretty forgiving grader and a great prof, I recommend her.
She is a great teacher! She is super fun and engaging but also teaches you a lot!

She is very engaging and will cut busy work assignments if she can (SMU has requirements for every SPA1402 class)- she prepares you very well for every exam and journal composition and is understanding/lenient with turning in assignments to a reasonable degree.

She is the best spanish teacher I have ever had, very personable and she treats her students like humans, doesn't focus in the 'professor-student' relationship. coolest professor ever. TAKE HER CLASS! She is so kind, caring and genuinely a great person. Going to miss her next semester. Ask her about her life stories, she's got some really cool ones
I wouldn't recommend taking her. She talks way too fast and other students had no idea what was going on. She also doesn't accept any late work only if you have an excused absence.
Miroslava is very unprofessional, she acts immature. Doesn't help if you're struggling with the course.

She is very nice in class but once you talk to her out of class she can be rude. She will give you attitude and told me attendance doesn't affect our grade then any time I was late to class it made my grade in the class drop drastically.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nice and friendly. Pretty organized. If youre online she only has class meet twice a week, individual or partner work on TuThu then a quiz or writing on Fri. She talks pretty fast, but youll get the gist.
She is the best! So funny and always shows up for class in a good mood. The online homework was frustrating, but is required for all Spanish 2401 classes. I highly recommend taking her class.

This is a very fun class. Quite a bit of regular homework, not too easy, but not hard either. It isn't a very stressful language class, and the focus on culture and history of Spanish speaking countries is super interesting. She can be a bit scattered, but this makes the class very friendly and flexible.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She has a decent personality but I find her quite scattered. She is not good at keeping her class organized and communicating important due dates and assignments. She gossips all the time and hardly pays attention to your comments outside of class. It isnt too hard but the projects along with the online relentless homework create a lot of work.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Great Professor! Overall the course is really easy and I learned a lot about Spanish culture and significantly developed my vocab and grammar skills. The one drawback is that she doesn't speak enough Spanish in class and does not expect you to be able to speak very well either. I wish I had been pushed more to speak and hear Spanish in class.

The only difficult part of this class was keeping up with the *almost daily* homework and remembering the details of articles etc. we read in class - BOTH of which are departmentally assigned. She doesn't give much extra work, while Professors I know like Bogard set lots of extra work. She's so nice and her lectures are enjoyable! Def take her!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: I really liked her - she's really nice and approachable. Online homework is set every weekday which is stressful, but it's pretty easy. She lets you redo your writing work to fix your mistakes which helps your grade significantly, and her tests are not too hard.

reviews.comment: She is super funny, which makes class more fun. Homework is all online which has pros and cons. Stay caught up on your work in her class.

She teaches well and cares about how everyone learns and is doing in the class and makes it interesting. Everything tested is taught and she is very reasonable with her expectations. Remember accent marks though!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She comes into class with a bad attitude. Yells at students for not doing homework but then the entire lesson plan is to go over the homework. Class is boring and repetitive. For tests you have to memorize all the homework assignments. Tough grader on accents, etc. Find another teacher for lab, lab classes should be easy.

It's a mandatory class but not bad at all. Class is different each time.  The class is actually not that boring for a lecture class and she is big on interaction and engaging  you with other students.

Do not take her if you ever expect to get sick at all. She does not care about your problems. If you don't show up to class, you're dead to her. Her lectures are super boring and she doesn't help students. Everybody in my class left speaking the same amount of Spanish as when we came in. Waste of time. Seriously, do not take this class.

Detcheva is cool, and she's super intelligent and qualified. She will help you if you need it and approach her. She's really big on attendance, especially with her TTh classes, so show up. Great teacher, took her again for 2402!
Easy lab teacher, highly recommended. She's very nice and not a hard grader. Be prepared for lots of speaking and writing but that comes with every lab class.
2401 a few semesters ago and the class was very entertainng and different. wanted to take 2302 with her but she doesn't teach it
The only bad thing about this class was that it was at 8 in the morning and you had to be there to get credit because of the speaking part.

I didn't think the class was all that easy. the hardest for me was the listening and we had to write long essays. the class was a lot of fun overall and I feel like I improved a lot. I recommend her class.
Her lab section is very easy, but she should not be a college level professor. Does not add to your Spanish from fundamentals class, and can be boring. Do your work and you will get an A.
Detcheva is one of the easiest Spanish lab professors at SMU. There were 2 presentations, 2 listening tests, and 2 writing assignments all semester. I would highly recommend taking her.

best spanish teacher at SMU. seriously, the spanish department is literally terrible and can be the most frustrating thing about SMU, but detcheva gives you no reason to complain. do the homework, turn in the assignments (they're super short and easy), GO TO CLASS, and pay attention and you WILL make an A. im terrible at spanish and did well.

Detcheva is very friendly. Little homework for the lab section of SPAN 2401 and it is not collected. She is not always clear on what she wants done for projects/papers, but she is helpful in class and responds to emails quickly. Great professor and makes it easily possible to get an A.

Great professor. Really has your best interest in mind. The homework sucks, but it's the same for most 1401 classes. The tests are relatively easy, and she explains grammar and vocab very well. Definitely take her!
lots of homework but not just in this class. you have to go to class because it's a part of the grade. the class was fun and i actually learned to speak-it made sense finally

She is so helpful and such a great professor. She will work with you if you have to meet her at odd times. Her teaching style and the style of her exams are spot on. If she tells you to study something, then it'll be tested. She keeps things simple and makes sure you understand it without piling on useless info.
She's very cool, but she writes her own tests and sometimes her grading doesn't make sense.

The class had a lot of exams and projects, especially towards the end but this is true for all sections. All profs use the same calendar. I learned quite a bit. Having two separate professors was confusing at times but could not avoid it.
Moderate homework.  Easy to understand but have to volunteer.
Enjoyed the class but you have to participate a lot since it's such a big part of the grade. I learned more than I expected but must go to class every day.
She was really cool and down to earth. (Always mentioned going to happy hour.) Easy class for me. I would recommend taking her.

The class isn't easy, but no language classes are at SMU. She keeps class interesting and relates very well to her students. Her tests are the shortest ones out of the Spanish department.  The class is fast-paced, with a lot of vocab and grammar, but then - its a college level language class. Go to class, do your work, get an A
i have no idea why she is getting terrible reviews because i LOVED her!! she was very easy to understand, and a very easy teacher. she would cancel class often too! i would definitely take her!

she was the reason i dropped my span minor. she was not very forgiving and was mean if people didnt answer correctly. i didnt notice her ever take role but somehow she knew i was skipping cuz she took it off my grade, tests are not easy but not impossible.

Makes ACCT so easy. Best professor to take. Tests are insanely easy with some having 90 avg!

Accounting is a hard subject, but Professor Wheeler truly cares about her students. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Accounting is a generally difficult subject but Wheeler makes it as easy as possible. Consists of 3 tests and a final with homework and attendance making up the rest of the grade. Bad, so bad
Worst class I've taken. Show up, listen to unrelated rambles, go home and teach yourself. You're being graded on something she didn't even cover.

She is very straight forward when it comes to her notes, what will be on tests, and lenient with partial credit. Professor Wheeler is the best accounting teacher. Her tests are very straightforward and she is very lenient with points. I retook ACCT with Erika and have a B, which is saying a lot.
Very organized and gives you note outlines. Homework is difficult, but she gives practice homework that is the same. It is a very chill class.
You guys ready for cats?

Overall this was a great class. She is super nice and very fair when it comes to workload and tests. Practices and Assessments are easy if you follow along in class. Exams are super fair and not meant to trick you. This class was very enjoyable.

Really good professor! She's can be very funny during class at the most random times which made class more interesting since the Advanced Accounting is a very technical subject. Also, really generous with partial credit which will help you A LOT on the tests!

I really enjoyed Professor Wheelers class! The class content is hard on its own, but she really wants her students to succeed. She is very clear on what she expects of you and what you should spend time on studying. Really accessible outside of class and always helpful with homework. I would totally recommend her as a professor!

Cannot teach

Never again will take his class
