reviews.comment: Amazing lecture, you'll learn so much from him, since he helps with thesis and conclusion, you will improve your writing. He has homework based on movies, but his wonderful personality and clear syllabus allows everyone to get A in the class. He is the best!

I was intimidated by this class at first but this was probably one of my favorite classes Ive ever taken. Theyre 3 papers for the class and he loves helping and giving you feedback on your work. Professor Icleanu is one of the nicest professors Ive ever had. If youre looking to get some UCs out of the way this is a great class to do so.

Was such a treat to take his class. It never became draining despite class being 5 days a week and he always made things fun and really cared about his students. Always had such a positive attitude which really made days more manageable. Take him for sure.

Prof. Icleanu is easily one of the best professors at SMU. Super funny guy, lots of dad jokes but he's so easygoing it's hard not to enjoy his lectures. He does lots of games and activity so its not all lectures, and is a super understanding grader. Not only an amazing teacher, but a funny and enjoyable person. If you can, take him 100%

Professor Icleanu has been my most enthusiastic and positive professor that I've had all year. If you need any help, he can help you, but the class was relatively smooth. I will definitely take a class with him again if I get the chance. P.S. You'll probably get a surprise on the first day of class (hint: it might or might not be donuts)

I would love to take any class with Professor Icleanu! He is really easy to talk to and encourages participation, and if you want to improve your Spanish, participating is a good start. He involves games in his vocabulary teaching to make the class fun. Homework almost every night but very easy, quick to do, and helpful in the long run.

Dr. Icleanu is such a great teacher. He is funny and makes class pretty fun. tests are straightforward but you need to study a bit for em. Homeworks easy (or on quizlet) and overall normal difficulty course. highly recommend

I took him last semester, and I don't regret taking him again. He's a real gem of a teacher who cares both about the subject and his students. If you put in just a little bit of work, he will appreciate you and grade accordingly. Still one of my favorite teachers at SMU!!!
LOVE!!! one of my favorite teachers at SMU! Take him for sure

Professor Icleanu is great, and he truly cares about what he teaches. This course is not difficult, just know you'll have some homework almost every night. You get to miss up to five class periods, and if you pick carefully you can use all of them without having to make anything up. Highly recommend to get your language credit out of the way!

He's a great teacher! He's very good at explaining the material in many different ways. There's a fair bit of homework, two tests, and a final. The tests are easy. He's also super laid back, and class is always a blast! He's an AMAZING TEACHER, and I CANNOT RECOMMEND HIM ENOUGH.
Takes a little warming up but once the class is rolling he is personable and funny. He's very engaged and involved in learning and conversational in class.

Entirely FRQ exams with no structure and hard grader. Doesn't provide feedback unless you hunt her down for it. Content is much too "high-level" for an intro marketing course. She teaches about vague, high-level concepts like M&As as if we are CMOs of a massive company, not college students about to get entry-level jobs. Content so irrelevant.

She graded us on our presentation before we presented in class. Never let us switch groups or give peers reviews till the very end of the semester. Single handedly brought down my gpa. Your entire grade depends on if you pick a solid group for this class. The test grades are worth less than any of the group projects.

This class is group project heavy and there are only a couple of assignments that make up your grade. Make sure you get a good group that is timely because otherwise you will be stuck. She was nice about leaving class early and missing lectures for health reasons.

Difficult exams. No feedback after presentations. Graded based on group performance not individual. Lots of group assignments. Strict about attendance. Does not provide your overall grade until end of the semester.
Literally the easiest class to exist, and yet I couldn't get anything above an 89 as a 4.00 student. Only take him if you want to tank your GPA. Thanks Hensley!

Most overrated professor. He has a rubric, but the grading didn't seem to follow it consistently. Blames the Cox curve for grading harshly, but no other class with the curve has ever felt this unfair.

Just take someone else. All we did was watch other students present, present ourselves, and watch TED Talks or YouTube videos. No actual teaching, and the classes were dismissed early. Save your tuition.
His grading feels subjective, and he won't give feedback unless you ask. Be prepared to advocate for your grade, constantly ask for clarification on lost points, or be okay with an average one.

Scott Hensley's grading is extremely subjective, especially participation. You can participate constantly and still get graded poorly while students who barely speak or attend class get much higher participation grades. The class feels more based on personal preference than effort, and my final grade did not reflect the work I put into the course.

He is not a bad person or teach the cox curve just messed up the style of his class. You need to actually read for the reading test, communicate with him and your group for presentations, and write a good research essay and that is the main chunk of class. Participation also matters a lot in his class. Class is not as easy as it used to be.

He genuinely doesn't teach, he makes us watch ted talks and watch other student's presentations and thats it. Im sure he used to be better but now his desire to be considered a "challenging class" makes him a hard grader and very unresponsive to students.

The worst class. We watch movies and Ted talks the whole class the only people that teach are your peers in their presentations. He misspells half the questions on the exams which makes a supposed to be easy class very difficult. The exams test on nitty gritty details and you learn nothing about ethics. No wonder an SMU alum was in Enron...

reviews.comment: He's really nice, but not an easy grader. You don't learn much, just make presentations. The tests are super specific, however.

Seems like a nice guy and easy to talk to but VERY difficult grader. Doesn't teach himself rather just reviews peoples slides and always leaves early
I think he was good but changed with the grading decisions that came down recently
Thinks not a good professor. Maybe he was before the change but he's not what the good reviews claim.

The only objective assignments are the reading quizzes, and the class average was always a B. While the class content is easy, the structure and grading makes it worse.

Great teacher with lots of insight and wisdom surrounding the management field and general business practices. His class isn't hard but definitely not an easy A type of class. Theres a fair amount of assignment opportunities to keep up your grade without feeling overwhelmed. He's super nice in class and loves to talk and help w/ students.

Love Hensley, great teacher and always in a positive attitude. Made MNO fun and interesting and made it my most favorite class that I have taken at SMU. Will definitely be looking to take him again. I have also taken MNO twice with 2 different teachers and his was far better. And he's from San Antonio so you know he's legit!
The whole class is basically presentations, no mid term or final. Dr. Hensley is actually really nice and extremely understanding, I would take him over any other option.

The class itself is not very difficult at all; I would say the worst thing is he just picks people to fall under the different levels of the Cox Curve. You can show him an assignment, and he'll say, "Perfect," and then give you a 90. Your grade in this class really isn't based off of your performance; it's based on if he likes you or not.
I think people like him because he comes off as personal but he is a bad teacher who favors some students over others.
Genuinely the most caring professor, always understanding of problems and actually wants his students to succeed. Always asking how we are in the mornings and always has a lookout for us!!
He's not good. Very full of himself and it's like attending soapbox Scott every day. Bad grader.
Overall very easy class. You need to PARTICIPATE because it's hard to get a good participation grade. I recommend him, Super nice guy.

It's like he does things to intentionally make sure you don't get an A. He barely does anything in class, makes us do presentations, then lets us all out early every day like he doesn't want to be there either. Wasteful.

I'm normally an all A student and this class (supposedly an easy class) was my only B+, maybe bec of the new Cox curve. We are let out 20 mins early which did kind of gave the feeling that he didn't feel like teaching. The rubric/criteria he is also looking for is kind of vague. He is a good person overall but I don't think I would take him again.
Does not teach, does not grade, does not do anythin.

Professor did not teach. Students are required to work on chapters like self study. If you want an inspiring instructor, this class is not for you.

He cares a lot about his students and their learning. Major grades are two individual presentations and a group one. 2 open book quizzes&written assignments. You can schedule a zoom meeting before presentation day for good feedback. However, he is a very tough grader, so if you struggle with public speaking do not take him or settle for a B+ max.

Prof Hensley gives the illusion of a good professor, but just enjoys advising. The classes are all group presentations (which you have to email him for feedback on your grade). He is a VERY picky grader and  vague about the rubric. He means well when he gives advice but likes to hear himself talk. As a Management major, don't take him. Take Dao.
He literally doesn't do anything. Wasteful of our money.

Probably the easiest professor for this class hes chill but lowk annoying, is SUCH a picky grader, takes off points and doesn't give an explanation, he took that new Cox grading criteria way too seriously, u have literally no way to get extra credit and he doesn't round grades. He doesn't teach, the entire class consist of group presentations.

Overrated ahl and the worst teacher at this university

Great guy. I'd take him over anyone else everything he does is very straight forward and makes sense. He explains everything well so you're never confused or unprepared. Not too many assignments which is nice and also no exams just quizzes that you're allowed to have open notes.

Prof. Hensley is about as cool as they come. Offering extra time for students and being able to help. Very clear rubric and very willing to be cool with situations. If you don't like him then its a you problem, by far the coolest professor I have ever had.

Should be an easy A but he takes off points on every assignment for his amusement. Extremely sensitive and expects you to not have a voice basically.

Barely gives out hundreds

Wow when someone on here said he doesnt know how to take criticism I was hesitant to believe it, but he really doesnt know how to accept beneficial feedback. Doesn't know how to take criticism and doesn't know how to teach either. Yes he is a character in class and always ends class early, but when it comes to what really matters (the exams and papers) you are screwed and need to figure everything out by yourself.

THE BEST management professor at SMU

Hensley is all around a great professor and I highly recommend him. The course is simple but engaging and he really cares about his students. This course is a joke and so is he. Factors certain students thinks he know everything because he's an alum. Acts more entities than we do.

This guy is a class act. Took him for BLI and MNO, too many good things to say. Knows who he is teaching because he was in our shoes as an alumni. He is knowledgeable and great at giving feedback. Professor Hensley is a great professor. He is very reasonable, understanding, and actually teaches useful material. I really enjoyed his class.

My second time taking Professor Hensley. BLI 1210. You have a few presentations and a few assignments. Follow the rubric and you should get an A. Amazing professor that cares a lot about his students. Best Professor in Cox IMO

Good professor. Getting an A is very manageable.
nice guy, good class
Phenomenal Professor! Must take

absolute goat. class was not that difficult but i still learned a lot more than i expected. i also took this class for honors credit and there was only an extra paper compared to the other sections. take him.

Mr Hensley class is pretty chill and not hard. Listening to the group projects was a bit boring, but I always enjoyed when he would talk after, as his lectures were entertaining and insightful. Honestly enjoyed this class! Found it easy and fun. Just go to class, pay attention, and participate and you will get an A. The hardest assignment / most time consuming in this class would be the research paper but he makes the requirements clear. Group presentations are fine and graded easily! Lets you out early and is just the nicest guy!!!
Professor Hensley is great guy and wants everyone to get an A. Show up to class and do the assignments and you'll get an A. Shout out Scott Hensley.

Professor Hensley is the best! If you have to take BLI, take his class! He always let us out of class early and also didn't make us dress up to present. He is super clear on how he grades and is very understanding and easy to reach outside of class.

The class is all group projects plus one research paper. He gives you plenty of time to meet with your groups and to write the paper, and he is super clear about how he grades. He always let us out of class a few minutes early and is super easy to reach outside of class. There is also no final exam. His class is the one to take!

Professor Hensley is possibly the kindest and most caring professor I have had at SMU. I have really struggled this semester with attendance and completing assignments on time, and he has been so understanding. His classes are very entertaining and he often lets you out early. He is the best!

I am currently taking this class as a freshman and this class is so great. Professor Hensley is truely a one of the kind professor, super cool, literally the best and helps a lot with connections, and cares about your gpa. Hensley is so goated.
He makes learning about management super entertaining. Super chill easy grader

Best professor at SMU! He is very clear with his instructions for presentations/papers and is very willing to help you and give you feedback. TAKE HENSLEY!! You learn without tests/memorization. If you participate and don't ignore him when he asks a question, you get a good grade.
Really cares about his students and actively tries to set them up for success. Really interesting class as well.
A great teacher and very helpful! Take his class!!!
Great teacher. Reccomend taking him.

Hensley was a great professor for Management. He was very easy and clear about his expectations. Really good!

Professor Hensley is a great professor who understands a great school and life balance. There are 3 reading quizzes and 1 research paper that was super easy because he walks you through how to make an A. The hardest part is the group presentations. but you only need to speak for 5 minutes or less. I enjoyed Hensley and would definitely recommend.

Great professor who gives a lot of helpful information. 2 individual presentations and 1 group presentation along with a few small take home quizzes and writing assignments (all pretty easy). Funny and pleasant guy who actually seems to care. Definitely take him for this class.

Best professor I've ever had. 2 group projects that are fairly easy to do as long as you get people that work together. A few quizzes that you can use notes on. love this king

wants you to get a good grade. great professor
joke of a class, joke of a professor, what a complete waste of time this whole program is

Great Professor! I'm not a PLSC major, but after his class I wanted to be. Classes were very interesting and he kept party ideals out of the mix so you could learn without bias. And the info you learn is extremely applicable to life.  Definitely recommend him for any class!

This is the type of professor I came to college for. He's absolutely brilliant in his field, incredibly well spoken, and makes the class a relaxed and comfortable atmosphere. If you have the opportunity, take him. What a great guy.

Great professor- engaging, responsive, helpful, and VERY smart. He knows what he is talking about and is enthusiastic about both the material and helping his students learn. I absolutely loved this class and I'm not a Poli Sci major.

Best teacher I have had at SMU by far. He loves his subject, is fantastic at explaining everything and is super helpful. He has a good sense of humor which keeps you paying attention in class, and class goes by super fast which is nice.

WAY harder than being suggested, when we do well as a class, he makes it even hard so we get punished rather than rewarded. Not available and is rude when students ask questions. AVOID.

reviews.comment: Professor Harris made this course very easy. As long as you go to his lectures and listen/take notes, you're golden. He writes everything up on the white board so you can copy it down. Plus, you get a cheat sheet for the tests. He is a great prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: he creates all the tests and homework by hand. everything is open note and pretty easy. he gives practice exams that questions on the test come directly from. not the most engaging professor, most of the lectures were pre recorded and he just answered questions in class, but a solid choice if you just want a good grade

Mr. Harris is a great professor and I didn't do that well in the class because I didn't try until the final. Every assessment is open notes and it's very easy to do well. I had friends in other STAT2331 classes and they had a much harder time than I did. He's the best option for this class.

This is now the second stats class I have taken with Ian Harris because he is the absolute best! I have heard so many horror stories from people who took STAT 4340 with other professors, but Ian Harris REALLY cares and makes it easy to succeed in such a short term. Take STAT 4340 as a May/ August if you can!! Best was to get an A

Ian Harris IS the stats teacher that you want. I'd base my entire schedule around when I could take him. 2 of our 3 tests were really close to the study guide so if you understand the study guide you'll do fine on the tests. He also drops the lowest homework which is a plus.
The best stat teacher at SMU. Highly recommend. Is a very nice guy. The only annoying part of this class is the labs.

Ian Harris is a really good teacher, and anyone can get an A in his class if they go to lectures and pay attention. His tests are very straight forward and almost exactly like his practice tests. I would definitely take.
He is so nice! Always solves students' problems with great patience. His tests are not hard at all! Pay attention to his lecture and you will get an A easily!

Ian Harris is a wonderful professor. He has a gift for explaining statistics in a simple way that is easy for the whole class to understand. He's also hilarious and tells funny stories. As long as you attend class and take good notes on his lectures while doing the homework and showing up for the labs, you'll be in a good position to get an A!

literally loved taking his class. im not a big fan of math and harris definitely makes the class manageable. little homework and labs are graded by attendance/ participation. he also lets you use a cheat sheet on all the exams. if you have the option to take harris, TAKE HIM!!

Mr. Harris is an outstanding teacher. I have learned so much from his lectures. Pay attention and put in the time and you will do well on his tests. They aren't that hard if you study for them . They are usually multiple choice. For the lab section, your grade is participation, so show up! I 100% recommend this class.
Dr. Harris is a great choice for business stats. His tests are straightforward and very similar to the study guides and class examples.  oh, and labs are not graded!

Harris' class is simple and if you pay attention you will learn the material. Homework is manageable and he makes everything easy to understand. Every now and then he'll take attendance for a grade so show up, speak out in class, participate, and you'll for sure get the A.

Dr. Harris is an amazing professor. The class is an easy A, but he keeps his lectures engaging. He assigns around 4 or 5 problems of (usually multiple choice) homework from the book per week, and the course grade is mostly determined by exams.

If your trying to get into the Business school or just want an A in Stat you should take harris. Tests are very similar to the review's and you only have to go to the labs.  Great guy and very fair teacher.

Easily one my favorite professor at SMU! He makes class interesting and really makes stats understandable, even for someone who's never taken it. He's a very nice guy and talks about his kids and soccer a lot. Do the homework and practice tests and you'll do just fine!
This is a great math to take for non-math people! He makes it understandable for anyone!
Amazing prof

As long as you come to class and take notes, you should make an A's on the exams (all MC and T/F). You are allowed a 8.5x11 note sheet on all three exams, which is ideal compared to other professors who only allow a note card. I barely studied for the class and made an A.  I would definitely take his class again.

Mr. Harris is the homie. He lets you bring in a cheat sheet for all 3 exams which makes them way easier. Also, before every exam, Mr. Harris posts a practice exam that is basically a shorter version of the real exam. A decent portion of your grade is lab attendance, so go to the lab period (labs rarely last more than 30min). HW is short & very easy

Professor Harris really cares about teaching his students. He is always very clear and he uses really cool examples. He makes statistics fun. These are the most interesting lectures I have ever sat through.

Very fun, low stress class. Harris would lighten up discussion by talking about his kids' soccer games. Super nice guy who did a great job presenting material with plenty examples. Hard to not do well on tests because he gives you a full sheet of paper for formulas. Definitely take him!

Great Guy. Class isn't hard but not a blow off class. He cares a lot about teaching and his students, which makes going to class worthwhile. All Multiple choice and true false tests, plus a easy homework assignment once a week. You really can't ask for much more in a professor than Ian Harris
MEMORIZE his practice exams for the tests and final and you'll do fine.

Great professor, miraculously makes Statistics easy. Took him for Business Stats and he simplified everything incredibly well and took us through each lesson step by step. Tests are multiple choice and nearly identical to the review he gives.

Sweet guy. Obviously enjoys teaching. Straight forward about tests, they follow practice tests he gives out very closely. Doesn't normally take roll, but showing up and taking notes is how you get an A. Easy, helpful, and hot ;)
Really Nice British guy.  Only things graded are the tests.  Maybe 4-5 homeworks, cant remember.  If you do the study guides tests are easy A's

A bit challenging but Professor Harris makes this class manageable. When it was the Man United and Man City match he didn't show up to class because he is the biggest Manchester City fan haha :) He's awesome, definitely take stat with him
love him, actually makes a boring subject like stats enjoyable, good sense of humor and a lovely british accent ;) lets you use a cheat sheet for every exam and the final, made an A
Great professor. Class is note-based and tests are very straightforward if you study. A is very doable.

Harris is not a difficult professor. His tests are incredibly straightforward. You need to read through the test carefully and make sure not to skip over words in the questions, but that is just basic test taking.

this is a good professor, he explains stuff clearly, but if you are not good at taking tests, or plan  on cheating this class will be very difficult. his tests are hard, and he is activley looking at the students while the test is in place... if u like to study take this guy and you will do fine

I took Stat 2331 with Ian Harris and got a D-. I dropped and took Tony and got an A. I am a hard worker but Harris gives pop quizzes and his tests are difficult. Stay away and take with Tony Ng, it will be the best decision you'll ever make.

For me, this class is almost too easy. I took stat in high school, and so far have only had a few days of class where I was learning something new. That said, he goes about teaching in a very successful way, the lecture format is stellar. He lets you out of class early rather often, and doesn't have a lab every week, so the workload isn't that bad.

I took this class over the summer. I was surprised bc we had 3 quizzes a week, hw every night besides fridays,a nd a test every friday. Lowest test grade got dropped. The tests were pretty easy, as were the quizzes. Dont take him if you dont plan on going to class. Lectures are vital. Watch out for trick questions. Overall good professor.Nice guy.

Harris is a really good professor who teaches you only what you need to know for the tests. He does try to trick you on his tests (the TA even admits that). A lot of the questions deal with rules for formulas or "this is true for all of the following except ___." The class isn't too bad. I got an A-, but it was harder than it should have been.
Wonderful professor. He explained everything very clearly. Tests were pretty difficult but if you study you will do fine.

Really good teacher! Anyone that can make statistics interesting deserves a medal. Dr. Harris is humerous and explains things very clearly.  He hangs around after every class to answer questions. Didn't like his tests but he was fair. He works around the book but read it anyway.  Also use the tutor center, it helps. The TA's are really helpful too.
Prof Harris does a great job of teaching.  His class was interesting.  Tests were pretty hard.  If you must take Stat for Business, take him.
Professor kept class interesting.  Explained everything very clearly.

A professor who seems to genuinely see the value in the things he's teaching. He's funny and really loves to see his students engage with the texts he assigns, regardless of their previous experience with literature and their conclusions on the books. Do not be afraid to engage in class discussion, he appreciates and welcomes it more than most.

Prof. Sae-Saue is one of the best profs I've had at SMU. Don't pass up on the opportunity to take him bc of bad reviews - some didn't like the heavy reading and felt he was difficult. You do have to make an effort in his class, but his lectures are thought-provoking and he is always there to help - he's very encouraging. Just take good notes!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is a heavy literature class. It will require a lot of reading at a fast pace. However, the professor is awesome. He knows a lot about what he is teaching, so he does it with a lot of passion. There are a lot of writing assignments but I got an A in all of them. Just make sure you read all the books and pay attention in class

There's reading each night and a lot. At least a few chapters per night. But as long as you know something about the book, the quizzes aren't too bad. For the papers, just write about what he talks about in class and he'll give you a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you want to do well in his class, you need to: take notes on every word he says (because he will not specify what is or is not important), run creative ideas by him first, or he will grade you low for not agreeing with his thoughts, also make sure to inflate his ego because he loves to talk about himself and his outstanding accomplishments.

reviews.comment: I hated this class. Just because he knows big words doesn't mean he knows how to actually teach. Most incoherent man I've ever had the displeasure of working with. He is rude and quick to tear students apart. Such a shame since this course is an interesting topic.

Sae-Saue's class started off as daunting with the lengthy list of readings. The readings aren't bad, and the papers are short. Probably spent max 1.5 hours writing each paper, and received A's on all. Super helpful feedback, and a really really interesting class. Def take if you're interested in the course or need an English credit.
Incredible, brilliant. Turns complex literary theory into accessible language.

Lots of reading in this class, but it is interesting reading. Not topics or books you would normally go to the library and decide to read, but I actually enjoyed them (and I'm not a big reader). Graded on participation in class discussions about the readings, reading quizzes, two papers, and a midterm and final.

As I write this, I've taken Prof. Sae-Saue twice. The first, which was this class, made me interested in taking on English as a minor or major. He is definitely one of my favorite professors thus far; super passionate about ethnic lit. and will make you passionate as well. Have to do all the reading, but lectures are 10x more interesting if you do.

Good teacher but the test are really hard. Lots of reading but its an english class

reviews.comment: This class was awesome and Jayson was even better. I would recommend this professor for any English class you need to take for credit. He is fun and encourages students to have fun and not work too hard. I would highly recommend anyone take from him.

reviews.comment: Its all true, he is one of the best professors in my opinion. He is so invested in the material so the rest of the class gets interested too. Follow the syllabus and do your best. He is understanding.

reviews.comment: He is a really nice professor and is extremely passionate and knowledgable about his material. He comes excited to class about his material and excepts the same from his students.
Great professor!! If you go to class and participate, you'll get a good grade.  I will definitely be taking him again.

He is a great professor! Go to class, read the books and see im in office hours and you will be fine. Also put effort in writing. He is very PASSIONATE about his class. If you behave in the same manner then you are set. HIGHLY RECOMMEND

I agree with the other two comments. DEFINITELY engage in class discussions! Participation is not only  part of your grade, but it is also benficial to understanding the course's content. Plus, he has a PhD from Stanford... For a student, that's like hitting the lottery with professors!

Amazing professor! He really is passionate about teaching, and while he is NOT an easy grader, if you put in your best effort and meet with him to talk about your papers + participate in class, you are pretty much guaranteed an A
Really great class, I recommend if you need the perspective credit. He doesnt grade too easy, so put some effort into your paper. Hes a really funny guy. I definitely recommend.
She is simply not as good a teacher as these reviews suggest.
Super nice. She will work with you. Loved her

The course lacked clear organization and direction. Expectations were often unclear, assignments felt disconnected, and feedback did not support improvement. Overall, the experience was frustrating and discouraging.
Poorly organized with inconsistent instruction. Assignments were unclear, expectations shifted, and feedback was limited. The course felt stressful and confusing rather than supportive of learning.
Dr. Kruchkova is an amazing professor. I took her Russian class this semester and really enjoyed it. It was the best class ever! She's not only sweet, but also makes the lessons fun.

Easy with minimal assignments and clear grading criteria! Must participate every class, but she always helps if you're stuck. Grading is very lenient as she cares more about you getting the main pronunciation than messing up one letter. Tests allow copies of the phonetic alphabet and are super fair. Bubbly personality and wants everyone to succeed!

She is the best. If you're looking for a foreign language credit or interested in Russian culture... take this class! Wants her students to succeed and cares more about you understanding/learning Russian than unnecessarily harshly grading assignments. I learned so much in this class and never worried about my grade.

This had to be one of the most difficult classes for me, yet I did not dread going to it. She provides the best learning environment possible and truly cares for the students in her class. It is a tough subject, but she does the best to make students learn Russian. If you have doubts of starting Russian, she will help you & you will not regret it.

TAKE HER TAKE HER FOR FRENCH!!! She is so friendly, sweet, and flexible. She really understands that learning a new language can be scary and does everything to give you a good grade while making sure you learn a lot. Lots of grades, so things balance out in the end. Trust me, take her.

I TOOK HER FOR WL 3389! If you need a CC credit, TAKE HER! She's absolutely the sweetest, most caring professor I've ever had. There are take-home quizzes which are easy, and two individual projects which are also relatively easy if you in some effort. There are a couple papers but nothing to heavy. If you ask her for feedback, she'll give it.

I was intimidated by her only speaking in french but it turned out to be not so bad. Class every day, participation helps your grade a ton, and the assignments/homework feel like completion grades. There are multiple quizzes rather than tests or exams and all content is reviewed the class prior. If you pay attention and go to class, you get an A.

Dr. Kruchkova is a great professor and is super understanding! She cares about her students and what she is teaching! The class is easy if you go to the lectures, ask questions, and do the online homework. There are a lot of opportunities to improve your grade through homework assignments and in class participation.

Prof. Kruchkova is amazing!! She is the sweetest most caring professor, I highly recommend her! Lots of homework each week but it is very manageable. Her class is fun and she puts in effort to know everybody. I am glad I took her class!
Professor Kruchkova was so nice and understanding. Attendance and participation are the most important things for this class, but assignments and exams are super easy because of it.

I loved Dr. Kruchkova! Taking French phonics with her really helped me understand how to speak properly and clearly. The homework assignments are very easy and they're worth a large percentage of your overall grade, so it can be easy to get an A.

Prof. Kruchkova is a very genuine human being. She wants to see you succeed and help you as much as she can. She grades very toughly, but it's only for your benefit. Overall, the class is pretty easy. Just be on top of your work and utilize the professor as much as you can.

Simply the best! She is extremely kind and caring and will help you way beyond than she should. She is very understanding for late work and will usually still give full credit regardless if you email explaining it or not. French itself takes work, but she makes it very fun and easy! Perfect for beginner and intermediate French speakers.

Took RUSS1401 and RUSS1402 with Professor Kruchkova. She gives good feedback on exams and assignments and she is patient and will go over what you don't understand until you get it. There is quite a bit of homework but it's manageable and I found the practice to actually be helpful. Overall great class/professor! Highly recommend!

reviews.comment: I took 1402 FR for the second term. Ms Kruchkova is an awesome professor who is always accessible outside of class; she takes time to clarify things, and is very attentive and professional. Definitely, an asset for SMU!

So Dr./Madame Yuliya is a good professor but it was her first year at SMU. I got a bit annoyed when she didn't have answers to my questions about class policies but that was to be expected. reviews.comment: Professor Kucker was the best teacher I had my first year of college. She is truly passionate about her class, really caring, and offers great help outside class time. This class is exhausting for no reason. Endless nitpicking, unclear expectations, and zero consistency. You spend more time trying to decode what she wants than actually learning. Easily the most stressful class I've taken at SMU.

She is amazing! Attend lectures if you want an A. She makes hard concepts easy to understand. If you have any problems just reach out to her shes so understanding. Extensions r given as well by TA's if you need, just communicate
She is amazing! Take her classes!!
One of my favorite psychology profs! Her lectures are super clear/interesting, and if you study the slides you'll do fine on the test. Also very available outside of class.

Absolutely not, do not take under any circumstances, not only is she the most-long-winded teacher here, she is painfully boring. Her grading is reserved for her pets and she takes no pity on the rest of us. She's also stuck up and rude and for gs take of the mask its 2025 ffs

Dr. Kucker is the best professor I've had at SMU. Her lectures are perfectly timed, engaging, and clear. She truly cares—met with me weekly and helped me raise my grade to an A. As long as you're a good student and interact with her, you'll succeed. Fair grader and super supportive. Take her!

Unseasonably difficult and just plain worthless in teaching. You have to do everything yourself and if you dare ask her highness a question, she's rude as hell and belittles you. Good luck Charlie.

I have had her for two classes (Developmental Psych & Research Methods) and she is the best. Her lectures are very straightforward and concise. By far the best teacher I've had in SMU.

reviews.comment:
Material of this course is what makes is hard but Dr. Kucker makes it much easier

Cares a lot about your knowledge and how much you take away from the class

Taking stats before this class is also helpful

Avoid at all costs. She makes the hardest tests to make sure no one is cheating and forgets about the fact that we are here to learn and need good grades to enter health professions.

Dr. Kucker is AMAZING!! All assignments have clear instructions and tests are fairly easy if you take good notes and study. She will always answer emails no matter what time it is sent. The feedback on all assignments are very helpful.

reviews.comment: Her lectures are great! Just go to class, take good notes, and study. There are 4 tests including a cumulative final. She is an okay professor. She can be very strict and specific sometimes.

Sarah Kucker is great! She really cares about psychology and her students. She's super available for office hours appointments and is a pretty fair grader. The homework is graded on accuracy which made the assignments pretty time-consuming, but they were helpful. Overall, the class is manageable and I would definitely recommend her.

Dr. Nielsen is very kind and open to working with students. I think some of the bad reviews are because students think the class is going to be about popular music which is it not. Sure some of the topics might be boring but Dr. Nielsen is great at explaining. Very straight forward grading. If you are good at taking notes it is not a hard class.

If you want to have 0 freedom as a writer, take this teacher.However; if you are really interested in writing essays about Lil Nas X, this is the class for you. Don't improve as a writer, get little to no insight into actual Music studies, more so what she believes is relevant in pop culture. don't expect any insight into you're class performance.

Amazing teacher! I was the only student in her class and I got the chance to essentially pick her brain for 3 hours a week which was an incredible experience. Please don't pass up the opportunity to take her classes if you get the chance

reviews.comment: Incredible professor - took her for a masters-level ethnomusicology course and enjoyed it a great deal despite being a finance major. You can tell she really enjoys her work which obviously makes the class a lot more enjoyable. If you have the chance to take her, don't miss it!

reviews.comment: Dr. Nielsen is an AWESOME professor!! I took her for Jan Term this year, and I loved her class! She will sometimes assign a reading as homework, but nothing major. Class is mostly just lectures, watching videos, and the occasional group presentation. There is some busy work, but it is graded based on completion. She is an easy grader and very kind.
Professor Nielsen was amazing. Her class was really easy and her lectures were interesting and comprehensible.

Very genuine and kind professor, he makes lectures engaging and recognizes when effort is being putforth

One of the best professors at SMU. Very knowledgeable and is great at explaining complex concepts for both math and economics
Dr. Kim is amazing. His lectures are well designed and encourage students to think independently and critically. His class for me has been challenging, but very much worth my time and effort.
Professor Kim is one of the kindest professors I have ever had. He will go out of his way to make sure you succeed. If you put in the effort it is an easy A.

Bro makes no sense in his lectures, zero sense, no organization and nothing relates to another then you get grades back super late like spend all semester not knowing where you stand to get grades that have no justification. Do the readings and attend class and you learn a lot. Also, pretty easy to get an A as long as you do the readings and participate in class. Straightforward and fair.
The readings were difficult at times but always engaging. The professor and in-class discussions cleared up any confusion. Prof. was good at keeping discussions on track and engaging.

There is nothing quite as jarring as the experience of sitting next to the person Tania busts for using their phone. At first you think she is looking at you, then you realize she is looking at the poor sap next to you. Just know that you are inviting the righteous and feral wrath of Tania Jordan upon your poor soul if you use your phone.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: A great economics professor, especially the the intro level. The whole point of the class is to study your notes clearly as you go on. Her class is definitely a weed-out class for Cox. Final is optional if you get an A and there was an extra credit exam administered when I took her. She's stern but fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: does not explain material clearly and expects her students to have the same knowledge in economics as her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Tania Jordan's classes are massive, so it's really easy to get discouraged from taking her because of the significant number of people who have bad things to say. However, there definitely are many people who do well in her class, but may not take the time to rate her. She's a very solid prof, just do the work and keep up. It really isn't bad.

This was one of the hardest classes I've ever taken. She has decent lectures but no slides so if you miss class and don't get the notes you're in a lot of trouble. Her tests are much harder than her homework and it always feels like she's trying to trick you on purpose.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Jordan is so much better than everyone out here has made her out to be. She is amazing with her lectures, holds your attention and explains the material so well! Yes, she is a tough grader, but all you have to do is attend the class and take good notes to do well; no extra reading required. And she always helps out during office hours too
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Worst teacher I have ever had. Do yourself a favor and do not take her class. You will probably end up dropping it and having to retake it anyways.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I am one of the only people who didn't find Tania's class to be ridiculous. I actually found it to be pretty easy and didn't worry about it too much. This class is meant to discourage people from entering Cox so do not expect her to be friendly or helpful. I could tolerate this class, but 90% of people I have talked to cannot so I would stay away.

avoid this class. the worst micro class by far. she thinks a low C class average on a test is optimal. homework is graded specifically, yet inconsistently. can turn in identical homework and get back 2 diff grades. I think this has to do with 3 different people grading it. After the second test at least a solid quarter of the class had to drop.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The class is huge and technically not mandatory, but if she notices a lot of people are gone she will give pop quizzes. By the second week she had all 300 of her students names and faces memorized and frequently calls students out for not paying attention. 100% of her class is either taking a test or listening to a lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I have never had a teacher who did not want the students to do well. This was one of the hardest classes I have ever taken. I studied very rigorously and attended class very regularly. I have all A's in my other classes and had D+ in this class. DO NOT TAKE. THERE ARE BETTER OPTIONS
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: BY FAR the worst teacher I've ever had. She NEVER covers everything on each test, she's a horrible communicator, she'll humiliate kids in class, is a horrible and unclear grader, and is above else a mean person. As a student who was interested in majoring in economics, that idea or passion has been swept to the side since taking her class.

You learn from the second you step into her class she is not a forgiving woman. Whether it be giving pop quizzes the day before a break when many students are absent(expectedly) or calling out students in front of the entire 100 person lecture. Highly recommend taking a different teacher if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Deliberately wants students to drop her class. Avoid at all costs. I'm a very studious kid who did not get above a 75 on one of her tests. Homeworks are graded by two different TA's, which grade completely sporadically. Teacher shows no interest in the well being of her students
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Lots of people don't like her, but I found her super helpful. I didn't open the textbook once and I've done really well. The daily homework isn't that bad, and if you go into office hours it's even easier. She does tend to spontaneously call on people sitting in the back more. The tests are very difficult though so study a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: My test grade average is a 100 in her class. Unlike most people, I only spend 2-3 hours max studying before her test. To do good in her class, you must be willing to learn. If you don't understand a concept, talk to her after. You don't need to read the econ book at all in her class. All the materials on her test can be found in her lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This teacher is a weed out teacher,  if possible get another teacher. Not even that good at teaching and yet gives impossible tests
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: She took two points off one of my quizzes because the top part of my curve wasn't curved enough, but everything else was right. Just don't take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She's very strict on her rules in the class, but if you play by them and do your work you'll be fine. Attendance isn't mandatory, but the test is over everything she says so GO to class and PAY ATTENTION! If you're in class but still confused she is super helpful in office hours! Don't argue over grading. Overall great professor. Learned a lot.

During the first day of class she'll take attendance and instantly remember everyone's names. If you don't show up, she'll know and will be less likely to help in office hours before a test. Just show up to class and PAY ATTENTION! The tests are over everything she says. Grading scale is very clear, and she won't change grades. Great professor!

Doesn't have your back and it seems like she wants you to fail. I'd take any other teacher at any other time before I took her again. Never had a professor less respected by students before, heard she was getting fired. Knows the material but should be teaching class of 10 kids in grad school not 100 freshman.

I've never had a teacher or professor deliberately try to make her students do poorly and discontinue the Cox track. She gives pop quizzes when there is low attendance to lower HW/quiz averages. The lectures are long, uninterrupted and  mostly tangents that may or may not be on the test, what she writes on the board is 25% of what you need to know.
Tests have very few questions that are completely off-topic and out of the blue.

I did not enjoy her class at all. She was often not helpful to us and a lot of us couldn't understand what she was saying. She talks about not disturbing the class, but will stop in the middle of the lecture to yell at kids and postpone what we actually are trying to learn. She also doesn't give a lot of help preparing for tests.

You are only given 4 tests including the final and you get to drop one. If you do well on the first 3 tests you don't have to take the final. Also the homework is really easy and counts almost as much as a test at the end so DO IT. People always complain about Jordan but if you go to class she is not as bad as everyone says.

I took AP Economics in high school but never took the AP test. I struggled so much in this class even though I went to class every day and payed attention to every boring lecture. When it comes to tests, do not expect to do well unless you study quite a bit. Her tests are impossible.

Hard tests, but not impossible to make a decent grade. Make sure you get all the homework right, makes a big difference on final grade. If you study a lot and still don't do well on the tests, Econ/Business is not for you!!!!!
Did not encourage my success. Athletes be careful, does not have a good understanding of what it takes to achieve athletic success.
Use the book to study for the test.  Do not need otherwise.

Do not take ECO 1311 with Tania. I am a good student; I come to every class, do all of my homework, read in the textbook, and even bought a study guide for this class and worked the practice problems. I studied a week in advance for a test and received a C. Sure, I'm not failing, but because there was nothing more I could have done, I expected an A

Tania is a very tough teacher but I can say the way she teaches is better than any other Eco. teachers for intro econ at SMU. I learned more in two semesters with her then I thought I would of. Are there easier teachers. YES. But if you want to be a Finance, Accounting, or Econ major definitely take Prof. Jordan

Tania is definitely a teacher that will make you work for it. She would sometimes give pop quizzes during lectures if a lot of people were gone. Super picky about phones and leaving class to go to the bathroom or something (DON'T). She is a very fair grader and lets you drop one test!

Tania is a stern professor in class, but quite helpful in person. The people that find her class hard are people that either don't show up, fall asleep through class, or just screw around all class. Pay attention, take good notes, maybe read the book for clarifications, and you should make an A.

Tania Jordan is a teacher that suits a particular student. A student that wants to learn the subject and not just have a teacher tell you what the material is. I was hospitalized one night and I missed a test but she did not like me make it up because one is dropped which is my only problem with here. There are easier micro teachers to take.

Only four tests throughout the year, and you can drop one of them. Do the homework and pay attention to everyone of her lectures. Read the book if you don't understand her lecture that day. If you listen to her in class and pay attention, you will do well in the class. Tania isn't the nicest person, but her class is easier than everyone says.

Everybody talks about how tough she is, but if you go to the office hours and put in the work the class really isn't that bad. If you can do simple math and understand graphs you will be fine!  She usually has 4 tests (including the final) but only 3 count so if you work hard you won't have to take the final! The tests are hard though so STUDY!

Professor Jordan is a very kind, easy to approach woman! She knows all (Yes, ALL) of her students names by heart despite the class sizes. However, I would not recommend her as she rants about material which is  100% unrelated to Eco and will deduct points from your grade for using the restroom and texting as she finds both of these disrespectful.

TJ has a bad rep but is actually a great teacher. Even those with negative things to say can't deny that she is a genius in economics. She's personable, kind, and willing to help. Go to class, take notes, spend some time in office hours, don't use your phone in class, and turn in the (few&easy) homework pages, and you can easily get an A.

Great teacher. You learn a lot in this class and feel like you're doing well... until you take a test... Tests are so difficult and tricky that they aren't even a good representation of what you know. 40% of the class dropped after receiving their second test grades. Avoid her at all costs if you need to make a good grade.
incredibly difficult, avoid at all costs.

Tbh, I think she's a great professor, despite all the negative comments everywhere about her.  Discipline is a must. Attend all lectures, submit hw, pay attention, study. Basically what you SHOULD be doing in college anyway.  If you consider yourself to be smart, take her. She's  always willing to help if she knows you're making effort.

change your whole schedule if you have to in order not to have her. tests are supposed to test you over the material you have studied while her tests are asked in a confusing manner just to trick you. she is also all over the place during class and goes lighting speed. DO NOT TAKE.
One of the worst professors ever. Couldn't be bothered to help her students would rather sit on her throne and dictate the tas to do everything. She lacks manners, intelligence and class. Do not take
She is a very hard intro teacher, but you can make an A. Do all the homeworks and always read your book.

AVOID if you're not familiar with economics. No homework to help learn concepts or help grade, no practice for tests, not helpful in office hours. TAs will tell you that she won't even tell them anything about her tests.

DO NOT TAKE. You can't miss a class, even if you are sick, or she takes points off your final grade. Her tests are absolutely impossible, no matter how much you study. If you have never taken economics before, don't even consider taking her. She tells you on the first day if you haven't had eco you'll struggle. That's an understatement
Horrible professor. Just don't take her

Her lectures jump around a lot and her tests are based on lectures and the book. She calls people out if they are absent, late, sleeping, or on phone. Tests are designed to trick you. Must study an extensive amount to get a good grade on tests.
Terrible teacher. Not helpful. tests are hard.
Worst professor ever. Hands down. She can't teach at all. AVOID. Change your entire schedule if you have to.
Absolutely horrible. Worst teacher I've ever had. Very difficult tests, do not take if you are weak/new in economics. Lectures drag on, not interesting at all.

While she can be very nice and helpful during office hours, Tania's lectures tend to be more focused on trying to weed out those who are not interested by making them hard to understand. Her tests are *VERY* challenging, but she does drop the lowest one. There are no grade "buffers" like homework or quizzes to offset tests. She hates extra credit.

Took her for both micro and macro but she's a lot harder for macro. Got an A in both but had to read the book and go to all the lectures. DO NOT go off her lectures because you WILL FAIL if you don't study on your own. Must be willing to spend time studying and learning yourself or you will not do well in this class.
Worst teacher ever. Tests are extremely hard and class doesn't prepare you for them. Very rude sometimes

Jordan is the worst economics professor you can take. She's nice and if you go to her office hours she will explain stuff to you again. But she is terrible at explaining concepts in class. She covers the easiest topics for the longest time and the hard ones she just passes over. Her tests are brutal and it's hard to concentrate during an exam

Worst class i have taken. She doesn't spend time on the hard stuff that will destroy you on the test. People who say they pass this class are the nerds who don't go out or rush. Save yourself. Do not take this course. Do not make the mistake i made.

Hate this class. she is terrible at explaining things in class. She loves to confuse you on tests and never prepares you for the tests. It's very difficult to study for her tests. I hated this class. Don't take her.

This is a class where you have to figure out how to study yourself. Do not consider taking the 1hr 20 min lecture if you are going to be even slightly tired.  Her lectures are critical to the test, she never covers anything that she missed in class on the test. Use the study guide. If you pay attention and study 2 hours a week, that's good.
I loved Econ in high school but Tania ruined Econ for me. She didn't teach it well, she yells at students, and her only grades are tests. Do everything to avoid taking her

Tania is a great teacher, despite what some reviewers said. I went to every class, studied 2 days before the test for 8 hours combined, did all 12 hmws (took 10mins and were simple), and I got a 97, 103, 81 (lol, didn't study), and I didn't have to take the final because I had an A. Take her if you're willing to attend class and try, if not, don't

Avoid Tania at all costs. The detail she goes into in class comes nowhere near the meticulous information required to pass her tests. She thoroughly enjoys tricking students on tests and does not prepare them properly. Her inability to teach is reflected in the fact that in my class of 160 students not one scored higher than 75% on the core exam.

The material would seem clear during class and I would think I understood, and then I would fail the tests. I failed almost every single test in this class.I tried to get help, and Jordan is very helpful, but were always so many people there that it took forever to even get to talk to her. She is nice but her class was horribly difficult for me.

Literally sucks. Worst teacher I've ever experienced. Extremely difficult tests. My buddy had pneumonia and had to miss the test because was in hospital, and she wouldn't let him take it at a later time and gave him a 0. I wish I curse on this site but because I can't, just know I would call her many bad names.

Jordan is super tough!! I went to class everyday and still barely came out with a B. Unless economics comes naturally to you, expect to spend hours with a nose in your book before the test! Good luck to all those stuck with her like I was.

All I'm going to say is that going to class is 80% of this course. ALl tests are worth the same(even the final) and she drops one (even the final)... Attendance is not mandatory but the only people i see dropping this course are the kids who dont show up to lectures...
If you go to class, and do the homework (which is not tough) you can get an A. She gives some extra credit and lets you drop a test. Great teacher for macro.
Professor Jordan is the worst economics teach at SMU. do not take her. she is just awful and her tests are extremely hard and nobody has the answers from prior tests.

Really helpful and good teacher, but the class is tough. I grasp economic concepts very well and aced the homeworks, but the tests are kinda brutal. I ended up with a B in the class, but I put in a lot of work during the second half of the semester to make it happen.

Professor Jordan is by no means a bad teacher. She's clear with the concepts and quite helpful if you ask her questions. However, her tests are incredibly difficult. I would feel confident about the material because I understood her lectures and my notes, but I would get back a C- on my test. Studying harder did nothing for me.

Tania is a great professor, and is very clear.  Those out there complaining about the "difficulty" of her tests probably don't study, or even go to lecture (not required)  HW is 25%, and she drops your worst test.  You can make an A in this class easily assuming you go to every lecture, take notes, and spend some time studying before the test.

She is a very nice professor, and can be rather funny. However, her TTh classes can seem very long. No matter how well I made sure I understood the concepts, I did C work on the tests because they are phrased oddly and unlike the assignments for class. Make sure you do the homework, it's easy and just gives you points to boost your grade!

She is a tough professor because students have to attend each class in order to earn an A. Tests are tough, but she makes herself available and she is a great teacher for anyone that is an aspiring economics major.

I loved this class! I hated in econ in high school but Jordan made it easy to understand. The classes can be long sometimes. She explains things really well and really got me intrested. If you take notes you do not need the book. GO TO CLASS. She knows everyone by the end of day one and will call you out. Homework adds up to a test grade major help
Not a great professor I have to say.  I studied for hours upon hours for her tests and never got above a B-...try a different professor if you want to take macro

She presents the material in a clear manner and repeats key ideas so that you understand. She doesn't take attendance because the class is too big, but you have to go because she doesn't put the homework online. Her tests are multiple choice but they're phrased weirdly, probably from a test bank. Overall, she's one of the better macro teachers.
She is AWFUL. stay away, seriously. she does a good enough job keeping you interested during class but her tests are insanely dificult. don't take this class!
If you go to all the lectures you'll do fine on the homework and tests. Yes, there is a lot of homework, but each assignment can usually be completed in under five minutes.

I thought she was a great professor, nearly every assignment is multiple choice, and her lectures are clear and well formatted. She has a fun accent too, not hard to understand, just fun to listen to. Showing up to class is graded as part of participation, but if you give her ample warning via email (not in person, shes forgetful) you can skip.

I didn't really like her lectures in class that much, but it wasn't hard. If you basically took notes, then you had everything you need for the test. She drops one test grade, including the final, so there is the potential that you don't have to take the final. As long as you at least put forth a LITTLE effort, you should get a good grade!

Professor Jordan's class is not exactly easy, but it's fair. She keeps students interested and builds a good rapport with students. Homework is frequent but not difficult, and she doesn't take attendance, but she will give random quizzes. Tests are multiple choice and worded strangely, so make sure you read the book.

Professor Jordan is very difficult! The lectures are interesting & she does a good job of keeping your interest -- but her multiple choice tests are impossible!! I usually get A's, and I'm struggling for a B-. Do not take her if you want a high GPA. Worse decision I made.

homework frequently,quiz for several times, tests are not hard. go to class on time and turn in homework because she will keep everything in mind.if you follow her well, you'll have a easy final time with no exam and an A
bad experience , her tests are very long and hard. she picks favorites.

Don't be fooled by these comments. Professor Jordan is an extremely good teacher. Her lectures are clear, concise, and to the point. Hands down the best Econ teacher you will find at SMU if you're actually interested in learning the material.

Mrs Jordan is very good! I took her for Price Theory. The subject is intricate. She does her best to explain it and does a fantastic job! Has a very nice personality and forms a rapport with the students. However, don't expect a "free lunch." Attend class and take notes. Go to office hours - helps every one. Keep up with material 'cause it's a lot.

She is a really nice professor and is readily available to help you when you need it. It's cool that she drops a test so if you do well enough you don't have to take the final. She does ramble a bit but it's easy to get past. Homework is easy and you really don't have to use the text book at all because tests only cover what you went over in class
Awful teacher. Terribly hard, picks favorites. cannot teach at all!
I liked her.

There are 4 tests worth 25% each.  You get to drop a test and homework counts as a test grade.  She does not take attendance and her class is extremely boring. I would not recommend not taking her simply because it is too hard to pay attention to her lectures.

There are 4 tests worth 25% each.  You get to drop a test and homework counts as a test grade.  She does not take attendance and her class is extremely boring. I would recommend not taking her simply because it is too hard to pay attention to her lectures.

Great professor. Does not take attendance (classes are too big) so attendance is not mandatory. Lectures can be boring sometimes, but if you keep focus you will learn a lot. The tests are easy and she assigns homeworks that help your grade. She also doesn't give 'minus' grades. i.e. if you got a B- you get a B GPA. If you get an A- you get an A GPA

If you enjoy intellectual thought do not take this class. If you are good at memorization of facts then this is for you. She is one the least helpful teachers I've ever had, her notes are very poorly organized and she has trouble giving any valuable real-world answers.

VERY boring class, esp T/Th classes. you must go to class because she gives pop quizzes and homework that isnt available on the internet. doesn't use powerpoint, all her notes are from the chalkboard. has an accent but is helpful.

She is not a hard teacher at all, but she is very tedious and her classes are extremely boring. There is not a premium on taking notes because it is very important to read the book  and do the practice problems in the workbook. The tests are only difficult if you haven't read the textbook because you will not understsand the wording. has an accent.
She can get repetitive and dull, but she emphasizes understanding, not memorization.  Not an unfair class by any stretch of the imagination.
A teacher that makes the extra effort

She's great!  Repeats things, so you definitely understand.  She doesn't want to fail you, she wants you to learn.  Her grading system is clear the first day of school, and you get to drop a test!  I didn't even take the final, got a C+ on one test and still got an A.  I still go back to her for help, even in my int. econ classes!

Moves very fast in class and tests are cover a lot of material at once and are pretty hard.  There is homework, but it actually helps your grade a lot in the end because unless you don't do it, you will most likely get an A for homework and that counts as a test grade. You can drop a test, too.
Her tests are hard!
Class wasnt too hard, but she wants you to understand the material more than just memorize the book and theories.

Homework is insanely easy and worth a test grade. Never even opened the textbook, just used the summary page in the workbook, which was enough. She drops a test, which includes the final which I didn't have to take. tuethu class is hell to sit through. She is easily approachable and happy to answer questions.

She is a great teacher. Sometimes it gets boring because she repeats the same material but it is real helpful.  She reviews the day before at the start of every class.  Her tests are tricky but they are multiple choice.  She drops one test and homework counts as much as a test so that is an easy A.  GO TO CLASS!  Get old tests and UNDERSTAND them!

Easiest teacher ever, study from the workbook for 2 hours before the test, you'll get an A. Her class is incredibly boring, but attendance is a waste of time so don't even bother going. Homework is ridiculously easy too.
it sucks, the test are reeeeally hard and I am a person who studies. everyone fails apart from the 1 exception.dont take it

Class was a breeze.  If you show up every other day and listen, you'll do fine.  Tests aren't as hard as people say they are, but they get harder through the course, so stay ahead.  I got an A and did very little reading/studying.
Jordan's Tests are impossible, its all multiple choice, and they suck. Don't take the class on Tue, Thurs. because then you have and hour and twenty minutes in hell with her, Her class is soo boring.
Nice teacher, class is kind of hard but if you pay attention it's not aproblem.
Her tests are IMPOSSIBLE. I got an A in my micro class and then when I took Macro with her I was fighting to pass the class. Whatever you do don't take her unless you want to fail a class.

The tests are very hard, they are all multiple choice which would seem easy but the wording on them is tricky.  She is enthusiastic about teaching the subject but it is still hard to pay attention in class.  I recommend taking Dadres.
No Comments
No Comments
Her tests are impossible.  She is a very boring teacher.  If you have the option take Dadres instead.
teacher lacks awareness for teaching the students, or making the class enjoyable, it's just blabbing until times up, no real structure or teaching methods involved. Difficult and lots of reading.

Worst professor I've met, babbles endless and never makes any sense, even when you TRY to listen he can't make sense. Everyone gpts the assignemtns when possible but when you can't you're out of luck bc his course is the most nonsensical farce of an experience

Very nice and funny guy who knows a lot about Islam. Lectures have no slides/outline and can be hard to follow and know what he is just yapping about vs. on test. 3 reading reports on 2 book you pick from a list. Attendance not mandatory but he'll boost your grade if you go to class a lot. Study guides helpful for test. Don't do for CC, but not bad

He's not hard he's just a waste of your time and expects you to read like its the 19th century, considers himslf a good teacher when he just yaps alll class long and nobody cares what he says nor does he get the point
His lectures are boring. He's not a good teacher makes you suffer to get a good grade. Expects you to read when no one does that anymore.
We do badly because you're terrible at your job.
never again. "I don't know why y'all do so badly..." maybe because the class isn't enjoyable?

reviews.comment: The most boring rigid professors I have ever had, expects you to actually read the books in order to do well and nobody gonna do that

not very good at teaching new concepts and explains them in a very unnecessarily complex way. 
Class is also incredibly boring and lecture heavy, and he refuses to let you out early even if you have 
finished all the topics for the day.

He is so incredibly knowledgeable and very friendly, he is very easy to approach and get to know, but, the class does require you to actually try and do the reading. If you do not do a lot of reading and/or do not have a great knowledge of the Abrahamic religions, I would probably try and take something else.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: expects you to read more than most other teachers and if u miss a single lecture good luck bc he doesnt have anything on canvas, too full of himself to teach well and not very interesting at all, so boring and vanilla in his forever lasting lectures, horrible experience

You are going to have to read - its a religion class not a math class. 
Great man. Good professor. Good class. 
In my opinion, he is a great intro to the religious department
Very rude and boring doesn't know how to teach and expects you to read every week.

He spends more time boosting his ego than teaching with a focus on himself, trying to win approval from students, is awkward and unprofessional. It's hard to respect his lectures when they're so self-serving. Too much reading, too few grades with no explanation, bad teacher.
Lectures are insufferable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Horrible course and professor. Grades are ridiculous for a credit course and his lectures are insufferable. Not sure he even plans what he's talking about beforehand and just wings it. Please don't take if you value your happiness or gpa.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Awful class! He is very biased to his opinion. And will grade you accordingly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Lamoreaux keeps things engaging, but his class requires consistent effort. The readings are intriguing, and using Unstuckstudy alongside them can really help with prep.
Worst professor ever! Talks in monotone, doesn't clarify confusing concepts. Expects us to magically understand. Avoid at all costs!
Utterly horrible experience, he has ZERO flexibility and just rambles on and on about nothing while somehow expecting us to derive sense of the readings when nothing substantive was discussed

take his class, he is a very nice prof

Read the readings and show up to class. Study the night before the test. You will make an A. His lectures are actually interesting and he grades leniently even though his tests are multiple choice.

Dr. Lamoreaux is really clear about the objective of his class. He is extremely well-versed and passionate about the subject, so discussions are always interesting! He keeps the class engaged and I would highly recommend taking any of his courses.
Dr. Lamoreaux is one of my favorite professors at SMU! He has very clear expectations and his lectures are very interesting. I highly recommend!

Dr. Lamoreaux is a fantastic professor. He is extremely smart and enthusiastic about the subject matter. His classes are fun and he gets the students involved in every lecture. Really clear about what he expects from students. Workload is enough to justify the class not being an 'easy A', but if you do the work, you'll do well. No tests; no essays. Professor Lamoreaux is a great professor. There is homework due for mostly every class but it is super easy, you just have to make sure that you keep up with it. Don't worry about taking notes or memorizing facts for quizzes/tests because there are none! The only homework is writing occasional reading reports and reading one book.

Cool guy, would definitely recommend taking his class if you're into religious studies and the way in which science adds to or deducts from the validity thereof. Easy grader but format matters most on his papers!

This is by far the easiest/greatest class I have ever taken at SMU. Professor Lamoreaux is clear with his expectations and  he is always willing to help accommodate his students. If you have a chance to take this class definitely do so!

THIS WAS MY FAVORITE CLASS BY FAR! You don't need to have any prior knowledge of the topic to do well in his class. He is so understanding and defiantly knows the material! Would definitely recommend him!!!!!

Prof. Lamoreaux is an amazing teacher. He is super smart and knows what he is teaching whether it is about the class or anything else. If I had room in my schedule, I would take one of his classes just because he is that amazing.

Amazing professor. Definitely a class worth taking. There's not a ton of work, and all of it is interesting. If you can spend 2 hours every week on this stuff youve got an A wrapped up. easily the best class I have taken at SMU
This class and professor are awesome! The professor is very nice and it is very easy to get an "A". I highly recommend this class if anyone needs a GPA boost. Also, the class is pretty interesting.

Lamoreaux is crazy but his class is not bad. He is unorganized and a little off kilter but he means well. Very nice man and the tests are easy as long as you go to class and take good notes. The final was only 20 questions long and took about 30 minutes. No homework either. (:

No tests, only reading reports that are due at the end of the class. He respects his students and looks at them like adults and therefore takes attendance but not counted towards your grade.  recommend it to everyone!

He respects his students and looks at them like adults and therefore takes attendance but not counted towards your grade. No tests, only reading reports that are due at the end of the class. I'd recommend it to everyone!
best class i've had in four years at smu. i learned so much and had great fun. lots of writing, but worth it. makes you think. 3 thumbs up
