She was quick to grade our work so i could get feedback and understand how I was doing in the course. I would definitely take professor R-D again! Definitely make sure you have the textbook on hand from day one!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Best class I've taken so far at SMU! If you make a relationship with her outside of class and go see her to get help, she likes to drop hints on what to study that helps a ton! Will give other opportunities for extra credit if you put the work in. Absolutely loved this class, if you pay attention and take good notes you'll do great!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: LHR gives great lectures and gives small amounts of extra credit for every test. Make sure to use the TAs and office hours.

She has the best lectures ever and is very accessible. Don't buy the textbook before the class, wait to see if you need the extra resource. She provides good resources so you probably won't need it. There is one mandatory group project.

TAKE HER FOR ACCT if you can. She has a heart of GOLD and wants the best for you. TESTS are not impossible. Acct is hard but shes the best teacher and explains concepts well and does everything she can to help you succeed. If you go to class and study hard you will be just fine!

Very sweet but completely unintelligible. Her lectures are required and she makes no sense. My only word of advice is to go to office hours and ask questions even if you don't have any. If she likes you, she will give you an A.

Tires to come off as this sweet old lady but is a condescending —- when she doesn't like you, which is almost all of us. Her teaching is beyond unorganized and she never makes sense. You'll teach yourself but still have to come and see her “outfits” which is what I think she wants. Attention.

This class isn't hard, but her teaching style makes it confusing. She rambles, uses odd analogies, and never explains things clearly. I usually just go home and teach myself the material in an afternoon. She's also rude for no reason, constantly grumpy, and makes the class uncomfortable to attend. attendance is required but the class is pointless
They read off AI-generated slides like it's the gospel, but if your paragraph is too well-structured, they scream “plagiarism!” Got referred to Honor Council for doing too well. Sorry I try?
Past her prime and doesn't know it. Asks us to nominate her for awards which is sad. And wins them. Even sadder. She's older and out of touch needs to retire.

I don't understand the positive reviews. As a straight-A student, this was my only A- despite working the hardest in her class. She often rambles and uses strange metaphors like "teach the dog" or "read the english" instead of actually teaching accounting. I didn't learn anything meaningful. Take Altizer and get an easy A while learning accounting.
Entire class is nothing but her rambling. straight 🗑️.

LHR is an incredible and caring person who genuinely cares. While she is tough, if you put in the effort and treat her as a person, she will respect you and help you out at the end of the semester. The course was rather challenging (probably more than needed), as sometimes there would be curveballs from what she taught compared to the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Just an unnecessarily hard class, not the move.  The homework are nothing like the test problems

It was a privilege to be in LHR's class! She's inspiring, hardworking, and truly cares about her students. Her strictness—partly her German side—is just her push for you to succeed. She believes in you and will do all she can to help you earn an A by semester's end. I just want to bundle her up and treat her to everything she deserves :)))

I don't get the hype about her. If you aren't part of the 3 people she likes, she is so beyond rude. She's old in her ways and is so hard to work with. Rude to students for fun then cries in class pretending to care about her students. Such a boring class and you learn nothing. She talks in riddles and is so annoying.
LHR's class can be challenging, but put in the work and you'll do well. Utilize her office hours and the TAs - they want to help you succeed. unstuck study was a game-changer for exam prep.
You learn nothing as her methods are so outdated it is ridiculous. Then you have to relearn it again but later on.

She is nice but doesn't prepare you for the exams, with a flipped lecture so get ready to put in some time out of class. If you don't already get accounting and feel like you would need help, it's going to be an uphill battle.
You will not learn accounting, just her way of solving problems. Easy class, but got nothing of it.
You learn absolutely nothing. I am regretting that I took her as I am not prepared for Intermediate Accounting. That being said its a very easy A with minimal effort. Just be on her good side.

LHR is the best. The class will be simple if you put in the work and study far in advance. If you put in the work you will succeed. The problems you do in class are very similar to the test. She is SO kind and looks out for her students with true care.

Tries to make managerial easy to understand. Very helpful and caring, stay on her good side and make sure she knows who you are. Do well on the quizzes and group project to help you grade. Tests are similar to the packet she gives you and will curve. Tests are somewhat hard but if you studied you will get a good grade. Do not make her hate you.

Yea she tried to gaslight a student when she set the timer 40 minutes short for the final. Class is easy if you can memorize random acronyms and charts. The exams were always challenging because they were long in a short amount of time, and I don't think i really learned anything, just memorized stuff.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not sure why reviews says she is nice.. definitely not. A student in our class because he tried to point out that she had set the timer for our final wrong and she proceeded to give him a rude reply and tell him he was wrong (he wasn't). The note sheet she gives us are hard to understand and unorganized.

LHR's class can be difficult but is also very doable. If you go to her office hours and spend time working on packets and other resources she gives then you can do well. She is sometimes a little unclear in her lectures and it could throw you off but things can be quickly cleared up in office hours. If you put in the work, you can do well.

LHR is such a caring teacher. NEED TO TAKE HER!! She really wants you to succeed. You have to put some work in to understand the content but she is very accessible out of class, and will work to get your grade up if you show her your effort.

LHR is the best professor at this school. I had her for both 2301 and 2301. She can come off harsh and strict at first, but its only because she really wants her students to learn and succeed. She likes students that speak up in class and ask questions. Use her office hours and TA's!!!!They want to help.
Professors comittment towards lecture is Amazing!

LHR is one of the worst professors at SMU. She gives no exam preparation whatsoever and uses weird terms and acronyms + her Eastern European accent makes this course so much harder. You have to teach yourself every material and even if you do, I wish you luck. She doesn't give any curves and I do not understand the good reviews that she has gotten.
Time for her to move onto another profession. Not as nice as she tries to come off either. Be warned.

I actually believe LHR she's the worst professor i have ever had and cannot understand her high rating, because she is objectively a horrible teacher. Her lectures are impossible to follow, and although you can teach yourself using online sources, that defeats the whole point paying what we pay for a college class. Avoid at all costs.

Nice lady and makes time for her or a TA to help but in my opinion, not a great lecturerr. I constantly found myself teaching myself the lesson after she lectured and not being engaged enough during class time. I am generally a good student (all my other grades were A/A- this semester) but I just could not get her method of teaching to stick.

LHR is not the professor that she used to be. You have to teach yourself everything and use her weird acronyms and methods. She will bump your grade up to the next tier (B- to B, etc.) but not at all worth it. Her grading is so arbitrary and not based on performance. She is a nice lady at heart, but is not a good teacher and can be mean at times.

Though I did not feel like she always respected me personally, she did give a ton of grace for my final exam score and my final grade. It was undeserving, but I am forever grateful. Also, do not buy the textbook. You do not need it. Regardless, there is a free pdf online. Good luck!

just does problems and does not explain in class. Her videos do not make much sense and can not explain concepts. Have to teach yourself all the material and end up using chegg for solutions to the problems because they make more sense than her explanations in class. Take someone else, do not understand how she has such a high rating
Shes getting too old and her lectures turn into nonsense. The material is not too hard, but you have to teach yourself

LHR is very passionate about what she does but I haven't learned a single thing from her lectures. I've taught myself everything, you have to figure it out. She also does not explain anything about final projects or why we even had to buy the mylab. She has an attitude but overall probably not the worst choice.
LHR has a great personality and tries to be a good teacher, but her teaching style is very odd and hard to follow.
I think LHR might be one of the nicest teachers at SMU. That said, it was difficult for me to sit through her class. The way she expects students to learn concepts is confusing.

I did not like her teaching at all. She is a nice lady, but that does not make her a good teacher. I could not understand how her acronyms related to accounting and for people going into the next level accounting class, they are struggling more because of it now. She does not explain concepts well and her tests are much harder than the pretest.

She used to be a good teacher, apparently, but this past year was horrible. Quizes are no t accessible after you take them so you cant know what you get wrong. Does not prepare you for test. Pretty sure SMU told her that too many people where getting high grades in her class. Take altizer instead.

LHR is an amazing person, but her class is extremely boring. She keeps it alive by making jokes and is very engaging, but taking it TuThu was a mistake. Her exams are exactly like her "workout" and "protests" and have no surprises. You MUST participate in class to succeed.

I actually believe LHR buys bots on this site to boost her rating, because she is objectively a horrible teacher. Her lectures are impossible to follow, and although you can teach yourself using the textbook, that defeats the whole point of a college class. Please trust me and avoid at all costs.

If you do anything while at SMU, take LHR. she is caring, loving, and makes learning  a boring subject tangible and interesting. The way she teaches is how EVERYONE should. She makes super complicated accounting subjects into easy and simplified concepts.

Nice does not make her good. I feel bad because I like her personally but she can't teach and that is what she is supposed to be doing. Class time is wasteful,videos do not help, exams do not match examples, while it wont matter if you don't go to intermediate, for some of us it does. She tries to hard to be cutsey when some of us need to learn.

I feel like LHR is overrated. Even though she's a helpful and successful professor, her lectures are not it. If you really want to enjoy and learn about accounting, I wouldn't recommend taking her because she's not good at clarifying things. She kinda makes things complicated and incomprehensible. I learned accounting from YouTube during her class.

Very nice woman and very accomplished in the accounting industry; however, she is very disorganized and her lectures do not make sense. She is not great with clarifying things if you don't understand. The exams and quizzes were much more detailed than anything that was covered in class

Just completely honestly I'm not always convinced that LHR is speaking English. LHR is clearly a very kind woman, but for someone new to Managerial Accounting I am simply unable to interpret her utterances.

LHR is a queen and the best professor at SMU. I took her last semester when her husband passed away and she still came to class ready to teach. I would highly recommend LHR to anyone taking accounting.
Goat. Great teacher despite the difficulty of the subject itself. Recommend

LHR's accounting class is okay. She will expect you to watch lecture videos before class and then just do examples in class, although the videos aren't always super helpful. I don't really know if I learned anything, but managerial isn't a direct predecessor to intermediate accounting, so don't stress too much if you feel like the class is all over

Biggest regret. Going to be so unprepared for Intermediate Accounting now. It is a lot of acronyms that are not that applicable. Thought this class was an easy A but you weirdly have to work backward and get on her good side for an A.

LHR is probably the worst educator I've ever learned from at any point. Maybe it's just me, but her teaching style of inventing a million random acronyms is annoying. For some kids, it clicks, but some have no idea what she is talking about. Don't expect to learn ANYTHING... just hope that you can solve problems her way for the sake of the grade.

Everyone told me to take ACCT2301 with Eric Mars while I was registering for classes, but I ended up taking LHR's class! BEST DECISION!! Nobody cares more about their students than LHR does. There can be a lot of homework, but she prepares you for the test. She never leaves you blind sided and tells you exactly what she will be testing you on.

OK. I am thankful that LHR gave me a 2nd chance this summer after a bad semester of 2301 in another class. She's very sweet and wants to see everyone succeed. It's difficult material to grasp, no matter the professor, but practice is really what gets you to do well. Suggestions: do practice problems & watch the videos before class. 11/10

LHR is a great professor. The combination of watching her online videos with doing practice problems in class really helps with understanding the material and doing well on the exams. There are 4 exams throughout the course (including the final) and a group project. There are ways to get help outside of class and she is a very generous grader!
Really cares about her students and is available outside class and even when the class is over. Weekly online quizzes, 2 test and 1 final, the final isn't cummulative.

By far the best decision SMU ever made was hiring Liliana. LHR made the core concepts of accounting less intimidating and explained it in a really good way. Her videos and practice problems are super helpful. LHR genuinely cares about her students succeeding and offers a lot of support to students, both inside and outside of the classroom.

LHR is actually the best professor I've ever had. She cares so much about her students and explains the material in such a simplistic way that it feels like basic math sometimes. Obviously, accounting is intimidating at first but she has made it so enjoyable, and her lecture videos are a lifesaver. Definitely take this class!

LHR is the best professor at SMU. She is hilarious and wears the best outfits. She explains accounting in a way that is easy to understand. I had her for both financial and managerial and I absolutely loved going to class everyday. She is one of the kindest people you will ever meet and will go out of her way to accommodate you. LHR is the best!

Makes effective memory tools. Many resources (e.g. book, online videos & notes, in-class "workout"). Weekly open-note quizzes help prevent falling behind. I found exams hard, but she gives partial credit. Ways to help boost grade. Networking with big-name firm. Important to do things like volunteer/Office Hours/talk & ask questions (she remembers!)

Definitely take her. She is the best accounting professor at SMU. She is the reason I got into the business school. She helped me tremendously. If you do all the work and let her know you need an A then she will help you. Im extremely grateful for this professor. Take her class!!!

By far the best professor I have ever taken at SMU. I have never met a professor who inspires me as much as she does-she is the reason why I am an accounting major! If you have the chance to take her I would highly recommend her for both financial and managerial accounting. Don't just take the class though-get to know her as well.

LHR teaches accounting as simple as possible. As long as you pay attention in class, there is no reason to not get an A. Class is made up of one project, four exams, and weekly quizzes. Beyond that, she truly cares for her students and wants everyone to succeed. Highly recommend everyone to take LHR if you get the chance.

Gives lots of examples in class. Very fair when creating test material. It is key to go to her classes as she will teach you how to do the problems if you go, and the tests are extremely similar to her workout examples. Quizzes and tests are hard, but not impossible. Does a good job with simplifying concepts

WOW, what a woman! LHR is absolutely the best professor at SMU. She is very straightforward with grading and loves her students. I have never had a prof that cares more about each and every one of their students. She knows everybody wants an and makes it clear that she will not be the professor that ruins your GPA.

Great teacher! She is very helpful and if you are falling behind she makes sure you get the attention and help you need. She is the best for accounting. Make sure to attend class, and there is a group project at the end of the class that helps a lot with your grade. She is amazing!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Hickman-Riggs is an unbelievable teacher. This was by far my favorite class I have taken at Southern Methodist University. Not only was I able to learn so much about managerial accounting, I learned many life lessons that I will remember forever. SMU is beyond lucky to have a teacher like LHR, I advise every student to take this class.

Professor has been, by far, the best professor I have had at both of the universities Ive attended (Baylor and SMU). Her teaching methods are uniquely structured and catered to the students ability to understand and comprehend the material. You will be doing yourself a disservice by not taking LHR. I was a student in her 2301 and 2302 class.

I love this Professor. The summer course was pretty fast and intense but well worth it. She makes it fun and has jokes or sayings to go with the lessons. Her personality and crazy outfits are awesome. I am so sad I wont get to take her again in the fall. If you have a chance to take LHR do it. As long as you study and practice youll be fine.

Absolutely amazing prof. I took her for Summer session to get my business minor & I learned so much. She made it so easy to learn, and my test average was a 98, truly all you need to do to pass is (IN THIS ORDER) 1. read, 2. watch the video, and 3. attend class. I suggest taking notes for all of them within one document. I did not study at all:)

She's a passionate and quirky professor. There's no homework, but there are weekly quizzes. The lecture videos were long and basically a repeat of what was taught in class but very helpful. She gave a lot of partial credit on exams, so an A is very attainable.

Pretty overrated IMO. Felt like the class is based around just learning her tricks and systems rather than actually digesting the information to gain intuition and real understanding. Feel like I got very little from this course walking out. I do respect the effort she and her TAs put into the review videos so people like me can cram, though.

LOVE LHR. THE BEST. TAKE HER. Dresses up every day. Weekly quiz on Fridays. 4 exams and she prepares you well. The final project she gives everyone an A. Wants all of her students to get an A. Comprehensive quiz at the end to replace lowest quiz score. No formal homework.

I found some of the lectures to be confusing at times, but most of the time they were easy to understand. Quiz and summary due every Friday which were pretty easy. The tests are pretty tough, she said theres no surprises, but I found some of the questions on the tests to be kind of tricky at times. Overall, pretty easy class.

Liliana is a genuinely sweet lady and wants everyone to pass her class. She uploads lectures and notes for every chapter and theres a quiz and summary every Friday (not too tough). Gives more than enough practice problems. She teaches tricks for getting the right answers, but isnt as helpful for conceptualizing. The best option for 2302.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: LHR is overrated by people who want an easy prof. She is extremely self-centered. She never says she messes up: it is always your fault! I went to her for help and she made me feel stupid... as a 4.0 student. She gives a lot of partial credit, but if you want to learn (i.e. accounting majors) do not take her! It will hinder you down the road
Best teacher I have ever had. I hate accounting but she made it as fun as possible.

She is a doll. You must watch pre-recorded lectures before attending the Monday class. 1-2 page chapter summary, 10 question multiple-choice quiz, and My Accounting Lab questions due every Friday. If you participate and she knows your name, you will do better, trust me. Exams are HARD but she curves them.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: LHR is the most incredible professor I've ever had!! She cares so much and makes you feel very respected as one of her scholars.

LHR is an actual angel, but not my favorite ACCT prof. The best way to describe her style is that she teaches ACCT for people who either don't get or like it. That being said, she consistently goes above and beyond to help her students. If you make sure she knows who you are (i.e. office hours), you are basically guaranteed an A.

Hickman Riggs is really sweet but her teaching only helps you solve the problems that she writes. If I opened a different Managerial textbook I would have no idea what i'm looking at. Just wish she taught more about concepts and how to apply practices rather than just answering her exam questions.
she's a gem of a person, but class isn't easy. you have to work for your grade. tests are SUPER long and you have to speed through them, final included.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Hickman-Riggs is an icon, take her if you can. She's very eccentric, but she teaches accounting in a memorable way and is there for her students. I'm taking her again next semester. Don't push assignments off, and actually read the textbook. The hardest thing all semester is the final, so solidify your grade before then.

LHR is a great professor. She goes above and beyond to help the students out and on the whole does a great job at teaching in class. Go to class, its worth it. If you dont get an A in the class its because you didnt listen to her lectures, put in the time or read the book. Just pay attention and always ask qs, shes always there to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Love her. The GOAT. Everyone at SMU knows Liliana is the one to take for accounting. Go to class, rework the homework and practice problems and you'll get an A on tests. Curves your grade based on the effort you show her by going to review sessions, turning in the optional hw etc... Need the textbook as she uses it in class and for homework

Cares about you like your own mother would. Without a doubt the sweetest lady in all of Cox and will give you the best grade she possibly can. Completely ignores the grading system because she loves her students. Personally deserved an F and got an A-.

Governmental accounting is a very dry subject to teach but LHR makes it interesting and engaging. She is one of the most genuine professors at SMU. She cares so much for her students and always willing to help.
One of the best instructors I've ever had, bar none. If you want to learn it right, she's the person to take. I'd take more classes from her if it were possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Horrible. Not at all helpful in office hours. Exams are too long for the time period and she knows it but still does not curve them. Tests Ive material not taught in class but learned from the text book. Practically need to teach yourself the whole accounting course. Would have been so much easier with a competent teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Pretends like she cares about you but its all a facade. She is passive-aggressively rude and so obsessed with herself. Grades the one group projects unreasonably hard. Shes disorganized and posted the final exam date incorrectly on canvas almost causing me to miss the exam. Could not read any comments on my test and was not allowed to see my final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Horrible teacher. Glosses over topics while reading straight from the txt book during class, then asks in depth questions about them on the exams. She is very egotistical and believes she is God's gift to the earth. She made herself fake cry right before my class did course evaluations pretending that she was so sad to see us go. Really overrated.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I LOVE HER!!!! I wish everyone at SMU could have her as a professor. She encouraged me to change my major to Accounting and I am so glad she did. Miss having her

I had LHR for accounting in Fall 2012. It is now 2019, and I am reading her reviews crying because of how amazing she was. One of the best professors I had in my college experience at SMU. You should not only take every class she teaches, but get to know her on a personal level. She cares more than any other teacher I have ever had.

One of the sweetest profs I've had at SMU who genuinely cares about the success of every single one of her students. Lectures often focus on practice problems as she provides many useful tips that'll make your life much easier. Material can be dense, but doable if you put in the effort. I would absolutely take her again for future classes.

Liliana is an angel sent from heaven. She is so sweet and cares so much about her students. She is an excellent teacher and comes up with a lot of useful acronyms to remember information. Homeworks are easy and tests are fair. Every class is a lecture which can get boring. She doesn't teach too fast and makes the more challenging concepts easy.

Greatest professor I have had, genuinely cares about her "scholars" succeeding. I got a B in the class but if you really wanted to you could get an A. I was never that good at accounting but she is very clear whats on the tests!! No homework only problems in class, also gives you a handout for each chapter summarizing it.

Probably the best teacher I have had at SMU does everything in her power to help you succeed. If you mess up her class its legitimately your fault. She is amazing and the sweetest lady you will meet, go to office hours if you need help. Do the homework and follow her methods. 10/10 would recommend and would take again.
Just a gem. LHR has opened so many doors for myself and others, and makes a difficult subject easy and fun. I can't recommend her enough

Took her class during the summer and absolutely loved it. She genuinely cares about her "scholars" and will do everything she can to help you succeed. Whether she's giving extra credit or tutoring in office hours she has a passion for the subject. She also understands her class is some people's last shot at Cox and tries to help you earn the grade.

LHR is amazing, you get out of the class what you put into it. The more effort that goes in, the better you do and the more she respects you. I highly recommend sitting up front, going to every class, and asking questions as she is likely to notice, remember you, and help you out later. Those complaining definitely did not put in effort!

Best teacher in Cox, cannot recommend her enough.  Makes sure students really learn the material, but also understands the difficulty and offers tons of chances to boost grade (curves, points back, 30% of grade is from online quizzes and easy project) - her classes are very hard to get into but she is a real gem.

Hands down the best professor at SMU. LHR cares so much about her job and her students. I was very worried to take accounting, but she made the material very understandable, gave out extra notes, was always available for office hours, and held review sessions before every test. Nothing on the test was a surprise and he's a very fair grader. LOVE

I love this woman. Don't listen to the hate she gets because those people obviously didn't try in her class or even go to her for help. She will go above and beyond for her students because she wants them all to succeed. She is the best professor I ever took at SMU. LHR is the most incredible woman and I will forever be grateful for her.

LHR is one of the most considerate teachers at SMU. If you go to class and put in some effort she will be very willing to help you get an A. She curves her tests significantly and doesn't want to be the reason you don't get into the business school. Wants all of her students to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Of all the professors, instructors, coaches, and leaders Liliana Hickman-Riggs was certainly one of the most inspirational. Above all else is her most gracious self. She is a CPA and has a huge office and even though she was busy she dropped everything to help me on my entry level accounting at Richland college. I'm in tears remembering her. :)

One of the most solid professors in Cox. Very straightforward about grading, and understanding of how the material can be difficult for students. Would definitely take her again, and super nice. If you need accounting, take her.

Liliana cares about her students more than any professor I've had my entire life. She's the nicest lady but can be difficult to understand- I taught myself most of the material. Class is not an easy but she tells you exactly what is going to be on the test. Make sure to go to her office! She bumped everyone up a lot at the end of the semester.

Anyone with a bad review on her clearly didn't try enough. You literally have to read and show up to get an A. I got 100% and 99% on first two tests. Quizzes are tough sometimes unless you read the chapter and pay attention to the notes she hands out in class. She basically does the work for you, you just have to give a respectable amount of effort

Not sure why she has such great reviews. She's a nice lady but the class is extremely hard. Weekly quizzes which you only have 15-20 minutes to do. Almost no one finished the exams in time, they are impossibly long. The homework isn't very helpful.

Loves her students. Cares more than any professor and really wants you to succeed. The tests and quizzes questions are pretty similar but worded differently than the book questions (which she uses often). Put in the time, go to class, and you'll get an A

Do NOT take! Tests are impossible! Literally hands you a blank packet and expects you to memorize fill in everything. There's stuff on the tests that were never taught. Says she's curving the tests but doesn't in the end. Acts like she cares about you when she couldn't care less. She led me to believe that I had an A and then gave me a D.

She leads you to think she is curving the (ridiculously difficult) exams. She'd told me I was doing well &in the end she ended up almost failing me! I was an Acct. major but after taking her class, I changed it. I hate Acct. now because of her! She talks about how helpful she is, but in reality she is not helpful at all! Take a different professor!

Great person.But her class was not helpful at all. It was too easy and went too slow. I've attended for less than 10 times and still got an A and still know nothing about mangerial acct. It did not happen to my other acct classes. She curved too much and gave free points to make everyong get an A. That's great but not helpful.
Do all the homework problems and all the sample problems she posts online and you will definitely get an A in class. Extremely helpful if you need it.
Extremely helpful and nice professor. Do all the homework problems and you will get an A.

I AM IN LOVE WITH HER. she is the best accounting teacher.  the topic is not easy but she makes it as easy as it can be and has her own way of teaching a lot of topics that makes it so much more simple! She is simply amazing and I would suggest just sitting around and talking to her a few times, shes great!

Best professor at SMU! I still keep in touch with her! :) Go to her office hours and go prepared with specific questions and she's super helpful! She has lots of tricks to help you know and understand the material!! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

Liliana is honestly the best Professor I have ever taken at SMU! Definitely take advantage of her study tools on BB and meet with her if you have any questions! The term paper counts for the most, he gives you three chances to write it. Take this class. You will learn more than you ever have before.
Tough but fair. Great guy who promotes good discussion.

Professor Lusztig is an incredibly intelligent man with a wide range of knowledge. PLSC 4370 often felt more like philosophy, sociology, or literature than political theory, and since it was his first time teaching the class, he was sometimes unclear about expectations but was very understanding when COVID came around. He's a tough paper grader.

I feel like students often mistake the intellectual depth of Lusztig's lectures with poor teaching. He is an amazing professor, but his course material is very dense. Class participation is your chance to show him you've read; asking questions shows that you've thought critically, which reflects in his opinion and grading. Great teacher and man.

This professor is a really good teacher-definitely knows his stuff. Unfortunately, I didn't care enough in the class and my grade reflects it. You get what you put in. Would definitely do over if I could. Take him if possible.

Professor Lusztig is a true gem. Although his class is very tough and he makes you work for a high grade, his lectures reminded me why I am interested in political science. reviews.comment: Professor Lusztig is pretty intimidating at first, but is very helpful and kind in office hours.  He can see if you're struggling and will do everything he can to clarify instructions and help you do your best.  He changed his grading scheme to benefit us, and he even made the final pretty easy to compensate for the lackluster grades on the paper.

If you need to take a class and he is teaching one of the sections, TAKE HIM. He's one of the best professors I have ever had, but just know that if you want the grade, you're going to have to work for it. He's tough, but wants you to succeed. He's totally worth the work and after the class you feel great about yourself. Seriously, take Dr. Lusztig

He'll try to scare you a lot with the term paper. He can be a tough grader, but follow his instructions VERY CLOSELY and you'll be fine. Going to his offices hours is SO important. He is so helpful there, but you have to go, don't make excuses. There a few reading quizzes that are meant to bump your grade, but they were more of a hassle than a bump

I would without a doubt recommend Professor Lusztig's Rights and Representation class to anyone! I actually enjoyed every single class lecture because he made the material so interesting and relevant to our lives. If you are talkative and enjoy a class debate- you will enjoy it even more. Only downside is- be prepared to WORK. He expects a lot.
One of the hardest professors I've had.

I got an A+, but I had to work really hard for it. If you take this as honors, you have to write a 15 page term paper, but he breaks it down into so many pieces that you don't really think that it's that long. DO NOT use electronics in his class, or show up late. From personal experience, it is better to skip class that day than be late.

Absolutely loved this intro class. Although my grade suffered a bit, it was mostly my fault. I did great on the papers and he guided me through them. Ultimately it was the quizzes that kept me from an A. Super easy quizzes but I didn't read like I should have. He's an amazing professor. My favorite so far. Definitely reaffirmed my love for PoliSci

Best teacher ever! He really challenges you. Although this was my most difficult class by far, I was so interested and looked forward to class. As long as you go and participate in class and go to his office hours, he will try to help you to the best of his abilities.

Amazing Professor.  Very challenging but he makes you want to work hard and show him that you care.  Very helpful outside of class.  Comes off strict in the beginning but he just wants to make sure you know you are in a challenging class.  Take notes on the lecture and make note of the questions he asks because they're usually on the exams.  G

Not an easy class by any stretch of the imagination, but he is super helpful during office hours and will stop lecture to answer questions. You have to be willing to put in the work, though, but if you do, he becomes infinitely more considerate and flexible. Don't be late.

Professor Lusztig is hard. If this does not digest easily, then I suggest you find some other professor. He expects a lot out of his students, and I am grateful for this. Look, this guy is not a cake-walk, but I'd say that he is a must-have professor if you want to become a better student/person in life.  Highly reccomend to take at least once, let either him or Kobylka be your Historical I pillar choice.  and GO TO OFFICE HOURS! Establish a good relationship, you'll be much better off if you do

He is the most helpful professor I have had.  Extremely nice guy and always available for help.  I thought his class was very interesting.  If you're willing to work, he is a great professor to take.

Show him that you care about the class and are giving effort, and it'll help all the more.  I would go so far as to say that he is my favorite professor.
The man, the legend. No seriously, great professor if you actually care about political science.

Without question, the highest point of my college career was this class. He is the best professor I've ever known. He runs a tight ship, but don't be intimidated by this. He cares tremendously about his students in and outside of the classroom. I cannot recommend him enough! I only wish I could take another course from him.

best professor i've had at smu. this man is the reason i'm a polisci major. very tough class and he expects a lot but it's so worth it. you will learn SO much in this class and his teaching style is wonderful. just don't get too intimidated!

Lusztig is an awesome teacher! However, you do actually have to do work. Don't expect an easy grade, but this is college so you shouldn't even expect that anyways. He may seem intimidating in class, but if you go to office hours, he will be happy to help you with any of your assignments. A great teacher to take while at SMU!

Lusztig is easily one of my favorite teachers at smu, not a blowoff class by any means, but the most interesting class I've taken thus far and his presentation of it is excellent. Lusztig is the best teacher I've had at SMU. He is hard and doesn't taking any **** (don't be late). He expects a lot of his students, but nothing unreasonable. This was a great class, I really enjoyed every lecture. There is a lot of talk about his unreasonable expectations, but this is completely ridiculous. He merely asks you are on time for class, turn in work on time, and proofread. I had a great experience and enjoyed how engaging the class was.

This class is my hardest but also my favorite this semester. Lusztig is a hard ass about his expectations but his lectures are always very clear and he makes the subject really interesting. If you truly enjoy the subject then take his class, if you want an easy course this is not for you. Go to his office hours, and DONT BE LATE

Lusztig is the shiznit. He might be a bit intimidating for non PLSC majors, but in my experience he is very willing to go back and make sure everyone understands before moving on.  Don't be weirded out when he stands with his leg on the table and speaks uncomfortably loudly.

Honestly she is the toughest grader I've ever had as a teacher. Like I don't get that she doesn't understand that we don't want to be writers like I get that. We have to know the basics of writing, but like she takes it to the extreme seriously. She's all right, but she's just a difficult grader.
she was an extremely hard grader and even grades classwork and homework. Attendance is madatory and if you miss class work you get an automatic zero.

just rude, and like the most insane grader , I gave up after my first essay because not only did I check in with her that it was good, but tutors , and I got an amazing grade of a 50, very demeaning, talks like an English major ,
Gives very confusing instruction really just all over the place. Having taken AP Lang/Lit in high school she made this class incredibly difficult for no reason at all.

very tough grader. even if she goes over your essay or even HOMEWORK and tells you what to fix, she will still critique it heavy. go to her office hours to show effort. finish your essay before conferences.

She's nice and helpful, but she is probably the hardest grader I've ever had for writing. She does not offer revisions like other professors. I even go to the tutors on campus, and they tell me my essay is great, but she gives me a low grade. I do not understand her thought process. Unless ur a god sent writer than good luck getting above a B.

She has clear instructions for the essays and classwork. She grades tough for sure but she is super nice and will give you great feedback on essays. DO UR WHOLE ESSAY before conferences!! She will go through the entire thing and tell you exactly what to fix. Also do the classwork and ask her to check it frequently, these set you up for the essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Sweet lady and decent teacher, but unnecessarily tough grader. At conferences, she will tell you what to change and such but still give you an 80 on the paper after making her corrections. Made friends in my class and found that none of them were getting any A's either. Little to no HW but there are some easy grades to bring up your final grade.

Professor Seaney is an incredibly nice professor: she always checks in and is willing to help in class. She is also very accessible outside of class and always answered emails. However, I think she is a tough grader on essays. I suggest checking in with her during workshops to help with your essay. There is also little to no homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: I am a rising senior and I had the pleasure of taking Ona my freshman year. I have recently reflected on my time with Ona, and I have some thoughts. First off, its an intro level writing class and my only message to Ona is this......you need to chill out... I mean take it down about 1000 notches. My advice for students who got stuck with Ona....RUN
Prof Seaney grades tough but she is amazing! She gives you great feedback at conferences and if you really put in the effort and take her feedback seriously, you can do very well.
Really good teacher but grades papers tough.
she is a terrible teacher doesn't care about her student

Professor Seaney is very caring! She wants you to get better at writing essays and prepares you for the next course. Doesn't judge and is willing to help if you ask for help. If you actually pay attention and participate, you will do just fine in the class.

Professor Seaney has been a rough teacher to work with. She has instructed me several times throughout the semester to completely rewrite my papers. Then proceeds to give bad grades once you complete her revisions. Overall she has been nice and kind but when it comes to grading and feedback it is extremely frustrating.

Professor Seaney's class feels almost impossible to fail if you put forth effort. She will literally mark up and give feedback on your papers on the conference days before they're due. She outlines her expectations very well and the class discussions/material feels relevant and meaningful. Her personality is fun as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Did not like her. Couldn't write any opinions that didn't align with hers, or would receive a bad grade. Almost got a C in the class and barely pulled the B-, and I currently have an A+ in this semester's writing class with a different prof.
Shes almost the worst professor I have ever met.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very nice and wants you to do well. Helps you work on your paper and improve it but she just doesn't give high grades. Paper grades among my class usually ranged from low C to high B. If her feedback on your paper is glowing you might get an A-
sweet but you need to work hard
She will really make you work but is not impossible. Really helped me progress as a writer. Go to your conference and she will give good feedback.
She really cared about her students and made the class enjoyable

Got C in both DISC 1311 & 1312 with her, 2 out of 3 C's I ever got in SMU. Class is not hard at all, but she thinks she's a hard grader but in fact she just gives you the grade she have in mind. I wrote an essay one day before it was due, I got a C. Wrote an essay more than 7 days in advance, went to the writing center AND her office hours, I got C

Her class is very easy although there are a lot of rumors saying that her class is hard. If your English is not good don't take her. She laughs all the time and her papers are of topics very popular song so it's not hard.

She may be a though grader, but it made me work harder and write better. Extremely helpful if you reach out. She assigns mandatory individual conferences for every student before each paper assignment. Easy A if you write your paper before your conference; she will correct your mistakes and provides great feedback. TAKE HER, totally worth it!
She is the toughest grader EVER! You will miss a hell lot of points for a simple mistake. No mercy. but she is resourceful and taught u a lot of valuable things.

As long as you read and find her in your own time, she's a big help. I could just see the difference in my writing when I compared my highschool papers to essays I've written in her class. If you are a student who seeks to upgrade yourself in terms of linguistic presentation, her class is definitely for you.
Not very helpful, not connected with her students.

She seems caring and funny in lectures, but very VERY tough grader. I work really hard in my papers but never got anything above 75%.  Other than being a really tough grader, everything else is above average.

She is actually pretty fun. Everything she teaches makes sense and is actually pretty interesting. She loves her students and her students love her. Her class is easy and there is not a lot of reading, we might read an article every three weeks but that's it. She is awesome and easy.
She is a really good instructor. if you are stuck among choices about DISC. Go for her class! You won't regret about it!
the worst teacher ever, avoid her if u can, boring class, and teacher, does not help

Prof. Seaney is very responsible for her students, learnt a lot during the conference. However, there is a lot of work to do and it is very difficult to get high scores in her class, I worked hard through the whole semester and only got a C+. Good professor but low grades.
feel like too much work to do in this class, and the class s kinda boring
She is awesome and pretty nice!!!Really recommend her^^
Super easy!Grab her!
Great prof. Funny, and very easy.

Lot of reading and writing, especially during summer school. Luckily, she was more lax on grading for summer school. I learned just as much about history as I did english. Great teacher.  Has multiple IMs and email if need to ask her questions. Recommend her.
I am so lucky to be in this country. I have not words for this acamedician!!! She is so wonderful!
the class is good... she makes the writing easy.
Interesting Class.. Great topic.. Sci-Fi.  Use office hours and you should make a good grade on her papers.
Seaney is a great professor. She treats students like human beings, and she highly values discussion.
No Comments
Fantastic teacher.  Learned so much.  Actually looked forward to going to class

They literally try to make students fail, give no curves rarely, and then blame students for not being able to learn from them reading off of slides. Other professors actually care and try to make class enjoyable, the difference is insane.
Avoid this professor. Class is boring, uses the entirety of it, and does not give honest grades.

truth hurts. if you dont like the comments maybe review the curriculum you're teaching and your attitude towards students. If you use chat gpt for everything dont you think maybe just maybe the students are gonna catch on? Like really you cant make or write your own tests? Bare minimum

Takes no accountability and often tries to blame students for his mistakes. Acts all nice and then when it comes to giving you an honest grade on a presentation that you and your group worked for hours and hours on, he'll do a complete 360 and give you a grade that definitely does not reflect the effort we put in. He also lied about the curves
He literally does nothing. And allows AI to do everything from writing tests to grading. Not ok with what we pay. This guy needs to go.

3 Tests and two projects is your whole grade, projects should be above and beyond expectations if you want to get a good grade, tests are on big units so study up. Very nice teacher though and if you ask him about test answers he will sometimes switch your grading if he sees your thinking
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Literally do not take this "class" - it is nothing but AI, he doesn't do anything and your grade will suffer because of him using chat to do everything for him. He also can't take criticism well either

Definitely wish I never took this professor, I should have made an A, 100%, but he's a ridiculously harsh grader on presentations and makes exams so so confusing! You'll have to read each question 10+ times because chat writes it for him. What a GPA tanker all thanks to his low-effort class. He puts in maybe 10% effort, chat puts in the other 90%

Overall he's a nice person, but the mistakes he's made are inexcusable. The second test the line for students requesting extra points and for their exams to be double checked was ridiculous. It took up basically an entire class period of 80 minutes. He also keeps you the entire time, I always get out let early in all my business classes except his

Overall he's a nice person, but the mistakes he's made are inexcusable. The second test the line for students requesting extra points and for their exams to be double checked was ridiculous. It took up basically an entire class period of 120 minutes. He also keeps you the entire time, I always get out let early in all my business classes except his
This class is a joke compared to other marketing classes at smu. Avoid if you want an A, he gives out unfair grades and doesn't stay true to the curve he says he "adds" it barely did anything

I was definitely nervous about taking this class at first but with a bit of effort I quickly fell into step and loved this every moment of it. Dr Overgoor is a fair grader and is clear about what he wants while still allowing me the freedom to discover things on my own. The power of marketing is incredible, just ask him!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is nice and makes the class engaging. He does use a lot of AI for assignments/tests. Tests can be a bit tricky and the final group project was graded a bit harsher with no specific feedback. I feel that he did follow the curve but I do think the class was a bit harder than it should be bc it was test heavy and little amount of assignments.  .
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: ITS A MARKETING CLASS!!! How can someone make marketing so difficult and complicated, one of the most lazy professors I've had at SMU. ANd trust me, I've had my fair share. But the effort other professors put into their classes compared to his effort is a JOKE. Seriously do yourself and your GPA a favor, and take any other marketing professor

THE worst thing you could do in life is take this person's class, and by "person" I mean chatgpt-riddled tests and grading. There is no rubric (other than that he claims there is), no explanation, a complete lack of transparency in grading, and unclear questions that are machine created and have nothing to do with the complete disasters of lecture

I would like preface by saying this professor is clearly passionate about the subject and is a pleasure to have as company, a very nice genuine guy with a sense of humor.

This course missed the mark in grading transparency, effective (existent) rubrics, and the amount of AI which seemed to be used in the course materials.

Don't listen to the haters, he's a good teacher. He does use a good amount of AI but it has never once negatively impacted me. His lectures were engaging and there are multiple group projects to break up the lectures. Tests were very straightforward and I did well with minimal studying. He's typically very generous on grading as well.

I found him to be a nice professor who genuinely enjoys teaching marketing. I wish he had a clearer rubric for some of the group projects, as he grades them harshly, but you can still do well. His exams are a little tricky but very doable if you study using his slides and ask him questions. Overall, I would definitely take him again.

Really nice guy who genuinely wants his students to do well. The exams are straightforward and meant to test your understanding rather than trick you. The group presentations are graded pretty toughly, so make sure to coordinate closely with your team beforehand.

nice guy, but was absent half the semester on paternity leave. He uses chatGPT to create the exams and study guides. As a result, his grading criteria and questions are unclear and he wasn't available to address them promptly. Class was taught by other mktg profs, which messed up the grading even more.
Unclear grader on the projects, grades on favortism rather than performance, lacks clear thinking at times. GPA suffered because he is unorganized and doesn't know how to teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Make sure you REALLY read the material and do well on the tests/quizzes. Make sure you do every class activity well since it counts towards participation grade. I found his lectures to be engaging but the tests did have some questions where the wording or information is sometimes tricky and not discussed during class.

When taking this course I found the tests easy but he is unclear grader on the projects, the rubrics are bland and he gives no guidance on it. In my opinion, he also grades on favortism rather than performance. He lacks clear thinking at times but is very passionate about his work. Overall, a good guy to be around, but lacks teaching ethics.

The class SHOULDN'T be this hard but it is hard only because he is such a horrible professor, cannot teach, doesn't know how to, refuses to listen to us and our suggestions, but then OUR GPAs suffer as a result of his incompetence. Send this guy home to keep cooking in professor school or whatever cause he ain't ready.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly, he is a great guy, but he is working out the kinks as a professor. His tests are WAY too long with WAY too little time to do them, and he won't offer a curve even after complaints and he didn't give us more time for the next exam. Quiz and exam heavy and he takes FOREVER to grade the presentations. Again, great guy, meh professor.

Very unorganized and clearly doesn't know what he is doing, which has been hurting our grades as he doesn't know how to teach the material. Dont take, maybe he'll get better but for now he is objectively an awful teacher and your gpa will show it.

Professor Overgoor is a genuine person and he always helps in class when you have a question, or even during exams. This is his first semester teaching this class and the only thing I would mention is that his lectures go at a very fast pace. Sometimes it is unclear exactly what materials will be emphasized on exams. Other than that, great prof.

Unorganized, unavailable, doesn't respond to emails in a timely manner no matter how important they are, is interested in hearing the sound of his own voice than teaching. Dismissive of student input, overinflates his own importance, and make the class all about himself. Avoid.

The best language professor at SMU. Loved the class and my French improved so much. He is always available to support students if you don't understand the material. His grading criteria is clear and applied fairly. He cares very much about his students and the subject he teaches.
The most amazing professor i have ever had. I wish I had him for every class. Very test heavy, almost every week, but very light grader and always lets you re-take.

I took him during fall 2025, I forgot I was enrolled in the class and midway through the semester he reached out to me through email and let me do assignments for full credit. He is very caring and understanding. He has lockdown browser tests but its really easy if you get the overall concept of the lessons. He is a very easy grader.
I do not like him or his teaching style. He's biased
Most entertaining teacher I've ever met.
Honestly, the best teacher i have ever had. I would look forward to his classes, and it is genuinely very hard to fail this class if you try. H
This class turned my brain into soup. Expectations changed every week, grading was aggressive, and lectures felt like TEDx talks from someone's emotionally unavailable ex. No thanks.

He's caring and does his best to make sure you succeed. Really breaks down tough grammar concepts and is super helpful in answering questions. Also super funny in class. Would highly recommend taking Arabic to fulfil your language CC.
Super nice professor, made class fun and I actually learned better because everyone was engaged. Created a great class environment and wants to see his students succeed.

Omar is a great person, and a great teacher. Always made class fun. I was always looking forward to Arabic on Tuesday's and Thursday's, and I know many people who would say the same as well. Wish I had him as a professor every day.
Omar is a wonderful professor. He really cares about he students and makes sure everyone does well in the class. I highly recommend
I adore Omar.  He's a great guy, and I've learned so much Arabic from him over a few semesters

He is the best prof I have ever had I wish I was able to take him next semester. he cares, is willing to help, and a genuine plaesure to take a class from. Mindtap the online homework was tricky sometime but he is always avalible for office hours or will set up a zoom to accomidate. would recomend.
Great professor, would take him again. He's always willing to help.

Easy class. You can't make less than an A unless you're actively trying to do bad. Most people like him because he jokes around in class a lot, but I thought it was a little too laid back at times. Good professor tho, answers questions and gives good feedback so you'll know where you messed up.

Best Professor Ever! He is very helpful! He will meet with you after class if you need help or are falling behind! Very Understanding! He enjoys teaching French and wants all his students to learn! I would recommend taking him for French 1401!
Best Professor. Hes hilarious and awesome take him if you have the chance you wont regret it.

A great professor, very engaged, hilarious, and willing to help. Lots of extra credit and therefore relatively easy to get an A overall. By the end, I could have gotten an F in the final and still passed with an A
Could not ask for a better teacher

Omar. Best teacher I've had at SMU. I have never had a teacher who wants his students to succeed more, and he will go to every length possible to help you. Really makes an effort to get to know you. Hilarious guy, great teacher, super relaxed class environment. Omar is the man, and in only 350 characters, cannot recommend this class enough!!!
He is the funniest teacher I've had at SMU, hands down. Make sure you participate in class, that factors into your grade. Homework is basically a completion grade. Omar is my guy. Take his class.

The nicest, most caring professer I've ever had. He is so sweet and wants his students to succeed. He is an amazing teacher and wants to know who you are. He is available outside of class, responds to emails quickly, and is engaging in class. If you have the chance to take him I highly recommend.
He is funny and kind. Explains things. And he really wants to know every student in his class.

Omar is such an amazing professor. He genuinely cares about his students and wants everyone to succeed. He also gives many extra credit opportunities throughout the semester so getting an A is definitely doable. Highly recommend!!!

I had Omar for my Lab section of 1401. He gets along really well with his students, and is willing to help them out when they need it. He is a lenient grader, and a pretty easy going guy. I would definitely take his class again.
This guy is by far the best teacher at SMU. Show up to all classes and receive a 10 point boost on your final. Hes a really good guy and tells the funniest stories. You will for sure make an A

Omar is absolutely amazing.  If you actively participate in his class he'll like you better and grade your stuff way more leniently.  Great man Great teacher.  Take the class. Homework is easy don't worry too much about it.  Few pop quizzes here and there but if you paid attention in class you bound to get an A without preparation.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Caring

reviews.comment: Omar is awesome. An actual character. Hella funny and loves to engage with the kids.
Omar is the man. Take his class.

Professor Al-Rashdan is one of the best professors I've had at SMU. He makes the class fun, easy, and entertaining. Expect to participate a lot in his class. He is a pretty easy grader and is super helpful if you are struggling. He's willing to work with you to get the grade you want if you show dedication to his class.
I didn't look both ways before crossing the street for the entire semester I had her course

This professor made it clear what content was expected to learn. There is a lot of homework, but it is necessary in a class like chemistry, and it prepares you for the test. My only complaint is that the dry labs (on paper) are not transparent about grading and are due relatively quickly. Take this class if you want to learn and put in work.

This class is a pain because the professor is not good. She puts the criteria for the lab in a different place than the lab. If she makes a mistake in instruction on an assignment, the student receives the penalty.

Proff Otteson is a sarcastic and caring person. She comes ready to teach, locks in, and makes sure you leave having learned something new. One of the best professors I have ever had and for sure succeeded in making me understand chem and even enjoy it at times. Will understand your struggles and applaud your successes, truly enjoyed her class.

Otteson is a very witty and sarcastic teacher who loves her job but doesn't tolerate BS. Her job is to prepare you for general chemistry, and she does that to the best of her ability as long as you do your part. Regularly contributing to lectures will make learning more fun, which I highly recommend.

I love Prof. Otteson! She truly loves chem and helping her students. She has a sarcastic approach to teaching which I find refreshing and uplifting but some students misinterpret it for being mean. Talk to her and become her friend, she WILL help you through chem but also respect her and follow her classroom rules. Take her!

she is the worst. EVER. half of our lab transferred in, and she still gave out the quiz and expected the prelab to be due, even though it was the second class and literally had no idea what was going on. The average was a 67 because she gave everyone 0's on the prelab and quiz. She SUX

I love Professor Otteson! She has a sarcastic personality which some people take seriously but she's just joking around, which I think makes chem a little more light-hearted. Chem is hard regardless of the teacher so go to her office hours! Ask all the dumb questions, she genuinely wants you to learn, she loves chem and wants you to love it too.

Definitely makes you work for a good grade. Nice teacher but the information is hard and confusing. Took it as a May Term, with tons of things due every day. Spent 2-5 hours a day outside of class time. You have to be completely free to take this during May term.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: SHE IS AWESOME! She loves chem & makes you love it too! Amazing teacher, if you pay attention and follow along in lectures, you'll easily learn material. Doesn't add any surprises to tests (just re-do homework for tests & you'll be fine!). TAKE HER FOR CHEM 1301!! She is great & easy! I am a business major & hate science & I loved this class!
horrible. never again. very belittling

Otteson is a good teacher and can explain topics well she just comes across as a bit intimidating. Her gen chem lab can be scary to freshmen but you will learn a lot. Beware of quizzes as they're every class and count for 30% of your lab grade. Doing homework is a must in order to be successful. This is not an easy A, and you have to work for it.
Favorite teacher at the school. All course work is very reflective of med school.

This course feels like a game to try to get through, I had to prioritize studying for this course against all my other courses, and I feel like what I got out of this course was not worth it in my opinion. It is not representative of a true medical school, dental school, or vet school, no matter what she thinks.
I wish I would have taken another upper level biology class, buckle up if you have to take her course...
Expectations felt unclear and grading was hyperspecific

Talks extremely fast and moves through material too quickly to take proper notes. Then she removed lecture recordings, making it impossible to review. Case study questions can be vague and she won't answer questions to clarify. The whole course grading expectations are unclear and feels like a game. Just take another upper level bio course
this class and prof will be my worst memory of SMU.

Dr. O is an incredibly tough professor, and I have total respect for her. She outlines exactly what you need to do to get each letter grade and exactly what you need to do to pass the case studies. She is very particular while grading, but not unfair. It is a hard class, and you will not pass if you don't show up and put in the effort.

The most difficult and unfriendly teacher in the biology department. All assignments are case studies that are graded out of 5 points, so if you miss two points you fail the assignment. She has strict criteria as to how she wants the assignments to be formatted, and will fail you for a formatting error. Will scream at you in her office hours.

This is a difficult class, but Dr. O. explains things very clearly, and she's really helpful in office hours. Instead of the usual exams, the grades are from weekly case studies. They are very hard, and take some time, but when you're done, you really understand the material. And, they're so much better than having to take exams. Worth the effort!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. O is friendly, caring, and makes lectures engaging by adding some humor. No exams, mostly case studies make up your grade. Case studies can be sort of hard to get a 90+ on because your answer needs to be precise, however, they are doable. Not that hard to get a B/B+ with the curve.

This rating is for the LAB and the lab only (lecture was incredibly difficult). This was one of the easiest labs I've taken at SMU. Very little time spent working on it outside of class, and the first lab practical was very easy... second was slightly more difficult. Not sure if it's worth it bc the lecture is so hard, but the lab was nice...

Dr. O is the greatest BIOL professor at SMU. Dont @ me, dont fight back, dont square up, none of that. She is the best and I am so thankful I took her class. I went on to take 2 more of her classes. I wouldve taken more but I graduated! Her class will make you learn and its not in a forceful way at all. Its through repetition and it works.

Dr. O is the greatest instructor Ive ever had. Anyone that disliked her were simply terrible students. She is SO caring about you, she is always available to talk and go over material. Her class is designed for you to succeed. It takes some work but I honestly learned more from her than any other BIOL class at SMU. Talk to her early!

I love how she teaches the information. She says to pay attention in class, and then re-listen to the lecture information when you get home. This has worked great for me. I love the case-study method of teaching information because it really makes you think. I think this class is a great way to be exposed to the info before you see it in med school

Dr. O can be intimidating at the beginning of semester but the class was very straightforward and all of the lectures are recorded and uploaded along with slides from class. If there are any errors she is quick to fix them. Weekly case studies and 1 quiz. No true final and an extra credit replacement assignment. She's great and I'm taking her again
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. O is officially my favorite professor at smu! I had her for both intro and Human tox! In intro, you never really get a chance to know her and people leave with a sour idea. In upper level classes she loves to get to know her students and is so passionate about teaching! This is by far the most interesting bio class ever, take it!

Great teacher with fun, engaging lectures. Had her in the past for 1402 and didn't like her so much. But, with a smaller class size, I've had an awesome experience! It's a shame this class won't be offered again, but I'd recommend all to take her no matter the class. Clear grading criteria and makes the time worth it.
Dr. O is O K. She is not very helpful and can be very condescending. Her tests are pretty much exactly what she gives you in lecture. Will not change her mind on anything.

Horribly mean. She is passive aggressive and despite her positive attitude during class, she is no help out of it. For her tests she expects you to know every single detail she goes over in class and in the powerpoints. She is rude and overall not a nice lady.

Dr. O is a great lecturer, I really enjoyed her class. She does ask a lot of her students tho between the reading assignments,  presentation, paper, and exams, you should get ready to work hard for your grade. Her exams aren't too bad if you study hard. And word to wise: don't buy the text book, you'll never use it. Overall it's a pretty good class

Dr. O is a great teacher. She only expects you to prepare from what she says in class and if you get A's on all of her tests you can drop the final which is nice. I loved her and can't wait to take more of her classes!

Engaging professor and very interested in her students. The class material was boring and not particularly hard, but the tests were crazy for this particular class and were hard to study for. The class average on the second one was a D. Despite the difficulty of this class and my lack of interest in the material, I enjoyed her as a professor.

Loved this class. Very interesting and applicable to everyday life. I can tell Dr. O. enjoys this class which made it even more enjoyable. She's very helpful! Never had to read the textbook. I suggest going to class every day, listen to podcast. Four tests, no final, occasional quiz (you know beforehand) and two VERY CASUAL & EASY presentations.

She is a horrible teacher. She will seem so nice in class but a minute before or a minute after or if you see her elsewhere she hates you. I got an A because I was smart and not because of her stupid attitude. Never taking her class again.

Fantastic teacher! Material & expectations for class made clear. Presenting material in interesting way, enthusiastic, approachable. Tests aren’t too bad, study notes really well especially what she writes on the overhead! I also read book & I think it helps. Only 4 tests, but lab grade averaged in. LOVE body systems so I thought course was great!

AMAZING CLASS! Helped create a strong backbone for future medical classes. Very easy to follow powerpoint slides and interesting information. Best class I've ever taken! Take this for your science requirement, even if you only need a 3 credit course. It's so much better!

Going to class will help a lot 4 some but if you can jus listen to her podcasts nd try 2 memoriz erthing she say u will b good. 2 do well you will want 2 listen 2 each podcast at least 2-3 times and type ur notes. If u tak notes in class they will not b detailed enough. Ther is 2 much info. DO NOT take this class unless u have 2 takes up lot time
