Best professor I've had at SMU so far. Sincere, kind, and genuinely wants students to learn in whatever way works best for them. Fascinating to talk to and every topic was engaging. He truly wants his students to succeed and makes you think differently about the world. Took both his classes and enjoyed every one.

I was in 3310 with Professor Pilcic and I genuinely walked out of his class learning so much about Crisis Comms. You can tell he genuinely cares about what he's teaching and he makes the class fun and inviting. I 100% would take him again if I could and I really appreciate how supportive he was of our class and me.
Best professor ever. It feels like real world work that is meaningful. Super understanding and kind. Assignments have purpose. Would 100% recommend for any class.
he is so great and so chill barely gives any assignments - fav prof so far

I love her, I think she's so sweet, but her tests are so hard, like I studied all the right material, and her exams are so much information, and I think some of the questions could be multiple things also there aren't alot of other assignments, so its hard to bring your grade up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Average.

Quan is the sweetest professor ever. She cares about her students but at the same time expects a lot from them. A few tests throughout the semester and one giant group project that can be time consuming. Her class can be hard but she answers emails quickly and will meet with you to help you. Just work hard and do your best!
Quan is so precious and a great professor! She expects a LOT out of her students but is so sweet and caring and wants what is best for all. You will have a great time with her!
really interesting class. She is very nice and wants students to succeed. 3 exams and a group project. Exams can be tough but curves them a little.
Feedback is confusing and somehow you leave knowing less than when you started.She's not as nice as people think either.

Her lectures are super engaging because she does many fun activities with other students during the lectures. She lets you review our exams and gain more points if you can identify where you go wrong. Overall, extremely nice and flexible, but just make sure to do your VHL.
Their only teaching method was shame. Assigned obscure readings, refused to clarify anything, and trashed students who didn't “get it.” Grades were a guessing game. Borderline academic hazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: rude and condescending and she doesn't really teach much to help better her students for the next level or real world. Hopefully the school can invest in someone better for others.

I took her online for JanTerm, she is a wonderful professor. She responds quickly to any kind of question on canvas/email. Be prepared for hw every single day and a heavy course load. You are basically teaching yourself and it is tedious. Do your work, use resources, and communicate with her when necessary and you will do just fine in this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Shes super chill and really nice. Class time is not really that productive. Super easy grader on everything but exams are difficult. Can submit late work with no penalty. Allows test corrections on all the exams except the final. If you are good at spanish take her and you will have a free A.

If you put in effort, this class is extremely easy. I came into this class stumbling out of the placement exam, but I very quickly got my Spanish back into shape. Fun class, extremely nice, take it if you can.

Profesora Pilar is amazing! She is a wonderful teacher who is patient and understanding. Available outside of class and overall very helpful. I learned a lot in her class and hope to take a class from her again.

One of the best Spanish professors at SMU. The syllabus looks scary, but this class is super fun, and I learned a ton about conversation. We had many interesting guest speakers and talked to so many different people. I loved this class.

This class was a bit tough because it's a lot of grammar-based work. There is also large amounts of time-consuming homework on VHL. However, professor Melgarejo is amazing! She is so sweet and is willing to help one-on-one outside of class and outside of her office hours as well. The tests are hard, but she allows corrections excluding the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Profesora Pilar is AMAZING. She is so nice and understanding. She gives extra credit opportunities which are actually fun! (One was a movie in Spanish). Read the readings before class and try to understand most of it. Make an effort on the reports and presentations and you will be fine. She can see effort and that's what matters. Take this class!

She grades on many different elements so there is not just one section that overly influences the grade. Talk-abroad sounds scary but is quite easy if you prepare beforehand for the questions you want to discuss. Homework can be time-consuming but is manageable. The quizzes are based on vocabulary, grammar, and readings and are done via computer.

Take this class. All you have to do is show up, participate, do your homework assignments, do your Olas Mama(including a format like Talk-Abroad), and you have 3 short essays to write throughout the entire semester. Easy class, but you'll still learn a lot due to repetitively speaking in Spanish.
Nice professor. Her class was really easy, and she grades very leniently. I don't feel like I learned a lot in her class though.

Generally I hate SMU's Spanish program, but she is one of the two Spanish teachers that I really like. I do enjoyed the atmosphere of her class and felt engaged in the classroom. She's also available after class, you can bring up questions or just simply chat with her in Spanish.
She is the sweetest. Always willing to help outside of class. The class itself was not that hard at all. The whole class is in Spanish though, no English at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: After struggling w/ Spanish in high school, I recommend this class/teacher. Its not a hard class and Professor Pilar is helpful/kind. Attendance is super important for this class and she doesn't accept late work so don't even try. There is daily hw online. She offers a few little extra credit assignments and the tests are easy if you study.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Melgarejo is very friendly and fair. I took her two semesters and if I could I would take her again. My Spanish ability has increased so much over the year that I can now have entire long conversations in Spanish and do extended writings. There are online assignments about every day. Speak only Spanish in class and you will improve a lot.
a sweet women and she is willing to help you

I really enjoyed this Spanish class! She is a very nice person and is ALWAYS willing to help you do your best! A lot of online homework due almost ever night. She talks for most of the class in Spanish, but it really does help in the long run!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Pilar is a very nice woman and a good professor. She really cares about her students' success and works hard to make sure we learn from our mistakes. She ended up moving things around on the syllabus a lot in terms of the schedule so it could be hard to follow sometimes, but the class was still enjoyable.

She is a really really sweet woman and really wants her students to improve and learn. Her class was very enjoyable and not very hard. She ended up moving things around a lot from the original schedule on the syllabus so it could be hard to follow sometimes, but the class was still great.

She is a very caring person who wants her students to succeed. Lots of small homework assignments, sometimes lots of small ones that take over an hour. Tests can be challenging if you haven't taken spanish before. Checks hw for completion. Can check your answers in the online book before submitting the online tests. Study the grammar and vocab
Tests are extremely difficult. Everything else is pretty easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's somewhat nice, but isn't very clear about assignments and often speaks too much Spanish. She doesn't give enough info in English for assignments and class work so the class is often confused. She is also bad about just randomly calling on you in class.

Going to her lecture is almost unbearable at times. If you enjoy reading a Spanish textbook in depth and being asked to speak Spanish all class she is the professor for you. She is a very nice lady, but has very boring lectures and then very hard tests. The rest of her class is easy though, but you have to pay attention despite the boring material.

Not the best lab teacher.  There are only two tests and they are a huge factor of the overall grade.  Easy B/B+ and if you study you can definitely get in the A-/A range.  I would recommend a different teacher, but she is overall not bad.
This class is very boring, you pretty much just go over homework.  It requires very little effort but its not a fun class.

Easy homework from the textbook (!!) due most class periods (they take 10 mins or less), a few writing entries (6 or less), compositions (2) and a presentation. Easy class if you do the simple homework, go to class, and participate at least a little. She's sweet and tries hard (spanish is her first language) and will help if you need it.

She's a pretty good professor, I think this was her first year here. Somewhat flexible with grades, by the end of the semester she barely even looked at the homework before grading. Tests aren't too hard if you know your Spanish.

Just a fantastic teacher, really tries to help her students and way more patient in teaching a foreign language than I ever could be. Besides, it's not like there are many other options for Chinese classes
Great professor. Cares about her students and their improvement in Chinese. She is funny and always willing to help out her students. Work is manageable. 10/10
Qu Lao Shi is amazing! Class was fun and we learned a lot. The one on one sessions she offers help so much with grammar and tones. I highly recommend any chinese classes with her at SMU

Like all the Chinese professors at SMU, Professor Qu is fantastic. She's a very funny and caring teacher, and works hard to make sure the students build good grammar habits in Chinese. Class is participation heavy (we do basic speaking practice in class). If you don't keep up with the vocab, it will show in class and she may get frustrated.
Qu is hilarious and really helped my tones.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Qu is an amazing teacher and has made me care about my growth in Chinese much more than previously! Would 100% recommend taking her as a class!

Beginner def. hooks you to take more classes, but, as you go up in level, the difficulty (understandably) increases--BY A LOT! Unlike the other professors she gets impatient if you don't grasp things quickly. If you mispronounce/don't understand something she tends to laugh a bit. But she cares about her students. Definitely has favorites.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Qu Laoshi is a great teacher. She cares about her students and is an easy grader in 2nd year classes, but gets tougher in higher level classes. She really cares about participation and attendance, so show up to class. But if you miss a quiz you can make it up and she's super understanding.
Enjoyable class.
Good.
Truly a inspirational class but the assignments are little bit difficult ( though Chinese is your mother tongue), nice teacher.
It's not a SHOW UP class!!! To some extent, very difficult to get the grade above 90.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I've taken CHIN 1402, 2401, 2402, 3311, 3312 with Qu Laoshi. She has good intentions for her students & will push you to help you improve which may come off a bit harsh sometimes. She is a caring and understanding. Beginning and Intermediate Chinese are pretty solid courses, but Advanced Chinese gets difficult. Attendance affects your grade!

Such a great professor. She is very direct, but has no bad intentions. If you aren't trying, she will call you out for it. If you are trying, she will help you to no end. Great professor, great class, answers all questions, very nice person.

Qu Lao Shi is amazing! She is so nice and helpful and cares so much about each and every one of her students. As long as you pay attention in class and try, you will do well. She will not let you fail if she sees your effort. She dresses really well too!

Mrs. Qu is a nice, cute lady. She is sweet to students and jokes around with us. She corrects students on tones and small mistakes, which I appreciate. I didn't give her fives on everything because I think that she moves a bit too quickly with the material. She misunderstands questions at times. Still a great teacher, though.

Dr. Quicksall is definitely very knowledgeable about all things chemistry and Environmental Engineering. He's definitely great to talk to during office hours and all of his exams and homework assignments are always take-home. Class often gets cancelled or moved to zoom.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is not the only professor that teaches this course, but it was awful. The feedback was slow and vague. It was often hard to know what we did wrong. He is a nice person and was always in a good mood and had a smile which was nice. I still cant recommend him for ENGR 1357 though

Dr. Quicksall is an amazing professor and an amazing person. He cares mostly about making sure you understand the material. If you put in the work, do your best, and show him that you care about the class you will do well. Make sure to go to office hours too! He genuinely wants to make sure you are doing well academically and generally too.

Quicksall is by far the best teacher I've had at SMU. He will go out of his way to help you succeed if you ask him. Im not even an engineering major and he has helped me find enough scholarships to stay at SMU and has allowed me to design my own classes to prepare me for my dream jobs. I would recommend his class 1000x over
awsome !!!!

Professor Quicksall is one of my absolute favorite teachers in the Engineering department at SMU. Although the class is difficult, and he doesn't really go by the book, if you go to see him he will truely help you. I thought I was going to fail the class because I was not doing too well on the tests, but i managed to finish with a B.

Took the course as a hybrid course during COVID. The content was simple enough, with interesting online labs to be completed during the lecture time, whether in class or zoom. The labs were insightful, and the grades were distributed in a way where no single assignment could destroy your grade. The lectures promoted dialogue/insightful discussions.

One of best lecturers I've had, super interactive and engaging. Lots of homework/busy work outside of class. Tests/quizzes have a lot of trick questions but content isn't that hard you just have to study. Group projects are large part of class. Prepare to have weekly homework assignments and quizzes. Drops lowest test and homework.

reviews.comment: Dr. Q is extremely kind and professional. She puts more work into preparing the schedule and syllabus than any professor I have ever had. Project Management is a useful class and Quinones is very knowledgeable with the concept. Tests require studying, but not an unnecessary amount by any means. Make sure you have a good group project team!

I loved Dr. Q. While I wasn't really interested in the course material she is really passionate about it which makes the mandatory class more enjoyable. The class is easy lots of grades to add a cushion. Also, she lets you have a cheat sheet for every exam and you don't have to take the final if you like your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Quinones is a fine professor for MNO. Not the best but is a nice lady who cares about her students. Material is super boring and seems straight forward but you definitely have to study for her tests. Must understand concepts very very well to do well on tests (always tricky). Overall, I would have taken someone else over her if I could have

Karin is a very caring professor who wants to make students work in Management, traditionally a field which is less challenging that others. She prints the slides for the lecture everyday and values participation. The tests do require memorization but are pretty simple. Group project has strange grading criteria but overall pretty easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Q is a really sweet lady, but she makes management way harder than it needs to be. reviews.comment: Thought this class was going to be a breeze, but the tests were really hard and she isn't really clear what she expects of you. Take an easier prof

She really cares about her class and enjoys teaching her subject. She brings in lots of real world examples and uses many companies to make material relevant. She was out this semester because her mother died but made sure the material was made up. Just look up and listen for like 2/3 of the class and you will do well.

Professor Quinones gives a really good overview of Project Management and her lectures are very thorough and I really learned a lot. However, when we were doing the actual group project, many of the assignments felt like busy work, and I think our time could have been better spent working on the project itself rather than on the paper work.
Great professor...one of the best I've taken in Cox.  Extremely helpful, not too hard, but tests are very involved.  Took her for Intro and Project Management.  Great professor
A lot of busy work and projects, but overall not a hard class.

Good teacher for the most part, definitely worth going to class as the material she covers will be on the tests. Tests are not too hard, there is just a lot of memorizing that is necessary to do well. A LOT OF MEMORIZING. Sometimes she is not clear on assignment due dates, especially when it comes to your group project. Not too hard of a class.
No Comments
Organizational Change is a wonderful class and would definitely recommend it to anyone! The cases were very interesting and kept the discussions engaging :)
Mickey is an amazing profesor..

reviews.comment: Great teacher.  Very committed to gaining student discussion in class and topics are very relevent to current management topics.  Highly recommend.
awesome professor with little to no homework    Tests are mc exactly from his outline pretty much
Best Professor I 've ever seen!
He's the man...good teacher and always open to help
Amazing professor, truly cares about his students, grades fairly and efficiently.
Very good teacher. Tests are not bad at all if you study and make a really good note sheet

This class sucked.  I thought it was really boring, never went, made A's on all my exams, but still got a b in the class.  I would say he was really easy based on his tests, but he really will curve your grade down if you don't show up and participate on a regular basis.
Genuinely cares about his students. Awesome guy, and quite entertaining to see in class. Top 3 favorite professors on campus. If you do not take his class you are making a mistake

wonderful professor. he is my favorite professor at smu. he truly cares about the success of his students. When he says he here to help he really does mean it. Do the homework, seek help when needed and u shall be fine. I love dis professor.

Fabulous professor. You need to just do the homework's throughly to ace the tests. Its just about 10 questions per chapter, so it is not difficult at all. He is extremely helpful and has a great resources like video solutions and plenty of TA sessions. He doesn't mind helping you even 15 minutes before the test. The TA sessions were not beneficial.

Finance is a tough subject, but Qin Lei works hard to help all his students succeed.4 tests, no final, and he drops the lowest test score. You have to work to get an A, but Lei goes out of his way to help students, posting video solutions to HW problems and hosting all-day review sessions before tests.

he is a wonderful teacher, always wants to help and goes out of his way to give extra lessons and tutorials (saturdays before a test, in the afternoon etc)he posts videos online where he explains homework problems and old test problems. the tests are doable but still hard. u either understand finance or u dont. he is great though!!!

Such a sweet man! Easiest class i've ever taken. Don't expect to learn anything though...he rambles and goes on side tangents constantly during lectures. Attendance is also taken and there's 3 exams and a final group project. Exams also don't make all that much sense but i'd take him again tbh

This professor should not be allowed to teach anymore. He calls on students to answer questions like, have you ever shot or carried a gun, do you have mental issues, and take medicine for them. He talks in circles and makes no sense. If you have to take him, I am sorry.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Makes no sense whatsoever. Just talks the whole time about random stuff. Test are open book but the textbook is written by him and makes no sense which makes test tough. This class is a joke but he was the only option.

Class is 90% random stories and 10% actual teaching. The only grades are 3 tests and a project at the end so if you mess up you're cooked. Tests are open book but he wrote the textbook and it's confusing. He's also not tech savvy at all which is annoying at times. Worst marketing prof but sadly not avoidable at the moment.

While this class wasn't too bad for me, I cannot stand him. He talks about nothing important in class but boring stories. While attendance isn't taken in class, there is a participation grade. He makes you have your name tag out. You will only learn from the textbook he wrote. His tests are open book/note which is very helpful.
This person is reprehensible! He exploits his position to evade accountability for his crimes.
I did not take this professor but I am writing because he hit a student with his car on SMU campus and refuses to take accountability! He should be ashamed of himself! and the university!

he is very difficult to understand, feels like he is teaching to only few students of the class who knows everything already. he might be a good researcher but not at all a good professor. not at all in a flow

This teacher was overall probably one of the worst professors I have ever had. He didnt know how to teach the material and seemed to be confused by it all. He graded based on his feelings, while also giving daily quizzes that he doesnt even know how to do. Overall, every student sat in class frustrated on the daily with his teaching style.

Professor Sethuraman tends to go off track a lot and waste time for students in class. This class wasnt that hard, but his grading scale is adjusted for his really picky grading. I don't really understand him.

reviews.comment: I would take him again.
I would take his class again. Wish he was at my college in College Station.

"Scalise has open note exams, there's no way it can be that hard."

Do not be fooled.

I watched some of the smartest people I know get their GPAs crushed. Partial credit does not exist whatsoever. Your hard work won't be paid off.

Forced majority of class to drop due to failing grades, refused to curve even though test averages were below 50. Total lack of empathy for students, called assignments extremely easy despite failing grades and told students they needed accommodations because they were doing so poorly. Absolutely would not recommend.

Nice old man, obviously very knowledgable in physics and seems like a great advanced physics teacher but doesnt know how to dumb things down for intro physics. Bases teaching off of calculus. not good. absolutely do not recommend. Grades were absolute, no curve was given even tho the averages on the exams didnt break 60%. Does random reading quizzes. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He does not prepare his students for any of the quizzes and tests. Missing just one question on anything brings you down to a B automatically. He has no empathy and thinks it's funny when students struggle. He laughs and says the tests and quizzes are "so easy" when averages are always below 50%. Do not take this class if you care about your GPA.
Worst professor at SMU. I've aced all my stem courses but literally had to drop this class. do not take!!!

Literally used notes from a billion years ago and he teaches as if hes just talking to himself. His tests are multiple choice 7 questions which is so unreasonable and he doesn't round, even though the average was a 55% and the lowest was a 7%. He wants you to fail. DO NOT TAKE unless physics is your major.
Very good professor. Prepare to use Mathematica a lot, but he will teach you how to use it. Class has more difficult material, but he is super accessible and ready to help you.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Honestly was a good teacher but just didnt teach during the lecture time due to the fact that the class was accelerated. Hes a nice and approachable guy, but I would stay away from this class online. 3/4 tests were in the lows 60s as a class and no As were made in two of them. The MC section on the tests were annoying as no PC is avaliable.

reviews.comment: Tests are impossible because 70% is MC questions with no partial credit, so you'll feel like you're failing the whole semester, but he curves at the end... Scalise is a nice guy with good intentions but I don't recommend taking his class online because he doesn't lecture (we watch YT videos and read the textbook) but I imagine he's better in person
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: He posted recorded lectures from a professor at MIT instead of teaching. Tests covered concepts that were not taught, nor on the homework. Each MC question was 7 pts and most required calculations, yet there was no partial credit. Doesn't curve. Class average for the course was around a C. Most tests had a class average of F. RIP my GPA
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Teaches you all theoretical and expects you to understand the most difficult practical examples on the tests. Class average on the final and the first test was in the 40's. reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: For a class that teaches scientific method and critical thinking, Professor Scalise is terribly narrow-minded. The class itself was quite interesting and atleast one of the professors was helpful (Cotton). Unfortunately, half the class failed the final exam, and also the course overall. Good luck trying to get a good grade on the papers. Hardest CF

I got a D in this class, not because of him, but of me.  Even though I sucked it up, this was the best class I have taken at SMU.  Every class is different and interesting. He is very clear and thorough and was easy to talk to during office hours.  I will take other classes from him in the future.

Definitely not my first choice for a CF but it turned out alright.  The class is pretty weird but manageable.  There is 2 book reviews and 2 research papers.  Everything is pretty easy but they grade pretty intense on the research papers fyi

Professor Scalise is very ignorant. He continually believes he is right all the time and is very narrow-minded. He grades hard on the first paper to "encourage rewrites."Overall the class has SOME useful information, like areas of critical thinking and questioning, but the daily reading quizzes and ignorant professor make this class undesirable.

Overall, a fairly difficult course. A lot of people say you have to work on the papers way before they're due, but I did mine a night or two before, although it's imperative you actually research/write well/have a friend edit. I enjoyed it and learned a lot, but definitely a hard class/graded difficultly. These guys are not afraid to fail you.
Both Cotton and Scalise are terrible teachers

This class is manageable if you stay on top of the material. Keep up with the reading, it is fairly interesting for a CF course. Do NOT wait until the last minute on your papers, the grades will show. These guys really know their stuff and do not hide it in their grading.

I've had Scalise for two labs now, and he's a really great teacher. Though I only had him once a week for lab, he was able to make physics concepts much much much more clear and understandable than both physics professors i had for lectures. Physics is physics, its not that interesting in&of itself but Scalise helps you actually learn the material.
Professor Scalise does a great job teaching the Scientific Method course.  It is a really fun course and he grades fairly easy if you follow directions.

Nice guy and very helpful. Pretty critical on the 1st paper if u don't do exactly what he wants but you can rewrite and as long as you fix what he tells you you're good. Course requires a lot of writing tho (7-pg, 15-pg research papers and 2 book reviews as well as reading quiz almost everyday) although it was a lot of work totally worth it
very unhelpful; bitter and cynical attitude; makes completely inappropriate comments

Lab is boring, and long.  He is a nice guy, and explains things very well.  TA's grade the lab reports.  The reports aren't hard or long, but I honestly think that I would rather go back and do my OCHEM lab reports than go through the physics labs.

The TA's grade the lab reports...if you put any effort into them, you'll do well.  Despite the previous comments, he's actually one of the best professors to explain concepts.  I can't speak on the CF classes though...he just really knows his stuff.

Lots of students during term were talking bad about him, i defended.  Then the final he and cotton just said study and learn everything, the final is the only test in the class.  Niether grade fair and maje you use a website like designed in 1994, makes no sense, AVIOD they dont care and are weird

Worst Profesor, Senor Lectuer ever had.  Turved out he is not evena real professor just part time or something.  Very arrogant and unhelpful.  he kept quoting how this british athehist was right to be an athehist.  The old british guy convert to christianity mid semester, crazy!

I guess a nice enough guy.  I had expected this class to be about the phiosphy/history of science.  It is a class about skepticism only.  I really didnt like it much.  Daily attendance quizes, lots of reading quizes, papers (takes 2 weeks for grades), Lecture quite boring, no one takes notes.  Aviod

Took for May Term (Wars in Film), and as a junior this ended up being one of my favorite classes I have taken at SMU. There is reading but it's never more than 30 pages a night, and the text book is super understandable and interesting. He gives reading quizzes everyday, but they are more of a grade booster than anything. Definitely recommend!
Everything is extremely difficult, from being in class to his grading to even completing an assignment for him. Would not take again
Hard grader. High expectations.

With that being said, this professor is very knowledgeable. The course material is very interesting, especially if you like international foreign affairs. He's just okay. If you go to class everyday you will be okay.

reviews.comment: Great Professor! Very passionate about what he teaches. Lectures are very easy to follow and slides are later published. Tests match material so easy to perform well if you study. Math has never been my favorite subject, but Dr. Robertson's kindness, accessibility, and constant support made my experience so great. He cares SO much about his students and makes an effort to get to know everyone.

The course isn't tough, but his behavior makes it unbearable. His obsession with being liked by students means he barely teaches. It feels like a failed comedy act rather than a class. The lack of seriousness makes it hard to respect the field when it's handled this way. Hes weirdly unorganized for a stats teacher and will grade you down hard

I will admit, this class is not easy. Heavy math and very complex formulas, however, professor Robertson did a killer job at explaining and teaching the material, making the complex topics easier to digest and understand. Such a caring and lighthearted professor, I would take his class again 100%. I did however get a C, but that's on me, not him.
Is very boring and has favorites in his classes eh get higher grades. He can't explain things well and will insult you when you don't understand. Rude.

H'es not a good professor and has his favorites, which is really frustrating. Totally unorganizes and can't teach well, grades incorrectly but eventually gives everyone higher grades because he grades so poorly.

My absolute FAVORITE professor I've had at SMU. I had him for STAT and am looking to take him again next semester. Incredible at teaching, genuinely cares for the success of his students and wants you to receive an A. Go to class, visit him at office hours, and you'll do great. Could not recommend him more TAKE HIM!
The most boring of teachers of mankind. Dumb attendance policies.

Professor Robertson was amazing. I took his class in Taos and would HIGHLY recommend it. Not only are you surrounded by nature all day, but the small classroom made the topic easier to understand. Professor Robertson was beyond helpful on every assignment and lab we did, and he overall made the class super fun. An amazing professor and human being.
The workload, overly harsh grading, and utter lack of teaching quality was completely inappropriate for the class. Absolutely miserable experience.
SO BORING!!! strict attendance policy. Not a super hard grader but still. Docks 5 % points off your grade for each class missed after 3 classes. Kind of ruined the subject matter for me.

Really nice guy. If you talk to him and express your challenges he will help you. Also Aidan, the teacher assistant,is a stud muffin.Super nice, caring, and both genuinely want you to succeed. If your taking may term it's not going to be easy but I know they both are trying their best. Class is most definitely challenging getting a tutor will help.

Professor Robertson is one of the best professors I've taken at SMU. He's extremely kind outside of class, is willing to give extra credit if the class is not performing, and genuinely cares about his students. That being said, this class is a doozie, lots of reading, lots of practice, lots of work. You will learn a ton in the class, but work hard.
Has no sense of personal space. A little rude during office hours. Can get off track. However, he is extremely caring, like the most accommodating guy ever.

reviews.comment: I cannot say enough good things about Prof Robertson. I had him as my STAT prof over the summer. Truly the most incredible professor I've ever had. He genuinely cares for his students and wants them to succeed. Takes time to make sure everyone understands the material. I would take him and the class again if I could. LOVE him!

Although I have close to zero interest in data science, Professor Robertson made every single class period engaging and energetic which made me thoroughly enjoy his class. There is literally nothing that Professor Robertson could do differently, his teaching style/enthusiasm is above and beyond. Also he is simply just a very nice person.A++ teacher

Professor Robertson is the man. I also took him for DS1300 and he's just a super good guy who cares about his students. STAT 4340 is a tough class but he teaches the material well and is accommodating to his students when it comes to last-minute emergencies and due dates.

Nicest prof I've ever had. He is absolutely the best. I've taken so many STAT classes and he is by far the best prof at the school. Class has homework every week but he's so willing to help you and cheat sheet for every test so it's super easy to do well in his class. If you don't take a class with him, you're missing out on the best prof at SMU!

Professor Robertson was by far one of my favorite teachers at SMU. He cares for his students and wants us to learn and do well. His tests are long but he hosts reviews and gives great practice tests. Go to office hours, meet with him, and he help you.  You can tell he loves teaching and is a very inspirational, smart man.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Show up to class and pay attention and you'll make a decent grade. This guy really loves to teach and it shows. He's very organized and great at imparting wisdom. Best Stats teacher by a wide margin.

Professor Robertson is a great guy and clearly cares about his students. He makes an effort to know everyone's name and reach out to them. He teaches the class effectively, and the content is pretty straightforward. The homework can be difficult and time-consuming, but they're not graded too hard. Tests aren't too hard, and he allows note sheets.

Professor Robertson is the absolute best!  He truly cares about his students and wants them to feel comfortable asking questions. You are able to use the front and back of a sheet of paper for a cheat sheet for the test, so it's pretty much impossible to fail. He also uses similar questions for the tests and homework.
Dr. Robertson's teaching style was the reason I did so well in this class. He made me excited to learn about statistics, and I did. His lectures were fun but also very informative.
Amazing professor and class!!

Legitimately one of the best professors Ive had. Doesnt do anything crazy but is just an amazing teacher and amazing human being. Anything negative I have to say about the course is due to the course material and cant be avoided, but if I had to take stats from anyone it would be him.

Dr. Robertson is great. He legitimately cares for his students and wants to see them succeed. Go to the lectures so you don't miss any of the important info. The class is graded on homework assignments, a statistics project, and 3 exams. I really recomend you take his class, great professor!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Robertson is one of the best teachers that I have ever had. Take him. He is extremely caring and makes lectures interesting. I was excited to attend his class each day, even though it was four hours long during May term!

His class is based off of a lot of lectures that sometimes don't explain the material well but he is very sweet and will help you if you need help on material or even homework. There are about 10 homework assignments but he will help you on it. There was a midterm, a project, homework, and the final. He is a very dedicated professor, take him!

Robertson is one of the most helpful professors I have ever seen. Literally you can feel how passionated he wants to help you. He will always talk to you and give you support and that is really great.

Ok! Professor Robertson is the best! So kind and really wants everyone to do well! He also really wants to get to know you and cares about everyone! I would take him again instantly if I had the chance
Professor Robertson is such a homie. Super cool guy, obviously cares about his students, and want to see his students succeed. I would definitely take a class with him again.

I think he is a great guy but i had a difficult time ins class, and I'm not the only one. during his lectures things seem clear but he does not clearly distinguish one thing from another. he also speaks very fast and strictly follows his pre-written notes, I wish he would give more in-class examples. also the LAB for this class was totally useless

reviews.comment: Dr. Robertson is a great stat teacher. He is very engaging with his students and works hard to get everyone to succeed. His lectures are better than most math lectures I have had in the past as he does not use powerpoints and writes out everything on the board that you need to know for each day of class. I highly recommend taking him for STAT 2331.

Dr. Robertson is great and always willing to help a student better understand material. He has a regular homework due every week so at least you know what is expected. He gets easily distracted during lecture, but is hilarious. The tests are somewhat difficult, but if you go to class and do the homework youll do great!

reviews.comment: The homework is nothing like the exams and the labs are a waste of time. The final was extremely hard and nothing like his other two exams. Dont take him or leave yourself a good 10-15 point buffer before the final.
He learns everyones names. His lectures are alright. The homeworks and labs have nothing to do with exams. The final is insanely hard.
He wasnt bad

Outstanding professor. Extremely fair and wants his students to succeeds. Makes an effort to learn students names. Engaging in lectures. Could not ask for more. Only criticism: tests are slightly tricky. That being said, I'm going to end with an A or A-, easily. Get big notecard for all tests. Take him, for sure!

Very nice guy and passionate teacher. Remembers all his students' names and provides examples to explain harder concepts. Only complaint is that his straight-forwardness made me underestimate the first exam; it turned out to be pretty tricky and I would have wanted a practice exam in hindsight.
Robertson is a great professor, who's not out to get you. Note cards on test, and sometimes lets class out early. Tests are straightforward and simple enough if you study.

Don't even think twice about it, take his STAT class. He's a great guy who makes the class super easy. Allows students to have a huge note card with formulas during the test. Would highly recommend him.
Loved loved loved him! He gives you a lot of real life examples of what he is talking about and it helps soo much! Very clear and you get a huge cheat sheet on all his tests. Best STAT teacher

Phenomenal teacher, undoubtedly the best teacher I've had at smu, so helpful and willing to help at any point. very good at clarifying and breaking down topics to where they are easy to understand. he doesn't try and trick you on the tests, if you review notes and homework you're solid

Professor Robertson is the man. Definitely in the top 3 professors I have had at SMU. Really cares about the subject and makes class interesting. Lectures are very clear and tests are straightforward IF you write down ALL the notes from all lectures. Lets you have a giant cheat sheet for formulas for all of his tests. Seriously, amazing professor.

He will always make time to talk to you out of class and takes a personal interest in his students. He knew everyone's names within the first week. He is an absolutely amazing stats professor. TAKE HIS CLASS! He and his TA are very available and want you to succeed.

I think everyone would agree he gets a 5 for clarity.  He can explain these concepts like nobody's business.  And if you ask questions or go in for help, he'll explain even more than you asked for. Great professor

He is the best teacher I've had at SMU. With that said, I am used to getting A's and got in a B in his class. He teaches things so well and makes concepts so easy to understand, but his test questions can be tricky, hence the B in the class. He always holds reviews for tests and the labs are super easy. definitely take this teacher!
Class isn't very difficult if you go to the lectures and labs. He takes attendance only on the lab days. Watch out for the probability test, though he warns you in advance it will be difficult.
Agree with what everyone has said, but just want to add that if you miss class (whether its due to an illness or not) he is not very willing to help you. He also doesn't answer emails.

Dr. Robertson is an amazingly clear and concise professor.  He's a great guy who really cares about the well being of each student.  He is very approachable, and always willing to help.  If you go to every lecture and lab, take notes, and pay attention there is no reason to not get an A in his class.  Highly recommended.  Aight, Keon?

Great teacher, very helpful, does get sidetracked sometimes, and makes class fun. Doesn't take attendance, except for labs. 1 hwk assignment per week and 1 lab (TA usually goes over the answers during the lab). Tests are somewhat hard but get to use a cheat sheet. Overall great class.

Great Teacher. Very interested in his students' success. Doesn't take attendance, but attendance is recommended to get the notes because he tests exactly what is on the notes. Go to his review sessions, always gives you a spoiler.Only about one hw assignment a week
The most straightforward professor I've ever had. You know what's expected of you.
DO NOT TAKE HER.

Make sure you pick your group wisely as their is a few projects to complete with your group that are a decent percentage of your grade. Exams can be tricky marketing should not be as hard as she makes it. She is kind of rude if you are not favorite and seems to be rude to guys.

This class is tough but this teacher knows what she's doing. She also gives great feedback. There are lots of chances to earn points. The tests are a little tricky, but talk to her bc she really wants to help you succeed. Make sure to pick your group wisely for the project bc you have to write two papers and do two presentations together.
The class was interesting. She's very well-connected and will set you up well. The exams created by the department are tedious

Professor Zaveri's course provides a challenging yet rewarding experience that enhances understanding of marketing. Her lectures are not bad, but her exams are awful. She makes them hard for absolutely zero reason, it's marketing and she makes it way more complicated. Be ware and do NOT take her

Marketing isn't hard, but she makes it complicated and really detailed. Test reviews are not helpful - read the book and (unfortunately) study everything. DO NOT TAKE HER! Zaveri was awful for an intro class. She was unnecessarily tough on grades and never gave any clear instructions on group projects and would dock for minor details. reviews.comment: She needs to chill. She takes life unnecessarily seriously

4 timed quizzes that consist of specific yet vague questions, 3 exams, and a group project (assigned groups). Her exam reviews weren't that helpful, as they didn't include any of the comprehensive examples that are on the exam. Zaveri is very knowledgable and there's a lot to learn from her but her intro to marketing class was not that enjoyable.

The course is test and quiz heavy. The questions are always unclear and barely understandable. The group project is a pain because you are forced to work with random students. Definitely too much work for an intro to mktg class. Zaveri is knowledgeable and experienced, however. The curve brought me from an A- to an A at the end of the semester.

huge group project, hope you get assigned a good team. 3 (difficult) tests were added to the course by marketing department since spring 23 but that's not her fault. broke many people's 4.0 but she knows what she's talking about and has lots of experience. terrible at responding to emails. take her if you're a marketing major, otherwise beware!

She is one of the worst professors I have ever had. She teaches well but exams are hard. It's not worth taking this course. 4 quizzes, 3 exams, a lot of group work but you can't pick your team.

There are 3 exams 4 quizzes and a lot of group projects. Her quizzes and exams are UNFAIRLY HARD, and the questions are extremely specific. Take any other marketing class. This woman will ruin your GPA.

You know how when people will tell you, "Don't take that class with that professor!" and you think to yourself, "I'll take that class with that professor, it can't be that bad!" and you take that class and the professor turns out to be as horrible as described? Unless you are a marketing major do not take her. Her tests aren't clear on the material,  contain many typos. One of my least favorite classes that I have taken at SMU.

This class has changed since last year. Exams are now in the class, and they were pretty tough, especially the final. If you're stuck with a bad group for the group project, that also brings your grade down. There were also the quizzes, which were difficult at times but didn't make up most of the grade. Wouldn't have taken this if it wsnt required

Do not listen to the other reviews. She added more exams on top of all of the work given for this course. Lectures are boring and you could learn it yourself with the slides. The exams are not quite straight forward + pretty long. I wouldn't recommend for everyone but If I were a marketing major, take her because she has a great network, done well

Favorite professor. She is one of the main reasons I really decided to pursue Marketing. She has so much real world experience that is great to learn from. Her lectures are so interesting and she always tries to bring value, whether its guest speakers or important current topics for examples or group break out room activities. Take Her!
Good choice for MKTG. Most of the grade is a group project. The quizzes will get you if you don't study, but the study guide is very helpful. Make sure you show up and participate.
Good class.  Very practical and can be used in life.  Has a good demeanor and is relatively easy going.
Prof is super accommodating and understanding. Only issue is 40% of your grade depends on a group project, which can tank your grade if paired with idiots

Prof Zaveri is the best prof for MKTG 3340. No exams, five in class quizzes that are based on lectures & she gives a clear study guide, like three easy discussion boards, and a group project. Class is on zoom every Friday and she hasnt ever taken attendance. She is also super interesting and engaging. I never read the book and got an A. TAKE HER!!!

Best professor for marketing!! Take her, look no further. You have quizzes that are based on class lectures and she gives you a review for them. She wants her students to apply marketing concepts and she does that through the semester-long group project, the majority of your grade btw. Not an overly difficult class if you put in the work!

Definitely the most interesting class I have taken. Professor Zaveri covered many fascinating topics involving marketing. She teaches a 3000-level class so her class requires active effort (it really pays off!) I recommend this class to EVERYONE and did better in my MBA program because of it!!! (take a 1000 class if you are scared of the effort)
One big group project that your grade is based off of.

This professor was so clear with what she wanted. A lot of people talk about how much reading there is, but it isn't a lot and the few quizzes are not difficult. In addition, there is no final exam just a group project where she gave everyone that I knew in my class A's. Not a difficult class and I found it to be an easy A.

First of all, I got so frustrated because I did not sign up for professor Zaveri. My school changed professors last time this semester. Prof Zaveri cold calls every class, which causes stress and anxiety. The quizzes contain very specific terms and range from easy to difficult, so there is no consistency. The project is a lot of unnecessary work!

reviews.comment: Professor Zaveri is very clear with her expectations of the class. She's very knowledgable and i honestly loved her class. Does cold calls - not hard questions

reviews.comment: There are 4-5 quizzes, they are so specific and if you don't read the textbook you will fail. She cold calls like crazy and picks on the kids who aren't paying attention. Prof Zaveri likes to cold-call people in class. She is knowledgeable about marketing but lectures are sometimes confusing. You will run out of time on the quizzes.

reviews.comment: Prof Zaveri is fine, she just gives so much busywork. She expects you to balance discussion boards, quizzes, reading 2 chapters a week, and an ongoing group project all at the same time. Her content is really confusing and the group case study is just a lot of work that doesn't make sense. I really disliked this course. Get a diff prof if you can

His lectures can be a bit boring at times but it's an easy class. He posts his lectures and exam questions. You also have 3 group projects but pray you have active members or it's not a good time for you. He's clearly a passionate guy when it comes to the topics and wider field.

Troupe has spent his entire career in sports management, working in various aspects. One big group project, and pray you have active members. An easy class for those who enjoy sports and want to learn more about the technical aspects of organizational structure. Pop quizzes are every few weeks, based on #smuapsm2310 Twitter posts.
