He has 1 on 1 conference which if you revise using his suggestions he will critique his own suggestions and give you a 70. Showed up to every class and still didn't learn anything.
Trust me, choose another wrtr teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is very hard on grading essays for no reason. In your conferences about essays, he will tell you what you need to improve on, and even if you correct all of it and more, you will still not receive a good grade. Easily the hardest WRTR teacher at smu.
A lot of the stuff done in class felt like busy work and it is super hard to write a good essay in class no matter how much time you put in. The class as a whole felt quite tedious and unengaging.

Really unfortunate. He is a pleasant guy with a good sense of humor but lacks completely in giving any guidance to students. It is to the point where I have other professors read my essays to receive proper feedback. One could follow all of his feedback to a T and still underachieve.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst WRTR professor ever, he would write my thesis for me and then when grading say it was horrible. He is very sassy and passive aggressive as well and is unclear about grading and then will give you a C on your paper.

Overall I've had a very negative experience in his class. He often gives incomplete or incorrect prompts for papers and then give poor grades to students on said assignments. He also has horrible time management and wastes a lot of time on unnecessary lectures, when that time could be used to help student with their papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Horrible teacher, grades papers based on the most insane demands. You could be the best writer and he will still give you a 70 on your papers. Takes like 25 points off of a homework assignment even if it is turned in three minutes after the deadline. Will not work with you or help you, and even after receiving help, he will still give you a 70.
He is terrible, not even a professor, unclear assignments, grades horribly
This guy is legit the worst professor, no clue how he got a job. Half the time he has no idea what's going on during his lectures and he constantly contradicts himself.

He is not a great professor. Now, he knows his stuff, but that is not conveyed well in the classroom. Aaron Hauser is extremely passive-aggressive towards students and enjoys shooting their opinions down at all costs.

 He also grades harshly,was difficult to receive anything above a B-.

Avoid if you want an open minded, fair professor.
His papers are thesis-driven and he will write the thesis with you, then on conference week tell you that your thesis is wrong and you need to change your whole paper.
Grades so hard! I don't think anyone in my class got an A even though this is a basic writing class
Aaron Hauser was the worst professor. Ruined the first semester for me and a few of my friends. He is a harsh grader and his feedback is very vague. Avoid this professor at all costs

Professor Hauser gives some of the worst lectures I have ever heard in my entire life. He bounces from unclear tangent to unclear tangent never really making a point or explaining an actual concept that relates to course material. Not a nice guy and a truly a god-awful professor and I beg you to avoid him at all costs.
Please do not take this class. He tells me that I am a good writer in my conferences and then proceeds to give me poor grades on my essays that he said were good.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Your grade in the class depends on how much he likes you. Find another teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I'm not exactly sure how this man was hired as a teacher. The man is probably a great writer, but had no idea how to teach and help students. He was awful at grading essays and would leave comments that were very confusing. He also would say some stuff in class that I would consider odd or something a normal teacher wouldn't say to his students.
He is not clear on instructions and it really kills your grade. I recommend finding another teacher. He is impatience with his students. He tries to help his students but does not do a good job.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I didn't mind the professor. He cared about improving his students writing and seemed invested in his students. As long as you pay attention to his comments on your papers, you should get a good grade.
He honestly is the worst WRTR teacher ever. He's super sassy, passive-aggressive, and wants his students to feel just as sad as he obviously is.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Mr. Hauser is a good teacher who cares about his students. I honestly never struggled getting work done. He lets you know way in advanced about upcoming assignments. He gives you good feedback and is not a harsh grader at all. I am taking his class again and I would recommend.

Do not take this class. For someone who is well versed in closed minded courses and professors, Mr. Hauser not only made my opinions feel condemned but outright attacked opinions that went against his own. He is a harsh grader and his feedback makes no sense at all. Dodge a bullet a choose someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The feedback on papers is helpful, but there is a lot. Make sure to read the material and be prepared to contribute, since his lectures are a little disjunct.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Perfect
Ron is really cool, and he lets you out of class early. Tests aren't bad and labs are easy. It's hard to get anything lower than a B+. Definitely take him for a science.
Entertaining professor and pretty funny, attendance is mandatory and tests are pretty easy if you've studied. Ask him about Vegas

He is a nice guy, Experienced in his field. He is one of the Four Lead Forecasters in the Country. Yet, in class he might be distracted a lot. His Class is Easy, Attend because he will take it each class and because he will give away exam questions during his lectures. Labs are easy, just ask if you are lost!

He's a nice guy, but his class is a waste of tuition dollars. Everything on the tests comes straight from the textbook and not lectures. For the most part, it's easy and no attendence policy, and the labs are okay. His final exam however was on material covered in the first part of the semester when he said it would be on the last part. . .

Love Ron! He's very helpful, you just have to contact him on facebook. He keeps class really funny and short. He will tell you important information he will test you on during class so pay attention and read the textbook and you will do great! PS - he loves to eat at Razoo's and loves the Vegas.

Haven't decided whether this class was fun or a waste of time. Either way, a good science credit. Try to go to class because he'll tell you what's on the tests, so when studying you can make sure to know those facts. Study the slides, read the chapters, and you'll be fine.

He's a funny guy. Does talk about irrelevant material, but also covers important concepts on slides. You have to read the book if you want an A b/c there is some stuff not on the ppts. the material is interesting b/c it is applicable to everyday life. If you want an easy science credit, take this class!

He talks more about unrelated material than meteorology.  If you want to be thinking "...and how much did i pay for this class!?" all semester, go for it, but i'm depressed just thinking about it.   You have to teach yourself the material, he just reads the powerpoints in class.. boring.

It's a hard class, word has it that it's the "easiest on campus," but that's not true.  Tests are pretty difficult, but Ron is a fun professor and doesn't care if you come to class or not, so it works out to be a good class to take.
He is nice and funny and will let you out of class really early, and may not even talk much about meteorology, but if you don't get it, he's really not helpful. You basically teach yourself.

To me, Ron Jackson closely resembles Champ Kinds from the movie Anchorman. Funny, gregarious, and always about having fun, he keeps the class short (so he can eat lunch at Razoo's) and easy. In fact, he basically lays out the questions for the students during lectures! By far the best professor and the easiest class at SMU.
The best class I've ever taken. It's so easy. He is a really funny teacher and will usually give you an A or B. The labs can be annoying but that's all.
obsessed with the resturaunt Razu's loves his cat and dog. Hes funny, but his tests are kinda hard

Professor Aaron is extremely kind, and encourages trying in class above all else. For those not as inclined in grammar, you will have to study a lot outside of class, as the lectures do not go in much depth as needed. However, the online quizzes and in person tests are explained ahead of time and not very difficult.

The SWEETEST professor!! She is very understanding and patient. She is never harsh about mistakes and understands that the classroom is a learning environment. Homework every class but it is not time consuming at all and are multiple attempts. She explains test formatting and is very accessible for questions. Stress-free and fun class!

Get ready to do a LOT of assignments and quizzes. She is an extremely kind and patient teacher, but you should definitely freshen up on your French for the class, at least much more than I did. I have had numerous days where we had 3 quizzes due in one day. TalkAbroad is also very stressful and hard to do.
Prof Aaron is a personable teacher whose class fun and light-hearted. The course is very organized and each unit is structured around a movie. She grades generously. Would absolutely recommend her.
I love Dr. Aaron! She's a great teacher and super understanding. I cannot recommend her enough.

Prof. Aaron is the sweetest teacher ever! She cares so much about each student and is extremely patient with explaining course material. Super easy to do well, but be ready to talk/write a lot. The course uses online modules too, so there's online work due every day (don't forget because she'll deduct for late grades). Tests also have bonus points!
I loved Prof Aaron!! She's the sweetest, and class was organized; however, sometimes she would let us out early, so class would only be like 30 mins. If you can, take her!!

Very sweet women. Cares about her students and wants them to do well. The course is material heavy but as long as you participate and make an effort you will get a good grade. Also, she is very understanding if you have to makeup a missed test.

There's a fair bit of work in this class, but the teacher is so nice. Prof. Aaron is awesome and always open to helping you out if you communicate. My only thing was that there were a lot of group assignments and discussions, but that's just a personal preference. She's a wonderful person and I recommend her!
She is such a gem. Literally never had a teacher as nice as her. There's a good bit of homework but nothing ridiculous and tests are really straightforward and very easy if you study. 100% recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: SUPER DISORGANIZED. This made knowing what to do difficult because there were many conflicting instructions. I found this class to be an easy A, but I didn't learn any new French. She's a sweet lady, but not a great teacher.
I don't know this person I live in a different country I just wanted to do something on this site. But you go Gwendoline!

Take Professor Aaron! She is so caring and wants you to do well in the class. There are a good amount of tests and lots of online homework but it helps you learn the language. Best French professor at SMU

Literally the best teacher I've ever had. She really cares about you as a person and wants to see you do well. She is a down-to-earth professor who makes you want to learn. I will really miss her class and if you ever get the chance to take her, it's a must!
Great professor
She is so sweet and always in the best mood. Her instructions are not always clear but she wants to help you and watch you succeed.
Great teacher, very helpful! Lots of textbook and online work, but it helps you learn the language better! I would definitely take her again!

Her class was pretty easy although, it required a huge amount of time with the course book work and online work. Tests were not very difficult and all had the same format with a focus on culture. I would take her again!

Incredibly sweet lady who is always in a good mood. Learning a language is difficult but she makes it enjoyable. Grades kindly and goes very slowly when giving oral quizzes. A sign-in sheet is passed around every class but attendance is mandatory for French classes, regardless of professor.

Fantastic Beginning French Teacher. If you have the option take Aaron. Her class is not difficult if you do the thirty minutes of homework assigned each day that day. Answers to Green Pages are in the back of the textbook. Go visit with her. If she likes you, it helps

Madame Aaron is fantastic. You must take her if you are a student of French at SMU. She loves to help her students and works really hard for you. Make sure you actually do the homework or you will for sure fail the class. An hour of work a night should be devoted to this class.
Great professor. has a passion for what she teaches, and it makes it just a bit interesting for me, which is quite a feat!
She is a very nice Belgian teacher, always laughing. TAKE HER
She is amazing and very nice. Has a great sense of humor, makes it ok to laugh at yourself. Comfortable learning environment.
She is so sweet and very easy going. Very helpful with French grammar, vocab, and pronunciation. Definitely advise taking her.
She is a reallllllllly easy grader on tests! She explains everything really clearly.  She knows how to make things fun. I'd definitely recommend her.. Shes also really nice and friendly
Loved her class! It's french but she's Belgian so I got to make fun of the french as much as I wanted!
The best French professor at SMU!
I believe Dr.Ron is the most awesome professor. His class is not boring, slides are actually useful, and hes very organized, and is there to teach you and not judge you..cool guy.

Ron took the time to organize materials to make this class EXTREMELY useful for those performing statistical research. Very interesting and useful class! I would rate Ron as one of the top professors I have ever studied under.

This class is open book open notes.  You need to go to class and pay attention, but most of all do the homework to the best of your ability and before the tests redo it and make notes on what you did.  The tests come STRAIGHT from the homework.  He also gives bonus on each test if you went to class.

This guy is very wordy, verbose even. In my experience he's evasive of questions, and also dogmatic. The class is pretty easy if you're good at learning on your own; he's not very good at putting together course material in a cohesive way.

Dr. Dearing really cares about his students and really tries to help you succeed. Course is easy if you go to class, take notes, and do the homework/labs. We had four tests and a final and you could drop two tests. I got an A easily. If you go to class and show you're interested in learning, Dr. Dearing will do all he can to get you through.
Places way too much emphasis on befriending students. Weird ahl

Loved Professor Abel! Made the class super interesting and was easy if you paid attention during lectures as that's what the midterms are- gave reviews for exams. Easy way to get the Technology credit. Please take him if you can!

LMFAO do not take this class. I am warning you. If you are reading this, DO NOT take 
this class. He is not capable of teaching or running a class efficiently. treats 
our 3 unit class like it is 5 units.

ABSOLUTE ANGEL ON EARTH. I only took this class for the cc credit, but I'm telling you 350 words isn't nearly enough to sum up how amazing professor Abel is!!! He really loves the subject and truly cares for his students.
One of the best professors I've ever had. Kind, caring, and passionate. Incredibly engaging.

When faced with differing viewpoints, professor exhibits dismissive, defensive, and overtly rude 
behavior, demonstrating an inability to handle criticism. Undoubtedly the least effective professor 
at this institution, they fail to facilitate learning, instead adopting a consistently sarcastic and 
confrontational attitude towards students.

Prof Abel is hands down the best prof on campus! I wish he taught all my classes bc then I would actually be engaged and learn. He is really passionate about what he teaches and it makes his classes fun and interesting. He offered review sessions and study guides before all exams and tests were very similar. Abel is the best thing to happen to SMU

Dr. Abt was my favorite professor at SMU so far. She is passionate about the topic and explains complicated content well. She ensures everyone understands content too rather than rushing. I would definitely recommend her and this course.

I think Professor Abt is good at what she teaches -- but she can be harsh at times and generally have a bit of an attitude. Her information is delivered well, but not in a manner that I would recommend for those who simply want the science CC, I'd recommend an easier course. If you just need the credit, please avoid taking this class.

Dr. Abt is an amazing teacher, but her class is super detailed. Tests are typically longer (50 questions + FRQ), and I typically had to cover 10 pages of notes per test. Other than that, I loved it. She is very accessible outside of class and is very accommodating to schedule conflicts. Feel free to email her before class starts!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is great. She clearly knows a ton about what she is teaching, and she really wants the students to understand. Always willing to help further explain if you need it, and sometimes the concepts can be hard to understand so that's good! kind and very energetic.

I absolutely loved this course and dr Abt. Not only is she an amazing, engaging, and knowledgeable teacher, but she is also one of the kindest people I have met at SMU. She genuinely cares about her students and if you pay attention in class you will get a good grade without much effort outside class. Thats how good she is. WIsh i could take again!

Professor Abt is AMAZING. I would advise anyone to take her. She is an extremely fair grader, her lectures are to her tests, and she tells you what is not going to be on the exam and what will be. She is extremely nice and makes lecture entertaining, but attendance is mandatory.

Dr. Abt is an amazing and caring professor. The class is a lot of material to learn but she makes it enjoyable. Tests are straightforward. Really good reviews that help you prepare for the exams.  She cares about students succeeding and will do anything to help. 100% Recommend taking her.

Dr. Abt is the most amazing professor I have ever had. She is so caring and is so easily accessible outside of class. Anatomy and Physiology is a very difficult class but she made it fun and exciting for me. I love this Dr. Abt with my whole heart and if I could take her for every class I would. DEFINITELY take her!!!!!

Dr. Abt is the best. She gives you so many extra credit opportunities and only wants the best for you. Attendance is mandatory, but you get to miss 3 classes without anything happening. She gives amazing review sessions before exams that are golden, but all exams are in the class on lock down, but the tests are straight forward.
He does his job so efficiently and dedicatedly. He wants each of his students to be successful and flourish in their chosen fields.
Dr. Abdelghany is one of the most inspirational and dedicated professors at SMU. If you get anything lower than an A- in this class you're a FOOL.
He is fine. His lectures are so boring and he will spend one lecture on one slide. His tests are easy if you just study the slides. Very easy class but he's just an awful lecturer.

Khaled is a great and respected professor in the school. He doesn't give much homework and wants the best for all. All you need to do to get a good grade is attend the lectures and follow the materials, and if you do so the course will not be any problem.

This class was pretty average. Not my favorite class, but it was sometimes interesting & easy to get an A. Sometimes he is very confusing over email so I stopped emailing him. Will randomly go into life lesson lectures sometimes during class. Tests are easy if you study the materials. Only had like 6 HW assignments & they were all pretty manageable

He is the model professor in the school. I've got A without any hassle. He expected students to work on the research paper related to the course.  Not too many homework that are the basis of exams. If you attend the lectures and follow the materials, the course will not be any problem.

The course is a high level one. He touch the important topics and will not waist your time with unnecessary stuff. Two exams which was based on Homework. There was a research presentation before finals. He will be there to help if you are willing to work.

he knows, he teaches, but not motivating ! he thinks but does not let you think (because the final version of correct thinking is his) . good researcher. however, it is "personal" and the end of the road.

he knows, he teaches, but not motivating ! he thinks but does not let you think (because the final version of correct thinking is his) . good researcher. however, it is "personal" and the end of the road.

Khaled is the man. Overall a very manageable course and he wants you to succeed. Topics are interesting and relevant. Very very nice teacher. TA on the other hand is horrendous but Khaled will help you get an A.

Just do a couple of power points and attend class and you should earn at least a B+. Don't worry what you get on assignments he doesn't even grade the the TA who is horrible does. The lab is boring and long.

Hahahaha This guy is awesome.  His class is not to be taken seriously.  Though he is a sincere man with good intentions, he failed to motivate any of us.  Since you're reading this you're considering his class...DO IT.  Free 3 hours and A-.
No Comments
Easy A, I would take again. A little silly.
The in class stuff is super repetitive, and the group work is kind of annoying, but she's really nice and the class is an easy A.

These  class should not even be part of the curriculum, it is a compelte waste of time to learn about "character" and "morals" from a wokey woke. We shouldn't have to pay for this stuff as it's dated and not current.

She is such a nice lady and just wants her students to be happy. Her lectures might feel heavy but we had minimal-to-no class work/homework. Most projects can be done in groups. Tests are writing heavy but she gives you the questions beforehand so you can prepare. I would totally recommend to cover your CC credits. Lots of participation required!

I think it could've been better, but overall not bad for the CC. If you take this class PLEASE actually participate in the in-class activities. The most annoying part of this class was the lack of enthusiasm from people. She teaches the textbook in class. Exams are free response but open note. She can be a bit weird at times, but overall not bad.

horrible professor. will yap about kindness and gratitude all class just to be rude to her students. have never felt so bad about my self in a class that's meant to lift ones identity and character lol. do better smu we pay way too much to deal with profs like her

What a joke of a course and she's too lazy to do her job as a professor. Clearly people take her because she's an easy "A" but a total disgrace to those of us who are here to learn. She is not as "nice" as you think, and was directly rude to me in office hours, never been treated so poorly. This course and department should not exist, what a joke.

Prof Pruitt is kind, but this class was useless. Unless you need the CC's, I wouldn't take it- you discuss the same "profound" ideas of identity all semester and the redundancy gets frustrating. Her instruction is poor, as she is obviously using materials from another professor. Check Canvas all the time b/c she doesn't tell you when stuff is due.
There is no reason we should have to take these classes with her, they and she are a joke.
class and teacher a joke and time waste, do not understand why we have to take her classes
Very poor teacher, gets off subject. Brings her personal life into the classroom which is totally unprofessional.
It's just a waste of time but easy.

Unapproachable and gets annoyed when students ask questions. Lectures are boring and unproductive, leaving students to rely on self for all learning. Communication is poor, and doesn't handle criticism well. Try to take this class with someone else, if possible. You won't learn anything but easy A.

I LOVE HER!! Amazing professor and am so genuinely thankful that I took the course. One of the only courses I've ever taken where I'm actually learning meaningful things while doing well in the class. You learn so much about yourself and others and it is quite easy to do well. Thank you prof abby!

Class was a breeze until the last week of school. Luckily we don't have a final, but she threw like 4 projects at us that none of us were prepared for. The quizzes are easy & take-home. Rarely homework, she just wants you to show up and participate.

Great professor! She's really caring and wants every student to succeed. During class there is a lot of participation like turn and talk to the person beside you so you can meet everyone in the class. There will be a class project but it's really easy. Overall great professor that makes you feel like you matter, made the semester really enjoyable.

Pruitt is an overall easy and caring teacher. She wants everyone to succeed. If you show up and submit assignments on time with some decent effort, you will get an A in this class. There are many quizzes (Asynch) and projects, but a manageable workload. There are also pop-up extra credit opportunities, so super easy to take CC or Education maj/min.

I enjoyed this class and Dr. Pruitt as a Professor and person! This class gave me no stress whatsoever. It helped me become more motivated to be a caring and intuitive teacher in my future career. I enjoyed participating with my classmates and getting to know them through group work. Dr. Pruitt cares about your learning! She wants you to succeed.

Got 100 in this class and never read a word. She gives you the questions to the midterm & final before so you can prepare. Kind of annoying since she wants heavy participation, but the class and material is so straightforward you barely have to pay attention.
Mrs Abby is literally the best. She is so chill, funny, and caring. She knows each student on a personal level and genuinely cares about us. Amen for this woman- She is an angel.
The best professor at smu she truly cares about each student. This class is an easy A if you do your work and will do everything in her power to help you.

She's literally one of the best professors at SMU. Class time is interactive and interesting, assignments are varied in type, not typically super hard, and usually fun to do. She's extremely willing to help you with class. As long as you pay attention and bring a positive attitude to her class, her class will be a great experience.

By far the best professor I've had at SMU. The classes are never boring and she makes the material easy to understand. Homework is minimal (only one project that requires a lot of outside effort) and long as you know the expectations for the assignments, it is not hard at all to do well in this class. If you have the chance, take her class!!!

I never bought the book. Everything you need for this course is at the library or provided by her on Canvas. Easy A. Long assignments. If you just do them, you'll be fine. Final is 20% and comes from all the hints she gives you through the semester and your assignments. She's such a sincere educator! Love her!

Such a sweet lady - definitely recommend this class.  Easy to do well but you learn the material too.  No tests, just projects - they take a lot of time but are really fun!  Participation is a strong part of your grade; no strict attendance policy but knows who isn't there.  Would recommend this professor to anyone

Abby is one of my all time favorite professors at SMU. She really showed me that education was my true calling. You need to attend class and participate, but I agree with the other reviewers. If you try your hardest and complete the work to your best ability you will do well in her class!

She is nice! I loved her! I will be in her class again, no doubt about it. The lectures are not demanding, and her discussions can be a lot of fun. You should read so its easier to follow along and be prepared for the occasional pop quiz, but the work load is not that heavy. She is not too hard on grading either, she is really looking for effort.

Absolutely my favorite at SMU. I've taken her twice now. She is super interesting, and she does a good job of applying course material to the real world. I had a friend pass away unexpectedly, and she was very understanding when I had to miss class. I recommend her 100%!
Professor is so helpful and interested in seeing each student succeed. Would definitely recommend!
Awesome lady. Easy A. Take her class!
She is by far the best teacher at SMU
Dr. B is so nice and genuinely cares about her students. Her class was easy, with NO TESTS, just one weekly assignment that you definitely had to do but that wasn't too bad. Her class was great.

No clear structure to the class assignments and an EXTREMELY subjective grader. Had to meet with her twice about two paper grades that she obviously didn't bother reading and just slapped a letter grade to. Take at your own risk.
She is a wonderfuln person and teacher! Her class is very easy...easy A. But she is very helpful...definelty take this class!

great teacher, very easy... it is very easy to make an A, but you have to do all of the homework and attendance is very important. 1 hmw per week, no exams, just 2 field projects (easy) and a final. This class isn t hard, it s just an 8am...
Easy class where you are often treated as if you have no brain.  Minimal work, but grading is often arbitrary. Class is boring, literally repeats of the readings

I absolutely loathed this class, and I am an Anthro major. She refuses to take control of people who insisted on yacking nonstop, lecture is unstructured, and she refuses to give clear instructions on assignments then you get marked down for it. There is only one test the entire semester, but at least it was easy. Take at your peril.
She is adorable and the class was entertaining and interesting. Almost no homework, but she takes attendence. Great teacher.

I absolutely loved this class and Abigail!  She was really fun and made herself seem like one of us, so she wasn't one of those awful teachers.  I actually enjoyed going to this class, the course content was extremely interesting.  Two things I would advise, visit her during office hours and take notes during the class presentations!!  Easy class!!
really easy class

Her lectures were super interesting and easy to take notes off of. She does not post her lectures online, so if you miss class you actually miss out on a lot info. That is detrimental to tests, which require your notes and have picture ID. Overall though the subject was amazing and she taught it super well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She graciously accepted my extra credit that I turned in late on accident. Everything is open note for quizzes/tests so take this class with a friend or two and alternate going to class and work together. Not a difficult class, make an effort to go to class occasionally; that is prob why she accepted my late work, because she knew my face.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Attendance not mandatory but obviously beneficial. Posts everything on canvas, tests, quizzes, and final are OPEN NOTE. She is incredibly intelligent and truly has a passion which makes class more enjoyable. One assignment that required going to the museum but it was actually really cool and took 20 min or less. Took as a breadth but I liked her!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not listen to the bad ratings for this Prof. Stockstill. She is the best professor at SMU hands down. If you can take her class, please take her.

This class is graded by a few things, I took the ARHS 3365 course and it wasn't too bad, we had a presentation and then a paper over the presentation which was a bit confusing. The professor wasn't too accessible outside of class, and the readings are pretty heavy and there is a discussion board every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: All of the grade comes from take-home tests, plus your participation in the section, so go to section. Each of the TAs grades differently, so if you take the test with someone else, be prepared to have completely different grades. Some of the TAs are very easy graders, some are very difficult. This is a class that is an easy B but difficult A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: In her 1301 class, Dr. Stockstill is wonderful. She is very knowledgeable, and the class itself is easy. reviews.comment: I really enjoy her teaching style. There were no tests or quizzes, there were 3 papers over the semester and if you follow the rubric and grading criteria you will do well. I enrolled in this class to fulfill UC credit requirements and I fell in love with the class. Dr. Stockstill is an interesting lecturer and I thoroughly enjoyed learning the material. She recommends people to read, but its not necessary to do well. Just take good notes. She really knows what she is talking about. Not a hard class. It's a gem

Stockstill's Medieval Spain class was the most interesting one I've taken at SMU. Grading wasn't strict, workload three short papers and 2 hrs reading per week. Great prof, great class.

I'm not sure why these other reviews are so negative. Maybe her first year of teaching was rough? Either way, Stockstill is an amazing prof. Her lectures are engaging and she covers cool topics. We had 3(3pg) papers and the lowest grades on all of them was an 80. As long as you show up and participate, you'll be fine. Would HIGHLY recommend.

Stockstill definitely knows what she's talking about and is pretty charming. Take him if you can!

Very very difficult to understand, especially on zoom. He was slightly helpful in office hours but not much. I basically taught myself everything from the textbook, which made the class very hard. The tests were not like the homework or quizzes, much harder. Take anyone else.

Aceves lectures were incoherent at best. He especially did not translate well to zoom. He was terrible at answering questions. Looking through his other ratings it seems he may just be terrible at teaching Business Calculus. Would never take it again.

reviews.comment: Professor Aceves needs to refine his teaching of business calculus. His lectures are near pointless, and spending a ridiculous amount of time in the book is necessary to receive a good grade. I barely passed the first test despite taking Calculus in high school. Take a different teacher than Professor Aceves for business calculus.

He is by far the worst professor I have ever taken in my life. He doesn't know how to explain things and is hard to understand when he speaks. His tests are way too hard and out of context. He is a tough grader and expects his students to answer the questions exactly as he wants to. If you change the procedure by own preference he wont give credit

Great guy, lectures can be disorganized as mentioned. You learn most of what you need in class fortunately because the textbook is a no-go. Tests and homework are and similar in difficulty and not tremendously hard. Will not take too much work outside of class. Very generous with partial credit- he mostly cares if you're understanding the concepts!
Professor Aceves is really nice and a nice grader. He really knows his stuff but his lectures are really unorganized sometimes and hard to follow. Nice guy, alright professor
The class is difficult however the tests are just like homework problems. Keep doing the odd problems! He uses sometimes questions in the book.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He was passionate about differential equations!!! Granted, some of the class lectures were a little repetitive; but overall, if you did the homework, then the tests were exactly like that. I went a couple of times for office hours--and he always was so helpful!! I would take another class by him in a heartbeat! he is by far one of my fav professors

He has a distinct teaching style which takes some time getting used to, but once you figure it out he's helpful and pretty clear. Always likes to challenge students to think instead of giving the answer right away. Was really generous when grading tests and also curved one of them. Not so generous when grading homework, however.

Professor Aceves is definitely a nice guy for sure, but his lectures are completely unhelpful. He has a very random, disorganized approach to math, often jumping from one end of the board to the other. It's very hard to follow him and take notes. On the other hand, he is very nice and helpful in office hours. Expect to learn there or on your own.
He's one of the best math teachers I have had at SMU and I highly recommend him. He is always available if you need help. Take him!

this teacher is super nice and all and will fix ur grades if u talk to him but u HAVE to teach everything yourself. his test as like practice test but he CANNOT teach. depend on ur self, other than that its ok because his test are not bad

This is the guy - Alejandro. His wife Adriana is also a teacher. I had to drop Calc II the semester before because I was failing, but this semester, in Alejandro's class, I made an A! He has a thick accent and his final was really hard, but he's very friendly & is decent at explaining things if you pay attention. He gives bonus Q's on tests!

I enjoyed Professor Herring's class. He's very knowledgeable and good at teaching the information. However, I'm pretty upset with how unorganized the grades are. Regarding a quiz question, I sent him two emails, got no response, emailed two TAs, got no response. Grade book is incorrectly organized, final is tomorrow, IDK what my actual grade is.
Such an interesting and also easy class! I loved him! He tells things like a story so the lecture is really fun to follow along to. He just doesnt like the use of technology in the classroom.

This felt like my first "lecture" in college and was well worth my time. Herring is a very respectable professor and knows what he's talking about. Class was comprised of semi-weekly quizzes, a midterm, and final. So easy if you just listen to the lectures and read the files he uploads on Canvas. Easy class and enjoyable content.

This is a very boring and easy class. Nice guy and he makes his lectures somewhat interesting. Grade is comprised of two major tests and a quiz every other week or so. If you want a GPA booster, this class is the one to take
Really full of himself. Obnoxious in teaching and talking to students.
He is a personified history book. Easy class but you will learn a lot!

reviews.comment: ARHS 3302 - Took this class during jan term for a history credit. I really enjoyed this class, the material was very interesting and Herring was very passionate about it. We had two trips to the DMA to look at art from the time period. There were 2 short papers and 1 final. I highly recommend if you need a history credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super passionate about what he teaches. You get to go to the DMA and view artifacts firsthand as he explains them. He's truly a world-class expert on the subject material and class feels more like a guided tour than a boring lecture. Grading is straightforward and he's not strict; great for an elective course. Take him if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Not sure you need to attend class? Just stay on top of due dates and exams and you'll pass. You just need to review the presentations before every exam.

He is very passionate about what he teaches but his lectures can be a bit boring sometimes & goes on many tangents. I didnt go to class very much at all. The course is made up of 2 papers, midterm, final, & 2 five question take home quiz. The midterm & final were memorization or hundreds of buildings but very doable. I would recommend for breadth

Stopped going to class halfway through the semester and still finished with an A. Two papers, two quizzes, and the midterm and final are the only grades. All the assignments in this class are very straightforward, just memorize the slides he provides on canvas. My class was huge so I got away with not showing up but that might change in the future.

Our class was so big that attendance wasn't taken, but I would definitely recommend going to the lectures because Professor Herring is a really interesting speaker. He's passionate about the subject and his exams aren't difficult so you should get an A if you put in a little effort.

Really amazing professor who is passionate about what he teaches. Attendance is not taken, but the class is super interesting. There were only 2 papers, 2 short take home quizzes, and then the final and midterm (he gives good review material for it). Don't buy the textbook. Great way to fufill a CC even if you aren't an art history major.
No homework, lecture heavy. 2 papers. Easy midterm and final.

Professor Herring is a great teacher who is very passionate about this subject but lectures are very boring. You just sit there watching PowerPoints for an hour, but the class is an easy A for CC credit. Few assignments and exams are easy. Overall, great teacher just not my favorite subject.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Pretty easy class; two papers that aren't bad, a few quizzes, a midterm, and a final that he gives you everything for. He likes the topic so really just goes on tangents. Easy to get A and not show up. I recommend it

A good class to take for CC credit. Lectures can be boring and long but attendance isn't mandatory. Super passionate about his subject so enjoy listening to what he says. Very easy midterm and final: provides slides to memorize and are straightforward. Two papers that you should do well on if you put in a decent effort. Good class and good guy!

This class was super interesting. Professor Herring really knows his stuff and presents it in a way that is hella engaging. He's a fairly easy grader just put some effort in and he'll give you credit for it. Professor Herring is a really great professor and I'm just bummed I had to take the class over zoom and didn't get to meet him IRL.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class. Most of the time I'd mute my zoom during lecture and sit there with my camera on so I got counted for attendance, but then I'd watch the lecture back at 2x speed and take notes with no issues. He's very passionate and I found the class very interesting. Few assignments, good luck on the quizzes. Tests were easy.

1000% recommend taking this class for a UC credit, Professor Herring is super nice and passionate about this subject. He makes the assignments extremely clear and is a very generous grader. One of the easiest classes I have ever taken

I took this class (11 days) in July and it was awesome. I can't recommend Professor Herring enough, he's super nice and the best teacher. He's very well-educated and is super knowledgeable about architecture. This class was on Zoom and since it was four hours, he gave us 10- minute breaks here and there and gave us a 1 hr break for lunch. Take him!
He loves what he does. His lecture may be a little boring but as long as you show up it's an overall easy class. He's very punctual but a very easy grader.

Adam Herring is awesome. I had been dreading taking a history class for my pillars but Prof Herring makes this class the best. All you have to do is show up to class, memorize the slides he gives you for the test, and you can get an A. The only bad part is the boring readings on which he sometimes will give a quiz.

Dr. Herring is an incredible professor who is extremely passionate about his subjects. I've had him for Maya and Inca art and his lectures are interesting and very well thought through. Assignments are very straight forward and not very difficult. A good amount of memorization, but not bad compared to other art history professors I've had.
Took this class for May term. He made it pretty easy you just had to show up to get an A and not fail the two papers or final.
Really nice professor.  Very helpful and extremely passionate about Maya art.  He knows that subject extremely well.  His PhD is from Yale.  The best Professor I have had at SMU by far.

I really enjoyed his class, he is very passionate about Inca Art. Only 2 tests and 2 papers and offers extra credit. Provides a master slide list for tests which is extremely helpful. Overall a really good professor who can actually teach! It seems SMU finally hired a professor based on teaching abilities!  Way to go SMU!!

I dont know how anyone could have anything negative to say about this prof. You really need to attend every lecture, he'll help you out if he knows you really care about his class. His midterm and final is actually REALLY EASY compared to what you would expect for Art History. Just be good at memorization.

DO NOT take him if you need to pass classes!!!! Extremely difficult,never answers e-mails! his TA is rude!they  choose few favorites in the class and fail others! tests are unclear and he never even seen them(TA grades all of it). attendance 95%.
the class is fairly easy if you attend lecture. lecture is really boring though, but the professor is completely intrigued by the subject. 2 papers, one which is 7-10 pages long, required.

He's like calling it in at this point and is more interested in doing nothing but collecting a paychek. Teacher unorganized, uninvested, doesn't talk about anything that is relevent to the assignements, just rambles. AWFUL.
Such a waste of time and money. Professor doesn't do anythin but hand out As like candy.

Such an easy class. It's impossible to get anything less than an A. Class is graded on 3 papers no exams/test. Prof Adler is so passionate about archaeology and it shows! Class was fun and interesting and the minimal stress made class actually enjoyable. He wants students to do well and enjoy the subject. Also fulfills like 3 CCs. Def take him!!!
Has an agenda and forces you to agree with it for an A. Most jarring sign of an insecure professor is one who can't allow others to think for themselves. That's him.
Doesn't know who's in his class, doesn't know how to teach, has an ego the size of Texas, and for no known reason why. Awful in all regards.
class is so easy, attendance is not mandatory 2 papers and a final professor is so sweet and kind if you take the class talk to the professor is a really cool dude if you talk to him

Literally the GOAT. Such a kind professor who genuinely cares about students and their learning. Class consisted of 3 short papers and an optional final (if for some reason you need a grade boost) and he's very accommodating on deadlines. Super interesting topics and Alder made class engaging. Def take him if you can!

Very opinionated heavy lecture only class covering very specific and limited themes, prof refused to acknowledge other themes brought to his attention, very defensive and condescending to diff views even on here

reviews.comment: Very easy class with a great teacher, just be sure to actually do readings by the time you do your writing assignments, as you're graded by very few things. Even then it's not hard, he's a great and caring teacher who actually lessens work in order to make students lives easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Adler is a super good guy. He is really flexible if you are not able to take an exam on time. Exams are hard but they are only worth 40% of your grade, and there are 5 and an optional final and he takes the best 4 out of the 6. Labs are easy and worth 60% of overall grade.

Lectures are incredibly engaging and the coursework itself is interesting. He is a very lenient grader on the tests and as long as you pay attention in class, check out the textbook every so often, and fill out the study guides, you will likely do very well. Labs are the only homework component.
Worst course and professor I have ever taken, stay away.
Horrible course and professor.

AWESOME!! Best class ever. Took his class "Plundered Past" and it was so interesting. You can tell he really cares about your mental health and will work with you. Two papers and one final paper, he really wants everyone to do well and believes everyone should pass his class with an A. Loved him!

Took ANTH 3318, and recommend it. Adler is a chiller. Did not pay attention in class whatsoever, and missed some classes yet finished with an A. 3 exams which are basically take home written responses, a final paper,  and an optional final. Do the extra credit as each extra credit adds to your exam grade. Really easy class, not much effort needed

Dr. Adler is the best professor I've had at SMU so far. He gives genuinely interesting lectures, makes an effort to connect with students, and even organized field trips to places like the DMA and Harlan Crow's personal library. He cares more about learning for the sake of learning rather than learning for a grade. Take his class if you can!

Prof Adler is very passionate about what he teaches and practices. His lectures are interesting and he is always happy to answer questions. Your grade is determined from a few papers and a presentation. Overall, very easy to get a good grade in the class if you know how to write a strong paper and show that you put effort into it.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've ever had. He is very passionate about what he does and he makes every class interesting. You are graded on essays and a presentation, but they are very easy (and also interesting!). I am not an anthropology major but this was one of my favorite classes ever, and I never had to stress over it. Would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: MA is awesome: he genuinely cares about what he talks about and is passionate. That being said, he seriously does the lectures to make himself happy: he seriously could not care if you were there, which is awesome, because it shows he loves to talk about archaeology. Huge papers and projects, but they are easy to score well on. Just put in effort!

reviews.comment: Professor Adler is one of the most amazing professors I have ever had! He is educated, dedicated, respectable, wise, and truly cares about his students. His lectures are extremely interesting and you will learn so much!

he is a super nice guy and tries to make the lectures as interesting as possible, but the content is so boring. he gives a comprehensive review before every exam and that's all you need to make an a on them. labs are kinda boring but the TA's will give you corrections on your lab reports if you send them in the day before they're due. TONS of EC.

He does give specific case studies in lectures that may appear on the test. Labs are good if get your reports checked before you turn them in. There's lots of work but it's all relatively easy.
Great guy who had entertaining lectures and gives great study guides for the tests.

reviews.comment: No Comments

Not to mention being a fox, he's a fabulous prof. He very helpful to those who ask. Truthfully, I missed my fair share, and probably other people's fair share of classes - due part to a torn achilles and and even larger part due to pure collegiate laziness

One of the best.  Absolutely committed to both his students and his profession.  If you are not a screw-up, you will learn more than just the class material from this guy.   Fun on camping trips, too. PCP '96!

He's a good teacher.  He's very thorough but he makes sure you understand the material.  The Labs are difficult and the TA's are weirdos.  Overall, an "A" is gainable if you take very good notes and go to class.
Great Professor! Very Helpful. Also, he puts most of the notes on WEBCT, just make sure you go to the labs.
No Comments
Felt like academic warfare. No feedback, no direction, just judgment. Asking for help was met with a weird power trip. This class was exhausting, demoralizing, and absolutely not worth the credit.

Prof Mawani makes class so interesting. I took this course to fulfill one of the requirements, and I ended up enjoying the course so much. I think a lot of that goes to the instructor. This course uses reading and writing, but it's not too bad. The Prof appreciated when I put my own opinions in the work!

Professor Mawani is wonderful. He will make you talk in discussions, however he is encouraging and appreciates any answers you give. The assessments are very easy. He always leads thought provoking discussions whether you know a lot or a little on the topic. Take good notes.

This class requires some work. The readings can run long, but get explained during lectures. The professor is very engaging in lectures and presents the topic in an impartial way. He really values participation and hearing what people think. I recommend!!

I took his honors section. Such a nice person and obviously really cares about his students. The workload was decently challenging, and there was definitely a good amount of reading. He does a good job of giving you the opportunity to show what you know on tests, and give some leeway for things you don't.
Avoid at all costs. He makes the hardest tests to make sure no one is cheating and forgets about the fact that we are here to learn and need good grades to enter real professions.

The guy doesn't teach at all and he is so bad at trying to that he didn't even know which class he was teaching or our names. He is so uninvested that he doesn't even follow his own syllabus and your grade will pay for it. He screwed up my grade and refused to respond to emails about it, won't meet, and wasn't in office hours so no help.

Avoid this class! Professor is out of touch with reality, lives in their own academic bubble. Assignments are irrelevant, lectures are uninspiring. Don't waste your time. He is a terrible lecturer and grades harder than anyone I have ever come across.

i have no words. please take another professor maybe even wait a semester to take it with someone else if possible. word on the street is we finally got rid of him. let this serve as warnings to others.
Awful. Do not take. Terrible teacher. Grades so hard. Tests are hard. Doesnt know what he is doing in any aspect. NEVER TAKE HIM

Dont take this professor. He is a horribly disrespectful person, cannot take ANY criticism without getting defensive, and will make students wait over an hour to take an exam. Some of us are premed and are taking the course for credit not to become theologians and someone should tell him that. 1000 level courses ain't that serious bruh.

The instructor's passion for the subject comes through in the lectures. The workload is manageable: a midterm and final (gives you the question beforehand), and four short quizzes. I didn't have to worry about writing essays. He's available during office hours to clarify concepts. I found the course to be a rewarding experience.

Mawani's honors section was exceptional. He's a kind and caring professor who genuinely invests in his students' success. The coursework was suitably challenging, with reading assignments. Assessments allow students to demonstrate learning, while providing flexibility for areas they struggle with. Overall, an outstanding course!

Where to start with Adil. If you have any self-respect, DON'T take his class. He has hard assignments so kiss your grade goodbye. I showed up for all lectures, studied, attended office hours, and still barely passed. Last 5 min of class and he is scolding us about how we have 10 min left and that it's "our grade" because we were packing up.

Avoid at all costs. Professor is condescending, lacks empathy. Makes learning a chore, if not torturous with his meanness and over the top testing strategies to curb cheating. Don't subject yourself to this educational torture.

His whole class is set up to make sure you don't get an A, and this is for something that nobody takes other than to grab a cred. His tone is inappropriate, condescending when students ask questions and sarcastically making fun of students. His grading is as unfair as his questions are, intentionally trying to confuse students as his lectures do.

reviews.comment: No matter how many classes I went to, nothing could bring my B up. Stay away, better options are popping up on coursebook  now probably because of how many complaints he gets.

reviews.comment: Stepping up to the plate of religious studies, this course delivered a grand slam of enlightenment, rounding the bases of faith and culture with finesse. reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Never ever did I think this would be the class I get a B in this semester. Such a disappointing class. Looked nothing like the class description and the reading quizzes were worded very tricky and meant to stump you. It's like he wanted his students to fail. If ur essay answers weren't EXACTLY want he wanted to hear, forget about getting an A.

His lectures go by so slooowwww and and the tests are meant to trick you. He's passive aggressive when you ask for help, and the atmosphere in this class is god awful. He never responds to email and is not flexible with office hours and whenever you ask questions, he can't answer them. Very disappointing experience and not one you expect from SMU.

Lectures are pointless and the class is a joke that will ruin your gpa. I copied down his lectures word for word and recorded his voice and copied everything perfectly, all useless. course way too difficult for an elective, not helpful at all, rude and condescending toward students, fails to receive any constructive criticism at all, take in Taos

This religion course was a marathon, not a sprint. There were times when I felt like I was treading water, but the steady pace of the lectures and the encouragement of my classmates kept me afloat. In the end, the course was like laps in the pool, challenging but ultimately rewarding.

While I enjoyed him as a person, the way he taught his class was messy. The material we read provided little information about the religions, and the quizzes were hard to study for. He did make the tests easy but graded harshly on participation (which includes attendance).

Alright alright alright. He was not good at the beginning of the year ngl, but he got there. Ended with a ~96. Talk in class occasionally, and pay attention before midterms and finals because you will cover the material on them. A good guy and definitely interesting material. Good for cc credit or easier class if you are going for a minor.

Intimidating class, but Mawani clearly communicates material and class expectations, encourages questions and participation. Lots of reading assignments, but definitely manageable. Class structure and diverse activities motivates learning. If you take his class simply for the credit, you most likely won't enjoy the material.

take home quiz's

reviews.comment: Go to office hours if you are struggling or need clarification! Even though I was doing pretty well in her class, I would always meet her in office hours if I had a question about the homework. Her lectures are clear, and she does lots of practice problems in class, which is helpful. Easy class if you put in effort and try!

I really liked Professor Aceves, she's a great teacher! Her class isn't bad at all, you have homework but you don't have to submit it, weekly take home quizzes that she can help you with, and only 3 tests. She's super sweet and I definitely recommend her class.

I really like Professor Aceves as a person, she is very nice and willing to help. However, if you aren't good at math, you will likely struggle in her class. Her exams are very long, and we only had 50 minutes to complete them. Most people wouldn't finish it. Also, small mistakes cost you lots of points so you must be careful.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Keep this in mind while reading this review: I am NOT good at math. However, I think Aceves is a good professor. She explains the material well and you will get a lot from the lectures if you pay attention. I had to study very hard for the tests but math doesn't come very easy to me. If you are good at math, an A in her class is very attainable.

Take her. However, go into this class mentally blocking off each of her office hours in your schedule. If you routinely do office hours, you will get 100% on every quiz, build a connection, and it will boost your exam grades. Without office hours I wouldve failed calc like i did in high school. She wants you to succeed.
The worst ever. Simple.

She is very accessible outside of class and ready to help if you need it. I will say there are easier professors out there for this class but she is super helpful in teaching you the material and her lectures were great
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Aceves teaches MATH1309 with clear explanations. Quizzes are take-home, and tests aren't too difficult. The textbook is used, but attending office hours is key. unstuck AI was a great study tool alongside the provided materials.

Coming from a non-math person: please, please, do the optional homework! If you do, Aceves is a good lecturer, accessible outside of class, and very understanding should you need extra help; you won't have any problems with her class.

I loved Dr. Aceves' class! She is super kind and caring, and she does her best to explain clearly. She is also very accessible outside of class, especially during her office hours, and always open to questions! Grades: Chapter quizzes (take-home), chapter homework assignments (optional, but DO THEM), chapter exams (not bad, similar to reviews).

This professor has a very thick accent so it was hard to understand her at times. There are 3 major exams worth 60% of your grade and weekly take-home quizzes worth 20%. The exams are long and you barely have enough time to do them. I had a hard time keeping up in this class as there's new lessons everyday and a zoom review session before the exam.

reviews.comment: This class was a challenge for me at first, but Professor Aceves was super helpful. She is super easy to reach outside of class. As long as you show that you are putting in the effort, she will help you and work with you. My biggest advice if you take this class is to go to her office hours. She is so sweet and really wants to help you!

reviews.comment: I took Aceves this semester and she was a good professor. Her lessons reflect exam topics, exam reviews are long but useful for learning, and exams are a bit long but manageable if you arrive on time. Overall, she is one of the best MATH 1309 professors you can take.

reviews.comment: Hate her sm awful everything get ready to fail

Had her for Calc 1, her tests are a lot longer compared to other professors and way more difficult. Lectures aren't super useful but attendance is mandatory and her office hours aren't useful either. Better off just trying to teach yourself with youtube videos or find someone who is good at calc. Don't trust her grading in Canvas, weigh yourself.

A great lecturer, who doesn't assign much homework. quizzes are take-home and tests make up a majority of the final grade. A high enough test average can exempt you from the final, which is nice if you're confident in your math skills. Office hours are consistent and helpful if students are struggling.

To pass this class you have to show up and pay attention. If you do show up and pay attention it is super easy to understand. She makes her lectures understandable and has lots of material and lecture notes on her canvas page. She also is a nice professor overall and cares about her students

Go to office hours she's actually super chill and awesome and super helpful for quizzes and homework and such. She's rly not a good teacher though when she lectures. The ALEC was my bestie when I took this class.

Aceves' lectures are lowkey boring. She helps out a lot and is accessible outside the class and puts in an extra credit question on every test. Math is not my strong suit and I'm particular about my teachers but she couldn't verbally explain to be in a way I could understand. She also expects you to remember all your precalc background.

Great business calculus class! She is super comprehensive and makes her exams based on the review assignment given before the exam. She is super accessible in her office hours and helps you understand problems step by step. She gives extra credit for perfect attendance and includes one extra credit question in all of her exams. Take her class!
Such a sweet professor! She's pretty good at explaining most topics and she's basically always accessible during office hours. I took this for the summer term, so it moved pretty quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing prof. Very kind and caring, but class is a lot of work. Weekly homework assignments -- start early and split up the work, it's very painful if you wait till the night it's due to begin. If you're confused, ASK FOR HELP. she's really sweet and she will help you, but you have to speak up.

She sometimes goes too fast but stops for questions. Quizzes are easy if you paid attention in class. Go to office hours to get it checked and she will basically help you answer the questions. Shes gives extra credit on tests which aren't difficult to begin with.
Professor Aceves was great! Her lectures are pretty good and the tests are pretty similar to the reviews. Overall, would recommend.

She knows the material very and is good as explaining the concepts of math and not just memorizing the formulas like other teachers. Very fast paced class and the homework can be confusing and take hours but she is accessible to review it. Tests are longer than they should be, and sometimes she will write questions to trick you.

reviews.comment: She is super nice and understanding. If you have perfect attendance your final exam grade replaces your worst exam grade which is super helpful. Great option for a class that can be hard.

She is a great person, but overall her lectures make no sense. I made the mistake of not taking precalculus before this class and it definitely hurt me when I chose to take 1309. I would highly recommend you take a different professor. If you end up getting stuck with her go to her office hours 3 days a week or good luck. say a few prayers before
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hard to understand sometimes will need to teach a lot on your own. Hard reviews guides that take a very long time but straight forward tests, other homework is pretty light once a week. Find a good study group

Super intelligent, but she makes a LOT of mistakes during lectures. Students constantly had to correct her. Lots of HW but it's a completion grade. Quizzes are pretty easy, but the tests are difficult. She's good about partial credit though. She moves really fast in lectures. Super sweet woman!

By far the best math professor Ive had. She explains everything well, with patience, and will answer all your questions. She cares about her students and wants them to succeed. GO TO OFFICE HOURS. Youll learn how she grades and what format she likes answers in so you wont get deducted points off small errors. Tests are just like her reviews.

reviews.comment: Professor Aceves moves very quick, which can be difficult especially in a math class. If you have her next semester make sure you go to her office hours because she tends to favor those students more. The homework/ tests are way harder than the homework and practice problems.
definitely had to put in work but she explains everything very well

Shes the best math professor Ive ever had! Shes super understanding and gives good feedback on work. Shes one of the nicest ladies and cares about her students and just wants everyone in her class to do well!!
This class was, uh, not it. She grades the tests based on the smallest errors, so unless you're meticulous with your work, be prepared to get grades far lower than they should be.

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Professor Aceves' style of teaching and she's super intelligent. Definitely lecture-heavy and more fast-paced than other courses. One of my favorite classes because of how helpful she is. If you take her and want to do well, go to most if not ALL her office hours. And the reviews  the test. Make sure to participate!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Cares about students who put in effort; if you're genuinely trying to learn she's happy to work with you. Explains concepts well enough for people who've taken calc 1 before, but if this is the first calc class you've ever taken, you'll suffer. Tests are 80% of your grade! Reviews are harder than the exams tho so do them. TA was awful at teaching.

Lectures can be pretty confusing because she moves pretty fast and has a thick accent. If you struggle with math, youre definitely gonna want to take advantage of her office hours because shes actually a great teacher one-on-one. Replaces your lowest test grade with the final, which is great, and you can also exempt to final if you have 95 avg.

reviews.comment: Professor Aceves is the absolute best! She loves to help people learn and understand the material. Go to office hours! She will help you with any quiz questions or homework questions! Homework assignments are optional, but I highly recommend doing them. Do your work and you can easily finish with an A in this class!!!

Possibly one of the worst teachers I've ever had. She grades super harshly. The homework, quizzes, and tests take so long. She doesn't do a good job of explaining anything or actually teaching anything. She is rude and does not truly care about helping you. She's one of the only teachers that teaches a math course in the afternoon, NOT WORTH IT!

GO TO OFFICE HOURS. She wants to help, and in a big lecture like this, it really helps because she knew my name and that I cared. You have weekly take-home quizzes that if you go to office hours she'll basically do with you. Do the homework it really helps. Do well on the first exams because you can get exempt from the final with a 95 test avg .

reviews.comment: She gives quizzes every class period and they are graded very harshly, I did many of them with a tutor, and still usually did not receive grades above 80%. Her accent makes all of the concepts much more difficult to comprehend, and I would not take this class again if I was paid to.

She talks way too fast and has a thick accent. Most of her class fails the recent test but she does not curve it because some people got a 100. Even though those people have already been through calc 2 or are retaking the class. Most people learn through khan academy to survive. The "completion homeworks" are graded on accuracy "accidently"

If you have her, she speaks very fast and with a thick accent. That combined with like 2 months to learn all of Calc2 is a little challenging. 3 Test 60% of grade and the last average was a 66 w/ no curve. GO TO OFFICE HOURS

Aceves is a excellent professor. Her lectures are clear. She gave weekly quizzes that are easy if you did the homework. She is always respectful of students and answers all questions

She's such an amazing professor! I went to her office hours frequently because she was always super helpful. Weekly homework isn't too bad, and she even has an extra credit problem on every test (even the final). Naturally a tough class though.

I think this class was great, she did a great job explaining and teaching the topics, there are weekly quizzes that are almost always take-home that really help you understand the material and her review guides are very helpful. this class does require a lot of outside studying

reviews.comment: Really nice lady. I went to see her outside of class and she was helpful and still says hi a year later. Homework is due every week. Tests are pretty straightforward and there's extra credit.

She is a really great professor. She has an accent that some people find hard to understand but it really isn't. She is pretty chill with phones and laptops as the semester goes on. Just make sure you're well behaved and she will prove super useful. Go to her office hours early on in the semester and she will like you.

Not the best for intro classes.

The worst professor that Ive had in college. Does a terrible job of teaching. She goes way to fast for an intro level class. Avoid taking her class at all costs. I am an A student but I had to drop her intro to business calc class because she was so horrible.

reviews.comment: Professor Aceves understands the material clearly and communicates it well. Not too difficult, but not an easy A. Required effort, but very straightforward.

reviews.comment: A solid choice for pre-business students, your grade is based on quiz( weekly) and 3 exams, easy A if you do the quiz and go through all review problems that are very similar to your exam questions.
