reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Let me start by saying math is NOT my strongest subject. Consol. Calc is a tough class, and it was one of the hardest I've ever taken (again, not good at math) Professor Aceves is very determined to make you learn the material, but sometimes she speeds through things too fast in class. More handouts and slower problems worked on the board wouldhelp

Great teacher. She goes over everything thoroughly and is actually helpful if you don't understand something. She writes out notes on the board exceptionally well. Lets you use graphing calculators on everything. Fairly easy quizzes and tests.

real good, highly recommended. adds one bonus question in exams (worth 5 points) and quizzes are take home. Do and understand the review for the test and you should pass. probably, final's in a month. Also, she replaces your lowest test score with the final score, of course only if it was lower than the final.  I marked extra creditbonus question

Great professor - kind and organized. Helpful and accessible outside of class. Sticks to syllabus. Found that she provides easy examples - making homework a bit confusing at times. Also, often makes small mistakes on the board -- so pay attention to those. Fair with quizzes, but doesn't give a lot of time. Attendance is very important for success.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She's a good professor and is not out to make all her students fail. She genuinely cared about how we did on the exams and always answered questions clearly. If you studied for the test they were not bad, she also gave a review for the exam that was very reflective of the exam. If you understand the review, you can pass her exams. Would recommend!
Aceves is a great teacher because she is so energetic. She makes the class easy to understand.

Prof. Aceves is probably one of the best teachers I have had at this school. If I had any questions about the material or HW, I'd just go to her office hours and she'd help me figure it out. A lot of homework, but it's graded on completion only. Weekly take-home quizzes and a really helpful review sheet make exams seems easy.

Good in the sense that every quiz is take home. Her tests are slightly difficult if you don't study. She teaches very quickly and it is extremely difficult to keep up. She messes up constantly while teaching her lessons and has to go back and go over the subject matter again. I would suggest finding another professor.
Great Professor Hard tester

Her instructions can be a little unclear during lecture, but she is always extremely helpful during office hours and is willing to reteach if necessary. If you have an A in the class at the end of the semester, you don't have to take the final.

Professor Aceves is very sweet and accommodating. If you pay attention, this class will be an easy A. We have quizzes every Thursday but each one ended up either being "take home" or "open note." Attend the review sessions before the tests, they are very helpful!

Aceves is by far the easiest Calc professor out there. She has weekly quizzes (which are almost always group, open note AND take home) and her tests (there are few) are very straightforward. She does have an accent so she can be a little hard to understand sometimes, but if you can get past that the class is very simple.

Takes time to get used to her accent. Goes through material very fast so make sure you can pay attention. Take home quizzes every week which are very duable and if you go to office hrs she is extremely helpful. Her tests are pretty hard but if you study you will be fine. She also gives extra credit on every one which is awesome. I never did the hw

Prof. Aceves is a sweetheart. Had her for Bus Precal & Bus Calc. She wants you to learn and will make sure you do well if you get to know her. Go to class and make sure she knows your name!! This will help you more than I can say. She can be confusing and her teaching style can be frustrating at times, but she is worth taking!!!!
Professor Aceves was one of the best teachers I've had so far. She's an excellent teacher and her tests aren't very hard. Take her class and go to class. She makes Calculus clear and easy.

Easy class, homework is optional, lots of groupclass quizzes. Most of the material is stuff you learned in middlehigh school. Tests always have a bonus question. The only "homework" you have to ever turn in are the test reviews, and those are worth doing anyways. I took her again for Business Calc!

She tends to mess up while explaining things in class. Compounded with her somewhat harsh accent and boring teaching style, she can be tough to listen to, especially for 1.5 hours on TTH. I'd look elsewhere.

A very kind and easy-going woman with a thick spanish accent! LONG lectures every class period and quizzes every thursday. If you miss more than 3 times, you will be dropped. Very helpful during office hours! If I had to take this again, I would choose her again. Homework is optional but highly, HIGHLY recommended. NO surprises. Read the syllabus.

She is an amazing instructor!!!! She will stay late, rain sleet or snow she is there for her students! She wants everyone to do well. She sincerely cares about her students!!! Love her! You could not ask for a better instructor!!! MUST TAKE HER!!!!

Not great at teaching Precal for Bus, but that's because she doesn't know how to "dumb it down". She's clearly primarily a calc teacher. She's sweet, but boring,  messes up during lectures, and has a thick accent and trouble understanding students. The class is not difficult (especially if you've had precal before!!) and she'll help if you ask!
Great teacher overall. Tests are easy as long as you go to class. Very helpful and clear, even though she has an accent.

I BARELY passed pre cal in high school so I was a little nervous for this class. So far, I've gotten 102s on the first two tests and have over a 100 average in the class. The first three weeks of class is Algebra 1 material. She's a good teacher who knows what she's doing. The accent sometimes gets kinda annoying but I still like her.
Too easy, son...

She is always there to help. She will give you extra time on tests and quizzes if you need it. She has office hours everyday except Friday so she is always available and ready to help. Strongly recommend taking her for pre-calc business.
she is a great prof. she is ready to help u.
Great Professor. Willing to help students and class is easy. I would definitely take her math education course :)!

Took Business Pre-Calc with her. The class material is easy, however, I have never had such a boring teacher. Lecture upon lecture upon lecture. I enjoy interactive and enthusiastic teachers and she made me want to sleep through every class because her teaching style was so umstimulating. She also nags you at the end of class if you test slowly.

Prof. Aceves was kind and helpful. She made the material interesting using real world examples and engaging the class when working out problems on the board. Also if you have a 92 or above you're exempt from the final. Easy and interesting class, perfect for fulfilling a math cred.

She is a great teacher, very helpful outside of class as well. take any class she offers!! at first it is hard to understand her but don't fret it only takes about a week to get the hang of her accent.

She's pretty nice. If you've taken calc before this class is a breeze. If not it's pretty difficult. BUT if you do the review packet (which is required, but actually try at it), then you should be set for the tests. Overall a good experience. Would recommend.

I took for business calc. There are weekly tests, but the majority are takehome. Her office hours are really helpful. She gives a study guide which is basically the test. Her accent isnt that bad, after a week you dont notice it.

She was a great professor. She is my favorite professor so far. She is very helpful in her office hours and is willing to answer every question you have. She is so sweet and she cares about all of her students. If you do the homework which is optional, you will do just find in the class. Her quizzes are harder than the actual tests are. TAKE HER!!
Great teacher. She explains everything clearly, homework is optional, always there to help if you need it. Best math teacher Ive ever had.

At first I somewhat found her accent annoying. But I she is a great professor! She explains everything clearly, and makes it easy understanding. She cares about all her students. Take her review seriously, if you do so you should have no problem with her exams.

Aceves is super nice and helpful! She explains concepts very clearly, and is very patient with answering questions. Even if you are struggling, she has generous office hours and it's so easy to get help for math. Aceves is merciful with grades and helpful in class. Take her course.

Such a nice professor.  Take your quizzes to her office and she will help you get 100 on all of them.  Offers study guides for test which are basically the test with different questions.  Easy A if you attend and just do the quizzes and study guide before test.
Helpful if you ask her questions. Homework is optional. Most quizzes are take-home.

Great lady who knows her stuff. She is really helpful if you need it but the class is super easy. If you took pre-cal in high school, this class is a breeze. Attendance is mandatory (sign-in sheet). Never used the book and I got an A in the class.

I have taken calc before and this class was amazingly easy - I have not done the homework since the first assignment and I have a high A. She gives quizzes every Friday but many are take-home or partner. Highly recommend if you have had calc before, but she does move rather quickly which may be hard with a non-calc background.

She is great. Homework is optional but recommended. Most of the quizzes are take home or done in groups. She is very helpful in office hours. I found the tests to be very straight forward and not tricky.

Really nice lady. Does her best to be clear about what she does on the problems, but she occasionally makes small mistakes. Talks quite quickly and has a bit of an accent, but she is still very helpful.
Aceves is a great prof!! She is extremely helpful and cares about all her students. If you really want an A, you will get an A. go to her office hours! Great class/prof!

She teaches well and her explanations are clear. She is also patient when you ask questions. If you pay attention in class and understand, you don't have to read the textbook and you're sure to do well in her tests/ exams.

Fabulous professor! She is extremely helpful in office hours. If you do the reviews, which the ALEC is extremely helpful with, you *will* ace the class. The exam reviews are almost exactly like the exam. She is also helpful in office hours, she'll help you through the exam review and tell you if something isn't going to be on it.

SHE IS A GREAT TEACHER BUT IF YOU ARE INTERNATIONAL STUDENT MIGHT BE DIFFICULT TO UNDERSTAND SINCE HER ACCENT MAKES IT HARDER TO UNDERSTAND THE CONTENT. HER CLASSES ARE FAST PACED AND MOST OF THE TIME IS NOT THAT YOU DO NOT UNDERSTAND THE CONTENT IS THAT YOU DON'T UNDERSTED WHAT IS SHE SAYING.
Difficult to follow sometimes, but relatively easy because the quizzes are usually take home and she gives us study guides for the test.
Not Bad , quizzes every week though , and she take attendance daily
Favorite class ever! She's so easy, helpful, and quite funny at times. I was actually excited to go to math for once. I would definitely take any of her classes again.

VERY EASY CLASS. I took Calc BC in high school though. You can use a graphing calculator and unit circle on every test including the final. She has an accent but everyone gets over it in about a week - no big deal really.
Loved her!! if you dont do well its bc you didnt try! she has an accent, but you get used to it. she is also really helpful, fair on grading, quiz every thursday but all but one was take home.

Extremely nice Professor who cares a lot about her students and wants them to succeed. Has an accent which is why she can be hard to understand sometimes. Her tests are not a walkover but if you do your quizzes sincerely and a few homework sums you will be fine. I would strongly recommend taking her class.

Great teacher! Go to office hours, and she will help you. She gives a review for every test. She says if you miss more than 3 classes you fail, but if you go and talk to her she will be understanding.
Fantastic professor who is always willing to help and get to know her students
She was the easiest math teacher I've had in my college career.She's great!And very helpful too!
Pretty good overall, but her accent is thick.
Great Professor, wants to help and you can constantly tell.  You get what you put into this class!
I would reccomend taking Aceves for pre-cal.  The material was extremely simple. However, I'm not sure that I was adequately prepared for Calculus even though I made a 98 in Aceves' class.
she was a good teacher but the reviews and tests were pretty difficult. if you study really hard you can get an A
Easiest teacher for math. She is very helpful. She is GREAT!
No Comments

Not a difficult class, but he's more focused on jokes than content. He's trying so hard to be entertaining and relatable that the material gets lost. You leave with little knowledge, which reflects poorly on the field. His lack of professionalism is frustrating.
Mr J. was an amazing teacher and cared about teaching. Don't need to take notes TA's will do it for you. A few essays tho.

Professor J is the best professor Ive had at SMU thus far. His lectures are amazing and have a very clear grading system for his class. 2 open note exams and a few papers but nothing crazy difficult. Probably the best professor to take for CC credit class.

This class was fantastic. Lectures were always super interesting. The multiple papers for the class are very easy to complete and are graded extremely fairly. Both exams are take home and open note and are also super easy if you paid attention in class. Highly recommend taking this course.

I really liked this class but I took it for time and because he used to not take attendance and now he does it on paper the TA's count every person in your row in the lecture hall. If your taking this as a blow off class, don't, but if you will show up everyday and want an easy class, I would recommend.
Great prof, lectures were interesting and engaging, and papers weren't too hard + he isn't too hard of a grader. Online open note final too!
Hands down best teacher I have had at SMU!

Dr. Jasienski is AWESOME!! His classes are almost completely lecture-based, but the lectures are fun and interesting! Attendance is optional, and he offers the class in person and on Zoom. I definitely recommend participating and taking notes during class, as his exams are open notes. There are very few assignments, and he grades leniently. 10/10!!

I think Dr. Jasienski is a very nice guy and good professor, I just don't completely agree with the way assignments and exams were graded for this class. TA's would grade the papers (maybe the exams too? not sure) but they grade harshly considering most people take this class for CC credit. Too difficult to get an A, extra credit was a lot of work.
AMAZING. took him for global baroque for history CC credit and he is so chill. attendance isn't mandatory and not a lot of assignments like 3 pretty easy papers. would recommend him for any class.
He's perfect. Best professor ever.

This is a prime example of a professor who really does not care about the grades and whatnot and just actually wants to share his love and knowledge of the subject. He really just teaches for the sake of teaching and it is very clear because he cares greatly about his class and is so passionate about art history as well as incredibly knowledgeable.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER. Never once taken attendance but I go every time because I enjoy it so much. He doesn't even know when he has assigned his own assignments. His main goal is to make you learn instead of testing you hard. I would recommend it to ANYONE and EVERYONE.

I have taken four classes with Prof. Jasienski over my time at SMU. He’s the single best academic influence I have had my whole time here. He loves his work (mainly Spanish art), cares for his students, fair grader depending on the class level, and enjoys discussion/debate. If you want a positive experience then take a class. He’s a cool guy!

Mr. Jasienski really cares about his students. His lectures are clear and as long as you retain the information, you'll pass. The labs are usually pretty fun and, once again, as long as you do the weekly homework you're sure to pass. He's an awesome professor and 1301 is an enjoyable class and a great way to fill CCs.

Dr. Jasienski is such a nice professor. He really cares for his students and is really laidback about his policies. There are a few papers and a midterm and final which are both open note. There's a lab each week and you learn in depth about certain subjects and a little group work. Overall, a really great choice if you're trying to fulfill credits

Prof Jasienski is amazing. Never taken art history, only did it for credit, and he made it accessible and enjoyable. If you can write a decent paper and participate just a couple times, he'll take notice and you should have no problem getting an A. Caring for his students and always understanding. Take him if you need the requirement
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Seriously one of the best teachers I've ever had and my best prof at SMU so far. He's a great lecturer and makes all of the course material super interesting. He and the TA Laura are both really understanding and helpful. He didn't make us buy any books and gave us all the required readings on Canvas. Overall really cool class and great professor.

Professor Jasienski has been one of my favorite professors taken at SMU. He gives great feedback on your papers, and responds to emails very quickly. Also, super accessible outside of class. There is no homework, but four short papers, and two tests. Highly recommend taking this class for an art history credit.

Prof. Jasienski is the best art history prof in the department hands down. His lectures are incredibly well made and interesting - you can tell he is really interested in what he is teaching. He cares about his students and makes time for them, and gives great feedback. There are 2 papers, 1 annotated bib, 1 final paper, and a take home final

Mr. Jasienski is a good teacher. He cares a lot about the material and his students. Although he takes a long time to grade and the student has no idea where they are at in the class. He also changed the weight of different sections right before the final and everyones grades changed. If you are good at art history, take this class. If not, DONT!
reviews.rating_tags: SO MANY PAPERS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Jasienski is such an amazing art history professor who has such a passion for the subject and his students. You can easily pass the class without going, but I highly recommend attending because the lectures are amazing. He is very accessible outside of class, but the work does ramp up at the midterm, final essay, and final exam so beware.

Prof Jasienski is an amazing prof who really loves his subject. His lectures are very easy to follow and interesting. There are a few short papers but they aren't easy A's. As long as you show up to lecture, the papers and tests aren't hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Incredibly friendly and accessible, Adam's class is great for those wanting an accessible way to learn Art History, especially those without an art background. All in all a great professor, just make sure to do the readings and his papers/exams will be a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I loved this class so much. Definitely take it if you are in any way interested in ARHS and want a good introduction class to it. I took this because I was vaguely interested and now I'm contemplating majoring in ARHS. Prof Jasienski is amazing and so was my TA (Delanie). This is a very reading/writing based class with take home midterm and final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Tests? Not many--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor There is a lab associated with this class and was the best part of it. In the lab, we went to view the different art collections on campus. In addition, for the main lecture, attendance is not mandatory but it is helpful for the midterms and finals. Consists of 3 short papers, 1 long essay, 1 final paper and an online midterm &final
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: Graded on weekly homework assignments and four tests. She does reviews for each test which are helpful, but you will have to look at other material as well. Her lectures cover what you need to know if you can understand them. The lectures are by far the worst part, extremely confusing.

I really enjoyed 3312 with Professor Julander. She is very very helpful in office hours. Her lectures are really boring and attendance isn't mandatory but if you want to do well, you should have an idea of what is happening in her class. Final is optional and replaces a test grade. 2 exams, 2 projects. Very manageable and would 100% recommend.

She's a chill professor who still cares for her students to do well in her classes. She's really helpful in her office hours and can help you through the HWs or group projects. Look at the lectures, HWs, or the practice exams to prep for the tests and you should do good in her classes.

To survive this May term class, do the homework and quiz assignments and really understand each of the problems done, looking back at the PowerPoint and textbook at the specific topics and formulas that the questions rely on. Test problems will rely on the concepts she lectures on along with problems similar to homework/quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Julander was always very willing to answer questions. If you don't take good notes or do the homework, you will not do very well in this class because test questions are very similar to in-class or homework questions. She was very accommodating during MayTerm, since nobody seemed to be very ready for the last test, she ended class a day early

Dr. Julander was able to take statistics and present it in an easy to understand format. The lectures can be a bit tough to sit through, but I think that has to do more with the content at hand. Don't be afraid to ask questions, she'll break stuff down really well for you.

Most boring class I have ever been to but it's important to pay attention. The textbook helped me understand the equations a lot better than the in class lectures. Can be a really confusing class if you don't keep up.

Ms. Julander taught her stuff pretty clearly. I think I could have got a better grade if I paid more attention to my homework and actually went to class. As tempting as it is, just don't skip her lectures and you'll be fine. Although she's a good teacher, she's not very personable. I was usually in lab for less than 20 minutes. Overall, she's okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Class average: 85.46944. A decisive majority of the class received a B+ or higher. Slightly easier than the stereotypical course, but not overwhelmingly so.

She's fine. She allows large reference sheets for exams, and, since the exams are literally just picking the right formula to use, what matters most is that you know what formula you're using. She basically lectures straight out of the textbook, so showing up to class is certainly not necessary.

Office hours are basically six hours a day five days a week since she is one of the Statistics tutors. Attendance to class is not required and definitely not needed. You can use a calculator that you can program information/formulas into along with a notecard for each test, which only covers like 2-3 chapters of repetitive material. Super easy.

Going to class and taking notes helps a lot. If you pay attention and go into office hours if you have any questions you will do fine. The grading scale is super chill an A- is an 88 I think and an A is a 92. She also drops ur lowest test and u get a notecard on every test. If you get A's or A-'s on ur tests u don't have to take the final.

Prof. Julander doesn't take attendance at her lectures, so technically you could skip, I just don't suggest it (esp towards the end when things get a little complicated). She is very clear in her lectures, just take notes and do the practice tests and you'll be fine. HW can be a little hard, but that's because the textbook is weird. Go to labs.

If you have to take one last math class just to get out of the requirement, I totally recommend this one. Basically as easy as it gets. Homework due once a week, lab on Friday is super easy and you just have to follow instructions and you'll get 100, you get to bring notes on the tests, class ends early most days. Go to class and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is a general entry level class, so it can be difficult to make a connection, especially when you are in a lecture room with 100 other kids. But she makes the concepts as simple as you can, and as long as you do the homework and take notes, you will be fine.

Prof. Julander is a very nice lady and if you've taken stat before, this class won't be too difficult. The homework does not line up with her lectures which is annoying, but her tests are very similar to the practice tests that she gives. he is always available and explains everything very well 1 on 1, and her grading scale is forgiving.

Ask questions! She loves it! She is very nice, lectures all of class, often lets us out early. Weekly homework, out of probably the worst, most confusing textbook I've ever used (it's and SMU textbook and it's horrible). TAs teach labs, very nice but go too fast but it's okay if you just ask questions. Pretty difficult, no one knows anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Clear lectures and gives good example problems in class. He exams are generally mirrors of the practice tests she gives a week before the actual exam. She is accessible out of class and helps if you can't grasp an idea. Go to class and focus on the lecture and try and comprehend what she says. If you're gonna be on your phone, don's bother to going
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She isn't the most clear lecturer, though what I can say is that she is the most accessible that I have had. You should be sure to visit her office hours if you are having trouble with anything. I found her to be much more clear 1-on-1 when you approached her with specific questions/problems. She is clear about what material will be tested on.

attend labs/do hw - 20% of your grade.  final replaces your lowest test so it actually counts for 40% not 25.  test heavy and doesn't actually teach it all that well, but if you've taken stats before you're okay.  about 30 of 120 people actually attended this class regularly

Ms. Julander is a very nice person. She is reasonable, helpful and approachable. She isn't that great at teaching the material (I have a hard time with math). Her tests are hard but she gives generous curves and allows you to have notecards.
no point in going to class. just follow the study guides and youre good.

Took Stat before so I had a fundamental understanding of the course. Don't have to go to class and its a waste of time. Test multiple choice is difficult but the short answers are fair. Not that hard of a stat teacher compared to others

very helpful teacher(manager of a-lec--if you go she will be there and she will help) lets you bring in a cheat sheet for the test. hard to follow in class but is helpful and tests arent tricky. plus the cheat sheet saves the day. you can put anything on it(solutions)

Very nice teacher, but is hard to follow in class. If you go visit her office hours though she makes everything crystal clear. HW assignments are from the textbook and are hard. Tests can be challenging, but she let's you do a take-home portion to help your grade. She always lets you out of class early and doesn't make you take the final!

Her class is understandable but her hoemwork makes no sense in relation to what she is teaching. Class seems very simply but when you get the work you realize that you haven't really learned a thing. Textbook makes no sense either and is very difficult to comprehend. Don't recommend her.

I had her for summer school but she is so awesome.  We got out early everyday and she works in the LEC.  So when test time comes around make sure you see her and talk to her and she will help out so much.  Very nice teacher. Approachble too. Be nice and act interested.
RIP Dr. Adams

Professor Adams recently passed, but I still wanted to share. I had Adams for GC1, GC1+2 Lab. Day one she assured me that I would be successful if I worked hard, but more importantly, if asked for help. Sure, she taught me chemistry, but really, she taught me how to be a student. I am forever grateful for her. Sending love to the Adams family

She was one of the best professors I ever had, never hesitated to spend more time with me when I needed it, always answered questions, had enough respect for us as learners to not be too easy but not too rigorous where we would get frustrated. A true mark of a great educator.

Prof. Adams always offered to spend time with me in office hours trying to help even if I wasn't the best student. She was willing to help any of us students out in any way. I really appreciated her knowledge and ability to convey it to those of us who knew so much less, and she did so with understanding. She was a terrific professor.

Mrs. Adams was always very nice and loved talking to her students. She was very straightforward with lab expectations and procedures. I never felt lost or confused with how in depth her instructions were. Lovely professor who clearly knew what she was doing.

She barely covers the basics but you have to do so much work on your own, demeanor in class is so unfriendly and uses a sense of humor that is rude and inappropriately targeted toward students. Yells at students during class for not paying attention, which is really disruptive for the students that are actually trying to.

She is a tough grader, says her quizzes are like the homework but yet everyone in the class get 15/30 on them, but if you do fine on the labs you will be good but they are a lot of work and you have to know what you're doing with her or she reads right through you
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Life threw me a ton of curveballs last semester so I wasn't able to get the grade that I wanted, but Dr Adams went above and beyond to help me out when it was obvious that my personal life was massively impacting my performance in the class. If I could turn back time, I would have prepped for labs earlier and completely mastered the hw problems
seriously the best lab instructor. thoroughly enjoyed her class

tough grader, but if u do the work you'll pass. always seems to schedule exams/practicums on the most inconvenient days but oh well. she's nice enough in lab, but very detailed in her quizzes - make sure you know your stuff before each lab day!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Fantastic!!! professor Adams is strict but clear with what she wants. Do the homework every week to prep for the quiz and watch the lab videos. Very helpful during labs and will answer all of your questions. Fav Professor!!!

I honestly love Professor Adams. She is a very particular grader but is always walking around and offering to help. She's not fond of people who slack off so work hard, put in the effort, and show her you care about doing well in the class.

Either you love or hate Adams--that's for most students. If you do your work well and put in a lot of effort, you should be fine. Go to her office hours and talk to her individually. She's really sweet when she's not lecturing. She's a harsh grader though so beware.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Her lectures are okay, the slides are good but she goes through them pretty fast. Honestly, I found her to be pretty unapproachable and intimidating. She wasn't ever the kindest or most understanding in my experience. The class is hard and I don't think she made it much better besides having good slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mrs. Adams may be a tough professor but she is caring and loves to teach. I would take her again in a heartbeat. She is always available if you need her and will answer any question you have. If you can, definitely take her class!!

Mrs. Adams isn't an easy grader and makes her class tough, but she's great if you put in the work. She's super nice and will go out of her way to help you IF you work hard in class; however, if you slack off or try to BS her, you're in for a rough ride. Essentially, you can have a great time in her class or a miserable one; I would do the former!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love this lady she is so cute and precious. The class is an easy A if you go to class and do all the homeowork problems. The tests are super straightforward and similar the notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Adams can seem intimidating at first, but she is a great teacher. She stresses how important it is to do the homework problems and it is a lot of problems. Her tests are similar to the homework, so do the homework. She doesn't check attendance but it is in ur best interest to attend class as she does not post certain notes on Canvas.

Dr. Adams may appear very intimidating, but she is an excellent! She will be mean to people who she thinks are lazy and don't care, but once you show her you work hard, study, and want to be there, then she will like you. You must EARN her respect. Once you do, she is extremely kind and will help and give you advice. So big tip: SHOW HER YOU CARE!!

She is extremely caring and takes a ton of time to make sure her students understand the material. Mrs. Adams also dedicates a lot of time to office hours if you email her. The lab lines up very nicely with the lectures as well.

Amazing lab teacher, encourages you to ask questions, can be a little picky when it comes to grading. Overall, very nice lady and wants students to do well. There is lab prep you have to do before class, though.

Professor Adams is the worst professor I've ever had in my life. She is an incredibly unfair grader and rude. She told me I would likely not get into med school and made me cry during a meeting about my grade. Clearly has anger issues and should NOT be working as a professor-Maybe a Dick's Last Resort waiter or executioner is more her speed.
Professor Adams is really caring and helpful! Her quizzes really help with understanding Chem 1304 material, and her lab manual is really informative. I'd recommend taking her for lab.

ok, she can be a bit scary on the first day, but as the semester goes along she is really caring, accessible outside of class, and wants her students to succeed. a good explainer too. i recommend building a relationship with her at the beginning of the semester, as she likes students who do that. don't get too intimidated by her!

Literally, on the first day of lab, she scares all her students by saying this class is extremely hard and that many people will fail. When you're confused and ask questions she will belittle you and make you feel even dumber. I had anxiety in that class all the time. I do not recommend it.

I found Professor Adams to be extremely hard for first semester Gen Chem Lab, but I've heard from other people that she's much more relaxed second semester and tries to be more accessible and an easier grader. Just be sure to do the homework problems before lab because she gives quizzes at the beginning of every class.

She definitely runs a hard lab BUT she does care about her students so much too. I was sick a few labs in a row and had to miss so my grade took a hit but she was understanding and bumped my grade up in the end. Communicate and build a relationship and you'll have a good experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof. Adams is a decent professor, but she is not forgiving at all. If you want a nice professor, she is not that. She takes off minor points for everything, ESPECIALLY decimals. She makes you feel bad about asking questions and is rude towards her students. Her labs are very detailed, so pay attention to everything in class!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Mrs. Adams is a great choice for lab! She definitely won't go easy on you but that will help you in the long run. She can definitely tell which students are working hard and really appreciates effort. Go to office hours for help and get the pre-labs done ahead of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She may not seem friendly, but she really is once you get to know her outside of class! She is very helpful and encouraging. She'd send emails telling students good job if they did well on a quiz/test. She can definitely figure out who is a hard worker, so work hard in her class!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The worst professor I have ever had! She is not understanding and is extremely rude when you ask questions. Her grading is very intense and she takes off for every small mistake, especially sig figs. Be prepared for long nights of writing lab reports, also be sure to go to office hours!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Mrs. Adams may not give off warm, fuzzy vibes, but she's reasonable, helpful, and incredibly patient. You absolutely MUST utilize her office hours, do the lab work over the weekend if you have to. This will pay off when you're making slight changes to your report while everyone else is figuring out why half of their calculations are garbage.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Do the homework a few times to get a good understanding. Slightly harder than 1st semester. Lab compliments material from lecture.
Do the homework, try to get all the bonus points. Very doable to get at least A-. Some labs are long but help with lecture material

I love her, don't hesitate asking for lecture help too. Her quizzes can be hard if you don't do the homework, but as long as you do the work required for class and give your 100% at labs you will be fine. Try to get the max points on the labs cause the lab practical never gives you enough time to finish the questions. Easy A-, a little harder A!

She doesn't only help you with chem lab but is able to help you with any lecture problems also. Do the homework from her lab manual if you want to do well on the quizzes. Truly the only professor that made me not hate chemistry.
She's not very kind. she is a very harsh grader. would not recommend it.

Soo knowledgeable about the class, she literally wrote the lab manual. I spend around 2 hours a week outside of class doing the prelab and HW but it pays off because it also helps clarify chem 1303 material. It isn't hard to do well, because there are 20 pts extra credit available throughout the semester. Overall, loved Adams and loved the class!

She defintely has favorites. She always says "ask me! I'm here for you!" but when you ask her she is soo so so rude and pompous. Last week she literally ignored me and didnt bother to make eye contact and told me "go ask someone else". I almost cried so many times in this lab. You'd think she'd be helpful because she wrote the book. nope.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Mrs. Adams is great. The 2nd semester of chemistry lab is definitely harder than the 1st but she is always willing to work with you during her office hours and is great about answering emails. She is incredibly accommodating to student athletes, which is hard to find in a professor. You have to come to this class ready to work, but it's great.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Really nice person to talk to individually. But like many other science teachers, has a lot of stigma against AP courses and students who accept AP credit. Has a lot of clear expectations. As long as you follow her directions, you should be fine. Make sure to do the homework. Tends to take off points for nitpicky things.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She knows her stuff and is clear about her expectations. Creative and engaging labs. Wants you to understand what you're doing. Only qualms (in my opinion) that she picks favorites seems like she either likes you or she doesn't. Appears that students who've taken her in the past receive special treatment, others can be treated coldly. Still good.

She's very straightforward in her expectations and is available for help outside of class. She tries to make the lab fun, but is also gets down to business. She also gets past assignments graded and returned in a timely manner.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable, ready to help you IF YOU ASK, when she grades your labs she puts feedback to let you know where you messed up.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Gives clear instructions, will provide help if you ask, and knows her stuff.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Would not allow me to make up a lab even though I had a family emergency (a funeral) that I had to attend overseas. Acted like I made the whole thing up, and by the time she came around, there were no more flights I could take. She is NOT accommodating in the least and she was unprofessional in how she handled the situation.

Prof. Adams is the best lab professor there is. She knows what she's talking about (she wrote the MANUAL) and she is willing to help students in any way. She does not tolerate foolishness, and freshmen do have the tendency to be foolish. Study well for the quizzes, take the labs seriously, and the lab practical will be *easier* to study for.
Mrs. Adams seems tough the first day of class but she's really the sweetest. She's willing to help and work with you on any homework problems and helps during labs as well.

Very nice teacher who will always help but she is one of the strictest graders I have ever seen. Her lab practicals are difficult and the quizzes themselves are also terrible. Make sure to do the lab reports ahead of time. Out of all the chem lab teachers, she is the best at explaining the material. She even wrote the lab manual!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Pre-labs take a lot of time. Mrs. Adams is fantastic, though. As long as you're trying and putting in effort, she is willing to help you and answer any questions you may have. Don't be afraid to go to office hours and ask questions - she wants to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Adams tells you exactly what she wants from day 1, she even wrote the lab manual herself. Find a way to make all your work in the format she likes, and you'll do great. Always beware of sigfigs! Adams is an amazing lab professor and really wants to help you learn, go to her for questions from lecture and even research opportunities in chemistry!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: First day you have Mrs. Adams she'll scare the death out of you, but she is actually one of the nicest most caring teachers i've met. She asks a lot, but show her that you care by doing well and she will love you. Do the homework and you'll be set for the lab. Her class was CRUCIAL for my success  in the lecture. She is an outstanding professor.

I LOVE Adams! She was by far my favorite professor and I only had her for lab. She is super caring and really wants to help you. She seems tough in lab, but is super nice in office hours. You can go see her to check homework answers or get help with stuff for lecture. She also wrote the lab manual. Lab is work, but thats just the class not her
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: You can't go wrong with any of the chemistry lab professors at SMU. I had her for 1114 and really enjoyed it. The material gets harder and some of the labs take forever to complete but overall it's not too bad. She's always available to help you out and wants to see you succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Adams is a great lab proctor. You will be doing a lot of work, pre-labs and quizzes before every lab, but it will reinforce what you're learning in Gen Chem and teach you how to apply it. All labs are long and draining, but Adams makes them worth it.

Wonderful professor who wants to see each of her students succeed. This is a pretty straightforward class. Pre-lab quizzes are very similar to the homework so make sure to go over it a couple times. Study hard for the final exam lab practical.

She is incredibly willing to help and truly wants her students to succeed. She has taught my lecture section a few times as well and I understood the material perfectly. One of my favorite teachers at SMU so far.

Mrs. Adams may seem to be a strict, unhelpful professor at first. However, she has office hours in which she is willing to help on anything chemistry related, and she is extremely helpful when asking questions in lab. She is a tough grader, but it is not difficult to learn what she expects on her assignments. There is a lot of work involved.

Best teacher I've had. She comes across pretty harsh in class, but will give all the help you need in office hours. She has office hours all the time and will work with you if you can't make it when she's there. She will check your homework completely and make sure you get all the points.

It can get stressful trying to cram finishing up the lab report at the end of the experiment. During lab Ms. Adams might be a bit cranky but during her office hours she's super sweet and very helpful.
SHE IS THE BEST!

Mrs. Adams is a fantastic teacher and lab instructor. Loves chem, fair, available for office hours, nice! Class was hard (not as bad as 2nd semester), quizzes were difficult, but were good prep for tests. Lecture fast paced, but she had prnt out notes on BB. Lab 1114 was really hard (as all chem labs), but she will check your hw during office hours

Good prof for lab (I hear) but horrible for lecture!! She goes very fast during lecture and is then annoyed when she has to go back a slide. Her quizzes are extremely challenging. She does have a lot of office hours but you will have to fight the other hundreds of students  who don't understand to get a spot.

The class overall is easy. Just do the prelabs and homework. If you go to her office hours she'll practically TELL you the answers to the homework. If you do well she likes you. If not, she hates you - and she'll show you she hates you. She can be mean and is always irritable but if you make good grades, you stay on her good side.

She exemplifies every quality I would want in a professor.  She is stern but very clear, knows her stuff and can be extremely helpful but only if you take advantage of things like her office hours.  Really really liked her
Work hard and you will learn tons and get a good grade. Don't wait till the last second to do the preLabs...

If you will do your pre-lab stuff, you will do great in her class.  If you are not planning on putting in the effort needed, she will not like or respect you!  If you ask for help she will help you!  She is great, but i wouldn't cross her!

Professor Adams treats everybody like a child.She is constantly angry and irritated.When people asked her for help she kept repeating the same thing over and over.She likes to talk about how smart she is and uses every chance to brag about herself.I have never seen a worst teacher in my life. Makes Chem lab a torture
She's awesome! SO SO helpful and funny... she's the best general chemistry teacher at SMU

Professor Adams is amazing. She tries to come off strong and mean to scare people but she is one of the best professors here at SMU. She is always willing to donate time to her students and actually cares if you understand the information. Take her class!
Great professor. Go to her office hours and you will do fine.

Really nice- So not mean! I think she is only mean if you dont try. She will check your homework and practically redo it for you if you take advantage of the offer though you do have to do your hw earlier than its due to make that happen. She is willing to help with anything and the people that do badly in her class dont make the effort to do well
Really helpful. will explain everything. will walk you through the homework.

i actually dropped chem with lattman and mrs. adams was my seconds time around. after having her in lab i was worried but she was actually a really great and nice teacher. she explained everything well and did many examples. i def recommend her!!!

Wonderful! Chemistry wasn't exactly one of my favorite subjects and i really didn't want to take it but it was required for my major. She really made me love chemistry and i learned a lot without even realizing it. if all chem professors were like her i would become a chem major! Take her! shes the best by far!

At first seems stern, but actually very nice, very helpful, very fair. Quizzes are from homework, so I redo it right before lab to help me study for it and it works. Ask her or TAs for homework help and do prelab first.

she teacher chem lab In lab shez strict & seems very stern But go to her office hours, she soo nice. Get you homework checked by her, ask her all your questions, and get an easy A! The experiments are fun and exciting. Do all the things she tells you to do before class like hw and the lab report. And be ready for the quiz or else she'll kick u out.
Great Professor!  Made lab fun and interesting.  She is very nice and helpful.  She grades fairly easy and breaks the material down to your understanding.
awesome teacher. Grades very fair and somewhat on the easy side. She is awesome for outside help and she is the nicest teacher i have encountered at SMU

She is such a great teacher.  If you come to class "almost" everyday, you will do fantastic.  She is willing to help you anyway you need, she even gives you her cell phone and tells you to call her late at night if you are having trouble.  She's the teacher that made me interested in Chemistry (Major).
DO EVERYTHING SHE TELLS YOU, PRE-LABS AND HOMEWORK. Make sure you remember what you did on the homework (equations, etc.) cause you'll need it on the quizzes
Very good professor in the lab, always willing to help, short quiz at the begining helps you to know what your doing, easy to make A
No Comments

Lab report, homework due before lab, and quizes before the start of each lab. Adams is always there to help before lab, during her office hours and during the actual lab. Keep up with the material and you'll be fine.

There is usually a quiz everyday but it helps you stay on track. If you take good notes and look at them before class you will do good on her quizzes.  She uses the material on the quizzes on her tests. She is very helpful and good with names.
She doesn't require as much as other professors.
Dr. Norris was an okay professor but his tests were often frustrating and difficult. You just have to study a lot to even have a chance at doing well and his questions are just tricky.

Besides the level up in enthusiasm from Jones' lectures, I found Adam Norris' tests to be much harder due to the near impossible select all that apply questions that are asked. He talks SO FAST so good luck trying to grasp any concept he talks about in lecture. Your best chance at success is to memorize each powerpoint slide word for word.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Dr. Norris' half of the class a lot more than Dr. Jones, as I found him engaging during class and it felt like he cared about us actually understanding the concepts. He is also more approachable and will explain things to you. That being said, no matter how much you study, exams will be very difficult mostly due to select all that apply

Personally, this class was difficult, as the material was on a different caliber than my previous courses. However, I found Dr. Norris to be engaging, and his passion for the material made it significantly easier to pay attention. If you go to class and pay attention, actively taking notes, you will do well. I thought his tests were very doable.

Absolutely mid professor combined with an awful class only breeds sadness. 5 points for a MC question is crazy. (out of 25 questions) Could not care less if you get clapped by the exams. Homework and practice tests are truly useless to the highest degree. I hope you read this Dr. Norris and I hope you reevaluate your career.

Also be prepared to show up to class, even if your in the hospital, he couldn't care less. Not just a bad professor but a genuinely bad person who you have to just get through.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: On the second day of class he sent out an email giving students a guideline of what you can and cannot ask him. His tone throughout it was very passive aggressive and rude. He used phrases like sending him email that had "stupid questions", "travel plans", trying to "receive special treatment because of travel plans", etc. he wouldn't answer AT ALL
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I read his reviews on here before taking the class, and I thought I could handle him. He does not accept any absences, we had 6 grades all worth the same amount of points. He gives art projects and grades them unfairly. We watched movies half the days -- waste of my time. DO NOT TAKE. SWITCH MAJOR/MINOR.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I was very interested in his lectures in which he showed us cool artists. But his TESTS are nightmares- he basically makes you memorize 10 whole dense chapters of information for each exam, so even though I was interested my grade was horrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Worst professor I have had at SMU. He is not fit to be teaching students. Doesn't understand how to behave in a classroom or how to properly instruct students. Doesn't give instructions or grading criteria. He would just tell you to do something without any instruction, then give you an F when it wasn't exactly what he wanted. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: By far the worst professor I've had at SMU. He takes pride in failing students. The 1st  class of the semester he said "1/2 the class will drop after the midterm". Every class you miss, a point is taken off your final grade. He doesn't respond to emails; if you you ask a question be prepared to be to have an email sent to the whole class about you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Only grades three things: two exams and a paper. If you fail one of those things, and you'll most likely fail the mid-term, you might as well drop. Incredibly pretentious and inconsistent. His lectures don't make any sense, I would have learned a lot more if this class were offered online.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He is condescending and pretentious, and he makes it difficult to get help from him outside of class. The only grades in the class are 2 tests and 1 paper. He makes the midterm ridiculously difficult and the final pretty easy. Most of his lectures do not pertain to the material, so you teach yourself  before the tests. I do not recommend his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: one of the greats
I really like him
He's such a sweet teacher and always tries to make class interesting and funny. He cares about his students and wants you to do well. He is always willing to help and so are his TAs.
My favorite teacher from SMU, so understanding. Ochem is overall pretty hard but he teaches it the easiest way possible! I have had him for all lectures and labs and I have no complaints.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Summer ochem with Humason is so chill, he's lowkey mad funny so you're never zoned out during the two hour lectures, doesn't like throwing curveballs on his exam and is probably the only reason im going to med school, goat chem prof
He is super articulate but only in his head. written directions are the worst and most confusing. DONOT

Super sweet and he's so adorable. I wish I could've taken him during fall/spring term so I could connect more, but I can tell you he is easily approachable and so nice. He's not the best at giving lectures, so I spent part of this course figuring out how to teach myself. He had mercy though and curved grades. Just make sure to STUDY the slides!

Dr. Humason is amazing for lab. He's very easy-going and super helpful. Pretty easy to get an A, lab reports aren't full write-ups like gen chem, just the lab worksheet, calculations, and post-lab questions. Lab final is cumulative and the reviews that he posts are helpful.
Dr. Humason was so great. Very nice and not a harsh grader. Always willing to help out with labs and answer any questions you have.

Ended up having to take OChem 2 over again thanks to Dr. Sons teaching methods. Taking it with Humason was a life saver. He doesn't test over exceptions to rules and tries to keep things as strait forward as possible. He isn't trying to trick you and I actually felt like I learned something instead of feeling like a complete failure every test.
The class was straightforward and clear to follow. He's always willing to help you out after class. Really nice and like for his students to do well.

Take him if you can. He actually wants you to learn the material rather than simply memorize reactions and is always available to help with any questions students have. His jokes are also seriously underrated: he's genuinely one of the funniest professors at SMU. Orgo II isn't an easy course by any means, but Dr. Humason actually made it enjoyable.

I don't understand how Dr. Humason has anything less than a 5/5 rating. He is hilarious and cares so much about students, and he is very understanding of any circumstance you may have. He truly does care about your learning rather than the result of your lab. He also is just so fun to talk to outside of class. He's the best - take him.

Dr. Humason is a great professor. He cares more about students learning for the sake of learning rather than studying to get an A, which makes lab much more interesting and less stressful. Also, his office hours are the best. He'll go over any concepts you're confused on and explains them in a straightforward manner. Take him if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Humason is so helpful!! The class is meant for you to apply what you learned in lectures and get a good grade. As long as you complete the labs, youll get a good grade. He is super understanding and Im so happy I had him as my lab professor!!

Dr. Humason is the first professor I've had (in my major at least) that goes above and beyond. He's pretty much my STEM grandpa, not to be dramatic or anyrhing. Talk to this man outside of class!! He's funny, and will help you with anything he can (he literally helped me run my own experiments outside of class, and they had nothing to do with orgo)

The labs take forever but he will walk you through or do the difficult steps for you. You don't have to be very accurate either, he's an easy grader. Dr. Humason is very talkative and easy to get along with and he tries to make labs funs. He also teaches Ochem lecture in the summer and everyone usually retakes it then and gets A's.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Humason really cares about his students. This class is not an easy one but if you take it with him it will be much more enjoyable. As long as you hold yourself accountable when learning the concepts the exams are difficult but straight forward. This course demands many hours spent studying. Take over June/July!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Humason is a fun guy and makes Ochem lab much more enjoyable than the gen chem labs. A refreshing change of pace as far as lab work goes. He is very easy to reach outside of class if you have issues or questions. My only critique is the lab book is a piece of junk and he or the department needs to ditch it for a new one.
Best Lab Professor ever! Such a kind and nice person, really empathizes his students and actually cares for them. TAKE HIM!!!

He has been so understanding and kind, especially during Covid. Many students could not come in-person this semester so he made videos going through experiments and provided many opportunities for office hours!

I hated o chem lecture but the lab was great! If i needed help in the lecture, Prof. Humason was always down to help explain things better. I probably couldn't have made it through the lecture without his help honestly. Also, the o chem labs are very straight forward for the spring. Pay attention and you'll be fine

The pre-lab quizzes are very straight forward, so that was nice. The labs are actually interesting and he's very helpful if you get stuck somewhere in the process. Also, he always joking which makes the class more fun than others lol

Professor Humason was GREAT for ochem! I had to retake the class in the summer and he made it so much more bearable (and actually fun). He tells good jokes throughout class which makes the space more personable, and he's always down to help outside of class. Definitely would recommend taking him.

Unorganized, even admitted to not knowing the material/studying it himself the day before lecture. Explanations were generally given as "If I read that before, I wouldn't have assigned it." Examples in class were at the end of the lecture material but were essentially him doing the problem as fast as he can to prove to us he can do it.

Amazing guy. He's very helpful during labs (will help you whenever you ask and will give you answers sometimes too). He can also help if yo have questions about lecture. He also loves to talk and has lots of cool stories.
Great lab professor, you can ask him questions and he'll really help you out, very helpful during the lab, and you can ask him questions about lecture and he can help you with those too.

Dr. Humason is a great professor. There's really no way to make Organic Chemistry easy or fun but he tries his best to do both. He is very accessible outside of class and works with students to ensure they succeed as best he can. He is a very nice guy and tries to make Organic Chemistry as enjoyable as possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Organic Chemistry is one of the hardest classes one can take, but Dr. Humason made it much more enjoyable and honestly, less stressful. If you receive a bad grade, its because its organic chemistry, and its HARD. Go to class, keep up with the homework problems he recommends, and make flashcards. Study it a little every day and its very manageable.
Really good guy who cares about his students. Is willing to help you with your grade in almost any situation, and makes organic chemistry lab a doable and even fun class.

Dr. Humason is a GREAT guy! Make sure to read up on the labs before you go in and that you do the labs as well as you can so you can cushion your grade for the practical (average is an 80). He is an overall quirky guy and a huge help when you want it.

1255.5/1350  A. Read the prelabs and key notes in labs to do well on quizzes. Double check lab reports before turning in labs. Do well on both. Practical is harder. Class average was a 80. Grading is chill. Only thing is had a 92.9. didn't round up to 93.0 :/ Great & hilarious dude!

I would 10/10 recommend taking his class during the summer. He tries to make the class as manageable as possible and gives out a lot of practice tests. Organic Chemistry is a lot worse during the school year, so do yourself a favor and take it over the summer with Humason. Great lab teacher too.

Love Dr. H!!!! This is what a college lab should be like. Hes super chill and is always willing to go above and beyond to answer questions or help with an experiment. Quizzes and lab assignments are straight to the point and dont take long. Spend some time getting to know him and you wont regret it. Truly a gem in the chemistry department.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Humason is the best lab instructor I've ever had. He's so kind and helpful during the labs. The grading is fair, and the labs aren't too stressful. The lab final can be tricky, but it shouldn't hurt you too bad if you've done well for the rest of the course. He also just got his PhD this semester!

Mr. H is absolutely awesome. Just do the pre-lab assignments and the quizzes and labs are easy and fun to do. Plan on doing well throughout the semester because the practical can definitely drop your grade at the end if you're not careful.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Mr. Humason is an outstanding lab instructor. The lab reports are graded fairly as long as you show your math for every calculation. He is very helpful during the lab, which can ease frustration when a reaction isn't going as planned. The lab is enjoyable and not too stressful, which is a blessing when compared to the General Chemistry labs.
Excellent teacher, Humason goes out of his way to ensure the class is engaged and entertained. The course is difficult, but he teaches it well and is always available outside of class.
Prof. Humason has a wonderful sense of humor, really trying to make a heavy subject lighter. Quizzes every class and lab reports due. Easy A if you complete all of that and do good on the lab final.

Mr. Humason is a good lab instructor. However, he is not a good lecturer. He is available for office hours, but when you go in he talks too much about his personal life and instead of spending 10 minutes on getting help, you leave after 30-40 minutes with your question barely answered.I would say you have to teach yourself the material.

Humason is the best lab instructor ever. He is very helpful and will explain things again if you don’t get it the first time. He can also tell you really cool stories when you ask questions. Lab quiz questions are based on the pre-labs you are supposed to do (almost or exactly word for word). The experiments you do are fun, which is an added bonus.

He taught the summer O Chem I class and it could've been hell, but he makes the class fun and easier than it could be. He's completely available whenever you need help. *One of the best professors at SMU*
One of the best professors at SMU. Really cares about helping students to learn the material and goes above and beyond to make sense of even the most confusing problems to students

Prof Humason is SO sweet! Lab would really SUCK if he wasn't so great. He's always there to help and has a sense of humor. His TA's though, should really get a life and stop grading like they're looking for mistakes. All in all though, he's pretty much amazing!

Amazing professor!  He makes O Chem interesting.  He is pretty lenient on grading which makes it easier to learn because you are not deathly worried about your grade all the time.  He is very humorous which keeps class exciting, and is able to explain things very well.  You should definately take him!
No Comments

Dr. Cortes is amazing if you just want to get through Calculus! If you want to actually learn material, I would advise taking someone else. His tests aren't hard and he gives study guides that are basically identical to the tests. He also has lab projects that are easy to do. He brings his dinosaurs to class, which always made my mornings!
Greatest Of All Time.
