I don't know how she got a job as a lecture teacher because she mumbles and just reads right off of her presentation notes. She doesn't actually teach us anything and nobody goes to class because it is so pathetic. She has a strong accent so it is also very hard to understand what she is saying.

This professor has a very bad teaching style. Rather than lecturing and providing useful information, she reads directly off of slides posted online, making it pointless to attend class. In addition to meaningless class there is a difficult language barrier as there is often miscommunication and misunderstanding between the teacher and class.
Aaaawwwwwfffuuuuulllll.  Horrible at teaching probably not a bad guy? Don't take.

Dr. Sadler truly cares that you understand the material. The course is tough, so study regularly if you want an A+. The TAs grade strictly, but stats is more about using precise language and making good estimates than always having the exact answer.  It's a tough class, but you can get an A in it!

One of the worst class experiences I have ever had. Dr. Sadler is kind, he clearly cares, and he is passionate about his work. None of that, however, is a substitute for competence. He has a total lack of understanding of demands of the work that he assigns. Endless, tedious, difficult busywork outside of class, useless lectures during class.
Lots of work (!!!!) but youll learn a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the best professor I ever had. He is great, knowledgeable and kind.

I cannot ask for a better, kinder, more relatable, funnier, and generally nicer professor. I will not forget him as long as I live because he has totally changed who I am by being passionate about helping students, sparking interests in students, and making students understand that the class is much more than a grade. Please, say thank you for me!!

Professor Sadler is an amazing professor. He makes the homework relevant instead of busy work. He'll help you do whatever you need from concepts he went over in class to other stats fields you are interested. He'll also try (and most likely succeed) to make you choose a career path in the data science field.

Professor Sadler is the best professor I have ever had at SMU!! Loves statistics and really wants his class to not only score well in the class, but to actually understand stats. Extremely nice and funny guy and he is always willing to help you out. His passion for stats really shows and it makes you want to come to class. Absolutely take him!

I am typically an A student, but I honestly underestimated this class. The multiple choice was hard and weighs a lot. I recommend actually going to Professor Sadler's office and truly understanding the concepts RATHER than just memorizing formulas. Good news: final replaces lowest test grade. Honestly though, I didn't put in effort until the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: At the beginning of the semester, I was confident that I would EASILY make an A but I completely underestimated the materials. Make sure you UNDERSTAND the materials; you can make a 100 on the quizzes but a few of your answers may actually be wrong. There is a group project but that boosts your final grade, the final also helped with my grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Sadler is one of the best professors I have had at SMU. His passion for statistics is evident, and he goes out of his way to help his students succeed. He provides numerous opportunities for extra credit and is always available to help. I would definitely take his class again, and I highly recommend it.

I enjoyed this class. My own interest in the subject increased a lot as this course progressed. Prof Sadler was a very engaging and clear lecturer, which was especially helpful in an early morning class. I definitely liked gaining familiarity with "R".

Prof Bivin is simply amazing. He is by far the BEST instructor I have ever been in a live class. His knowledge in Stats, and illustration techniques second to none. His commitment and availability off hours has been amazing and inspirational. Everyone on the offline message boards were so much impressed about his style and knowledge. Whamo!

Bivin was good at teaching Stats but my one complaint was that he explained things very quickly in class. But overall, he conveyed the subject well and it wasn't hard to learn. Tests are fairly hard, especially the second but it is easy to get everything down for the final. The final replaces your lowest test grade and is the easiest of the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Bivin is a really good professor, he has very nice communication skills, goes above and beyond to explain the subject. He is very funny and inculcates a sense of community in the class. You have to be ready for lots of study though.
Bivin makes you work for your grade, but is very willing to help if you need it.

I've had 4 statistics classes and every single one, I've felt like I had to teach it to myself. This was the first time where I could trust the professor and actually go to class and be taught the material. Bivin is such a bro. Such an awesome guy who knows his stuff. He doesn't look at himself as a professor but a student himself, as we all are!

Great teacher! Very passionate about statistics, obviously loves teaching and wants his students to succeed.  He's kinda quirky but in a funny way.  I didn't think I'd like stats, but after his class I'm considering pursuing it as a second major.  Attendance is part of your grade, perfect attendance adds a point on your final average.

Sadler is a really passionate teacher- he gives his all every single day in class and will spend whatever time it takes to help a student grasp a concept outside of class. He is a little quirky and can be all over the place but it doesn't inhibit him from getting his point across. Lowest test grade replaced with final, so lots of chances to succeed

Although the class is disorganized and much of the information on the homework has to be self-taught, Bivin has a passion for the subject that most statistics professors lack. He's highly interactive, always approachable, and practically mandates for the class to understand the concepts rather than score well on tests. Highly recommend.

Bivin rocks! He is so nice, has a great attitude and is awesome in class. He DOES give HW in the form of a quiz (on BlackBoard) after every class! But they are not bad and this is how you learn the material. He is very disorganized and class can be hecticstressful, but he will work with you and if you get to know him he will look out for you 100%.

Hands down my favorite SMU professor. If you can take him do It even if its an elective; you'll learn a lot and he makes STATS really interesting; no previous high math knowledge in order to pass the class. Just show up to class every day because there are quizzes due almost every class (super helpful quizes) but if you practice you'll pass it 100%

Take this class! Professor Sadler is awesome! I was not excited about math, but he made this class fun and easy to learn. Do the homework it will help a lot! He is very interesting and always is excited about class!
Handsome and smart. His class is very interactive which makes it easier to understand. I highly recomend him.

This course is such a joke. The whole course is nothing but ai on the discussions and tests and she either didn't know it or doesn't care. While easy, it inspires the worst out of us so even if I wanted to learn the topics, when it's clear no one else is to do well, why should I. A joke and waste of time.

Dr. Lopez does a great job teaching, and this class is very easy. There are lots of books to get for this class, but you barely even read them, so don't let it scare you. ALL tests are taken home, and the only in-class quizzes are map quizzes like from middle school. Homework is just to submit a few sentence comment once a week.

reviews.comment: Unorganized, even admitted to not knowing the material/studying it himself the day before lecture.
Cool instructor who seems passionate about her students. Easy to talk to and very accessible. Made subjects interesting. Would take another class of hers.

She will straight up lie to your face. She told me how great my work was compared to one I got around a B on then proceeded to give me a lower score on the same work she said was better. I seriously think this woman is a know it all who I disproved on a handful of occasions by doing a simple google search. She is very opinionated, rude. Avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: A total snoozefest and is rude to students who ask questions, also very unavailable and doesn't return emails.

Overall an amazing professor. Her lectures are a bit long and boring, but it is such an easy way to fulfill a CC. She is super understanding, make sure to build a relationship with her and she will help you with assignments. She is so sweet!
She is a very nice lady, a bit unorganized. Overall, very fun class! Got to make a sword!

Literally the nicest professor you will ever have. Very understanding when it comes to late work and super helpful if you go to office hours. Lectures are clear and pretty interesting. Goes on a lot of tangents, but she really knows her stuff so they're always interesting. Would take again for sure.

I had her for a problems in European History class. She has very clear and reasonable expectations and is a fair grader. We had great discussions but always covered what we needed.

reviews.comment: Mary Blackburn is the best professor that I've had at SMU. Great teacher, brilliant person.
Thumbs up
Values input
She's the only professor here I would consistently take.

She's probably the smartest professor in SMU's art department and puts extreme time and care in her lectures. She meets on her own time and give studio visits regularly. There's no way to fake your way through her class. You grade yourself in the end, but she won't give you a grade you seriously don't deserve.

Mary Blackburn is not the kind of professor who values your input. She rules the class with her vague and pretentious ideologies and will not accept or respect your opinions should they differ with her own. DO NOT TAKE.

MWB is a great professor. Though confusing at times, she is always willing to help. Her class is definitely challenging; however, it is rewarding and you will get a lot out of it if you are attentive and if you participate. She is a walking encyclopedia and will dish out relevant information to any piece you create.

Having the opportunity to work with and learn from Mary has had an enormously positive impact on my experience at Southern Methodist University. Her encyclopedic knowledge of the field has prepared me for the future in ways that not many others would be capable of. She's an extremely interesting person with strong convictions and great stories.
I believe that i have not had a professor at this university that better understood or provided guidance through the development of my artistic practice. Truly a great advisor and mentor
Her assignments were ridiculous, and she makes you go to the DMA every week
Bad experience.

Always late to class and lectures are sometimes confusing, but if you really understand all the labs / actually do the homework assignments you will do fine. You really don't cover a ton of material - gets pretty repetitive so if you follow along you should be fine. Not lenient with late homework and homework graded difficulty for accuracy.

He will take off a ridiculous number of points for one tiny mistake. DO NOT TAKE him if you care about learning because he is always 5-10 minutes late to class and rushes through the lecture for everyone to do awful on the homework because he is such an intense grader.
Does not respect you if you do not respect him. Notes are kind of hard to take Mandatory class and no computers allowed. He did make the class more difficult.
Professor Bozorth does a great job lecturing his classes! He is extremely accessible during office hours and is passionate about the course material. I would highly recommend taking him.

reviews.comment: NOT a nice person or as he trys to be, did not help us learn and is constantly unavailable.

This is the worst professor I have had at this school by a long shot. Does not help us learn and is constantly unavailable. On top of that has an attitude and is sarcastic with students specifically those of us who are premed who have other more important courses to spend our time on. AVOID.

Professor Bozorth is the greatest professor at SMU. He cares deeply about his students inside and outside of class. He makes learning enjoyable and passionate. There are so many wonderful things about him, and I would HIGHLY suggest taking a class with him. He's there for all of you. If you want to learn in a safe environment he's the one!
I love poetry and Bozorth showed me how to appreciate it better through his class. He is funny. Really fortunate to have him.
Great professor. Lectures were always engaging and clear. Grading on papers was very fair. Really have nothing negative to say about Professor Bozorth.

You can tell that Professor Bozorth cares about his students. That being said, his grading is not clear. He wants you to write about what he believes, but when you figure this out he says not to worry about what he wants. Office hours often left me more confused. Feeback leading up to papers only for him to comment on an issue he hadn't mentioned.

Dr. Bozorth is very laid back and creates a non-threatening learning environment. Poetry will feel relevant to your life, and there are enough assignments that you don't need to worry about your grade. Very good about helping you know *how* to think about poems. He genuinely wants students to succeed and enjoy his class.

literally the worst DISC prof. He would never let you have another opinion on a piece of literature if it was not his own. reviews.comment: Bozorth is actually the coolest and I love him
Bozorth is the best! So flexible and understanding and a very intelligent man! I've taken two classes with him and he is one of my favorites!

I really enjoy professor Bozorths class, there are a lot of readings 9 books to be exact, you will have 4 short papers 20%, 2 long papers 20% each, in class leading discussion 20% and an in class final 20%. He is a tough grader but he gives amazing lecture. He is also available outside class time

reviews.comment: He is an awesome teacher and great at lectures/discussions. This is by far my favorite class, as he speaks from experience and profound knowledge on the subject. He is very honest and a no BS guy which I really like. He also picks really good books to read.

reviews.comment: Not easy, but he was very helpful and made poetry enjoyable

Professor Bozorth has been an amazing professor. He helps you as much as you ask, I spent hours getting help from him. He notices when you're engaged and really tries to make the class as enjoyable as possible, which with him it always is.

He's an incredible professor, and one of the few I still keep in touch with. He is the prof who actually made me decide not to drop my English major! His class was tough at times, but he was helpful and his lectures really made the material more clear. There was a lot of reading, and he liked when you spoke in class. Take him before you graduate!!!
Excellent and passionate teacher. Extremely helpful with assignments. Grades fairly and offers good suggestions for improvement.

My most difficult class of the semester, but also my most enjoyable. The class discussions are engaging, and the paper assignments are fair and engaging. Bozorth is a fantastic professor, and I will take a class with him again.
Love his class.
OMG what a great professor. He made each class a pleasure; his enthusiasm for the subject matter was contagious. Very refreshing and not hard on the eyes!!!

He is really interested in the subject, which helps get you interested in it as well.  He is knowledgable about the material, but does get upset if the class is not prepared to talk about the readings.
Gay Lit class was enlightening. Reading and discussions were very interesting.  Dr. Bozorth is an excellent teacher.  Would take any class he teaches.
No Comments

Pretty hard. I remember he didn't like it when people didn't speak up in class, usually because class didnt read assignment. he kicked the whole class out once. but very good teacher. i had him for both gay lit and poetry..and Yes he is pretty darn cute!!
No Comments
Sooo hot.  But aside from that, his class was amazing.  I actually wanted to do all the reading assignments.
My favorite professor from SMU.  He is one of the few professors I still keep in touch with.  His classes always spurred my interest.
I also took Poetry with him, and Bozorth is one of my favorites at SMU. He has a reputation as a hard grader, but he is fair and expects students to do the work. Awesome instructor.
Everyone should take his gay lit class! He will help you to understand gender in a different way. You will never want to miss a class.
The worst. Uselsss.

James Bottom is the best business professor. He is constantly giving you business advice that you will actually use outside of college. He is super accessible and you really walk away knowing what it looks like to start your own company. There are no tests, you just work on one big group project for the whole semester.

James was an awesome professor who puts in real effort to make his lectures comparable to the real world. Real examples of how to apply what you learn to life. He does a great job at making the lectures feel more personal rather than just reading off a presentation. Take this class if you are business student, you get out what you put in this class
Attendance is not mandatory. Great class if you want to launch a startup or need credits.
Super nice guy. If you need hours this is a great way to get it. Attendance isn't mandatory so come as you wish.

Learned very little in this class. Was disappointed by the absence of any grades until the final grade posted in my.smu. Most assignments did not make sense and were not logical or useful to starting your own business. No need to go to class.

Absolutely awful class. Overwhelming number of assignments he fails to grade throughout the semester, and so will just assign a random grade when he's rushing everything in at the course's finish. Do not take- a true waste of time I wish I could turn back the clock and do something actually meaningful.

this guy is an absolute joke. as stated by other posters, man has a bloated ego and talks about himself the whole lecture. 

even if you put in the work (which is an insane amount), grades are arbitrarily distributed at the end because he doesn't have time to actually look through the stuff you did. DO NOT TAKE!!

Lots of assignments throughout the semester, yet he does not answer a single question via email, canvas or text ever lol... His lectures were unbearable and not relevant to the final proejct which is your entire grade. The only upside is the lows ended up being like 86-90 on every assignment even for teams that messed up the entire thing.... idk

sucks bottom. teaches because he doesnt know how to do. he does not show you/teach you how to do any of the heavily graded assignemnts and just says stuff like "im gonna bring in mark cuban" and then doesnt. all talk and huge ego bc he played football at USC. it is half way through finals week and everyone's grade shows NA or --

reviews.comment: Does not grade any assignments and comically egotistical. I would rather listen to nails on a chalkboard for two hours than his rambling lectures. Avoid.
Avoid his class. Did not learn a thing and he doesn't grade anything.

Pick a good group! Your group project is your entire grade. You never know how you're doing in the class because he doesn't give any feedback. Class lectures weren't relevant to the project assignments. When you ask to meet with prof he just rambles about something he wants to talk about and isn't helpful. Don't recommend this class.

The entire class is a group project, so pray your group is decent. Also, the teacher is bad at giving feedback so you don't know what your grade is until too late and he seems very biased in his grading. He spends the entire lecture ranting about random stuff and does not explain the assignments until the last possible minute. DO NOT TAKE!!!

reviews.comment: The whole course is based around the end of the year project, with each part being turned in slowly over the semester. This would be easy, but Bottom never graded or gave feedback on a single thing until the end.

Avoid at all costs. Your grade is predominately based on whether or not he likes you, there are no objective grading criteria. Also didn't give back any grades until finals week. Barely learned anything all semester.

Very knowledgeable professor, but, there is a lot of ambiguity when it comes to assignments and he doesn't post grades. He is more than willing to meet with you if you have questions outside of class, but overall it's a heavy workload and not knowing where you stand in terms of grades is stressful. Pick your group wisely!

He's really nice and super easy grader compared to the rest of the department but kind of boring and doesn't offer alternates to doing the same thing every day. A couple of essays, one final, and quizzes that you don't have to read for (easy answers or chat summaries work well).

For honors I was expecting way harder grading but he's really chill. Go to office hours if you are ever struggling the guy wants u to do well. Lots of reading (lowk can skim or chat) for the weekly quizzes. Other than the reading there was not too much work and he loves what he is teaching

He is v easy but he is v boring, tries to hard to be a people pleaser so each class he's changing things based on different opinions then acts like you shouldn't be confused, also acts like he wants you to think for yourself but make u feel wrong if u don't agree, likes the a kissers

Professor Bolger is a breathe of fresh air! Class is very interactive and he is very passionate about what he does. Content is very interesting and engaging. There is a decent amount of reading and pop quizzes but they are very easy.

reviews.comment: Hes a book smart guy and easy grader, which is appreciated and I also like that 80% of your grade is papers and witting unlike other classes. My main complaint is no directions are really explained and you spend all semester hoping he comes through with the grades. He did but still stressful. No reading necessary but attendance is mandatory.

Smart professor who genuinely encourages students to think for themselves. The class is structured around in-class activities and discussions rather than just textbook lectures. The readings can be challenging, but they're manageable and push you to think critically.

Super monotonous, doesn't seem to be too receptive to ideas different than his own. It's an honors class so that's why you have to read a lot but out of the teachers they have he by far the easiest. Just do what he want, says and agree with anything he says. Grades evereyone who does this with an A. Low quality prof, easy A if that's what you want

Don't even try to ask questions even in office hours as he will be extremely rude for you simply wanting to understand. Wally knows a lot about RE Finance, no doubt. He will make you feel stupid if you ask a question. His lectures are hard to follow because they are super technical and the subject matter is very complex. The midterm was the hardest test I have ever taken, and the final project took me around 48 hours.

This class is so difficult, do not take it as an elective. If you are going to work in real estate, it is a must, but if not, stay away. Wally is a nice guy and he's SUPER knowledgable, but he expects you to know way more than you do. The midterm was the hardest test I've ever seen. You will be forced to learn, but do not expect a cake walk.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Boring class. Confusing lectures. Attendance not mandatory. Teaches nothing in class and then expects so much on exams and take home projects. Absolutely hated the class.
Great Prof! She is super understanding and if you do what is asked it is not bad at all! Take Her!
Prof. Bogard is great! Her class is super easy, just show up, pay attention and you will be fine. Homework can be a lot at times but shes great! 10/10 recommend!
Professor Bogard is a great Spanish professor who cares about her students. She is always available for feedback and explains things very well.

Just wow! took her for Jan Term online spanish and I could not be more pleased with my decision. Seriously, take her and get your second language requirement out of the way. If you don't make an A it's because you didn't want one. Easy grader, helpful, nice, accessible. MUY BUENA!

best professor for spanish at smu -- there is a lot of homework (mostly vhl) but that is with every spanish course. makes learning spanish genuinely fun and helps each student understand the language well. so hilarious and definitely recommend her to everyone
Very good at actually teaching Spanish, reasonable and understanding, but the course is difficult with lots of work.

Prof Bogard is a great professor if you truly want to learn how to speak Spanish. She is very patient and is willing to work with you outside of class. If you are looking for the easy-A class, she probably isn't the best option. Overall, would recommend her class, just be ready to work for your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Bogard is exactly what a language professor should strive to be like. She's kind, reasonable, and shows a genuine interest in us learning and succeeding in Spanish. As long as you pay attention in class, you will almost certainly do fine. The one drawback to her class is the daily homework, but as long as you stay ahead you'll be fine!

Professor Bogard is an awesome teacher! She cares deeply about the success of her students and truthfully loves the language. She is available outside of class, super engaging during her lectures, and has a wide knowledge of the subject. Highly recommend her to anyone trying to get their Spanish credit completed.

If you want to learn the language, take her! If you just need the class for credit, feel free to look for other professors. 
She is very dedicated to her job and puts in 100% effort to make her students learn and understand the language. Homework is everyday and multiple writings and discussions.
She gives partial credit and second chances.

I love Profesora Bogard! This was my first ever Spanish class and I was worried about learning the language but she makes it so easy! She even inspired me to minor in Spanish because I loved her class so much. Very fair grader and great at answering questions. If I could take her for every Spanish class I would!

Professor Bogard is the best, most caring teacher I have had throughout college and as a senior, I can say this with full confidence. She genuinely cares so much about her students and is so helpful with anything you need, whether it is in or outside of class. I cannot recommend her highly enough! Funny, relatable, caring, kind, smart, the BEST!!

Profesora Bogard is one of my favorite professors at SMU! This was my first experience with spanish and she makes it as easy as possible, clear, and fun. There is a lot of nightly homework and you have to stay on top of the deadlines in order to get a good grade. Shes super sweet and fun and cares about each students success.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Assigns a LOT of homework regularly. She is very accessible outside of class and genuinely wants her students to learn. Very tough grader on participation, expects you to contribute multiple times throughout class and come very prepared. Tests cover a lot of material but aren't that hard though as long as you study/keep up with course work.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: No, this class is not a walk in the park. However, it is manageable. At the beginning of the year, you can expect lots of homework. 1-3 hours per night. Later in the semester, it gets easier. There are ways around doing all the homework. The tests are subjectively easy. Sarah Bogard is a fair, passionate teacher. I would recommend for 2401.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You will learn a lot in this class, but she makes you work for your grade. There is a lot of busy work for homework. She's pretty funny and approachable. Not an easy A language class. I would take her if you want to become better at Spanish.

Assigns a lot of work, but very invested in her students' success. She pushes you, but she will do everything she can to make sure you succeed. Accessible out of class, will review tests with you, and answers emails promptly. Helps a lot with conversational Spanish as well
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Lots of busy work, but I found that I learned a lot without even realising it. Lots of talking in class, so you'll get plenty of practice. A ton of homework
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professora Bogard was one of the most helpful professors I've had. Her expectations are very clear and she teaches directly from the textbook. There is a considerable amount of "busy work," but as the semester progressed I realized this is why my knowledge of Spanish increased. All of her assigned work is helpful and she is very willing to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: By far one of the best professors I have ever had. She really does care about her students and prioritizes us learning the material over anything. She is extremely understanding and her grading is straight forward. She is the reason I decided to minor in Spanish. If you do your work and participate in class, you will get an A. Take her if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Bogard is very nice and understanding esp. if Spanish is not you're strong suite. There are conversations with her for a grade. She let me do mine over & come in to practice, because I was nervous. You must read & do the online work! It creeps up on you. You have to work for your grade, but even struggling students can get a B+. Speaks only in Span

if you are given the chance do not take her! her grading is unclear and will give you a super low participation even if you participate in class everyday/ do your homework. lots of VHL and long packets that are just busy work. she will assign long assignments the night before they are due, even if they aren't on the syllabus. avoid her

Prof. Bogard is by far one of the worst teachers I have ever had. She is very rude to her students when she is asked a question and is not much help at all. She will assign lengthy assignments the day before they are due that weren't mentioned in the syllabus. I love Spanish but I loathed going to her class. She does not make Spanish fun.

I took this Spanish class in her first semester here. She is very intense. She also makes rude and sly comments about her students that are completely aside from their Spanish ability. Overall not very nice and she accuses her students of cheating when they do not. Very condescending when she doesn't have much going for herself. Do not take.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Sarah is a real gem at SMU. My review comes in her first semester and I think she's one of the nicest and most caring faculty members I've met so far. She can seem a bit intense with the subject and homework can be a bit much, but she's a great lecturer and the class is always active. The class was daily, but I didn't mind it because of her help.
A bad teacher and unorganized.

Took his course for the study abroad session in Oxford. I really enjoyed the content in class and the out of class readings were long but stimulating. 

Very kind professor and very willing to work with you, lenient essay grader and gives mostly positive and helpful feedback.

Very knowledgeable and passionate, I recommend his class
Spent most of class roasting students and the rest blaming us for not learning. Genuinely shocked this person gets paid to teach.

Good class to take if you're interested in applying for grants or fellowships. Class can sometimes focus too much on one type of grant, but he's available outside of class/willing to shift focus based on what the majority of students are aimed towards. Assignments are straightforward and he's not a harsh grader at all.

There's a fine line between being personable and overstepping boundaries, and unfortunately, that line was often blurred in this class. Some interactions felt uncomfortably performative and unnecessarily hierarchical. It created a dynamic that discouraged open dialogue and made some students visibly uncomfortable.

Took him for the UHP class on applying to different fellowships and grad schools. Easy class, met 1 hr per week, & you get an A on everything as long as you turn it in, and counts for honors credit if you need that. Also very insightful on preparing for applications postgrad and he gave great feedback on everything we submitted. Take this class!
Teaching is not his calling, horribly boring, ineffective, useless course and material, very biased in his views too.

He's boring and everyone knows this but the worst part if you won't be inspired to learn because he is so incompetent everyone is gpting their way through the course so why work when no one else is. Want a course you can AI your way through? He's the one.

HIST 3341. Two written exams that he gives examples for in advance and two 1500 word essays. The readings can get heavy but do them and you'll be fine for everything else. Exams and papers are fairly graded. For history majors, an easy and interesting class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dont take this professor. He is a horribly disrespectful person, cannot take ANY criticism without getting defensive, and will make students wait over an hour to meet with him. Some of us are premed and are taking the course for credit not to become historians and someone should tell him that. history courses ain't that serious bruh.
Awful.

Will make you search for irrelevant information while being a  hard grader for basically a class to get a requirement. He is also completely oblivious to the fact that no one is engaged by the topics he focuses on and he seems to not know what he is talking about even on those topics he selects. He is also rude to students who ask questions.

There are easier courses to take to fill your History req. Miller assigns 300 pages of reading per week some weeks, is spectacularly vague in lectures, and the course is much more time-consuming than it rightfully should be. Recommendation, take something else.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Class consisted of 2-1500 word papers on the readings, one of them could be re-written at the end of the semester, he gives good feedback on both. a mid-term and a final with 2 essay questions that he gives you before hand. lectures can be dry but he lets you have your computers. allows 4 absences per semester. assigns a lot of reading

Very knowledgable and enthusiastic about the subject, so he is absolutely willing to help and answer questions as long as you ask. No tests, but there is a final paper at the end he is glad to help with at any stage of the writing process. He checks a reading journal through the semester -- the reading selections can be long so don't put it off.
Loved his class so much that I'm taking him again in the spring. He's really knowledgeable and enthusiastic about the subject, which makes class extremely interesting.
Great professor! Took his class about WW1 for my history pillar. It was a interesting class and I really liked it. Really trying to take his WW2 class before I graduate.
Very helpful. Knowledgable on the subject matter. Grades easily as long as you know the material. Classes are interesting, and you can tell he cares about the material.
SO BORING!!! strict attendance policy. Not a super hard grader but still. Docks 5 % points off your grade for each class missed after 3 classes. Kind of ruined the subject matter for me.
Literally love her, easy A and just so sweet. Could not say enough good things.

Really sweet teacher and genuinely loves what she does and loves her students. She is very chill and so understanding with everything we do. Not a stressful class whatsoever, while still learning a lot. Some of the things we learn/read are a little weird and disturbing which can make it more complicated to follow along.

SUPER nice, kind and caring. She is a funny and extroverted person and loves her job. She screens a lot of films and documentaries which makes the class fun and easier to understand concepts. Her work is mostly discussion boards, but they are fun and unique activities that do not take time or hassle. She is such a kind professor and funny. Take her
TAKE HER CLASS!! She is so easy-going and compromises with students' ideas and opinions. She really cares about us and cares that we are successful after college. SO KIND SO FUNNY!

Learned literally nothing and every class is spent watching art/design videos and documentaries. Barely any homework besides an occasional short reading or "assignment" that takes like 5 mins. She's super sweet and chill, but almost too much- there is zero structure. If you want an easy class, this is it

I'm pretty sure Buchwald wont last at Cox. He's honestly on a power trip and just does not respect students or care that we learn. His quizzes are unecessarily tough, he seems to grade presentations based on vibes, and he ZOOMS through his lectures leaving no space for questions. Avoid him at all costs (although Cox will probably fire him soon)!

I don't know how this man is employed by SMU, let alone teaching a capstone class. Intentionally makes the quizzes difficult so students have a "sense of the real world" and what it is like to take your chances. He also has no lesson plan yet expects you to recall information.

this is genuinely the worst class ever. do not take. if you want to argue with him for 50 mins why 75% of the class missed the question then go ahead. he is unreasonable and thinks it is funny to watch kids be tense and stressed because this is the "real world". aims the average for the quiz to be a 50-60%. Avoid at all costs.

I have loved all my Cox professors, but they dropped the ball with hiring Jon. Definitely had real-world success, but is extremely rude, condescending, and does not take criticism at all. The class feels like it was made up on the fly, and Jon will shut down any sort of critique on his logic rather than welcoming a discussion.

I'm sure this professor has found success in the real world (and that's great) but it does not apply to the teaching world. The biggest issue is the lack of compassion, understanding, and dialogue. He will shut down any conversation where he has a chance of being wrong and will defend himself vehemently with no room for negotiation.

Don't know what the hiring process at SMU is like, but it must be incredibly amateur if this guy got a job as a capstone class professor. Success in the real world does not equate to an ability to teach effectively, and that becomes quite obvious with Jon Buchwald. Professor evaluations will be quite the wake-up call for the department.

Should not be a teacher. He does not know what he is teaching, and quizzes are extremely ambiguous and opinion-based. Threatened to publicly hurt and shame any student who attempts to cheat-- highly inappropriate. Not a good person and I have not learned one thing from this class. Does not know how to use Canvas or grade anything.
Truly terrible, will give quizzes to students that have "a best answer" even if all of them are correct. Extremely ambigious quizzes.
Horrible in every way. Worst at the university.
He is a pragmatic researcher. He researches carbapenem antibiotics. He has in-depth knowledge of organic synthesis.

Really smart kinda funny old guy. He dosent update grades regularly so you never totally know your grade. He does grade easy though. His class is very applicable to the real world and he makes sure you really understand the fundamentals.

Honestly a really great professor, not sure why so many bad reviews. This is the 2nd class I've taken with him. Effort goes a long way in his classes and if you're genuinely trying you will be rewarded. Classes are usually only a few students so he gives free points for just coming to class. Exams are difficult but he grades easyish. You wont fail.

Is a lot of history behind drug development rather than strictly chemistry. I am not that great at chem and have loved this class. Professor is older but is nice/funny. 2 tests, long paper, and a presentation. Hw due dates aren't strict, just have it done by end of semester. He does use a lot of videos to teach and his focus is clearly on his lab.
Buynak is the worst professor. He refuses to give reference letters.  Do not work for him or take his classes.

Buynak is the worst professor, put his students on risk ( some chemicals and acetone poured in sink), refused to give reference letter, do not give companies or student credit for research. Do not take his clssses or work for him.
Buynak is the worst professor, he put his students on risk (acetone and poured into sink) and refuse giving reference letters. Do not take his class or work for him.

This class is mostly antibiotics. You only have a few homework grades ( don't look to get them back in a timely manner). You only have 2 tests, a mid term and a final. It is hard to determine your grade in the class and the text books don't help on his test. You are better off taking notes on his lectures and paying attention.

This is not a class on medicinal chemistry, it is a class on antibiotics with a poor review of biochemistry. So take it if you want to learn about antibiotics I guess. Otherwise, you're better googling the mechanisms yourself.

Buynak is rarely prepared for classes and many classes are spent watching youtube videos for the entire lecture. He does not expect much from his students and they don't expect much from him in return. He rarely checks homework or grades assignments because he focuses on his research so it's impossible to know how you are doing in the class.
Challenging class on med chem. Spent most of the time on antibiotics (there's a lot!). Don't bother with the textbooks. Very helpful class prepping for med school.
the worst I ever had

He's getting towards the end of his time at SMU. Very knowledgeable but lectures are very boring. Every week or two he will cancel class for some reason. Grade is based on one project, an essay based final, and a couple quizzes taken throughout the semester. A majority of the students during class doze off or fall asleep
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Does not curve properly, know how to teach, or even knows the business he's supposedly in. Stay away from this one, soft and unconnected plus your gpa will take a hit on that A-.
WAY harder than he should be, obviously unaware of the curve rules in this school
Not a good class, doesn't seem to be aware that he needs to tone it down a little on the grades.
Wouldn't round my A- up to an A despite my grinding all semester for it. Don't take him if you need an easy elective.

I took BUSE 3332. Bruce is a great professor if you are interested in energy or need a business elective. The quizzes are sometimes difficult but he drops the lowest one. The final is an essay. There is one other essay(book review), and as long as you meet the page requirement and know what you're talking about, you should get an A on both papers.

Professor Bullock knows everything about the energy industry and is a great person to ask questions to. The class can be a little boring with lots of videos/slides, but Bruce makes class fun by sharing energy-related insights that undergrads are lucky to experience.

One of my favorite teachers at SMU! A super nice guy who genuinely cares about all of his students. Very easy to tell how passionate he is about the energy industry - he's really knowledgeable. Minimal work outside of class
Absolute homie, who is extremely knowledgeable about the energy industry. If you're in any way interested in energy, that being nat gas, oil, renewables - take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: goat
The class was easy but boring. The only assignments we had were a group project and two papers.
Id love to offer my actual opinion, though the guidelines won't let me.

Lots of readings and films to understand. Quizzes are short answer using random passages from readings, so you actually have to read. Exams are difficult but graded easily. The first quiz was a pop quiz with an average grade of 35, after that he started scheduling them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Levy! His lectures are easy to sit through, but he does yap your ear off. He also really gets to know you as a student, which I appreciated. Do be aware he is somewhat of a tough grader, and doesn't really let you know what he expects from you for your essays. And, he doesn't post any grades on canvas. Participation does matter!

He's a good professor and cares about student learning. Our class all failed the first pop quiz of the semester and the next class he held a discussion on how to improve the class and ended up changing his policies and stopped doing pop quizes. Grades are based off 4 quizes, a mid term, and final. this class knocks out 3 breadths and is easy enough
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: In this class you have to read a decent amount, but in class you watch a lot of movies. The exams are pretty easy if you go to class and pay attention, but you might have to memorize a couple of authors and dates. Professor Levy is pretty funny, but be prepared to here "et cetera et cetera" a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is seminar style and the grade is based on the participation, essays, and final. If you read and put the work in, you will be happy with your grade. You must actually participate in class, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Spends the class time primping and preening for his ego and then can't even put grades in nor tell you what you got. What kind of bs is this? Do your job. DO YOUR JOB!!
Great professor, 10/10 recommend everyone take him.
cool guy, mandatory attendance though or else your grade suffers badly.

Dr. Levy is a great professor, however you need to work really hard because sometimes you won't know how you did since he doesn't put in grades at all. He also won't tell you what grade you get on your essay. Put in the work, constantly revise and edit and you'll be fine?
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr Levy is one of the nicest, most approachable professors I've had. The class can be tough but as long as you talk to him, he will work with you. He is helpful in conferences and very personable, also loves to joke around with his students. Great class and professor, he makes you think about your beliefs and is very good at facilitating discussion
Full of himself thinks he's funny when he's not the whole class is poison to my soul. Hate this course sm.

Not much is done in class other than meaningless lectures. Lots of reading. Only two papers, but those are literally the only grades for the class. He's a nice person and a great professor, but gets off track so easily. I wouldn't take him again, but the discussions were interesting and the class was simple enough.
Honestly, a great guy. He sometimes does not grade anything, but I think that's because his class is more about participation, which is when you have to read!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good teacher, show up to class and read and you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This guy does not know how to teach and makes everything difficult for no reason.
Cool dude, he's very funny and cares about his students. Just show up and do the readings and his class is super achievable.

Professor Levy is a great professor and teaches the class subject matter is really interesting too.  The syllabus itself isn't really followed at all. As we are nearing the end of the semester the final exam has been done in multiple parts to the point where it feels like i've done 20 finals given all the writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Levy is fabulous, and one of my favorite professors I have taken thus far at SMU. While the course is very lecture and reading heavy, Professor Levy is extremely accommodating in helping you succeed in his course. He often extends due dates and allows take home assignments. The movies are engaging but get ready to write!
Great in class discussions on reading that was always engaging and insightful. There was barely any assignments besides the midterm and final. I would 100% take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Doesn't teach well, and makes the class harder than necessary by not having a cohesive syllabus or other materials. The material shouldn't be difficult, but he makes it difficult by limiting your available resource. Blatantly rude when students ask questions, require clarification, and answers with sarcasm and hatefulness. You won't learn anything.

I took Dr. Levy for honors writer, then later again for ENGL1365H and I loved him yet again! Dr. Levy is easily my favorite professor at SMU. He is hilarious, compassionate, and brilliant. His lectures are thought-provoking. He also grades pretty generously, with two papers averaging at 92. I would take a class with him every year if I could! :D

Prof. Levy is amazing! I would definitely take him again, hearing his lectures in class are always so interesting. There is a good amount of reading but nothing too hard. He also doesn't force you to participate if you don't want to. Overall he's an amazing professor, take him if you're able to.

Nice professor who made class light-hearted and interesting.  Just wished that the WRTR classes focused more on developing the students' writing style, instead of what felt like too much reading.  Going to his conferences was probably the best part of the class, as it really focused on the writing aspect.

His WRTR 2306 class is incredible. He talks a lot, but the topics are always interesting. He's an easy grader, you'll have to write around 3 essays a semester. Come to class to participate, student involvement is extremely important. I took WRTR 2305 and 2306 with him, and both classes were well worth it.

Do NOT let these comments fool you. His ENGL1365 class is NOT AN EASY A, you have to read a ton and he makes you watch films that are not able to be streamed through SMU libraries, so you have to pay money and rent them off Youtube or Amazon, or watch them IN HAMON. Did I mention the films are DVDs? Midterm and final only two grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Levy truly cares about the well being of his students. His class is discussions everyday, with a few readings that are manageable. He is very approachable. The only criticism I have is perhaps more structure, like rubrics or examples, but when I asked for those things he gave them. Just be friendly and participate! Always ask questions.

Professor Levy is probably my favourite teacher at SMU. I took him for WRTR2306 which was a pretty hard class for me, given that English isn't my first language, but he was super helpful and gave a lot of great tips. He's also really funny and makes hard topics easy to understand. Make sure you go to his conferences and participate in class!

Great guy! Dr. Levy is down-to-earth, compassionate, hilarious and intelligent. He's so friendly he will make jokes during lectures. He's a joy to be around and to talk to, especially when meeting with him over your papers. He's polite and gives well-rounded feedback. As long as you participate in class and have him see that you try, you'll be fine
Great class.

Levy is a great guy. Lectures are SO boring you will fall asleep. Expects you to participate and will cold call. Weekly discussions/journals just competition grades. Midterm and Final you have to ID major terms/ideas and do a mini-essay on some of the readings. Very easy to nail the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! If you are unsure about your essay please step in for his office hours for a conference, it is EXTREMELY helpful and he is VERY clear on where you can improve and how you can get the grade you want. He is also hilarious in class! Very enlightening discussions

Professor Levy is the BEST. He's funny, caring, knowledgable, and easy-going. He really wants you to do well and structures the class so that you are really learning how to improve your writing class. I looked forward to this class every day, take him if you can.

Professor Levy is AMAZING! Take him whether you need an English/history credit or not, you will not regret it. He has a great sense of humor, is extremely knowledgeable and intelligent, and really cares about his students. The class required a lot of reading but it was interesting.

Professor Levy's class was so much fun and extremely entertaining! Attendance isn't strict but he does notice if you miss class a lot. Midterm, paper, and final paper but not strict on grading. He is a super funny guy. Took this class for a UC requirement, highly recommend if you need a language and literature credit.
I originally took this class for the UC credit, but Dr. Levy was one of the most inspirational and amazing professors I have ever had. I am so glad I took this class

He is without a doubt the most caring and insightful teacher I have ever had. His wisdom will be carried with me throughout my entire life. The lectures and conversations in class are just about the most interesting things you will find on this campus. Honestly, Mr. Levy is the best teacher you will ever have if you choose to be engaged in class.

Dr. Levy is an incredible professor, and if you have the opportunity to take one of his courses, you absolutely should. In the past I have never enjoyed history, but I actually love this class! He makes the lectures very interesting, and he is one of the funniest people I have ever met. He is also happy to help with essays and answer any questions.

Professor Levy is a fantastic teacher. He provided thoughtful insight on topics that challenged me to think and analyze in different ways, while supplementing lectures with some entertaining humor. Although not in stone, the class layout for Jan term consisted of a midterm, essay, and final. If you're considering this class, you should take it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Levy was one of my favorite professors. When giving feedback on your paper he aways points out what you did well giving you a boost of confidence, and makes you want to write a good paper to prove him right.. he often goes off topic in class but if you read the material he sends you then you should good to go!

Great Class. Who would have guessed that addiction would be a great course topic? So interesting. We read things from history and literature and sociology, neuroscience. Great short stories and films. Really interesting class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Profesor Levy is incredible! He is not easy but I learned so much. His class completely transformed my writing style. It is very easy to conference with him because he is always available outside of class and will meet you whenever it is convenient. I hope to take more of his classes in the future because his lectures are interesting and inspiring.

Professor Levy is awesome!! I was a little scared to take an honors writing course considering writing is not my strong suit; however, Professor Levy really helps you with your papers in office hours. You will have to do a substantial amount of reading, but the books are so interesting. He is such a caring and funny individual. I highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Great course about Addiction and alcohol.  Really interesting history and literature readings.  I had no idea about a lot of it.  Learned a lot.  Team taught
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Great professor, kept class fun and interesting. He made class enjoyable. Nothing terribly challenging just have to do the work.

Levy makes us see things going on in stories that we would never see on our own.  Sometimes it feels like magic. He's really smart and cares a lot about what the stories mean for the real world. Really interesting to meet with him in his office.

Professor Levy is quite an interesting person, although, interesting in a good way. He really cares about his students and will ease up on the deadlines when needed. (he gets how stressful school can be.) He is very good at giving constructive criticism so make sure you're able to take criticism well. Overall a great class and professor.

Took this course for J Term (7 hours classes for  8 days!). I was dreading it, but this course was terrific. We read great stuff, mixed it up really good films, had great discussions. The tests were fair and he helped a lot on the paper. He really makes the material relevant to  today.  My mom would think he's really hot! :)

This course divorces you from a normal class approach because assignments aren't the point, learning is. This professor is really interested in what other people have to say about the discussed issues, so be prepared to speak up! Most of the class is the professor speaking, but he welcomes students chiming in with their ideas to force redirections.

This is a tough class to get an A in but you can still work hard and get a decent grade. Visit his office hours and get as much feedback as possible, though sometimes that doesn't help. Overall, a good professor who loves what he teaches.

I have taken 4 classes with Prof Levy. His depth of knowledge in each subject continues to enrich my learning experience. He loves his students, and will make you a better writer. The reading lists are long and worth every minute spent reading. How can you not love someone who teaches out of his shoes in groovy socks?

This class was by far one of the most interesting English classes I've taken. As long as you do the assigned readings and pay attention you will do fine. Only two tests: the midterm (open-note) and the final(take-home) and one 5-7 page essay. For me this was an easy A because the material was very interesting and relatively easy to read.

Great guy, funny and smart. Talkative most of the class period. Decently fair grader. Though it seems like he wants to specifically know what you have learned when it comes to papers and that is tough for some people. Thought I had the A, but ended up with B-. Still would take him again.
Worst Disc teacher I've had at SMU. Will embarrass you in front of whole class.

Spends most of the class going off on tangents that are loosely related to the course material or sometimes completely unrelated. Very few assignments are graded. HOWEVER, when he finally does assign a paper, he will grade it very harshly. Participation is also graded and it is difficult to do so when he is the one talking most of the time.
Amazing professor. Take him if you can. Super easy and informative.

Levy is my FAVORITO prof I've ever encountered.  I've taken him twice now and he has yet to fail me.  Take his J-term class Lit of Minorities, it is so interesting and he knows so much about the topics.  The days can be long but it is so worth it,  the reading is fun and short and the movies are good and make the time go by fast.  Highly Reccomeded

Enjoyed this class very much.  Class is easy, hardly any homework, you dont have to do the reading as long as you can write a good paper.  He is fun to have in class but a hard grader.  It was crazy hard to get an A on his papers and I'm a good writer.  Office hours you should go but I didn't find them helpful. Deff take this class, it was cool.

Levy is a great professor, I absolutely loved being in his class. Although he likes to goof off in class, he is a serious grader. He expects college level writing, and if you do not provide the level he is looking for, expect the grade to reflect that. He gives you a very clear idea of what it is he is looking for though. I will be taking him again
Awesome professor and very passionate towards his interests! Loves to help students and is hilarious at times!

Prof Levy is a delight!  So enjoyed the free flow discussion about the literature and relevance to the world today.  He's very helpful when it's time for papers.  If you need structure, this professor might not fit your learning style.  He's very knowledgeable about the literature, and he will expand your thinking no doubt.

AMAZING Professor!!  I went into this class not particularly excited because I don't love English but Bruce is so much fun and always tells entertaining stories. There is a good amount of work but as long as you go see him during office hours and chat he'll love you. Seriously recommend this class!!

Gave 3 short 4-6 page papers and a 10 page final paper. grades based on your attendance and if he remembers you and how much you talk in class. participate in discussions and he will love you. follow the prompt write the page length he wants and you will do fine on the paper. rambles in class. loves to go off topic which is ok---kills time !
Funny guy, very entertaining class. Took his class a couple of times, and would take more. Likes to talk, can get off topic, but still interesting.

In Literature of Minorities and Addiction and Recovery. Great professor. Likes to talk...but very funny and a great guy. Tough grader on papers but 110% willing to go out of his way to help you get the best grade possible. Very understanding. Awesome prof. Take AT LEAST one of his classes!

Funny and entertaining but also a good professor overall. Gave 3 short 4-6 page papers and a 10 page final paper. He's most willing to help if you come to office hours with specific questions. You won't get much input if you just ask him to read your paper. Topic (Alcohol & addiction) was more interesting than other 1302 class topics. Recommended.

Very interested in his students. There were more class periods I went in to listen to discussions, or him just talking, then actually doing work. Only about 4-5 grades in this class. Encourages encourages encourages conferences. Loves cycling.

May be one of the worst teachers I have had ever in life. Classes are boring, papers have no prompt, and the way he grades is terrbile. If you are taking a CF class do NOT take his class or you will be in for a very long semester

I would recommend this teacher to anyone.  He was interested in what he is teaching and the class is not terribly hard.  Can be a bit boring at times but overall it was a good class and he was a good teacher.  He is interested in his students lives and lots of class was spend talking about our lives.

This professor is willing to work with you as long as you show that you are trying to work. Don't be jerks during his class, and you won't have to worry. I would definitely take more of his classes. Thumbs up!!!

This is the best professor I've had at SMU. His class if fun and interesting, and every day is totally different! He grades fairly, if you put effort into a paper, you'll get an A. I would definitely recommend taking any and every class this professor offers!!

This professor is amazing! He is very nice and cares about the students. You volunteer for his class but if you can't make it he doesn't hold it against you. He is very reasonable. He sometimes won't return grades but you can assume you did well. I would definitely recommend taking this class for CF!
Not clear communication
Horrible grader  so irrational. Idk what is saying half the time
Mr. Butler is the best. Very intelligent

He is very unorganized with how he prepares for class. His grading is also very irrational. Will give timed exams and take points off for minor mistakes. At this level of engineering,process is more important than minor mistakes. His communication is very unclear and has a hard time explaining concepts in class. Very difficult to pay attention.

Very interesting sense of humor, likes to ramble.  Good teacher when he is teaching, and very easy for homework, quizzes and tests.  He practically gives you the answers, we had open book / notes for everything.  The only tricky part is the programming assignments.
funny...cheesy (very)

Mr. Weinstein seems to know what he's talking about, and is really funny, and gets great speakers for his class--ie guest lecturers that are very good-- but his grading is way more nebulous. Hard to get a decent grade in this class. Never seems to materialize for office hours, nebulous about grading policies. No feedback on graded work.

Weinstein is highly respected in the energy policy field. His class and teaching style is very laid back though. Attendance is optional. Only 3 assignments for whole semester. No textbook. His opinion on energy policy is certainly interesting, and at times, funny, and you'll learn a lot. Doesn't seem to keep to his posted office hours.

The reading was interesting, but class was boring. All he did was go over the newspaper articles we read about the topics, so I just browsed the internet. I learned more from reading random Wikipedia articles than from listening in class. Exams are take home, but you will have to google the answers. He's a nice professor and easy to like though.
BW is wonderful I had her for WRTR 1312 and she genuinely cares about each of her students. All you have to do is participate and present meaningful ideas and you will get an A

The course depended heavily on self teaching because lectures rarely explained concepts clearly. Questions during class slowed everything down because answers were indirect and confusing. Expectations remained unclear until after assignments had already been graded.
My class and I are on a first name base with BW. All she wants is for students to feel comfortable. Sweetest person ever. Show effort and she'll reward you for it!

BW Hamilton is a good professor however i find her grading to be a little strict. There is zero electronics allowed in class so know that going in. She is very accessable outside of class but everything is done on paper and a lot of outside reading is required. Overall if you read and go to class you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I don't understand how her rating is so high unless its sarcasm. The workload is ridiculous and she honestly thinks it's normal to expect us to read in this day and age of AI.
Great Prof! Very understanding and will listen to what you have to say. YOU HAVE TO PARTICIPATE IN THIS CLASS!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Talk now and then, and you'll be good. Super laid-back lectures, and she doesn't have any restrictions on tech in class. She grades mostly on completion-based assignments, so expect 2-3 assignments per week, with a maximum of approximately 1-2 hours per assignment. She is super accessible outside of class and is willing to meet on weekends as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Made us memorize a 300-word speech word for word to present in front of the class, and is a very tough grader
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Comes across as condescending and hateful when you don't write to her expectations. Very political and left leaning which makes her not like my writing but maybe you'll be fine if you match her stance. She's just a mean teacher and frankly untalented.

I had BW for both 1312 and 1313, and cannot put words into how much she is a great professor. I highly recommend going to her office hours for feedback-- even through email. She is a tough grader, but the feedback should help you to improve on the next essay. BW wants to get to know you as a person & writer, which helps you achieve success.

DDisrespectful if you don't understand concepts immediately. Does not seem to care if students do well. Hard to reach and a poor communicator. Many student had to drop the class. I would not ever choose to take this class or professors again.
Disrespectful and a very hard grader...
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Took her first semester freshmen year. Would advise against taking her, not because she is horrible but because she is a really hard grader. This class is my only B+ ever at SMU and haunts me till this day. I put in so much, went to all her office hours, and could not do well in this class. Next semester I took a different WRTR teacher and got an A

As someone who enjoys participating in class, I loved her so much... and since I was practically the only one participating... she loved me and it showed in the final grade! If you dislike class discussion and engagement stay farrrr away

I love BW Hamilton, she is an amazing teacher and person. She gives really good feedback. If you speak during the Socratic seminars and actually put effort into your essays (not just CHATGPT it) you will get a really good grade. Would take again 100%.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hamilton is nice but you have to get to know her first. Really tough grader on papers but if you go to her office hours she'll give really helpful tips. Lots of reading but if you ask her directly for feedback it'll help a lot on your papers and will reflect in her grading - maybe look for an easier writing prof if you can though
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I LOVE Professor Hamilton! She is the best professor I've had so far, she is super understanding and gives amazing feedback on your work. She is one of the kindest people ever and has amazing class discussions when students participate. Her assignments and work are carefully thought out to ideally benefit you in the long run, not just busy work.

Professor BW Hamilton is a wonderful professor. She is understanding (like extremely) and gives HELPFUL feedback. There are also many EC opportunities. If you want an unconventional experience, take Professor Hamilton.

There is nothing more to say than BW Hamilton is the best professor I have ever had. She really helped me to become more confident in my writing and she is such a caring and inspiring individual.  I learned more in one semester from BW than I had ever learned in my high school career. TAKE BW!

Although there is a lot of busy work, BW Hamilton is the first professor and writing teacher I have ever felt respect from. She is a very caring and understanding individual. She has created interest as a student to participate and speak up in class without the fear of being wrong as I experienced in high school.  The best teacher I have ever had.

Prof. Hamilton is a great teacher, and I decided to take her again after my fall class with her. She genuinely cares about her students and their interests, and really encourages us all to do our best in class. She always provided excellent feedback which would always encourage me to work even harder to impress her.
Very good teacher for WRTR 1312. You have to do some work, but she is a very fair and want's everyone in her class to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I was scared to take this class because of the mixed reviews but she was an amazing teacher. All you have to do is show up to class, do the work, and participate in class discussions. Sure she gives more work than other professors but the class is very beneficial.
Nicest teacher ever and she genuinely cares about her students! I mostly got straight As in this class. Love her so much!

Professor Hamilton was my favorite professor last semester. She deeply cares about her students and wants them to succeed. She assigns a lot of work but is understanding and wants to help you out. My writing improved in her class and I am taking her next semester. This class is rewarding and worth the hard work!

Strongly advise anyone NOT to take Prof. Hamilton. She is the toughest grader I have ever experienced in my entire schooling career. Used to get A+s, finished with a B. She provides more work than other WRTR classes and its all busy work thats graded harshly. Shes really rude when you try speak up in class, and all her students are struggling.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Hands down the worst teacher at SMU. Miserable woman.

I took 2311, and I am a typical A student. And I got a B in this class. The material is all over the place. you can try and review the information on the slides that she rambles about in class but when it comes to the test that information simply wont be on there. I really wish her experiment of a class and text book didn't effect my grade.

I took her 2311 class which the only material consisted of her awful un-published, un-edited textbook. The textbook contained information that wasn't in the slides and was some of the most random information that doesn't matter. Don't take the Out of Many class because it is just dumb. Sent an email and got a rude reply when I asked for help.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I'm in HIST 2311 and the first exam is tomorrow. NO STUDY GUIDE AT ALL. Her lectures are not engaging, boring and very disorganized. Worst way to teach a history class and there is just so much material to memorize with no guidance at all. I am a history minor and a senior thinking this would be easy. NO. AVOID! 3 exams worth 70% of final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Take her classes! Very straighforward. Nice and gives good feedback on papers/projects. No exams, just projects and reading assignments. Great if you need to get CC credit.

I took HIST 1325 with her and it was super easy. You have to use software that is kind of hard to understand at first, but once you get the hang of it the projects feel simple. I would say this class is an easy A.

Flat out just avoid this professor. Pointless 100+ page readings with random specific questions. 99% of students take this as an easy CC but she decides to be the type of teacher that rhymes with bunt.

She reruns her same lectures from 15 years ago
 or whatever, which don't match her books assigned or assignments. If you go by office hours, she makes sure you know your interrupting her lunch with her passive aggressive responses.
This professor is a nightmare. Assignments are confusing, instructions contradictory. Offers no support, then wonders why students struggle. Avoid this class if you value your sanity.
Lack of feedback and empathy and sometimes can get passive aggressive when asked a question.

Knows a lot about her topic and is a very engaging lecturer. On top of emails and makes her expectations clear. Also she's just a very kind and approachable person in general. However, don't take her if you don't like reading- the readings can be over 50 pages at times. Make sure you're interested in the subject beforehand. Otherwise, she's great.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The absolute worst course and professor I have ever taken. The readings are ridiculous, the assignments are torturous and nonsensical which you won't get back for weeks later and can't correct your mistakes, and she uses class time to espouse her personal views which you must agree on if you want to do well.

Your grade is just reading reflections, papers, and presentations. Presentations are so low key and easily graded. Lots of reading for every class but you can pretty much just read half and write on that. She lets you rewrite papers below a 94. Lectures are actually interesting and show colonial America from cool perspectives.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Intro to Judaism- Carte is great! Very approachable and truly knowledgeable and passionate about her work and her students. She really wants to make the course as interesting as possible. LOTS of reading before every class and sometimes they are pretty dense, 3 simple papers, a midterm and a final. Pretty easy and fair grader with great feedback!

I took Professor Carte for Intro to Judaism. She grades papers and mid-terms fairly. She had recurring reading journals that would be twice a week. Often these readings would be 20+ pages, often easy to read and understand, but an hour to complete. Overall I would take it again. She has great lecturing skills, especially in history.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: LOVE DR CARTE!!! She's super available to help, grades super fair (almost easy), and really just wants people to enjoy the class. That being said, you can not understand a thing about history and still get an A if you do the reading responses and proof read your papers.
