Dr. Carte is awesome. Don't be fooled this class has many assignments that can pile up if you procrastinate. She is kind and the material is interesting. She gets really into her lectures and makes students feel safe and comfortable. I have taken her a couple of times at SMU. Highly recommend

Professor Carte is the entire reason I am getting a minor in history. She is engaging and funny, cares about how you feel about the class, and is always willing to help on papers or discuss tough readings. It is a lot of work, but it's absolutely manageable, and all you need to do to make As on papers is ask her for help!

Incredibly nice professor. Very engaging. Course covers N. American discovery through 1776. Carte takes a ton of information and pairs it with engaging readings and lectures. She is upbeat and funny. Daily reading journals (easy 100's). She takes and grades attendance. Bring your papers to her before you submit. Would take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors at SMU! Get ready to read and write, it is a lot of work, but she is a great teacher.

Dr. Carte is hands down my favorite professor in the history department and I would take her again. She assigns a fair amount of reading each night and usually checks to see if you did it either with written reflections or pop quizzes. Her lectures are amazing and she is passionate about what she teaches. If you can, take her classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: For every class, there is a reading that could be anywhere from 15 to 50 pages long that has to be read and write a paper or do a quiz on it. You won't get your assignments back until 3 weeks later so you don't get to correct your mistakes, just deal with the 80's because she doesn't grade on time. If you are conservative, do not take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Super rude in person when you go to his office hours. His class was pretty interesting, but it felt like he thought he was somewhat superior to us, or that if we did badly it was entirely because we didn't listen to him, and it's not his fault.

This Professor is the worst Professor I've ever had. His poetry should've been so easy but he treated it as more than a poetry class. There's only 4 written exams and like 3 other assignments but he's a tough grader when it comes to the exams. I don't recommend at all.

Little bit of a tough grader, but overall good class to fulfill literary analysis CC. Funny guy, have to go to class to do well on the tests, but interesting discussions. Never thought poetry could actually be fun but it's kind of fun. Would highly recommend. Very straightforward grading, but must come to class!

Professor Caplan is the illest. Seriously, he will make you think, wonder, and question all things literature. He is an amazing professor who will work with you, teach you, and guide you, so YOU can become the best version of yourself in his class. Does he grade harshly? Yes, but do not let that stop you. He will not let you fail!

I took his poetry class and can say he is a wonderful man and professor. Dr. Caplan is extremely knowledgeable, engaging, and passionate. His ability to discuss, teach, and unearth meaning in poetry is truly second to none. Loved this class!

Professor Caplan has been the hardest professor Ive taken at SMU. I took poetry to fulfill my CC requirements and out of an interest in poetry and I now despise the subject. I would avoid taking any of his classes at all costs especially if youre looking for an easy CC course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: 5 labs, 4 online homework, and 1 online midterm with a practice exam and many in-lecture activities that make them fairly easy. Final Project: You come up with an idea that uses Ch. 11-22 of the textbook. Tight 3-4 week schedule with tough, nitpicky grading. He will grill you if you present in-person. 20% HW, 20% Labs, 30% Midterm, 30% Project.
Never met a man more full of himself for reasons that are a complete mystery to the western hemisphere.

Dr. Camp is one of the best professors I have ever had. This class was a fresh of breath air for me in a much-needed time. The class assignments can be seen as difficult as they are not a direct reflection of lecture but a build on them. The lectures are boring, so go to office hours, learn, build a relationship with Dr. Camp, and you will succeed
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Should probably switch careers from teaching to anything else where he isn't public-facing and can be segued away in a corner, because this guy has less charisma and ability than my pet rock.
nothing matches from what he teaches to what your supposed to do on assignments and your grade will suffer for it

Prof heavily enforces policies to the point where they will not work with you if
 anything major (or minor) in your life happens.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: As a 4.0 student, I know a good professor when I see one no matter how tough they are, and he is nowhere near a decent one. He'll make you struggle for no reason bc he's terrible at explaining things, not even sure HE KNOWs what he's doing (which is awkward), and hes a most annoying personality with a rude, in your face sense of humor. Insulting.

Professor gave many incentives to do well, like skipping the final if your grade is an A and having practice midterms that use the same question bank as the midterm.  Homeworks are somewhat difficult, but he makes it much easier to understand if you go to his office hours.  If you ask the right questions, he will give you a clear answer.
Got an A but worked hard for it. Be ready to work hard on the killer homework assignments.

His lectures are just very boring and dry. He doesnt present content in a intuitive way and just scrambles to explain things. His grading is pretty irrational. I Like the subject so worked hard for the grade but managed to make me hate parts of this class like the homeworks and projects which were poorly guided.

There is no flow in his whole class and the group project is a joke. He doesn't have much time to care about the project. Grading is not fair, he will give students who are talkative higher scores than other quiet but hardworking students.

The syllabus was disorganized and the textbook was horrible. Tests were completely different from what is in the homework and in the textbook. Homework guidance was no where to be found in the book. Grading is not fair because book itself doesn't  talk about the topics in the homework. Don't miss quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Best teacher ever. He is one the most caring teachers on campus and really wants every student to understand the material. He grades super fair and the hw and quizes are great study guides for the tests. Definately take him for a class if possible.

Interesting class. Carbiener knows his stuff. Recommend showing up to lectures even though he doesn't take attendance. In-class notes and problem sets were more than enough prep for the exams. 3 exams and one dropped if you take the final. Id consider myself a few sandwiches short of a picnic and even I did well in his class and learned a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Old school professor and teaching style. Class grade is entirely based on how you do on the exams. You don't need to study too much in order to pass them but the questions are definitely a lot harder than the practices. Show up, take notes and you'll do fine.

Professor Carbiener is a very knowledgable professor who cares about money and banking. The class is no homework and I had it at 8 am. Go to the classes even if you show up late and take notes. You don't have to study a ton and I really enjoyed his class

Take this class only if you're willing to work outside of class to excel. He does not provide you with much material to do well on the tests, and notes often do not correlate directly to the questions. You have to understand the topics, so attendance is crucial to get the information. Without that, you have no other resources. Wordy Lectures.
I don't think he writes his test questions because they have no correlation to his lectures which are easy to understand.

DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE

Course material is not difficult to learn, he just doesn't teach it at all. Zero correlation between lectures and exams. Course is only graded on 4 exams (one dropped) but there is no review packet or homework questions to help you prepare for the exams.

If you have ADHD or learn from lectures DO NOT TAKE HIM!

Incredibly interest course material largely limited by an outdated lecture style and course structure. Carbiener is clearly a knowledgable guy, but it seems like he does this to pass time rather than engage with students heavily. By no means a hard class if you take notes daily, but really hard to stay engaged. Quizlet is your best friend here.

I did not enjoy Professor Carbiener's class. His lectures felt like cliff notes of what we actually needed to know for his exams. Could tell he doesn't write his own questions bc there was a lack of connection between lectures and exams. 5 exams - half multiple choice, half take home short answer. Drop one exam and extra credit at the end.

You absolutely have to attend class in order to do well. Take good notes because that is all you will have to study for the exams. 5 exams, he drops one. Does extra credit at the end. Not a bad prof but I didn't love him just because the lectures were so dry and if I missed anything in my notes I wouldn't know it for the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: All the exams are based on lectures. If you attend class and actually learn rather than memorize the material you'll do great.

Took professor Carbiener for Money and Banking. He's a good professor and his tests are only of material covered in class so you don't really have to read the textbook if you pay attention. 4 tests and extra credit. I'd recommend if you need to take this class.

I would not recommend his class over the summer because you only get 3 tests and if you fail one of them you would have to retake the class and it's not for free. I physically can NOT retain any of the material he teaches, it feels as if I am talking to a book. He is very intimidating to me and I feel very helpless in class. (Eastfield)

He is a great choice for Econ- the only problem I had taking this class was taking it 8 am. He is often funny and describes concepts in a way that makes sense. Drops the lowest test grade. Also, I would recommend buying the workbook as he assigns optional but helpful problems there. You can go without the textbook if you pay attention in class.

While Carbiener can be monotonous at times, his lectures are clear and easily understandable, and he makes it clear how to get an A in the class. He lectures straight on the whiteboard, so show up and take good notes. The class is 4 tests and a final, and he drops the lowest one, so you can exempt from the final. Extra credit offered at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great professor! Explains concepts easily and allows you to drop one of five tests. He gives lots of extra credit at the end of the semester, so it is definitely very manageable to make an A in this class. Definitely worth taking!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is a good professor, lectures are very relatable. He gives clear understanding and is always willing to answer questions. Class was at Eastfield.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very solid professor. Had him 8am MWF. Drops 1/5 tests including final. Need 92 for an A. Solid lectures. I never used the textbook. I attended every lecture, but some opt to self teach and still skipped the final as well. Worth the 8am to avoid Tania. Do optional HW in study guide book. I mainly studied by redoing and reviewing those. 10 points EC
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: A very knowledgeable professor, his lectures are extremely clear and inspirational. He uses real-life examples which is easy to understand. Tests are pretty straightforward. Plus he is a really nice guy who wants to succeed in this class. Take him if you got a chance. Overall, he is a solid choice and better than Tania Jordan certainly.

The professor is amazing. Although I may have mentioned the course description requires you to buy a book, the book really is not needed if you go to class all the time. You do not have to use the book if you take notes during the class. He also uses the funniest examples when teaching his lessons.

It is important to read the textbook, but it is equally important to go to class. Certain material is covered in class while other material can only be found in the textbook. Grading is based solely on 5 tests, the lowest grade is dropped, but there is an extra credit assignment towards the end of the class that is very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Carbiener is a solid choice compared to other micro teachers. He lectures all class and basically spits out the same info as the textbook. Go to class since he skips sections in the textbook and he doesn't put test dates on the syllabus. Seems intimidating but really respectful guy. Lots of opportunities for students to ask questions

He is a straight-forward, professional teacher who relates microeconomic concepts to the real world. Sometimes, lectures can be a little difficult to follow but he does not try to trick you on tests and specifies what he expects students to know. Patient, thorough, and helpful during office hours. Attendance not required, but necessary for success.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's not an especially inspirational teacher but it's a decent class. Show up to the lectures and do the workbook pages even though they're more optional. Tests are fairly straightforward with a couple tricky questions. It's a manageable class that is better than other options from what I hear.

I really enjoyed my Microeconomics class with Prof. Carbiener. He is very good at explaining concepts and clear in all of his lectures. His tests are not meant to trick you, and I felt well prepared for the tests without excessive studying. I would take him again in a heartbeat.
Would not recommend, plain and simple

had him 8 am on mwf, went to class 9 times all semester, with 4 of them being the exams. Studied the book pretty vigorously a few days prior to each exam, and ended up making a B+. Don't do that at all, it sucked, and a B+ isn't impressive, but it goes to show that making a good grade isn't very difficult if you show up to class and study some.

He is intelligent and it shows. You cannot skip a class or you will be lost because all of his lectures are written on the board. He can sometimes jump around from topic to topic, but overall he is a good professor. Don't expect to get an easy A, this class requires you to study for each exam and attend every class.

Even though he follows a very precise format when creating tests, students never know what to expect. His lessons might sometimes be confusing, but if u ask he will help. Even though he doesnt take attendance, GO TO THE CLASSES. It is work, but it can be a work well done

Only 4 tests on the year, one of which was the final. Economics came easy to me and I hovered right above 90 the whole semester. Carbiener is very clear about what's on the tests, and the class after the test he reviews questions that students got wrong. Really solid econ teacher.

He's a really great economist, but maybe not the most inspired teacher. I definitely would recommend him to anyone who is willing to learn, but if you're looking for a handout probably not Carbiener. I missed two classes and I stayed afloat but it was definitely difficult due to the dense lectures. If you are conceptual he can help you understand.

I liked him! 8am class, but not a big deal if you miss a time or two. No homework or quizzes, so not a super stressful class. He explains everything in a pretty straightforward easy to understand way. Tests are not too bad and will normally give you some points back if you explain why you put your answer. Offers extra credit that helps

Very intelligent professor He explained the concepts with easy to understand examples and simplified the class He broke down each concepts He made the class interesting He knows how to teach Would definitely recommend him Textbook is optional but will help in understanding the concepts further
Make sure to go to class! Tests can be tricky so pay close attention to the wording.

Professor Carbiener is great! He knows his subject and is very helpful. I didn't get an A because I was taking too many classes and kind of neglected this class. Take notes and study them for tests, he doesn't use the book a lot.
Really Good teacher. Great lecturer, and not much homework. Easy teacher.
Go to class, and you'll get an A, the class is straightforward, listen to him and you won't need the textbook. He makes the exams very clear, and you very simple. Great teacher

Jeff is awesome, he's pretty funny in class and really tries to convey the material in an interesting way. Make sure you go to class (he doesn't check) so that you can take notes and understand the info. The test is basically the notes and he usually curves it 3-4 questions. Went to 90% of the classes and got an A.

He is the best! There is no reason for not getting an A in his class. My English is very limited, but he explains stuff so well. If you miss the class, just read the book. HIs text is very straight and clear. Strongly recommend!
Great professor very clear and understanding.  If you use notes and read the books, the tests are not too bad.  Explains everything in a way that is very easy to understand
Everyone used to have his old exams and he suddendly changed them and screwed everything. Had to drop the class. 8 AM and really boring.

great professor.  had no interest in econ before taking this class and he made it somewhat enjoyable.  only grades are 4 tests. if you go to lectures and take notes you should find it relatively easy to make an A.
He is very nice and helpful. His exams base on Workbook, so do your homework. :>
THis teacher is extremely hard he's a good lecturer but that's about it.

Brilliant man. Makes economics easy to understand. Attend every class and take good notes and you will score high on exams. No need for the book. Four exams are your only grade. Attendance not mandatory, but recommended since some material you're tested over isn't in the book. He is interesting to listen to and understanding. Highly recommend.
Pros: Reasonable, knows the material every well, and tests are pretty straight forward.   Cons: 8AM, and if you want an A, you have to go and take notes.

He is the best teacher i have had yet. He is clear, he is fair, and he is reasonable. If you have any issues or problems you can just talk to him. Take this professor if you want to do well and learn something

He is by far the best teacher i have had at SMU. He is clear, he is helpful, and he will phrase things in a way that anyone can understand. He tests the material he teaches, and if you go to class, you will get an A

If you attend his class, which is optional, you will pass. If you chose not to go to class good luck passing the class as he doesn't use the textbook at all. A few times he used a workbook which he told us to buy the first week of school but he provides PDF's if you ask.

Very easy class. Never show up to class lecture because he goes straight out of the book. Read the abridged notes in the workbook and do problems night before test. Get a high A on test. And repeat. Three times.

This has been my favorite professor this semester. I have thoroughly enjoyed his class. He is very easy to understand, and really knows the material. His tests are fairly straight forward. From what I hear this ECON professor is the best. I agree hands down.
Good professor, drops a test so if you're satisfied with your grade you don't have to take the final. The class really isn't that bad, if you show up to class you should do fine on your tests.

He is VERY boring and monotone (especially at 8am) but should be a fairly easy A.  Attendance is taken daily but doesn't directly affect your grade.  EVERYTHING ON THE TESTS IS IN THE NOTES.  Show up and take good notes.  If you study the notes you should do very well.  light coursework and no homework.  Take econ with Carbiener.
Okay so I think his class was really easy because we never had any homework, quizzes, or projects. We just had 4 tests, each worth 25%, and as long as you actually studied, it was an easy A

Carbiener's test are incredibly hard.  Class attendance doesn't technically affect your grade but he takes roll everyday.  Class is basically a repeat of everything in the book. tests are multiple choice where all the answers are generaly right, but you have to "choose the most correct answer" only its VERY difficult to do given the choices.
No Comments

Don't get behind on assignments otherwise it'll be difficult trying to get caught up. I had a hard time, but Dr Hepburn was willing to work with me. The lectures are spot on in terms of the course material.

He's a walking encyclopedia. If there's something he doesn't know, I would be shocked. He always has the best answers to questions about writing. He's great a connecting things to a larger picture. I am glad I took this course instead of the wrtr course.

This class is probably easier than WRTR courses. There is A LOT of material to cover and, if you get behind, you're going to suffer. Dr Hepburn has a very strict assignment acceptance policy, and you have to submit a certain number of assignments to pass. If you do get behind, Dr Hepburn is willing to work with you but contact him early.

Easygoing class where you get full credit on assignments as long as you submit something. First time teaching at SMU, so the class felt haphazardly put together: the assignments skewed pretty far from the syllabus and a bunch of classes were cancelled. Non-mandatory attendance, but there were a few surprise in-class assignments here and there.

I was crazy behind because of life things but Dr Hepburn worked with me throughout the semester to get back on track. I really respect him for that. Definitely don't let yourself get behind, though. The assignments are really straightforward, but if you get behind, it's going to be hell trying to get caught up.

I won't say this class was easy. If you get behind, it's going to be very stressful, but Dr Hepburn was so receptive to my situation and offered time outside of class to help me get back on track. The class was enjoyable. each day it was something new but there is a lot of reading... we worked through a lot of the assignments in class or as groups.

Attendance and participation definitely matter. I learned so much from Dr Hepburn about writing, research, and presentation. He's funny, totally up-to-date on current events, even tries to learn and use new generational lingo, and he's totally respective to feedback from students. I am so glad I took this course.

First class he said "I don't do attendance or due dates, and everyone will get an A as long as you turn in assignments" the "assignments" are extremely chatable prompts worth a ton of points and as long as you submit something sometime during the semester you're guarenteed an A+. Absolute GOAT couldn't recommend this class any more

Dr. Hepburn is so awesome, he is so funny and a good teacher. He gives all A's, no such thing as attendance, holds class MAX once a week, and has a lot of fun teaching. We danced, acted out theater and had lectures and take home assignments but as long as you turn in work and aren't shy you'll get in A
If there is one professor to take at this school it is him. Best. Teacher. Ever. Class is the lightest thing ever, he just calls on people to come up and dance and he's so funny.
Dr Hepburn is the GOAT. This class was so much fun. We learned about music from different cultures, sang, danced, and even had a grammy-winner as a guest speaker.

Office hours were technically available, but asking for help usually led to dismissive answers or more confusion. The class environment felt tense, participation was discouraged, and grading seemed based on personal preference rather than any consistent rubric.
Do not understand how people don't like him.
Don't know how people don't like him
Lecture style was disengaging and felt wasteful. He tends to foster discussion on the material that matters the least when exams come around. Really not a fan.

Easy going professor and has jokes every so often so it keeps you alive during class. He's pretty understanding and very fair with grading. His lectures are good if you actually pay attention. Course content can be heavy at times but I would take him again.
If you value your GPA, run. Workload is huge, grading is brutal, and there's zero consistency. You never know what counts or what doesn't. Easily the most frustrating class I've taken.
Best professor you could have for communications, the only class you look forward to having every MWF.

He's a chill, funny guy, loves to discuss class topics with students and get our opinions which makes lectures more engaging. Attendance is part of the grade but if u cant make it slides are posted. Not a bs class, gotta put in some work but he wont drown you in assignments over the semester like other profs will.

Hands down the worst class Ive ever taken. He is disrespectful to students and makes bad jokes 
that are mean spirited. He is rude and his lectures are so boring I would never take this 
class again.
Wildly unprepared to teach and just rambles. Doesn't seem to know much about the topic nor have any real life experience at high levels. Somehow really impressed with himself when no one else is.
really good professor. great entertaining lectures (very knowledgeable). one paper, 3 exams. easy quizzes for HW. attendence is mandatory (uses qr code). i would definitely take him again.

The man can't teach and exists here only because he's an A machine so students keep taking him and keeping him employed. He doesn't know what he's doing and spends the entire class talking about himself and all his supposed accomplishments. That's not a class. That's a pub meeting with your audience. We're his paid audience and learn nothing.

I'm a fifth year senior, I have taken many different professors at SMU, and he is hands down the best. His lectures are funny and always entertaining no matter the topic. He doesn't assign homework, and grades fairly. If you show up and pay attention, you'll do very well. He creates an environment where students actually look forward to attending.
Genuinely a great professor and very understanding,I definitely recommend taking his class!

Absolutely love his class! He gives a few quizzes on the topics that you do at home and have 2 attempts for, 2 midterms, a final, and one essay (write at most 7 pages). Very easy class if you attend and pay attention. He also likes to tell stories and give examples of the concepts. Overall, a great guy and I would take his class again!
Easy A professor for anyone and everyone who shows or doesn't show up, ridiculous excuse for a professor and for the amount of money we pay

Let's you use ChatGPT on quizzes. Gives everyone 100s on everything and every thinks they deserve them so they exhale him to be the best teacher. It's sad. This is not education but very got my free a.

Good professor. Not really hard class imo. Homework are quizzes but 2 attempts and you get answers. 3 midterms but they were pretty fair. 1 paper but wasn't crazy hard. Just take good notes and try or pretend to try

Very generous grader, clear on what he expects, and doesn't hold back on giving 100s or high A's if deserved. Attendance is taken every single day but in-class participation isn't a grade. Reading quizzes are done usually once a week but with multiple attempts. Exams aren't difficult and come from slides, pay attention in class and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Such a nice guy and a good professor. He explains concepts very clearly and offers many real-world examples. Your grade is based on quizzes that you can use Chat GPT/notes on, a group presentation (that I think everyone got an 100 on), a midterm, and a final. The midterm/final are kinda tricky but overall not too bad. Def would take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Salinas is the best. This was my second class with him, would take more if I needed them. He wants students to learn and makes it no harder than it should be. Is a great lecturer and makes class entertaining. 2 test including final, 1 group presentation, easy quizzes with multiple tries and correct answers shown. LOVE SALINAS.
I could not wait for his class to end.
Nothing personal but he's just not a good teacher. Unorganized, rude, condescending, especially toward non-majors.
Ego-stroking lectures and rigid conservatism define the Salinas' insufferable demeanor. Empathy is alien, rendering flexibility a mere fantasy. Endure insipid rants at your peril.
Entertaining, so easy, nice guy. I'm taking another class with him next semester!

reviews.comment: great professor, class is easy to pay attention, cares for students, posts slideshows, you should take him

Lectures are meandering and nonsensical as he'll cover stuff you don't need to know then bounce back for no reason to something else. Easy, yes, but useless and so are his connects he so desperately brags about. Better options out there, take someone else.
I love Salinas! He is the best and is a super nice and caring teacher. Take him!

Salinas is a favorite of mine, and I wish I had done better in his class. But he cares so much, has the most fun lectures, and tries to connect in-class topics to the contemporary world. Stay on top of your notes, review them frequently, and email him with questions. Same with the paper: DO NOT PUT IT OFF. I will take him again, thank you Salinas!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Salinas is a king! His lectures are funny, relevant, and engaging. Tests are hard, you have to verbatim memorize everything but other than that relatively low work load. One paper, it is fun and creative with clear instructions. Great class!

Attendance may be mandatory but honestly his lectures are so interesting that you'll want to show up!! Professor Salinas really cares about what he is teaching and makes his lessons relatable for students. He really cares about his students succeeding.

Dr. Salinas is great! The class is graded on 5 speeches throughout the semester, but if you put some effort into them you will do well. It is not hard if you listen and show up to class. He makes lectures fun and entertaining. Take him for public speaking if you can!

He's AWESOME. His classes are always so interesting. His tests are difficult, yes, but if you study hard, you'll do great! You can tell that he genuinely cares about everything he teaches. He also talks about current pop culture events a lot and makes connections to topics that are easier for our generation to understand :) TAKE HIM.

Definitely take this professor! Professor Salinas was incredible this semester and it's really clear that he wants his students to succeed and does his best to make that happen. For the critical essay, follow the rubric and the outline provided to you and you'll be fine. Test questions also largely come from his notes! Loved this class :)

Very enigmatic guy, it's not the most interesting subject matter but he's an amazing public speaker so it's not bad. tests are literally so easy, he pulls straight from the slides. easy grader on the paper. very nice and cares a lot about teaching this. he gives lots of examples in class which is helpful. would definitely recommend taking him

A really good professor who cares about what he's teaching, and better yet, knows what he is talking about. Will sometimes go on tangents on really interesting stories, but his class is very entertaining and would definitely take him again if I could!

He is one of the best professors at SMU. He makes lectures interesting and engaging, and is super funny while doing it. Uses real life situations in his lectures. If you can take him, I definitely would.
Great professor! Genuinely wants his students to learn the topics taught, and doesn't overload with homework/projects/etc. Extra credit is given for going to office hours too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Salinas is a great professor because he always uses every tool to make his classes engaging and accessible. He is very concise about posting material online, making class fun to go to, and outlining what will be expected on exams and papers. His office hours helped me a lot, aiding me in a direction for my thesis and sources I could study.

Wonderful professor! I took this class without knowing if I wanted to pursue this track, and after taking it I definitely want to! While there are only two tests and a paper (in additional to small online, open-note reading quizzes), his grading criteria is extremely clear. I would definitely recommend taking his class!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He lectures quite heavily, so skipping the class won't help. However, he does post the slides and is available outside of class. His test are NOT multiple choice, so it's best to read the slides verbatim. He can be awkward in office hours, but once you get to know him, he isn't that bad. Be aware of a 20 page paper!!

Hes an incredible lecturer. If you dont go to class you might get a little lost on the material, but attendance is mandatory so you should go anyway. 2 tests and a cumulative finalall SUPER straightforward. There is a 20 page paper but dont be intimidated by it. It is not hard at all and he is very willing to help.

One of the best professors I've had here. Really good at communicating the material, makes it comes to life. Great guy, knows all of the students by name and genuinely cares about you. Can't recommend him enough. Also a suprisingly huge Astroworld guy

there are 6 speeches and a final. If you don't like your grade you can either re-do the speech for a better grade or talk to him in private and he will boost your grade. Super easy and is entertaining

Professor Salinas is by far my favorite professor at SMU. I am going to take another one of his classes again next semester. His public speaking class is very comfortable and fun and he provides you with awesome feedback. He also really wants his students to succeed so he gives you a chance to make up your grade if you need it. TAKE HIM!

Salinas is very entertaining, but his tests and quizzes often feature information that was never covered.  There is one 20-page paper assigned, and it's not too bad.  The instructions are super vague, as is most of the other information in the class.  Memorize his PowerPoints verbatim to do well on the test, and you'll be fine.

Dr. Salinas is a very humorous and open-minded person. The tests are basically completely based on the Powerpoints. You could probably not ever read and still get an A. However, he does not answer emails. It's just strange because even though he is very funny, he is also a bit aloof and cold. I feel awkward and unwelcome when I talk to him.
Salinas makes the class interesting. He's a funny guy and the class is pretty easy. Be prepared for the 20-page paper, which is also pretty easy assuming you follow the rubric.

Absolutely AMAZING teacher! Hands down the best lecturer I've ever had. Completely disregard the other comments  it is by NO means difficult or boring. Study guide for major tests-if review, SUPER easy got 100s. Friendly & easy to talk to. Start writing major essay early and talk to him throughout writing it. TAKE CLASS EVEN IF YOU DON'T HAVE TO!!
I am a straight A student and I got a C in his class. He gives you no direction in office hours. He is extremely boring. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS UNLESS YOU HAVE TOO!!!

so boring. literally never got off the internet during class. that being said, still made an A. he's easy, tells funny stories, and puts his slideshows online. he gives out a study guide for his major tests. hint for essay: follow his grading rubric EXACTLY. made a 100. definitely gauranteed my A for the class.

Although the material may not be too interesting at times, Dr. Salinas finds ways to make it interesting! He always cracks jokes in class and is very chill while teaching. If you show up to class and put in some effort, getting a good grade won't be hard. Everyone should take a class with Dr. Salinas!

Claims to be unbiased while constantly pushing liberal agenda in discrete ways.  Assigns lots of homework and readings that are never even brought up in class.  Can be quite disorganized, often wasting valuable class time struggling to pull up presentations or materials.  Treats students differently based off their responses to his questions.

This course feels poorly planned with littl cohesion between classes and assignemnts. It is unclear how material connects to assignments, and feedback does not provide meaningful insight into performance.
He is so full of himself and that makes for a bad teaching ingredient.
A complete mess, totally unorganized, you never know what's going on in class, his grading is random af, one day you'll make an A then next a C on the same quality work, and he is SO FULL of himself.

This is not a hard class if you put in minimal effort but the class was very disorganized, and most of the time no one knew what we were supposed be doing. Lots of busy work in between assignments and he takes off points just because he felt like it- no reasoning behind it. Other than that, pretty easy way to knock out 1313
I didn't enjoy his class or teaching. He doesn't know what he's doing and he's here for the money grab rather than actually teach.
Overrated and he's not good teacher. Just assigns tons of busy work.

JUST LOTS OF WORK if u go to class and study you will be okay but not an easy A. nice guy but LOTS of assignments and you will have writing to do on top of many random assignments and a midterm and cumulative final..... lectures are boring and long and you have to pay attention does give study guide for midterm and final which is helpful
Not that hard but not a very good teacher, tries to hard to be popular and a people pleaser, which is sad.
Easy class but this guy is obnoxious. Way too much work for a cc and clas time is him fawning over himself and you're expected to fawn too. Nobody know why.

Grades pretty leniently. Lectures were decent. The workload is kind of crazy for a 1000 level class (coming from a senior Stem major). He came across as pretty condescending at times. Requires you to buy subscriptions to news sites and asks you to purchase quite a lot of books (most you don't need).

The quintessential elitist journo...
Very relatable and chill professor. Gives lots of extra credit opportunities. Easy grader. Lectures can be a little boring, however.

My favorite professor all semester. He grades fairly and his class is engaging. There are extra credit opportunities if needed, but it's easy to get an A without them. He is very understanding and accessible. I really recommend taking his class.
Professor Scudder was my favorite professor this semester. He makes his classes interesting and grades fairly. I would definitely take another class of his.

Prof. Scudder is a great guy, very passionate about his teaching. At the beginning of the semester, I found him patronizing but eventually grew to appreciate the remarks he makes based on his experiences. Good balance of big and small assignments & cooler 1-on-1, so go to office hours. Good feedback and a fun class!
Really cool teacher, really hard to fail this class let alone get a C
Terrible teacher. Talks at students, not with them. Doesn't encourage participation, stifles creativity. Avoid this class if you value your education.

Professor Scudder is amazing. His classes are exceptionally engaging, thanks to his method of integrating his journalistic experiences with theoretical exercises. He has a clear grading rubric, tests are easy if you half pay attention in class, 5 random attendance checks and he also has various extra credit options.

Prof. Scudder is new to SMU and off to a great start. He teaches through hypothetical situations and his own experiences as a journalist that makes it interesting and allows students to apply the learned material. He is a fair grader, provides ample extra credit opportunities, and helps students outside of class. He's a great prof and great guy too

reviews.comment: AMAZING. 5 random attendance checks during the semester. lets you go to whatever block of class you want. weekly discussion boards and quizzes, a midterm, a final, and two 3-5 page papers. gives incredible feedback on papers and very clear with his expectations. Offered tons of EC. very approachable and nice guy. really got me to love journalism.

reviews.comment: 100% would take this class again! Professor Scudder explains everything in detail and helps when his students need it. He now teaches JOUR 1313 which almost everyone in the class took because we loved him in JOUR 2312. Best Teacher!
He is super fun and nice and is a interesting teacher

Just because you've worked as a journalist does not mean you can teach journalism and this guy epitomizes this (though his "journalism" isn't all that great either).  Not only did he fail to teach anything useful, he also was unavailable for office hours and didn't return emails while being chaotically disorganized and useless.

Great Class! Attendance isn't exactly mandatory but he does have 5 random attendance checks throughout the semester so be on the lookout. Tests are pretty straightforward as long as you look at his study guide.

reviews.comment: He's great

class was not hard to too much work, but 50% of your grade comes from 2 tests, the other 50% from discussion boards, 2 papers, and random attendance checks. The lectures were interesting and engaging and the tests were not too hard but the average is around an 80

I went into this class unsure of what it would be like and worried it would be lecture heavy. Prof. Scudder made it so interesting. He is very knowledgable and passionate which makes it engaging. He gives opportunities for extra credit and provides students with what they need in order to succeed. Would highly recommend taking this class!!

Absolutely my favorite teacher. Please take Charlie Scudder if you have the opportunity. He cares so much about what he is teaching and makes a somewhat difficult class fun and interesting. I wish I could have him for every class. He is the best please take news reporting or anything with him. He also has so much experience in this field.

I LOVE CHARLIE SCUDDER. Assignments definitely take a lot of outside work, but I love the class so much I really don't mind. He is SO passionate about what he does and I look forward to going to class every day. It is honestly so much fun and he loves what he does. Take him.

If you have the chance to take Charlie PLEASE DO. He is so passionate about what he teaches and will always be available to help in any way. News reporting is not fun and it can be challenging but this class was hands down my favorite. He cares about his students and their success and he's just overall a really awesome guy. You'd be missing out!

reviews.comment: Chillest teacher for advanced corporate for sure. Tests aren't bad if you study the material she gives you. Very generous on partial credit, even on MCQ's. Class itself can be boring but she's a very sweet woman.
Nice professor for corporate. She cares about her students and is available outside of class for clarifications.

Professor Haendler was a good teacher. A lot of the material is pretty straightforward. Go to the lectures and review her review slides for tests. For multiple-choice type questions on tests, even if you get them wrong, she will still give you full credit. Overall, the chillest teacher for advanced corporate.
Really easy class, pay attention or go through the ALTS program and this class will become your easiest class

Senior Design semester 2 was much better than semester 1. There was far less busywork and fewer mandatory lectures, which made it easier to focus on implementing the project. The only required assignments were the midterm and final deliverables, which were largey copied from semester 1.

Many intermediate assignments and meetings felt like busywork and got in the way of the main project. Overall, the more you write for your submissions, the better your grade usually is, so it helps to write as much as you can for each assignment. The lectures were interesting but largely unrelated to the project itself.

reviews.comment: Dr. Chiao gave excellent  lectures. They are funny and focused. I have never had such engaging lectures before.

He gave the best lectures ever! The topics on IP and ethics are so interesting and exciting from his lectures for engineering students. I had never have such great lectures. I hope he can teach every class

Best teacher ever! 
His slides are very clear. No need to take notes because he gave all the slides in Canvas.

Dr. Deluzio is one of the best professors I have had at SMU... definitely take her class, she cares and if you do the work its not hard to get a good grade

reviews.comment: One of the worst classes I have taken. Prof. Crabill sits up at the front of the room and has a conversation with himself for the entirety of the class. Outside of class, he is available, but you won't get anything out of it because he is going to go so far in depth and bring in so much irrelevant detail. He doesn't explain his tests either.

This class was the worst. he gives a very vague idea of what will been the tests. he gives a "study guide" with a list of topics that can be so broad its impossible to know what we are supposed to study, the readings are confusing. His tests are also confusing to navigate and most of your grade is based off of 2 tests
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Easily the best professor I've had. He is open to feedback, and really cares about making sure that you understand the material. There are some written assignments that allow you to engage with the material, and he is pretty lenient on format because he prioritizes the content. He encourages participation and there is no stupid answer with him.

Professor Crabill is the best lecturer Ive had so far at SMU. I had him at 8am and still he was very lively and really got me into the material. There are 10 assignments that if you compete will be an easy 25% of grade in class. Two papers are kind of hard but not long. Midterms are not cumulative.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is clear about what he wants and how he wants it. He is not a tough grader, so you can easily get an A if you turn in everything on time and show up to class. If you have a problem, let him know. He is a philosophy professor so he does try his best to be fair. You'll have 10 writing assignments 1 midterm and 1 final (non-accumulative)

Not a huge fan of this prof. He makes you read all day, every day which is awful. Also, it didn't feel like a good environment where I was comfortable sharing ideas. He clearly knows a lot which is good though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Take this class! No homework, quizzes, or tests. Super easy and fun. Victoria wants her students to grow and become comfortable when being in the spotlight. She has the best personality.
Victoria is the BEST professor for this course. She makes an 8am class really fun. You do have to show up & participate but it was worth it. Would definitely recommend her.
Very easy class, you just have to be willing to be loud and embarrass yourself. Kind of strict attendance/tardiness policy.

For an 8AM class, Victoria makes the class really enjoyable. Most of the class consists of acting games and exercises which are then used in individual and partnered scenes. Victoria is super understanding and a great teacher, but she wants some effort. The best teacher to take for THEA 2311.

Having an 8am is not ideal but if you have to have one take THEA. It is so easy, you literally play games and do acting exercises. It definitely wakes you up in the morning, and is actually really fun. Just show up and you will get an A! She is awesome and so understanding!

Absolutely love Victoria! Even though her class is an 8 am class, it is fun and will go by super fast. There is no test in her class, and only like 3 things of homework. Your grade is based on participation. You don't need any background in theater. You will LOVE her!
Terrible.

Do not take this class unless you like torturing yourself. The first test was nearly impossible. I think the majority of the class actually failed it. The lectures are extremely dry. Even if you spend hours taking notes and studying, do not think that will mean you will do well.
don't take this class. no test reviews. no canvas, no lectures posted. all reading the TEXTBOOK. tests are too specific. all he does is go through power points the entire time way to fast.

He is insanely smart and you learn about some cool things like how wind and weather actually work. Every lecture is important and he doesn't do online materials so you really have to stay on top of stuff. There is no homework at all but there are four tests that are basically impossible without taking good notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Yapp is extremely nice and caring outside of class, and it's clear he's very passionate about Geology! He covers material efficiently and clearly. If you like Geology, take his classes! A head's up: Contrary to popular rumors, this isn't a blow off. The tests are brutal, draw on obscure details, and heavily rely on the book's info too.

Crayton Yapp is a terrible professor who does not care about how his students perform in the class. His lectures are insanely boring and dry making it hard to sit through his class and take notes. You will have to read 1-2 chapters of the textbook every week which will take a good chunk of time taking several hours. The labs are hard also.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Wow, really just an awful experience. The professor is very nice, but his "lectures" consist of looking at slides with very little explanation as to what you're looking at. Textbook helps, but the tests are incredibly difficult and cover very little of what is "taught" in class. And they're scantron, so you can't even see what you missed.

It was a hard class for me, especially the labs because they took a long time especially as you had to teach yourself. The lectures are REALLY dry. There are only four tests and he drops the lowest grade, which is how i managed to pass. I had to read the textbook a lot. He's a nice person, I just didn't care for the subject.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: EXTREMELY boring lecture, most people don't even go. Doesn't try to get to know students at all. Tests are hard and the majority of the people do poorly on them. Don't take this as a blow off course bc it is actually pretty hard and you'll have no prior knowledge to coast off of, as you likely do with chemistry, physics, etc.

He makes you sign into class so find someone who will do it for you. I found that going to class was not mandatory, the tests are straight from the book. It's not that hard to get an A if you study the book well for the test.

Nice guy who is really interested in teaching his students geology. The class is a little tough and the lectures are a little dry, but overall its not too bad. I bombed the first test but ended up with an A in the class. The class gets way easier as the year goes on.

great, nice guy. Very helpful if you have questions and knows a lot about the subject. Test are REALLY hard, though. Dont expect to study one day before the test and get a good grade. Had to drop the class

It's a pretty boring lecture, and he's difficult to hear if you sit in the back. He's really helpful outside of class, and is nice about questions. If you're interested in geology, this is a easy enough class to take. You must read the textbook to pass the tests, though.
Would not take another course with this professor.

Never had a more caring and invested prof. Works harder than students to push you and makes sure you're learning and producing good work. Knows his stuff and has his opinions but they were all very helpful. Decent workload so you can focus on what matters. He pays attention to students so much. Fave class I ever took at UMN
Wonderful teacher, he makes you work hard but he gives you endless amount of feedback. He will turn you into a writer. And a good one.

This man is the journalism divisions equivalent of a resident mad scientist. he is a genius, and his teaching method is sublime, but he is completely insane... in a good way. he doesnt accept shoddy work. may God have mercy on the fool that turns in shoddy work, or pays little attention to the readings. he will find you, and he will call on you.
he knows what he's talking about.  the class isn't easy, but he is really helpful and wants people to learn about the law for "real life" and do well in the class.  great professor.
No Comments
He intimidates students.  If you're not cut out to basically stretching the truth, you're not going to cut it in his class.  A perfect teacher for future tabloid writers.

Flournoy is very experienced and knows his stuff in depth. He has an intersting sense of humour and really teaches how to become a serious journalist. The investigative or computer-assisted stories he assigns are really tough but very instructing.

If you have already taken precal before this class isnt hard. Dont pay attention or do the hw. Do the quizzes and go to class so you can get the drops. 2 days before the test print the review and work through it 3 times. Prof struggles to teach but has good office hours. There was a big cure on the final. Final can replace a bad exam

Professor Cumiskey is the sweetest lady and wants you to succeed. You can go to her with questions whenever you need. She went super fast when teaching and didn't explain every step well. There were 12 quizzes, but you could drop your 3 lowest grades. There was no homework and 4 exams.

Cumiskey is a nice lady, but she is a terrible teacher. Literally just rewrites word for word what the textbook says onto the whiteboard, and you just have to sit there and copy the work. Show up to office hours and make sure she knows you, she will cut you some slack. DO NOT miss a lecture because you will fall behind quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Cumiskey is hands down one of the sweetest teachers, with that being said I would have never taken this class if I would have known her teaching style. She faces the board and copies examples down for an hour and a half. She tends to make mistakes in her own work and fails to correct them. Do not take this class if you struggle with math.

she does not actually know what she is talking about. she just copies printed notes onto the board. the homework is nothing like any of the assessments. quizzes are take-home so those are an easy A. but the tests are impossible to do well on.

Worst math teacher I have ever had, avoid at all costs. Doesn't actually teach. Stands with her back to the class and does example problems on the board. Frequently messes up her work and is corrected by students. I haven't learned anything in her class. If math is already a struggle for you, don't take her class and if you dare, get a tutor

Professor Cuminsky is the sweetest professor ever. She really really wants you to succeed. If you have questions, ask them in class, she's always very kind. Always at her office hours and willing to stay after class if you want to clarify something from that days lectures. If you pay attention in class and do the worksheets, you'll be fine.

Mrs. Cumiskey is an amazing professor. She genuinely wants you to succeed in her class and be prepared for your later math classes. She is a bit quirky which I loved too. Attendance isn't mandatory for her class but if you miss less than 3 classes she'll replace your lowest test with the final if it's higher. She did for fall 2018 class at least.

Mrs. Cumiskey is very sweet and always available in her office hours, which is very helpful for clarifying information because the class does go fairly fast. She does lecture the entire class and has follow-along notes. She really cares about her students and making sure they are prepared for calculus.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: she just does problems on the board. thats all she does all class. she tends to mess up within her own work quite frequently as well. pretty bland as far as excitement in the class

Jane is a very sweet older lady who is passionate about math. 80% of the time has her back turned, facing board. You'll have 1-2 take home quizzes a week that are graded by a TA, who is an easy grader. Tests can be hard, but if you do the study guide and take notes during class you'll be fine. Very nice during office hours.

She will show up outside her office hours times if you need her too. Teaches a bit like a recommended but not needed to pass, also gives test reviews with similar problems to the tests. She does do take home quizzes that are worth a grade but really help cover the material and prepare for tests. Overall one of the best math teachers I have ever had

Professor Curran is a fascinating man and it is interesting to hear about his experiences. Since the class meets just once a week, the lectures are long. Most of your grade comes from a couple of essays/exams that can really spring up on you if you aren't prepared, so be ready to get started well ahead of time.

Incredibly intelligent man, but sitting in lecture for three hours at a time is incredibly boring. Very cool to learn from this guy but he is a very tough grader. 70% of your grade comes from assignments in the last weeks of class which makes it very stressful. Very tough A.

His exams are based on lectures that have no slides or textbook to go with them and all the questions are subject to bias. Additionally on exams he expects you to repeat verbatim what he has said in class or he will take off points. He is old and old schooled. DO NOT TAKE unless you have a photographic memory.

Professor Curran is extremely knowledgeable on bioethics and I learned a lot. He assigns lots of readings but he goes over them in class. He provides you with his notes for the whole semester, so if you miss class you won't be missing too much. Don't slack off on the papers, they're basically the only grades you have in the class besides the exams.

Fantastic Professor.  He's an incredibly famous man for his dissent from the catholic church.  I loved getting to know him outside of class as well.  Phenomenal man and phenomenal academic.  Taking his class was a delight.
Great professor. Very knowledgable about the class buuutt it's a tough course. It is by no means an easy A!

He is a great professor who really knows his subject particular with issue of bioethics. Now he is quite hard but you will learn a lot from his class. But the class can be somewhat boring. Still, he is definitely the expert in the field. SMU is very fortunate to have him.

He's a nice old man. The layout of the course is nice and structured and he stays on course.  Its really boring though, the tests are hard(even though he says there easy), the papers stink if you don't read the book. going to class is a must but they're a snore.

Professor Curran is great if you're the type who falls asleep during powerpoint lectures. His are all on the chalkboard and he gives an outline of discussion.  Lectures are very thorough and he encourages input from the class. He's easy to approach if you have questions about the class.  It is hard work though, you will have to read 3 books and write a paper for each.  There's also a midterm which is based on the lecture. So take notes and attendance is important!

Excellent Professor.  Catholic U's loss was our gain.  Take his classes if you get the chance.  You have to put forth effort - it's not easy to make an A - but you will get so much out of learning from this world-renowned scholar.
Stay away from this professor; he practices favoritism and does not support students in class. Does not give clear feedback on submitted assignments.
He practices favoritism based on people's nationality

I loved Professor Desai. This class was very applicable to real world content and I thoroughly enjoyed going to this class. It is a reasonable amount of work, and he is always willing to help if you are confused.

She blames students for not doing well on exams because we "not studying correctly" when in reality 1/4 the class has C's because of her lack of ability to teach. She gives way too much, unnecessary information for topics and this ends up just confusing you more. She is very available for office hours but, you will find there also not helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor DeArman is blessing on SMU's campus. Absolutely recommend taking her!

Class is awkwardly organized by topics, repetitive. She's the degree advisor teaching a college course and it shows. She doesnt explain complex terms well or at all. Her project has no directives models, she'll give a rando grade on it w no feedback. Has to curve tests highly bc noone knows whats going on in class

This class is easy if you just pay attention in lecture. DeArman is a great communicator and she very clearly lays out expectations. She also genuinely wants to see her students succeed so if you are struggling she will put in the extra effort to help you succeed. One of those professors who really cares!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Honestly she is one of my favorite professors at SMU. Her lectures are not boring and she makes them more fun by turning them into class discussions. She really values all students opinions. Her Monday trivia's are also really helpful to prepare for exams. I really enjoyed this class and all the topics covered. She's awesome take her!

Her lectures are confusing and often incorrect. Feels like she's pretending to be a teacher. Doesn't know the material well, makes frequent errors. Attendance policy is strict but class time is useless. She tries to be fun but its forced and mad annoying. Take someone else for the ccs

I didn't mind her as a prof, she was a decent person who wants her students to succeed. However, the homework is time-consuming and takes several hours to complete. The tests are heavily weighted but don't really reflect what we do in class, which can be frustrating. Quizzes are the same 12 questions every week, so at least those are predictable.

Prof DeArman was literally one of the kindest professors. She was not difficult with attendance and you can miss 6 classes with no questions. If you miss just communicate and she wont care. LOVE HER! Best Prof ever! She literally was so understanding and helpful about everything. TAKE HER!!! Tests weren't hard and extra credit is easy to get.

The worst teacher at smu. her class is pointless and shouldn't be taught. it hard and the grading makes no sense. the projects are tedious and unhelpful. she snaps and overreacts about certain things.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor difficult to deal w disruptive and can fast switch from acting understanding to losing temper and snapping out students. Grades hard and inconsistent based on mood in a credit only course we have to take and she loudly talks during every test so its impossible to even focus. Projects tedious af

Mrs. Dearman teaches a class that should not be taught at SMU. Unfortunately, although it's required for a markets and culture major, the class is highly pointless. She does not have a grading scale and grades all assignments based on her mood. She wastes the first 40 minutes of each class on gong over homework. The Practice is only worth 2 points

Shes tries but her class is so pointless its ridiculous like you will never need anything she teaches. Grading is unpredictable and she can overreact in class when she thinks your laughing at her or point out a mistake, plus attendance is mandated but unhelpful.
Sputters nonsense constantly contradicting herself, cant answer questions about her own material and forces her politics on you in an impressionaby dull confusing course that has no point.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: this class should not exist and she should not teach
She is the nicest sweetest lady ever but the class is so pointless its insane. You learn things you will never ever use outside of college.

Prof. Dearman is such an inspirational sociologist and professor. She encourages you to take charge of your own research and find things to study that youre passionate about. Workload is managable and she is always available to help you out in office house and after class. Projects are actually kind of fun to do too!

Professor DeArman is one of my absolute favorites. I took one of her classes just for a pillar and it ended up inspiring me to minor in sociology. She is truly passionate about sociology, knows what she is talking about, and wants her students to do well. I highly recommend taking any of her classes!
Super awesome, take her!!!!

Professor Leslie is a wonderful professor, she makes you fail in love with sociology, she is relaxed in class that lecture becomes enjoyable,tests are easy if you do the readings, power points very clear and for the term projects shes is there to help even on weekends!! that's how much she cares for her students. PLEASE TAKE HER, highly recommended

She is one of the nicest professors I have ever had at SMU.  She is a good teacher and genuinely cares about her students.  She wants everyone to do well, which is extremely important.  She knows the material presented and makes class interesting for students.  Just go to class, smile, and display interest, and you will do well.
Very Interesting and helpful. She is always willing to take time out to help clarify information for you. She is a great professor!!
Awesome teacher! Communicates well with students, and does what she can to keep the class interesting. I definitely recommend her.

This professor was given the monumental task of teaching decades of discoveries in the hardest field of physics to students who struggle to understand what mitochondria do, in the span of 16 weeks. Despite this, I still feel like I can explain exactly how and why electron bonds work the way they do. He's also funny!
Lectures are not well prepared and everything is confusing

Dr. Matthews has been one of my favorite professors at SMU! He is approachable outside of class and organizes his lectures methodically. He could have made his tests extremely difficult but instead he wrote his exams to be very fair! Practice exams are similar to the real ones.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Matthews is the GOAT! He is incredibly friendly and easy to talk to. He explains the concepts well (p-chem 2 is confusing in general). He gives extra credit on the exams and curves like crazy. We also get a drop exam. He could've easily murdered everyone, but he chose not to: the exam averages were always in the 90s. Love this guy!
Take another instructor if you can.

his lectures were okay, but it was more helpful to read the textbook, so most people didn't even attend class. exams were doable. also he does record his lectures but doesnt provide everyone access to them unless you have an excuse for why you didn't attend class...not a fan of the tone he uses while teaching and his inflexibility with some things

This class is difficult, it is PChem after all. I think he had his expectations set too high at first. The tests started off crazy, and were near impossible to finish in time. I give him a lot of credit for adjusting his expectations later. He's very accessible outside of class, and he's patient and willing to help you understand the concepts.

Dr. Matthews honestly struggled a bit during lecture because it was his first time teaching. However, he is SUPER approachable outside of class and never makes you feel stupid for not understanding right away. I think he is the most patient professor I have ever had. The course is very test oriented so do the practice tests and GO TO OFFICE HOURS!
Dupont is so sweet and encouraging. She grades pretty easily and always gives meaningful comments. This class was an easy A, but I got so much from it! I definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: the sweetest professor ever. so understanding and caring. her classes are fairly easy but you learn so much if you participate and read. weekly discussion posts and assignments, but all are easy. midterm and final are take home. couple short essays which are very subjective and fun to write. ive learned so much about religion with them.
the sweetest prof ever. this has been my favorite class in college. she knows a lot and is so caring. i HIGHLY recommend her WL2355 course (especially if you are interested in religion).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: super sweet! willing to chat after class. I sent in multiple EC opportunities and they were all approved. happy to discuss your grade. I missed a BUNCH of assignments for personal reasons and was still able to turn them all in for almost full credit. lectures are not super relevant, just do the reading and you'll be fine! 9 excused absences!

She is clearly so well educated and enthusiastic about the material, and it translated well into the learning environment. She is super sweet and reachable outside of class (even kind of late). She wants you to pass and will do so much to help guide you in the right direction for essays.
You take her because she's easy not because she's good.

Professor DuPont is great, and fosters a very comfortable environment for people of all faiths. She grades easier than her colleague. A ton of reading is assigned, but it is typically able to be skimmed so that you can understand enough for discussions. It can be overwhelming, but is ultimately easy. Both professors are very caring and intelligent.

Professor Dupont is an incredible professor. I took her for WL2355, where I initially viewed the class as overwhelming due to all the readings, It is very doable! She and professor Marshall created a very warm, welcoming environment. It is also a great class for CCs.
I love Prof. Dupont so much! if you thinking of taking a 3000 level class she is EASILY the best prof. She is so kind and helpful.

Professor Dupont is one of the best professors I have had at SMU. She is extremely caring and provides good feedback. Class is an easy A if you participate (even a bit) and complete all assignments. This is a great class to take for the Spanish minor.

ProfessorDuPont is very nice and understanding.Class was shared with another professor. There's a lot of assignments/readings but they are really short and easy to do.The topics are interesting/interactive. Just know that you'll have to spend time on this class since there are essays,presentations,midterm and cumulative test but it's not bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The class is amazing, and if you need the credit I would definitely take it. You will need all books, and have to write essays in which you choose the topic. Grades include 2 midterm papers and 1 final essay. The class is fun, filled with discussion, movies and you even get to read off of plays. would definitely recommend her, she is a sweetheart.

If the TAs weren't unorganized and rude towards students this would have been a fun class. Other than that, it should have been an easy A, but the TAs grade based on how they feel about that particular student. One TA didnt even show up the entire semester

If the TAs weren't unorganized and rude towards students this would have been a fun class. Other than that, it should have been an easy A, but the TAs grade based on how they feel about that particular student. Even though most of the time they aren't paying attention. One TA didnt even show up the entire semester

Most unique class I've taken at SMU. Course is entirely centered around case studies and live negotiations, so there are no quizzes or exams. Your grade is based on attendance and participation. Some of the grading is weird tho. He also brings in guest speakers. Prof Denson is super cool and I would def recommend his class.

Only graded on attendance and participation, so no quizzes or tests. The most unique class I've taken at SMU. Literally the only thing you do is study cases and negotiate them. Sometimes he brings in guest speakers. I will say that some of the grading doesn't make sense tho. Prof Denson is a rly cool dude and I would recommend his class!

Only graded on participation and attendance, so if you take this class you need to be ready to talk! Super fun and unique class. No tests, quizzes, or written work. Literally the only thing you do is study cases and then negotiate them. Sometimes he brings in guest speakers. Prof Denson is a rly cool dude. Would def recommend this class!
TAs and him are literally having a picnic in the back of class

The TAs and him are fully having a picnic in the back of class while we are left to negotiate for 3 hours. I just dont get it. Getting us pizza at the end of class doesnt make up for the TAs grading unfairly and stressing every single person out. Nor does it cancel the gossip we hear yall talk about in the back of class
do not take
These TAs are probably the most unebeneficial TAs ive ever had.  dont help whatsoever, and just gossip about students in front of them

I have 2 other important finals tomorrow, and they just sent out the final negotiation sheet we're supposed to be having tomorrow. Why do they send everything so late. The TAs grade unfairly and send things late all the time. What kind of a class is this

puts basically no effort into this class. id rather take organic chemistry than this class ever again. nothing is remotely organized in this class. TAs act like everything you ask is a burden, and he kinda just watches all class with no input

TAs tell students class is cancelled an hour before class starts. Students are supposed to be told ahead of time, respect goes both ways. This has happened more than once, which tells me the first time wasnt a mistake

Take any other professor. He didnt even tell us class was cancelled on May 4th, come to find out him and the TAs treated specific students with special treatment and didnt tell the whole class. Interesting, no? I wonder what the Cox department would think about this

Thought this class would be a much different class. I never heard good reviews other than the fact he has a few good connections, but so does half of the cox department. I don't truly think he wants the best for students. I know many of us don't agree with the way they grade our cases with 0 feedback. Attitude sucks yet I'm supposed to show respect

I have 5 other finals to take, and every single class cancelled on Tuesday except this one. We're doing another case within 2 days as if this is beneficial at all. Now I have to waste my time going to that class instead of studying for my finals. I have real classes to focus on

Its the end of the semester, Im still unsure what my grade is in the class because they dont update grades regularly as they should. TAs grade everything im pretty sure, i dont think anyone has made a 100 on a case. Its pretty odd the way they grade with no feedback, i know many cases i deserved a higher grade. Many other students feel the same
I thought this class would be completely different. I wish they actually put in effort into making class fun. It used to be my favorite class in the beginning, and now it's just a disappointing class

I personally would LOVE to know how the TAs grade our cases. Because i contribute all the time and put in time for these cases that they dont see, and somehow im getting grades between B-C?? I know 100% i deserved between an 85-100 on all of my cases. Be so for real. They seriously have a God complex. Have some respect and grade truthfully

As hard the truth may be to hear, the comments below are fairly accurate. I dont think ive ever disliked any of my past TAs until now. They dont respond to emails, lack ability to grade honestly, and act like theyre above everyone when all they do is sit on their computers for the entire class and contribute nothing. Yea... avoid if you can fr

Interesting how rude the TAs are. They have no compassion or common sense clearly as they openly gossip about students and then we have to hear what they said about us from other people. Maybe focus on yourself? Or maybe focus on the 10 assignments you still need to grade, as we've been waiting for weeks now. Orrrr maybe actually learn how to grade

Very interesting material but presented in a way that is horribly confusing and frustrating. The class is a series of mock negotiations where you take the role of a party.
