Little feedback and grading is a mystery. Apparently an 80 for an assignment is good? Participation matters but it depends on how the TA's think you did. Would not reccomend.
I've never seen a professor leave before their students before. It's kind of rude to us, who are forced to stay after the 1:50 mark to finish the negotiation we've been having for an hour already.
we are learning nothing. we wait for our grades for over months. worst class ive ever taken what a waste of money
TAs are checked out, they dont respond to emails and neither does he. Some people have missed over 5 classes and had people sign in for them, and he's taking this attendance thing way too seriously.
Avoid this class if you can. Many people I know are taking this for their minor, and they all feel the same way. I cannot believe I'm paying thousands of dollars to take this class

TAs dont even know how to properly grade and its obvious he gives it to them to do. Every other professor accepted my doctors note and they know ive been seeing doctors for something I have being trying to figure out, and he was the only one not willing to be understanding. be so for real right now
Doesnt respond to emails, argues with students who dont agree with his teaching style, and tries to make our education even more difficult by being uncooperative
Most difficult professor i have ever encountered. Definitely bringing this up to the cox department

Let me get this straight, I ACTUALLY used my absences for sick days and now im being told 1 extra absence is gonna cost me my grade? Do i need to show my medical records and tests ive had done this semester? I just dont get it. Why is my grade in this class lower than my biology classes? The grading is ridiculous and unfair

Im taking this class for my minor. The TA's don't even respond to your emails, we are basically teaching ourselves how to negotiate. Gives unfair grades, not sure why my participation grade is in the 70s when I literally participate and work hard outside of class. Doesnt even tell us why we received the grades he gives on cases. honestly baffled

Such a waste of time. Every negotiation is pointless, I didn't learn anything, and there's always like 3 people who lead every one. Had a C the whole semester but somehow ended with a B so ig I can't be that mad about it. Just save yourself and take a different course it's not worth it, he's mean.
This is the worst most laziest professor at this school and likely out of the entire nation. Does nothing and knows none of us.

Denson is a very hands off professor, and the majority of the grading is done by the TA's. All of the negotiations are in groups (minus one), and it sometimes feels like your grade is dependent on your team members versus the effort you put in. It's a good class to meet new people in, and as long as you show up and participate- you'll get a B.

Great real-world preparation! Denson has a hands-off approach to the class that works very well, but you MUST participate to get out of the class a good experience & grade. The cases have a wide variety but the TAs are very helpful. Great way to get to know people and not just sit and listen to a boring lecture. MUST take class

This professor does zero grading. All of the TAs do it for him and is graded over a month later. Asking him for help out of class is nearly impossible i dont think he could name 5 students in our class. He completely destroyed my curiosity and i would not have taken this class if i knew him beforehand.
I was excited to take this class, b

The TAs do all of the grading and it shows. Reaching out to the professor is no help (multiple people in our class did it and made no headway). Difficult to do well if you don't have good TAs which most people in our class agreed we didn't.

This class is so much fun. It is the most engaging class I've ever taken and I made several great friends. You need to participate because the class quickly separates into lions and sheep, and you want to be seen as a good negotiator to lead your team. Denson, however, is sometimes an unfair grader and he often rambles about his "war stories."
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: BEST CLASS AT SMU! Must take class for sure.

A man of the people. Favorite class this semester by a mile, and one that translates into real life really well. Grading system is ruthless at times, but it's a reflection of what you put into it. If you participate, go to class, read beforehand, and work with your classmates, you'll be fine. Best business elective and prof I could've chosen.
One of the best classes at SMU. Denson knows what he's doing and I actually gained life skills. Make sure you participate in the negotiations and go to class and you'll do well. Highly recommend.

Very fun class that you'll actually want to go to. Participation is very important for your grade. You'll end up making so many friends because you really have to get to know everyone. You really get out what you put into it!

A great class and professor. You get out of the class what you put into it. Make sure to get to know at least one of the TAs very early on into the semester, and email any work you do on any case to them. Participation is very important, if you do not speak up during class they will notice, and you need to compensate in another way!

He's really chill and nice to the class, but he rarely gives lectures or "teaches". He usually lets students run wild with role-playing negotiations, which is the main part of this course. Attend every class and get involved in the cases, it's what makes most of your grade! I recommend this class, especially if talking & teamwork is your cup of tea

The professor was great but the class was difficult for multiple reasons. All but 1 of the negotiations are in groups- after the first 2 weeks of the class it is apparent who the key negotiators are and who just follow and don't do any work. If you are one of those key people, this class is A LOT of work.

The most important class every business student should take. If you participate and show up to class, the TAs take care of you especially if you take the effort to get to know them. The cases can be tough but the most important thing is to not be afraid to speak up, and I am not even that outspoken of a student
avoid

Denson is a very nice guy, but your grade in this class often feels like it's dependent on the strength of your assigned groups. This, combined with vague grading policies and an overreliance on TAs, made this class extremely stressful and often unorganized.

Class is very fun; my main complaint is the lack of structure for the course. No criteria clearly lay out what we're supposed to be learning. The TAs do most of the work & are the primary channel to reach the prof. Even if you are sick as a dog, go to class. Absences hurt your grade a lot & it's better to show up and do nothing than to stay home.
Unsympathetic guy. Avoid if you can

This class is not difficult but the amount of work that goes into this class to do WELL is more than any of my other classes. Speak multiple times in EVERY class to get participation points. Make friends with everyone because you will be working with everyone throughout the semester. Super fun class but requires prep work & time outside of class.

Even if someone in your family is dying and you miss class, you will still get insanely penalized for missing class. Interesting course, but he's very unsympathetic. Got an A on every assignment and didn't pass because I missed classes due to personal issues.

Professor Denson is an insightful teacher with many interesting information and stories to teach his students. The class is fun at times, but the grading criteria are subjective and stressful. However, the more you speak up and email him your takeaways, the better your chances of a high grade will be. He also offers extra credit for volunteer work

grades on case outcomes which you honestly have little control over, & this was very stressful to me at the beginning of the year when i was putting in hours of work and seeing bad grades. however, participation matters more than anything and if you are speaking up, going to office hours, and putting in the work, you'll be fine. definitely take!!!

The class itself is not very difficult, but the grading scale is impossible to get a good grade. The people who participate every day in class are still struggling to pull out an A. This class is in no way a GPA boost. Attendance is mandatory and there is a new assignment every day. Find a different class to take.

Avoid at all costs unless you are extremely comfortable being a group leader/spokesperson in class. Drops your grade 1/2 letter grade every time you miss class above the allotted amount. Also messes up grading and makes no effort to fix it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have had at SMU. Wish he taught other classes I could take. Very accessible outside of class if you email him. He is also willing to connect you with professionals in just about any field - he knows everyone. I highly recommend Negotiations to anyone considering. It is one of my favorite classes I have taken at SMU.

Denson is an amazing teacher. His commentary is golden and his stories are entertaining. The issue with this class lies in the grading: it matters what he thinks about the outcome rather than if the outcome is a good one or not. My team took a unique approach to a case and created a solid deal by the end based on scientific facts and got low scores
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Denson is the best professor I have ever had at SMU. If you have the opportunity to take his negotiations class, I highly suggest you do so. It is so much fun and you build a great community with your classmates. Your grade in the class is based on how you negotiate. That being said, he is very observant.
greatest ive had at SMU
one of the best in SMU
If I were to describe a professor as chill, it's Denson. Participation is about 60% of the grade. One of the few classes I look forward to attending.

Pr. Denson is a phenomenal professor. I recommend all business majors take his class if it lines up with their major. The experience you get from negotiating in this class is great. You have to attend class to get good grades because everything is based on participation. I didnt find this to ever be an issue because it is such an enjoyable class.

Amazing teacher. Really nice guy and his classes are actually fun. Group negotiations make up pretty much the whole course. Make sure you show up and participate in as many negotiations as possible. One of my favorite teachers I have ever taken. Highly recommend!

LOVED taking this class, i wish this class was for a full year. Super real world based and have about a dozen negotiations. He brings incredible speakers who talk about how they negotiate in their job. he brought in a speaker from the Bush administration who dealt with foreign affairs and negotiations.

Favorite class I took at SMU. It is very participation heavy, so if you're one who skips class or just memorizes your way though a subject, this is not the class for you. I learned so many real world lessons and made good friends along the way. Also he is one of the best career contacts you can make. Can't recommend him enough.

Honestly, it's Negotiations, so if you are expecting to pass by book work and essay writing, think again. You have to actually learn this stuff. My grade was %60 participation so be sure to speak up.  He does require a course pack though which isn't listed, so don't let that $50 book catch you off guard.

If you need a business elective TAKE THIS CLASS!! Denson is great and wants to help all of his students however he can. This class is actually interesting and useful and it doesn't hurt that he lets class out early very often. Just make sure you never take your cell phone out during the negotiations and make sure to participate and you'll get an A.

Attendance is required if you want a good grade.  You need to actively participate in the negotiations and be active in the followup conversations to earn a good grade.  Also don't pull out your phone ever or he will dock your grade without telling you.  I highly recommend this class and it's definitely one of my favorites at SMU

Take this class. I came out with a lot of additional knowledge which will be very useful. He has interesting stories. You only have two quizes which is take home (you have to negotiate). Very easy class. It's very enjoyable since you don't have to constantly do work outside of class.
Professor Denson is awesome! Be prepared for class and you'll do fine. One of the few professors that teach real world material and skills.

This is absolutely the worst professor ever.  He is rude, lazy, and worst of all completely unfair in his grading process.  Everyone in my class, without exception, got a much worst grade than they should have earned, and the stubborn guy wouldn't change one of them.  He missed numerous classes for bogus reasons and at times no reason at all.  :(

Not the best lecturer, he spends most of it just looking at code and explains things in a confusing way. Quizzes and homework assignment at least every other week and total of 3 exams with a project and presentation as the final. Overall very nice and understanding when you talk to him though, and offered extra credit since we all had low grades.

I'm not gonna lie, he's a pretty bad professor. He's a decent person, but he cannot lecture effectively for the life of him. His quizzes are vastly different than what he teaches, his "notes" consist of him typing on the computer for most of the class, is heavy handed with grading, and insists on LaTeX for homework, despite its unwieldy nature.

Overall, a pretty tough class, but Dr. Cai helps make it enjoyable and manageable. The lectures are far too reliant on him just typing on the computer for my liking, but he did steer away from that at the end of the semester after receiving feedback about it.

She says she responds to emails but does not. She changed attendance to 10% on the day of the final and showed up late. She refused to support accommodations. I studied for two weeks and still failed a subjective test. She is discriminatory toward students with disabilities. If you value learning and your time at SMU, avoid her.

I would love to get coffee with her, but I would never choose her as a professor again. LOTS of info is given during lectures, so much it becomes unclear whats on tests (or we get tested on stuff never mentioned). She tells students all different things so no one knew what was going on in my class. Whole grade was based on 2 or 3 exams.
the worst teacher I have ever had
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is the worst. Lazy doesn't teach and complains about teaching. Tests are impossible and not related to course content. She keeps flagging my comments to prevent my warning to you
Worst professor ever!! Does not like you take tests if you take it out of class. Finals worth half of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hardly does anything but complain pinky about us being her not real job and how important she is at the school, no real grades other than tests that cover content she doesn't go over, literally in the shape of a circle like girl how do you get in that shape
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: While this course was very challenging, I really enjoyed having Dr. Dixon as a professor. She makes you think outside the box.

Prof Dixon prides herself on failing students. She changed the course of the class several times throughout the semester. 60% of the class failed the first test. She is an intentionally hard grader to keep people out of the major, which she has admitted. Her exact words were "A lot of you are in this class for the major, many of you wont make it".

She's funny and definitely entertaining but she is incredibly disorganized . Acts like she is the single threshold to the major- she's not. She thrives on failing students whether she wants to admit it or not. Try to avoid taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I absolutely love Dr. Dixon. She is hysterical and loves what she teaches. With that being said, this class is one of the hardest that I have taken. She isn't the most organized of professors I feel like what she expects from us changes every day. But an A is manageable, just work hard!

Dr. Dixon cares deeply about what she teaches, however the manner in which she teaches is sometimes not the most accessible for those not already understand the course. Due to her demeanor and sarcasm, she may seem unapproachable at times. Usually she will use personal anecdotes to help explain material, but often they go on too long.

Dr. Dixon is a difficult professor and can be hard to get in contact with outside of class. You have to be persistent. I failed the first test, but went in to see her every week after that and got an A in the class. I worked hard, she saw that, and rewarded me for it. I learned a lot. Her Ethnicity, Gender, and Cultural Comms taught me a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dixon's challenging. Essay format tests, but if you pay attention, ask questions, focus on application, you'll do well. The tests are hard but not impossible. Ask for feedback & put in the work. She's disorganized, but knows what she's talking about. It may be hard to keep up at times, but she respects you if you ask questions. Get on her good side

This professor changed the structure of her course several times throughout the semester, was unclear in her expectations, and unfair in her grading. Worst teacher I have had at SMU and worst grade I've received at SMU. She's funny, but it's not worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Worst teacher I have yet to have. Avoid like the plague if you can. I studied 31 hours for her final (not an exaggeration) and still only came out with a C in her class.  Doesn't care about her students, doesn't care about your grade, and does whatever the hell she wants.  I'm sure she was a great teacher at some point, but those days are long gone
She's a great teacher who knows the material but the class is hard. To pass you must show up to class and really know the material but even then her tests are nearly impossible

This class is what college is all about -- it is challenging and makes you think about the world in different ways. While this class is hard, Dixon is an expert in her field. Dry reading but interesting material -- if you put the work you, you'll learn a lot.

Read the book, won't pass without it. Lectures are boring and full of typos. Tests are pulled from lectures and powerpoint but also from out of the air. Some of the questions referenced Mustang Corral and you would only pass if you actually paid and went to it as a freshman. Those who didn't could only guess.

When it comes to her class it may seem difficult but the most important thing is to actually read before class.  If you have a problem with the reading or understanding make sure to ask questions. She is bad at answering emails but if you just walk into her office hours she's beyond willing to give you help and explain what went wrong.
PowerPoint and Book material but exams don't reflect it in the examsquestions asked. She loves Alabama. Seems to treat the class like a second job.

Shoots down every idea presented by a student in class and refuses to help you when you are confused. Lectures are convoluted, unorganized and riddled with tangents. She knows about three kid's names in the class by the end of the semester. Avoid if possible.
Very poor at communicating ideas in class. Tests are very hard and do not always reflect what was taught in class.

She may tell you one concept is a primary focus of the course, but she will test you on minuscule details instead. If you want to go to her office hours or converse with her via email, good luck. Also, for a class that is graded subjectively, she is incredibly not open to meeting with students to discuss rationale behind grading. Avoid if possible.

Professor Dixon was rude, contradictory, biased, overly subjective, unavailable, and a huge bully. No one likes her but they are too intimidated to say so. I know more about Alabama football then I do her material, because her PowerPoints are full of ridiculous examples and slang. Do not take her, AVOID HER! A sour apple in a great department.

Dr. Dixon is awesome.  While yes, she hardly ever responds to e-mails and is barely ever at office hours, she is worth it.  Her lectures are hilarious, and she is so interactive with her students.  She cares a lot that you understand the material and wants you to ask questions in class.  Read the material before class!!!
Dr. Dixon gives great insight and gets her students excited to be there. Absolutely amazing!

'Mustang Consulting'...Anyone who praises her blindly is brainwashed by her intimidation. Her lectures are unorganized, hypocritical and contradictory. She crosses the line with personal business and has inappropriate behavior. She is a bully and if you confront her, she lies, denies and blames. Avoid.

She is an awful teacher. She is unprofessional and lazy. She forces you to cheer for Alabama football every friday for half of class, and I have learned nothing. If you don't like being judged, being talked to like a child, or being treated like you are stupid, don't take this teacher.
great teacher. confident. FUNNY!!! Helpful! Medium hardness! i love her! kinda interesting but at the same time boring material.
She is interesting, a lot of fun, and a great teacher.  It is extremely hard to get an A in the class...so if you want an A take something else.  However, you do learn a whole lot.
The class was such a joke.  She was so unorgonized and unhelpful that i felt i should be getting a tuition refund.  I can't believe she didn't get fired after all of the complaints that year.

This is the type of information I will need in the real world. She is funny and energetic which makes class fun to be in. She loves practical application of the material: i.e. internships and hands on projects.

The material is clear because the book is online, and you study on your own. She is very tough with grading, so the assignment that I got an A for in different class, she would give a D for it even though she did not provide a very clear expectations. I have been with other instructors at SNHU. They were fair but not her. Avoid her class completely
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof. Di was able to tie course concepts and explanations to examples from her own professional career, which aided in better understanding of how concepts are applied to the real world. She was also available outside of class times to answers questions. Brought in fantastic business speakers, encouraged a learning environment. Amazing professor.!

Dr. Sanchez brought 3-4 guest speakers (most of them executives from publicly traded companies). These were by far the most important experiences I have had at Cox. They brought information and perspective from the real world and I consider those lectures invaluable. I could not give enough praise to Dr. Di. She is an amazing enthusiastic teacher!
She brings in speakers from different field
Clear grading, very good speakers, great class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Sanchez is amazing. She brought in speakers with experience and encouraged her students to participate in asking questions. She also has one group project and 4 tests, and lets you drop the lowest test grade. Her lectures are easy to follow, and she will give you a test review and go over it before every test. Best professor ever. Caring.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Sanchez is an amazing instructor. She pushes you to give your best. She brought in several speakers discussing management. I appreciated her lectures and her energy!

Dr. Sanchez should not be teaching. It's sad that she's a Cox prof. Avoid this class, you wont learn and will have to deal with her all semester. If you do take her, get ready for disorganization, terribly subjective grading, and listening to her struggle to read the textbook. She is also lazy, doesn't fully read papers, and gives all scantrons.

Do not take this class if you can help it. Run for your life !!! He doesn't know how to teach and knows nothing about curriculum. Weirdly enough he's also partial to people who are white and rude to colored people, even though he's colored himself. Extremely tough tests, very ill put together lectures too
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Very bad experience
He is asking questions after questions and does not let you think. He always mock my accent. I think SMU needs to send him for therapy
If you are American you are totally fine if not you will have to figure out how to deal with it. Because he would not behave in the same manner

I liked professor Rajan as a person. However his tests were ridiculously difficult. They were nothing like homeworks or lectures or practice exams from the past. When the average is so so low, you must do something. Not sure who grades the exams but they take points off like it is nothing. Terrible experience, do not take unless you want to fail.

Listen. Professor Rajan is good at teaching, and I actually enjoyed his lectures. However, his tests were ridiculously difficult this semester. They were nothing like what he lectured, put in homework, or even like the old practice exams. It was kind of ridiculous how difficult he made it. I enjoyed his lecture but wish the correlated to the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: overall good professor
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Tests? Not many--Would take again

reviews.comment: Professor Barr is a great professor. Lectures are a bit dull but the work is easy to complete and he's very fair on grading and gives a ton of partial credit. Great course, great teacher. 9/10 would take again.

This class is easy for some and difficult for others. There was a disparity in the final grades of this class (surprised he published it). The low was 50 and the highest was 98.5, the average was 78. Class is decently difficult but curved at the end. Math involved. Grade disparity+curve means there's room for teacher improvement. ~1/3 dropped class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Barr is simply the most amazing professor this university has. An amazing man, massive heart, so intelligent, and really cares for his students. I had the best time in his class and he should honestly be promoted. Go to class and do well in tests, listen to him and ask questions. Engage in class. He sees the potential in everyone.

The lectures are very easy, he just goes over his slides (which he prints and makes you buy from the bookstore....). Class is graded based on 3 tests and 12 labs. The tests were very easy, they mimicked the lab problems. Professor Barr is super kind and willing to help!

Barr's class is easy. His class is 2 tests and a final (not cumulative) plus a lab once a week. Most people didn't come from class but his tests are exact copies of the labs. However only 35% of people can get an A even though the class is easy. (Lyle's rule not his)

Barr teaches the equations pretty good. The tests were mainly pencil and paper style and 0% verbal class output is an option in there if you'd like. i ounce gave a bird outside the classroom window a slight wave . Also, eat a rasin before class begins if you have a weak brain.

Tests were based on the output of his models. Gives you old  tests to study from. Easy to get a B and pass the course but very hard to get an A. Would recommend this course to all engineers! Learned a lot!

Would definitely recommend getting in Dr. Barr's section for Senior Design! He went above and beyond the call of duty to help our team meet our goals! He expects a lot, however. Be prepared to put a TON of work into the senior project! The projects are often very challenging. So choose your project and team wisely.

Really smart and nice guy. Very respectful to all of his students! He mostly reads from his printed slides from lectures and not many students go to class. The material is not hard, but the tests can be challenging because he will sometimes put unexpected questions in there and they have a lot of material. There are only three tests.
Smart and very good at presenting the material. His tests are a kick in the nuts though. 85mins and you use all of it, and probably need a little more. But this a good class.
She is a caring teacher but its sad to see the students really do not care about her class. Just show up and do the work and you'll get an A. If you got her class consider yourself lucky.
she was great would take again
Not a professor who knows how to teach, respects students time and money. Someone who isnt professional or understands the depth of what it is they are trying to teach in SMU economics Dept.

She is the BEST!! Please take her! I wish I had her for micro too. The other econ professors are way more difficult. Everyone wants her class and tries to get her as a teacher. She offers extra credit. One test, one project, and a final. So fun in class! She is AMAZING!

Not even a real professor, doesn't have a PhD, is only here bc her husband is a professor, meanwhile they stuck her w ECON and she doesn't even have a degree in it. We shouldn't have to pay for this. She also doesn't seem to want to teach as she is never prepared and cancels/ends class early ALL THE TIME, waste of our money

Best college class ever. She is the nicest professor who would stick up for all of her students. I do not know how she does not have a better rating you will have a guaranteed A in this class which most people in other econ classes fail. I wish I took her for macro and micro.

Please listen to below. Clueless woman I have no idea how she got a job, READS word-for-word from slides that I'm not even sure she understands, never had my time more wasted. Would waterboard myself before listening to these lectures again.

Everything bad that people say is true. All she does is read off slides with barley any inflection in her voice. You just can't be motivated to pay attention to her at all. It's an easy A but I never had any class be a bigger waste of my time. Attendance by 3/4ths of the semester was down to 10 people. AI could do a better job at teaching me.
This is the most clueless teacher i have ever met, she has no idea what she is doing and neither will you and your grade will suffer

She lacks a lot of emotional intelligence, and seems to not be able to read into social awareness. The class is easy, but her instructions are contradicting and seem to never really align with the projects.

Prof DC is the absolute GOAT of SMU professors. Very unhinged (in a good way) and has an insane amount of lore you will get to hear. Class is cancelled when necessary. Some people say that you "don't learn anything" but I have learned a lot. Specifically for Macro, there is only so much that can be taught within the curriculum and she does great.

This class is the biggest waste of time yet easiest class offered at SMU. If you want a free A and the writing credit, take it. if you actually care about taking classes and learning stay away as it is the most boring and unproductive waste of time I have ever taken part of.

Quite possibly the worst university professor I have had the displeasure of learning from. Incredibly lazy and doesnt' do anything do teach, can't be bothered to know the material she is holding us accountable to, easier than the other options, horrible to get through.
Can't teach, reads off powerpoints, seems useless

Class is ok. Homework every couple of weeks, one mandatory exam, one group project, final is optional. Lectures are basic and the slides are all available for you online. Two papers for econ (dont know why) but other than that its not too bad.

Cancels class constantly, ends early on days she doesn't cancel, does nothing but read from slides and even that never makes sense. How do these people get these jobs? I'm mean I'm not complaining but it looks bad when people already think Econ are business rejects.

This is such a waste of time it's not even funny. There is no teaching in her part, I don't even think she knows the subject matter in any way, and while everyone gets a's, we don't even know what we learned. This is an embarrassment to the university and SMU. Both she and her spouse need to retire form my experience. Useless and overpaid.

i wouldve never thought id spent my parents money so badly as i did by taking her class. dont get me wrong, shes very sweet, but i didnt learn one single thing. i am a 4.0 student and could simply not grasp one thing from her lessons. if u want the easiest A without learning a single thing, take her, but if u care ab ur learning and sanity, dont.

Took this mf last semester but wanted to spin back on this, yes I got an A+ bc I'm not a veggie and I skipped class. Everything in the bad reviews are true. I rather go back to the ranch with SAE pledge masters than sit through this class again. Easy A+ if you have a pulse but she could he replaced by AI easy.

I loved Professor Carol's class! She is super funny and a pretty chill professor. She likes to cancel class on Friday's. Grades: One 10-question homework assignment per chapter (easy, answers are online), and 3 exams (including the final). The exams are not too bad, and she offers extra credit too! Extra Credit: Complete attendance polls in class.

Take this class! Its easy if you do the work and she ends class early every time. I didn't stay for longer than 20 minutes. However, you have to power through her not making sense and doing a poor job of explaining and structuring the class.

I only didn't give her a 1 because she does make it very hard for you to have a bad grade. I don't personally love her teaching style, because she literally just reads very basic slides to you. I don't think I actually learned anything, but somehow, I have a decent grade in the class, so I can't complain.
All she does is read slides to you. We are not exaggerating. Every. Slide. Read. To. You. Do not take this mess.
Do not take her.
She's basically the last worst of the worst options at SMU in Econ. That's not a compliment or endorsement. Easier but boring and she reads to you like a kindergarten teacher.
easier to get an A with her but omg, she cannot teach. reads from the slides, makes no sense, you have to teach yourself but that is true of all the econ profs, ugh

I love Prof Dickson-Carr, took her both semesters. Lecture heavy but a pretty light class compared to the other Econ professors. Only 3 tests and she drops one of them and you get a notecard for each test. Homework for easy points and takes attendance with a code on TopHat. Cares a lot for her students. Literally best prof TAKE HER!!!

Super easy and a great way to learn the basics of Excel if you don't know them already. She records the lessons so you can do them at home and don't need to go to class. Literally walks us through them so you get 100 every time. Super sweet and funny lady!

Her exams are not that hard; several questions are worded meticulously, and others are straight from the slides. She provides a notecard for the two non-final tests and a back-and-forth one for the final. To do well on the final, I would put everything on it to play it safe. Homework is light. She does take attendance on tophat every class.

She mainly reads off of slides, but as long as you study through her sample tests, you will do fine. She drops the lowest test grade and offers so many extra credit opportunities. If you don't understand why you got a question wrong, she usually records a video and explains to you why an answer is correct to help you out. She's so caring!

Professor DC cares about her students and provides many opportunities for you to do well in her class. Two exams and a final and she drops the lowest exam score. She mainly just reads off slides and doesn't provide many examples so you'll probably have to understand the content outside of class. But a good alternative to other SMU econ professors!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Dickson-Carr was great! She was very easy going in our class and understood the grind of college, helping us out any way she could and posting lecture slides after class. Although the material wasn't easy, she tried her very best to help out as much as possible. 10/10 would recommend for any freshman taking microeconomics.

People who criticize her lecture style are unaware that microeconomics really is that boring. Dickson-Carr gives plenty of opportunities for extra credit and lets you have a cheat sheet for every test. She is a bit difficult to reach through email but you can always ask her questions before class. The textbook is literally the lecture material.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: While I did well in her class, she is probably THE WORST professor/instructor I have ever taken in either a high school or college course. She pulls up the lectures every class and goes through them at a pace a kindergartner would understand. Her lectures add absolutely nothing to economics and you could do just as well without her speaking at you.

It's a pure lecture class. If you go to class, you'll get rewarded in bonus points. Everything is done pretty rigidly, so your experience will probably be take notes-> do homework-> take notes-> test review -> test.

She doesn't put effort into her lectures as they are PowerPoint notes that you spend $30 for TopHat that she reads off and posts. She gives HW, tests, and participation as grades that you could pass with just the 3 tests including the final. You have to learn everything by yourself and spend additional money on a textbook or be good at searching YT

Professor Dickson-Carr is so sweet. This class has a lot of busy work and requires students to be organized. Definitely a great course to fulfill the Writing CC. Just turn in assignments on time and you will succeed.
DC is incredible, she is funny and a very easy grader. Pay attention to lectures and do top hat homework and you will pass. With tests, she allows you to have a full cheat sheet.

She does not care if you come to class or not. She takes attendance on TopHat and the attendance code can be shared through a group chat you create. I never showed up once and got a B+. She is awesome because you get 3 credits and a free period if you want it, as long as you are ready for the tests you are fine. She also drops ur lowest test score.

Grades are mainly dictated by tests. She drops the lowest test grade and her curves are very generous. Lectures can be confusing but if you are able to take notes on the slides when studying for the exams you will have no problem in the class even if you don't attend in person class. She gives the option of watching the lectures on zoom as well.

I took this class already having experience with econ and the way Professor DC taught the class made me confused and unable to learn the material. She lectures for class so if you have a hard time understanding stuff on your own I would not recommend choosing this professor. I had to pay to be able to use a website for class in order to get a grade
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Please ignore the negative reviews on here. It may change because I took her virtually, but her tests were open note and extra credit for simply GOING to class and much more. Sure, I really don't know anything about macroeconomics, but if you want a laidback class, she's the way to go!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Very kind lady but very boring as well. Easy A if you're looking to take for credit, but you won't learn anything. Plenty of better options if you're actually looking to grasp key economic concepts.

Doesn't care about attendance, drops your lowest test score, weights things differently to help you do the best you can, every test and homework question is online... Absolute legend take her if you want an A, its impossible to fail this class

I'm someone who just struggles with economics. Attendance not mandatory at all. I always went to class but still ended up teaching myself the material. She's very nice, everything posted on canvas. Drops your lowest test grad. Great teacher if you need the class for credit/fulfill a requirement. If you're really trying to learn, you won't.

Do not take this class if you want to understand economics or be able to use what you learn in the future. Her tests are easy. Her lectures are hard to understand and follow that's why no one pays attention or shows up. It's not even worth coming to class, just take your class time to teach yourself.

Depends what you want... had basically a 100, never showed up to class, and studied a day or two before each test. It was an easy A, but I learned practically nothing. Even when I went to class it seemed like a waste of time because she only read off of slides that she then posted online. Nice lady, but don't take if you're looking to learn a lot.

I don't understand how anyone can fail this class unless they just don't care to try. She says day 1 she doesn't care if you come to class, and makes her lectures streamable from your bed. She gives great test reviews and LOTS of extra credit. DC is truly caring and passionate about what she does. Absolutely love her!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easiest Micro and Macro Teacher by far. If you want an A with the smallest amount of work, take her. Posts all slides online. Extra credit for JUST COMING TO CLASS. Classes were deserted by November. She solely read off the slides and what she taught was very surface level. Would take again for the easiness, not for the learning.

so easy, if you show up to class she does assignments step by step for you. I made a 100 on everything. take this for an easy additional credit hour. also, she's just a cool professor and i like her as a person.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: log into tophat with access code for attendance and easy participation questions, hw answers were all a for 7/10 HW's. tests were relatively easy, provides practice tests for both exams and the final. drops the lower of the 2 regular test scores so your grade is really just your highest test and final, final is EASY. 75% practice test questions.

She's a super great prof. Take her if you can. The lectures can be boring and while attendance isn't mandatory, there is an attendance quiz that will count as extra credit. It won't seem like you need the book, but get it, it makes the tests so much easier. The tests aren't hard as long as you pay attention and read the book. Seriously, take her.

Provides extra credit opportunities throughout lectures. Only two tests & a final (& you can drop one test!). Homework questions throughout semester help grade. All notes / homework are online. Textbook is provided for extra study help. She's willing to help you if you reach out. Study hard, take notes, & reach out & you will do well. Great prof!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I signed up for one of her classes again, she is super nice and gets to the point. Its lecture heavy but she makes them interesting. Not mandatory to attend but its helpful. She is super sweet and tries to make sure everyone understands, and always available for help over email or office hours. If you listen and get help when needed you'll pass.

Professor D-C is one of the most understanding professors Ive had thus far. Drops lowest test grade at the end of the semester which helps tremendously. Attending her lectures isnt extremely vital, but it does more good than harm. Definitely an easy A as long as you complete all your work in a timely manor. A bit scatter brained but hilarious.
She is great. If you have a chance take her.
Pretty easy compared to the other econ teachers. She nice but not really a great lecturer. As long as you can learn from the book you'll be good

If effort is expended, an A is attainable. Attending class essentially counts toward extra credit on your homework grade, so go to class even if you don't want to. Take the old tests she posts three or four times in preparation for the actual tests. Reading the text book is also helpful. She drops the lowest non-final test score.
She's really nice and doesn't care if you come to class. Your grade is essentially decided by one test and the final.

Prof DC's lectures are very scattered brained and often goes on tangents while teaching, usually they are funny. Gives 2 exams and a final, she rewards improvement so your better exam counts for both exams and if your final is the highest grade it counts for about 70% of your grade. Didn't learn much, and had to teach myself but got the A easily.

I took her for both microeconomics and macroeconomics. She doesn't seem particularly inspired and doesn't dive much beyond the material in the PowerPoints, which are accessible outside of class. I think that one would gain a deeper understanding of the subject with another professor, though I was able to get an A here with little time commitment.

I took DC for both micro and macroeconomics and she's absolutely awesome. If you're a business student and are looking for a good grade to get into Cox, she's your professor. She posts everything you need online so you don't have to go to lecture but they're definitely very helpful. Her tests aren't bad at all either if you study. Easy A!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Literally so easy. I made a 100 on both tests. Online homework was a completion grade. Gave a take home final (this was probably a one time thing though). Attendance is not mandatory and she puts the powerpoints that she lectures straight from online. Easy A. Not the best if you're looking to really learn and retain the material though.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She isn't the best teacher as far as getting her students to learn a concept in depth, but if you want an easy A in a class with optional attendance, she's a good option. I mostly learned the material from her powerpoints(which she sends us). She offers a lot of extra credit, and drops the lowest test grade, so its pretty hard not to do well.
2 tests..... that's what it comes down to. One wrong turn.... and your grade is done for.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She is funny and does a great job of being straightforward on how to do the homework and what will be on the tests, however if you do get confused (which you shouldn't) she isn't the best at further explaining. Otherwise, easy class. You have 2 test and a final, and she drops one of the two test and weighs the final depending on how it affects you.
Easy class. Makes your best test worth 60-70% of your grade. Attendance is not mandatory and not really necessary. Just make sure you do all of the work on your own time and don't slack off.

Easy class, but horrible professor. I did not learn one thing from her. Attendance is optional so maybe 15 or 20 showed to a 100 person class every time because her lectures were pointless. Our Econ department is just awful. Get the textbook to learn it yourself.

Super easy Econ teacher! Halfway through the semester I realized that if I only went to class on the week leading up to a test I could still receive an A. She doesn't take role, and in class she just goes over a power point which she then posts online. Good luck getting into her. Her class fills up quick.

You have to do all of your studying outside of class. She flips through powerpoints the whole class and rambles to herself often which isn't helpful. Went into office hours for help, she wasn't helpful. If you read each chapter on your own you'll pass. She gives an outline of what to study before each exam.

This class is extremely easy as long as you study for the exams.  She doesn't do a great job teaching the material so be prepared to learn some on your own.  Attendance isn't mandatory.  She helps you a lot with the material on the exam and gives you plenty of study guides.  Class wasn't enjoyable but would take again because its so easy.

Easiest professor I have ever taken. She is decently helpful and clear. She gives a lot of extra credit and attendance is not necessary for passing (but it certainly helps). I received a much lower grade than I should have because I really slacked off but she really is very easy.
Super easy just study for tests from power points

Dickson-Carr is fairly easy, but most students study outside of class. It works for most people (including me). If you do need help though, she's there and she's helpful. Coming to class sometimes is beneficial. Aplia (online hw) assignments are kinda annoying. Overall easiest econ teacher- take her.
She is an incredibly nice teacher, but you HAVE to study a lot outside of class if you don't attend lectures regularly. If you go to every lecture and do the hw, it should be an easy A.
Easy, just study your text and do aplia HW's.

This is an easy class. Unless you already know micro, you need to either go to class, or read your book to do well on tests. There are no trick questions, and she is very straight forward with her questions. Class is boring, but not mandatory.

Cheery professor. I did not attend class after the first exam. Easy A, but you must study. All notes were posted on BlackBoard and I learned more by reading the textbook than by going to class. 2 midterms and a final--bizarre test policy though where she drops the lowest midterm. Aplia is survivable b/c she posts very close practice questions.
This was a very helpful class
She is so nice and not afraid to answer any questions. Tons of extra credit! Easy A. Gives practice tests and some questions reappear on the actual test. Definitely a must take!

Attendance is a joke but kids think they can totally blow this class off and then wind up dropping.. You kind of do need to study for tests! Definitely not hard, but not a high school gym class either.
EASY! But you have to teach yourself!
Easy A! Probably the easiest teacher, only have to read the textbook. Her courses are not very helpful though.
Easy A, attendance was not mandatory or necessary if you just teach yourself out of the book. Tests were pretty easy, multiple choice, you just have to know the basics.
absolute joke... never went to class  and she gives a ton of extra credit
DC is my facebook friend and a hilarious lady, she doesn't teach you that thoroughly, but you learn enough to make it worthwhile. She's pretty easy if you can teach yourself out of the book.

She was extremely helpful!! She was very lenient with deadlines but she is a hard grader. If you go to her conferences she tells you exactly what she's looking for and what she doesn't like in your paper. She's a wonderful person and professor
MOST HELPFUL; ALWAYS AVAILABLE FOR ONE-ON-ONE MEETINGS.
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments
she's crazy. Her grading is off the wall, but because she is so crazy, if you kiss up, she will give you a good grade. I came late to class every day and got an A-.

She's a wonderful person and she would do anything in the world for a student that is commited to their grade... if you are not doing well, go  see her, her door is always open and she is very understanding and flexible

Her grading is off the wall, for a paper that I went to her for consultation, which is mandatory, I got a C but two other papers I skipped the consultation and got an A and B+.  Her assignments are bogus and fail to expand your writing.
She is a wonderful teacher, she is very helpful and i would highly recommend her.
No Comments
No Comments
she is the worst teacher ever! she wouldn't know good writing if it was right in front of her nose. seriously, do not take her class.

the hardest professor I have ever had. I had to drop his class bc his tests are nothing like practice problems/quizzes. To be fair, I'm not the best at accounting but he made the class unbearable. Around 10 other people dropped his class after the second test, and the final is worth 40% of your grade (which I've heard its worse than the tests)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He's very sweet and tries to help, but his exams are THE WORST. Had to drop his class because they were so rough. They are nothing like the practice exams or quizzes and thats what he bases your grade off of (3 tests). A lot of people also do poorly on his tests, so if you want an A, don't take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Funny guy and fairly helpful. Students overreacted to the final exam. IMO, he shouldn't have made it as hard as he did (some kids got 25% on a final worth 40%), but he also made the rest of the class STRAIGHTFORWARD. So, the final exam balanced it out. If you need an A to get into Cox, I'd suggest another professor because the final is a doozy.

Very bad teacher. You do not learn anything from his lectures and the first two exams are very basic. The final brought the class down by an average of 12 points per person and was easily the hardest test I have ever taken. I would recommend against taking him, due to the fact that it is an unfair course and you do not learn a single thing.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The quizzes and midterms were all straightforward. The class average for both was around an 88. He seemed to recognize this and decided to make the final exam difficult- the average was a 68 after the curve. 13 out of about 160 students received an A in the class. That is well below the norm and was a result of his final exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The class is straight forward and not difficult except for the final. He has an ambiguous participation grade (subjective based on attendance and whether he knows who you are). His final (40% of the course grade) is mostly material not ever seen before. I wouldn't recommend Dmitris, especially if you need a good grade in the class to get into Cox.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Be sure to always go to class and pay attention. Ask questions. The material can be tricky but it's not terrible. The quizzes are easy, but the midterms rely on the practice problems, which are more difficult than the quizzes for sure. Study many hours for each quiz/exam. The final exam brought the class average down a lot. He's solid overall.
The class is easy until the final exam which he makes impossible to bring the class average down so it is basically a guessing game and does not represent the material discussed in class.

Worst professor in Cox. Can't communicate the info necessary to succeed in this course. The first two exams were moderately difficult and covered material that had been slightly covered in class. The final (worth 40%) of the course contained 10-15 questions that had never been lectured on, and was the hardest test I have ever taken in Cox.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Vrettos clearly does not care about his students. Although boring, the class was very straight forward until the final. He wanted the class to fail by making nearly every question on the final tricky and then adding things we had never learnt. Nearly everyone in the room was panicking to finish the exam. Dropped from a 98 to a B+ after the final.

Vrettos teaches one course and tests on another. The final exam is absolutely killer and dropped my overall GPA tremendously. The course material in the class was not indicative of the final exam. He is obviously not a good teacher. He is just a lecturer. You have many other options for accounting professors- I would not recommend this professor.

Vrettos doesn't check attendance, and lectures mostly consist of working on textbook problems  (I didn't find this helpful).  He also has a slight accent which can impede your focus. Overall, however, I recommend Vrettos because he gives very clear outlines of what to know for quizzes and tests, and the material is easy enough to learn on your own.

Vrettos has been one of my favorites at SMU. He's very nice, and conscientious of his students' time and effort. Fastest grader of tests and quizzes I've ever seen. Make sure to participate in class, and you'll find him a fantastic teacher.

Vrettos was a fantastic professor, extremely pleased I took his course. Caring, clear, and thorough, he cares for his students. Very accessible, and happy to help in office hours. Encourages question in class, even if you're stating the obvious. Tests are M/C, direct from class discussion. Quizzes really boost your grade, directly off homework.

I had him for Managerial Acct and he was one of the best professors that I have had at SMU. Willing to go way out of his way to help students and always goes over all of the material in class thoroughly. Highly recommended but I think he is teaching MBAs next year!
good

The lecture material does not always pertain to the exam topics, but pay attention to the problems because he goes through all the steps. Really willing to go out of his way to help his students, overall awesome experience.

One of the best and nicest professors I've had at SMU. Actually cares about his students and knew almost everyone's name within the first few weeks. Teaching style is crystal clear along with PowerPoint slides; he makes managerial accounting understandable to anyone. I had no interest in accounting which changed completely after taking this class.

Good professor. He tries hard to make accounting understandable for those who aren't accounting majors. He is always available if you have a question. Very direct and clear professor-- which sometimes is hard to find. I actually like accounting now.

This guy is a really good professor. He is very clear, and works through everything in class. He doesn't just simply click a PowerPoint all class. He doesn't talk down to students, and he truly appreciates any input to class discussion. I highly recommend him. I am a marketing major, and he made me like managerial accounting... That's saying a lot.

I genuinely could not understand what this guy talks about when he lectures. Had to drop the class (smartest decision) because he is so bad. Serious about attendance. I knew this would be a difficult class but he made it impossible. Homework graded for accuracy due every Monday at 5PM?? Accent so thick. Nice guy though

He genuinely cares if he sees that you're trying and will spend time making sure you understand, but only in office hours. Lectures way too fast. He's so smart that he doesn't know how to teach an intro class though. Heavy curves on tests and final grade because basically everyone failed.

In order to do well in this class, you really need to rewrite all the lecture notes on your own since he goes way too fast in class. You will have to teach yourself all the material, but the exams and materials are very consistent and there really are no surprises.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: he goes so fast no one knows what is going on he speaks way to soft way to fast and i cant understand a thing he is saying with his accent this is the worst class i have ever taken he doesn't explain anything he just does R coding at his speed when this is supposed to be an intro class for people who have never used R before.

All of Dr. Dong's classes are HARD. Sometimes his lectures are less than exciting, but the material he teaches (forecasting and econometrics) is dense, by default. He is an EXTREMELY generous grader and genuinely cares about his students. I was challenged in his class but would take him again in a heartbeat. He wants his students to succeed!
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Dong truly cares about his students. He wants his class to succeed and is very accessible. His class material was definitely difficult for me to understand and was probably one of the harder classes I have taken here at SMU, due to the material and his accent. Lastly, his TA sucks because he grades way harder than Professor Dong.

French is going to be a time consuming class no matter who you have.  You will have it every day of the week but Prof Dodd makes sure to keep the content engaging and fun for students.  There is a good amount of homework but her skill and knowledge is incredible.  You will leave the class way smarter and if you pay attention you'll get a good grade

I took both 1401 and 1402. She is probably the best teacher I've ever had. Taking a language course at SMU means you have to go everyday which was tiring, but she always came to class in a jolly, upbeat mood which made going so often a little bit easier. She's an easy grader with lots of bonus points, so if you want an A you absolutely can get an A
An “A” machine but that does not maketh a good teacher.
Not a fan.

She is a wonderful teacher who is very kind and cares about her students. She is always available for questions during class and over email. Only warning is that the work load is quite heavy. Homework every single night, but I think that is just the nature of the course. Would take class from her again!
Wonderful teacher and spirit. Attend class and pay attention and you will get an A! Her bubbly personality makes it a great class

I LOVE Prof. Dodd. She is literally the sweetest and best teacher out there. I am so thankful I had her for both FREN 1401 & 1402. Amazing lectures, very interactive, and challenged me to push my limits. Learning a language is hard but Prof. Dodd makes the journey so much more enjoyable. You will not regret taking her!

Janet Dodd is everything good about the foreign language department, she cares about what she is doing and every students success. Learning a language is difficult if you dont commit time and effort inside and outside of class. That said, please do take her class.

Prof Dodd is just the cutest person ever. Loved her SO much I decided to take her for 1402 as well. She wants her students to succeed and offers so much help. Learning a new language is a challenge no matter who is teaching it but she does her best to make it easy and enjoyable. 10/10 take her if you can!!!
Very caring, she is easily one of the best teachers in general I've ever had.

I took Professor Dodd for 1401 and 1402 because I loved her so much. She is an excellent professor and cares about her students a lot. She offers some extra credit on certain assignments which is helpful.

She is the most sweet, caring, and enthusiastic teacher ever and wants you to love French as much as she does. She is very clear about what will be on tests/quizzes. She helped me whenever I needed it and gave me good feedback on my tests and will let you finish tests in her office if you need more time. Brings cakes and donuts to class!!

Extremely sweet and caring, wants you to love french as much as she does. Curriculum is a little boring but she makes it interesting/dynamic. Must study for tests but if you show up and do the homework, youve already seen all the material on the test. Great review PowerPoints! Lab was helpful before tests. Curves when its fair to do so! LOVE LOVE

The course itself was meh, but I really enjoyed Prof Dodd. She added so much personality and real world tips to otherwise redundant textbook lectures. Accessible outside class and more than willing to help you with anything, and will let you finish tests in her office if you need more time. Motivational, pretty, and sometimes brought free food!
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Prof Dodd was really personable and outgoing. She puts effort into her teaching. She was quite clear about what would be on quizzes/exams. There was homework due most class periods, which usually took me 45-60 minutes. Putting effort into the homework is the most important thing you can do to succeed, especially when it concerns grammar.
Prof Dodd is the best! She's so sweet and understanding and she makes you enjoy learning French.
Professeur Dodd is simply amazing. She is so enthusiastic and sweet and she clearly cares about her job and her students a lot. I would highly recommend any of her classes to any student.
I love Madame Dodd! Could she get any cuter? She's so funny and so sweet and loves her job and makes it very clear. I highly recommend taking her for French! I promise you won't regret it!

LOVED HER. I'm actually considering taking a third semester of French just to take another one of her classes. Super, super helpful, explains everything so clearly that even a five year old could understand it. Seriously, take her classes if you're taking French at SMU. You won't regret it.
I did not exactly try in this class. You can breeze by and get a B no problem. Minimal effort will get you a B+ or A-. She's funny and makes French an entertaining subject. Definitely recommend.
Professor Dodd is wonderful! She is helpful, professional, and personable. She was meant to teach. She's hilarious and very reasonable. I absolutely recommend taking from her!
Dodd is the best professor for french. Super nice.
She is so sweet and so helpful. I highly recommend taking one of her classes if at all possible.
Very helpful, makes power points to calm nerves before tests. Brought in croissants and Nutella one day

She is perfect in every way. She's helpful and will take the time to make sure you understand the material. She's so sweet and loves what she does. She's a fair (but not necessarily easy) grader. Be sure to enroll in her class early because it's the first to fill up. Would definitely recommend.

Without a doubt the coolest professor I have had my first semester. Such a fun, sweet woman and she made French enjoyable. I can't even explain how much she helped students, ranging from extra credit to making additional PowerPoints before tests to help students review. Take her if you can!!

Seriously the best language prof here. She actually makes me want to show up to class, plus makes the material so easy. You can tell she is really passionate about french and she's so freaking sweet and happy. Sends out power points before exams, really helps out with everything related to the class. And she's super hot, so there's that.
Very excited to teach French, always sent out powerpoints with amazing test review before major tests
Take her class!! Not only is she helpful, she is also incredibly nice and funny. You'll learn in her class but also have fun.
She's awesome, enough said :)

This teacher is one of the friendliest teachers I've met at SMU. She genuinely cares about every student and just wants to help you succeed. Never have seen her get mad and she brings in treats when she is late in returning tests, she's that nice. I highly recommend getting in her class

Lectures are mandatory. Homework often asks about content that lecture doesn't explain well, making going to office hours a must. Professor gives unclear, confusing answers to any questions you have about the homework. Tests ask questions that are different from lectures and the homework. You don't know your grade until the course ends.

Worse than his ECE1350. Overly-complicated lectures and long, difficult assignments often unrelated to lectures. Not a single assignment graded except the midterm and praxis proposal. Compared to 5365, 7365 adds 1 problem per HW, 2 for midterm, and requires doing the praxis (final project) solo instead of in pairs. 35% HW, 25% midterm, 40% praxis.
Bad instructor. Does not know what he is talking about. Low teaching quality and cannot hold a conversation about science. Do not take his class if you can!

This is the easiest class I've took and I love Prof Douglas's humor and his knowledge. This is an old fashion one which you need be ready for dozens of physical papers, and also please take your note down on physical notebook since the exam is open books open notebooks. If you ready for these stuff, it is an easy A. BTW HWs are graded by the TA :(

Horrible lecturer who is nearly incomprehensible unless you have an incredibly strong base of knowledge.  Homework is poorly explained and he is not accessible during office hours, as he claims that "grading is the feedback loop" and as such, he is evidently unable to explain confusing problems.  Labs are just as bad, with confusing directions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: His lectures are just him copying things from the book. His homeworks are too difficult. He gave us little to no practice problems in class. His book has no practice problems. Zero preparation for the homeworks which takes hours and hours to complete. His lectures add no new information or explanation. Just have to struggle till end.

In class instruction consists of a lectures that relate directly to homework (due weekly) and labs. He keeps regular office hours and is willing to help. Reviews, which are nearly identical the tests, are given prior to the open-book/open-note tests. Overall, the class gives a solid introduction to EE and the different career paths available.

I enjoyed whenever he demo-ed MatLab code, thats up to personal preference.
Egotistical and doesn't even teach the material. I'm sorry if you have to take him
Very difficult homework and tests, but I liked his liberal use of Matlab in class and in homework. Seems very knowledgeable in the field and speaks clearly in lectures.
Pretentious and unhelpful.  More interested in listening to the sound of his own voice than helping his students learn.
Very bad teacher, tests are impossible be prepared to get an adderall perspricption
He is rude and thoughtless. Mocks students openly. Fails at teaching on all levels.

Lol he is so mean to students who aren't the brightest. Did not like him at first but he grew on me. Philosophical logic isn't easy to begin with, it is indeed very hard to grasp at first. Don't think that's his fault. His lectures are good. Easy to get on his good side, just don't miss class, do EXACTLY what he says, and sit in the first 2 rows.

Probably the worst teacher I have ever taken at SMU... my class size significantly dropped after the first couple tests too after kids were dropping it. He thinks its the easiest stuff in the world and offers no help outside of class. Graded by 5 tests only and homework every single night but it somehow only accounts for 5% of your total grade.

reviews.comment: Listen to me when I say this. do NOT skip this class and make sure you listen during the lectures. if you're good at math you will be good at this. ehring is known to be a little more confusing than the other logic professor but he grades stuff super lightly and he doesn't care about anything except that you attend class. so DO THAT!

This is not an easy intro class and the lack of online resources make it extremely difficult if you miss a day of class or don't understand a lecture. The only way to pass is to study really hard for tests cause they are by far the most important.

reviews.comment:
Does not know how to explain things well but if you don't understand you're screwed.
Can't even answer basic questions about the content.

Sometimes has to have students explain the content because he can't.

reviews.comment: Prof. Ehring understand the subject well and can teach it clearly (despite his bad handwriting). His lectures can get boring, but his occasional jokes and bits make up for it. Don't get confused by his quirks and eccentricities; he's just very New York. If you do your HW and come to class on time, you'll have a good experience.

He is very passionate about this class and this topic but it is way to hard for an entry level class. He doesn't respond to emails or show up to office hours. The whole class is tests and theres no extra credit or curves at all and the homework is only worth 5% the rest is tests. Overall its a hard class.

He is so uninvested that he doesn't even follow his own syllabus and your grade will pay for it. He screwed up my grade and refused to respond to emails about it, won't meet, and wasn't in office hours so no help

This is a warning to anyone who is not a great test taker, do not take this class. He had an exam scheduled the second week of classes. He doesn't respond to emails, and the Canvas page for his class is a mess and hard to navigate. No extra credit, just 5 exams and homework each week. Overall, there was no support provided to succeed in this class.

reviews.comment: Professor Ehring is an excellent teacher. The material can be challenging at first, but as long as you pay attention during the lectures, practice from the textbook, and are a decent test taker, you should be fine. Overall, it was a great class with a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Even though PHIL 1301 is an entry level class, it is very difficult. If you're going to take it, be ready to work. The class is hard but Dr. Ehring is a super kind and knowledgable professor. It's definitely possible to succeed, but it takes work and studying. There are 5 tests over the course of the semester.

makes the two new "languages" learned in class make sense with good and funny examples. 6 grades are 5 exams and homework! homeworks can be difficult and lengthy but many days were spent only going over the previous nights homework.

He definitely knows what he is talking about when it comes to Logic. He is a little quiet so it is best to sit up front in the class. He is very kind and easy going. He sometimes mutter some stuff under his breath and it is always hilarious.

Clearly has a passion for logic and makes concepts easier to understand than they would be without his enthusiasm for the subject. Your whole grade will come from 4 tests + a final so be prepared or else you won't do well in the class. Definitely not an easy A, but Professor Ehring made lectures interesting with lots of practice to master concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Exams are super important. Just practice practice practice all the natural deduction truth trees tables etc, and u should get it. Really not too hard but a lot of kids drop so just keep pushing. I couldve gotten an A but the tests are like 95% of the grade and I got 2 bs. Lots of tests but he weights the tests so that the are progres get worth more

reviews.comment: Ehring is so funny, we were always laughing in class. I think the bad ratings are due to the subject being hard, not poor teaching. Do the readings and the homework and you should be fine if you're a logical thinker and decent at math.

DO NOT TAKE. No extra credit offered and he does not reply to emails. His tests are very hard and small questions are worth a lot of points. I really can't say anything else other than I hated this class and advise everyone to stay away.

If you are not a philosophy major, do not take this professor. He cold calls in class and forces participation, and if you miss any class days you will be super behind. There is homework due everyday that is from the textbook, and most of the time the homework is over stuff he hasn't taught yet. He is a nice guy, but boring and tough.
Do not take

If you slack off it will hurt you so much. If you are struggling and don't understand get help or be prepared to be called on to answer a question. He was very hard to understand, and his class was lecture heavy. Your grade are tests which were really hard so I had to drop the course.  Beware taking this class.

The worst teacher I have ever had. I went for extra help and kept telling me to do a problem and come back. He wads very dismissive and would not explain it to me. Kept telling me to go to the Alec even though they did not have a tutor for this class. Definitely do not take this teacher. I even went for extra help with the other logic phil teacher.

If you are not a logical person, do not take him as a professor. But if you are, I would definitely recommend. The majority of his lectures are going over practice problems and cold calling students to do these problems. If you don't know how, he will push you to complete the problem so you have a clear understanding of logic. Your grade is exams

In 4 years of undergrad and 2 years of grad school this was the worst class and worst professor I ever had. There is a text book, but he literally only uses the inside covers. Dropped the class, but it was mandatory and he was the only one to teach it.

Five tests are basically your only grades. Says you need to attend class but only to turn in homework. He doesn't make sense a lot of the time. Tests are graded hard (one t/f question wrong was 7 points off in one case). Do not take him if you have to take 1301. He is not helpful and confusing in his lectures.

reviews.comment: This class was alright. He's not a bad professor and can explain everything well, it's just that his class get's boring quickly. The class is boring, but it's important to go.

reviews.comment: If you do the short hw readings, class is simple. If not, no biggie unless there is a pop quiz but those aren't too hard. I got above a 97 on all tests, easy easy grader just use the lectures online!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great Professor! If you like philosophy you should definitely take one of his advanced courses. Brilliant guy and lots of in class discussion. He left 2 long take home tests, but he is a fair grader. Doing the readings will definitely help, but if you pay attention in class they're not necessary.

Guy is a genius, potentially overqualified to teach a 1300 class. Not super engaging and overly complicates material. WATCH THE VIDEOS ON THE SYLLABUS. Makes material incredibly simple.
