reviews.comment: If you don't naturally have a "logical" mind, then you will likely not enjoy or succeed. If you do have a logical mind (you know who you are), then you will find it interesting and engaging. I found him to be a good communicator (with a similar sense of humor as me). reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I would not recommend Prof. Ehring to anyone. The material he uses in class is not his own - you can find the PPTs on Google. He reads directly off the slide and gets bored teaching (he announces it in class). Syllabus is not downloadable, was not helpful when I asked for it, grades are not clearly communicated with you. Stay away!

If you are a logical person this class is super easy. It is similar to math in the sense that if you get it, you really won't have to study much and you will make an A. He teaches the material in class very well and provides optional videos for extra help. I actually really enjoyed this class. It can be extremely hard if you don't get it, though.
he's a nice and funny professor and he will always tell you exactly what's on the tests but they are still pretty tricky

This class is so so easy if you are a logical person (I am a mechanical engineering major and I never had to study for this class), but if you struggle with logic then this class will be a big effort, so many people dropped.. either you are really good or really bad at this class I guess

reviews.comment: I received 88-95s on every exam, yet even if I get a 100 on the final, I can not get an A in this class. Giant flaw in his grading system. He does not respond to emails. reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: For an intro class, he does a good job. The material is not to hard and he goes through it enough times in class, and call you out, to make sure you get it. Attendance isn't mandatory but if you go to class, it will seriously make the class an easy A. He isn't boring and isn't mean. Overall, pretty good deal.

Not a difficult class, does not take attendance but homework is due every class. He is funny and really easygoing. There were 4 tests and a final. Grading scale is a bit weird but it is an easy philosophy credit. Ehring has a dry sense of humor but he made me laugh so hard I was almost crying! I want to take I'm for intermediate logic.

Interesting, but you have to be into it. It's like learning a new language and you have to learn how to speak it fluently in order to keep up. Learning the language is not hard if you are willing to put in about an hour a week into this class.

If you're taking this just for an easy Phil perspective- don't. Intro to Phil & CMP are easier. That said, Ehring is a pretty good teacher and explains logic well. However, his grading is very frustrating as he only gives full letter grades (A,B,C) on tests. So getting a 100 is no different than a 90 as they curve to the same thing.
Elementary Logic is very much like Algebra or other forms of math.  If you do not enjoy math or are not good at math, avoid  Elementary Logic.
He is extremely eccentric, but he really is quite brilliant. There is a lot to learn from him if you're willing.

I went into Elementary Logic not knowing what to expect. The first day started and I was terrified. But after a while I realized that the material isn't that hard at all. Prof. Ehring is extremely helpful, even spending whole class periods to go over homework. Another plus is that he constantly has the class laughing with his dorky jokes.

Had him for metaphysics, which is a very difficult phil. class and did fine regurgitating what I read in the various readings, being that all he had was take home essay tests. Great guy, loves his philosophy. I enjoyed class although I didn't go all the time cause he loves it so much. If your not a dumbass you can get an A.

I can't emphasize enough how much I loved his logic class. He's very emotional and logical at the same time, which is priceless. I miss his class, I actually cherished the final exam as the last of a subject I discovered and adored. I can't wait to learn more logic and I hope Intermediate Logic is offered before I graduate.

His teaching style is not very clear, and he repeats himself two or three times no matter what he says.  His board writing is atrocious. He forbids cell phones in his class yet routinely interrupts class to answer his phone.

Very condensending, not a very nice teacher and expects that people study for his class over any other.  Doesn't give any partial credit, and the material is very much so that you either get it or you don't.  If you don't get it, he doesn't care.  Incredibly hard, and I'm a philosophy minor who's taken 3300 levels that were MUCH easier.  Ehring=Bad

Fin class.  Great for future lawyers.  Its not hard if you do all the work.  I was terrified at first, but then it wasnt so bad.  He even changed a grade for mu up to an A when i proved him wrong on a test.

he is completely impossible. do not believe what the suck ups are saying. there is so much homework and none of it makes sense- and i'm a philosophy major! he's not helpful and his tests are hard. expects everyone to automatically know everything. just don't take him and save your gpa and spend your extra time doing better things!!
Wow, Ehring is great.  Those who think Ehring is out to get them are just mad becuase they are illogical.
GREAT class, GREAT Prof.  Logic is the best thing that has ever happened to me.

This logic class is one of the hardest classes I have ever taken.  He does not give partial credit.  He speaks to you in a very condescending tone and loves to screw up an A student's GPA.  He is smart, but out to fail you no matter how hard you study.
Genuinely believes being mean is a teaching strategy. Graded like a revenge plot, taught like a TED Talk for people who don't read, and gave feedback with the warmth of a DMV line. Absolutely not.

Zero empathy, zero feedback, and a burning desire to make students suffer. Asking for help feels like crossing a line. If you enjoy academic sabotage wrapped in passive aggression, this is the class for you. Otherwise, run.

reviews.comment: Objectively a terrible professor. Can't or won't teach well and floats in her credentials while not knowing her subject matter.

I don't understand how her rating is so high unless its sarcasm. The workload is ridiculous and she honestly thinks it's normal to expect us to read in this day and age of AI. She's dated, out of touch, and past her prime. Don't take unless you want to learn like a pioneer.

This class is A LOT. 6 textbooks that aren't cheap and you have to bring to class and might get cold called to read and interpret. Final study guide had 110 terms and 10 essay questions of which she chose 6 and 4 for the test respectively. Lectures are long and detailed and you don't get the slides. Content is somewhat interesting, but hard work.

reviews.comment: Dowling clearly loves the subject matter that she teaches, but she fails to realize that not everyone in the class wants to become an Egyptologist. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers

reviews.comment: She's fine, nothing special and no extra effort - just an ok prof.

Prof. Dowling is the greatest teacher I have had. I've taken 3 classes with her, including the Junior Seminar and Distinction. reviews.comment: Dr. Dowling must be considered among the top 5 professors at SMU. Her knowledge of and excitement about the course material is inspiring for students, even in online classes. If you're going through RMP looking for a prof, stop here. Not a MD, but for some reason, I would trust her as my own doctor. Very understanding. Never condescending.

I wish I could take her every semester. She cares so much about the subject and her students. When we went online, she was the only prof who handled it well. Get ready to read so much and write a lot, but that's just an upper level history. Take Dowling, you won't regret it, she's incredible. Also tons of extra credit opportunity
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Dowling is awesome! I took her Class & Gender in Ancient Society class in Oxford and loved it. I'm a science major so I wasn't really sure what to expect from an SMU history class, but I really enjoyed the class and found it very manageable. Be sure to do the reading (or at least a SparkNotes reading) if you want to be able to participate.

Dr. Dowling is the most inspirational and helpful professor I've ever had. It's a TON of reading, but all very intentional and necessary to understand the course. She answers EVERY question asked and is such a wealth of knowledge. Offers 10 easy bonus points on the final grade so not too hard to get an A if you put in effort.

Best Teacher at SMU that I have had so far. She made me fall in love with Roman History and I looked forward to her class everyday. BUT it was a very hard class. Lots and lots of reading. I spent hours studying for her class, but it was all worth it in the end. Take her class if you love history!

Prof Dowling is an energetic and passionate teacher. Her enthusiasm is tangible and contagious. Very rewarding class. It was definitely the toughest history course I've taken thus far into my 3rd year.

Professor Dowling is great. She is very passionate about her work and wants everyone to do well. She will always provide examples and is very relatable. Be prepared to write a lot (She said and I quote "A good exam should make our hand hurt for days afterword) But it is  truly rewarding and you will learn so much.

The class is tough if you're not a history or english major. Would not recommend if you just want to fulfill a pillar. I took the class just to fill up my schedule and I'm not either of those majors so it took some work. That being said, Mrs. Dowling is one of the best teachers I've had. Class is very interesting and you'll love Roman culture.
Professor Dowling is super nice and helpful and she know's so much about what she teachs! I would recommend her classes to anyone

I've taken her twice at SMU (class/ gender and ancient rome) and LOVE HER. can not say enough good things. she is very passionate about the subject which she instills in her students. very helpful and wants you to do well. she demands a lot but you are rewarded in the end for your hard work. such a great lady and professor!

Wonderful professor and person. Very passionate about what she teaches. Likes to make you write long papers but she is very helpful with editing and telling you exactly what she wants if you make an appointment. No homework, quizzes, or tests. Greek mythology class. Awesome opportuinity if you need a perspective credit.

I made the mistake of taking one of her classes in my very first semester; it was a wake up call for me. Still, even if her class was difficult, it was very interesting- she is very passionate about what she teaches, and she is very helpful one-on-one.
She is an excellent teacher! Very knowledgable but she demands a lot in her class...I had to study ALOT for an A- in her class! But it was very interesting!

Dowling is a great professor who really is passionate about what she teaches.  She is very helpful and knows a ton about the subject.  The only downside is that she assigns a ton of reading.  I have had two classes with her and each class had nine books.  I recommend her anyways.
Dr. Dowling is inspirational! She is passionate about her subject and enthusiastic about teaching others. She is the best professor I've ever had the good fortune to take a course with!
Her class required a lot reading. Class time was mostly spent in class discussion.   Bottom line, she's just a great teacher. I highly recommend her class.
Best teacher ive had at smu
Ok, she's a great teacher. She really gets into the subject matter, and knows her stuff. She is so enthusiastic about the material, it gets you into it as well. Superb!
Very knowledgeable and passionate about the classical studies. Nurturing and empathic style.
A masterclass in how not to teach. Rambles incoherently, answers no questions, and seems annoyed to even be there. Assignments are nitpicked into oblivion. Avoid unless you enjoy academic misery.

Unfortunately, the classroom often felt like a space where certain students were elevated based on attention-seeking rather than academic contribution. David is horrible and a legend onlly in his own mind

A colossal waste of time, as are all these courses, taught by the most pretentious untrained professors who otherwise couldn't make it in academia. To succeed you must mirror exactly what Prof believes, and take useless bus trips for nothing. If you seek to improve your skills, take another course.

Why was there a month in between the due dates for Essays 1 & 2, but two weeks between Essay 2 & 3?? Why is there a final exam instead of paper when the entire semester we've been writing papers for grades?? Why was there no mention of women's history?? Why wasn't the Bus Tour for a grade?? Wasted 5 hours of MY Saturday for no reason.

reviews.comment: He's a busy man, but he works insanely hard. I did very well in his class, and don't see why everyone doesn't like it. As long as you read, and take the class seriously, then you'll be fine.

reviews.comment: Last 5 minutes of class and he is scolding us about how we have 10 minutes left and that it's "our grade" because we were packing up. Can't respond to a single email, doesn't get grades online, do not take this class if you want good education.
He is so full of himself yet can't do even the minimum to help students, has an obvious agenda when he teaches, is biased, and forces you to be so unless you want a bad grade.
Cannot be bothered to even respond to student concerns.

Look, I'm cool with teachers having opinions but they shouldn't be using the school's time to push their agendas. All the time we spent talking about his personal stances was inappropriate and not what I pay for. Meanwhile his coursework, reading are heavy and hardly related to the course. Blatantly rude when you ask questions, not a nice guy.

Contrary to what others have said, he is definitely the softest grader of the three who taught the Dallas class (in Fall 2019 at least). Lectures in this class were really interesting and he's very flexible. Unfortunately he is disorganized and always takes longer than he says he will to grade papers. Without holding that against him, he's awesome.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I took the University Honors Program Seminar. The classes were unplanned and sometimes the professors didn't bother to show up at all. My biggest problem is that Doyle changed how he was calculating final course grades from what was in the syllabus without telling the students. One assignment was originally 20% but 45% in the end. How is that fair?
Professor Doyle is the best professor at SMU, hands down.

Great professor that is very helpful. By far the hardest grader out of the 4 that teach the Dallas section. In the other classes, a written essay and some analysis is an easy A. That will barely touch B ground in Doyle's class. Have to go above and beyond for an A in this class.
Amazing professor and so funny!

This is my 2nd class w/ Dr. Doyle. He is a demanding teacher and the assignments are challenging, but he is a very fair grader and very passionate about what he teaches. He is very nice too. His classes are some of the best Honors classes offered! Lots of reading and writing, but very rewarding in the end.

Up front, his class was the most challenging class you will ever take. Especially if you are in the honors college - he demands your soul in return for an A. Out of my class of 20 or so, I was one of 4 A's. However, that being said, he is passionate, deeply caring and very, very brave to be outrightly gay and democratic at a school like SMU.

Dr. Doyle's class seems like it's going to be really hard, but it's actually not. There is a ton of reading and writing. (Nearly a book a week!) But he is a very fair grader and extremely helpful and friendly! If you think you can handle the reading, I would definitely recommend this class! I learned so much! It was my favorite class this fall!
Adorable. If you're in the Honors program it's useful to get close to him.  Be prepared to read a lot though. A lot.
I love Dr. Doyle, he is fabulous, intelligent and incredibly understanding and helpful. He's soooo funny and wears adorable little bow-ties. But come to class prepared.

Terrible teacher. Talks at students, not with them. Doesn't encourage participation, stifles creativity through endless monotone lectures nobody can pay attention to. Avoid this class if you value your education.

Lots of readings and the lectures are long and boring. Homeworks are easy, two tests and two papers. Slow at giving feedback and never got a grade for essays. Do the study guide for the tests and show up to class just for the activity, they will drop your grade if miss a lot of them. Not engaging but is an easy class to fulfill a CC.
Very boring and hard to follow, I could not take it any longer, do not take him while there are other options, he's awful
lectures are bland but easy grader in general. Best BUSETHICS teacher there is
