reviews.comment: Class is completely lecture-based and lectures are very boring and hard to follow, Spaid is ok to take if you are there for the credit alone. If you go to class and do the readings, it is not that difficult of a class, but if you are taking the class for reasons other than just credit, possibly find a different professor.

a vapid waste of time and space, barely even know what's going on in his course cause it is so insanely boring you can't pay attention, even as an easy grade it's not worth it, he's really that bad id rather have someone who knows how to teach well and have to do a little more work or whatever. Just find something or someone else for the credit.

Pretty bland guy, but nice. The class itself it pretty boring, but for a CC class pretty easy. Just do the HW, the in class assignments, and You'll be fine. 1 midterm and final, 2 papers. Grade is mostly made up of in class assignments and HW.
What a waste of time and space this course and this professor is. Look, we all like easy courses but this is ridiculous. Some of us need to learn for future classes and this is a joke.

So easy I literally went to class 3 times ever and got an A. He also doesn't grade the daily assignments I just write a random sentence every time not even to do with reading and get a 100. So easy take this class w him if u can so so easy almost forgot I was in it.
His lectures are extremely boring and it is very hard to pay attention. There is nothing more to the course but that. Take another professor, trust me.

This professor is easily one of the worst instructors I have ever had. Save yourself the time and energy and do not take this class. His lectures are long, boring, and repetitive. He gives no leniency or grace under any circumstances and has absolutely no understanding for any issue you may have outside of her class.

Professor Spaid's class is pretty fine. I took Business Ethics with him. If you want to learn and are invested in his lectures, you'll get an A. If you don't want to learn, you'll probably still get an A. His lectures are long and his voice is monotonous, but I found staying engaged made the class go by faster.

Nothing personal but he is a terrible teacher. All he does is lecture, which is fine but it comes straight from the reading and he adds no added value so going to class is wasteful. Everything is wasteful, his review is literally the test. everyone gets an A but he berates you if you interrupt his droning with a question. Take someone else.

Professor Spaid is a very decent professor. During lectures, his voice is super monotone and robotic. Definitely come to class with Starbucks or something. Other than that, the exams are all super easy. He pretty much gives you the answers a day before you take the test. Homework is a few 15-30 minute readings per week. Overall, easy but boring.
Nice guy who is an easy grader.

Super nice guy and very knowledgeable. If you aren't interested in philosophy, the lectures we be boring. Homework for class: a reading and a response. Homework is graded on effort rather than accuracy / understanding of the text. Midterm is very fair and he prepares you well -- same with final. The 2 papers are fun and easy. Nice grader / easy A!
He is a good guy... His class is fine, with lots of lectures and very monotone. Be ready with caffeine, or you might not live. Homework is not crazy.

Very caring person. He does get excited about what he's teaching but he's also very boring. Drags on his lectures and talks about a lot of things that don't have to do with the class he's teaching. You have to be super big on history to not get bored in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Klumpp is the best! He comes to class every day really excited and makes the content easy and fun even if you are not interested in history or religion. There are papers, but they are relatively easy. The exams are fairly easy if you study well. Read the book. It helps, and he knows if you don't. 10/10 recommend, and it's a pretty easy A.

I took RELI 1304, intro to world religions. Class is based on 3 tests, 3 essays, and participation (cannot miss more than 5 classes). Essays are not hard if you are a decent writer and took any AP lit/history courses in HS. Taking notes is extremely helpful. He is a very caring professor and amusing. Def would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Really enjoyed this class! Professor Potter is highly respected and always willing to help during office hours. Participation is key, but he makes the material manageable.

Professor Potter has a lot of ground to cover in one semester.  Therefore, his lectures can seem a bit rushed, leaving you with questions.  However, he is very approachable and always available outside of class.  The test reviews are always more difficult than the exams, which make the exams more bearable.  I recommend him to engineering students.
He was an alright teacher, but his tests are way too hard and doesn't give partial credit. Makes the class harder than it needs to be and does not curve even when the majority of the class fails.

He is an awful teacher and an even worse grader. There is no chance you will understand how to take his tests as they are nothing like the examples in class. Not to mention the quizzes that are ten times harder than the homework... If you love to spend countless hours studying for bad grades then this class is for you!

Prof Potter is by far the worst math teacher I've had. He seems like a super nice man, but his teaching abilities weren't there. I took Calc in high school and came here and thought it would be a piece of cake because I had already taken it, but it was the exact opposite. Worse grade in a class I've ever gotten. I even had a tutor. Try to avoid.

If you are not good at calculus or have never taken it, do NOT take this class. He teaches calculus backwards and often makes mistakes in class. The tests are tricky and so are the quizzes. The class is also very boring. Don't take this class if you have to

The class isn't too bad, but I'm just not a fan of him. I feel myself looking at the clock every 5 minutes just waiting to get out. The work isn't too difficult, but some of the ways he tries to explain things does not make sense. Also, people correct him on his mistakes occasionally.

Dustin potter is the most amazing calculus professor you will ever receive. He is so nice and open to helping you. He is a generous grader and There are take home quizzes that help you prepare for the exams. The exams are not tricky and are true to his teachings. He won't screw you over by teaching easy problems and putting difficult ones on exams.

Highly recommend him! He is not only great at teaching but he is fair at grading! I failed highschool calc but taking calc with him gave me a better understanding of everything! Test are straight forward and nothing he hasn't taught! You get take home quizzes which can be difficult but not bad! Seriously take him! He is so nice and teaches so well!
All he does is ramble all class and make no sense. His ego is huge and it's obnoxious when he can't even answer basic questions without talking about himself.
Places way too much emphasis on befriending students.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. you will regret it. He's awful and only yaps endlessly on and on about nothing in particular, no structure, no PowerPoints. Horrible old school professor who hasn't updated his approaches.

Pretty good guy, not an amazing teacher though, because he sits there and yaps about a million things each class. Three in-class essays based on books you must read + a huge final with all the info he yapped about + another book. Class wasn't challenging, but the final is awful and might completely tank your grade, dropping it from an A or B to a C

DONT TAKE THIS FOR CC CREDIT YOU WILL REGRET IT. He has 0 powerpoints and just speaks on 100 topics in 50 minutes, and makes the final exam cumulative and NOT multiple choice. Be prepared to be expected to learn a bunch of random, specific stuff that he will ask random prompts on for the final exam with 0 study guide or review. He seriously sucks.
A tool and a joke of a class.

Lectures seem to focus on a personal need for validation rather than material. talks endlessly about himself, aiming to gain approval from students half his age. It's cringeworthy and distracting. Class and andrew show a lack of academic depth, making the lectures increasingly unbearable. Focuses on easy As so his classes load.

A joke of class, teacher, major, but you'll get an A without having to do ANYTHING, literally hands them out so his classes fill and shows no interest in actually teaching. People like this should retire, he's past his prime, if he had onel.
This class is 🗑️ and so is his teaching. I know not his fault but the course is nothing like what he teaches, which instead is on and on about his fake storie about being some captain of industry.

Super easy class but also really good at the same time. He enjoys what he teaches, but understands that not everyone might love it. He's an easy grader—it's almost impossible to do poorly. He's happy to give out 100s
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Bro is incompetent at teaching and laughably not even trying. Just here collecting his paycheck nothing f more

One of the best professors at SMU! Cares about students and understands everyone, clear grading, if you put in effort you will be okay and you get what you give so just go to class and do the work and participate and you will be good! Great teaching, learned a lot and appreciate the experience

Class is a compete and total waste of time and so is he. The entries class is nothing but AI, all the essays, and eh know sir but doesn't care because he's calling it in to cut a fat paycheck and nothing more. Retire Andy.

Absolutely loved Professor Graybill! This was an 11 day summer class and he made it so interesting. Assignments were 2 essays, participation in class discussions, and a final written exam. The way he taught was super interesting and he made the class really interactive for us. Take him for the Historical Contexts credit if you can! Highly recommend

The man does nothing all course every course and neither do we so what you're signing up for is a free credit which is fine and all but there's no real point. Guess he's been tenured for a while so that why he can get away with doing nothing. Absolutely not in. Put some effort into your work or retire.

In Taos, Graybill took us on lots of fields trips, the essays are easy if you do the readings and highlight like important sentences, but also on the final it was open-ended and almost like "show me what you know." Great professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's been tenured for like 800 years so he doesn't do anything of anything any more which makes for an awfully dated and snooze fest of a course. If I can deal with that easy an and that's his only real purpose in this world at this point. Pitiful to go out like that but some do.
It's like he's calling it in and isn't passionate about what he does anymore. Cashing the checks and
Andrew writes more than his ugly remarks on your papers (see below for some examples). Terrible teacher and his courses are a complete waste of your time.

amazing experience throughout the course. his lectures were very in-depth and introspective. he truly cared for each and every student with his motto: “no student left behind”. i would highly recommend this course and professor for students wanting a wonderful experience in college.
Professor Graybill's class was great! He is very interested in the content and he truly wants to teach.
Great guy and clearly cares about the class he teaches. Fun field trips and really entertaining.(10/10)
Really nice guy and great classroom environment, took for Jan term and really enjoyed it
Displays dismissive and defensive behavior and outright rudeness when confronted with dissenting opinions. Did not like or appreciate his rudeness and sarcasm directed at students.
Really annoying guy
Wouldn't round my A- up to an A despite my grinding all semester for it. Don't take him if you need an easy elective.
Honestly, he is soooooo boring it is not worth it. Past his prime and nobody has told him, not funny or entertaining like he thinks he is, and just an outright drag, do not take.
This professor is a disaster. Lectures are incomprehensible, doesn't hold office hours, avoids student questions. Save yourself the headache and drop this course.
Veeerrryyyy boring, talks too fast, you don't learn anything, not worth the prices we pay for a guy to stand there and do nothing.
He is not as funny as he thinks and is honestly quite boring, hard to get through his classes.

Dr. Graybill was a fun professor. Easy class for the credit, it is discussion-based so you need to do all the readings, I found most of them enjoyable (fiction reads). Participation is a good chunk of the grade and we only had two essays and a presentation. Wasn't a tough grader at all and the assignments weren't difficult either.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The only reason everyone likes him is because he's an easy A. He runs his classes like a popularity contest rather than a competitive college course, some of us are here to learn.

I took Professor Graybill for Taos in the August term (Cult.Hist.of NM) and it was AWESOME. I visited Los Alamos, tried spices in Chimayo, and sampled five-star traditional cuisine at a lunch. I learned a lot about an often-overlooked part of our nation's history, and he made sure we were comfortable as well as entertained. Go with friends! 10/10!!

He is AWESOME. Has a very interesting lecture, attendance is not super mandatory, and wants you to learn! All of the grades come from essays, but you are able to work on the essay all day and use your notes. 100% recommend him.

I took his "Cultural History of New Mexico" course in Taos and LOVED it!!... I don't even like history. If you need to get a history credit out of the way, do it in Taos. Most of the class consists of field trips around New Mexico and Graybill is so fun! Very few assignments and the final is an in class essay.
One of the best professors I've ever had. he is incredible and if you ever have the chance to meet him or take his class do it in a heartbeat.

He's kind of funny but his lectures are honestly still really boring. He doesn't use any visual aids and talks very fast. That being said, his class is extremely easy, so still a good choice to fulfill a history credit.

You have to take notes during the lecture because literally almost everything he says is important to note. There is a lot of reading in this class, overall you read 6 books throughout the semester and usually a reading assignment every week. There is a midterm, two timed essays and the final. Graybill is great, he is very sweet and funny, take him
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This guy is awesome. He has a great attitude going into every class and makes a number of jokes to keep class engaging. He found a way to make our quarantine discussion class very interesting and thoughtful. Very accessible and gives good feedback. Would 1000% take every class he offers. Read a book each week which was certainly a lot of work.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Best Professor I have had at SMU. Talked pretty fast but made sure you understood what he had said before moving on. If you get a chance, take his class.

Hands down best class I have taken at SMU. Wasn't too excited when I got into it, but his lectures are great and you learn so much just by showing up to class. The papers are fair and there are only two which you turn in twice, once as a draft once as a revision. take him if you can!

Great teacher - loves history. Two tests that are super easy as long as you listen in class. Two in class essays that are even easier as long as you know how to work sparknotes the night before. And he's a real sweetheart. Highly recommended!

He is a good teacher the only bad thing about( He acknowledge it) is that he speaks way fast. This could be an issue for international students but other than that he is great. Definatelly recommend taking one of his classes. He is very understanding and helpful.
Doesn't know what she's talking about. PhD from. Local state college. Not. True. Professor.

I truly don't why she's getting bad reviews. She was one of the sweetest professors I've ever had and if you have the opportunity to take public speaking with her, I can't recommend a class more. She's so positive and supportive and builds up so much confidence in her students. JUST FOLLOW THE INSTRUCTIONS AND YOU WILL GET AN A!!!

She was SO condescending and belittling, horrible to have to be in her class day in and day out hearing how important she is while reminding us of how insignificant we are. Her grading was absolutely random unless you parroted her ideologies back to her, so take her if you can manage holding your nose as you write otherwise find a better option.

Hands down, one of the worst professors I have ever had. Her instructions are always unclear, class lectures are unprepared and make no sense, and is not accessible after class. While I was considering majoring prior to taking her class, I am no longer- she is rude, condescending when you ask questions.
She is the worst professor I have ever had. She will not help you with any assignment and then grades the essays so hard after not offering an ounce of help!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Duhe is alright. Lots of people like to complain about her teaching style but honestly if you just follow the directions on her assignments perfectly you will end with an A.

She is amazing, she can sometimes be tough but it is because she genuinely wants her students to succeed. She lays everything out for her students and is extremely specific on what she wants, all you have to do is put in the work. She is passionate about what she teaches which makes lectures completely bearable. Highly recommend!

Dr. Duhe is one of the best professors I've had. She is super sweet and extremely helpful when it comes to giving feedback and helping her students improve throughout the semester. Her expectations are high so you definitely need to work for a good grade. However, she really makes you see the importance of what she's teaching so it's worth it.

Group project makes up a lot of your grade, so hope you get a good group (randomly assigned). Took this course during Mayterm, and as a result tests seemed easier because there's such a short time period, so you dont have time to forget anything you learned. Overall, a great prof who truly cares about her students; not easy, but work hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Duhe is a kind person. But her class was awful. Most of the class is based on a group project, and she did not spend enough time actually teaching us. The group project is very confusing and unorganized on her part. Way too strict with absences/tardies. Overall ridiculous and unreasonably difficult especially for a 2000 level course.

Dr. Duhe is one of the nicest people you will meet. But as teacher for this class: She is unavailable at the beginning and ends of the week, she assumes you have no other work outside her class, answers are her way or ZERO CREDIT,  requires an absurd amount of time for group projects outside of class and her attendance policy is insane. DO NOT TAKE
Really liked his class and he cares deeply about students.

Prof. Durham's intro finance class isn't hard per se, but you have to teach everything to yourself. If you just go to class, you'll feel like all the material is beyond difficult when in reality it's really simple and he just overexplains it. Just teach yourself on your own time and do all pre-exam practice problems and the class is easy.

His class is like Finance for dummies. He effectively breaks down the material so everyone can understand what he is teaching. Some people didn't like him because he is quirky, but I really enjoyed his lectures. He gives you all the handouts in class and has thorough study guides. If you listen in his class it is difficult to NOT get an 'A'.

The class itself is not too challenging, but the lectures are awful.  Durham overcomplicates the material making a ten minute lesson two classes.  The extra lecturing he does makes it so much confusing than it needs to be.  If you understand the homework (Easy once a week assignment) you'll do fine.  teaches like he is talking to toddlers

Prof. Durham is a very knowledgeable person in the industry of finance, but this does not make him an effective professor. His lecture style can be very intensive and if you blink you might miss a lot of details. Drastically overcomplicates the subject through his own methods which can lead to confusion on exams and homeworks.
He will accuse you of cheating, even if you don't. Homework takes 3-4 hours to complete every time. He's knowledgeable about the subject, but not an understanding teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: i LOVE LOVE LOVE him. He is a great professor. I am still using the notes from his class and I took it last year. He really cares about his students learning and will help you if you ask for it. Truly such an amazing professor. Best professor in cox.
Great teacher, although it isn't the easiest class

Durham is one of the nicest and most caring profs. He prepares new material between classes to give students diff resources to help them learn each subject and answer ?'s. Finance is just hard, and there are only 3 tests. If you want an A, you need to get an A on all of the tests.. the study guides are very helpful and I'd take him again if I could

Nice guy on a personal level. Has some very great office hour sessions where his teaching style is far easier to understand than in lectures. However, his lectures go fast and he spends a lot of time asking for student opinion when that time could be spent covering lecture notes. His tests are tricky but not impossible. Not an easy A class...
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Finance is not easy, but he does make it very palatable. He is extremely accessible and will work with you. Come to his office hours and ask questions on things you do not understand. He gives out exam breakdowns and also study guides for the exam, so follow that! One of the nicest professors I've ever had who takes time to help their students.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I personally hate finance and think that his tests are very hard. His lectures are very hard to follow if you are a visual learner. He talks pretty fast, but I would recommend you to go to his office hours if you want to get an A. He teaches better during his office hours. I've heard worse stories about finance professors in SMU, so take thisclass.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Really nice guy and he takes the time to learn about his students. My only professor that actually knows my name. Tests and homework make up your grade. Go to office hours and ask questions during class. His tests are a lot so you have to know the material to move quickly. He loves to talk so sometimes class can be overwhelming.

He reads off powerpoint slides without looking up to explain once. His homework are hard and his tests are open book but they are graded in a difficult manner. Everyone just ends up helping each other get through this class. Coming from someone who has already graduated with a high grade point and very happy right now, I did not like his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Classes are a little dry but he tries to help students succeed and he makes exams open note to ensure understanding.
I think he actually degrades SMU reputation and quality. Worst professor ever.

Most of the students in the class had his previous semester's homework and tests. He is so lazy that he just gave pretty much the same thing for us too. Barely anyone attends the lecture, and just come on the test days only. He actually doesn't teach well, just reads off the slides he have years ago. Really boring lecture and tough grading. Skip
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: His classes are him reading off the slides and giving out his knowledge in the subject  in a way only a PHD student would understand. He doesnt teach at all, its like going to a seminar where prof talks about some fancy concept, much understanding and learning has to be done on our own.
Avoid this professor, he just reads off the pdf slides.
No Comments
I think this is the last year he is teaching, but he is the best teacher in my opinion. I really enjoyed writing for him and taking his class. I wish him the best.

Professor Gibson is the BEST DISC professor at SMU by far!!! I took him for two semesters (DISC 1312/1313) and loved every second of it. He gives fantastic feedback and he is always available for students. Very nice guy and a pleasure to work with. Take him while you can; he is retiring soon!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Loved his class overall. Only thing I didn't like is that all of the papers, mini essays, and quizzes are weighted equally so don't just blow them off because it might screw you over in the end. Don't have a final just a presentation thats not graded.
Class is very straight forward. Gibson is the king of B+'s. If you want to get an A definitely go into office hours, they are very helpful.

Dr. Gibson is one of the BEST professors at SMU. He's very passionate about higher education and writing  so if you are a lost freshman signing up for his class  this is a PERFECT ONE! Not only that, class never last the entire 50 minutes! He makes you work for an A, which i know i will appreciate in the long run since he is my 1313 professor.
He's so great! Go to his office hours at the ALEC if you want to bump your grade up. Write papers like he wants you to and you'll do well. He's extremely helpful! Definitely take him!

Professor Gibson is a great resource. He's very unique so definitely try to learn what he likes in a paper by going into the A-LEC. He gives great feedback and will really try to help you improve your essays. Listen to what he has to say! It was a fun class, and the scheduling was very nice.
So Gibson is a little scary at first but he is the best professor ever. He helped me so much with my writing and he was so kind to all of the students. He always made himself available for questions.
Best English Professor at SMU! Can be a difficult grader on the first paper, but extremely helpful and will prepare you for the rest of college
Had him for 1301 & 1302. Very funny guy. Go to his extra conference hours at the ALEC and your paper grades will improve a lot. Great professor I recommend him.
Love Dudley! His class consists of reading out loud every day and you have tons of no class days. He grades a little hard, but his class is sooo easy

Prof. Gibson has been my favorite professor at SMU by far. The materials we learn in class are very applicable to college life and beyond. He is a hard grader if you do not pick up his style. But I highly recommend taking his class!

We read out loud and have discussions during class. You get to know all the people around you pretty well. He is very clear on assignments, there are NO surprises in his class so its very easy for which to prepare. I'd suggest his class to anyone in the HSP.

He is a very hard grader. He gave me really good comments and would have only 1 or 2 "corrections" on a 4-5 page paper and yet I would get A-'s. I received an A only when there was not a single correction on the entire page. I got A- on every major paper and an average of A- on the mini papers and was given a B+ in the class. That's just wrong.

TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN! The best Hilltop English teacher. The class is super-easy: only 8 papers (4 of which are one-page essays), no research required, no peer reviews, 4 easy quizzes. NO FINAL. Very helpful conferences. He is a cool guy and sometimes would spend the whole class just talking about stuff,lets out early.Great at explaining assignments.

The class is really easy and does not require your attention to do well. He either likes your writing style or doesnt. if he likes it then you get As if you don't you get Bs. He has a dry sense of humor and is a pretty cool guy.

I don't understand the reviews. 1. She does not yell and she's not rude. 2. Her class is not hard, and you do not really have to do much outside learning. 3. The only hard aspect is the lab, even then they are very easy. If you find this class hard, just please go to her office hours and speak to her, after I did that I loved the class!
Worst professor I have ever seen at SMU. Zero ability. Zero teaching and research skill.

Dr. Dworak is literally the best professor I had in SMU.
Really cares about students.
makes a lot of effort to make sure that everyone understands the course materials

Honestly, I always look for her course offerings first. 
SHE'S AMAZING.

She barely covers the basics but you have to do so much work on your own, demeanor in class is so unfriendly and uses a sense of humor that is rude and inappropriately targeted toward students. Yells at students during class for not paying attention, which is really disruptive for the students that are actually trying to.

Professor Dworak is the best professor I have had so far in Lyle. She teaches difficult concepts in ways that are easy to understand and keeps lectures engaging. Tests are similar to homework and the grading curve is extremely forgiving. She is accessible outside of class and has useful exam review sessions. If you can take her class do it.

Professor Dworak's teaching makes understanding difficult concepts easy.  She is receptive to student feedback and will spend time in class to re-explain concepts that students don't understand.  Very clear what she expected the class to know.  She grades fairly, making it easy to get an A as long as you are engaged in class.

Professor Dworak makes lectures engaging and entertaining, and does a great job breaking down complex concepts. Her amiable personality and extreme smarts make her a wonderful professor who I would highly recommend.
If you put in work, and do it sincerely, you will get good grades. She has amazing credentials and is very helpful. A very fair grader.

Great professor: does everything she can to make you successful as long as you ask for help. She definitely challenges you, but her grading is fair and you'll get through it if you work hard and use your resources. She minimizes textbook use to hw problems. Get ready for Star Wars references! :)
hot

I had Dwelle for both 1301 and 1302. You do not have to do that much reading. She grades hard, but if you put a good effort in and listen to what she says in office hours you will do great. I hated english going into college, but Dwelles class really improved my writing abilities. She loves to see improvement
Dwelle is a wonderful instructor. The class is hard, but she is VERY helpful. If you want to improve your writing skills then TAKE HER! I took her both semesters freshmen year and made an A- and A.

Her essay prompts are terrible, and she essentially tells you what she wants you to write. If you don't agree with her, you're screwed. She sets arbitrary requirements for the papers (like having a paragraph seperate from the intro for the thesis). She's also one of those people who finds symbolism in everything. Avoid this prof at all costs.

By far the worst teacher SMU has to offer. Lots of reading and if you dont participate she kicks you out of class. Papers are the only grade and if you dont write how she wants and totally argee with her even if you dont you will get a bad grade. I used the writing center and it still didnt help because i didnt agree with her opinion. Stay away!!!!

She was very friendly and easy to talk to.  She was not incredibly clear during conferences on our papers I was always confused what she was asking.  If you have complex ideas then your fine in this class but you have to write the way she wants you to write not the way you learned in high school. But she can be kinda intimidating at times
She is a great teacher as long as you actually try and see her for help!

I took her both semesters for English my Freshman year. The first semester was really hard but she was really good at teaching and making my writing better. Second semester I'm not sure what she did but I went from a B student to an A student in my essays. If you want to evolve as a writer take her if you want something easy take Knight.

Excellent professor, she makes your writing evolve, at the beginning of the class I was a horrible writer and the last essay I made a 98%, the best I have ever done.  She is very helpful and the discussions in class are very good.  As long as you are not disrespectful or just plain stupid you will have a good experience in this class. =)

Dwelle is an amazing teacher. You have to write tbe same amount of essays as all other classes but she does have you write a lot of drafts of one essay. She is super helpful and has a very dry sense of humor. If you dole it out expect to get it back.
Very straightforward and willing to help. Has opened my mind to stray away from the typical 5 paragraph essay. Has helped me formulate ideas and tear my papers, for the better

This class was boring. She also grades really hard and she isn't very nice. I don't feel like she puts much effort into helping her students either. I once showed up for a conference and she had forgot about me. She is very strict and won't let you get away with anything, unless you are one of her favorites.
DROP THIS CLASS NOW. This lady makes ZERO effort to establish a relationship with her students. She is  a RUDE & MEAN lady.. should def RETHINK her career as a college professor.
moderate to poor

Dwelle is hands down the worst teacher I have ever had at SMU.  If you have her as an instructor IMMEDIATELY drop her.  she acts like every word she says is a burden to have to speak, she will do anything to teach less, grade slower, and put less effort into her job.  She has no personal relationships with any of her students and is blatantly biase
Kind of a witch with a b.  Definitely thinks this is still high school.  No way to get ahead but no way to fall behind... basically boring as hell.

Such a waste of time and money, they hired her for a reason and you can see that it's not becuase of her teaching, she is here to increase differently capable groups... does not respond to emails, does not hold office hours

Shes great! idk why there's so many bad reviews lol shes super accomodating.... some students are just so entitled especially at this school. It doesn't take much to get a good grade, just go to class...
JOKE of a teacher hired under last administration dei plofies as she isn't teaching or doing her job an embarrassment of SMU
Great professor and great class. She is super understanding and kind. Tests were open note. There is a big group project, but it was not too bad. Would definitely take her again.

Very easy class. Tests weren't on Lockdown and they were mostly open note (the last one was only a notecard). The team project seems daunting but it wasn't bad. The weekly discussion posts were annoying because there were no reminders of them. Dr. Jinneh is kind and passionate about the class. This is a great, easy way to get a PSYC elective done.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class-wise, it was very easy to do well and the content was moderately interesting. Prof was kind and not a hard grader on the paper and the tests were all virtual and open note. She LOVED the football players and spent a considerable amount of time catering to them. Kept filming us during lectures though?? idk take this class for an easy A.
worthless course, an embarrassment to the university
Easy class, a little hard to reach outside class
Like a used car salesman and degrees from Capella. They hired her for a reason and not because she can teach.

Literally the first day and I  can already tell how this is going. Never felt better in the first day of class and absolutely love her teaching style and goals for her class. Very inspirational and is a coach/mentor to you instead of a professor.

I LOVE THIS PROFESSOR! She felt more like a friend than a professor and was fair, respectful, and kind to everyone. She truly wanted every student to succeed and always emphasized how she never wanted her class to cause us stress, just wanted us to learn and grow. Take her class if you get a chance she's the best!

Dr. Jinneh is an amazing person who wants her students to succeed. She went over all the exams before we took them, which was extremely helpful when it came to knowing what to study. She could have done better with time management, as we had to teach most of the material for the last two exams to ourselves since she brought in guest speakers.

She only teaches the fundamental concepts but does not explain how to apply them. The homework that is given is not very helpful for the exams, and only the practice exams she releases are actually relevant to what will appear on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Balakishiyeva is a decent professor, physics is just a difficult class to teach, especially in larger class sizes. She is accessible if you need help and will always answer questions. I appreciated her grading policy, with 40% of your grade being made up of homeworks and online quizzes.

Don't expect this to be an easy class, test two average was under 50 for my class and I've yet to see everyone finish a test on time. This class is what you make of it if you show up everyday and go to her test review you'll probably do fine. I just don't understand why the tests are under an hour but have more questions than a TTH statics class.

Just through lectures it is clear Durdana knows the material well. It is a good idea to go through the slides before or after, but not necessary. She is available every weekday for office hours, so if you don't understand something, attend them. This will be one of the hardest classes you take, but that's just physics. Durdana isn't bad.
The WOOOOORRRRRSSSSTTTTT
worst professor and person. Huge ego with little interest in actually teaching. Do not take.

Dr. Durdana is super sweet and always available for questions and help. Physics is naturally just hard so you'll definitely have to study alot outside of class, but she explains concepts very thoroughly and multiple times during class. Sometimes, she was hard to follow but overall pretty good, highly recommend!!

Physics is already a really hard subject but it doesn't help when shes super disorganized in lecturing and wont ever finish an example problem if her life depended on it. Tests are so extremely difficult with averages in the 40s. shes really kind but you'll end up teaching ur self the entire class just to still end up failing exams

Durdana is one of my favorite and least favorite professors. So kind and willing to explain almost anything, but her exams have been exponentially harder than what I expected. I have many previous tests, and the level of difficulty was increased fs. Still recommend her, just know that my grades with her are the lowest ones on my transcript.
the woman cannot teach and is clearly writing her own reviews

The contents of the class were very difficult, but Professor Balakishiyeva can be very forgiven when grading the exams, and almost half the grade comes from online homework and quizzes. Lowest score exam gets dropped.

Took both PHYS1303 and PHYS1304.  Lectures did a decent job of explaining the content, but I preferred online resources (The Organic Chemistry Tutor) to understand the content in-depth.  The grading distribution makes getting a good grade fairly straightforward.

Her lectures can be confusing and fast at times so make sure to pay attention during class and take good notes. Don't be afraid to ask questions during lecture. I thought this course was tougher than 1307. She is the best professor to take physics with at smu. The class is hard but she does provide plenty of office hrs and easy to reach via email.

Lectures confused me at times and I did have to put in a lot of work outside of class. I found videos on youtube (Theorganicchemistrytutor yt channel gr8 vids to help study) that helped me better understand the topics. She is an amazing and understanding professor. She was always very quick to respond via email which i really appreciated.

I took her for summer physics 2 and she was great. She doesn't rush through things during lecture and walked through problems which helped a lot for tests. She gave a lot of Hw but honestly it prepared well for tests. Also she's so sweet and is the cutest lady!!

Lacks teaching skills. Does not teach subject properly. Doesn't explain concepts to help students apply the knowledge. Belittles students, classes are one way, asks students if they have questions and without giving them time to ask, moves from one topic to another. The worst

is so rude to students and makes fun of them for being confused or getting questions wrong, makes no effort to actually teach anything in office hours without being condescending, lectures are riddled with mistakes teaching us wrong.

DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE

Took 1303 with Durdana, now 1304 and she was amazing yet again! Best physics professor in the department, having 40% of the grade be easy 100 homework/online quizzes, 40% 2 of 3 exams (one dropped) and 20% the final. She teaches the material well and is hilarious in class. She is generous with points back on exams. Durdana is a legit girl boss.

Amazing professor! Grades are generous: 20% Online Homework, 20% Online Quizzes, 40% 2 of 3 exams (1 dropped), 20% Final Exam. The homework and quizzes are easy 100s, so 40% of your grade is already 100 with a drop exam. Dr. Balakishiyeva explains the material excellently and is easy to understand. 10/10, best professor in the Physics department.

Dr. Balakishiyeva is so awesome! Her lectures are consistent with the exams, and she is very accessible outside of class. If you talk over your exams with her, she might give you points back. I highly recommend taking her over the other physics professors here.

The most unnecessarily hated professor. The class is difficult but that's just the nature of physics. As a prof, she's a great lecturer and is really patient. Plus, there are lots of ways to raise your grade even if you don't do well on the midterms- homework and quizzes (all submitted online) are worth like 40% and she drops your worst midterm.

Definitely very knowledgeable and a good professor - I honestly think her talents would be better suited in a more advanced physics class than just an introductory course. Her grading scheme is very generous and there's lots of opportunities to improve your grade. Only criticism is I didn't find her lectures themselves very helpful.

This is the worst professor I have had at this school by a long shot. Does not help us learn and is constantly unavailable. On top of that has an attitude and is sarcastic with students specifically those of us who are non-majors
The worst professor in all my years of school. DOes not teach and is condescending in office hours when you seek help. Stay away.

Took this professor for both physics 1 and 2 and didn't put in that much effort but was still able to make a good grade in both. Physics 2 was really difficult however she has office hours everyday and you are able to go back after exams and ask for points back. Physics in general is difficult however she is great and very caring and understanding.
While her lectures are quite difficult to follow through, she is awesome outside her class and always willing to help students. Took her both 03 and 04 and she is great at grading styles.

Regardless of what others say, it is my opinion that the SMU Physics department is lacking. With that said, Balakishiyeva is the only physics professor I liked. Yes, be prepared for some extremely hard tests, but she truly wanted her students to succeed. She will answer questions and talk after class and during office hours if needed.

Took during a July term. Durdana is one of my favorite teachers at SMU. Took her for both 1303 and 1304 and would take her for more classes if I could. She's funny, approachable and very helpful. She made E&M interesting and exciting. Definitely take over an intersession. HW + Quizzes + Particpation = 70% and final exam = 30% of your final grade.

The grading was pretty straightforward, and she dropped the lowest of three in class exams. Attendance was not taken at all. Lectures were bland, but she tried to get a laugh or two. Not much participation (no grade for it). From what I have heard, she is way better than any other options in the department. Speaks coherently and provides examples.

Durdana is a phenomenal prof for such a difficult subject. Great for PHYS 1303 and 1304. Lectures aren't always interesting but are meaningful. Will give partial credit and points back if you go to her in office hours, which are super helpful. Textbook, quizzes & homeworks are online through Wiley but lecture examples help the most with studying.

Nice person and a good teacher for a difficult class. Her lectures aren't the most engaging, but the concepts aren't too difficult to understand. Homework and quiz grades make up 40% overall, but use Chegg for help. Tests are pretty difficult, but she'll usually give you free points back on your tests if you talk the grade through with her.

You'd think as the only physics 2 prof, she'd be an amazing prof but no. Her lectures make little to no sense, and the tests are pretty difficult. The homework and quizzes make you think you understand the concepts well, but when it comes down to the test, the problems are 1000x harder. Its like taking a calc test in an algebra class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Balakishiyeva is overall a good professor. She gives examples on the board but doesnt even fully solve them. She makes jokes through out class. Very good at communicating and is also helpful during office hours. Physics overall is pretty hard but she does a good job at teaching it
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not who you want to take. Bio majors im sorry but she also teaches physics 2 and I havent seen another professor available. She is very hard to understand and doesnt work through the example problems. She does not show work at all, even if you go to the test reviews. Hw and quizzes are doable but I had to use chegg for help.

Durdana is a great professor! She is super sweet and funny and actually cares about her students. Her tests are hard, but there is tons of partial credit and a drop test! The homework is very time-consuming, but helps to prepare (and an easy 20% of grade). I would recommend Chegg to help with homework, usually different numbers so it actually helps

She is very nice, pay attention in lectures and actually do the homework and you will be fine. Available during office hours, willing to help but physics in general is not easy and her class is no exception.

Super easy. If you took physics in hs, you'll be fine. Got an A in PHYS1303 and PHYS1304 and did not need to show up to class once. Super accessible if you have questions. All homework is done online with Wiley but can get time consuming. Tests are pretty easy if you can do homework with no problem. Great prof and would take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was hard but Dr B was a good professor. Her lectures are informative and she works through a lot of examples in class. Because this class is hard, do not be afraid to ask for help! Many smart people struggle in this class but Dr B is available to help. It is also very nice that one exam is dropped.

Took her for physics 1&2, in my opinion 2nd semester is easier. She is very passionate about teaching physics and very accessible outside of class to ask questions. Just make sure to do a lot of practice problems, and get good grades on hw/quizzes as they make up like 40% of your grade. Should be able to get atleast B+/A- as long as you study well

I took physics I & II these past two semesters with Durdana & am so grateful to have had the opportunity to learn under her even though I really dislike physics (bio major). It was definitely hard and the homework kind-of sucked, but she is extremely accessible and genuinely cares about your success. Her passion for the subject is VERY evident.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I love her. I took her for physics 1 and 2. She does not care about attendance at all. Her tests are really hard but you get a drop test and the way it is weighted sets you up for success. She is available outside of class and cares about her students even though it does not seem like it at first. She's one of my favorite professors, a homie.

Professor Balakishiyeva is very good at teaching the material. The tests are manageable and she gives resources so you can succeed in the class. You need to do the work and study outside of the class.

The class is difficult and the homeworks are impossible. Luckily each test/final together take 60%. There is a pre set curve but it is difficult to get a B because the averages on the test are below 58.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Durdana is probably the best physics professor in the department at SMU. She is extremely accessible outside of class (answers emails within 5 min at 12AM), very straightforward with testing material, and will give back points on tests if you ask her to review the grading bc its done by her TAs. Physics is hard but doable with her!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor balakshiyeva is wonderful. The class is hard obviously... its physics. She gives you a drop test though and is very generous rounding grades at the end of the semester. Although it may feel like youre failing or barely going to pass, if you put in the effort and show up to office hours she will notice and help you out at the end

The way Professor Balakishiyeva explained the material made a lot of sense to me. Physics is naturally a hard subject to learn, however, I came out of the course with more knowledge than I started with. If you do not understand something, her office hours are really helpful and are a good backup.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If you want to fail your class, get her! She is the absolute worst teacher at SMU

There's two good things about this class: attendance isn't mandatory and you can pass it with a C- at a 60%. Very difficult tests, unhelpful lectures because she won't actually fully solve any problems, and she assumes you have quite a bit of previous physics knowledge. Sadly, she might be the best option at SMU though

I never took physics up until college, I was worried it was going to be difficult. There are 3 tests with 1 test dropped but the hw and quiz grade makes up 40% of the total grade and they are not very difficult. I managed to get an A on the first test and a B on the next. Go to her after tests to get some points back and you will be fine. Not hard
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. B is really knowledgeable about physics, but I think sometimes she forgets her students might have little to no physics or calculus background. She does a lot of example in class, but stops halfway through by saying "the rest is just math", leaving you confused. I must say she's good with her office hours though, it's the only way I survived.
Is exceedingly clear in her explanations and really knows what she is talking about. Physics is hard, though, so be sure to study hard. Also, go to office hours, it really helps

She's a really good professor and is really helpful during office hours. She's really good at answering any type of questions too. Her tests are not impossible if you understand the homework. If you have any trouble, just go to her office hours.
She is very accessible outside of class. She is very approachable and caring. You will work hard but she tries hard to help you in any way.

Dr. B was honestly a really good professor, especially relative to some other professors in her department. I actually learned quite a bit, and the midterms weren't that bad. Physics is a difficult subject, so it definitely won't be a cake walk, but Dr. B is a solid choice for intro physics.
Very tough class but not impossible if you do the assignments. She's very helpful in office hours too! Looks great too!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Avoid taking at all costs, please save yourself! This professor somehow is able to ramble for 80 minutes straight, while still teaching no physics. Her tests are nearly impossible, as they don't match what she teaches in class. Unfortunately, she is still the best option in the physics department, which is really sad.

Might be the worst professor I have ever taken. Going to class does not help. Grading for the tests is very harsh. Also, no way to know what tests are going to be. Quote "it is a game of chance, which topics are included and which are not in the version of the test that you will get." Honestly, this should be against SMU policy for grading . Unfair
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: By far the worst professor I've taken at SMU. Test are graded to an impossible extent. WileyPLUS is an awful software. Avoid her at all costs.

Exams are extremely hard and not similar to practice questions or those on Wiley Plus. TAs grade with no partial credit so you must go to office hours to bargain points back. The hardest class I've ever taken at SMU.

Everyone told me to beware her class, but after finishing the semester I really enjoyed her. The class was tough, and I bombed the last exam for outside reasons, but her office hours were key. She was super ready to walk you through any questions you had. Super heavy on WileyPlus, but I appreciate her so much more after taking Dr. Ye for 1304.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: It was her first semester teaching when I took her (fall 15) and it was awful. Her tests did not resemble lecture in any way. Her TAs are the toughest graders you will find.

she is so so nice but does not grade her own tests. the TA that grades the tests grades WAY too hard- always go into her office to go over the test and she usually gives points back. she really cares about her students and will help those she knows truly care

This class is 100% based on your 4 tests (w/ 1 dropped). The tests aren't hard, but they're only 4 questions. Also her TA grades them and gives NO partial credit, so ALWAYS go in to have her re-grade your tests later. Plus, then she knows your face and that you care and will help your grade in the end. Class isn't necessary as long as you study.
Seriously I have never felt so lost in a class ever.

Terrible instructor, uses Wiley for everything, going to her class is the exact same as staying home and reading your textbook, there is no noticeable difference. She is Nice, just a terrible teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lectures are conceptual. Examples in class are CALC3 level mathematically, doesn't solve all the way, states, "The rest is just math". Exams are difficult, you never know what to expect. WileyPlus is a broken system, making homework nearly impossible, and Wiley PP slides are difficult to follow (and have errors). Course grade impossible to predict
I enjoyed the clas, Dr. B can involve students with day to day related activities that help us better understand more complex lessons in physics. I may not enjoy physics but I do enjoy the class.

Very nice teacher, and wants to teach the class but there is a disconnect. Read the book and teach yourself, doing as many practice problems as you can. She tries to give partial credit, but for a lot of people this understandably isn't enough as most people aren't learning at all and isn't helped by the difficulty and lack of interest of most ppl.
She is a good professor, and the lecture is clear if you pay your full attention to her.

This class is so tough because she doesn't do much course design herself she leaves the material to Wiley, so the PowerPoints are all graduate-level calculus and quantum physics that nobody understands, the mandatory online WileyPLUS textbook goes over our heads, and the online homework is brutal. Also she is no longer allowed to offer retakes.

She uses a very shoddy online website for homework and quizzes. The homework and quizzes there are not like anything you go over in class. The website crashes often. She will often only work halfway through her example problems and won't guide through the rest of it. If you can take another teacher, do that without hesitation.
She WILL NOT give exams or quizzes retakes anymore. If you want to take her for that, then don't because it's not available anymore.

She's dropping the re-take policy, so if you are considering taking her for it - don't. Her lectures are beyond boring, shallowly covering the material, rarely doing practice problems. Tests are really easy if you studied hard, but she gives little to none partial credit when you mess up. Does not record attendance, but gives pop quizzes sometimes.

Dr. Balakishiyeva's class is a mess. She doesn't take attendance but wonders why only half the class shows up, doesn't teach the material clearly, and is't available outside her office hours. If you have the chance to get another professor, take it.

Her lectures are sometimes dry, but overall, she is a really nice person and she dose not want to make it hard to pass the exam. So she gives everyone chances to retake all tests and quizzes which costs her personal spare time to grade.
Professor gives test retakes but never gives graded homework back if you do it on paper. Doesn't help that much in office hours

The class can get kind of boring because she only goes over the powerpoints in class and sometimes goes over examples that aren't on the powerpoint. Tests are hard only if you dont put in the effort to study outside of class. She does give the option to retest if you do poorly on a test.

Seriously I have never felt so lost in a class ever. She does not have a syllabus and announces tests a week before. She only lectures on concepts and expects you to learn how to solve complicated physics problems by yourself. Everyone fails the tests and she doesn't curve or give partial credit. Unless you took physics before, don't take her.
Doesn't tell you when there is homework, doesn't give you back grades, test, or solutions. No equations or examples given in class. doesn't give partial credit and won't help you during office hours

We had Exams 2,3,4 over the course of TWO weeks. Exam 3 was only over one lecture as well. Her English is not too good, but what do you expect from introductory physics here at SMU? She used the online site to assign homework and such but she never announces when she assigns the homework and wastes 20 minutes every other day giving pop quizzes.

Others have mentioned patient confidentiality issues, shifting due dates, and lack of feedback; I wanted to confirm those. Additionally, she didn't notify us of an important assignment (SONA credits) until the middle of November. Strong lack of professionalism when speaking on serious topics. Avoid if you can. If not, you need the online textbook.

We learned half of the content in class and the other notes were often just posted after class. It was an easy A but not an exciting learning environment for someone who actually wanted to learn the material. While the prof is really talented at her job outside of school, teaching is not the best. I felt like we glossed over all the content.

She reads straight off the slides and then overshares about her clients. She once told us the first and last name of a client and then simply said "it's fine he's dead." Doesn't grade anything. Never got a response to a single email all semester and doesnt have office hours. She said we would have 4 exams and drop our lowest. We had one exam.

I do not think Van Dyke is fit for teaching abnormal psyc. She glosses over more complex concepts in her lectures. It's all surface level things I already know. I did not learn anything all semester. The class is fairly easy, but she ruined my favorite subject, now I don't know as much as I should about psychopathology as a future therapist...

PVD has an online PhD, which is reflected in her teaching style. She frequently teaches objectively inaccurate information about abnormal psychology and reveals personal information about her former clinical patients. Her syllabus is a mere suggestion as she ran about six weeks behind changing deadlines on a whim. Blames most mistakes on the TA.

Great class! She's hilarious and so nice, and the class is graded by 2 test grades (one of these is the highest of the first two unit exams during the semester, so 3 tests total), a project, some written assignments and a 5-10 page essay. It's definitely achievable to make an A!
Great Professor.

The class is extremely interactive. Get ready to talk to everyone in the class and have break-out room discussions. The lectures prepare you well for the tests however to really do well make sure you do the quizzes from the online textbook. If you do this you should get an A.

I don't think Van Dyke was prepared for online teaching: she didn't update the syllabus from last semester & she was constantly changing due dates. Other than that she was a good prof, really experienced in her field. You have to pay $120 for Cengage. lots of discussion boards & class activities, 3 tests, 1 group project, and 1 paper.

Horrible professor. Tests are based on 100s of slides over weeks yet are only 35 questions. Makes it impossible to study for them as she gives you super vague study guide. She is rude when she feels threatened. All students questioned her after first test and she backfired aggressively. Pointless long paper and group project. AVOID IF YOU CAN
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Overall, I had a subpar experience. The class itself is tedious and asinine, which doesn't help. PVD didn't communicate her expectations or grading criteria clearly. She also didn't respond to anyone's emails the entire class period, which made it difficult since I took it as a June mini-term. She never graded any of the assignments before finals.

She knows her management and has years of amazing experience to back it up. While course content didn't feel like the class priority, her stories taught us just as much. I looked forward to her TuThurs 8am all the time! Crazy!

Easy A class, but you won't learn a lot from here. It was a-okay course, but I am in process of grade appeal. After I received my final grade, I asked her about the breakdown of the grade, and she marked me 7 absences even though I never missed the class. For exam 2, there were 3 questions that were wrong, but she did not reflect those in the grade
The nicest, funniest, best professor. I had it 8am but did not mind going because it was such a chill class. She lets you collaborate on all assignments and we are taking a group final.

Dr. Van Dyke is one of the best professors I've had at SMU. She is very well-spoken and knowledgable, but also extremely kind. She is looking to help you succeed. She is willing to do whatever it takes to help you do that. Her peppiness also keeps class interesting and fun. I would definitely recommend taking her to anyone. Well worth it.

PVD is the best management teacher by far. You will not regret taking this class. It is the one class I enjoy going to in the morning. She makes class very fun, and it is very laid back. All she wants from you is to succeed!

Professor Van Dyke is so awesome. She is super fair and lets you collaborate with your peers on the tests ;) (like actually). Lets you out early and tells you everything on the tests & she drops one test too. She tells you to read the txtbook but you do not need it & I wish I didn't buy it. Her lectures are so interesting and she holds ur attention
Really great professor. Her classes weren't boring and the tests weren't too bad.
I took this course for a JanTerm and it was awesome. The workload was light and the lecture format was fun and engaging. I would highly recommend this professor and this course.

Great teacher, took her during the summer. Some group projects, lots of in class participation helps with grades, and really nice about the tests (i.e. lax about the grading, open book, etc, etc). One of my favorite professors in Cox. Really nice and understanding lady as well.
Great teacher! Really prepared when it comes to knowing about the real world. Class is easy, attendance is not mandatory and tests are straightforward. I would definitely take her again.

PVD's class was a mess from day one. She has a completely different understanding of the material from the text she uses and frequently mistakes definitions. Her first exam was missing half its questions, the second included the same question four times. She cant pronounce words properly and cant distinguish affect and effect. Not up to par for Cox
Took him years ago and he was hostile toward students and a bad teacher, now in administration where he hopefully has less contact
Great Professor! Took him for Fundamentals of Environmental Engineering

Professors Easton is enthusiastic and explains the material well. He is easy going and is willing to help whenever requested. The class is mainly comprised of design projects which take time and effort. Altogether, he is a great professor and nice guy.

Dr. Easton is a great professor. I took Fundamentals of Environmental & Civil Engineering with him and I really enjoyed the class. He shows how the concepts we learn in class will apply to potential future jobs. If you listen in class and take notes you will do well in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Super super nice guy. Homeworks and tests are take home, but take a lot of time. Very accessible outside and will pretty much give you the answer to test problems. Wants his students to succeed. Final open note and he helps you during test. Hard class but he really tries to explain well. Would recommend!
He's a really nice and caring professor, but his classes are average. It's an easy class if you show up and but in a little effort.

The class covers very elementary and boring material (how to write a paper, how to speak in front of people, etc.), but Easton at least makes the class somewhat interesting. The class is really easy if you understand the basic concepts of public speaking and writing. Overall, Easton is pretty nice and interesting.
he's nice but the class isn't easy
No Comments

Grades easy assignments and peer reviews extremely hard just to try to made her class seem legit. The fact that this class dropped my GPA and I'm majoring in Math and EMIS is a joke. Her background and experience seems made up and illegitimate. Peer evaluations and group projects will drop your grade even if you do your part perfectly.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Easton honestly ate with this course. She's the absolute best. SLAY Queen. I love you.
Professor Easton is a great, engaging professor. She is easily accessible and truly wants students to succeed. The class is challenging, but take notes and don't miss class, you will do fine!

I loved this class! The course content was kind of a lot, but it was manageable and Professor Easton was flexible with due dates. She also allowed people to redo assignments for a better grade. Overall, I really liked her and would take her again.
This woman is such a horrible professor. Her lectures are dry, and boring. Her industry experience seems made up, and she does not have clear grading criteria.

Professor Easton seems like she means well during the first two weeks of class. However, once you start actually doing group projects and big assignments, her grading criteria is absolutely bonkers. She gives you rubrics each time and they don't align with what her assignment detail handouts say or what she says in class OR what canvas says. SO BAD
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Wow, for such an easy class Diana makes it way too tough. This class was too big of a time commitment for such a poor grade. Homework all the time, a big group project, all to receive a bad grade because she grades very hard. Presentations arent often so doesnt even help with public speaking. And when you do present, expect a low grade
