reviews.comment: Professor Moskowitz is very qualified and knowledgeable about business. At first I found him intimidating (typically Wall Street Banker). Overall, I really enjoyed this class and I think every business major should take it! It rolls every business situation into 1 class.

Great course! The course cases are interesting and valuable.  The work is challenging but the prof is very helpful to students, you will get a lot of value from this course. Great discussions but you must prepare! Take him if you get a chance.

Rowena is a great lecturer. This class has no final exam, just online quizzes and a group project at the end. Attendance is important, you need to be in class. If I had the opportunity, I would like to take lessons from her again.

- The professor knows alot, but doesn't know how to communicate well
- Might be a good researcher, but is possibly one of the worst teachers in the MSBA program
- Teaches in the air, it was quite evident from the faces of students that no one was getting a thing

One of the worst professors in the Cox MSBA program. She is very unaccommodating to student requests, gives very unclear instructions on homework, and her lectures are as interesting as watching paint dry. Additionally, her lectures don't align at all with what she ends up testing on. Very tough grader, avoid this professor at all cost!

Exams are basically useless as the HW's are worth like 40%. There's a HW pretty much every week and at least for our semester, he doesn't upload any notes so if you miss a class either go office hours or get a friend cuz you will be screwed. Test 2 average (last before final) was abysmal too so take with that what you will

Never written a rating but I came here to hype my boy harsha up. Gangammanavar is one of the best professors I've had at SMU. I had him for EMIS 3360 and his lectures were very clear and straightforward. He did an amazing job at keeping the students engaged and provided plenty of resources for tests. Take good notes and you'll get an A.

Homework cases (graded) much more difficult than material covered in class. No individual feedback on homework. Mistakes in the instructors partial solutions to cases, and some cases built on each other, making subsequent assignments more difficult. Limited, inadequate assistance when requested. Cases required solution methods that were not taught.

One of the worst teachers I've taken so far. The lectures consist of a daily, plain powerpoint with no real insights. 

He claims to be an AI expert and then when he uses chatGPT to make his tests he leaves the dashes and random bolded words. 

The final exam was the most ridiculous thing, 62% average with BS questions designed to trick you.

Class content itself is easy to understand but the exams are written by AI and designed to trip you up. Final had average of 72/110. Tested on obscure concepts from class discussion and the 3 guest speakers. You will learn the content but if you're looking for a safe A, even if you work hard, look elsewhere.

Dr. Orosy seems like an enjoyable teacher, but will very quickly slap you across the face with bad grades and a ridiculous final, AFTER you submit a teacher evaluation (convenient for him). Was doing well for the majority of the semester, until last presentation and final. He gave us a study guide that had zero correlation to the final.

I don't understand why Gary has such negative reviews I love him! He's so funny and is very knowledgeable in what he teaches. He is not always clear on what he wants but go to his office hours and form a relationship with him. He wants to help you now and in the future! Easy grader if you put in the work and ask questions!!!
AI guru. Very funny and cares about his students. Projects can be tough, but if you go to office hours, he helps a lot and will tell you exactly what you need to do.

Hell on earth. Nothing was ever clear in this class, assignments were not relevant to the course, and would not give clear feedback on assignments. Expected us to just understand what we were supposed to do for assignments then would give us a bad grade if we didn't do it "correctly." Avoid this class if possible, not worth your time or money.
he is the worst

Orosy is quirky. The lectures were so boring, the case studies are a little hard to master, but overall he is super laid back (call him, he doesn't answer emails). If I could explain how I felt in one word it would be perplexed (by him). Good class though

He cold calls all the time, and if you miss even a hyphen wrong on tests and quizzes there's no remorse and you get the question fully wrong. He interrupts every single presentation group and guest speakers to the point its disrespectful. Also talks while you are taking tests, yet doesn't allow any questions to be asked about the test, no excuse.

The professor feels narcissistic. Refused to provide an explanation of why our group received the grade we did on a group project. He seemed offended when our group questioned what he counted off for. Feels unfair to refuse to provide a student with feedback.

He is very unapproachable! My group project was not assigned a case study to complete. When we asked him which one to do he gave us the first one, which was due 2 days later, when everyone else had 8+ weeks to do the assignment. He doesn't respond to emails, there are no set office hours and the syllabus was not on canvas for over half the course.

Gary is an amazing person and has had an amazing career in marketing, and it shows. He does care about his students and really cares about engagement in class. He will cold call on you even though it is a huge lecture class, so pay attention.  His office hours really matter and going will show him that you care about the class.

Gary Gary Gary, where do I begin? To make it simple, he is a good professor, and a nice man. Your grade will be just fine if you engage in his class. He is very quirky, and can be frustrating at times, but at the end of the day, he's a good experience. You never know what is going on, but usually you can survive it. Worth taking.

I love professor orosy. As long as you go to class and try to participate where you can, you will have a good time in his class. I have taken 3 different courses taught by him because I always enjoy his classes.

Professor Orosy is a very harsh, energetic teacher. His class was not super hard and he prepares students well for his tests. He cold calls and you have a presentation worth 30% of your grade so don't take him if you don't like speaking in public. He does not extend deadlines or give second chances on assignments.

His lectures are extremely dry, but he cold calls so you have to pay attention. He makes people answer really unnecessary questions that oftentimes require googling the answer and wasting time. He's pretty condescending as well. He has unrealistic expectations for assignments and does a terrible job explaining criteria for them. Not worth taking.

You will be okay in this class if you memorize the meaningless information from the textbook/lectures. The group projects are easy, and he grades them nicely. The exams are often poorly written, and his grading on the free response questions is somewhat nonsensical. This class was not at all interesting, but it was also not too hard.

professor orosy has lots of knowledge of marketing and his course is interesting. however, his course is test heavy and his study guides do not cover what will be on the test. he is picky about free response answers. going to office hours and introducing yourself helps. do every extra credit opportunity because it will help you in the end

Overall a pretty good professor. Can be arrogant, and cold calls but makes it very manageable to make an A in his class. Very knowledgable about marketing and wants students to learn and do well. Tests sometimes don't always align with reviews but gives lots of extra credit throughout the class.

This guy is not a great professor. His tests are horrible, and you are expected to know the smallest details about marketing topics that seem extremely irrelevant. Most intro professors don't even give exams, let alone Gary gives them and makes them extremely hard. Barely pulled off an A- in the class, and he is quite rude. Cold calls
Dr. Orosy is nice and helpful outside of class. Can be arrogant but it's mostly jokes, he has a good heart. Been in the field a long time and knows what he is doing.

Why all the bad ratings? GARY'S THE BEST! Take notes in class, kinda read the textbook, study, and you'll get an A. The group project is easy and actually interesting. He's worked in the industry, so he knows what he's talking about. SUPER nice guy. Ratings say he's condensing. HE'S NOT! There are so many extra credit opportunities too. TAKE HIM!!!

Prof. Orosy is a real professional in the industry. I see that through his lectures; however, be ready to be called on randomly to answer either material that you are expected to know, or just the random things to look up on Google. Can be somewhat condescending with this too. Most of your grade will come from exams and 2 group presentations.

Orosy is super condescending/vague in class. He's nicer one-on-one so office hours would be good so he can remember you and like you. MyLab quizzes and HW due 1-2x a week, but they're all on quizlet so easy. also a couple group projects but they're quick. Don't use your phone in class he gets weirdly mad.
pulled an A- w/ minimal effort

He is a great guy, but a really tough teacher and grader.its impossible to get a good grade in his class. You can  miss 4 classes but after it effects participation. If you wanna do good in marketing/get a good GPA, don't take this class. He is the hardest grader ever.sometimes you'll have the same answer as people and be graded differently.

Prof Orosy makes class mandatory and cold calls. If you don't know the answer he makes you feel dumb and inferior. There are a lot of group assignments and a 10 page paper at the end of the course. I dreaded coming to class and would not take him again

Class was not too difficult but lectures were insufferable. He is extremely rude and cold calls on students for random information that is not from the readings. He loves to make fun of students and embarrass them in front of the class. In addition to my own experiences, I have heard stories of him berating students in front of everyone. Don't take

Class started off seemingly easy, with easy quizzes and extra credit opportunities. Then the first test hits... so many questions asking about information I had not only never heard about but my best judgement could not decipher. Low and behold, the following 2 test held the same unbreakable enigmas. Class would be awful without the extra credit.

He's can be condescending during lectures because when he asks a question, he already has an answer in mind. If you say something slightly different but still correct, he will blatantly say "no" and recite your answer in a different way. Overall not bad but not the best. Tests are kinda more difficult than you would expect for an intro class.

A lot of extra credit opportunities will help your grade. Doesn't post any assignment details online, doesn't use or post a grading rubric for assignments. Uses My Labs for assignments, quizzes, video cases, and simulations. Easy class overall, but the professor is very rude and condescending to the point that the class is horrible

Not my favorite professor, but certainly better than the alternatives. Read the textbook and take notes for a relatively easy A. Lectures can be long, boring, and a verbatim restatement of the textbook. Orosy gives study guides for the exams that make the exams fairly simple.

I think Prof Orosy is one of the better choices if you just need to satisfy the marketing requirement, but I dont agree with the other comments that his class is easy. His tests are almost nothing like he teaches, though he does offer a lot of extra credit. He is pretty knowledgeable but not helpful if you are struggling.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class itself is fairly straightforward. Just study the terms in the textbook and know how to apply them in real-life situations. Pay attention during lectures because he sometimes gives hints or tips for the exams. The exams given were very fair and there were no surprises.

A solid choice to fulfill the requirement. Not too much homework and the tests aren't hard if you read the textbook. Boring topic and not the most exciting lectures, though. Make sure to do all the extra credit opportunities. There's more at the beginning of the semester, so take advantage of them. Overall, you can't go wrong with Gary Orosy.
Gary Orsoy is the best!!! He is so knowledgable and experienced the field of international marketing and has great insights. He is always accessible outside of class and always gives great feedback.

He is a good guy, the material is boring though and mostly self explanatory. A lot of extra credit opportunities early on in the semester so don't take them for granted then. Be ready to participate if you are on zoom, he will call on you and wait until you respond. He also mentions that he is getting his DBA in Florida about every 15 mins.

He's great, yeah not good with technology but is always there to help when you need it. His grading criteria is clear, his lectures make you feel like you're not even in school, and he is a known in the industry. Good professor to have but also keep as a contact.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's fine. I don't think he's the nicest person ever, but the class isn't exceptionally hard. Extra credit, lots of small assignments, really vague final paper that he critiques all of your ideas on. Marketing majors - take someone different.

This man is amazing! He has been so successful and teaches his students how to be successful as well. This class is an easy A, and the tests are straight from his lectures and the textbook. He brings respectable speakers and class is often filled with insightful conversation. I highly recommend this class to everyone!

I heard he was hard, but he teaches you exactly what is on the test, even tells you what is covered on the test. He offers lots of extra credit. His quizzes are on interesting podcasts of real marketers and he brings in guest speakers. Really relates the material learned to real world. He is great!

Speeds through irrelevant lectures, bad at technology, inflexible, very unhelpful. I took marketing at SMU for undergrad and didn't learn anything new from his class except a little experience with case studies. The undergrad teacher taught it way better. Would not work with me or my classmates when we had issues. Seems spiteful.

Thank god for the extra credit he gives. Completely understood the material during lectures, but when you were given an exam they were extremely hard. He would make the class difficult for absolutely no reason.

Nice guy and chill guy during lectures, but it's clear he gets lazy and doesn't actually pick exam questions based on what he teaches. I frequently saw words and situations on the exam that he never mentioned in class. Nobody is guaranteed an A in this class, even if you show up to every single lecture and take notes.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH OROSY!!! Its deceptive because he is such a nice guy and plays music in the beginning of class but the tests are IMPOSSIBLE. soooo detial-oriented its awful. I studied three days, 4 hours each day for an exam and got a C. this class will make you hate marketing. Unnecessarily difficult!

Loved taking this class for international marketing, the prof has traveled all over the world and has real-world experience. He tries to make the class interesting and offers tons of extra credit, went from a B+ to an A with extra credit. Also, fun group projects are assigned based on cases. would highly recommend!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I did well in the class, but I don't think anything I learned is helpful to me. Lectures were a wave of noise.

Gary is a nice guy, but his exams are just plain awful. WAY too detail oriented. Luckily, he gives out a ton of extra credit to make up for it, but he is just too disorganized and nit picky on tests. impossible to make A

His exam has multiple choice and short answer questions. The multiple choice is hard . He teaches fine, but sometimes he is out of the lessons. You work hard if you want to pass. Also, his office hour is flexible. I do not recommendation if you have any option.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: 11/10 - Great Professor! Cares about his students and will go out of his way to help them out.
Great teacher always looking to take his classes

Carlos is a great professor and explains concepts very clearly. It was easy to understand the material of the class. He grades fairly and was reachable for whatever questions we had. Would recommend others to his class!
Very easy to understand and made learning fun!
Feedback was “I don't like your tone.” What tone???
This is a review for Spanish 1502, she was a great professor for a relatively difficult class; she is super funny and makes the class enjoyable. Take her if you can.

Challenging but absolutely worth it. Online homework due at the start of class, plus readings, quizzes, compositions, and presentations. Attendance is strict more than 2 unexcused absences affects your grade. But the professor is awesome, supportive, and really helps you improve your Spanish.
She is a good professor. She is willing to accommodate to her students understanding of Spanish. Alot of online homework. Projects are pretty easy. Attendance is strict and counted always.
She's awesome but super strict about attendance
Waaaaayyy overrated. Self glazer fs. No student wrote this below.
THIS WOMAN IS A COLORIST DO NOT TAKE HER!
Awesome person and teacher. Super funny. We would sometimes spend whole class days just watching videos and talking. Pretty easy classes too. Lots of homework, but they're not hard.
She is willing to work with you where you're at. She wants to see you succeed and is very caring!
Fun class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: THE GOAT THE ABSOLUTE GOAT. VERY KIND. super funny
She makes class fun and entertaining. there is a lot of homework but if you do it you do well in exams

Attendance was mandatory and not needed literally hw was so easy and could be done outside of class. Test harsh grader . She was not understanding at all if you were absent be aware if absent 6 time you grade to drop 10 points
Very nice lady, class is pretty fun. There a bunch of homework, but no tests. If you come to class and participate as well as turn everything in on time you should be good.

Dr. Lopez Hevia is great. She is so sweet and caring. Her class is attendance mandatory. Her assignments are easy, but there is a lot of homework (check quizlet). A lot of talking with others in class and participation. Overall great class.

Professor Lopez is so sweet and really cares about her students. The class itself is a lot of homework outside of class but I think that is a department policy. Her tests are very clear and she gives you practice tests that are identical to the actual test. You will need the textbook to do HW but you don't have to read it. She is the best!

Dr. Lopez Hevia is amazing. She is so sweet and caring. Her class is attendance mandatory. Her assignments are easy, but there are a lot of homework and presentations. A lot of group projects, so choose the correct people. But overall, the class was very fun.

This teacher is a really good teacher if you are actually interested in what you're learning in class and how to apply it outside of college. He is such a sweet man and will laugh with you about anything; however, he is a very very tough grader (for a good reason) but will give good feedback.

Very nice, kind and caring. He is very calm, and often has a fun personality. His lectures are not that tedious, and the class includes 2 individual presentations and 1 group one. No HW, only occasional reading, and quizzes are open note and easy. Very understanding and just a very nice and good professor. For sure should take him for BLI 1210!
Tough Grader. Doesn't need to be that hard for a pre-req class. However, he's a chill guy, and you can learn a lot from him.
Compared to other teachers his grading was extremely hard. I would take another professor if given the chance.

Even when you ask for advice, it's super general and vague, like he doesn't even know what he's grading. he'll be super harsh for no reason and then completely switch up later. all of us would complain about him. don't take him lol. kinda racist but i don't think he grades harshly BECAUSE of that.

Explain why he's giving 89.5 or 75.7 to students. It's BLI—makes it unnecessarily hard and so, so boring you will fall asleep. But he grades harshly for no reason. I got an A, but some of my friends still struggle with him because he's difficult.

Chill course with straight forward assignments. Grading is very harsh for a pre-req class. Class is pretty boring but participation and attendance is mandatory. You can email assignments before the due date and he will give feedback fairly quickly so you increase your chance of getting a good grade which you will NEED. Chill dude, harsh grades

I can see why he can be horrible, if you don't go to lectures and not reach out him, class and projects will seem tough. But he's genuine and caring so just reach out and everything will be okay. If you're okay reaching out to professors (I know a lot of people who're not) and having to spend time outside of class for projects he's overall great.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not a class I would ever take again. Graded on 3 group projects, 2 exams, and a couple random completion assignments. The projects have extremely vague instructions and you have to constantly contact the professor. Having a bad day? He'll ask you about it in front of everyone. He didn't even post any grades until our final grade at the end.

DO NOT take professor Spiride! He was my least favorite professor at SMU. The class is based off 2 tests and 3 group projects all of which are incredibly time consuming. He is very unclear in his criteria for projects and expects you to know everything. He also didn't post one single grade to Canvas so you never know how you are doing in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great class - The professor does a good job going over material and making sure all the students have downloaded the appropriate software. I am not very strong with technical skills and understood the class.

The class was well taught. The material was relevant for from a few years ago. I took this class as a graduate student. He knows his stuff. I would not have said this was a waste of money, but the material could have been made more relevant to current technology.
This guy should NOT be an instructor at any University. He taught one of my graduate level classes and all I can say is what a waste of my time and money. My advice is to run far away from this one.

Although the exams are very difficult, if you read when you are supposed to and reread every chapter before an exam by timing things out, you'll be fine. The class is beyond interesting and he is a nice guy. He knows what he is talking about. This is the most engaging class I have taken in college thus far. I get excited for class! Weird, right?!

The most unclear teacher I've ever taken. Assignments are graded on his opinions and severe points are taken off for minor things. He gives quizzes with questions that are so random that it's very difficult to study for them. Each exam covers way too much. Not great at lecturing and is all over the place. I would NEVER take a class of his again.
Super nice and very intelligent professor (he wrote the textbook). Wants you to learn rather than cram information. Only 3 tests and no final plus 3 small papers. Would definitely take him again!

first semester that human rights from a psych perspective has been offered. good professor. a lot of readings, but it's all quite interesting. just do your work and ask a lot of questions if you're ever unsure
very nice professor. easy to talk to and gives good advice. attendance is mandatory if you want a good grade because he asks questions about things you wouldnt know from simply reading the book.

Dr. Geiger is the best! The class is hard, but he does everything he can in order to help his students. Come to class, do the homework, and study for the tests and you will be fine. He is available outside of class and is always willing to help, I wish I could take him for every math class

I had Prof Geiger in Fall 2017. He is a very sweet and approachable person but his class was very difficult particularly the tests. His homework is far different from the tests. He doesn't let you use a calculator or a formula sheet during the exam so it's even harder. I felt like he made Calc 3 much harder than it already is.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Nice guy. Homeworks take a long time, but they supplement the tests well. He straight up says hell bump your grade up if you go to class and office hours. Tests are pretty hard and long for the time given. Grades harsh, not many points for attempted answers. C- is a 60 in this class so, manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Geiger is an amazing teacher. Go to class and do the homework to get an A. He is willing to help out outside class and will extend office hours if needed. Also, he has extra credit for test reviews and sometimes bonus questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Geiger's homework had nothing to do with his tests, and his tests were very difficult. He is an extremely nice and approachable guy on the surface, but his class is nearly impossible if you don't plan on attending office hours and you can't master material from sitting through lecture. The class is far more difficult than is reasonable.

An amazing math professor. Really good at explaining concepts, and is such a nice guy. Really understanding, and encourages you to ask questions. Homework helps you understand the exams. Overall a great professor that I highly recommend.
I had him for Calc 3, and it is a tough class, but he made it manageable and broke it down well. I enjoyed going to his class, and also he's frequently available outside of class. He was a great prof

Overall, this professor can teach and will help anyone who asks for it. I was struggling at first, but when I started coming to him for help, I slowly improved. You will do well in this class if you work hard, which is expected of any class, but I would rely more on the textbook rather than the lectures, so that is up to the student's preference.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was a really pleasant teacher overall, yes he can be hard to understand sometimes but overall he puts a lot of work into his lectures. He gives a ton of in class examples and tries his best to make sure everyone understands by constantly checking in with the class. The only thing is he gives extensive hw out of the textbook every 1-2 weeks.

While he was supposed to be a substitute, his lectures were impossible to follow and almost everyone failed. He does not know how to teach lower-level math and jumps through steps too fast. If you have him, be ready to teach yourself.
He only gets such a good rating because he is so lovely. It is hard to understand, grades fairly, and tests are pretty difficult but doable. He is happy to help. Try your best, and you will do well.
SOOOOO boring. i cant emphasize that ENOUGH. take another teacher if possible.  You cannot understand what he is talking about no matter how hard you try.

I really enjoyed professor Geng's teaching style. He gives you lecture slides that you can print and write on which really helped me succeed. There's no doubt you will have to work hard as the tests and projects are very challenging but if you work hard and go to office hours you will do well. He also lets you use a note sheet on the exams!

Professor Geng is really sweet as a person. However, I would never take him again because I never knew what was going on and he didn't explain things very well & the notes were never helpful. The projects are very hard and I would spend hours on them. The homework wasn't awful, and quizzes and tests are open notes but still very hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Ive had Professor Geng for two semesters now. As others have said, there are few assignments and tests so it is important to study hard for everything. After having him for so long, it is clear that he really cares for his students and wants everyone to succeed. If you show interest, ask questions, and work moderately hard, you will do well.

Such a sweet professor. Genuinely interested in math. Very organized class. Gives homework every week, 3 exams and a final. Final is optional if you're fine with your grade. I found his lectures very confusing but he bases his class off a textbook so I just read that and did fine.

Dr. Geng was an excellent professor. He did not assign excessive amounts of homework and had very fair tests that he reviewed for in class. He only makes you turn in about 6 problems per week, but I would also focus on the T/F problems that we did not have to turn in to study. Also he let us use our course average for our final if we wanted.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is one of the sweetest professors in the department. Tests are really hard and theres only two of them worth a huge percentage. Made the final optional because of COVID. He cares about all his students. He teaches okay and uses power points with examples.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I think pandemic absolutely make his class harder. Lecture went crazy fast, super hard to absorb anything out from it. If you take it online, I think it better to just skip class then teach yourself. It not worth it.

Prepare to self teach. Calculations on the tests are quite easy but he will test you on concepts as well which makes it tricky. For an upper level class he is not a good fit because his accent's too thick. He is open for office hours a lot but it is not a useful session because he is so difficult to understand.

You can't help but not like him. He's so nice and wants us to learn. The homeworks are much harder than the tests, and if you don't do well on them then it's hard to come back from that. The only grades that go into your final grade are tests, homework, and attendance. He gives an opportunity to earn extra points
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Second time taking him and I know how he works. 6 assignments (2 dropped), 3 tests. That's it. Go see him for help during office hours and he will show you whatever you need. Need the answer? He'll show you to it, just put in the work and go see him! Tests are extremely easy versions of the homework. Always put something down on the bonus question!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is extremely helpful in office hours. I totally recommend you to take this course with him He is very caring professor, who truly wants students to succeed. Homework problems are great tools for exam preparation. Online lecture note is helpful.
Best professor for Scientific Computing. Really accessible and genuinely cares about students succeeding. Would recommend to anyone!

Scientific computing is known to be one of the worst CSE/MATH courses. Professor Geng makes this class absolutely doable and almost enjoyable. He's very clear in what he expects and extremely willing to help. Highly recommend taking him. Put in the time and work and you will have no problem getting a good grade in this class.
Dr. Geng is a really nice guy. He can be a little unclear in lecture sometimes, but he holds extra office hours before tests and is always willing to explain things further if you want him to.
Easy grader. Easy tests. If you understand the basic concepts, you will get an A
Tests are straightforward. Final exam was impossible

Professor Geng is an extremely nice and helpful professor. He knows what he is talking about, but he occasionally has a difficult time getting it all out. His accent is definitely thick and takes a lot of effort to understand, but he writes everything down and is available almost everyday for office hours if you need further clarification.

Professor Geng is very friendly and wants everyone to succeed in his class. His homework and examples in class are much more complicated than the tests, and he adequately reviews for the tests. I found the class slightly boring but easy and I definitely learned the material. His accent is sometimes difficult to understand but overall he is great.
do not take this expecting to learn

This professor is impossible to please unless you align entirely with what she says even when it is incorrect. Does not know how to teach well to us, is rude when you ask questions or clarification on assignments, stay far away from this one.

Mr. Gibson was an amazing professor who cared for his students. He always asked how other students are doing and if they were having trouble with anything at the beginning of class. His lectures were short and straight to the point. He would read any rough draft you would hand him, whether it was after class or during his office hours. Phenomenal!

definitely take professor Gibson if you can, he almost always ends class early, ask question in conferences and ask him to read your paper in office hours or after class, 4 mini essays and 4 longer essays, his criteria is clear and easy to follow and the paper topics and sources are interesting

Professor Gibson is a very nice man who cares about his students. His class is very doable, just allocate enough time to get your four mini-essays and four essays completed on time. You do not spend the whole time in class. Class is only to have a short discussion and read examples of good essays, that's it. We often left class 20 mins early.

He is the best professor Ive had. He genuinely cares about you and wants to hear what you have to say, even if he disagrees. Professor Gibson. Best WRTR 1312 professor out there. SOOO approachable and will read and give feedback on essays to make them A+ worthy. Professor Gibson is great- I loved the format of his class and thought he was extremely organized. I did take it on Zoom but he is a great person and I'm sure is just as great in person.

GILES KNOX IS THE BEST PROFESSOR. This class is so so fun and being abroad in Italy doesn't hurt! Professor Giles is very passionate about his subject and presents his lectures in an engaging manner. Ruthless conniving cold and hateful.

Enjoyed having her as a professor! She truly cares for her students.

Econometrics is hard bur she makes it possible to get an A. It is not super difficult if you go to class. literally the worst professor at SMU. her examples aren't topical, she makes mistakes while providing these examples, and then she doesn't provide sufficient answer guides for any of the material prior to the exams. also, don't expect her to help you during office hours.

great lectures. this was my first time that I took anthropology. found it really interesting. Gillian actually inspires me to be a teacher. I want to be like her as an adult to be honest. She's so witty, and well spoken. DO NOT TAKE PROF. GLASBY-MILLINGTON if you want to learn how to screen write! She doesn't know how to teach despite grading harshly and slowly. She's easy but that does not make her a good teacher. Glides on being nice and she's not so nice. Self glazes.
BEST PROFESSOR I HAVE HAD!! She loves all of her students as long as you are respectful of her time. Responds quickly to emails and will meet with you outside of class.

Easily best teacher I've had here. Very cool teacher who really cares for her students and actually wants the best for them. Do not understand how she has a singular bad review. *** is the best thing when learning!
if you go visit her in office hours your grades magically go up

Professor Gleiser is amazing, one of the best teachers at SMU. She is very clear with her expectations, gives excellent feedback and is always available outside of class. Really loved Prof Gleiser - hard grader but gives great feedback and truly cares about her students. Class is really interesting and I always looked forward to it! Attendance and participation are absolutely crucial

She has alot of experience in the sports world. If you make an effort to participate in class and make a connection with her she will like you and be super supportive. She's really about her students. Her lectures can be long but if you participate it can be a lot more engaging.

Prof. Gleiser is the best professor I've had at this school. Best Professor I have had at SMU so far. I was not knowledgeable about Law until I was in this class and found myself using the concepts taught daily. She is an amazing Professor! Just put in the effort and you will be perfect

She is amazing! She will go out of her way to help you and I don't think she has a mean bone in her body.
She is a total sweetheart! She talks alot in class but there is no way you can fail! She would go out of her way to help you with anything!

cocky, favored creative-track students and very obviously looked down on the non-creative track students, class contained some interesting information about theories of creativity which Griffin taught well, but projects were a waste of time and didn't reinforce the class/test material

Don't have to take notes in class, everything you need to know is on the slides and they are posted on Blackboard. Midterm is exactly like the study guide. Idea blog is easy if you keep ahead on it
No Comments

Prof. Linden is one of the best teachers I have ever had! He is so knowledgable about U.S. history and he is so sweet! You will have to write a research paper but class isant mandatory and its pretty easy to get an A in his classes.

Professor Linden is a kind old man who loves the Civil War.  He's very passionate about his teaching. Not boring at all, unless you truly don't care one whit about the Civil War era.
kind old man who loves history...but boring. attendence is not enforced, homework is assigned once a week. liked the class. use a lot of primary sources on essays and tests.
Good prof is willing to help you if you go see him. Really nice old guy.
Professor Linden is nice man, but he is a hard teacher. Go to him for extra help and you will do better on papers. His tests are really hard.
He socks. He's just easy. That's why we take him.

Gordon is literally the best professor you can take at SMU. He cares so much about his students and is so willing to give any extra help you need. 11/10 professor.

He is an amazing professor and I highly recommend him! Anyone lucky enough to take him should! He also has a great sense of humor. I hope you take his class. Oh... take your group projects serious and put some thought into them. He appreciates when you go the extra mile.
Absolutly do not take. Shes not even worth me saying more
Waste of time.

great teacher if you show effort and participate.

I have much respect for her, but the class is difficult

you need to write what she wants to hear. Lots of class discussion. if you want to get higher grades, you need to regurgitate what she says. Prof. Goyne not only is a must-have professor at SMU, but also a great person that will really help you individually to grow intellectually.

SHE IS AMAZING!

Class is centered on class discussion. She is very nice and interested in what you have to say. Going to her office hours for a paper is extremely helpful. She is not a very difficult grader if you work hard.

Jo Goyne was one of the best teachers I've ever had in my LIFE! She makes everything completely understandable, and gives you enough to work with on essays. I learned SO much. she was the worst professor i had during my freshman year. she gives poor grades to students who don't write what she wants to read. not helpful, never listens.
Very harsh grading but interesting class.
Very nice lady! She is helpful and passionate about what she does.
Wonderful professor!  The class is challenging, but very interesting.  She is definately one of the best  professors on campus.
Great prof... very helpful and keeps class fun.

lectures were very long and boring, always talks about how she doesn't want the class to be stressful but will give very specific pop quizzes on very long readings, made several strange remarks about students (including 2 about their looks, and 1 with clearly racist undertones).

She inspires students to reach their potential & provides course material & engagement opportunities. What more can you ask of an instructor?
She's really kind and knows her stuff too. Show up, don't use your phone when she's talking, and get your walking done and you'll do just fine.

This class was easily my favorite of the HSP-only classes. Dr. Gober is super caring, makes the course interesting, and I feel like a better human having gone through 3303. She forces everyone to become familiar with one another, and to this day, they are some of my best friends.
would definitely recommend taking Dr. Gober for her PRW2 class, yoga with her was really fun and she is such a nice woman

Donna Gober is an excellent yoga teacher. I had an amazing time in her class. Yes, she will tell you not to use your phone in class (it's yoga for goodness sake, how are people texting) and she doesn't appreciate disrespect or laziness. She wants excellence and will help you get it. Take her for yoga!

Unfortunately many students have rated her and she has had them deleted. I highly recommend that you do not take this professor. I had her for PRW 1 and have heard horrible things about her PRW 2 class. She does not care about her students and her style of teaching is very poor. Her coworkers even agree with this. Worst professor I've had at SMU.

Dr. Gober is a caring, friendly, and respectable professor who is clearly passionate about communicating the importance of wellness to her students. I learned much during my time in her PRW 1101 course and would recommend her to all incoming freshmen.

Professor Gober is by far the best PRW professor at SMU. Her Power Yoga class is very interesting. She cares about all students. However, do not skip her class. She is very strict on people skipping her lectures.

reviews.comment: Gober is so sweet and has a lot of teaching and wellness experience. Please only take her class if you are willing to take PRW seriously because she gets sick of students on their phones and she is a really nice lady and doesn't deserve that. I found this class to be extremely interesting. She was passionate about what she spoke about. Most people take it as a joke class, but I am glad it is mandatory.
She takes her class very seriously and attendance is required which is annoying but that is the same for all PRW classes. She's very energetic and sweet and passionate about the material.

Dr. Gober is seriously the best. She is helpful and knowledgeable and wants everyone to enjoy it, but also knows when to push you to the next level. Super nice and energetic, and all around great person!
Bench Aerobics was so fun, and she is so nice.. she even invited us to visit her class the next semester. Everyone showed body improvements also!

the yoga is super basic. very easy for beginners. enjoyable and a great stretch but not a work out. some days are "meditation days" which is awesome. just go to class and youll make an A. she has a lot of optional days too which is cool
Good yoga class. Only as hard as you want it to be. I asked her to push me, and she did. I would recommend the course!
Attendance is mandatory. She is very sweet but does not let you off easy.
A complete waste of time, I guess SMU just wants to milk students for tuition.
interesting..cares alot about the course..helped me learn some things..sweet, nice lady, nice southern accent, fairly good looking
Gober is nice and the class is pretty easy.  She obviously cares about the course but it is hard to take a wellness class seriously.
She is nice, and give you to make up what you miss, in wellness one or two.

Wonderful woman, she's very nice, and very helpful. However, she take the class very seriously given that it's a requirement and most students don't care about it. She makes you learn everyone's name (which is actually helpful) and has more projects than most Wellness teachers. However, none of it matters because it's pass/fail.

You will have to put WORK into this class, it is hard, and she makes that VERY clear. I liked Goodman more and more throughout the year, she is very funny, super real with you, and will help you understand the material! ASK QUESTIONS!

Goodman is an awesome professor, she doesn't BS and is tough but she's also super nice and funny. 10/10 recommend

Knows her stuff, funny, no bs. Class is copying notes into course pack. Rushes through notes, hard to keep up, got out early most days so unnecessary. Labs waste of time. reviews.comment: I greatly enjoyed her class. I found the lectures interesting with the case studies providing real world examples of the material covered in the lectures. There is a good amount of reading involved, so procrastinating isn't an option. I found the material useful for job interviews. Definitely would recommend.

She claims to have her material very well organized, but her powerpoints are all over the place and very hard to follow. All in all, you'll  try to remember useless details from 15-page case studies for the reading quizzes the next day and then memorize a lot of terminology for the tests.I found it interesting, although the quizzes are bs worth 12%
Hands down best professor at SMU

I started my job at Fortune 500 last week--a job that Goodman helped me get. When some other opportunities fell through, I visited her in office hours & told her my situation, and after contacting employers in her network, she connected me with my perfect fit. I am forever grateful for her and her dedication to helping students in Lyle. Thx Goodman

She tells you from Day 1 how difficult the class will be, and she was certainly right. You can succeed, however, if you put the time in, plan ahead, and study early. Most people who dropped/failed this class failed to do that.
She's awesome.

Here's the thing about Goodman's class--it's hard. Plain and simple. But she tells you this on the first day of the semester & lays out exactly what students need to do to succeed. The majority of ppl don't heed her advice & that's why grades are so low. But she DOES care. Visit her in office hours & get to know her. She's an amazing resource.

Her management class was incredibly interesting and engaging, but if you procrastinate or try to cram for exams and quizzes, you won't do well--something she warns you about upfront so there are no excuses. Highly recommend this course!

Good teacher. Study in advance for the tests. Most of the material taught isn't anything mind-blowing. The tests are comprised of 66 surprisingly hard multiple choice questions about easy material. Unless you are really dedicated and interested in the material, you won't do well.

She is fantastic. However, dont go into the class thinking that you will get an A. Even if you feel like you completely understand the material, the class is hard and there are few tests, so know that you have to work extremely hard, especially for the first test, to get an A. The average on the first test was a 61, start studying now. Shes great!!

Goodman is an incredible professor, she literally helped me so much through the semester. The class is hard but I worked even harder and it showed. If you put in the work, she will like you. She is no bull-crap so don't expect anything. Can't wait to continue the major with her.
be teacher ive ever had. Learned more in this class than any other one. and  actual useful information for my future

This is, by far, the hardest class I've ever taken in my entire life. However, Professor Goodman is an amazing professor who cares about whether or not you understand the material, if she sees you're trying. She does not tolerate laziness. If you work hard, you'll be just fine.
You know why I love Goodman? Because she is no BS. Period. Do what she says and you will be fine. Procrastinate and cram? Good luck and try better next time.

I respect Goodman more than any professor at SMU. She's tough but fair but also so knowledgeable and interesting about the topics she presents. And most importantly she genuinely cares, more than any professor I've ever had. She wants to genuinely get to know you--your interests and goals and she checks up on them. I can't praise her enough.

Hands down one of the best professors at SMU. On top of Goodman being an amazing lecturer, her management class was incredibly interesting. It will really prepare you for interviewing for internships and learning about today's workforce. Goodman is the bomb.
I learned more in this class than in any other course I took at SMU. Prepared me for job interviews and interesting. Thanks, Goodman!
My favorite teacher, but the class is still very difficult
Professor Goodman is the best professor I've had at SMU and fair, but she expects students to work hard and she doesn't accept laziness. Visit her in office hours and attend class.
Tough class but if you work hard and you'll be fine. Professor Goodman is the absolute best.

I always looked forward to Professor Goodman's class.  She's funny and very knowledgeable in the industry.  Her exams were difficult due to the amount of work required given the time constraints.  Try to cram and you probably won't do well.  Study for an hour or so daily.

Goodman cares SO MUCH about her students--I can't stress this enough. When I was looking for jobs (and having problems) she met with me every week for 2 months, helping me search, finding people for me to contact, using her network until I found the perfect fit. She's an amazing advisor and cares about the subject matter. She's the BEST.

Goodman is the best. If you work hard and put in the effort, you will have no problems. She's tough but fair and gives you everything you need to do well. Visit her in office hours--she has so much good insight about careers, classes, & general life. She really truly does want students to succeed, but she has no tolerance for laziness.

Goodman is by far the best professor I've had at SMU so far. She truly cares about her students and their futures. This class is by no means easy. When she says study after every class, do it! The tests are hard but if you study enough you will do great. She created the binder for the class and it is extremely helpful, but you cannot miss lectures.

Goodman isn't easy, but she's fair. Which is more than I can say about other profs. The lectures can be boring sometimes, but she's pretty good about knowing which days to let class out early. If you pay attention in class, do the extra problems, and find help before the exams you'll do fine. Otherwise, well there's a reason why 20 people dropped

Super nice and helpful but the tests are crazy hard and are worth 66.66 percent of your grade

Professor Goodman is no nonsense but in a good way. She has high expectations of students and with the coursepack she created, gives you everything you need to succeed on tests. She's a tough grader but funny and relates well to students.
Professor Goodman is the best professor I have taken at Lyle, and at SMU as a whole. It's clear she cares about the subject matter and even more about helping her students succeed.

Out of all of the professors that I have had at SMU, shes been the msot impressive. SHe expects a lot out of students, but gives them everything they need to succeed. Gives an excellent introduction to EMIS, and is a great teacher and beyond prepared.
Tries to make dull subjects interesting and is relatable to students. She can be tough but you'll learn a lot. Also is an advisor for EMIS department
Clearly thinks they're brilliant, but couldn't explain a concept if their life depended on it. Responds to confusion with hostility. You'll learn nothing but how to disassociate.

Professor Grollman is very kind and understanding. You will have to do a lot of homework and make sure you participate in class, but it is not extremely difficult. He really just wants the best for you.

he is a great guy and really seems to love what he teaches. he is very understanding and willing to help. however lectures are really boring unless youre super interested in the subject. also only graded by two papers and two tests. grades kinda easy and the tests are decently easy if you do the study guide. gives extra credit opportunities too.

Randall is the GOAT. Nicest professor I could've asked for. Took this class for my UC credit and I don't regret it at all. He grades super easily, mostly his TA's do the work for him. The class can be boring, but it is an easy A and he overall was a great professor.

Just apply direct quotes from HW articles/books for that. 2 movies in class throughout semester. Lectures every day. Interesting content.
