reviews.comment: This is the best class I have taken at SMU. I have friends who aren't business majors who want to get in to this class and SMU won't let them. I learned so much about Excel and data and I use it every day at my internship. Gwinn is by far the best professor i have ever had.

I took this professor 4 years ago and his core content was so irrelevant that none of it is being used on my job in the field. He is past his prime, is unaware, and you will learn things that have less to do with current tech need and more to do with what he thinks you'll need if it were the early 2000s.

He is the best professor at SMU period. I took professor Gwinns class 4 years ago. I use everything he taught almost every day in my job. When I got to my first job they gave me a SQL assignment. If I had not taken Gwinn's class I would have not been able to do this job.
Below. He's a very average teacher who thinks he is single-handedly changing the world and all our lives with his time-tested teaching that you can get out of the book.
He's fine but a bigger fan of himself than he should be. I've learned more from study groups than his entire course.

I took professor Gwinn a few years ago and he talked me into switching my major to BASCM. This was the best move I ever made. My dad wanted me to do finance because of the job opportunities. I switched to a new job as a manager over a small team of analysts. THANK YOU Professor Gwinn! It wouldn't happen without you!
just paying $200/class to get free datacamp
Gwinn is the easiest choice for ITOM. Basically a free A if you do all the work. He is also a funny dude who is very quirky. Makes the boring subject not as bad.
yaps for 80% of the class and then rushes through the content
Not a fan
I went in to Dr. Gwinn's course without an internship and got an internship because of Dr. Gwinn's course. There. Said it.

Professor Gwinn is the best professor at the university. He makes you think and he makes you work but he will spends time with you when you are having problems. His TAs were also good. I am already using SQL in my internship and would not have gotten the job if it were not for Professor Gwinn's course.
Will cut you off in the middle of a question to talk to other students. He seemed like a great guy, but he blatantly let other students cut me off or would cut me off when asking him things.

If your looking for a fun professor that knows way more than the material of the class then Professor Gwinn is for you, even if you have to take a bit extra time to learn some of the material on your own, and in office hours. A valuable connection to have for the rest of your career.

On the first day of class he told us that what we learn will get us a job. Guess what! I applied to several internships with SQL and an Excel certification on my resume. I got several offers and ALL of them wanted to know more about my SQL experience! I strongly recommend this course!

Try to come into class having already been introduced to Python, which will make the difficult Intermediate-Python midterm easier. Also, look at the Intro and Intermediate Python course content on Datacamp beforehand so you know the content coming in. Gwinn is entertaining but explains the content in a disorganized fashion/difficult-to follow.

Gwinn is a good guy. He cares about his students and the subject he teaches. However, he is not a very good professor. He does little to explain the material in his lectures and spends the time joking around/letting himself get sidetracked in class. I get he wants to be funny, but class is essentially a waste of time and you learn very little.

Best professor for ITOM. He cares about his students and focuses on helping them learn instead of just giving them a grade. An A is very attainable as long as you do the HW and ask him for help when you need it. He's super funny and makes class fun to go to. You'll use the material in this class in the future! Definitely take him, thank me later!

Definitely the best professor you can take for ITOM2308. Really enjoys the material he teaches, makes his lectures engaging and funny, genuinely cares about preparing students for the really world, grading isn't too difficult and the way assignments are graded is very clear-cut. Show up to class and participate and an A is very attainable.
Great professor! Really funny and knowledgeable about the class. Mostly weekly homework and 1 open note final. Overall great class

Professor Gwinn has fair grading criteria, and it is a smooth class as long as you put forth an effort to understand the concepts, especially during SQL. I would take another one of his classes in the future.

Professor Gwinn is a smart and caring professor who takes the time to teach what you need to know and more. If you do the homework and have fun along the way, its an enjoyable class. Also if you need help or are bored go to the common desk with him and the TAs and him will help you out a lot! I wish more professors as SMU were like him.

Dr. Gwinn is an amazing professor. He is literally the best professor I have had at SMU. There is a lot of homework but it is worth it. I got my internship because I could put down my Excel certifications and knew SQL. I wish he taught the next level of ITOM because I would take him instantly.
gwinn gives way too much busy work. wouldnt recommend taking him for credit. even a harder teacher with less work would be better than this.

Gwinn is an awful professor. Wastes students time with needless and repetitive homeworks. . Goes on tangents that literally waste half the class time and leave the whole class disengaged. The excel work, which is really the only important/useful stuff for business majors, is taught WAY too fast and he doesnt answer any questions or keep us engaged

Don’t know what these other reviews are talking about. He goes on awful tangents half the class which wastes everyone’s time. Then goes through the material way to fast and barely, if at all, explains it. Homework’s are not hard just tedious.
I dread going to this class and it’s the worst grade I’ve gotten since I got to SMU.

He tries to get to know all of his students. I highly recommend taking his class and sitting towards the front. He is always willing to help and does his best to keep the class engaging. I wish he would teach other ITOM classes. He is one of the best teachers I have had at SMU.

Gwinn is a great prof. He's funny and class was enjoyable. He teaches kind of fast, content isn't too hard and everything is available online. He wants you to succeed and actually learn the material. Weekly assignments weren't too bad, but kind of annoying sometimes. I would definitely take him for ITOM!!!

He grades easy and there's not much homework, but he doesn't seem to get that not everyone wants to major in ITOM. Sometimes goes off on long tangents about complicated code stuff and won't answer basic questions. That being said, if you want an easy A the class is fine even though a lot of the stuff you do in class is irrelevant. He's nice ig
One of the best professors in Cox. He made the class very enjoyable and easy to learn. Answers all of your questions in and out of class. Just show up to class and you'll pass.

Allen Gwinn is hands down the best professor I've had at SMU. He is so nice, cares about all of his students, and genuinely loves teaching. His lectures are great and you learn a lot from them. I wouldn't have wanted to take this course from any other professor. He is always available outside of class for extra help and goes above and beyond.

Allen Gwinn makes coming to class always worth it. I have loved being in his class because it feels like a break from school and he makes data analytics actually sound interesting. There are few grades but you will get A's on all of them. Super caring professor and easy to access.

Professor Gwinn is hilarious. He makes excel palatable, if not fun. There is a TON of information, so beware. He moves extremely quickly, so be ready to keep along and understand later. The simulations and capstones are a lot, but they help a ton. If you work hard and learn the material, the excel certifications will be easy
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I LOVE THIS MAN! I hate staring into a computer and doing C.S. stuff, but he made it enjoyable. Most of the assignments are basically completion-based and are easy 100s. If you take the certifications through the school and make a certain score, it's an auto 100% on the tests. Final wasn't too bad! Pay attention and you'll be set. Easy A!!
one of the best professors I have ever had!!!!! TAKE HIM!!! he is so funny, so understanding, wants to help, always there!! pay attention to his lectures & follow along when he does examples.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've taken. He's very understanding and will push deadlines back as needed.
Amazing professor! He really cares about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Great class and teacher! Makes content enjoyable and simple, and there is not much work outside of class at all. Only test is the final exam, which is very straightforward. Definitely recommend this class!
Take him! He's funny and actually cares more about you learning than anything else. If you put in a decent amount of effort you'll get an A
So funny and makes a boring subject enjoyable!
I literally would never have been able to learn SQL and Excel without Prof Gwinn and this class. I actually found myself looking forward to going to class even when I didn't want to.
This is the best class I have been in at SMU. Take his class and you won't be sorry.

Professor Gwinn is amazing! I never thought I would be interested in data but he turned most of the class into geeks. Now when I go to a store I literally think about how things get there and what happens when someone buys it. I am literally addicted to Excel now and am learning more about Tableau on my own. Why can't he teach all my courses?

First of all, Allen Gwinn is an actual genius (no, like he was writing code when he was 13) so consider yourself blessed if you are able to take his class. He's hilarious and entertaining, but really everything he teaches is so useful.

AMAZING PROFESSOR! He is very personable and truly gives his students tools for success. The latter portion of the class is hard, but he works with you so you can do well. If you want to enjoy a class and actually learn something, TAKE HIM!

Most unconventional teacher I have had at SMU. Never had an outright "test" except final which makes it so easy to get an A. Make sure to pay attention and understand the things he teaches and you will be fine. ESPECIALLY the SQL part. That is the hardest part of final. If you don't understand, ask him for help. He is ALWAYS available.

Gwinn > Every other professor in Cox. He's a grade AAA professor and sets the gold standard at SMU. His class should really be called life skills that every student should know. I wish Cox had more quality professors compared the lackluster teaching and revolving door of professors in the Finance dept.
Great guy for sure. Makes an uninteresting subject very likable. If you don't learn something in his classes, check yourself.

All in all this had to have been one of my best courses. It seemed like it was easy but looking back it was a lot of work. I never though I would be as good as Excel but he makes us get certified to I guess that is pretty good.
Everyone wants his class so you have to be ready when they let you sign up. You will be glad you took him. I actually learned thing I didn't think I could. His final is pretty hard though.
Gwinn is literally the best professor I have ever had. Everyone says ITOM is boring but his class was not and I actually feel like I learned something useful.

Gwinn is great guy. He really cares about his students and the subject. What bothered me was that he did not have an outline for the semester on he syllabus, and assignments were thrown at us randomly. I was totally unsure what my grade would be until the very end. However, he is pretty lenient and is willing to work with you.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Gwinn is super nice but goes way too quickly through material/tutorials and no one in class seems to follow. Then when assignments come around they are impossible and he has to do them step by step for everyone in class. Chill guy and very very smart, but this class is just inefficient

Dr. Gwinn, if you are reading this, I just want to let you know that you are the coolest professor in the world -- no matter what anyone else says. Your sense of humor made me wake up from my dreams laughing. Peace Professor. Peace.

Prof. Gwinn is simply the best. He is so passionate about what he teachers, but even more so, his students. He goes out of his way to accommodate to everyone and is super clear with his communication. I honestly can't say enough nice things about him; if you have the chance to take his class, please do!
Take him if you want to have the best experience in ITOM super accessible, his team of TAs is amazing too shout out to Hanna, Maria. This is the best class ever

NO DOUBT THE BEST PROFESSOR IN COX! DO YOURSELF A FAVOR AND TAKE HIM HE IS AMAZING! I CANNOT EMPHASIZE THIS ENOUGH I LOVE THIS MAN! He makes me want to become an ITOM genius!!! Also he is super funny, you'll be looking forward to his class every day.
He is awesome! He makes learning fun. I never thought I would like ITOM but now I wish they had a major.

Since you need to take the class as a business major, Prof Gwinn is a good choice to take it with. I didn't find the class too interesting, and I can't say that I got too much out of it, but it was alright. Learning basic Excel and SQL is somewhat handy, though. His geeky sense of humor helps make the class better. Exam is open book/internet.
Love him! Understands majority of the class is not interested in ITOM, so keeps you awake by making ridiculous commentary throughout. Also, always willing to help you.
Totally the best but you need to sign up early because his class fills up. You work hard but everything is straight forward and he helps you outside of class.
Yeah ITOM is boring but Gwinn is dope. He works with you to make sure you get it.
This guy is dope.  Take him you wont regret it.
Literally the best prof I ever had. Sometimes the course is confusing but Gwinn is chill and works with you.
SMU needs more professors like Gwinn. He is definitely not easy but he makes a boring subject interesting at times.

Hands down the BEST professor at SMU. Professor Gwinn truly knows what it means to be an educator. He will prepare you for the real world as he stays updated with the newest technologies religiously. Gwinn on the other hand will help you over and over until you finally get it. He'll make you enjoy this course. All in all, he's an amazing guy too.
This is my second time taking ITOM. It is about 50% boring but is a required course. He is the professor you want.
Everything is open note, book, and Internet including the Midterm and Final. Minimal homework and it's usually pretty easy. I haven't learned a lot, but this class is really easy.

Seriously the best professor I have had at SMU. Takes a boring subject and makes it fun. I actually look forward to going to a boring class. A bunch of us are trying to get him to teach the next ITOM course so we can take the next class from him.
Professor Gwinn is really great and makes ITOM more enjoyable since its such a crappy subject already

Dr. Harrod is genuinely my favorite professor in the biology department. This is my second class with him. He's incredibly knowledgable; it shows in how he writes his exams, which are open-book (although it won't always help). Annotating your textbook meticulously means the difference between getting an A and dropping after the first exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Such a caring professor!! He is super passionate about his field and encouraging to students! Use the open text book exams wisely!!! I wish he taught more classes because he is so caring and you can tell he likes to teach. The class is interesting too.

Terrible experience. He seems more interested in appealing to college students than teaching. Opposing views aren't welcome, and the lack of depth leaves you learning little. It's professors like him who make psychology seem less credible. Truly disappointing and frustrating.

Loved Dr. Harrod! He is unbelievably smart and it shows through him breezing through complex lectures but he is very approachable and always available. There are 3 grades total but they are open note, so if you properly annotate your textbook you can get an A no problem. I would 100% recommend him and his classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: LOVE him. Brought us donuts to our final and was very kind throughout the semester. Tests are all open book, but definitely pay attention during lecture because some of what he says during lecture isn't in the book, but it's on the test. I was super intimidated going into Cancer Bio, but Prof Harrod made it interesting and I'm glad I took it!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Harrod is one of my favorite professors at SMU. His tests are open book and his office hours are extremely helpful. I took virology and cancer bio with him and absolutely adore him. You DO have to go to class and i 100% recommend you get to know him 1:1 in office hours. He notices when people put in the work and reflects that in their grade.

Dr. Harrod is a true expert in his field and is a gem in the biology department. He goes through stuff quickly but make yourself pay attention and you'll have the notes you need for the exams. Doesn't throw any curveballs. If you understand the material you'll be fine on tests. Also offers a paper as buffer to grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Harrod is my favorite professor, and I don't say this lightly! I wish more faculty at SMU lectured like he does. It's apparent he is an expert on the material and well accomplished in his field. He does talk quickly, but records (and uploads!!) the lectures. He's very considerate, fair, and fosters confidence in his students. Take his classes!

Good professor and interesting class. He is an expert in cancer, so he knows his stuff. Just go to class and try to pay attention, he can be hard to listen to at times. All the material you need is in the powerpoints and short answer tests allow for a lot of partial credit.

One of the best Bio professors at SMU. I took him for Virology and Cancer Bio and really learned a lot. His exams can be pretty tough so reading the book  and taking good notes are a must. Be sure to bring your phone to class to take pics of the slides bc he does not post them on Blackboard (not a big deal). This is a good professor to take.

As far as Bio classes go, you can't really go wrong with this one. Dr. Harrod is very good lecturer and a lot of the material comes straight from the book. WARNING: He doesn't post his class slides on black board so be prepared to take pictures during every lecture because he talks so fast there's no way you can write down everything he says

OK, this is one of the laziest professors.  As long as you can find last year's tests you will make an A.  He doesn't change the questions, and sometimes the order is the same.  If you don't have last year's tests it will be hard.  The paper is a joke.  He has to grade 25 papers in a day?  As long as you do the paper you will get an A on it.
Lectures repeated basic information while exams emphasized obscure details that were barely mentioned. Overall, the class felt poorly managed.
Do NOT take this class unless you enjoy having your GPA destroyed.

The course lacks structure and consistency. Assignments appear with little explanation, and there is minimal effort to clarify confusion. Feedback is sparse and does not help students understand mistakes or improve future work.

Your grade will really come down to how you do on you tests. If you spend a while studying, you will do fine. His partial credit is biased but overall decent to work with. Offers a few extra credit points per test so be there for review day.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Class isn't challenging, but it's frustrating. He prioritizes being “cool” over being effective, treating the class like a stand-up gig instead of a learning environment. The result? You barely learn anything, and his approach reinforces negative stereotypes about our field.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Most overrated professor. He does literally nothing but hands out packets.

Intermediate is just a very challenging class and you are tested like you would be tested on the CPA exam at times which can be difficult especially if you are not planning to take the CPA. Do all of the chapter homeworks before the next chapter otherwise it is really hard to catch up and do well.
This guy is the worst, thinks so highly of himself and makes half the class about his "success" when he can't even deliver a single lecture without a gd packet.

This is one of the hardest classes you'll take at Smu and he openly says that this class is going to be the hardest class you'll take. Just be prepared to work rlly rlly hard. He's really smart so its hard to keep up with what is saying and expects you to already understand a lot of the information for intermediate accounting
Easy. A but not a good teacher Can't take criticism well either apparently.

Weed out class gonna weed out class… honestly the course itself has so much material that I dont rlly blame him for not being able to hammer home every concept perfectly. Just gonna have to thug it out

One of the best professors I've had! I took Intermediate Accounting over the summer and not only was the class super engaging, but I'm already using what I learned in my internship (like revenue recognition and allowance for doubtful accounts). Highly recommend!

Does not deserve to be at this university he verbally attacks students when they don't understand things. he constantly making mistakes during lecture so it his fault anyhow and has no care for success of his students. Expect to teach yourself the entire curriculum and receive a horrible grade ruining your 4.0.

Take him. I am at a finance internship this summer and am using everything taught in this class. His business world experience really helps. I am literally standing out at this internship because of this class.

Looks like someone's a bit salty about their grade and is posting nonstop. I've taken both his classes and TA'd for him. He builds his packets off the book so it's way more efficient. His real-world experience actually makes things click. This is Cox you earn your A here. He will help if you reach out early enough.

Taught like he was speedrunning how fast to ruin your semester. Assignments made no sense, lectures were chaotic, and feedback felt like a chance to hoist his own accomplishments (oh hey did you know he runs a company? No? Don't worry, you'll know in the first two minutes of meeting him), gross.

Packetman who only knows how to use other people's prepared accounting packets to "teach" from when he clearly never even learned the material himself. Terrible teacher and it's a crime we have to pay for it.

Worst course experience i can't believe we pay for this. Cannot teach for the life of him, the most boring lectures read from prefabricated notes, then you test on entirely unrelated prefabricated questions he takes from packets that have nothing to do with what he taught

Very hard to learn form and I'm not sure he knows his own material even given that all he does is use prep made packets and when you ask questions he can't answer them then he gets mad at student for not undemanding things immediately. Do not take and I do not recommend in any way. Better ones out there.

So much to learn in 3 months. The amount of material makes this class hard, but he does his best to make it relatable. You do walk away learning how to read a 10K. Take him if you want to learn otherwise find someone easier if you just want the grade.

Do what he says & go to
office hours. You will be set.
Helps connect everything you are learning to the real world. Very invested in you knowing the why behind things. Very organized & helpful!

speaks to students like they are third graders, answers questions that he clearly has no idea of the answer to by guessing, writes tests that seem intentionally confusing, consistently fails to communicate deadlines, and assigns obscene amounts of homework that are effectively better versions of the lecture. Makes an easy class hard.

Professor Sohail's class is definitely challenging, but he works hard to make the material clear and engaging. He gives homework packets, uses Gleim for practice, and offers plenty of extra credit. He's extremely understanding, always available after class, and truly wants his students to succeed. Great professor and very supportive!

Prof H is an excellent Intermediate (and Managerial) professor. Accounting/finance majors should take both classes with him - Managerial tests prep you for Intermediate. He uses custom packets from the textbook and real-world examples. Attend office hours to show effort. Tests are hard, but reviews are pretty similar to the test. Highly recommend!
Sohail is great. Enjoyed the class. Likes to throw tricks in exams but felt like I actually learned the material. Nice curve at the end.

Professor must care for those few but overall, he doesn't care for his students. He'll string you along all semester allowing you to believe he cares and will reward you for hard work. When I met with him at the end of the semester to review some previous test questions I was unsure about, he started laughing and didn't help me. So confusing.

Sohail is a fantastic professor who truly cares about his students and puts energy into every interaction. His lectures are meaningful and weave in real-world experience that he has gained from his professional career. He goes out of his way to help students who are struggling, and rewards those who are willing to put in the work.

Professor Hamirani is the absolute best. Would 100% recommend for Intermediate I. The class is hard, but he gives you all the resources you need to do well, and he truly cares and wants to see everyone succeed. Go to office hours! Learned so much from this class and could not recommend him enough!
Uses packets he doesn't design to teach rather than teaches, not for everyone's style, not for really anyone's learning style. Should put more effort into his course.
GOAT! Super helpful. Test averages are in high 70's and provides ample extra credit. It's a hard class, but he is so helpful.
Waaaaaay overrated and doesn't even teach. Just does worksheets. Seems confused about and tries too hard to be liked by students.
All he does is hand out packets you could purchase at a bookstore, no interaction, no engagement, awful...........
Overrated and disappointing.

This class was difficult, but you definitely learned a lot. He uses a lot of really good real-world examples that help concepts fall into place. The homework is difficult, but the TA and him will check it for you during office hours so that you can get it correct. There is also a lot of extra credit for tests.
Sohail is a great professor who is very helpful and nice. Extremely clear in lectures and gives great guidance on what to expect for exams. He is also very helpful in office hours if needed.

Great professor who provided ample opportunities for students to earn extra credit and improve upon their grade. Relative to other lecturers, I think he offered more office hours for students to learn the things that they didn't understand in class.
His class was enjoyable since he tries to make the course material relevant to the real business world. You can earn extra credit for each test.

He is a good instructor, and honestly, the reason I didn't like the class was that I didn't enjoy accounting as a subject. However, he is arguably a great alternative to LHR. While LHR offers more straightforward tests, Hamirani really does care about his students. I thought I was going to get a C in the class, but I ended up with a B!

You might be looking at this because you didn't get LHR and you're worried about managerial. You'll be just fine with Sohail. He's a great lecturer, explains things well, and walks through tons of examples. This class is much easier than financial. Homework is light (one homework per chapter), and tests have lots of partial credit.

Managerial is really not a hard class, it's just a combination of accounting and algebra. Attend the lectures and do the test review packets and you'll be fine. There's usually also a 2-3 point extra credit. He wants to see you succeed so just show him that you are putting in the effort
Professor Hamirani is a fantastic teacher. He truly cares for all of his students. If you put in effort you are surely to do well in his class. Couldn't recommend taking him enough!
Great prof just go to class and listen. Easy A
He truly cares about his students. Yes you have to work for your grade. It's on you to study, put in the effort and ask for help. One of the better Cox professors.
Not a very good teacher, lectures are boring and students never finish their exams on time. super tough grader
If you do what he says you will be fine. Super doable class. Great lectures! Take him!

This is one of the hardest classes at Cox, but I learned so much. This class also helped me in my internship and made me stand out from my intern class. Hamirani is so helpful & transparent. This class is no joke, but ended up being one of my favorite classes. Get ready to work harder than you ever have, but it will be so beneficial.

One of my favorite MBA professor's. Lots of material is covered with real world examples. Great notes, guest speakers and activities. 2.5 hours go by fast. Be aware of weekly quizzes but they help you stay on top of material. Take him!
Not a very good professor.

If you want learn & grow in the business field take this professor, if you are looking for an easy A take someone else. He is very helpful and wants you to know the why behind what you are learning. If you are taking intermediate accounting in the spring you will have him so better off taking him for managerial so you can get use to exam style.
Absolutely my favorite professor at SMU. Brings a lot of

This is the hardest class I've taken, likely the hardest I will take at SMU. Broke my 4.0 actually. My biggest issue with Hammy is that while he does his best to teach such a huge amount of content (and he does this well), he seems intent on going beyond what he teaches in the exams. There will be questions intentionally designed to trick you. 4/5
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He was super transparent with grading, expectations, and how hard every exam would be. We had many extra credit opportunities and as long as you truly tried he gave credit.  He had practice exams, homework with solutions, and additional CPA instruction videos for EVERY chapter posted on our online portal.  Favorite SMU professor! -BA

Definitely hardest class I've taken, never spent as much time with a class as I did this past semester, quiz or test every single week, 5 tests and a final which he drops the lowest so that wasn't too bad, but this class is a huge time commitment
Best accounting professor ever! I learned so much in this class. Although the material is difficult he makes it interesting with real world examples and his own personal experience.

Prof's super nice, but class was a massive pain in the butt. Test is way trickier than the practice material, and he will pull specific ?s from one sentence in his 30+ pg lecture packet. 5 tests may let you "bounce back" from bad grades, but it means tests almost every other week which gave me no time to breathe. At least extra credit was generous!

Professor Hamirani is my favorite professor I've ever had! This is notoriously the hardest class in the business school, but Sohail made it bearable. I loved his teaching style and his many office hours were so helpful. He really believed in me, even when I really struggled! He also rounded me up a LOT because he saw how hard I tried!

Intermediate I is a very hard class, but I loved learning under Sohail. He is adjunct and very impressive -- works as a CFO at Mohr Partners and still gets our tests back in 3 days (5 exams + a final). You learn so much and he really cares and wants to help. The content is hard, but he doesn't have control over that. I highly recommend!

Sohail Hamirani portrays himself as a nice guy to make up for his hard tests and tomfoolery. If you are not the best test taker, save yourself some hassle and take LHR. He is sneaky with the way he makes his tests. They are not straight forward or like the practice material. Do not be fooled by all of the good reviews, it is because he is nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Intermediate is an incredibly hard class, but Sohail does everything to support you and wants you to succed. Incredibly caring, tons of office hours, great lectures with interesting and valuable explanations, provides extra credit for tests, and lets you replace the lowest test w/ final. There are 5 tests so it's a LOT of work, but it's very doable

Hard class no matter what but Sohail wants you to succeed. He is always available and has ample extra credit to help you get a good grade. Study nightly as you cannot cram for this class. The 5 exams makes it easier to comeback if you bomb one. Group project that was easy if you just put in work. Very rewarding class, you get out what you put in!

Professor Hamirani is a great professor for Intermediate Accounting 1. The class is very tough and requires a lot of work to succeed but he provides great note packets that are helpful for studying and plenty of practice problems to work before the exams. Exams can be tricky so do as much of the extra practice as possible.
The tests are entirely made up of trick questions or stuff that is nothing like he goes over. Take someone else so you don't regret your entire semester like I am.

Loved this professor! I deserved a B+ in the class, but he rounded me to an A- solely because of how hard I tried and how often I showed up to office hours. I liked the class style, as it was super interactive. You filled out notes he printed for you and did tons practice problems, which was super helpful for the exams. Overall, 10/10 experience
While this class is hard, there are a lot of office hours which was extremely helpful. There was also always a way to get extra credit for the exams. Definitely recommend taking this class with him!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Hamirani was fantastic. Managerial accounting is a difficult course to begin with and he presents the material in a learnable way. Lots of office hours and extra credit opportunities. I learned a lot and recommend taking his course .
Nice guy, good professor for sure

I loved taking Professor Hamirani. He is one of the most qualified Cox professors and although he makes the course challenging, he really wants you to succeed. I would recommend studying a lot for the exams and making sure you get good grades on the hw. Also, he takes the participation grade seriously. Take him!
I did not do well in Intermediate Accounting but he is a great guy. Only complaint is that he acts like his tests are just like the study guides but he always manages to spin things way harder.

Prof H. is a cary, accessible teacher- I appreciate the effort he put into teaching. That being said, he tries to trick you. I would study for 20+ hours for each test, but I never got better than an 85%, because 20% of each test was comprised of tricky things that would not be found in the textbook. Take Sommers for a more straightfoward class

Best accounting professor at SMU by far. Intermediate accounting 1 is a difficult class, especially as a summer course but he made it very doable. Teaching is not his full time job, he does it because it's his passion and he loves it and you can tell by his dedication to his students. The class is hard no matter who teaches it but he's awesome

This class was hard because it is a lot of material, but Professor Hamirani was absolutely amazing. He is one of the best professors in the business school. He is also always available to help and enjoys teaching his students. You can tell Professor Hamirani actually cares about his students and preparing them for the future.

So far my favorite professor in the program. Strong EQ and IQ. Clearly cares for his students, uses "real life" examples, and supportive in and out of class. I don't love Accounting, but I highly recommend this class and professor.
Amazing prof! He cares about his students. Put work in and you will enjoy it

Sohail is extremely kind and involved. He wants to do everything he can to help his students and is more than willing to take extra time, respond quickly, and accommodate needs. His lectures are engaging as he uses follow-along packets and weaves in tons of real-world experience. Definitely take him while at SMU, challenging but super worth it!

I'm not going to repeat everything that's already been said about Professor Hamirani, but I will offer some advice for incoming students. 1. Don't sleep on quizzes, they can seriously hurt/help your grade 2. Do every single practice problem and question. You can't expect to do well just by doing the practice test. 3. GO TO OFFICE HOURS.

Really great professor. I loved his teaching style, which consisted of filling out the note packets and practice problems during class. There were 6 quizzes throughout the semester instead of the generic 2 huge tests which I really liked. He is always willing to help and has plenty of office hours. All around really nice professor and great class.

He is an amazing professor who really cares about his students. There are lots of tests but each only contains one unit. There is only like one to two homeworks per unit. The class moves pretty fast so go to class and pay attention. Reviews and homework problems in the packet are really good to study for tests. TAKE HIM!!!

Professor Hamirani is incredibly supportive of his students, creating an encouraging environment to learn despite the difficulty of Intermediate I. His notes packets are incredibly helpful, and he takes time outside of class to help. It is evident that he is passionate and truly cares.

It is a tough class due to the volume of information in such short time, but he made it so manageable because of the commitment he has to students with the notes packets he created and the number of office hours he offers. He brings in such valuable real-world examples with his career experience and it's obvious the passion he has for teaching.

This guy is one of the best accounting professors at SMU. Intermediate accounting is tough, but he makes the class manageable. No homework, 5 exams, 4 quizzes, and 2 projects. He also teaches how to read real-world financial statements, which is super cool. You must put in the effort to get an A, but Sohail 100% wants all his students to succeed.

This guy is such a beast. Class is a huge grind simply because of the volume of content, but he makes it super accessible and is clear in what he expects. Also very committed to students which is a huge plus. Must take

Yes, this course is hard but there is no other teacher I would rather have than Sohail. He beats any of the other ACCT teachers at SMU.  Sohail does care about his students and has unlimited office hours. He takes his Sunday's off to review before tests.

Professor Hamirani is a good teacher. However, his tests aren't what is learned in class. The test questions are worded to trick you and don't match the practice tests. He's a picky grader and instead of focusing on whether you have mastered the concept, he grades on little details which can destroy your grade even though you know the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Hamirani is really nice and wants everyone to do well in the class. He sometimes has a hard time explaining concepts to the class and speeds through examples during lectures. You can tell he's newer to teaching and relies on intuition to teach at times. Tests and quizzes aren't too hard, but he can grade written questions tough.
Was an awesome professor that genuinely cares about his students. The class was hard, but there are plenty of resources to make up for it.
Class is fully test and quiz based. If you go to class then you will do well

Professor Hamirani is a CFO and SMU alum who cares about his students. He provides notes packets in lieu of a textbook, and condenses concepts into 15-20 pages. Practice exams/quizzes are provided, if you study those you do well on the exams. Prof is very accessible after class and genuinely wants us all to succeed!

Sohail was an amazing professor. I took his ACCT 2302 course and will be taking him for intermediate accounting as well. He doesn't use a textbook, just gives a notes packet with everything you will need to know for the quizzes and exams. He's super caring and wants to help. Also offers extra credit for each exam.

This professor is one of the hard ones for managerial acct. His lectures move so fast that you can hardly take notes and have to re-teach yourself everything later. He does provide all the things necessary to succeed but get ready to work hard.

Great professor!! Really cares about his students. Class time is used really well and class notes are helpful. He can explain complex ideas extremely well and break them down for people who don't have experience with accounting. This was managerial accounting and learning things about the internal workings of the business was interesting/helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hamirani was amazing for Intermediate. The material was difficult but he teaches it in a concise and easy way to understand. His notes are AMAZING, literally condenses 80 pages of reading into just like 15-20. Make sure to read them super carefully for the quizzes since they are already very condensed! He is super caring and wants you to do well!

He is one of the most caring professors I've had throughout my education. He is available a ton outside of class, given that he is a CFO of a company speaks measures to how important teaching is to him and making himself available all the time. Int Acct. 1 is the hardest class at SMU, but Professor does well with helping students learn material.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Many consider Intermediate I to be the one of the hardest if not the hardest course in Cox, but Professor Hamirani tries his best to mediate the pain. He cares for students because he was once a student at Cox as well. Take him if you get the chance.

Professor Hamirani really helped me succeed in this class. I struggled with thr material but he was available to help. He offered office hours on Sundays, sounds unusual, but its due to his CFO job. I liked that he incorporated the material into the real world. He is passionate in teaching accounting and really wants his students to succeed.

Professor Hamirani is an amazing teacher, I've never had a teacher that cared about their students to the extent he does - he's frequently available outside of class to help students with material. This class is difficult but fair - info is given in notes packets so no memorizing entire textbooks. Hamirani is EASILY the best option for this course

Professor H is hands down the best professor I have experienced in my college career. He taught the hardest class in the business school but teaches it in a way that is enjoyable and beneficial. If you are looking for a professor that is there for you 24/7 to help you learn this is your guy. You better be ready to work hard, but if you will succeed

Every Intermediate Accounting class will be a pain to take and there is no getting around it. However, Hamirani really puts in a lot of effort in meeting with everyone to see how they are doing. He gives some extra credit for you to earn if you so choose, which is invaluable on tests. Not easy but it's the best you'll get for this tough subject.

Professor Hamirani was a great professor. He is very excited to teach and loves to get to know his students. Always available for extra help/credit. Weekly quizzes take up a lot of your semester because they are very dense - so memorize the packets. They are good bc keeps you up to date w material. Overall, best intermediate prof at SMU!

Professor Hamirani is one of the best professors I have ever had. This class, regardless of the teacher, is very difficult and time consuming, but he makes it do-able. He is always available outside of class to help you and truly puts so much effort into helping you learn
He is very kind. He gives lots of practice and extra credit. You are well prepared to get an A. He does lecture using a notes packet but it contains everything you need to know.

Despite the rigorous nature of this class, Professor Hamirani is one of the nicest and most caring professors I have ever had. He was always available outside class for office hours and review sessions and he gave up his Sundays to work with students as well. He wants every student to succeed and he will go out of his way to help you improve.

Professor Hamirani is the most caring professor that I have ever had. Not only is he very knowledgeable about accounting and teaches well, but he makes himself available almost all the time. He meets with every student 1-on-1 and genuinely wants his students to succeed. This class is HARD, but Professor Hamirani gives you the tools to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best Cox professor I've had. Such genuine care and dedication for his students, putting in his Sundays for office hours and available for text and additional office hours before exams to help. Very accessible and kind. I feel tremendous growth in my learning after being one of his students. Don't get me wrong, the class is hard but worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor H is one of my favorite professors at SMU! He put a lot of time into making note packets so you don't have to read 80 page chapters. He holds a lot of office hours and is very available for help. Intermediate I is a hard class, but he makes it an enjoyable class to attend. He even brought the class cookies! Can't recommend him enough! :)

GREAT professor! For any finance/acct majors, take him over LHR because he'll prepare you super well. He gives you concepts in a holistic understanding so you know why you're even learning all this stuff. He doesn't curve but gives extra credit. Go to office hours and review sessions they help sm. He's also so funny and makes acct bearable! 10/10
Wants you to succeed and gives real world examples in the field of accounting

He has been the BEST teacher I've ever had. I would highly recommend taking him. He cares about his students' success and devotes his time to help them succeed: review sessions and extra practice on Sundays. He uses examples to apply what we learn in class to real life, and he shares lots of real-world applications due to his position as a CFO.

Sohail is already a legendary professor at Cox. Gives you 100% of what you need to know on exams, it’s solely up to you to study the material and do well. He responds to texts outside of class, and despite being a CFO, he prioritizes his students. The class is hard, but Sohail makes it as easy as he possibly can.

Easily the best Professor at SMU Cox.
The level of difficulty (3) is attributed only to the course, not the Professor. Prof Hamirani is an expert in his field, he’s a CFO as well as an adjunct and teaches at two universities. If you attend every lecture and review, you’ll not only do well in the class, you will also become a capable accountant.

If I could have chosen Hamirani for both Financial and Managerial Accounting I would have. He doesnt just prepare you to answer exam questions, he helps you solidify the concepts in a way that builds an incredible foundation for both finance and accounting classes. He gives great feedback and is incredibly accessible. 
He is the best Professor @SMU
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Suprise grades you down after the drop date, doesn't tell you its coming, he acts all lowkey then dops the hammer when you can't do anything about it. Lies and says his supervisor is the one to blame for his hard absense and grade rules when we all know each individual teacher make those. Talks about other soc teachers negatively which feels off.

If you sit in the front of this class and actually listen he will give you a better grade and grade your stuff more easily. But if you sit in the back and get distracted be prepared to have a C+ or B- in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: I'm in his gender class, and took his last semester too. Really liked him and now I DONT, he's waited until the last 2 days of class to grade everything, and decided to tank everyone's grades. He now plays favorites, and he reuses like all his material. Save your energy and take anyone else. Went from an A- to B today, but half are failing.

whatever you do. do not take this class. Would not recommend at all. he holds ideologies and grades based on that. he also does not give clear feedback and is always vague. Make sure you don't get sick either.he finds ways to take off points for every little thing. not to mention he just simply is not a good teacher and boring
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There is a lot of reading in the class. IDK about the other reviews, he does not present himself in a political way. Wants to make class engaging. He has quizzes every week & often will tell us when they are. He is very lenient with extensions and wants to help his students. I like going to his class bc he is open minded + interesting class

Overly full of himself and makes the course miserable. Class turns into self-important speeches about ideology. Gives quiz after quiz and the questions are intentionally misleading. Grades are unnecessarily strict and nothing is ever good enough. It's literally just a CC class - why is it this intense.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
Really enjoyed this class. Professor Henderson is very kind, energetic, and genuinely interesting, and he always brings great energy to lecture. The class is very fair, if you prepare even a little, an A is attainable. He gives test questions in advance, allows two quiz drops, and offers plenty of extra credit.


Great human being!

reviews.comment: Huge ego simply not built for SMU. Classes consist of talking about liberal social problems because of the dudes pride in previous education. Will pile 10+ quizzes and try to trick you on those quizzes. Always takes off points unnecessarily for all assignments and all this for a CC class no one cares for-doing way too much
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: It began very hard for a course that nobody takes by choice but then he made it way easier when we all kept complaining. Very boring class but he responds to complaints and will make the class bearable and easy if you speak out enough and go to his dean. I still regret taking the course but did ok.
Dr. Henderson is great. The exams and quizzes are super easy. Just do the readings and you'll be fine. The lectures aren't anything special, but he is always willing to engage with students.

Hard class for a cc credit, if ur good at memorizing then I'd say you'd do pretty well in the class. He offers extra credit which more professors should do, so thats also a +. Overall, he's a nice guy and very very knowledgable, but his class is a little boring. I wish class wasn't so dependent on 4-5 readings a week, fun activities would be nice

It's not a terrible class. Did I dread going to this class 3x a week? yes. Would I take this course again to get the same cc out of the way? No. Way too much work for a class that's supposed to be a gpa booster if im being honest, and he really does have a superiority complex. But overall it wasn't terrible, I'm terrified for this final tomorrow

The professor teaches in a clear, organized manner that makes the material easy to follow and understand. Their professional approach and ability to explain concepts effectively create a strong and supportive learning environment.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Way to much work for a course that most of us take for credit only. He knows none of us are majors then acts like we know sociology, pop quizzes, attendance isn't required but there's a participation grade, every class is just a book club run by someone who didn't read. He's self-absorbed w main character energy  and superiority complex

He gives 3 article reading every week and there is a pop quiz once a week on one of the readings. One midterm, one paper, one presentation and final exam. He doesn't use slides, so his lectures aren't structured. Every class is about the reading of the day, Attendance isn't mandatory but he has a participation grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I really like him tbh he admitted that he had to be hard in the beginning but it was all just papers! As long as you go to class it's easy and he wants to help you. Just go talk to him he is so chill

Ngl the class got easier when we all started complaining bc he said he needed the job. His teaching is amateur but all teachers are else they'd have an actual job but at least he adjusted unlike others. Moral of story is complain more and louder
