Yo lets put a MASSIVE test 5 days before the final exam bc three months wasn't enough to fit that test in. I would rather get beaten for a week straight than take this class again. This is a waste of time, my parent's money, life in general. Thanks for ruining my semester.

RELEASE ME!!! Worst mistake of my life taking this class, most of the class only shows up for the attendance check-in. A fair comparison would be the 9th level of hell from Dante's Inferno, this is not an exaggeration. I can't do it anymore this class is literally hell, and to make it worse, the examples are filled with liberal brainrot rigmarole.

Notice how there is some overwhelmingly good review that follows every bad review. This is the most bipolar review page I've ever seen and is a major red flag as everyone I know agrees with me when I say she's the most horrendous professor I've ever encountered. One of us is lying of conniving. Trust.

Shes super sweet and wants you to do well! She offers partial credit on her multiple choice exams which can help ur grade A LOT. Go to her lectures, pay attention, study and you will be just fine! She uploads all her notes and explains things well! It's a faced paced class but totally managble
Worst professor at SMU, her only fan on here is herself
Don't take this class seriously terrible teacher, and why is she leaving her own reviews?

Its crazy shes seeing the feedback here and instead of learning from it, is writing reviews that are clearly written by her. It's impressive how bad she is at teaching, maybe she would be more suited elsewhere at SMU...
HORRIBLE.  Cannot teach, infantilizing, unorganized, and I question her qualifications. Worst professor and person. Huge ego with little interest in actually teaching. Do not take.

Dr. Wickersham is a fantastic teacher. Stats is not that hard of a course, but she makes the class interesting and fun to learn about. If you want to succeed, however, you must attend office hours when you are confused and dedicate a good amount of time to studying. You have to try to learn actively, and you will get an A.

Professor Wickersham is one of the best professors at SMU for sure! The feedback on homework and multiple attempts are a life saver! Additionally, provided practice tests help prepare you very well for the tests as well, and she is very easy to access via email and outside of class hours. Attendance is helpful, but it is only 5%.

approaching t-minus 12 hours until judgement day... the second test... The class as a whole knows nothing. me and my boys are suffering in loyd rn... slaving away at our note sheets just for them to be consficated because they didn't fit the 75 different criteria... running off 50mg of addy some bag... just need to hold out until may... wish me one

reviews.comment: She is so much tougher than is misrepresented on here and is a terrible lecturer and everyone I know agrees so I don't know who's liking her. Disorganized, rude, and not effective at presenting the concepts. SO bad...

It shoudnt be this hard but it is becuase she doesn't know how to teach nor does she have her terminal degree which may be why. did not care about the students, and would not help out no matter what the questions was.  SMU needs to pony up the big bucks and get more qualified professors.

Very easy to succeed in her class. You get a cheat sheet on all tests, and get to drop your worst test, homework, and lab. 3 attempts on each homework and lab with feedback to help guide you, so it's very easy to get a good grade on that. She posts her notes so you can follow along and fill in the blanks. Generously gives extra points back on tests
Unskilled, underinformed, deeply untalented in teaching and seems to be unaware of these things.

It is recommended to use the textbook but I did fine without it. You can get lost if you don't attend every class but going to office hours really helps. Completing all of the practice exams she provides was also very helpful. She does posts notes at the end of class so I suggest paying attention rather than taking your own. I really did like her!

A bad experience overall. She spends more energy on being a rule-follower and babying you than she does teaching with her condescending worksheets, shutting down opposing viewpoints in the process. You leave the class feeling like you've gained nothing. Lack of professionalism contributes to the dumbed down reputation of SMU.

Open note exams that are not super hard. The lecture is just slides where we all follow along and fill in the blanks with her. Lab is super easy but homework is a bit tough but doable. MAKE SURE TO PAY ATTENTION IN CLASS. You will fall behind if you don't pay attention but you can always ask her questions during office hours or emails.

Do not take this professor. Really tough material and she does a very poor job of teaching it. She doesn't know how to teach and yet we have to take her course. SMU needs to double check who they are hiring starting with the stats department.
LITERALLY THE WORST PROF I'VE EVER HAD. Insane about cheating and will falsely accuse you then never apologize when she realizes she's wrong.
The material in the class was hard but she did her best to explain it! She also gave multiple attempts on homework and labs which was great!

Professor Wickersham is a solid prof if you're taking STAT 3300, but you have to be willing to pay attention or you're going to get left behind. Homework is a nightmare but the exams are actually relatively easy, you get a cheat sheet. Beware of the group project, though, it's a solid amount of work. Final is open note, so it shoudn't be a problem.

reviews.comment:
Don't take this class. She doesn't like teaching and it's pretty clear throughout the semester that she
 would rather be somewhere else. If you can, try and take another professor unless you are looing to ruin your gpa, then by all means take her. She acts like she hates her job and is not very good at it anyhow.
Prof. Wickersham is kind, patient, and genuinely wants to help her students. Very kind person! Would take again for sure.

LITERALLY THE WORST PROF I'VE EVER HAD. She had no clear instructions for her assignments, and what ever was there didn't include what she specifically instructed. Additionally she took off points for something that I wasn't supposed to do or needed to do.

I absolutely adore her. She is so kind and makes it her personal mission to help you succeed. The class isn't difficult to pass if you pay attention and if you don't understand something GO TO HER OFFICE HOURS. She is incredibly caring and helpful
Doesn't have a phd and it shows, take someone who is an actual professor.

The worst professor at SMU and a bad person. She is so rude to students and makes fun of them for being confused or getting questions wrong. She makes no effort to actually teach anything in office hours without being condescending. Her lectures are riddled with mistakes teaching us wrong. I hope SMU does something about her soon.
Very unhelpful
Am a 4.0 student and I have never gotten grades like these even looking it up and you find nothing. its impossible to ace this class and she's not setting you up for anything for good grades at all

reviews.comment: Last 5 minutes of class and she is scolding us about how we have 10 minutes left and that it's "our grade" because we were packing up. I also had her beginning of the year and she was extremely rude and said that "I should be lucky to be in this class because she would have said no otherwise" Do not take this class if you want good education.

One of the least competent professors at SMU. Does not have a grasp on the material she is teaching. Material is auto-created and auto-graded, lecture slides are straight from the textbook. Jessica does nothing, can't teach. She tries to baby you into taking notes and it is horribly insulting as a college student. Got a C with hours of work.
Cares and wants to see students succeed. Hands down best professor at SMU

Very unclear grading criteria, unreasonably high expectations for assignments, absolutely boring "discussions" where she expects us to teach the rest of the class. Her snarky comments to people who disagree with her are unprofessional DO NOT TAKE (she's a bad teacher). I couldn't wait for her class to end.

Such a rude woman, you never know what you are going to get with her, sometimes she is helpful other times she tells you to study more in a dismisive manner than help you. Her tests come out of nowhere so no matter what you study you will do poorly on at least one. She used to be easy from what i understand but is now the worst option.

Wickersham can come off as passive aggressive when teaching, but she's better one-on-one when you need help. Homework isn't too bad, and neither is the first exam. The second exam kinda blindsides you, but the final is redemptive. Most people got high B's or A's. But beware, this class is easy to get lost in, and it's hard to get back on track.

You take notes all of class. 90% of the notes have nothing to do or are on the test. I've never had a teacher like this in my life, she actually took me outside of class and told me to drop her class. I am giving you the truth because I am disgusted with what she does to students. I am saving your grade

I am shocked at all the negative reviews on this professor. She is incredibly helpful in her classes. She let's you redo wrong answers in tests for partial credit and allows multiple attempts on homework. She gives great feedback. It can be a lot of work but she is so kind and helpful.

She teaches like middle school algebra but way less effectively. It's mindblowing how much we pay to go here and how poor our teachers are. She couldn't be bothered to respond to emails or be in office hours but could count off points for answers we had actually correct. She should count herself out and go somewhere else.

She is an extremely difficult grader, the only assignments you have cant be dropped, and the amount of word she expects you to do is ridiculous. She used to be easier which is why she's getting more difficult as you can see from history of ratings. Her "lectures" are a waste of time, never helpful in office hours, absolutely terrible.

Honestly, Wickersham is a great professor for those who are willing to put in effort in the class. What makes Wickersham a "hard" professor is her willingness to engage with students. Meaning, she expects you to do the same. If you are the type to skip collaborations/class, expect a low grade. If you are willing to put in effort, she is an easy A.

Doesn't teach, worst course experience of my life, never been so lost in a class before and I make all A's. She is NOT a nice person, gets angry at students when we ask questions, and is too lazy to help. So infantilizing it is gross and she needs to get a job at a middle school rather than trying to work with college aged adults who expect effort.

I really felt like I taught myself for the majority of this class, Wickersham isn't very nice and comes off as condescending and rude often. She will not round up your grade even if you are close so beware. You get knocked down 3% in attendance for every class you don't go to which is insane. Attendance should be optional, we're grown adults..

Wickersham prepares you well for her tests, and I would even say the practice were almost exactly like the tests. Labs helped with my understanding of the lecture content and practice with Excel. This was a fairly easy class, especially if you have taken STATS previously in high school.

Wickersham is the teacher who knew her students' names. She was absolutely wonderful for the first two tests but started to rush really bad for the last two tests. Her lectures are engaging but attendance is mandatory. I would recommend her!

She really should be teaching high school instead, she's better suited for that. Kind of felt like she babied us (not in a good way), and she constantly told us to turn to a partner for partner work. You don't learn anything in the class as it is flipped, everything is through videos. Additionally, the weight to estimate your grade was always off.

She let us use cheat sheets on tests, and she gave us practice exams which really helped with studying. If you're going to take this class, take it with her! While the material was challenging at times, she did her best to make it as easy as possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Have you missed the most useless class of middle school with the most irritating teacher assigning daily homework like you're 15 years old again rather than a college student?  Well, this is the teacher for you. One step above the gym coach teaching health.

There were lots of assignments but multiple attempts on homework and labs with useful critiques on wrong answers. She posted lecture notes and practice tests that are like the tests themselves. She responds to emails fast and is easily available during office hours. Also allows a cheat sheet for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Wickersham teaches a lot like a high school teacher: HW for every class, slides with fill in the blank, practice tests. If you show up and pay attention, you'll be fine. She has made it where you can't game the class now.

I loved this class, learned so much! Wickersham is honestly the sweetest and truly wants the best for her students; she goes above and beyond every time and wants to make sure everyone is in a good mindset before starting a lesson! Definitely recommend her if you have never taken stats before. Love her!!

She gives great lectures, wants to know every student, and gives partial credit for correcting free response questions. She assigns weekly homework, a group project and practice tests that isn't too heavy or hard and they help prepare for exams. She even posts internship/job opportunities! Always goes above and beyond, one of the best profs. at SMU

One of the best professors I've had at SMU! I was nervous about taking this class but, she really walks you through everything you need to know. The grade is made up of homework, exams, and a group project. She gives quick feedback on all assignments. You can also do corrections for partial credit on the free response portions of exams and homework

Before this semester, people said she was a fine teacher, but the reason they took her class is because she gave a manageable study/workload. However, because people said she was easy last semester, she has worked very hard to make the class harder to pass. If you want a teacher who understands that this is a mandatory class, do not take her.

If I could take her for all of my stats classes I would. She truly cares about her students success. If you are willing to put in the work and show her you care  you will be rewarded. By far my favorite professor at SMU.

Miss Wickersham allows multiple attempts on all homework and project checkpoints. She gives a practice exam with questions from the test bank for each exam and allows a "cheat-sheet" for each exam (2 for the final). She really wants you to understand the concepts and is very helpful during office hours. Definitely recommend.

Amazing prof. Her canvas is organized and detailed. Multiple attempts on homework and labs. Gives practice exams. Lectures are engaging, she's not just reading off the slides but actively works through them and gets feedback. Available after and before class, email/canvas, and multiple times to meet during office hours. Textbook pdf was given.

Wickersham is very passionate about what she teaches and it is clear in her lectures. It is basically impossible to get a bad grade in the class since she posts filled out lecture notes, practice exams, and lets you redo homework and labs. The class moves pretty fast, but it is doable.

If you have to take stats, she's the one to take it with. The class is graded very objectively, there's multiple attempts on everything except tests, and she's accessible and knowledgeable. Doing the labs isn't optional but going to the lab class is optional. Once you get over the HS teacher vibe, you'll be cruising.
Completely agree with how dumb down she makes everything while messing up her own dumbed down version as if she intended to make the mistakes as a way to "test" us. Don't know how she has a job.

didn't like her lectures but she is a very caring professor who always checks on the students. she is caring and will extend deadlines if you have a valid reason. very straightforward about what is going to be on the tests. if you take the practice tests you should be able to get a good grade because the exam is exactly like the practice test.

I took Wickersham for Winter Term, and she understood her students' schedules. She excused absences when necessary, allowed you to work ahead, and explained the concepts really well. Her real tests pull from the same bank as the practice, and you have three attempts.

She goes very fast during lectures, but with homework, labs, and multiple attempts on either, it's not the absolute worst but still not the absolute best. Class is pretty much impossible to fail if you just do everything. She's really nice and very available with office hours and appointments. Lowest homework grade and exam get dropped

she is a great professor and I really liked her class, as long as you go to class and do your homework and labs you will be just fine. the class is extremely lectures heavy and if you get behind it will be hard to catch up, but she is very nice and understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: STAT 2331 is a tough class hands down, doesn't matter who you take. But with Wickersham, you'll have a bunch of HW attempts, practice tests, and buffers that'll bump you up even if the tests don't go well. Might have to YouTube a concepts every now and then, but Wickersham as good as it gets

Don't listen to the bad reviews - take her. The whole course is formulated to help students succeed. 3 attempts on homework, practice test with same test bank as exam & unlimited attempts (to see the questions). Cheat sheet. Allows you to make excel template to use on exams. She does everything to help you succeed, and the lectures are very good

Class consists of homeworks due each time class occurs, labs, tests, attendance. Labs are so easy and teach you how to use excel. Tests are online and she gives you a practice test the day before with a question bank that it pulls from for the real test. She is superrrrr nice and funny and you get to know her life a little during classs.
If you do all the homework and labs you can't fail. Stats either clicks or you struggle so go to office hours she's very helpful. the fill-in notes were helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Class is pretty easy. Multiple attempts on homework and labs means you should get full credit in most of the class if you care enough. She will let you use a page cheat-sheet on each test as well as a calculator or excel. Final is open note. Partial credit on multiple choice tests somehow. Not too bad.

Prof Wickersham is amazing! Her lectures can be tough to follow but if you read the online textbook (you don't have to buy it and she doesn't make you read) it really helps. She is so nice and willing to work with you. There are weekly homeworks but she gives you 3 tries and explains the answers after each try. Would love to have her again.

Tests are hard, but that's just the nature of the class. Everything you are tested on is very upfront as she provides sample tests for practice. It's also nice that she gives multiple attempts for the homework and labs. This class isn't easy, but Wickersham tries her best to make it fair.
Her tests were incredibly hard and I had to reteach myself every singel thing she taught because she is awful at teaching.

She is very nice! Always available to help and almost always respond within 24 hours of you reaching out. She is very caring and really tries to break down the content for you to understand. You do have to do work tho, this isn't a blow-off class, you have to study hard on exams but the homework/lectures prepare you for sure.

She really cares about students and is accommodating but she absolutely flies through lectures and tests are difficult, although we can use a cheat sheet. Homework once a week but takes a long time and you get 3 attempts. The lab section is easy and you don't really need to show up. Overall a pretty easy class as long as you study.

Professor Wickersham moves very fast during her lectures, so she is hard to keep up with. I only survived by watching the recorded lectures outside of class which took a long time. She didn't really help me when I asked her questions or emailed her. Tests are very hard so make sure to study. Overall she is a nice person just not the best teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lots of examples, and a very generous grader with lots of opportunities for bonus points or extra credit. Very helpful to go to her office hours or through email. Talks rather fast in class, but the lecture notes are all posted, so even if you miss an example you can follow along with the lecture on your own time.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Wickersham is a good teacher, but she lectures very quickly. For people that have never taken stats before, it can be kinda difficult to follow at times. She gives multiple attempts at all homeworks and labs, and the feedback on those is very helpful. Tests aren't super easy but not too awful. If you put in the work, the class isn't bad.

Homework and labs are easy, tests are pretty hard. Goes through the lecture very quickly which makes it difficult to keep up with notes, but most of my notes came from homework and labs because she gives a lot of feedback on those. Wants you to succeed, will give you multiple submission attempts, and let you push off tests if needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is very nice and she cares about international students. She curved every test(If you got the question wrong, you will lose partial credit), which is very easy to get 90 or above. She wants all the students to learn the materials, not just for the test but to apply them in daily life. Very accessible during outside classes.

She is incredibly nice and LENIENT when it comes to grading. She let us use a cheat sheat on every test and the final was open notes. And you got to use excel on every test. The homeworks can take a long time to finish. You get multiple tries to submit anything in this class, for full credit. Just do the practice tests and homework to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: she is kind and truly tries to connect with students. HOWEVER. wow does she just move at 100 mph. Even when students ask her to slow she really doesn't. I understood about the first 3 weeks but she moves so quick that all the basics don't really stick and then I had no idea what was going on. Lots of tests, hw, labs, projects. Not worth taking.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Wickersham goes incredibly fast when teaching and she doesn't like to go back to previous slides. Her homework is very time-consuming so make sure you set aside a lot of time. Tests are kinda hard but she gives partial credit. Overall, she's very understanding and cares for her students but she's just boring.

She is a nice teacher and no doubt cares for her students but my gosh she goes so fast during lectures. I was barely able to keep up, the only way I could get through the class was rewatching lectures but I am not sure how long that will be an option. She does make time to help and gives good feedback. But stats just sucks as a class in general.

Make sure you go to class because it take a long time to makeup otherwise. She only gives homework once a week but it takes 2+ hours so set time aside to do it. She talks very fast in class but records the class so you can go back and take notes. Tests are hard but similar to the practice exams so take advantage of those.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: very obvious she wants to help you succeed. overall great professor.
She is a really nice professor and is super accommodating and understanding. My only problem was that she went through material pretty quickly. Would recommend her
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Truthfully Professor wickersham has been one of my favorite professors during my time at SMU, she knows how to teach the material in a way to not lose engagement. She will never leave you hanging and always be willing to talk.

I was nervous at first (this was my first statistics class ever) but found her to be an excellent professor. Her homework is designed to reflect the content that will be tested and she puts in a lot of time to check project submissions and give helpful feedback. There's a lot to cover, but she always takes questions and has solid office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: She just reads the slides and doesn't actually teach; she loves her Excel and face masks. If she spent less time talking about her kids and COVID, she wouldn't have to rush through the lectures every single class. If you want to self teach yourself, take the course: she at least gives you a full sheet cheat sheet for each exam.

Professor Wickersham speaks incredibly fast during lectures, your lucky if you can even get one sentence down. Her tests are hard but manageable and she only assigns two things a week but they are very time consuming. She is also incredibly strict about wearing masks and will send you home from class if you are sick.

She does not give you any help whatsoever. She speeds through the lectures and does not slow down for anything or anyone. Awful at explaining things. you are best off just teaching yourself everything if you decide to take her.

Best math teacher I've had so far. Extremely understanding and has a very good class setup, in which class is just for questions. A fantastic choice if you plan on taking statistics, especially if you already took it in high school and have a decent understanding of it.

Even though it was not a hard class, it was difficult for me to stay interested in it. She explained things well, but she just gave so much homework and lectures. As a result, I stopped caring about the class and left the videos playing in the background. Sadly I received a B+ where I really should have gotten an A if I had pushed myself more.

Class just sucks. She never taught us anything, and only had us come in with questions. It was nice we didn't really have class, but you had to hold yourself accountable to learn the material, ask questions, and stay up to date on all the homework and labs.

Yep, easy and nice but the course is a waste of your time and infantilizing. It's like she thinks we're still in high school with her dumbed-down videos and the material is nothing more than elementary level. Sure, take if you want an easy A but don't expect to learn anything.

This professor is a literal blessing from God. I don't have the words to describe how amazing she was. I was blown away by how easy the class was, and I still learned so much! I honestly wish every professor was like her. Easy homework, exams are just like the practice exams, lots of office hours, lectures are non mandatory!!!

Professor Wickersham is the nicest Statistics professor I've ever had by far. What's super helpful in this class is she posts videos and lecture notes to help explain to students better. She's also always accessible outside the classroom and as long as you see her during her office hours, she's super helpful. She also gives extra credit!

Honestly the best! If your schedule is tight the online class is very flexible as you do the notes and hw on your own time and come to class to ask questions. She is super sweet and you can really tell she cares about her students

SHE IS AMAZING!! She always asked for feedback at the end of each module and she would adjust her teaching style. She is super accommodating, understanding, and a very good professor. She makes things easy to understand and helps her students do the best they can. As long as you do your work, you will pass. I definitely recommend her class!!!

She worked hard to make class easy for her students. Her lectures are thorough and easy to follow, and all the homework questions are easily answered with her notes. Exams are 60% of your grade, but not very hard. She is very flexible and will work with her students to help them when they need it.

She is a gem. Very sweet and cares how your day went. I took this class entirely online. Packets of fill-in notes posted for each module and you watched the videos and did homework on your own time. Practice tests identical to the exam. The class was just office hours, if you don't have questions, no need to show up.

Professor Wickersham is the best! She is so sweet and understands that online classes can be difficult. She is very available in office hours. Class was totally online and lectures were videos done on your own time with homework assignments. Class is basically office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: His lectures can be very disorganized and hard to follow because he speaks with no references for all of class. Only things that go into grade are the three midterms and final exam which he grades very subjectively. Go to office hours for some brownie points.

I ended up dropping my major because of this class. His exams aren't even about what you know it's just about how fast you can write. Expect 3 midterm, each 3 essays in 50 minutes the final is 5 essays. Not flexible and mean

I would rather watch paint dry than sit through another one of his lectures. He speaks like a monotone AI bot and presents absolutely zero displays on the classrooms electronic or classical board/whiteboard. 4 tests that are graded based upon how he's feeling that day with very little feedback and attempt to help students. If you want a B take this

reviews.comment: Hated everything about this man and class.
The most worst professor in the school.
My least favorite professor I've ever had
My favorite professor I've ever had
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Never met a man more full of himself and with fewer reasons to be. Terrible old fashioned lecturer who rambles and has no flair in speaking. My communications prof would fail him. Tests are nothing like his lectures. Terrible.
Do what he asks and you'll walk out with a great grade.

Jillson requires extensive reading, which is standard for PLSC. He's a traditional, approachable professor who focuses solely on lectures and readings—no slides or online aids. Tests are challenging but manageable, and he provides support for a major paper. Attendance is mandatory, so regular participation is essential.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: What a pompass.

He was pretty rude when asked questions + made passive-aggressive comments in both verbal and email communications. All he does is lecture, he is a dated man without any creativity in thought of how to relate. When you come to office hours to make a connection and for help he is condescending and rude. If you want to regret your semester, take him.

You only have a few grades in the course: 2 midterms, 1 paper & your final exam so don't take his grades lightly. To get good grades you must attend lecture. His lectures are straight forward. Do the readings. He is accessible outside of class, always has office hours. I've taken two of his courses now. He's great.

Every single day is nothing but lectures, out of a book he wrote 
One of those profs that literally won't let you in the room if you're 1 minute late
Does not put grades in Canvas at all through the year- I thought I was failing until he released final grades
Leans left politically and references this many times in the class (very Pro-Blue ideals)

Jillson's lectures are very clear and straightforward, fair grading. To do well, try to write down the details in his lecture and know his lecture outline very well. Very doable to get atleast a B/B+, if you study well. Sometimes adds humor to his lectures which is nice.

I can't speak highly enough of Cal. He is so knowledgeable, willing to help, and passionate. He wants you to succeed, so attend office hours. Since he wrote the textbooks, any detail is fair game for an exam, so you have to read carefully and memorize names/dates (especially for the first 2 exams). Exams and the term paper are fairly graded.

This class was very difficult for an intro-level class. BUT! Jillson responds to emails very quickly and is much more easygoing than he seems during class-super flexible and accommodating when you need it. Very knowledgable and interesting, sweet guy just really difficult
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This teacher was too hard for an introductory course. There are no power points and he lectures the whole time. He's a very hard grader and the tests are unclear and contain random essay and multiple choice questions. He seems very knowledgable about the topic of American Government, he is not welcoming and not understanding of the students needs.

Take someone else for 1320--there's typically 2 or 3 other professors who teach it, he's not worth the stress. Very hard grader, no ppt while he lectures, and comes across as very unapproachable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Jillson was such an amazing professor! He was super helpful throughout the entire class. Office hours HELP as is the usual with every PolySci professor ever. If you make the effort to approach him outside of class for help it'll boost your grade by leagues.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: His lectures are boring with no visuals. He also grades fairly harsh. However, he does care and is knowledgeable of the topic. Just have to work for your grade and conference with him on the paper. Not a horrible choice.

Professor Jillson is an unreasonable professor who does not consider the student's understanding of the material before moving on. He is an extremely tough grader, especially on essays. If you are interested in Political Science do not take this class because it is dry, boring, and harder than it needs to be.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Pros The class is pretty easy if you read the book (courses are based off textbooks he wrote). Cons He stops class for the slightest of distractions (students going to bathroom, etc). He post no work online. His lectures were complete auditory with no visual elements. His tests were mostly about memorization, and little about application.

This class was one of the hardest classes I've ever taken. I did all the reading and went to class and took notes and did not do well on the tests. Your whole grade is based on two tests, one paper, and the final, so if you do badly on one thing you're screwed. He is not clear what information will be on the tests and they are extremely detailed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Jillson is totally knowledgeable about the subject and even respected in the professional world for it. However, he grades incredibly hard and there are only three tests and an essay. Book reading is a must. Gave the most effort in this class and only got a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took this class for a minor. Unbelievable amount of work for a B minus when I really tried my hardest

reviews.comment: Would NOT recommend taking this professor at all. Too smart for an introduction class and is somewhat rude in office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Hello Future Students, This class was one of the most challenging class I ever had to take as a freshman. I'm not going to lie to you; this class requires effort on your part to even make a B or higher. You need to be prepared to do a chapter of reading for each class day and take notes on that material.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Brilliant guy, but tests are super specific and nit picky. Go in to talk to him if you need help, he's helpful and it's good when he gets to know you. You have to work for the grade but you will learn the material
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Amazing prof, very difficult class. His lectures are great and he knows what he's talking about forwards and backwards. Success requires an immense amount of work and discipline, from reading to listening to note-taking. Tests are quite tough, with questions sometimes over the most random details. One 12-15 pg. paper w/ plenty of time to complete

The tests are very detail oriented; if you want an A, you have to read, and you have to study. The lectures are good, but almost fully one sided. Only take this class if you are prepared to work. The whole class is graded on 2 tests, an essay, and the final. Attendance is taken but how (or if at all) it accounts into the grade is not clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Incredibly interesting lectures. Very knowledgeable and passionate about politics and US history. Its cool also that the textbooks required for the class are actually written by him. No laptops allowed in class and he grades on the harder side but don't let this discourage you from taking this amazing class. Absolutely take if you like PLSC.

he is an amazing professor! super knowledgeable and passionate, especially in Texas Politics! I have learned so much in his class. Readings are manageable, and tests are too if you study and pay attention in class, which honestly isn't that hard because he is hilarious! if you're a poli-sci major you have to take him!

avoid taking this class. I loved political science and wanted it to be my major but after taking this teacher I think I want to change. the multiple choice part of the tests pretty easy but the essays on them were hard and he would take off points for no reason. he does not create a canvas so you wont know your grade till end of semester. boring
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: He is an excellent professor with interesting lectures. Very respected. His tests are tough and the research paper was 15 pgs, but he is always great with help. Great professor for keeping you engaged.
Brilliant professor. Really knows the material and is able to explain so that everyone understands it. Make sure you do the readings because these are important on tests.

You either love Cal or you don't. I loved him. He is very direct about what is required of you. His lectures closely follow the reading so don't panic if you miss class (allowed 4 absences) Only 1 essay. Make sure you know the IDs. He really likes it when people can give him responses to questions he can't remember the answer too. Tests aren't easy

Dr. Jilson has tons of experience in his field. He puts everything into very easy terms to understand. His tests were easy (multiple choiceessay), but you HAVE TO READ AND TAKE THOROUGH NOTES. He will pull some obscure figures for the test, and the essays require you to incorporate sources from memory. There was 1 5-10 page paper, very easy.

Jillson is a Texas politics expert and will expect you to know almost as much he does by the end of the semester. Nitpicky on all exam questions. Do all the reading (and there's quite a bit). Had plenty of office hours, though, and made time to see me over spring break. Nice guy generally, but do NOT fall asleep in his class...

Professor Jillson is an expert on Texas politics. Listening to his lecture was truly eye opening and influential. Professor Jillson's class is very rigorous, and I have never done more reading in any other class. His tests are very difficult, and the term paper is reviewed stringently. Obtaining an A in class requires mass amounts of discipline.

One of the harder classes I have ever taken at SMU. Jillson is so smart it's hard to make him happy. Do not expect to get above a B- unless you are an incredible writer who is willing to do hours of reading each week

You learn a lot in this class and Professor Jillson definitely knows his material. However, it is not easy. You have to do a good amount of reading, but if you're interested in the subject it is worth taking.

Not easy but he really knows what he's talking about. You won't get an A in this class unless you do all the reading carefully (which is about 3 hours a week). If you want to learn a lot, take him. If you just want an easy class to fulfill your GEC (like I did), this is not the class/professor for you.

Jillson is tough. Extremely tough and you need to read all the time because he makes everyone participate. Tests are easy, paper (if you do it right) was easy too. He's a hard grader but generous with a curve. He's also willing to talk. Just read!!!

I have taken many PLSC classes before and most of them were 3000 or 4000 level. But compared to this class, all the other PLSC classes were easy! This guy hard, tough, and unhelpful. DO NOT TAKE HIM i warn u!!!

He gives 2 midterm tests(20% ea), a 8 page research essay(20%), and the final(40%). He gives 5-6 quiz's on the reading he assigns every night, at random before each midterm comes around(worth 10pts from the midterms).Midterms are 35 m/c and 2 essays. He is very smart but very sensative old man. this class is not a blowoff at all.
Jillson is great.  Tough grader, but it doesn't matter because you actually learn the material.  He's hilarious in class and one of the best PLSC professors at SMU.  Take him if you can!

Kinda tough.  Nice guy, but he flipped his lid in class once.  We called him the "over-cusser" because of his non-sensical use of curse words.  We feel like he used bits of our essays for his book.  Just a hunch on that one.
No Comments

This guy is not helpful and I would never recommend him to anyone. I have only made 2 B's in 3 yrs at SMU and this class was one of them and it was because he admittedly gave me a bad grade on a paper that he didnt even read.

This professor is extremly professional.  In class he pushes students.  In office hours he encourages students.  Additionally, he is an expert and media star, Class was cool, learnes alot and earned! a good grade.  Take him!!!!!
Cool Dude, really smart, really cares
Very intelligent and very interesting.
He is an excellent professor. He knows what he's talking about.
Great
No Comments
Liberal Democrat who is not open minded to conservative views.  If you have to take him, pretend to be a Democrat.
No Comments
Sraight laced, no nonsense approach. Excellant instructor, expert in his field, take his courses

i really liked his lectures. 3 midterms, 1 final, essay-based tests. everyone who truly stuggles in this class is bc we don't read the material. the tests can be challenging, but no HW. super available, and he was friendly/flexible ab my attendence. i skimmed the readings, studied a couple days for each test. show up, be awake, take notes!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Terrible lecturer and that's all he does. You cannot stay awake he is soooo bad.  Tests have nothing to do with what he lectures in so you have to read the books and still show for lecture even though there's no point.

He's genuinely a good professor. Very knowledgable, knows what he's talking about. Be prepared to read the 3 required textbooks and sit through 50 minutes of straight lecture. He pulls test questions from the books, and its multiple choice with 2 essays in 50 minutes. Only take if PLSC is your major, I've definitely learned a lot in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Truly, best professor I ever had at SMU. I would audit the classes I took with him all over again for fun. Extremely interesting course and extremely well-prepared, knowledgeable professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Pretty intense but extremely knowledgeable.

Honestly not sure why there's such bad reviews for his 1320 class. His lectures are actually interesting and you can tell he really enjoys what he's talking about and is very knowledgable. The class isn't easy, but it's not unreasonably hard either - there's a ton of information to study so it's really all about how much effort you put in.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took this class this past fall. Absolutely ridiculous. Jillson takes off points for almost everything with no explanation at all. I read the book, studied an extreme amount of time, and could never give a B for anything. I would suggest never taking this teacher if you would want any type of good grade.

Class has been overall pretty enjoyable. Taking it online due to COVID, but by far one of the most open and less threatening teachers I've had so far majoring in PoliSci. His class is interesting, and his lectures are enjoyable. If you read the book you will do fine on the test and if you go to class the short answers will also be easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Another negative reviewer wrote "he expects you to memorize dates and who wrote things." Of course he does. This is an upper-level PoliSci class. Don't take it if you don't want to learn. I am not a PoliSci major and had to work for my grade, but Jillson is a very respected expert on politics and he expects his students to be prepared/work hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Worst professor I have had at SMU thus far. He expects you to pretty much memorize the textbooks (that he has written) and expects you to remember dates, who things were written by, and outrageous things. Way too much reading, 0 feedback on tests and essays, and overall a terrible experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Most brilliant professor I have ever had, very sassy in the beginning but after a few weeks I'm 99% sure he doesn't check attendance sheet. EXTREMELY hard tests, if you work for it you will get an A, but it will not be easy by any means. If you are not interested in poly sci, dont take his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Absolutely loved this class--considering changing my major after this course. LOTS of reading and not an easy A by any means. Do not take if not interested in politics and history. Very heavy reading outside of class and tests are comprised of multiple choice and essays (typically 2). Studied hours for tests and never got an A with zero feedback.

Dr Jillson is undoubtedly an extremely smart man who often appears on Texas and national news outlets for his opinions on politics. His class itself is not difficult, but he requires a lot of reading outside of class. Class participation is expected, attendance is included in the grade. Good teacher and interesting course but don't expect an easy A
She's an A machine but tries to hard to be cool with kids, like her low self esteem requires it.

I enjoyed the curriculum. Her lectures are pretty monotone and I think she's looking for reactions to her stories which she thinks are cool. And they are interesting! but idk it kind of peeved me. Easy tests, offers bonus if you participate in research and the paper is an easy 100.

Doesn't encourage participation, stifles creativity through endless monotone lectures nobody can pay attention to. Avoid this class if you value your education.  Terrible teacher. Talks at students, not with them.
A frustrating professor who values popularity over professionalism. Not even sure she knows what she is doing, focuses more on her other job at that degree mill than her work here.

Honestly a huge you know what. Incredibly condescending and makes the class harder than it needs to be. Im convinced that she hates her job. Everyone Im in a group text with hates her with a passion & so does everyone I know thats had to take her in the past. Only take if ur forced

Professor Love was very engaging during night class lectures. You have to visit court a write a paper about your experience which was super easy. She doesn't reply to emails that much, but if you talk to her, she is very helpful.

Such a disappointing experience and everyone knows why we take her. Yes, easy A in her class cause she's clueless about cheating but while listening to her grandiose, self-indulgent stories about how she manages to save the world is not fit for college curriculum.Take someone else if you want to learn, it's an embarrassment of a course and to SMU.

Wasn't hard and the quizzes are on Quizlet. Definitely an easy A, so if you need another Psych credit then this is a fine class. Don't take it if you actually want to gain any knowledge. She doesn't answer emails or texts and makes fun of you if you get a question wrong in class, but if you stay quiet during class she won't randomly call on you.

This is the worst professor I have ever met. You cannot understand anything she says because the lectures are all over the place, refuses to help when students have questions by acting like she didn't understand, and she is severely opinionated, angry towards students. Blames students for "not studying" if they ask a question.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was such a waste of my time and money.  She's too lazy to do her job as a professor. People take her because she's an easy "A" but a total disgrace to those of us who are here to learn. Also not as "nice" as you think, was directly rude to me in office hours, never been treated so poorly. Definitely prefers to treat us like we are less than.

Easy class and that's why everyone takes her less entertaining that you might think given subject matter and definitely less interesting than she thinks she is. Won't help if you are trying to fashion a career in the field so good luck.

Super funny professor with interesting lectures, makes night class super enjoyable! Her tests are on quizlet and she has you write one paper over your experience at court. Would take her again in a heartbeat

such a fun class!! made my first night class super enjoyable - she's hilarious and does a great job teaching material. all tests are online, but the final was in-person, which was weird. had to take a teeny field trip on our own to the dallas courthouse and write a paper over the experience, which i'm pretty sure everyone got a 100 on. love her!!!!

I love this woman. Her life is so interesting and she has the best stories. All the exams are on quizlet and she doesn't even care. 1 paper and it's an experience of you going to the courthouse, which was actually super fun. Night classes aren't the best, but I would take this one again in a heartbeat. Highly recommend.

Dr Love is easily my favorite professor I've had at SMU. Such a unique and interesting class I would encourage anyone to take it. The class is mostly graded on the exams so its hard to bring your grade up if you mess up. Also she only gives letter grades, so no plus or minus, which can be a good or bad thing depending on the grade you end up with.

Professor Johannson- Love is one of my favorite professors Ive ever had. she is so funny and keeps a 3 hour class genuinely interesting. you do have to read the textbook but its all extremely interesting stuff. you also have an assignment and have to go to the jail and listen to a real court case. hands down favorite class I've taken at smu!! 15/10

Dr. Love is incredible! She is the most amazing lecturer I have ever had. She is very funny and has a dry sense of humor. Do not get offended by her blunt delivery. Participate in class- it makes it way more fun. It is a night class which sucks but she lets you out early Tests are not too hard. One easy essay and you go to the courthouse-so fun!
My favorite class that I've taken at SMU. You need to read and pay attention to pass, but it's very interesting. Don't expect to get an A if you don't show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Although your entire grade is based on the Exams and Papers if you study the material and pay attention during lectures you will be fine! Dr. Love is an amazing lecturer. She is hilarious to anyone with a darker sense of humor and has crazy stories from her line of work that really make the class. Honestly love her as a person and professor!

Dr. Love is great! She's really funny and also has alot of hands on experience and super cool stories from working as a forensic psychologist. The class is graded on multiple choice exams. If you use the book online resources and take the practice quizzes and got through the flash cards you'll be in a really good place for exams. Def recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She's funny and sarcastic, and I think people just think she's mean because they don't have a sense of humor. I have NO idea why people think this class is easy. Her quizzes were hard as hell because they always had questions about random statistics never mentioned and like every sentence in the textbook is a fact. I'd take her again though!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: She is very nice and very understanding! I went to class and liked her a lot. She's very funny and if you study a lot for the quizzes you'll do well. Beware: The textbook sucks ASS whoever wrote it is the worst. Also, she doesn't respond to emails so text her if you really need something. I'd take her again!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. love is the homie. She is super funny in class and I love hearing about all her sketchy and entertaining stories from her job! The class essay is graded SUPER easy so don't stress. Attendance is mandatory but she often lets you out early! She's a bit intimidating sometimes but is truly a sweet and considerate woman! 10/10 would recommend

Shes so funny. Every single lecture was a delight, and the tests werent anything that you couldnt find in the book. Im surprised her ratings so low. Shes super sarcastic, but not at all mean. Really easy, fun experience, no complaints.

Intentionally misleads her students. Exams full of random factoids straight from the textbook that she never talks about in class. Then she said the final exam would only cover 2 chapters-a third of it had questions from chapters we were not supposed to be responsible for, and she blamed the students for "clearly not studying enough." A joke.

Interesting. The class is most PowerPoint and the test aren't that hard. You get your scores back but you never get to see your actually test. She can be very  vague, but manageable. Don't try emailing her, just text her; you get a quicker response even though its weird. .You tend to get get out of class early, so that is nice.

Loved her class, definitely one of my favorite at SMU. Her lectures were interesting even though they were 3 hours long. Exams are not hard at all. Study PowerPoints, and when she mentions the "hints" you better memorize them in detail. Oh.. study vocab as well!

Great teacher. She still works as a forensic psychologist and she has some great stories. She uses a lot of personal anecdotes. Her tests are super straight forward and pretty easy. Curves tests too. One mandatory assignment to go downtown to watch a real trial - really fun and easy grade (gives you 100% if you follow her length guidelines)

took STAT 3304! - Quite difficult for those who have never coded before (i did this for my psych bs requirement). I went to the ALEC and office hours multiple times a week. He speaks softly and has an accent so I didn't really learn much during class. Chat GPT can be helpful but in person help is the best IMO. The 2 tests were of medium difficulty.

Such a kind professor! He really cares about his students doing well and he is so sweet. He's willing to help with anything and I definitely suggest going to office hours if you are struggling because he is a huge help. Love him
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Sun's class! He is a super kind and caring professor, only negatives are that he reads off slides in class, and he talks really quietly sometimes, so it can be difficult to hear him. Grades: 2 homework assignments per chapter (easy, answers are all online), labs (easy, done with TA), exams (open notes + very similar to practice exams)

If you can't get Wickersham, Sun is your best bet at getting a decent grade. He isn't great at lecturing but compensates for it with generous extra credit added to each exam, but you MUST attend lecture.

Professor Sun is possibly one of the best stats professors. The class is difficult and he teaches from a slideshow, it is possible to do well with minimal work. Do all homework assignments and see him outside of class a few times-he is very lenient with grading. Lots of extra credit opportunities just by showing up! Cheat sheets on all exams!

Really nice guy, but the class being in a lec hall with a mic made it hard to understand him a lot of the time. This, on top of the lectures being boring, made the class feel particularly long. That being said, he is definitely one of the easier stats profs. Multi attemps on HW's and tons of bonus pts on each exam. Lowest exam grade dropped too.

A little challenging to understand at times but was very forgiving with grading. Home works had multiple attempts allowed and each attempt gave automatic feedback that would guide your work. He gave opportunities for extra credit and incentivized going to class. The class is heavy in excel so be prepared for that.
Nice man. Busy work for sure but if gives lots of chances to do well
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Sun knows WAY too much to be teaching an intro stats class. Most people were there to satisfy the credit, and our exam averages were really bad. Thankfully, he provided extra credit opportunities and gave feedback on incorrect questions. Take him only if you know Excel and if taking another section would be bad for your schedule!
Tbh hes not to bad his classes aren't very intersting so not his fault. If u try rly hard on the exams and go get help if you need hes very understanding. Show him curtosy and hell do the same for u

The professor wants the students to succeed, unfortunately, the way he teaches is very confusing. I even attended office hours and only partly understood what he tried to explain because he didn't know how to demonstrate it. His assignments are fairly easy due to the helpful notes he adds after your first try attempting it and that's what helped me
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Do NOT take this professor!! He does not know how to teach, and you will get lost in class! Nobody knew what he was teaching and his lectures made no sense. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Instead of modeling collegial respect or intellectual humility, this professor seemed to foster a classroom hierarchy built on false attempted (poorly) charm and favoritism. The way power was used, subtly but unmistakably, left a lot of us questioning the integrity of the environment

If you enjoy history, this class is for you. 4 Analytical essays over books read outside of class. 2 exams with essays within them. I recommend being a strong writer and showing up to class bc her slides don't have much. She can be passive aggressive but manageable in class; you only see her twice weekly. Drew B, her TA is great.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ruthless class and professor as she will leave you in the dust if you get behind because of lack help. Class far too difficult for an elective, a ton of reading and note taking. When you ask questions, she is blatantly rude to you, and that's if you even get an answer at all. Try all you want, don't be surprised when you still fail.

Instructor is incredibly difficult to deal with. Jill holds no substantive class plan, has no interest in hearing other opinions, and performs no set method for grading. It is near impossible to please unless you align completely with the extreme and unnatural beliefs she expresses in class as her platform of "knowledge". Hostile class environment.

Dr. Kelly is one of those professors who clearly LOVES teaching. She is very invested in her areas of study, and you can tell that she genuinely cares about her students understanding the material. She assigns a lot of reading and a few papers, but she is extremely helpful and understanding if you have any questions or worries.

Dr. Kelly is a tough grader, she doesnt really give higher than 95s on essays. But, she does care about her students and if you take the time to show that you care, it will pay off. There is a lot of reading but you can get away with not doing it if you are smart and cleaver about it. Take good notes in her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I know all of the reviews for this teacher are somewhat decent but DON'T LISTEN TO THEM. I am just trying to save you from one of the worst classes you will ever take at SMU. She is completely unfair, gives random pop quizzes that can alter your grade to a point where there's no coming back, and she is not helpful at all in office hours! Don't take

You have to do A LOT of reading so if you dont like reading dont take the class. Aside from that it was a pretty good class. You just have to write 2 5-7 page essays and write good notes for exams. This class isnt for people who skip regularly or do not like reading or writing
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Kelly is nice and accessible outside of her class. Attendance and participation definitely matters, but she definitely cares about her students' well-being. It was a good bit of reading that you need to do in order to participate in the discussions and to do better on the papers. Her exams are pretty specific but I would take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor, had her for two semesters, very knowledgeable and lectures are interesting. You will learn a lot. Effort required, but its not difficult.

Professor Kelly is very nice and overall a good professor. Her class requires lots of reading and the lectures can be boring, but her nice personality makes them bearable. There are only a couple of papers and tests (all short answer). She has an extra credit opportunity and is a pretty fair grader. Not a blow off class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Kelly is the best! I really enjoyed her class so much, that I am taking her again next semester. She requires a lot of reading but it is all helpful information that will be good resources and material to cite on tests. She is super nice and always willing to help students. She definitely wants to see students succeed. I would take this class!

DR. KELLY IS THE BEST! I definitely recommend you take her. She is super sweet. Very helpful. Her class requires you to do work and lots of reading but you learn a lot in this class. I am taking her again next semester. She is super nice and willing to help students learn and reach their highest potential. Definitely one of my favorite professors.
Very helpful and knowledgeable professor. Outlines material to make it crystal clear for you and it is easy to do well if you come to class and participate.  Very helpful in office hours as well.
His tests are so r word

This class is primarily based on the four tests given. No final, no quizzes. 30% is an attendance based booster. Test questions are MC and TF but they are worded weirdly and decently hard. Very nice prof though
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His tests are ridiculous and he's confusing in his lectures. Doesn't give good information to help you test well and makes constant mistakes. He's also very rude when you ask questions. Horrible.

Not an easy A and confusing concepts. Really have to listen and study and UNDERSTAND content. Tests being open note saves u from memorizing a million terms and facts but still HAVE TO STUDY as test questions really test ur understanding and nuanced topics in lecture. Not an easy A if thats a course you are looking for tests are not easy either.

Most overrated professor at this school and has an ego the size of Texas. Makes tests harder than they need to be, a very untalented lecturer who drones in and on. Sad life when you go nowhere from your college days.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Engaging professor that cares about his students. Exams can be challenging and have nuances but you will be fine as long as you pay attention to his lectures and take notes. Not the easy A that people make it out to be but no homework and not an impossible class by any means. I recommend going in for office hours after the first essay

Definitely take Chester for Blaw!! Only complaint is that his essay criteria and grading seemed dicey at times. The MC tests only get easier after the first one and you're allowed to miss 5 classes!
