His classes have an extreme amount of work (e. readings, essays) but I've definitely learned a lot and have improved my writing skills. Don't take his class if you're not willing to put in work because you WILL do poorly, no debate. He's a cool guy if you get to know him
One of the greatest professors I have had. He is passionate about the material and really cares about his students learning. A very nice guy but be prepared to put in the work. You will learn A LOT
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Am I glad this class is over because it was so hard? Yes. Was it 100% worth it? That is a definite yes! This class is so difficult yet you really do learn a lot. Be prepared to put in the work and you will befriend a brilliant and hilarious professor that wants to help you succeed. Do all readings and take lots of notes. Always come to class!

If you're thinking of taking Dr. Kobylka's class, DO IT! Take good lecture notes, go to office hours, READ, and you'll be able to respond to the essay questions (not prompts) well. Midterm and Final are challenging. Dr. Kobylka is an awesome professor and you'll definitely end the semester a better writer and a more prepared student!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Got my butt kicked by him but I will continue to take his classes because he cares about his students and is an all around cool dude.

Way too difficult for an intro class. Lots of small feedback on papers but doesn't help you write any better. Essay "questions" not prompts are incredibly vague. Office hours helps marginally. Expect to take amazing notes and remember minute points he mentions just once. Overall, loved Kobylka and the class. Did not like the assignments or grades.

Professor Kobylka is the rare breed of professor that leaves an impression with you for a very long time. His depth of knowledge and ability to give engaging lectures make this class exceptional. It is extremely hard, but Professor Kobylka genuinely cares about the success of his students, so long as they put their total effort into his class.

Kobylka is an awesome guy. His lectures are entertaining and you can really tell that he's passionate about what he teaches. That being said, he expects you to have that same passion, which is reflected in the heavy reading/case load, and he's an extremely harsh grader. This might be the hardest you'll ever have to work to earn a B, let alone an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Kobylka seemed very nice and caring at the beginning of the semester, before you begin to do actual work. Then pop quizzes start and the nearly impossible essays which he assigns. The expectations that he has for the course are that of a graduate level professor at the minimum. Avg grade received in his classes has to be B-, C+ if that.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Joe will rip you to shreds on papers, often writing "NO" alongside your writing to really underscore the fact that you're intellectually inferior to him. Joe truly deserves to be this tough - he's an expert on all things USSC related. However, the amount of work he demands is staggering. He upped the case load to 130 (2017) from 50 (2015).
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Kobylka is a cool guy: His anecdotes are entertaining, his jokes are amusing, and his expertise is admirable, but his cool factor ends there. You will be expected to demonstrate a broad comprehension of every case you touch, especially when it comes to papers. Every assignment is demanding and writing-heavy. A's are the exception, not the rule.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Kobylka is such a gem. So many funny stories and examples that makes learning fun and easy. He grades hard on the three essays and the tests but the material itself isn't too challenging. He wants to get to know his students and even invites them over to his house at the end of the year. Really approachable guy. Go to office hours!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Probably the hardest liberal arts class I have ever taken and ever will take but so rewarding. He is gold in lectures--so funny! Lots of reading and writing. My best advice for papers is to make sure you're understanding what he said in lecture and putting that into your own words (i.e. write what he said in lecture). He cares so go to his OH!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: What every liberal arts professor should strive to be. There's a stigma around campus about the difficulty of his courses but he's very reasonable. If you put in the work, you'll be rewarded.  Learned more in one semester than I did in all my other classes. Very understanding during office hours. A necessity polisci students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Kobylka is one of the most brilliant people I have met in my life, and is absolutely engaging in lectures. A very complex individual. Take his class, but be prepared because I guarantee that his course will be the hardest of your life. You have to read volumes, but if you go into office hours and care he will have your back. So rewarding

The man knows his stuff. He makes you earn your grade. Do not be late; he will grill you for it. You'll do around 50 case briefs, one brief to present to the class, a research paper, and then the midterm and final. The briefs are fairly simple, but the exams are essay driven. To sum it up, just get ready to work. Loved his class. You will learn.

So you have heard the rumors? They are true. Dr. Kobylka will kick your butt, but that is OK. If you don't take Kobylka at least once, then that is a disservice to yourself. Case briefs will take a colossal amount of time, but it must be done if you stand any chance in his class. Dr. Kobylka thrives on student participation. Give him what he wants
Into it. Tough. Fair. Fun for the most part.

He is a great Professor. He is always willing to help you, you just have to ask for it. He is brilliant! If you not interested in poli sci I would not take him, but if you are, take him as much as you can. Also be prepared to work hard!

Joe is the man. That is all. Get ready to actually work and prepare for class. He will hold you accountable. If he catches you unprepared he will let you know about it. If you show him that you're not there to screw around, he's a great guy. If show otherwise, his classes will be your worst nightmare. Best professor I've ever had.
Was he a difficult professor? Yes. Impossible? No. You will learn so much if you just suck it up and take his class.

Very knowledgeable, good teacher who will prepare you for polisci. However, I do not recommend taking this class. WAY too difficult for intro class. It is supposed to introduce subject and get people interested, not weed off those who he does not seem fit. Don't follow other comments about him, it's clear he is writing comments here himself.

Do not take this class if you have to take any other classes or work. He is a great teacher but does not understand that he is not your only class. He is at time very rude and condescending making it hard to be serious and meet with him. Unless you have 100% of your time to devote to this class do not take it.

If you are up for the challenge you will find that Professor Kobylka is the absolute best professor at SMU. Every lecture is interesting and he is EXTREMELY helpful outside of class. Many people find him intimidating, but in reality he is one of the most genuine and caring professors/people that you will ever encounter.
Very interesting class! If you are a Political Science major I would extremely recommend taking this class! Yes, there is work and reading but you learn tons and it is a great class.

Kobylka is awesome. He has office hours that he keeps consistently, and is very helpful. This course is not easy, but he lays out everything you need to know. The only way to succeed in this course is to read absolutely everything he assigns, and take really good notes over the reading and lectures.
Great professor. Always willing to help and explain if you  go to office hours.
Great professor and smart guy. You will learn alot if you put in the time. Not a class for an easy A hard grader and expects you to put in as much work as senior level courses.

This man is a genius. Yes you do have to work hard but it is worth it in the end.  I got more out of this class than any other class I've had thus far--read, read, read, and go to office hours like crazy. He is very receptive to students who show interest and effort. Best lecturer I've had as well. Not a fan of greek life.

I read/did more homework in this class than all my other classes combined. Studied 3 days for the final and still only made a B. Absolutely rediculous. Good luck, but if your trying to keep your GPA high rather than deal with some self-inflated man looking to make an Intro to American Government class difficult do not enroll.

I learned more in this class than all of my other classes combined this semester. The material is fascinating, but it requires you to really think. Kobylka has high expectations for his students, but is extremely encouraging and appreciative of those that work hard. Don?t be afraid to take his class. It?s an experience every student should have!

He is a great professor.  He pushes and demands much out of his students.  The workload in the class is honestly quite ridiculous.  But, you will take more out of his class than most professors.  Work hard, very hard, and you can make an A.  But you have to be on top of everything and put in hours of time.

This is the man who convinced me to be a poly sci major. He is an incredibly skilled professor, who keeps the classes entertaining, while at the same time incredibly informative. He is a hard ass though, he has no tolerance for lateness or skipping, and, at least in my class, mocked a student who was frequently skipping. Best professor I've had yet

Was not a PLSC major and took this class blind. Came out wanting to minor in it. I may not have gotten a high grade, btu it was worth every minute, even the agonizing paper. He's amazing and if I can, I would love to take his class again. Be prepared to do the work. "It's like an actual college class." And it's amazing!

Had a bad attitude half of the time and a good one the next...very moody. Picks his favorites early as well as the ones he doesn't like...and DONT WEAR GREEK T-SHIRTS! Unless you are a polysci major...don't do ittt

went into Kobylka's class unsure whether to major in plsc and came out it determined to be a poli sci major. he demands a lot of work, but if you do your work and show effort, it pays off. one of the only classes that I felt like my tuition money was worth every penny.

The most intellectually stimulating class I have taken. Kobylka teaches through wit and discussion. He brings the material to life. Its one of a few classes where I felt I got my moneys worth. He will challenge you, so be prepared. I would suggest reading the text book twice before the mid-term.

It's a love/hate relationship while you're in Kobylka's class. Love, because he is a great, witty teacher who loves to quote Bork ("I think it would be an intellectual feast just to be there..."). Love, because his class is intellectually stimulating. Love, because he isn't a stodgy curmudgeon. Hate, because he isn't afraid to assign a lot of work.

Highly knowledgeable about the subjects he teaches.  A bit intimidating, he is a no-B.S., head on guy, and won't give you an inch of wiggle room.  Teaches very challenging and difficult courses, and class is entertaining due to his sarcastic, yet highly smug attempts at humor.

I love the audacity of the previous comments.  Apparently this person has insider knowledge of the poli sci dept. Well, let me let you know that if you went to class and did the work, your comments might be slightly more complimentary.  He is helpful if you ask him to be, smarter than you'll ever be, and oh yes... he IS king.

Not only is this guy one of the most hypocritical men I have ever met, the majority of the professors in the Poli Sci dept. dislike him as well. All the comments that say he is a great professor, the guy recites the same information every semester lets not pat him on the back. Overall he is condescent, smug, and thinks for some reason he is king.

He is not very helpful outside the classroom. He will email you back right away while poking at your intelligence level. Not flexible to meet outside office hours. He is a very tough grader, while the grading is hard it seems rather arbitrary. If you get on his good side you should be fine however be warned he has preconceived notions of students
One of the best professors at SMU but class is pretty hard.  He expects a lot from his students and has a fairly heavy workload.
Probably my favorite professor at SMU.  Very entertaining.  If you can get him to like you he will be one of your best contacts in the school.  Be prepared to work.
Great guy.  Very hard, but worth it.  He was my first PLSC prof and was the one who got me into it.  Very funny.  His class will help you in law school if that is your plan.

Look - anyone who says Kobylka is "too hard" has either (1) never had him or (2) needs to stop slacking off. He's one of the best few instructors in the entire university, and anyone who has had him knows this. Don't chicken out - accept the challenge and work hard. Taking Kobylka will pay serious dividends in grad school.
great professor hard as hell ti get a decent grade
The greatest professor I've ever had.
Very challenging, but well worth the extra work.
Fabulous
it is very difficult to get a decent grade in his class. very very difficult. that said he is very intelligent, his classes are interesting and fun
No Comments
Love him! He makes you work hard, but it's rewarding. I am in law school now and his class is one that will prepare you for the work ahead of you (if you plan on getting your JD).

Kobylka is brilliant & very funny in class. He is not the professor to take if you are looking for an easy A, but if you are really interested in learning the material, I definitley recommend taking him. Great guy, very funny-sucks that the Green Elephant is closed, Kobylka loved that place.

Truthfully the hardest class I have ever taken in my life. Really confusing lectures on top of that and an EXTREMELY HARSH GRADER. The layout of the class with the midterm and the final being weighted so heavy makes it even harder. He is a nice person outside of class, but a really tough professor. If you can plz avoid.

AVOID!! do not take him he is so bad. He has a big curve but his lectures are awful. I don't understand anything and his office hours are just as bad. He has hw every week that you have to turn in in person and he doesn't give u the answers he says to use chatgpt and theres a quiz every week. Do not take hes awful
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: take another proff. really hard

Prof is super kind and helpful outside of class. Lectures are super heavy and confusing at times. Overall, the class is simple, just intro to stats on steroids. He is willing to accept feedback and he will incorporate what he thinks will help. Read the textbook! It helps a lot. Exam questions are out of the textbook and so are HW problems.

The class structure is tough, the midterm and final are 70% of your grade. He also subtracts 0.6% from your final grade every time you miss class. He is an incredibly nice person but a harsh grader and an awful lecturer. He uses proofs mostly and makes the work incomprehensible. He also doesn't understand a lot about grading.

Extremely challenging class, I would recommend taking another professor. I'd say this is the hardest class I have taken at SMU. Dr. Jurek is a nice guy, but unfortunately not a great professor. He is new to teaching so hopefully he will improve following the feedback he receives.

The professor is just starting out, so I assume he is learning and will do better in the future. However, right now, I think there's a lot of room for improvement. Thankfully, he curves his tests, because the problems are extremely difficult, and I don't believe he prepares us for them very well. He seems like a nice guy though.
She's very sweet and is willing to help if you ask. The grading can be inconsistent or unclear, but as long as you follow instructions you should be fine.
Great professor. Very flexible and fun classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Teaching style is chaotic, office hours were a trap, grades came with zero rationale, and acted annoyed you were even enrolled.
Took her for JOUR2312 and she's the best!!!

She picked on me out all semester—others noticed. She calls out students for not focusing even when lectures don't align with assignments. For a 1000-level course, it felt like high school, with a heavy workload and unclear, often conflicting directions. Grading was inconsistent. Overall, very stressful and hard to navigate. Would not recommend.
For JOUR 2312*** Great professor I would def take again. She made the class super interesting and interactive. Some assignments are a little annoying but you learn from them.
Grades fairly, very kind and understanding. Lectures are pretty engaging.
Her notes are super easy and the tests are identical versions of the practice test and tophat practices

She can be whiny sometimes, but she cares about you. MEMORIZE THE STUDY GUIDES because the test questions are mostly identical. You still need to know how to do the math because thats open ended, though. Attendance isn't graded, but there are in-class assignments that you can't make up if you skip class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very nice, she assigns easy notes that you have to print out and bring to class. She doesn't care about attendance but it does get confusing if you miss class and don't have a friend who has the notes. The exams are very similar to the practice exams. She does a good job of relating course content to the real world.

Lectures are so boring and she is very particular about everything. But, she's better than the other 2 professors for this course and she gives LOTS of extra credit at the end of the semester. 3 exams and an optional final. Lowest grade of the 4 exams is dropped.
It's a bird course for sure but the professor is a lot to tolerate.

The tests are exactly like the practice exams that she gives on canvas and tophat. Id say she wasnt a good professor because we just filled in the lecture notes and I kind of had to teach myself, however it was very easy. I recomend printing lecture notes before each class, makes it easier to study. Dont have to take final if u like ur grade before
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy class with simple concepts. She can definitely talk and sometimes over-explains simple directions. If you can get through lectures and do well on the first exams, you won't have to take the final exam since she drops one test. If you don't like being treated like an elementary schooler, avoid. If you just want an easy class it's chill
So eat just listen In class and you will be fine, also the test are just like the practice exams and the hw quetions.

A lot of people complain about her as a bad teacher but she was helpful, I will say she is a bit of an oldhead but the tests are exactly what she says they are, no trips nothing. You read the textbook and can get extra credit up to a grade point. I will say the material can be difficult but if you read (optional) it really helps

Easy ECON class. Test are exactly like practice tests. Notes are fill-in-the-blank style and she gives you the answers in class. She does love to talk so sometimes can be boring. Attendance isn't mandatory but if you go to class you will have all of the answers you need. Pay attention to hw due dates tho. Super sweet teacher and would def recommend

no powerpoint or digital format for notes, so you have to show up to class and take notes in real time. other than that shes a great teacher, content is very clear, she makes it easy and gives you lots of opportunities for extra credit, easiest econ class ever

She's a very old school teacher. She's not an awful teacher but she's not the best either. She doesn't do any extra credit activities which is frustrating because I know a lot of people were struggling and the top hat activities dont even help your grade. Like you just have to fight battles to pass the danm exams
She would spend class ranting about other students, so just show up and pay attention to her.

She's kind of a mid professor. Her lectures are boring as it follows the boring notes. She wants you to print out notes for each chapter and bring them to class which can get annoying. She also kind of crazy and can be rude towards the class often. However she's still probably the best professor for this class.
She does an awful job of instructing and never holds office hours

Although I attended every class this semester, I still did not enjoy her teaching methods. It's 100% a lecture where you copy down very outdated notes. She gives pop quizzes or take home quizzes, however never puts them on canvas and if you forget to bring it to class its an automatic 0. She is extremely rude in class and over email. Do not take.

I found her to be really rude and out of touch with cure t teaching trends. Treats us like middle schoolers with worksheet notes then won't help you fill them in. Attendance required even though it's a slog to get through one lecture with this burdensome rudeness.
Show up and you get extra credit. Studying for exams is going to class and taking the notes. Doing the study guide and the top hat really prepare you for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Talks in circles rather than teaches but she at least tries. Not a bad person just a bad teacher. Better option than the two cox blockers (M&T) so long as you don't die of boredom. Won't learn anything but that's all economic at this school is like.

Don't know how she's even a professor with her lack of knowledge.SOOOOO boring. i cant emphasize that ENOUGH. take another teacher if possible. it wasnt THAT hard as it was BORING. just avoid it, ppl were falling asleep all around me ALL the time in class including me.

Prof. Battaglia can seem to talk about unrelated topics but if you show up to class every day and follow along, her stories are actually helpful in understanding the material. She assigns work far in advance and gives pop quizzes sometimes but they're more meant to help people who go to class rather than test you on anything hard (open note a lot)
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: JUST GO TO CLASS. Loved her & teaches material well. So much extra credit by just showing up to class. Lets u drop your lowest test grade. Provides a practice test before any exam that is A LOT like the real exam so just make sure you can understand the practice exam and you will do well! Class is not hard and SO MUCH extra credit offered.

Most people that complain about her just don't show up to class. She's a great professor who teaches the material in depth. She values attendance A LOT. If you're in every, or even most classes, she'll notice, and will gives tons of bonus and extra credit points. She gives quizzes in class sometimes but they're all open note and super easy.
You won't fail but you won't do well either. She was a smart teacher, unfortunately she was less than helpful, only self interested, and her tests are on only the most obscure of topics.
She is a good professor, the class is graded on a different scale. A C would be a 64, it is almost impossible not to pass if you just go to class.

Just AWFUL, her personality is all over the place and she can go from "understanding" to pissed off in one second flat if someone asks the wrong question she doesn't want to stop her lectures for. Teaches like we're in high school and will wait until you stop talking to continue ("are you finished?") but material is never covered that you need.

She teaches like high school econ but way less effectively. Who hires these econ profs? how much we pay to go here and how poor our teachers are. She couldn't be bothered to respond to emails or be in office hours but could count off points for answers we had actually correct. She should count herself out and go somewhere else.

You have to KNOW EVERYTHING just to be tested on some random factoids of the material. Unfortunately, you have no choice but to take one of these bad econ intro profs. She's very lecture heavy and tests are way harder if we do well the first time and shes making things more difficult. Instead of getting rewarded we get punished.

Kari shows minimal expertise in the subject and has an off-putting attitude. Demeanor in class is so unfriendly and uses a sense of humor that is rude and inappropriately targeted toward students. Yells at students during class for not paying attention, really disruptive for the students that are actually trying to. Needs to retire.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This was hands-down the absolute worst course I have ever taken by the rudest, least available, least helpful, and worst profs I have ever had the displeasure of meeting. Do not take any classes with her. Cannot teach, doesn't not care to know how to. Blatantly rude to students, cruel in comments when questions are asked, wish I could give a 0.

Battaglia is an organized teacher, though it absolutely requires that you go to her lectures. However, if you go to lecture, she gives you free 100's, test answers, etc. She went through a lot but was professional. Her tests are super easy, multiple choice or fill in the blanks. If you go to class, there's no way you'll not get an A.

I took this class thinking it would be taught by a stellar teacher after looking at rate my professor and boy was I wrong. She is so much tougher than is misrepresented on here and is a terrible lecturer and everyone I know agrees so I don't know who's liking her. Disorganized, rude, and not effective at presenting the concepts. SO bad...

Disrespectful and a bad person. Does not seem to care if students do well. Hard to reach and a poor communicator. I believe the current average grade is failing. Many student had to drop the class. I would not ever choose to take this class again.

Kind of a nutty lady; her analogies and lectures often go off into left field and make no sense...The material is straightforward and tests are very managable. Attendance is not manadatory, but beware of weekly pop quizzes on Wednesdays. Print out the note outlines to use or she solves them in class. 3 exams and a final, drop the lowest.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She's a great professor, highly recommend for econ. She can go on different tangent while speaking, which can be distracting when you're listening to fill in the notes. Can get a little frazzled and act a bit zany. Practice exams are exactly like the test. Just beware of pop quizzes when audience participation is low.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Amazing professor!! Take her for econ!

Very easy class. Notes are fill-in-the-blank, and she lectures all of the class (class can be boring but also easy to follow without actually listening). Tests are just like practice exams. Not too much work out of class and she drops several assignments at the end of the semester. Rarely paid attention in class and made an A. Take her!!

The class was painfully boring, you fill in her notes online as she writes word for word. The lectures seemed like they lasted 3 hours when it was only a 50-minute lecture. The work outside of class was easy and the practice test really prepares you for the actual exam.

This is a really boring class, but it is also one of the easier classes most people will take in college, so she's definitely worth taking. You do need to be in class though because she will give pop quizzes, but they are very easy and based purely on the notes. Exams are almost identical to the practice ones.

This professor is excellent at teaching. She explains concepts very well and makes them easy to understand. She does take attendance most days, but going to class is beneficial as she drops bonus questions throughout her lectures. If you plan on taking Macroeconomics, I would highly recommend choosing her.

Professor Battaglia was great overall. Be ready to show up to class, there's days where she will give pop quizzes and if you are not there without a valid excuse then it's a zero. She gives extra credit on tests which help at the end of the year. Clearly very passionate and knowledgable about macroeconomics which made long-winded lectures bearable.

do not like her as a person, but class isn't the worst. she lectures with note outlines, but often talks about irrelevant and useless stuff at random times. gives bonus questions and practice exam and does review. drops a lot of low grades and final is optional. 50 min lecture is hard to sit through though and her voice causes pain sometimes
classes is very lecture-heavy. she is somewhat hard of hearing so she would pause and make up cases of people talking.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Boring lecturer but easy class if you can get through her talking. Everyone takes her and like her because compared to the other econ profs shes alright, but for those of us who have to learn the material for later on, it is a complete waste of time. High school level material taught like you're a fifth grader. Its econ for the dumb.

I'm terrible at econ but if I had to take another econ class and Battaglia was an option, I'd take her class. She's easy to understand and practically gives you the test answers. Test reviews are basically the actual tests. If you talk to her outside of class she is super nice and fun to talk to. I'd recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very easy overall. Classes consists of lectures and guided notes. Prof is passionate and dedicated, making lectures to be engaging. Exams are all multiple choice and very similar to practice test, HW, quizzes. Lots of bonus points. Did not learn as much as I hoped due to how simple the topics were.

BEST PROFESSOR AT SMU!!!! She makes the class soooo easy to be successful. Just show up and she will give you the answers to pop quizzes, otherwise if you don't go you will get a zero. All the material is easily digestible because she makes it that way. She is seriously the best! I would take her class over and over again! Couldn't recommend more!
GOAT

Battaglia is an amazing lecturer, and is very knowledgeable about her subject matter. There are 4 exams including the final but she lets you drop the lowest grade. Attendance is not mandatory, but she frequently rewards extra credit points for showing up to class. The quizzes and homework are super easy, and you get lots of time to do everything.

I took her for 1312** The grading criteria are very clear. There are no surprises on the exams, but get ready to study if you want to get an A. 75% of the grade are exams. STUDY THE NOTES. Also make sure to attend class, because sometimes you'll get extra points on exams if you do. Great professor, hope SMU hires her full-time!

Kari was a likable prof, and well respected among my classmates. Her syllabus is very clear, and her notes and lectures were helpful. there was no attendance policy, and the class was really "get what you put in" ..  would take again

I would 100% recommend taking her class for Econ. She knows so much and her lectures are very clear and easy to follow. I had a C in micro and I have an A in macro. All of the chapters have guided notes that you can fill in and she is so knowledgable. Attendance isn't mandatory but she has given students extra points for showing up to class!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Overall a really great person as well as teacher. Econ teachers at SMU have a bad rep, but Kari Battaglia does not fit it. She is funny and cares about her students. If you frequently go to her office hours, she may help you out with grades. Make sure to read the online textbook and an A will be within reach.

This prof is the way to go for econ at SMU. Her notes are very helpful, she literally provides fill in the blank notes for you in class. Her tests are just like the practice tests, she occasionally gives quizzes and only a few are pop quizzes. Overall, super nice lady who wants the best for her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Top professor who actually cares for her students and makes the course really interesting and interactive. Not an easy course or anything but just an all around great professor.
Dr. Sutton is incredible!

Took her Jan Term in Taos and it was hands down one of my favorite SMU experiences. Five CCs in 10 days, volunteering with local non-profits and super collaborative assignments. We still had time to explore and got really close as a group. The final was a ping pong tourney against her. She is the sweetest. Take her.

The most enthusiastic professor at SMU and by far the most caring! Difficult course if you aren't familiar with the topics and easy to get distracted by her sillyness but she seriously wants to help students succeed. She gives random points for stuff like football wins and genuinely the class felt like a family at the end of the semester!

Very enthusiastic and caring professor, to the point I didn't mind coming to 8 am lecture. She clearly cares about the subject. 4 quizzes with the lowest one dropped, 3 exams, 1 mini-presentation and 1 5 minute presentation. Exams require understanding and not just memorization - you'll have to put in some work but she's a delight!

Very sweet and caring professor, tough subject but she makes it bearable and fun. Wish she taught the other sociology classes I need. Study guides, slides, practice questions, and Canvas materials are very helpful.

I'm not good in school but this is the first time in my life I've been excited to go to class excited to hear her how she views the world. Treats us like she respects us. I leave her class genuinely uplifted and in a better mood. She is the most moving professor I've ever had. If you want your tuition to feel worth it, take her class.

She is the very best professor. I have taken her for 4 out of the 5 semesters I have had so far at SMU. She is the sweetest and most exciting professor I have ever had. The courses can be challenging, but she makes it fun!

I took Sutton for 3 classes as a nonmajor you have to work HARD to earn a good grade. But the experience is worth it. she puts in 10 X the effort of other professors and makes class fun. Go to lectures take notes and you don't have to read. Shes tough, fair, high quality and will help if you show effort Would take her 1000 X

Took her in Taos for Nonprofits and Community. One of the kindest most supportive professors I've had. Not only a great person but she also deeply cares about her students and future success. I can't recommend her enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: My big take away is you want Kara Sutton as your professor. Breadths are hard no matter which professor you get, you are going to have to study and put in a decent about of time. However, Sutton has great lectures and covers the content really well. She is also super accessible outside of the classroom
best prof on campus, love her so much!

I can't put into words how much I loved this professor. Took it for my minor but it ended up being one of my all time favorite courses and professor. She is amazing lecturer, and she is super passionate and knowledgeable. If you put effort in the class, you will get an A.

Such a sweet lady. Different types of quizzes with two dropped and one group quiz. Tests were hard and need to grasp more of the concepts rather than definitions, which is annoying. She's really passionate about what she teaches. As long as you attend class, take notes, etc. it is relatively easy. Super nice and enthusiastic which makes it fun.
The most memorable professors I had, expects effort and gives the same tenfold.

She is a fantastic professor who genuinely invests in her students and brings enthusiasm to every interaction. Her lectures are useful and uses her own professional experience and she goes out of her way to help students who are struggling and rewards those who put in the work.

She is very smart and I wish she would dumb things down a little. That said, she's the most impactful professor I have had at smu, she really listens and tries to get to know you and will respond within hours when and would take again but you need to study to do well

Absolutely love professor Sutton! She is so sweet and I would definitely take another class with her! She gives such good feedback on assignments and is super encouraging! She lets you opt out of attendance, and presentations. You do have to put in the work though since tests are somewhat difficult. She does curve tests though!

I really like Sutton, very cut and dry expectations. She doesn't put up with BS. Detailed study guide for each test and example problems with her review games and were fun. Show up to class, take notes, study a few days before each test. 2 tests, in class writing prompts, quizzes, and attendance. Final isn't cumulative. Easily 5/5 prof

Attend lectures, it'll save you tons of time studying later. Make use of her office hours. Most caring professor I've ever had. Her office hours are always packed.  I hope that I can take another class with her in the future.

Such a sweet woman who cares deeply for the success of her students. You have to pay attention in class. Her tests are very high level conceptually so if you dont understand every aspect of the material you wont do well. That said, it is super straightforward if you study what she covers. Very accessible, curves grades and is very smart and caring.
Absolutely hate this class. Bane of my existence

Anyone saying anything negative just doesnt have the mental capability of being in college. This is the most transparent teacher at SMU. You know right away what you need to know for everything. And on top of being a great teacher, just a cool person too. I dont fw reading like that, but just because of how cool she was, i put in some effort.

SOCI 3360 isn't an easy class. Professor Sutton however is a fabulous professor. She cares about her students and works to understand why we did poorly on tests. She gave me a 110/100 on my final participation because I tanked the final and my grade would have gone down. I'm so jealous of anyone who still has the opportunity to take her class.

If you need the cc credit take her! Class everyday but not mandatory though participation helps your grade a ton 110%, and the reading isn't bad. Multiple types of quizzes, 2 exams, no hw, she gives study guides. If you pay attention and go to class, you get an A.

This professor literally helped me so much through the semester. The class is hard but I worked even harder and she bumped my grade at the end. If you put in the work you will do well. She is no bs so don't expect anything. She cares for her students and rewards hard work.

While this class requires a bit of effort, it is amazing and worth your time. I have learned so much about different legal theories and my perspective on society and sociology has changed. There are 3 tests, 4 short response quizzes, two presentations. Overall a great class.
She's amazing! Cares about students deeply and will do what it takes to give you a better grade. Lectures have lots of material so it would be good to attend lectures but not required

Great class and amazing professor. She's extremely caring, and understands that we have busy schedules. Her office door is always open, and she never has a bad day. Her tests were just like the reviews, and the quizzes weren't too hard.
Could not ask for a better professor

Look at me, TAKE HER CLASS. Shes hilarious, you don't need to read if you pay attention in class, she reminds you about things long before they come up. She geniunely cares about you, she let me take my final early because of a family issue and it was no problem. Just take her class! She makes every lecture engaging and hilarious

Prof Sutton is seriously the kindest soul I have ever met, was a breath of fresh air every morning!! I don't really know why there are any ratings below 5. She is EXTREMELY considerate. Obviously you still need to work for an A, but it's possible. Even if you have no interest in socio, I would recommend taking her just for her personality.

Your grade comes from assignments that require you to read or pay attention in class to do well, incredibly undoable. Her lectures and tests are a linguistic labyrinth requiring you to know words. Words are hard. This is college, not a library.

Your grade comes from 4 quizzes, 3 writing prompts, and 2 tests, each is incredibly hard. She expects you to read 15+ page articles after each lecture, which is incredibly undoable, she offers no extra credit and I never made above a 75 on any of her quizzes. She is very nice, but her tests are impossible, wordy and consist of extremely niche info

By far the best professor I have had at SMU! The energy she brings when she walks in at morning hours makes it worth waking up. She randomly has conversations with you during class and makes it hard not to pay attention. The material in class is interesting, but she makes it more entertaining with her teaching style. You will not be disappoint!

Don't understand these comments at all. Sutton is one of the most considerate professors I have ever had, she is extremely smart and resourceful, and respectful of her students. Her course isn't the easiest but it is by no means the hardest or unfair. Would recommend taking her class to anyone.

Im so confused seeing all of these bad ratings, she is THE BEST, SO kind and caring of students, she understands that we have other coursework. can be kind of hard, you have to work for it but she genuinly cares so much its refreshing.

Though I struggled a little in the class, Dr Sutton is the KINDEST, most passionate teacher, she is so positive it makes the class SO positive!!!!!! 
She's amazing, just pay attention because the tests are harder than you'll probably expect. Nonetheless she's one of the best professors I have had.
I had never seen a professor actually drown puppies before until I took her course.

Professor Sutton is a master of microscopes, zooming in on copyright page trivia with fervor. Whispering like a copyright connoisseur, she leaves lecture slides barren, drowning us in legal jargon. My A-? Only because my genius shines even in the darkest corners of academia.

In my entire educational life of 1.5 yrs @ SMU, I've never had a worse prof. She tests on the smallest details from the textbook & when I say smallest I mean that literally: the fine print from the copyright page. She whisper-reads it in lectures and it's not included in her slides. SO much copyright. Only class I've received A- in bc I am so smart

In my entire educational life, I have never had a worse professor. She tests you on the smallest details from the textbook and some questions are based on things she would mention during her lectures that aren't included in her slides or textbook. SO much material and her lectures do not help. This is the only class I have ever received an A-

In the beginning, the class was good but as the semester progressed it got worse. Her quizzes are only around 8 questions with little to no curve at times. Now onto her test, her tests are tough but if you dedicate your time to making quizlets, reading all the slides, and your notes you will do okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Sutton is great! Shes not an easy A and makes you work for it but the class experience is worth it. Interesting content and office hours got me through some rough patches this semester. She has such a big heart and is fun to talk to too

Kara truly is the sweetest lady, but her lectures are extremely hard to follow. Her slides are COVERED, and it can be challenging to figure out what is essential or what is connected to what. It takes so much outside work to understand the most basic ideas. She constantly contradicts herself, and the tests confuse students even more.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Challenging yet rewarding course with a prof who cares

no one better for a 9am. attendance mandatory but would sometimes end class after 10 minutes. so caring and mindful of students, busy schedules, etc. course is just a lot of memorization and slides but she makes it interesting with lots of energy.

Tests are very straightforward and she makes reviews that are very helpful. Study her slides really well and her lectures. She is very caring and easy to talk to. Lectures are engaging and she likes to tell jokes to keep the classes attention. Highly recommend taking this class, easily one of the best professors I have had at SMU.

I absolutely love professor Sutton! she's hilarious and makes class fun. Her tests and quizzes are fine as long as you put some time in. She offers extra credit, drops the lowest quiz grades and curves if the average isn't good. If you don't want to study or learn, she's not for you so stay out of her classes so the rest of us can get in lol!!

Waited a year to make sure I got into her course for cc credit, does not disappoint living up to everything I heard about her in. As a senior never had another professor like her who cares so much about her students and puts in the work trying to get us engaged, interacting with the class everyday. Highly recommend and wish I could take her again

Sutton is the best professor I have had at SMU. She goes above and beyond for her students and REALLY cares. She will curve things frequently and as long as you show you are trying you should succeed in her class! She had a lot of energy and is very unique, but I think her spastic lectures make her even more lovable! I cannot recommend her enough!
cuts class short because students look stressed and then tests on the material she skips

These reviews do not do her justice. She is such an amazing professor, and I ALWAYS left office hours feeling inspired and validated. She is so incredibly kind and respectful. She is literally the walking embodiment of golden retriever energy. Even if you're not a humanities major, you will walk out of her class with a valuable experience.

She's an angel! I would take any course from her. Her lectures are amazing you understand everything when she teaches and she will explain something 100 until you show you understand. Go to office hours because she is so helpful and fun to talk to and gives you study tips or expanded review sheets. Very motivational enthusiastic lady!

How could I possibly explain how much I enjoyed this class? What a kind, caring woman. Her lectures were extremely engaging, and her assignments were incredibly straightforward. I didn't even need to take this class, but I would take MORE with her if I could! I'll miss her greatly, but I'll be sure to keep in contact with her! If you can, TAKE HER!

Professor Sutton is the best teacher I've ever had, she is also an amazing person! she is super caring and will do whatever she can to help you succeed in school. Go to her lectures and study hard for her quizzes and tests, they are very hard and not at all common sense. I would take my class from her!

she is an AMAZING human being. cares so so much about her students and reflects so in person, and with grade feedback. her quizzes and tests are difficult and not as "common knowledge" as you would think given the class, but she offers a lot of extra credit for just being there or fun bonus questions. really adapts the class style to the students

One of the most memorable professors I have had. Expects much from her students and gives the same. The assignments and tests in this class are very manageable if you go to class and take notes and the content is quite interesting. Anyone who left a bad review on here is most likely did not put in any effort or is just dumb. 10/10 will take again.

Had her last semester and taking her a second time now. Professor Sutton is hands down the best. She cares so much about her students and makes lectures so interesting. She gives lots of good feedbacks and is always available for help. She doesn't assign too much work and will adjust if she thinks we're overwhelmed too much. Definitely worth taking

I took 3315 as a 3hr night class and Sutton is the only professor that could've made it bearable. Super sweet, cares a ton about students. Sometimes her lectures dance around the main point but if you ask her specifics she's more than happy to go in depth. If you have any kind of coding/stats background you should be perfectly fine.Take if you can!

She is a ball of light, happiness, and wants her students to thrive. Provides an interesting thorough lecture, will adjust the format of test questions based on feedback. Gives you 5 different paper topics with different due dates for your 1 essay so lots of flexibility in the class. An enjoyable way to knock out a CC and learn more about sociology

Dr. Sutton is one of the nicest people ever, she truly cares about her students and has such a big heart. Her tests can be tough but she does like to add a lot of extra credit and if you pay attention in class you will be okay. Outside reading is not necessary, just look at slides. She is the most fun teacher, I really hope I get to have her again

I'm a senior & haven't felt compelled to write a review before but she's one of the best teachers I've had & probably one of the best people I'll ever meet. Everyday she does her best to make learning enjoyable & you can really tell she has SUCH a huge heart. She is such a joy and with a reasonable amount of effort you'll do well in the class.

The sweetest teacher, shes always so excited to teach! Mostly lectures, readings with ppts, a few essays and a midterm and final. Honestly I didnt care much for this class but I look forward to it because of her. She cares about her students lives and understands that school gets tough!

Professor Sutton is honestly so inspirational, you can tell that she is genuinely passionate about the material that she is teaching. In class, she gives more information about the lecture powerpoints in a way that sticks in your brain. She posts the PowerPoint online as well and is available for help. Took her class for a CC credit and loved it!

Favorite class and professor ever. I looked forward to class just because she is SO passionate about what she teaches and class is actually alot of fun. You GO to COLLEGE to have a professor like this. She is an extremely positive person, the assignments are very interesting as she uses her own research, I would take her a every semester if I could

I genuinely don't think that I will have another professor like her. She is always so happy to see her students and I find her excitement so charming. Her class is very interesting and she cares so much about her students in a way that I have not experienced from any other professor. The sweetest human. TAKE HER!!

Dr. Sutton is the sweetest professor ever. She's very excited to teach sociology every day. Assignments have a clear grading system from the beginning. You don't really need the textbook if you listen and take notes during class and go over the PowerPoints. She always has bonus questions on quizzes and exams. So glad to have met her!

AMAZING PROFESSOR. One of my favorites at SMU. She is truly passionate about what she does and it shows in every one of her lectures. She also encourages conversation about controversial topics, but she values everyones opinions. You need to know your stuff for the tests/quizzes, but the essays are easy and she gives you great feedback.

I loved her as a person. She was by far my favorite professor I had at SMU. She is a very nice lady who loves her students. Her quizzes and exams are all based on the lecture so focus more on that rather then the book. Make sure you take notes as best as you can, she can tend to talk fast and go on little rants. If you put in the work you'll be ok.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is very lively and excited to teach her students. The class was basically the textbook pasted onto slides and her reading it to you. The grading was easy and there is a nice curve. She is a really nice lady her teaching style just was not great for me.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you get the chance to take her, you should! Put in the work, and it's easy to get a good grade. She definitely cares about her students and is extremely passionate about her classes and their topics.

Dr. Sutton is a truly amazing teacher and person. She really brightens every student's day with her amazing energy she brings to class. Dr. Sutton provides great feedback and excellent support, and her classes are always interesting. I would recommend this teacher to everybody.
Professor Sutton is easily my favorite teacher at SMU. She does an amazing job at keeping her class engaging and manageable. Would 100% recommend anyone to take a class with her.

She is so sweet! Super nice and is a real gem if you see her in office hours. Always brightens up my day with her laugh! She has such a passion for what she teaches and it really shows. Tests can be a bit difficult, but just read the book and you'll be good. She curves and gives good feedback on papers. Super caring, definitely take her!!

Dr. Sutton is WONDERFUL. Incredibly understanding of her students and caring of each one of them. Content in her course is easy to learn and very interesting. Dr. Sutton has a legitimate passion for what she teaches that rubs off on her students. I loved this class, it's really easy.

Kara was literally my favorite professor of all time. She laughs the whole time and is so sweet. I got 100's on every paper and the tests were straight from the book. I'm taking her again next semester.

Prof. Sutton is an amazing human being who made me look forward to SOCI everyday. She is one of the most caring teachers I have ever had, I highly recommend her class if you want to just discuss current problems around the world today. The only downside to her class is that there is only one test and it is worth 40% of the semester grade.

AMAZING! Prof Sutton is so passionate and dynamic. Her class was the one bright spot in a difficult semester. She will not only make sure you understand the material but will provide you with individual help if you dont. She made the class enjoyable by somehow not making it feel like school and a requirement. She redefines what a professor is!

Professor Sutton is an incredible person and is just one of the sweetest people. Although she can be very unclear with what she expects and really focuses on whether the class is 2000, 3000, or 4000 levels and makes her 4000 classes a lot harder. She is very knowledgable but sometimes too smart that she can't explain it down. Not a very easy class!

I took her last semester, and she is STILL the greatest professor you will ever have. She cares so much about her students, is so passionate about the field and her class, and simply wants everyone to be educated. she cares about your opinion, and always wants what is best for each student she has. I love her to pieces, TAKE HER!!!

Dr. Sutton is the most caring professor you will ever meet. Her lectures are interesting and she is an amazing lecturer, she is receptive to all students opinions, and she is extremely involved in the Dallas community. I would take this class a hundred times!!!! Will definitely be taking another one of her classes!

Professor Sutton is one of my favorite professors I've ever taken. She really wants to connect and engage with her students and makes the information easy to understand. If you have the chance definitely take her class!

Professor Sutton genuinely cares about her students and it is clear she wants them to succeed. Professor Sutton is very flexible and willing to work with students one-on-one outside of class. Her lectures are interesting and her laughter is contagious. Highly recommend.

Quality Prof! She puts all of her lecture power points on canvas and gives out a thourough study guide for each test. Spend a good couple hours reviewing the material and it is fairly easy to get a high A on all of her three tests

She is a very nice and caring professor. She does not require attendance but it means a lot to her when students show up. She gives great feedback and she is very flexible. Just show up and youll have great class discussions. You would almost even forget that you are in a lecture. She is great and wants nothing but the best for her students
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Kara is the funniest woman, loves to talk all of the lecture and tells hilarious little stories when she gets sidetracked. The class is mainly lectures and some days she chooses to do an activity and she gives extra credit for showing up. She cares immensely about her students and is so passionate about her teaching, that I am taking her again!
should be a highschool teacher if that.
Worst Wrtr teacher ever, picks favorites and grades favorites easier. No matter how much work you put in she will still give you bad grades and take points off for no reason
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This may just be the worst professor at SMU, Extremely tough grader with little to no guidance. Attedance is mandatory and will drop your grade if you are late/miss 3 lectures. Always looks extremely depressed as well. SMU do better.
Shes a pretty nice professor, but so much homework, in-class essays, and an extremely tough grader. Doesn't really give any clear feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: whatever you do. do not take this class. she finds ways to take off points for every little thing it's ridiculous. She's very unclear in her instructions and leaves a lot of information out and because of that i lost so many points because I “did not meet the assignment requirements” Not to mention she just simply is not a good teacher and boring
Would not recommend at all. She holds personal biases and grades based on that. She also does not give clear feedback and is always vague. Make sure you don't get sick either.

She will micromanage and give vague feedback that really doesn't help at all, the grading seems simple but she will find something in your final submissions.I was one of her better students who actually engaged in her class and I still had to work too hard for my grade.Take another prof for. WRTR credit all the other prof. are so easy AVOID!!!.

I honestly feel bad for her, she looks so depressed all the time but that is because her class is hilarious. She gives crazy amounts of work and readings and will deduct points over the stupidest stuff. Someone who has no friends vibe. Don't take the class, she will just put this energy onto you as you see your grade plummet throughout the year.
Terrible should be fired
DO NOT TAKE AT ALL awful.

Absolutely loved having her class. I genuinely think if you fail her course it is because you chose to. If I had any recommendations it would be to build a strong relationship with her and really just try. She takes participation super seriously so if you're an active listener who is on top of class she's willing to hear you out.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Do not take her at all cost. Worst lectures, extremely rude teacher when asking for feedback, and will never have your back
If you take this professor expect everything to be micrograded. Any minor detail you do wrong will be ma
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She tells you exactly what she wants from you and gives clear feedback. Most of the complaints are because she doesn't tell you what to fix, she guides you there. The workload isn't even bad; it's around a reading per class and she gives us around 2 weeks and a half to write an essay. Overall, she's really helped me with my writing.
Do not take worst prof on campus.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is straight up butt. do not take her class. she is a passive English teacher who makes you feel bad for no reason. she is the worst grader with no forgiveness, and putting a singular comma in the wrong place will get you multiple points off. and, attendance matters. not worth a semester.

Do NOT take this class. Worst teacher I have ever had. Not only is there so much reading assigned, but attendance is mandatory. Compared to other professors, she is the worst. She has no forgiveness for her students. The course work is extremely difficult if you didn't take an AP in high school. Do everything you can to avoid this teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Very ough grader, I couldn't get anything above a B on any papers despite a grade of 5 on both the AP English literature and composition exams in high school. Employs a Socratic method dialogue within lessons and office hours sessions that isn't very helpful or effective in my opinion. For the best odds towards an A, frequent her office hours.
She is a very nice person overall, however very tough grader, class can be awkward if you don't have people involved in discussions, but if you do your best you might clutch up.
Absolutly do not take. Shes not even worth me saying more

Out of all of the classes I have taken in my life, this is by far the worst professor/teacher I have had. Has clear favorites in the class and if you're not one of them, good luck. I think it should be noted I received an A in WRTR 1312 and got a C in 1313, and there was no decline in quality in work.

Not a great teacher, terrible grader. The feedback on my essays was borderline ridiculous; "be more specific" and "be more clear" on every essay I turned in. To be clear, I've written dozens of upper-level college essays and never once had a complaint about specificity or clarity. If you keep up with the daily homework you can grind out an A.

She's nice and very open to feedback, but she wastes a lot of time inside and outside of class. She will find the smallest error within a paper and deduct multiple points for it. And those points add up. Follow the rubric as closely as possible, and try to not leave any room for error in homework or essays.

Overall, I had a positive experience in her class. While I did feel like she was a tough grader, it wasn't anything that I couldn't handle. However, if you didn't have to consistently write essays in high school, this course might be overwhelming. There is a lot of homework and often it isn't beneficial to what we're doing in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Extremely tough grader on the essays. If you can, take a different professor honestly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Wilhelm is kind, however, she is a very very tough grader on all assignments. I was the student that saw the reviews on RMP saying she wasn't great and still believed my charm could win her over .. half way through the semester I gave up on that. Gives B's for work she deems good. Bottom line, If you dont want a stressful semester, avoid her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Do whatever you need to do to get a different professor for your mandatory writing classes. Worst professor at this school, worst class I've ever had.

You will be counted absent if you show up as much as 10 seconds after the class time. You will have homework for every class and it's never homework that helps at all. Also if you mess up the submission of anything and try to resubmit it you will still be held accountable as late even if you turned it in before the deadline without a rubric.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: She was a pretty tough grader, but she also outlined exactly what was expected to get a good grade and gave good feedback. Show up to class and do the reading (it's not that much). People are just mad that she actually assigns work. There are a lot of assignments, but it means your grade isn't dependent on just one essay. I recommend her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof. Wilhelm is really nice, and she was always easy to reach outside of class! Is she a tough grader? Yes, but she tells you exactly what you need to get a good grade. The people who don't like her class are the ones who want an easy A without actually putting in effort. If you actually show up and make an attempt in this class, you'll be fine.

Not helpful outside of class, not clear on homework or expectations.Rubrics for essays are not spoken about until the day before the essay is due. Plays favorite, prompts are confusing and class time is not used to be productive at all. You talk about random stuff all of class then have something due. DO NOT TAKE. ANY OTHER WRTR PROFESSOR BUT HER.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The workload, overly harsh essay grading, and utter lack of teaching quality was completely inappropriate for an introductory class. Absolutely miserable experience. I am a worse writer for the time I wasted in WRTR 1313.

She does not teach you anything, all you do is busy work. Be ready to read so much meaningless text each night and take notes that don't matter. If you submit an in class assignment even a minute late she will not grade it. Avoid this teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Very hard to get an A. Her critiques feel more nitpicky than anything else and will just tell you to "specify" when your ideas are right there. Would not recommend.

She's a nice lady but a really tough grader. She would say things like "I rarely give my students A's on papers" and would be extremally vague with her feedback. She answers all of the questions you have with a question like, "well, what do you think?" and "Do you think that's right?" instead of telling you what you need to do to improve.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hands down the worst teacher/professor I've ever had. Holds no accountability, super disorganized, and offers no meaningful feedback other than "be more specific". If she doesn't feel like thoughtfully grading your work, she won't. Whatever you do, for your own sake, do NOT take WRTR with this professor.

This is supposed to be an intro to writing course, but the professor never taught any of the skills to become a better writer.
