He is a horrible person and I will never take a class of his again.

Never responds to emails. Never grades on time. Harsh grader. Unclear handouts. Slides don't explain the content on HW/Tests. Tests/HW take 6+ hours each. Confusing slides. Poorly explained. Lack of accountability. Lack of responsibility. Takes forever to regrade.

Never grades assignments on time. Hard grader. The sound of his voice gives me flashbacks and night terrors. The First 8 weeks have so few assignments, then everything hits at the end. His assignments don't line up with the lecture at all so you have no clue what you're doing. Most disliked professor in the CS department and he earned it.
Not good management and caring

I am rating Dr Lin for NLP(CS 5391) and OS(CS 5343) as I had him for both in the same semester. he does not provide much guidance on the projects for either class and his lectures are not very engaging. Not very accessible outside of class either. I would not take him again for any class.

I had heard neutral things about him, but when I took him I gave him the benefit of the doubt. He was nice, okay at lecturing and somewhat available outside of class, but vague answers to your questions, tough grading, and extremely disorganized. I had to help fix what was wrong in his program MULTIPLE times throughout the semester! Disappointing.

She assigns a lot of work and seems to think her class is the most important. A lot of people take this class as nonmajors, so her expectation for people to put in excessive effort is unrealistic. Her grading is arbitrary, but the assignments aren't necessarily hard. As long as you submit the assignments with effort you should do fine.
Steer clear of this class. Professor's expectations are unrealistic, grading is arbitrary. Offers no guidance, then penalizes students for not meeting unknown standards. Total waste of effort.
She was so understanding and cool. Lots of homework but no tests. Definitely take her if you do the homework you WILL get an A
She wants you to succeed in her class. Do the reading and talk in class she loves that. Give you a great inside into CCPA and the overall classes.
This class was very interesting. Good lectures, interesting material, and no tests but prof Lance can be hard to read and unclear about exactly what she's looking for.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor is good for the 1301 but avoid for 3323. My grade dropped so much just because of a group project. Exams are unrealistically hard and even when you study, you won't make an A. Great professor but hard grader. Also, I would like to note that this course is a core class and we need a good grade on this to actually major in it....tired
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Avoid this class if possible. The topics are interesting and the material is relatable to real life situations, but the teacher doesn't want you to succeed. My whole class is struggling. The grading criteria is not clear at all and the tests are given in an unrealistic amount of time. There is no way to do well, so just don't take it.

Professor Commerato is awesome! She makes her lectures interactive and interesting by relating them to things in our daily lives which helps a lot with understanding the material. There are 3 exams and a final, 6 assignments, and a group project so it's not hard to pass. She encourages reading the textbook but I never do and I do fine on the exams.
A great teacher who made me want to go into CCPA! Very intelligent and this class is great for people wanting to go into communication but not sure where to start!! Would take every year.

Took this class just to fill up credit hours not a CCPA major, was not super focused on it and still got a 85% in the class. If you actually apply yourself on the homework essays you can easily get a A.

You can get an A in this class but you have to put in effort! There are a lot of assignments but if you try on them your grade will reflect that. Also no tests! She is so nice and genuinely cares about her students. However, she does take attendance everyday. This class really helped me learn more about the CCPA program.
Literally I have learned so much from her. She is an amazing teacher and actually cares about her students. Definitely recommend her to all.
Professor Commerato is great! Super nice and assignments are straight forward. CCPA 1301 is a fun class as well

This professor is a person with no words. I majored in CCPA only because of taking her and her one class. She's not too out there but also not enclosed in just herself. She cares about her students and wants to help them out as much as she can. She has inspired me to be more open to others and to assess who I am. Because of her class, I know myself

This was my favorite professor I've taken at smu, Dr. Smith truly cares about his students. He has plenty of experience in the engineering and buisness world and has given the best advice for finding internships, writing letters of recommendations

I rarely say I wouldn't take a Professor again, but he's just not the best at teaching. Barely lectures. + It's not even that he plays favorites, he only is like that if you behave how he wants. Likes power plays. Establishes chill and friendly dynamics with students, then randomly is mean one day bc you didn't try as hard on one assignment.

Actually, for CS5351. Did not listen to my complaints about my group's performance all semester and refused to help me when I contributed over 90% of the codebase, all while my group continued to slack off. Clear favoritism of some students and outright rudeness to others. Overall, beware of Smith and the group you choose.

I love the guy, I do. But in class, he is insanely paranoid about cheating. He talks about himself through half of the class. Reads off of slides when he rarely lectures. Doesn't let you use electronics in class and attendance is graded and mandatory. Random project halfway through which doesn't pertain to ethics. Its an English and CS class mixed.

Wasted entire class periods just talking about himself (instead of actually teaching), so I didn't feel like I learned much from the class. Yet attendance was mandatory. 
Mobile app project is considerably difficult (at least if you haven't done one before), and has no connection to the ethics topic.

Okay guy but not a good teacher at all and thinks he reigns king in all things. Is not good at facilitating OPEN discussion or knowledge. An okay guy with an okay class and there are many better options out there to not waste your time with this one.
Hate to say I did enjoy this class. Not necessarily a big fan of his (makes me a bit uncomfy and thinks his opinion is best) but the discussion in the class made it worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This professor does not understand that his students are only taking the class for credit and has too high of expectations from us. Constantly tells us he is disappointed in our performance and is condescending and rude when we ask questions. Gives way too much workload for an intro class and is unclear of instructions.

BEAST professor you could ever have at SMU! I took HRTS 4343 for summer I 2022 with him and he was more than great! You will learn a lot!. Highly recommend you to take this class if you want to learn about Ethic and Human Rights in the real world.
easy 1 hour UC credit. met once a week. discussion based class, so easy. read before class and participate, very interesting topics. one paper and one group project. definitely take him

Do not take this class. If you do, expect to be working on an essay at all times during the semester. For about a month we had 2 essays outside of class we were working on at the same time. She doesn't seem to know the material well so don't bother asking questions. Her due dates are always impossible. Also There's no conferences on your essays

I think she is a terrible teacher and basically thought I was going to fail the class the entire semester and hated every second of i but I ended up with an A-. I never read anything she assigned or spoke in class but with the exception of my C+ first essay, she liked the rest of my essays and the final speech really helps your grade if you try.
I actually enjoyed Dr. Klein's class. It was certainly difficult but you learn a lot over the semester. I rarely read and still got A's and B's on my essays. Not a terrible time overall

English is my best and favorite subject and she really lowered my confidence. In every conference she told me I was on the right track and had great ideas, but when I got my papers back I would get C's. You read around 6 books that are extremely old and difficult. Basically DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. You will be lucky to get a B.

No precedent is set for the quality of work, until she hands you your C or D on the first essay with little to no critiques on your point it how you argued it, just grammatical errors. Never explains what she expects and grades like she is expecting phd level work. Avoid at all costs.
dont take her

This was an awful class. She is an impossible grader and harps on the little things like intensive grammar. Her prompts are impossible to understand and the books we read are all fro 50000 years ago. It is impossible to get above a B in her class. I would highly recommend not taking her, she should not be a freshman teacher.
Incredibly difficult teacher. Her way or the high way. Would not recommend taking her

I normally find history interesting but he makes it so boring. Lectures are super long and he expects you to read a chapter each night which might not seem like a lot but the chapters are 30 pages minimum. His expectations are very unrealistic
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Steer clear of this class. Professor's expectations are unrealistic, grading is arbitrary. Offers no guidance, then penalizes students for not meeting unknown standards. Total waste of effort.
Super swe

There are only 3 tests, which is basically the only thing that goes into the grade book and makes getting a good grade tougher. Dr. Knock is a super sweet professor though! He cares so much about history and is super knowledgeable. With a little work, the class is definitely manageable and it is more than possible to get an A.

Professor Knock is a very respectable professor, but the class is rather harsh. There are only 3 grades ever recorded in the entire class; 2 exams and a final. Exams are always written on paper, which sucks because you have to write multiple essays. That being said, Professor Knock is very caring and is a great person to talk to!

Knock is a good professor, but he treats this 1000 level class like a graduate seminar, especially when it comes to the essays. 8 page essays, which I don't have a problem with, but he grades extremely harshly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: HIST 2312 with Professor Knock (US History since civ. war) is a tough class but manageable if you do all the reading and participate in class. Class consists of only two tests and a final, plus occasional extra credit quizzes. Grade can also be improved/deducted based on participation. If you skip class, it will be hard to get an A.
Great teacher. Student of American History himself. Reading is required and class participation is key because he will reward you for raising your hand constantly. 10/10.

Professor Knock is a phenomenal professor and guy. He gives interesting, engaging lectures. He really makes the course material relevant. There is a lot of reading and you don't want to miss a class, but I loved this class and I loved going. Wonderful person.

Professor Knock cares so much. Do yourself a favor and go talk to him, if you're having any kind of trouble throughout the semester. He is a cute little marshmallow.  Even if you're not in dying, just go to see his insane shrine of American presidential history in his office. His buttons and campaign material collection is so cool to look at.
reviews.rating_tags: Inspirational--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Knock is one of the single most amazing professors I've ever had the privilege to take. Everyday he comes to class you can see how much he truly loves what he's teaching about. On top of that he's just a very sweet man in general, talk to him, participate, and care about the course and you'll do great. Could not rate more highly

Only professor I have ever had that seems to care more about educating his students than earning a paycheck. He can be dry at times and admittedly expects perhaps too much on papers, but he is by fa the most genuine professor on SMU's payroll. I was going to minor in history before he inspired me to major.

I took HIST 2312 with Professor Knock and he is amazing. His lectures are fascinating and he really has a passion for American History. As far as his tests go, there are only 2 tests and one final in this class. He gave us pop quizzes but did not count them towards our grade. His exams are not hard, although they require a moderate amount of study.

One of my favorite classes at SMU. Professor Knock is a respected historian and knows the Cold War like the back of his hand. But, the class is not easy. A lot of reading and essays are tough and he will sometimes grade them hard if they disagree with his views. Overall, the course made me look at the U.S. in a completely different way

He's extremely passionate about this topic. The class is entirely discussion-based (with the exception of a few videos), so be sure to do the reading every week. The tests are difficult and don't really follow the class discussion, so make sure you know the material front and back. After you get to know him he's like a grandpa: sweet and caring.
Has the most ridiculous requirements for papers that he'll arbitrarily change as he grades. Wouldn't recommend him.

Kind/friendly/good person. VERY passionate about HIST. Have to read before class. Wants to help you & loves to talk with students. Tests are 2 essays + short answers. They're challenging but not impossible & need LOTS of studying. Glad I took this over the other HIST classes. A good grade is possible just read and study for tests. No assigned hw!
unhelpful
Be sure to read before each class period.  He asks a lot of questions.  There are only 2 tests and a final.
Very Unhelpful
He doesn't give solid prompts, he gives ideas and you are supposed to expand on those. He rarely replies to emails.

Mr. Knight is a nice old man and is an interesting person. However, he is no English professor. Though he liked my papers and the class was easy for me, he is rather unclear in what his expectations are and neglects his own assignments. If you want a professor that lets you slack off, go for it. Otherwise, his class is disappointing and unexciting.
I had him freshman year.  He asks for your opinion and then criticizes your opinion.  He is extremely liberal.  I got an A and worked really hard... it wasn't easy.
He is very unclear in what he wants and is tough on grading papers. He does not hold office hours and is very hard to get help from. I would not recommend this professor.

Do not take this class. He teaches in the most confusing way possible. Before writing an essay you learn about 5 completely unrelated things and then are asked to write an essay on them without a prompt. Says he will answer emails and often doesn't. The whole class is just really frustrating.

Professor Knight is a great guy and I really respect him, but I don't see him as a very good teacher. My biggest annoyance was that he said I needed to change the content of my paper because he didn't agree with my interpretation of the text. This was very frustrating, but as long as you attend class, do the work and try your best, you will do well

He is a decent professor. Nothing amazing, nothing boring. Has very strong liberal views. If you can pick up on his opinions and then mime them in your papers, you are golden. Also, using phrases he says is very helpful.

I strongly discourage anyone from taking one of his classes. He is unhelpful, vague, and pushes his opinions on you although he'll tell you he won't. All of the work is busy work and doesn't get graded. The essays limits your writing abilities. He won't show up for conferences and won't email you back.

I really don't enjoy this class. We don't accomplish anything in class and he gives you a lot of busy work. He will tell you in a conference that your paper is good then turn around and give you a B-. He is NOT helpful and working hard on a paper doesn't get you a better grade. He's an interesting guy though... I don't recommend this class.

He's a cool person, but was very unhelpful when it came to grading essays. Conferences to point out flaws prior to the final draft, and then counted off for things he didn't mention in the conference. ...? Your best bet is to pick up on his opinion in class and then parrot it in your papers.

He is a decent lower tier 1 professor. He is very liberal and enjoys his liberal students. This class was enjoyable and I would recommend him to other liberals. Professor Knight also wears the same thing every day, black! Black shirt and black jeans or something along the color black. Although liberal he is tolerant of conservatives! I grade him: B
Great guy who never grades the work, good to talk to.  Has very interesting stories

However a nice guy, he'll start off the semester telling you he's very open minded and he doesn't try to push his views on anybody because he claims to not be conservative or liberal, which is true because he's a communist.  He'll read you all the instructions he gives... assuming you can't read them yourself.  And your work is never graded!

He is very helpful. You may think some of the work seems like busy work at first, but it really helps you to understand how to become a better writer.  The first day of class I thought about dropping because he seemed intimidating, but I didn't and I'm SOOO glad that I didn't.  He is a great teacher who will whip your writing into shape.

He begins the year telling you he is open minded and will hear both sides but for 3 months you get nothing but his liberal propaganda...he was a nice guy and hard to dislike but he couldnt help from letting his biased approach into the class and the grading
harold knight is one of the best in the department...yay for prof knight!
Very enthusiastic and friendly. Makes taking this mandatory class quite bearable. Would definitely recommend her to others.

Megan is great! She's an incredibly sweet, encouraging lady. I took one of her earlier classes but she was still always energetic. I love how positive and energetic she is. I definitely recommend her for Wellness!

Knapp is adorable and full of energy. Super easy class, just show up and you're good. You get 4 absences for a MWF class. Don't bother buying the Personal Finance book. We used it one day and I forgot it. It was fine.
She is very excited to be there. I think this section is a little bit more work and effort than other sections for Wellness 101. But, its no big deal. She is friendly.

Jogging class was great! I never thought I would be able to run four miles straight but Prof. Knapp really eases you into it and helps you achieve your jogging goals. Great class plus she is super nice!
Take Knapp for Wellness, she is awesome. Easy class, lots of movies, but when you do have to do class activities she makes it fun and unthreatening. Take Knapp.
EASY AND AWESOME. I LOVE PROFESSOR KNAPP. take her wellness class, she makes it fun and actually makes you want to go to wellness
She's adorable
Easiest class ever but she gives the most work out of the wellness professors. Still a blowoff pretty much
Excellent teacher! Plus she is not bad to look at.  She knows her stuff and makes class fun!

Dr. Kouros was the best professor to have for a 400 level course. She is SO caring and wants you to succeed. Her lectures are mainly working out practice problems and she provides a study guide for exams. You also get 1 flash card per exam. She offers office hours, too. You'll put in work, but take her! Cannot recommend her enough.

Dr Kouros is very approachable. Does not at all try to make the course difficult for the sake of making it difficult. The class has 3 exams/1 cumulative final/research-video project,/bi-weekly journal entries/readings before lecture, but she breaks tasks into manageable steps. She wants everyone to do well in the class. Can't say enough good things
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Also, developmental psych is all about babies and children fyi. I thought it would be all of life span but this class is essentially babies 101. Still recommend taking.

She's honestly really sweet. You still have to put in work for the class- it's college. But you can still zone out sometimes since she used Power points all of May term. That being said, it's still a lot of info. I think I can get a B or an A in the class :) Working on a group video right now which I don't love but will get through. She's helpful.

I enjoyed every minute of this course. She wants her students to perform well and is readily available. Her PPTs are interesting - use the learning objectives to create study guides for tests. Straight forward class. Offers extra credit. Participate, read, complete assignments and you can get an A. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Really great professor. Very straightforward and gave out extra credit a few times. A bit of a tough grader but willing to help you understand concepts. Super nice and approachable lady, willing to help talk to you about labs to work in on campus and career goals if you're interested in Psychology as your major. I would highly recommend Dr. Kouros.
Kouros is a solid professor. She is very kind and helpful when needed. Would take again in a heartbeat.

The topic was very interesting, but class was a little boring. First tests are easier, two last ones cover more material. She is not an easy grader. Always helpful if you go to office hours. Learn study guides, most of the test questions come from there, especially final.

Developmental: I agree that her voice was annoying at first, but I got over it. She is very succinct in her lectures, experienced and knowledgeable in her field, and very helpful in office hours. She is one of those teachers that wants you to learn and succeed. The course is like parenting 101 and is very interesting.

Her voice was annoying at first, but otherwise I really enjoyed her class. Her lectures and tests were based off of the book, but she also taught us many new things from the field. There is a group project/presentation--you can select your own group. She gives nongraded quizzes to help you review for the test.

Nice lady, but didn't like her teaching style. Lectures straight from her slides. Grades way too hard on short answers on exam. Makes students work in groups. She made the class a lot harder than it needed to be. Nonetheless, I learned a lot from her. Just go to class, read the book and take good notes, otherwise you won't do so well.

Kouros shakes up the traditional lecture class.  We would do class activities that were hands-on and interesting.  The tests aren't hard as long as you attend class and read the book. Weekly article questions take 30 minutes tops and go over a lot of what you are learning.  She made class interesting and low-stress. Definitely a great professor.

Don't take this professor!! really boring and makes the class harder/more complicated than it needs to be. reads straight off power point. we have to answer questions weekly to 20 page articles about studies she doesn't even ask about on the test. very picky on short answers on tests..
It's not that he's too difficult I'm but it's that he doesn't teach anything you'll get graded on. Better options are out there. Use then.
Good guy bad professor.
I am a Junior at ASU, Dr. Kota has been one of my favorite professors. I believe the bad reviews above are old and he has changed his teaching ways. I would definitely take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy but he does not even teach at all, not worth your time if you are looking to move ahead in the program, also lacks any real current connections in the field so totally useless to even maximize your time with him. Nice guy but not useful to your goals.
Not a bad dude but doesn't have a real class and you are't going to be prepared for your other courses becuase he tries so hard to be a people pleaser rather than an actual professor.
the goat
The BEST. literally the best. you have to take him. for any class it doesnt matter hes the best
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr.Kota is an absolute legend. His passion and engaging teaching style make complex concepts accessible. His dedication to student success, approachability, and research contributions make him an invaluable mentor. Under his guidance, I've gained a deep appreciation for the industry.
The BEST teacher at SMU. He cares about his students and his lectures are so fun. Assignments are easy and he is very understanding.
His classes and lectures are very entertaining and actually relate to sports and what I want to do with my career.
a monumental waste of your time
Its a good class and easy to do well. He does call on you randomly which is annoying but hes a nice enough guy.
Dr. Kota is the best and one of my favorite professors. He makes classes fun, but there is a good amount of work. Tests are open note, so that's nice. He will also call on you randomly.
I love Professor Kota! He's the best professor, but this class has a lot of work and presentations. He will also call on you whenever he wants.
Professor Kota is the best! There is a lot of work, but his classes are so fun and he always makes it a good time. I always take his classes when I can.
Easy class but he's a huge nerd and less entertaining that you might think given subject matter
Easy A, waste of time, thinks he so smart and funny, somebody need to tell him the truth.

Best professor I've ever had, any class he teaches I recommend you take it. He is incredibly knowledgable and if you show interest and effort you will have a good grade. If you want to progress professionally he will stick his neck out for you. Great guy.
Dr. Kota is the bomb. There were no exams, just quizzes. There was also one big project that you had to present on. He made the class so much fun and exciting. I would take him again in a heart beat!

I signed up for ratemyprofessor just to rate Derek. He was on my thesis committee years ago, and I have stayed penpals cause he is a real enthusiast for a lot of stuff in film, comics, movies, new media. All props to his academic integrity, no snark, but he is also one of us, y'know? The more you bring to class the better. He does tailor!

This class was so easy. We had an assignment due every week or two, which was usually a paragraph based on a film element we were learning in class. A couple projects, but they're not hard. He takes attendance but it doesn't count towards your grade. Pretty chill guy.
Super easy class, as long as you try you'll make an A, don't do anything controversial though.

This man is a gem! He truly cares for his students- even their emotional well-being. He is so kind and understanding and makes sure there is something interesting for everyone. The class is easy as long as you put in the work. Most of the grade is made up by in-class stuff that is very easy, and there is barely homework. Such a fun class!
I love Dr. Kompare! He is very understanding and easy to communicate with. The class material is very interesting and you will definitely learn a lot! I would take again if I could :)

Fantastic professor on all fronts. I took him for a TV class and he was so knowledgeable and passionate. His class is very participation heavy, but thats because he is interested in what his students have to say and wants to have an open conversation. I went into the class with an interest in the subject and it only grew as a result.

DEREK IS GENUINELY THE BEST PROFESSOR ON CAMPUS. He is extremely caring and intelligent. All of his assignments are clear, straightforward, and interesting. It is such a low stress environment that you are able to fully tune in and enjoy learning which I absolutely love!!

literally the best film professor at SMU!!! super understanding and willing to work with you. genuinely kind, and has interesting and relevant lectures. always has something interesting to say. love this guy

His classes can really drone on and be really boring. It's pretty much all lecture heavy with a few in-class assignments, quizzes, and a group project. His grading is very broad so it's not very clear where you went wrong when you get a grade back. He's a pretty picky grader.

soooooo.. He's a cool guy and knows a lot about films. The class wasn't per say a blow-off???? But all you talked about was film and the media surrounding it. But he also took off too many points for my attendance so I was a little heated at the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--GROUP PROJECTS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Professor Kompare is really nice one of the best professors I've had. This class was really interesting, the films we watched were all really. Not a difficult class, actually one of my favorites. Also plus that the professor is really cute.

Great professor. Definitely passionate about what the subject of film. Study hard for his tests because they are somewhat difficult. Other than that, great class. Labs are fun b/c all you do is watch movies. Highly recommended.

Very nice and cool professor. Knows more pop culture than anyone I've ever met. Does a great job at engaging students and leading thoughtful, interesting discussions. Tests aren't bad, study a bit, write strong essays, and you should get an A or a high B. Attendance policy is strict (only 3 absences allowed), but you'll want to come to class.

He's a great prof, really nice, encourages discussion and teaches in a really manner. He's nitpicky for grammar in your essays though. Overall, I didn't mind having to come to class (attendance in mandatory). Definitely take a class with him

Good professor, but grading is confusing. He'll give you good comments but scores are low. Wonderful lecturer, engaging in class and seems in tune with students. Take a class with him, and put in the extra effort and you'll make a good grade and love the class.

Prof. Kompare is great. The only downside is you can only miss 3 classes. The numerous upsides include: He's great at relaying information. He knows more about modern pop culture and medias than you do. Glance over the notes before the test and it's impossible to fail. I really enjoyed showing up for this class, it's modern, relevant material.

Great professor, he encourages discussion and listens to what you have to say and has things to say himself. He brings up thinks from pop culture that are relevant to the material. His exams could be better if they featured less true/false questions, and it'd be cooler if he had more grades like essays. Overall he's a great professor!
Knows his stuff, but packs it all into a few tests and likes fill in the blank questions! Tough because it is all lecture. Bias view. Has a gift for imparting knowledge. Good teacher.

If you want a good grade, take his class, but if you want to learn, then don't. He always ends class early, and I doubt his Spanish skills. When I wrote sentences like "vamos al parque a jugar", he said it should be "para jugar," but in fact both are correct. I got A by self-study, but my Spanish could've been improved a lot with a better teacher.
he is a funny guy and legit the easiest professor ever. he teaches you everything. i dont know a single word of spanish and I got a B.
Sr. Korrie makes spanish fun, was always helpful and energetic for class. A good sense of humor too. This class has a lot of work however and can be difficult. Good professor none the less
Genuinely the worst professor at SMU. His total incompetence and general lack of intelligence makes the class almost impossible. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Horrible teacher. Doesnt teach at all. Learned everything from VHL. Doesnt even know Spanish that well and taught us the wrong thing many times. Is biased towards athletes and gives them more chances then other students. Also talks down to students.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: the class is not too hard--how hard could 1402 be though? You can make an A in this class, but I would recommend finding someone else. He doesn't teach the material in class. The entire class is just spent doing practice from the textbook. He's a nice enough guy, but I did not like him as a teacher.

Korrie is probably the worst SPAN professor at SMU. He leaves the room randomly, doesn't engage with his students well (talks to us but doesn't make us write on board etc.), and frequently misspeaks (ex. said there weren't stem changers in preterite tense multiple times). I am a good student (As and Bs) and am telling you - avoid him at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've ever taken, period. When I tell you that this man doesn't teach,believe me. Never once did he teach a single piece of material. All he does is give worksheets and put problems on the board for us to work on(alone and without instruction)for the entire class then expects us to do well on pop quizzes,tests,and oral presentations

He doesn't teach. That's the bottom line. I've taken 6 years of strenuous spanish and was one of the top students in the class and still couldn't manage an A-. I missed two classes in total, missed one homework grade, and despite this received sup-par in grades on all tests. This was my only class that required many hours of work outside of class.

A good professor.

Great professor, she has passion for her class, expect to read, pop quizzes, she loves to help students with papers, clear study guide for mid term and final, only 2  test and 2 papers for the whole semester. Overall easy and clear class. W

Good professor, very helpful, but expects a lot for an introductory course. Gives quizzes in class that are easy if you've done the readings, but grades tough on papers.

such a sweetheart! i took her for mesoamerican anthro which i had absolutely no interest in but prof kovacevich made it fun. she gives out reviews before every test that have everything you need to know. fairly easy and super nice.
One of my favorite classes ever. I highly recommend this professor and this course.

Very clear and understandable when teaching. She's very willing to help, and I am not very good at writing. I highly recommend taking her class. She really helps set you up for following classes and for writing in general.

Polster is great. Really good teacher, really understanding.

Not that hard but not a very good teacher, tries to hard to be popular and a people pleaser, which is sad.

Prof. Kulkarni is one of the sweetest professors I've had. I recommend taking her if you have the chance. Her class is super easy and the workload is very manageable. Professor Maddy is one of my favorite professors I've had at SMU. She is so kind and genuinely cares about her students and wants them to succeed. Most of her tests are 10 questions. Super easy A.

Professor Kulkarni is incredible!!! She is so caring, and learns the names of students in a big lecture. You are set up to get an A as long as you are engaging and participating in class. Take this class, you will not regret it!

Feels like a 3-hour podcast about her Pepsi career. Constantly tells students to switch to marketing/Cox instead of supporting advertising. You're forced to buy her own textbook. Long, dragged-out lectures with awkward pauses. If you flatter her, you'll do fine—otherwise, good luck. Not worth it.

She is so kind, honestly just be engaged and you'll be fine. One of the few professors that relates material to real world issues, I find this extremely impactful and helpful for my career. Also, actually cares about her students and knows names.

Professor Kulkarni is a great instructor. Engaging. Afternoon class for 3 hours; get out early sometimes. Mainly, power points and participation matter when discussing lectures and activities. The exams are online on a lockdown browser, and easy A if you show up to class and do the work. There is 1 group paper or presentation.

I would take his classes over and over again just because of the guest speaker and his wisdom. If you are a finance student, you must take his class. I have signed up for him class again!
Long, unhelpful lectures.

Overall great professor who made the material really interesting.

Dr. Kupfer is one of the most passionate professors I have taken at SMU. He turns a kind of dry topic into a really fun class and is willing to talk to you about how you are doing. Dr. Kupfer is one of the most passionate music professors at SMU. You get excited being in his class just because he is so into his subject. Truly a class I was excited for when entering this semester. reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: treats his class as if it is the only class you have all semester and is an incredibly unfair grader. He only gives negative feedback and doesn't tell you what you are doing well often if ever.

Not a great teacher, terrible grader. The feedback on my work was borderline ridiculous; "be more specific" and "be more clear" on everything I turned in. To be clear, I've written dozens of upper-level college work and never once had a complaint about specificity or clarity. If you keep up with the daily reading you can grind out a B+.

Professors are either helpful or brutal in their teaching methods. Prof. Lawrence makes sure everyone is doing their best at grasping the material and my house and friends have him listed as a preferred instructor to take. The only negative is that classes fill up fast, and I had to wait two semesters to get into a sold-out class.

Professor Lawrence is a favorite instructor at SMU for me and many of my friends. He cares for all his students and there are many learning lessons. He will keep you engaged in class and is a great person to help with your career if you reach out.

The workload, overly harsh grading, and utter lack of teaching quality was completely inappropriate for
 an introductory class. Absolutely miserable experience.

An uncomfotable guy with notes that don't cover material remotely related to the work you will be expected to do. Doesn't know how to teach or grade, tries too hard to be "liked" and "popular" among sudents a third of his age, sad really.

Not a great teacher, terrible grader. The feedback on my work was borderline ridiculous; "be more specific" and "be more clear" on everything I turned in. Absolutly do not take. Hes not even worth me saying more.

Clueless ab business, totally disorganized in lecture (or what he calls "lecture"), cannot stay on course with material to save his life and would rather opine about how important and invaluable he is to industry without having much to show for it. Take anyone else for this course and thank me later.

Professor Lawrence is awesome!! He really cares about his students and wants them to succeed not just in his class but beyond SMU as well. Put it in the work, ask for his guidance (he'll help you out) and you will do great in this class. If you have the opportunity to take him, you won't regret it!

Professor Lawrence truly cares about his students. He goes above and beyond and worries about their academic success as well as their outside-of-school success as well. During the lectures, he ensures every student is engaged and puts a lot of effort into ensuring each student understands the material.
He is a great professor who truly cares about his students and believes in what he is teaching. He is in my opinion one of the top professors at SMU. I highly recommend taking Dan Lawrence.

Professor Lawrence is one of my favorite instructors at SMU. This course is necessary for all students seeking professional and personal growth. Professor Lawrence seamlessly weaves his personal experience with the course content to create an engaging and memorable course.

Dan Lawrence is my favorite professor at SMU and the only one I will ever do a rate my professor for. If you get the opportunity to take him, do it. For extra credit we were ask to attend the women's volleyball game. He believes in supporting students inside and outside of the classroom. Great with DASS students.

He's a great professor but an even better human. He goes above and beyond for each student, as long as you show genuine care. He wants to help every kid possible, even outside of academic success. He'll help with professional development, like resume building, networking, etc. He also keeps the class engaging, making sure everyone is understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Lawrence goes above and beyond to help his students. As a Harvard grad, he is very knowledgeable and brings lots of real-world experience into the classroom. Can't recommend this Management class enough. We had several athletes in our section and we received extra credit when we attended their game!! He cares about his students deeply.

Best Professor. He brings a valuable practitioners perspective to the classroom every day. 

His teaching style is engaging and helps bridge the gap between academic theory and real life application. Recommended by many friends. He expects a High level of excellence. Classes can take 2 or 3 semesters to enroll because all his classes sell out fast.

Professor Lawrence is the most involved instructor I have ever come across. He invests in every student inside and, if need be, outside of the class as well. I cannot express the deep respect I have developed for this person.  He pushes his students to think, write, and perform at a high level. You will be a better student after you take him.

Favorite professor at SMU as told by several friends. He really cares about all his students and wants you to succeed. He made his lectures extremely interesting and engaging where I actually wanted to show up to class to learn several new lessons every day!!! You will be challenged and inspired from start to finish.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Mr. Lawrence is a great professor! The class is very very easy. It is not necessary to read the textbook, but I did find it helpful because honestly his lectures are a little vague. He goes on many tangents and is a character. Just know what has been covered in class and you'll be fine on the midterm and final.

I like Professor Lawrence. He's one of those teachers where you can definitely tell he is experienced in the business world and knows what he's talking about. Only tests are the midterm and final which are manageable (pun). He'll cold call you in class but not in a cruel way. Case studies are annoying but otherwise an awesome class.

Mr. Lawrence is a very good teacher and a very caring guy. He goes to support his students at sporting events outside of class and knows everyone's name. The class is pretty lecture heavy and there is only a midterm and final test wise. Otherwise, there are 4 case study papers and weekly discussion boards. I'd recommend, entertaining guy.

Professor Lawrence is one of the best professors I have ever had. Each day he comes to class ready to inspire and teach his students. He always listens to you and wants to help you even beyond his class. The class structure is straightforward and there is only a mid-term and final. I cannot recommend him enough!

Professor Lawrence was amazing! He really wants his students to participate so that everyone stays engaged. He wants everyone to do well and learn the material. The tests are pretty hard but there is only a midterm and final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Super interactive and great with students despite being a lecture heavy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Hello SMU students, I have been in Professor Lawrence's Management course and I have to commend him for making it interesting to come to class and actively participate. The course mainly revolves around having 2 exams and 4 case studies which are very challenging. The main part is that he cares about his students and really cares about teaching.

Professor Lawrence is a great professor. His motivating and inspiring lectures make you want to show up to class. There are 4 case studies, discussion posts, and 2 exams throughout the course. The exams are hard, so be ready to study. Worth it to be in his class and listen to his lectures!

Professor Lawrence is extremely dedicated to his students, and he is willing to help anyone who reaches out for it. He clearly explains the grading criteria and gives very clear feedback for improvement. If you read the textbook (as he says a lot in class) you'll do great in the class. He is a great person and a great professor!
Honestly my favorite professor at SMU. Lawrence genuinely wants all of his students to succeed. Definitely take him if you can, you won't regret it.

kindest prof in cox. material is pretty straightforward. if you talk in class/sit in the front he'll love you and pick on you. attendance policy is not as strict as it is in the syllabus. also he knows about course hero so don't copy your case studies from there

Amazing teacher. if you can take him DO!! no matter what the course you will get a good grade. amazing teacher and hilarious, I would take his class even if I was receieving no credit just to attend his class hes so funny
He has really fun case studies, but he can be a tough grader. I definitely learned a lot in his class. As long as you work hard, you'll do well! Remember to participate!

I'm not going to lie, the midterm and the final were both hard. The class overall is incredibly easy with no homework besides some case studies (once every few weeks). The midterm and final were open note. Lawrence is a very caring person, TALK TO HIM AFTER CLASS!  He wants to know his students, and really wants to help them succeed. TAKE HIM!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: By far the best professor at SMU. Won Professor of the Year. Dan cares about his students like no other teacher I have ever had. Take him and get to know him, he is such a great guy and is the most caring professor I have ever had. Made MNO fascinating, and loved going to his class so much. Wish I could take him several more times.
Great Professor

Dan is a really good professor. I got to know him on a more personal level, and he genuinely wants to help students - both on academic and personal level. Great guy to grab a lunch with and chat about life/career!

Professor Lawrence is a game changer, the best I’ve had at SMU, hands down That being said he is very challenging, don’t take his class lightly It is ALOT of material and attending class is a must to understand and learn everything needed to perform well The lectures are insightful and highlight how he  should teach more classes
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I wish he would teach more classes. He is very insightful and lessons will be valuable for our careers. He instills confidence in all his students and encourages participation in every class to make sure that every student feels included. He gives great feedback on assignments and is very understanding. This is why he won Professor of the Year.

He is excellent for MNO3370. I looked forward to attending his class. Interesting, engaging lectures so participation was easy. Challenging exams; preparation is key. Class readings were important, gave better understandings of lectures. Good, constructive feedback on case studies. I would take him for another class if given the chance.

This class and Prof. Lawrence at Cox Business School exceeded my expectations where you will learn a lot of "real" applicable lessons to use in your personal and professional life moving forward unlike a lot of other classes. If you come to class you will be encouraged and excited to learn something new every day! Class interaction is also great.

Great choice for MNO3370. Lawrence gives great real life examples and really wants students to succeed. Textbook reading is necessary to participate in class (which he grades you on). Only thing I didn't like were the midterm and final- they were hard and not enough time, but he curved the class in the end. Super nice prof, take him!!

Dan Lawrence is one of the greatest professors hands down, I have learned so much in his mgmt class. He is a really down to earth guy who just enjoys teaching. He is very passionate with what he teaches and he cares so much for his students. The only down side is not enough real world examples and the final is a bit ridiculous.

Professor Lawrence has raised the bar at Cox business school and is the Best choice for learning mgmt, people, and life skills to succeed as a future leader! Classes are very well structured and you actually look forward to coming to class where you actually learn something new every day. What a fun, engaging class full of learning experiences.

Professor Lawrence was amazing and I enjoyed this class overall. If you come to class, do the case studies you'll pass. He is very helpful and went out of his way to make sure I succeeded in his class. The workload is very manageable and tests were exactly what he says they are. I wish there were more professors like him for real.
Great Professor, really enjoyed his class he's an awesome and caring guy. Super funny as well.
Great prof, highly recommend
Favorite professor at SMU so far. He really cares about his students and wants you to succeed. He made his lectures interesting I actually wanted to show up to class.
he teaches the best management classes. TAKE HIM AND DONT LOOK BACK. hes only intimidating the first 2 weeks.

If you actually want to learn in depth about management and business in general, I highly recommend his class. Guarantee you that he will be the best professor you will ever have. He is very accessible outside class, which I highly encourage you to talk and ask questions especially if you have any questions and even a start-up idea. -k

Professor Lawrences class uses the Socratic method in his lectures at SMU. This is a form of cooperative dialogue with classmates based on asking & answering questions to help stimulate critical thinking relating to the chapters. Cases and in-class simulations are fun too. While not an easy class you will be challenged. Seats are hard to get too.

This is my only professor I have reviewed, but he is worth it. One of the better professors out there, highly recommend taking him. Take notes, do discussions, and write the case studies, and it is an easy grade.

Professor Lawrence is a great teacher. His midterm wasn't as easy as anticipated, but overall he is a great teacher that wants you to succeed and get an A in his class. He loves his students, is very qualified to teach management, and is the best choice for an MNO 3370 teacher. Take him!

Dan Lawrence is my favorite professor this semester. Lectures are engaging and just solidify the readings from the textbook. Each week there is an easy discussion post after reading the chapter, 4 case studies throughout the semester (four-page paper), then a midterm and final. He is super funny and knows everybody in the classes name. LOVE. DAN.

Prof. Lawrence was the best professor I've had so far in my time at SMU. His lectures are highly engaging and he does an excellent job of relating the course material to the real world. If you have the will to succeed in his class and not just do the bare minimum, you'll take away highly valuable and marketable skills for today's business climate.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The best management professor at SMU. Dont take my word for it, just ask around. The class is very applicable to becoming a better leader and manager versus lessons taught in classes like economics, finance or others where you might never actually use the material.

His engaging lectures get students involved and the lessons transcend academia, helping students get internships and be better leaders. His class is challenging and rewarding, as discussion boards and case studies stimulate student's critical thinking. Additionally, he is available outside of class and he truly cares about student success.

Dan is amazing. I legit never had a professor who cares so much about his students (i.e. can spend hours talking with you on the phone for interview prep etc). Academically speaking, if you show him that you care about the class and put some work in it, you will get an A. There will be some light studying but Dan is THE BEST option for Management.
Best teacher I've taken at SMU. He's very reasonable and is always available outside of class. Additionally, he is very knowledgable about the content and is patient.

Professor Lawrence is the most inspirational professor I've ever had at SMU. He actively engages with students to ensure that we perform and think at a high level. He actively challenges you to perform your best and become a better student through case studies, theory, and in-class participation. His goal is to shape your mind for the long term.

Professor Lawrence brings a valuable practitioners perspective to the classroom. His teaching style is engaging and informative, bridging the gap between academic theory and practical application. He sets a high bar for excellence in instruction and truly invests his time and attention to ensuring his students achieve mastery over course concepts.

Dan Lawrence is amazing. He teaches in a way that students can understand the material and apply it to real-world examples. No tricks at all and tests are straight forward. Outlined each lecture using PowerPoints, extremely helpful. Learned a lot about management and all of the information will be useful later on. I would highly recommend the class

One of the best classes at SMU. Professor Lawrence is great at covering weekly lectures with his ppts and open class discussions. His class is full of weekly lessons on management. The class is very engaging and you will learn a lot! The class involves a lecture, a few great case studies, a class discussion board, and group simulations. Take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Respected--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I have never had a professor that is more caring than him. He genuinely cares about his students. The lectures are very straightforward, if you pay attention in class you will do well on the exams. Definitely take him

Professor Lawrence is excellent! Topics super interesting and he keeps class engaged with student interaction. Not an easy A, but hes very accessible & if you follow clear syllabus & are attentive in class, youll know what is expected. Highly recommend this class. You will get out of it what you put in & there is a lot to be gained.
Take his class. You wont regret it. Easy A if u just do whats required.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Lawrence is one of the best teachers I have had... ever! His lectures apply to real-world events outside of the classroom. Each lecture is engaging and relevant to the required reading. Furthermore, the case studies you must complete further broaden your understanding of how to successfully manage people. I highly recommend him!

Run! Boycott this professor! Cancel him! My GPA tanked because of this man. He pretends to care but he doesn't care about his students. I was actually warned by my fraternity brother against taking a class with this professor. Thought my frat bro was exaggerating about the material being basic and professor was an ego maniac, but he was spot on.

There's nothing good to say about this class. Don't take it. The tests are BS - 3 free response questions that he grades off of vibes. There are 2 projects - also graded off of vibes. He spends the class making gross jokes and making you uncomfortable, because he's not there to teach you but to boost his ego and feel important.

Do not be catfished by the positive reviews from years ago. He is a terrible professor. He is disgusting and derogatory to students, for example telling a student: 'hey how's it goin! I was up last night thinking about your hot bod'! Additionally, tests are 3 35pt questions graded arbitrarily + no canvas organization + he doesn't teach you anything
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the most kind and amazing people I've ever met, let alone professors. He is the definition of wants his students to do well, gives you every tool he can to help you succeed and makes the classes super interesting while you're doing it. Had him for a 3 hour class and I was never once bored. If you ever have the chance, TAKE HIM!!!!!
Final 30 page group project worth 30% of total grade. If you do poorly on that you will finish class with bad grade. Funny professor and nice guy overall.

Took him online over summer and he's super energetic! An easy A if you show up to class everyday and pay attention to lecture. Exams are lecture based. There were 2 exams, 1 required case study, and 1 final paper that's 15-20 pages. All of our exams, case studies, and paper was group optional, so that was nice. Funny and easy prof, take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Lei is hilarious, encouraging, and knowledgeable. He gets a bit repetitive with jokes and stuff, but he always tries to have a good time. By far one of the better professors at SMU: I would say he is probably the best professor at the Cox Business school
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: David Lei is a HOOT. He was my Monday morning, 8:30 a.m. professor and he even made *that* enjoyable. You DO need to be in class; the exams are based entirely on the lectures, and the exams are very straightforward if you've paid attention to the lectures. Classes are significantly more fun if you participate. Really fantastic professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took him in the summer for the Strategy capstone class, he is an absolute gem! The guy is so funny and makes 3 hr classes actually bearable. He is very transparent on what he wants to see in papers and on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I took him in the summer. Graded by attendance, participation, a short paper on a case studies and a final. Lectures are VERY repetitive and he gets off topic a lot, but he is funny and cares about his students. I would recommend taking the class

Lei is a great prof and a very funny guy. The downside is that you have to go to class in order to do well on the exam, as Canvas notes don't convey the necessary information and there's no textbook, but the upside is that the exams are extremely easy if you show up and half-way pay attention. The material is very commonsensical - easy A.

The class was a waste of my time. It was an easy A but I did not get anything from it and was bored throughout every class. Lei is funny and a guy I would love to grab a beer with, but that does not make up for the lack of content in the course.
Would take him again didn't know Professor(s) in Universities  like this existed..
I don't normally write reviews on professors, but he is the best and most awesome professor you can ever take. Like seriously, take him. Like duhhhh. I'm super serious. You'll make an easy A. :)
David Lei is one of the best professor's I've ever had. Any student would be lucky to have him.
Awesome Prof. Makes the subject fun, very easy to get him off subject though. Lets you know exactly what will be on the final and repeats and repeats so you get it down.

Just took him for Strategic MGMT.  This professor was great at explaining things and would let you know what would be important to know for the final.  He makes class very interesting.  Highly recommend if you get a chance.
Wonderful teacher.  Very enthusiastic and one of most entertaining professors I've ever had.  Makes a boring subject fun and interesting for everyone.

Steve is awesome. He has lots of stories from his experience working. Make sure you show that you care about what you're doing - even if things may not seem super useful they will be later, especially when applying to other CCPA/PRSC classes.

opinions on prof lee are polarizing depending on your major/why you take the class. he was funny but went off on tangents to the point where attending class seems pointless. participation grading was subjective and preferred students who were ccpa majors over minors, which made it hard to feel included at times. class was easy and fun though.
Super nice and funny teacher. Bad at responding to emails and planning on meeting times. Tests are open note but still hard to find the exact wording. TA grades everything for him
Lots of work and is unwilling to work with you if it slightly inconveniences her. Also very rude when being asked questions after class. Plus mutters under her breath.

She was amazing. I learned so much! It makes me sad when people play on their computers all class because she explains everything well. You will talk a lot in class in partners and groups. 2 oral presentations, but they are low stakes (she helps you if you get nervous).

Dr. McDoniel is very caring and nice to students overall. She grades you very kindly if you are a non-native speaker and definitely gave me the confidence to do well. There is a good amount of homework but it isn't overly difficult. Big grades are presentations, final essay, and some easy quizzes. She doesn't like if you don't pay attention though.

Dr. McDoniel is the best world languages professor I've seen while at SMU. While attendance is mandatory for this class, Dr. McDoniel was incredibly helpful and cared for each of her students. As long as you attend class every day (you're allowed three absences), this class will be the most enjoyable and easiest for your schedule. She is the best!

Shel is one of my fav professors I have ever had. She is the nicest person and genuinely cares about her students. There is daily homework but it's definitely not hard, just complete it on time. There's two short presentations along with two exams and a final. Overall, amazing teacher! Definitely take her!!

Learning a new language is a lot of work so naturally there's a lot of work and activities in this class. But she sets you up for success in any case, if you answer questions and participate in discussion in class you'll improve really fast. She is very easy to reach and will go out of her way to help you if you go to her office hours.

Professor McDoniel is one of the best humans I have met at SMU. She is super sweet and caring and is always willing to talk after class or outside of it. The homework can be annoying at times. She grades very easily on assignments and even tests. I would recommend preparing a few days before the test and ask any questions you have about the test.

Professor McDoniel is so sweet and fun! If you show up to class and contribute to class (answer questions) you will do well. She genuinely cares about her students and is very patient if you don't understand something.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's amazing. So nice and really cares about her students. She's a good teacher and an easy grader. VHL is a bit time consuming but easy to get done. Tests are very straightforward. Be sure to participate often as she will like you more. The class picks up about a month in and moves very fast so it is imperative to have some previous knowledge.

There are a lot of short assignments due each week in the conversation class. You will review a lot of grammar concepts you probably studied in high school or advanced Spanish. Professor McDoniel is lenient grader and very nice.

Prof. McDoniel was great! There is homework almost every night, but it's usually a quick 5-10 minute assignment. There aren't speaking, reading, or listening assessments. The tests vary between fill-in-the-blank, multiple choice, and essays, and cover vocab, grammar, and culture. Lots of daily grades, so tests won't affect your grade as much.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: You definitely need to understand Spanish before going into this class. If you do though mcdoniel makes every effort to ensure her students are successful and score highly. Tests can be a lot but they usually get curved. Final was easy. Homework is constant though and canvas assignments can be a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Class is homework heavy with many online assignments. The positive is that tests weigh less. Dr. McDoniel is a tough grader but good professor. She cares about her students and wants them to do well. However, she is not flexible. Do not expect an extension from her or change of due date because other section teachers did. Overall good professor.

There was homework six days a week. Everything we learned I had already done before in high school but it was a nice review. Your participation grade will suffer if you miss more than two days unexcused.
She's a great professor! Go to her office hours if there's any confusion, she genuinely cares about her student's growth in the language.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor McDoniel is the nicest professor of all time, but in order to do well you need to show up to class and participate. It literally doesn't matter how badly you screw up the Spanish or if your work isn't that great - as long as you show effort, she'll appreciate it, and you'll do fine in the class.

McDoniel is the best. Really cares about her students, is very clear about her expectations, and conveys the material in a clear manner. A lot of the grade is based upon participation and writing and 5 quizzes + the final. Quizzes are manageable and very easy to predict what is on them. Awesome teacher, awesome person. Take McDoniel if you can

I highly recommend Professor McDoniel. She really cares about her students and is willing to answer any questions during class. There is a lot of homework that is pretty time consuming, but nothing you can't handle. You'll only struggle if you don't study outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Sweet lady, but the class is very rigorous so get ready to meet every single day of the week. Apparently, she moves faster than other teachers, so if you aren't up to date on your Spanish then don't take her.

I would suggest that people majoring/minoring in Spanish take McDoniel. I was taking it mostly just for UC credit but also because I wanted to learn more of the language. There is daily homework so be sure to have time for it. Some pop quizzes. Tests are relatively easy, and she is very nice and approachable. The class just requires a lot of time.

Dr. McDoniel really helped me with improving my speaking abilities! She's really patient and kind even if my accent is whiter than a bowl of sour cream. She does the whole class in Spanish, but it's pretty easy to understand if you have taken Spanish in the past. The online homework is sometimes annoying, but otherwise fabulous teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She is an incredible professor and really helps you grow as a Spanish speaker. She gives homework every night and makes you work for your grade. This is a great class for people wanting to minor in Spanish.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I got a C- in Spanish III my junior year of high school and while I shouldn't have been in 2401, she was totally understanding. Not an easy A, but if you study the material she tells you to, it's very possible. Overall great teacher, approachable and she made me consider a minor in something I dreaded before.

I loved Professor McDoniel's Spanish class, and I would take another class by her. Although she assigned a lot of homework and assignments, she prepared you well to do well on them. Just work hard, visit her office hours, and remain optimistic throughout the semester! She is a very approachable professor and eager to help! Practice your Spanish!!!!

McDoniel is a very sweet teacher that cares about her students. Class participation is super important. Online homework every night which is tedious but not hard. Good practice. Tests are not too hard but make sure you know all of the culture in all of the chapters.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She is very helpful and wants you to succeed.  She speaks in spanish a lot in class but then again it is spanish class so that should be expected.  If you need help she will definitely make sure you get it.  Tests aren't the easiest but quizzes are a breeze.

really nice lady. if you go to her office hours and semi pay attention in class she notices. needed an 100% on my final to get an A- and i know i bombed it, but still got an A-. definitely bumps up grades if you put in minimal effort. doesn't collect homework.

teaches a first level spanish class in all spanish.  no english.  hard to learn or understand a concept when you dont speak the same language! goes over a concept the day after the homework rather than teaching it before.  do not reccomend if you actually want to learn the language and have no prior experience

Dr. McDoniel is incredibly nice, challenging, and fair. She is very clear on her requirements for the course, and is very knowledgeable about the Hispanic business world. She's great in office hours and wants to see you succeed. Pretty much, put in good effort, and your grade will reflect it. Very useful class, highly recommended professor.
Worst professor ever!! So unorganized and if you disagree with her opinion she will give you a B on your paper. if you are a Native Speaker and care about your GPA AVOID HER!!!

I took her class as a freshman and it is easy if you just study before the night before the quizzes and tests. Her quizzes are harder than the tests. She's really nice and helpful so make use of her office hours!
She is an extremely nice woman, but very challenging. She speaks spanish nearly all of the time which is fine except for when most of the students are completely clueless as to what she is saying...

She is a very nice woman, but very difficult. Even though i was only in 1402, she acted like i was in a high level and never uses English even when no one understands. Her quizzes are also really hard. Overall, she was just okay!
She is a nice, but very hard. She treats us like we are highly advanced Spanish speakers and will never use English. Quizzes are hard, but tests are easy.
Doesn't know how to lecture and can't speak a lick of english. Tests are just like practice test so not that hard at all just needa apply yourself. Attendance in mando
Didn't have to do anything to get an A in the class, not a good teacher but easy A.

Didn't pay attention to any lectures and got an A in the class. HW is simple if you just do it on time and she has practice tests which if done enough times, the questions are the same on the actual test.
