Dr. Lovatt is a true scholar. SMU is privileged to have her in residence. Take advantage of her knowledge while you can! The class is interesting, thoughtful, structured, and discussion based. There are two papers and a presentation for graduate students. I have thoroughly enjoyed my time as a student of Dr. Lovatt.

She is so full of herself and doesn't know how to teach. Talks in a character voice like she's some erudite when I'm certain she doesn't know her field. Not a PhD we're used to at this level. Got hers locally so that might explain things. Better options out there. Take them.
Overall, a really great and understanding professor. Her class was always nice to be in. All readings are online so that makes it a bit easier. If you do the readings the class is pretty easy.
Displays dismissive and defensive behavior and outright rudeness when confronted with dissenting opinions, clearly can't take any criticism,

She's such MCE w her constant need for attention, the whole course is nothing but online software vhl so she does nothing but sit there and collect a paycheck while making weird af announcements, language department here sucks
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take her. She's belittling and makes every single moment about her big main character energy. Sad. Also favors students who are not native language speakers. Worst teacher at SMU.

Refused to let me submit a project for full points despite an emergency. I emailed her a week before the due date with documentation. She didn't answer until the day after it was due and told me that she had wanted to drop me, that everyone has problems, and that I was lucky she was letting me submit anything at all.
Dont even bother reading the reviews, simply do not take her.

Professor Molina was very caring and intentional in her teaching. She begged us to reach out and ask for help outside of class. She was a generous grader and took a different (I think better) approach to teaching Spanish than most language teachers. There was a lot of homework (as are most SMU Spanish classes), but it wasn't hard—just plentiful.

Extremely condescending and patronizing. Impossible to work with outside of class. Never felt like she had her students' best interest in mind. I got a fine grade in this course, but would recommend NOBODY take her. Her teaching style is extremely rigid and monotonous.
Needs a lot of improvement in teaching the actual language, not even sure she knows what she's doing. Favors students without experience so be careful.

Belittling to students who aren't critically perfect at speaking aloud. Will grade you harder if you have a Spanish sounding name. Don't know how to teach and is very abrupt in style. Not worth your time.
I did not like this woman and she could not teach but did grade unfairly and had too much homewords.

My favorite SMU professor yet. Very willing to meet you in office hours and gives clear and really helpful lectures. Homework due mostly every class but it isn't very difficult and doesn't take long. Cheat sheets on tests and corrections after + 2 projects- not a lot of work. Profa. Molina is really great I definitely recommend this class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Super unorganized and impossibly rude and condescending to students. Grades unfairly and harshly to certain students. Can't stand her but language classes are easy here though she's the harder one. Only take if you have no choice but you should have better options.

loved this class!! lots of extra credit opportunities and does test corrections. cheat sheets on exams. relatively fair grader. lots of vhl but that's how all spanish classes are. she can be rude at times and sometimes things are a little disorganized but i still learned a lot and didn't struggle too much
She's good energy. Lots of vhl but that is what you get with a language class. Get a few absence passes. Very willing to help you.
too much hw, lectures very simple tests are super complicated, sneaky prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She can be very offputting and rude when you don't do exactly what she wants. I did well but can see why students don't enjoy her class (it's boring).

Not understanding and will not accommodate students. She refused to excuse absences for SERIOUS health conditions and was extremely rude and inconsiderate. She is the worst professor I have ever met and would NEVER take her again.
Not a good professor relative to the other ones who are better options, boring, belittling, terrible at grading and even when you follow her advice, it is never enough to pull your grade up.
Professor masquerades as easy but conceals a labyrinth of confusion. Preaches communication while embodying its antithesis, fostering a toxic learning environment.
Avoid this professor! Uses outdated teaching methods, doesn't adapt to modern education. Dismissive of student feedback, refuses to improve. Waste of precious learning time.

Professor Molina is very caring and is always willing to help her students succeed. She allows test corrections and extra credit. She is accessible outside of class but attendance is mandatory. Her assignments are straightforward and I think she is a fair grader.
Very poor people skills and teaching skills
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Molina is a great option for Intermediate 2. She is so nice and really helps you in and out of class. She makes it easy to get a good grade with extra credit, test corrections, and nice grading. One of my favorite profs at SMU.

Dr. Molina is awesome. She really values learning and her grading scale reflects that. Tests do not make up the majority of the grade but rather projects. Dr. Molina really cares about her students and wants them to succeed. She is always available to meet through appointment. Homework is through VHL, you get cheatsheets on tests. Take her!!
Without a doubt, you should take Molina if you're taking Spanish. Incredibly helpful, understanding, and involved. If you're consistently trying, you'll get an A.

I LOVED Prof. Molina. She is very caring, is always available to meet, and her class follows a routine. VHL sucks, but she cannot control that. She gives quizzes, grade participation, and many projects. I have loved all the work for the class, and it is totally manageable. I had not taken Span in a while, but she made it easy! Definitely take her!

Super nice teacher, and so caring. There is a quiz after every unit, but she allows for up to 10 points added for corrections, and if you are not a good test taker, there are other assignments to help balance you out. Attendance is mandatory but you get 3 free skips. Overall easy class if you study and pay attention. TAKE HER! You won't regret it!

Profesora Molina has been my all time favorite Spanish professor. period. 
she is so hardworking and empathetic at the same time. she understands the stress and struggles of learning a new language and she is very helpful with overcoming them. I love her

Professor Molina is a fantastic teacher, I would definitely recommend her. She really cares about her students and schedules time individually to discuss course material. Her lectures are enjoyable as are the course assignments and projects. The structure of the class is straightforward, and if you put forth a good effort it is easy to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Molina is wonderful, I was worried about a gap in not having taken Spanish in 5 years, but she made it super accessible, very reasonable on grading and expectations, and doesn't kill you for silly errors, but tells you how to correct in the future. Very flexible office hours for anything(even non class-related, and you can speak in English too
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Shes an amazing professor! So kind and cares so much about her students. Unlike some professors, she actually wants her students to do well and succeed. Shes always makes time for her students if they have any problems or need help. Would take her again in a heartbeat!

Molina is a gem. She is so understanding and cares about her students, and her classes were always interesting, even when we went fully online. She's also super woke and taught me a lot about cultural appropriation and other issues I had never even considered. Would definitely take her again.
One of the best Spanish professors. She is clear about how she will grade, and is always available to help. Doesn't count off for stupid mistakes, but instead tells you how to correct in the future.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Molina really cares about her students and if you communicate with her you will do well in this class. You need online access to homework and online textbook, but hard copy textbook is useless. Lots of busy work, but if you put in the effort you can get an A because she follows her rubrics with her grading pretty closely.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Amazing Prof who clearly outlines her class and grades very easily. She is definitely my favorite Spanish teacher from all of high school and college. Study and keep up with the homework and you are sure to get an A- or A.

She is one of the better Spanish professors. Like any Spanish class, the tests are hard but you are graded on a lot of different things so you can easily get an A or A-. She is much better than the other options, and her class is fun compared to other Spanish professors here.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Took her for 1502, it was easy because I had already taken 3 years of spanish in HS. She was an awesome prof, one of my favorites. Take her if you can

Dr. Molina is a very, very good professor.  She has a clear cut grading policy, teaches in an engaging way and goes above and beyond to work with students to further their learning.  She also makes herself available outside of class to an extent most profs do not.  Did assign a group video project, but that was my only beef with her class.

Professor Molina is the best! If you have the chance to take her, do it! Her syllabus and grading policy is straightforward and she is always looking forward to working with you. She understands learning for the sake of learning rather than grades and is always ready to work with you rather than against you!

I took Professor Molina for SPAN 1402 and 2401. She's a wonderful professor and she cares about each of her students outside of the classroom. She made Spanish fun and worth going to at 8am in the morning.  Tests and quizzes are not too hard as long as you take good notes.
BEST PROF EVER TAKE HER NO QUESTION
She's a really cool teacher. There isn't much homework and she's very specific with in class explanations.

Profesora Molina is the best spanish professor that I have had! She is more than willing to help with anything, at any time of the day. She spends the time to make sure that everyone knows the material and doesn't assign anything that isn't necessary. Her tests are fairly easy if you study what she tells you to.

BEST Spanish professor at SMU!! Very relaxed class; teaches well and clear in her expectations; TRULY wants students to succeed and takes interest in their diverse majorsinterests etc.; goes above and beyond to make sure students have a great experience and succeed in learning Spanish! CAN'T RECOMMEND HER ENOUGH :)

I didn't mind this class overall, but I wouldn't recommend taking this class for your PREI credit and certainly wouldn't want to do it again. You're allowed zero technology in class, not so much as an apple watch, and attendance every day is mandatory. Lectures are 80 minutes of listening to him talk with no slides, tons of reading, and pop quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: he is very nice, says a few jokes here and there and is very approachable. However how he manages his class is not the best. Lectures are lengthy and boring, no devices are allowed EVER, and tests are a nightmare (you're only graded by exams and pop quizzes which brings your grade down a lot). This was my lowest class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've ever had. He paces around class rambling about random topics that don't relate to the material. Only three tests, and the grading is harsh and totally subjective. If he doesn't like your writing style, your grade suffers. I'd avoid this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I hated that class the moment I walked in. He is extremely strict about attendance and phones. No material, just straight talking the whole time. Prepared to be bored because the way he talks is so unengaging, and he may crack a few jokes here and there but a lot of reading and a magic eightball decided if we were taking a quiz Doesn't make sense

Not a good class for a breadth requirement. The professor is strict, lectures are dry (mostly talking at you), and laptops aren't allowed. Attendance is mandatory. Pop quizzes are tough, and exams are all on paper and very difficult. Grading is harsh. Consider other options if you're not majoring in this.

Pompous, uninteresting and arbitrary. Extremely unclear grading, despite somehow writing an eight page instruction document, which essentially boils down to "answer the question." Has a wonderful way of writing sentences over sixty words long that could be ten words. Berates questions. Worst of all, nothing is relevant to law school at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do NOT take this class for breadth. I hate teachers that have a power trip and grade u like this is some subject you have a masters degree in. lectures are so boring (he stands there and talks at u for 80 mins), no laptops, attendance mandatory. Pop quizzes on readings and extremely difficult, on-paper exams. Grading is SO harsh. Take someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't take his class for the ethics requirement. He bans all electronics, class recordings & earbuds included, but that's not even the worst part. His tests are all written (with over 1k words per test), grades tough, and you dont get good feedback on what you get wrong. If you give it effort & show up, you won't fail, but it's miserable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Robinson is quite frankly one of the worst professors here. He talks the entire class, basically an open convo that nobody seems to care about. When someone answers his question it always goes both ways so no one even bothers asking again. He got mad in class when people would talk about what he is teaching because he is such a poor teacher.
Awesome guy. His jokes are funny. Concepts are enjoyable. "My wife tends to kill a lot of her patients at work." The class sits shocked. "...she's a veterinarian." 10/10 Prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Had him for intro to ethics. One of my most difficult classes. If u need to take him, just make sure u go to office hours and show u care. Otherwise, no hope in doing well. VERY difficult tests and pop quizzes. Do not miss class or youll miss a pop quiz and get a 0. Also no phones or computers are allowed in class. And you have to participate.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: do NOT recommend. he is kooky and typical philosophy teacher personality. writes on board for lectures and take notes of everything. most boring and sleepable class and he can be very mean. must produce paragraphs from lectures WORD FOR WORD on exams and you are marked off if you miss a single word or use a synonym. reading pop quizzes. JUST NO
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Robinson is a decent man, but he for some reason gets confused as to why kids get bored in his class... maybe because you talk for 90 minutes straight, every day... Anyway, he is completely not understanding and very inflexible. If you try to ask for any for of assistance or adjustment to anything, he will tell you no, and enjoy doing it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Robinson is a nice guy, but the class was so boring. There were 7 quizzes and 3 exams. He did give you a work sheet of about 50 questions and 25 or so of those questions would be on the exam. So you could do the exam beforehand pretty much.

Professor Robinson made me dread Tuesday's and Thursday's. If you have your camera off for a SECOND you will be counted absent. If you get more that 6 absences you automatically fail, or he'll send you to a therapist and if you do not go, he will fail you. Also if your face is not centered you will be counted as absent. SNOOZE FEST!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took this class as CC fulfillment, it was quite enjoyable. Professor Robinson loves it when students participate in discussion and is always happy to explain any topic in detail that you may not understand. Just be present in class, he often gives answers to tests and quizzes in his lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Thinks he's really smart and gets angry when students ask questions he doesn't know how to answer. Lots of reading with confusing lectures. Tests all short answer & essay q's. Turn your camera off for 1 minute you will be counted absent. He takes attendance very seriously, doesn't care if you are extremely ill or dealing with other circumstances.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I don't understand the negative comments about Professor Robinson. I loved this class! I took it to fulfill a UC requirement and found the material to be very interesting and engaging. As long as you do the readings, prepare for tests, and participate in class conversations, then its actually a pretty easy and enjoyable class. I highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Participation will be reflected in your final grade, so do the assigned readings (6 pop quizzes) and don't be afraid to participate in class. Every class is a lecture and you should be taking notes. Lectures are pretty boring. Hes a tough grader on tests. I went to class and took good notes and got B's on tests. Participation got me to an A-.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Seems like an okay guy. Lectures are very boring, and students fall asleep. Test grading is unclear, and prep is unreasonable for a 1000 level course that is required
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If you attend and participate, there is a huge curve on your grade (mine was 11%). There are pop quizzes, but they don't really matter (I got 50's on almost all) and have no relation to the tests. He gives you the test questions before you take the test, so pre-write your answers & get them approved in office hours. Talk in class and you are good.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Terrible teacher. Incredibly hard class for a 1,000 level class, inaccessible outside of class which is inexcusable at a small school, and overall just boring and overly harsh. Avoid his class as if it were the plague
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: just don't. if you're a philosophy major thats one thing, but if you're just taking this to fulfill philosophy requirement - choose an easier class. this intro level course is unnecessarily difficult and ridiculously boring. my gpa would be perfect if it wasn't for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I'm a philosophy major who has taken several advanced level philosphy courses. This introductory philosophy course was more difficult than any of the advanced level ones. The exams in this class were extremely extensive and required extensive prep. Unless you have a profound interest in ethics, I would advise you to avoid this class at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: I studied for so many hours before the test and got an 80. He gives you the questions before tests but they are very difficult. He gives pop quizzes on the reading, a lot of reading. Luckily no final but there is a paper

Lectures can be very dry and long.  Falling asleep occurs on a regular basis.  He gives you extra credit if you miss no more than 2 classes and if you actively participate in class.  Overall, it's pretty boring, but also very easy.  If you're looking for an easy A and you don't mind sitting through long lectures, then go for it.

Robinson was an awesome professor to me. Show up to class, pay attention and take notes and the class is very easy. Readings really become optional if you just listen to what he says and take decent notes to study.

Eh, if you pay attention and don't fall asleep during his lectures and awkward pauses you'll pass. He doesn't really care for your opinion during papers and tests, so long as you explain whatever the answer to the questions is. Hard grader. Take very good notes.
VERY TEDIOUS CLASS. Painful to listen to him- but if you go ask questions he will help you. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND TAKING THIS CLASS HOWEVER

He is an extremely hard grader for no apparent reason. He absolutely hates when you question any of the theories or arguments. He leaves long pauses that are awkward. Don't expect an easy A for this pillar class. AKA there are much easier teachers and it wasn't worth taking.
Robinson's grading is unfair and vague. Lectures are not boring and despite other reviews, he does not let you take notes into the exam. Stay away from this clas

Professor Robinson provides excellent instruction in his introductory level ethics class. I found his grading fair, as he made his criteria and expectations clear before each exam. He even provides extra credit opportunities (via blackboard study sessions), and is more than willing to assist during office hours. I highly recommend him.

Robinson is a great professor. Covers interesting topics.Usually a funny lecturer. Gives you each exam, just doesn't tell you exactly which prompt will be chosen. Even lets you bring in notes into the test. Does grade grade kind of hard.
I enjoyed his course. Interesting readings that are not too long. Class discussion is usually solid and I did not find him to be too tough of a grader.

Worst professor I?ve ever had.  I?m usually an A student.  Numerous professors have tried to recruit me to be a philosophy major.  His pretentious air belittles his students.  His grading is overly harsh?our class?s average participation was an 83.  His grading is arbitrary with no reason why.  He is unavailable and often never responds to email.

He was sooo not helpful at all.  I thought the class would be so interesting but he made the class terrible. He's the kind of teacher who will mark your answer wrong for writing "was" instead of "were" when it doesnt change the context of what your saying. My best friend had straight A's that semester except he gave her a B. and he won't help you.

Thought the class would be very interesting. 1st sem to teach for Prof. Robinson. Not a very good lecturer. Maybe more practice will help. I think he's an adjunct (PT). Stdts have told me that other PHIL1318 classes were interesting so it has to be this prof that makes this class suck! Take someone else!!  Trust me!

My friends who have other teachers love the class. The class sounded interesting, but he just makes it unbearable! I had him in his first year teaching (Fall '06), and he's nothing like the other teachers. Take the class, but DON'T get WLR!

Only graded on exams, no assignments or anything else in grade book. Exams are extremely specific and precise, and most of the time you have to select the wrong answer which is really tricky. This class was my first C in my academic career. He is a really nice guy and you can earn his respect, just an insanely hard class.
Super challenging course. He isn't very kind or offering of any extra credit oppurtunities. Unsure as to how he still has his tenure.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wildly rude. Incredibly difficult to receive feedback from. Will call you out during lectures and make a mockery of you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Manzetti is a very tough professor, who has a lot of funny stories and anecdotes, but requires a lot of reading and has very heavy lectures. He's a sixty year old man named Luigi from Italy, you get exactly what you expect with that. Someone else said don't wear a hat, DO NOT WEAR A HAT. And don't ask him personal questions, or sound like an idiot.

Luigi is a fun guy outside of class but at the same time he can be very condescending given his elite background. He is a TOUGH GRADER. Slamming the laptop and shouting to one of his favorites everyday but I didn't mind him being a notorious dictator in the classroom. It's really up to you whether you don't mind or you hate him.

Manzetti's class is very difficult if you do not have enough outside time to read all of the materials and study for the quizzes. There's a quiz every week, and they impact your grade a lot. There's only one paper, and 2 exams, so quizzes are really important.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very knowledgable professor. I found the work load to be unbearable at times. 100 pages of reading for quizzes that have obscure questions that are stretched from multiple topics. Not very respectful towards others as well.

Manzetti is a walking meme, and just hearing his name makes me laugh.  He's an A+ academic and a B+ lecturer, easily distracted and has some interesting and tangentially related anecdotes to share.  He can get lazy at times, which usually manifests with lousy powerpoints.  Pretty tough grader, but it could be worse. Don't wear a hat lol

I will give credit where credit is due; Dr. Manzetti is a brilliant man. But, he is one of the meanest human beings on the face of the planet. He bullies students in class to the point where we pee our pants every time he calls on us. He is completely unreasonable with grades. He is inaccessible as a professor. If you hate yourself, take Manzetti.
Manzetti deserves hard respects for his academic work, nevertheless as a professor he disparages any sort of conversation, or view-point outside his.

I cannot warn against taking a class with Manzetti enough. So egotistical and doesn't seem to care about his students or have any interest in teaching. Lectures are dull and straight from the slides, which you have to have already read before class for a quiz with niche questions. No clear grading criteria and not very respectful. 1/10.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took this class as a summer course and was appalled by how biased his teaching is. It seems as though he is trying to brainwash his students to agree with his political view. The movies are boring and repeat the same thing and the daily quizzes are incredibly specific even though the movies are 2 hours and contain a lot of information.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hard professor, really makes you work for the grade. Manzetti expects a lot from you, demands respect, and quite frankly he deserves it. He is the most experienced professor that I have had. I appreciate his course tremendously. Show up, Read, and do the work. He seems intimidating, he is. However, if you approach him and talk to him he's great.

Awful. You're graded on very few things (quiz average grade from 9 quizzes, term paper, midterm, final) and you're expected to know EVERYTHING. You'll come out knowing a lot of little facts about Latin America. Also, lecture is almost useless - you'll teach yourself everything from the powerpoints and reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: To put it frank, Luigi Manzetti is the worst embodiment of a teacher I have ever witnessed. He makes speaking up in class a pain because if you aren't 100% correct he will berate you for being wrong. 100+ page reading weekly for a quiz at the start of every class. Scoffed at students in class, yelled at students for taking notes on computers.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Manzetti was not a bad lecturer, but he made frequent comments that made students uncomfortable, and multiple times sent out 80+ page powerpoints that we needed to learn that he wouldn't have time to teach. He graded extremely hard and did not hand things back/put grades up. The whole class is based off two papers, midterm, final. Do not take it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Whilst he isnt very knowledgeable, he is incredibly closed to new viewpoints. He is disrespectful and unprofessional. His class is interesting, but his methods are questionable. He is a really good example of Professor that are only there to receive research bonuses
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Luigi has a tendency to go back to his Italian ways by showing an incredible amount of disrespect in his office. Does not care about students, and is not willing to look over your essay, midterm, etc. Avoid

Luigi is probably the most disrespectful professor I have ever had. Definitely not a fair grader, and doesn't even give you the chance to discuss paper in office hours. Not willing to help, disrespectful, and makes rather inappropriate comments. Do not recommend

He is a humorous professor and loves it when the class speaks up and engages in discussion.  He even moved our class to a smaller classroom for that reason. There is a lot of reading and he expects more than regurgitation; comprehension is key.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Knows his stuff, tough class but you'll pass if you try.

I found him/the class to be very interesting.  he's brilliant, knows what he's talking about certainly.  however, he's confusing in the way he presents material and is very unclear about what he expects.  he's a very arbitrary grader and you have to fight for the grade you deserve.  makes a lot of inappropriate comments, wouldnt take again

Sends mixed messages about what to expect on tests. His quizzes on the reading focus more on obscure details than the overriding points. He told our class to not worry about grades when most people were doing terribly

Professor Manzetti does a very good job an maintaining a fairly neutral stance on both economic and political issues. He addresses the information in a straightforward manner and is not afraid to ridicule you for being American, which I found to be funny. Very smart guy, and an incredibly easy grader.

Dr. Manzetti is literally the worst professor I have had both in the political science department, and at SMU as a whole. The entire class time is spent listening to Manzetti read his powerpoints, and it seems clear that he only teaches for the research grants. Be ready to memorize as many obscure facts as humanly possible.

College is supposed to be hard. Uses a bit of the old school Socratic method, and always being prepared for class helps on tests. Enjoyed being ridiculed in class a bit, it breaks up the monotony of any political science class. I didn't get straight A's but he knew I honestly interested in the material so he was always willing to help.

Mean.. Doesnt want to help students even if you go into his office. I was ridiculed for being an ignorant american. Doesnt care about his students, not willing t help out. Half the class dropped due to his teaching style and lack of detail when discussing the test and information.

Cute in a Mr. Bean sort of way. I had to drop because he is so smart it is hard to understand him. Exams are super easy but he does not weed out useless info. Must know EVERYTHING!!
