He will give you good grades on your essays if you attend his office hours before the essays are due.
No complaints about this class! There are only four essays and the class is mainly discussion/seminar based. Make sure to send your essay ideas beforehand for the best essay grade.
Russ is a great teacher and truly makes the content fun to learn about. Gives great feedback and helps you walk through potential essay ideas. Participate!!

Took for WRTR 2305 and 2306. Great and easy professor. Go to office hours to look over essays and you will do fine on them. You can manage by skimming the texts and not reading fully as we discuss what he wants to look over by reading the passage in class first. Make sure to talk every once in a while for partcipation.
McConnell was a great option for Honors Oxford Tutorial. As long as you showed up, participated a little, and wrote your essay, you got an A. Very manageable for a 1 credit honors course.
Easy a like all the others but he misleads you into thinking you'll get a 100% on things then slam you with a low A at the end, doesn't respond to emails about it either.

Honestly I found talking during class to be difficult since discussions are SO student-led, but if that's an environment you thrive in then I would 100% recommend. He's super funny and somehow made a class I thought would be incredibly boring really interesting. Also, going to office hours beforehand is essential if you want A's on the essays.

Grades off participation and four essays. After the first essay you start to understand how he grades and grades start to improve significantly. Would rather students lead discussion than lecture, so you get to voice your own opinion over the texts. Very fun and thought provoking class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: No clear prompt or rubric for essays. You never know what grade you'll get because he could say one thing during office hours then another when grading your essay. He says you'll get 100% participation as long as you contribute at least one thing during class and don't miss more than 2 classes. I did this and got a 93% on participation.

This is my first semester in college and I can say that Dr. McConnell was one of the best that I was able to take. There was something very special about this class and I get emotional every time I think about it. Dr. McConnell's class helped me through a lot emotionally and his course touched my heart. I am glad to have taken his class.

Only reasoning for giving bad grades is that he "doesn't understand" (actually said this), even though what he doesn't understand is something he told you to put in the paper. Talk 100% of the time or he'll give you a bad participation grade. Gives 100% on papers to select group he likes. Gives bad grades to the rest. Don't listen to good reviews.

Is not helpful during office hours. Said he liked my essay ideas and then would comment on my essays saying he doesn't know why I chose the topic. Essays have no prompt. Participation is important in every class. I spoke in 90% of classes and got a B+ on participation when the average grade was a 95.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: great teacher . go to office hours and hv him check ur papers before u turn in to get good grades
This guy was the toughest grader I have ever had at this school. Likes basic arguments. I don't understand these reviews at all. Trust me, every option is better.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: While he does seem like a nice guy, I don't understand the reviews saying he is a great teacher who grades very easy. He will focus on things that are very unimportant causing him to rush through important topics. He's not an easy A as some say and his feedback is unhelpful. Again, he's a nice and funny guy but just not the best teacher.

If you are a UHP student who wants to sit in class and occasionally participate in the discussion WITHOUT having to wreck your life with homework, take McConnell. He's super helpful outside of class, an easy grader on essays, and doesn't even require the readings.
Dumb but easy course, professor not very smart.

Professor may be knowledgeable but he is incapable of teaching it. Spends so much time on the simple things and run out time or super rushed going over things that are complex and technical. avoid at all costs
He sucks but he's easy, thinks he's cute with his email and someone really needs to tell him the truth - he's annoying.
Dr. McConnell is a great professor. He has very clear grading criteria and makes discussions enjoyable. I highly recommend taking his class.

Dr. McConnell is a very caring and funny professor. He grades very easily and fairly quickly, and he is helpful and accessible outside of class. Discussions are Socratic in nature and are based on the readings. It could get a bit repetitive but the discussions themselves aren't that difficult. Just read the content and try in the class.

Dr. Mcconnell was great! He definitely knows how to carry on a lecture and engage student participation, and gives good feedback on essays. Definitely email him your essays before turning in - he'll give you feedback beforehand! I spent the amount of time I think I should have spent on UHP WRTR.

Dr. Russ is a great professor! However, he grades very strictly and his feedback is not very helpful. You have to go to his office hours to understand how you can improve on your essays. Participation in class is very easy because the lectures are super fun and and the reading are actually interesting. Overall, would highly recommend his class!

Dr. McConnell is one of the best WRTR teachers in SMU. Classes are discussion-based and student-led. The readings are light and the essays are easy. He is always available to review your essay drafts and provides detailed, helpful feedback. He makes the class very entertaining, though the energy entirely depends on the class itself.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. McConnell is a great professor. His classes are discussion-based, so attendance and participation are extremely important. He allows for a lot of freedom when writing the essays, and is a very fair grader who provides detailed feedback on every essay written (4 total). I highly recommend taking his class.

Took him for honors. Participation and attendance definitely matter so prepare to read the material and talk in class. However, he is very understanding and willing to work with you. He gives great feedback on papers and has clear grading criteria so use his office hours. Super entertaining lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Russ is a good choice for UHP WRTR. The class is unenjoyable, but he tends to give good grades towards the end of the semester or if you go to office hours.

McConnell is much better in the second semester because the material is a lot more engaging. His office hours are great, but they can get busy. Emailing him your essay drafts is key to getting an A in the class, alongside ample participation.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor McConnell was pretty easy. He's a light grader on essays and we only had two essays and a research paper. The class discussion was not particularly deep, but participation was easy to achieve.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Russ is a great human and an intriguing professor. Some believe he is overrated, which is fair to say, but he's certainly one of the top honors WRTR profs. Only four papers and a final paper but he made the final paper virtual over zoom in two hours so everyone could go home for break. He cares about his students and provides ample feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As someone who is very bad at writing, McConnell helped me a lot. I attended office hours several times and let him know about my situation. His feedback is clear, but his prompts are very generic. As long as you have a thesis and textual evidence supporting it, you should get at least an A- on every paper.

My overall experience with Russ was okay, but I would not take him again. The discussions were interesting but repetitive because we never did anything else. The only grades for the semester were essay/participation, but he rarely gave good feedback (even during office hours). He's a great guy, but maybe don't listen to all the glowing reviews!

I think Professor McConnell is pretty overrated. He's definitely an interesting guy, but grades super weirdly just based on whether or not he likes you and if you go to his office hours. Go to his office hours for sure, he'll give you a good grade because of it, but overall just a mid teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As someone who sucks at writing papers, Dr. McConnell was a huge help in improving my writing! I got a B on my first paper, so I then went in office hours 3 times for the next paper and got an A. So as long as you go into office hours and talk with him and show him you try, it should be an easy A! He's also hilarious! Love this guy!

Take him! He makes the class a joy to be in. Every class is a discussion over the reading, which he guides in a way that allows the students to present their ideas and discuss the writing. If you participate in class and do the readings, you will not only have a great time, but learn a lot and significantly improve how you think, analyze, and speak

Great professor! Every time you need help with an essay, I highly recommend going to office hours or emailing him and showing him anything you have because he helps you clearly answer the essay rubric (sometimes it can feel vague). Other than that his discussions are super engaging and interesting
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very discussion based--he rephrases students to offer better organized ideas and connects that to main idea. Only calls on you if you raise hand, but poor participation reflects in grade. Gives timely feedback on essay drafts. Only thing I didn't like was unclear grading rubric for essays and participation.
Do the readings! Work hard on papers!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: the best honors writer teacher by far. he is funny, engaging, and not a tough grader at all. plus, i literally did not do a single reading before class because at the beginning of every class he summarizes the text for you. i recommended him to too many people and i literally couldn't get him for next semester. just show up and talk during class!

Russ is a real king. Like literally. He gives great feedback on your essays and is open to all of your ideas and will support you the whole time. He is very insightful, office hours are your bestfriend. He even takes your essay drafts in email and will help you out. Overall, couldn't of asked for a better WRTR professor my first semester in college
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof McConnell is hilarious, kind, and very smart. His class is discussion based, but you don't really need to do the readings in order to participate- he asks super open ended questions and makes everyone's thoughts seem valid. He will help you with your essays and is a pretty easy grader. I LOVE RUSS
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: I definitely preferred Professor McConnell over other WRTR professors I took. Discussions in his class are engaging and fun and he doesnt grade papers very hard, but still gives you feedback on how to improve.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor, very helpful and caring, especially in office hours. All classes are engaging discussions of texts. Grade is primarily based on essays and presentations. No pop quizzes. He is a fair essay grader and focuses mainly on the content and quality of papers, not scrutinizing every single grammar error.

He is truly an amazing person. I wish I did not have him as a FLEX class because I would sadly just attend class online out of laziness. He is very understanding! He really likes participation in class. Only four essays and 2 presentations. Best WRTR professor at SMU! Do expect to read lots of literature, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Every time I talk to someone talking another professor, I thank God that I took Russ. Super easy class. If you already know how to write essays, you don't even need to try in this class. If you can't write essays here's what you do: go to office hours to discuss ur topic, email him your outline and drafts. You'll get a literal 100 on your essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He was the nicest guy and really seemed to care about his students. He was very passionate about what he was teaching. Your whole grade consisted of 4 essays and then participation/attendance. He also graded our essays very easily, our class average was always a high B or low A. He is one of the best intro WRTR teachers at SMU. Take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Russ. My guy. I've never met a teacher who so genuinely wants his students to do well. If you do the reading, participate in class, and put work into your essays, you will succeed. If you're struggling, he is always there to help. He's hilarious, open to new ideas, and was incredibly forgiving when we went online due to COVID.
Lectures are interesting and he is very reasonable with course work

Listen up incoming honors kids: Russell McConnell is the fairest, nicest, and most hilarious honors disc teacher there is. I cannot emphasize how much of an impact he left on my writing. He lets you have your opinion in your papers and the discussions in class are always chill. Clear up your schedule. You HAVE to take him!

Russ is AWESOME. He's super charismatic and open to new ideas. His classes are entirely discussion based and as long as you do the reading and engage, he appreciates your work. Make sure to run edgy paper ideas by him and use close reading and textual analysis in your essays and you're sure to get an A. I'm taking him again next semester!

I've never liked English. Dr. Russ really showed me how literature can be interesting and he truly made me a much better writer. Of course, you have to work hard and read a lot, but he is a huge help in-office hours. Hilarious teacher in class and he's super chill. I wish all English teachers were like him.

Assigns readings that you discuss in class. Make sure you participate. Papers are graded fairly - he really likes when you notice the details in the text and write about that. Go to his office hours or email your paper to him beforehand for feedback. If you write decently and can engage with the text you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor McConnell does a good job engaging students, and he makes it interesting for an honors english class. There's a lot of reading and writing, which is to be expected, and two presentations throughout the semester. He starts off the semester grading pretty hard, but he gives good feedback and eases up toward the end. I would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He's pretty easy so long as you go into office hours. There is a 20% participation and attendance grade, so that helps out a lot. Discussion based class. No tests or quizzes, only essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This is such a hard class for an introductory science course. He's a nice guy and good professor and took feedback from students when everyone failed the exams. Rough class so don't recommend but if you are up for a challenge then go for it I guess
Very difficult, bad professor tests are impossible. Not an intro level class.
Do not take this class its tests are impossible

Such a nice and wholesome guy. Only have to go to 20 classes to get 100% attendance. Tests were hard and weekly take home open note quizzes plus a few homework assignments. Labs were so annoying but TA grades them easily. It's a cool and fun class but you definitely have to do a lot of busy work. He's super nice and enthusiastic which makes it fun.

I regret taking this class because it took up so much of my time. He's a great lecturer and is passionate about weather, but the assignments and labs were so much busywork and time consuming. I wanted to learn about weather, but wish I took a different science class. Tests are open note, but are riddled with trick questions and mental gymnastics.

He is really passionate so the assignments are really hard. Alot of assignments so it'll help with your grade in the end. He is nice and understanding. The lectures are pretty long but he doesn't waste time. Take home tests. 7 Labs that aren't that hard
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Absurdly hard course for it being a non-science major class. McCauley for some reason expects every kid to dial in on Meteorology even though there is no major for it. Exams feature almost nothing from study guides, and the curves vary by class causing some people to get shafted and others not. Exams are absurdly tough. Would not recommend him.
Dont take this professor. This was the worst experience of my life. Absolutely everything is excessive. Take literally anything but this professor for your science cc.
He sucks and doesnt reply to email. The hardest intro class you can take....I dont know if he actually realizes we only take this class for cc credit and the 5 hour labs are excessive
He writes his own good reviews on here which he wouldnt have to do if he was a fair professor and made it intro level
When I saw awful, I mean AWFUL!
An absolutely horrible experience that I wouldn't wish on my worst enemy. Don't take this professor for your science credit, trust me.

We caught him writing his own good reviews on here!!!! Be aware!!!! Any positive review on this is likely from him! 

I would not recommend taking this professor. This was the worst college class I have ever taken. It doesn't matter how hard you try, you'll be lucky to get a B+.

Labs take hours (7 Labs) and are overly hard, quizzes ( every week) are difficult but doable and tests (3 + final) are expert level hard. He knows his class is for nonscience majors and that ppl are taking the class simply to fulfill credits, but he is so into meteorology that it crushes you. I would look into a different class for sci credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Quizzes and tests are open note, but need to grasp more of the concepts rather than know the definitions, which is annoying. There would be times we just never talked about something on an exam. Don't get to see feedback on labs/quizzes/tests, so how can you improve?

This class man. Not sure how it is different in person with no COVID but online this class was a nightmare. The tests would be questions from one specific line in the textbook and would be a lot of curveballs. The labs and homework are tedious, half the time and you can spend 2 hours on a lab and get a 15/20. The textbook is a must. Not easy.
He is really passionate about what he teaches and knows his stuff. As long as you attend class, take notes, etc. it is relatively easy.

BEWARE, This class isnt as easy anymore after the pandemic hit. It was nearly impossible to study for quizzes or exams because of how convoluted the questions would be. Steve would also assign a test, quiz, and homework within the same week. I highly recommend taking another science course for credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: he gives lots of extra credit which is nice but he's kind of a harsh grader and you'll be really annoyed with his grading system, trust me. but overall pretty easy, just a ton of work but worth it compared to the other UC options.

Worst class I've taken at SMU thus far. No matter how hard I study for the exams (1 week in advance) I get a C/B. He has extra credit but this class is the worst and I can't believe a UC science credit is tanking my GPA. Only take if you're prepared to spend all of your time on it. He expects his students to be experts after surface level lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Zero complaints. The class is hard but he gives so much extra credit, and there's a lot of things that go into your grade. Go back and rewatch lectures on 2x speed & fill out study guide to review for test. Of all my teachers, he handled the transition to online learning the best by far. Really nice & helpful if you go to his office hours as well.

Mr. McCauley is a pretty cool guy. He's really interesting and has a lot of funny stories. There is a lot of work in this class but its manageable. You'll have a quiz due every Monday and the weeks you don't have labs you'll have homework due on Monday. I recommend not taking lab on Monday or you'll sometimes have three things do on the same day.

took for an "easy A" science class. not easy but possible. tons of busy work. open note (not easy) quizzes every week, mandatory attendance, labs, and homeworks that are not easy. tests cover a ton of info.
Good way to get your science credit out of the way. He's a great guy and is very fair. However the tests covered a lot of material and could be more difficult than expected.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Close this tab and take the class already.
He is great

Professor McCauley is just okay. I've heard students say they are taking his meteorology because it is an "easy A"... it is definitely not an EASY A though an A is possible. My major grievance with Prof. McCauley is that he speaks insanely fast- impossible to write down what he is saying. Luckily he posts the powerpoints but they are 80 pages
An absolute legend. Take any and every class you can with this long of forecasting. Thank you for making meteorology cool

As and Engineer looking for an easy science credit, this class was easy for me. Prof. McCauley made class so interesting, he lectured like a TV weather man: with waving hands and an almost theatrical voice. Please take this class!
McCauley is the type of professor that you want to learn from: passionate, entertaining, knowledgeable, and available.  If you're considering ANYBODY else- you'd better think again.  TAKE HIM!!!

hes a tough grader but makes it very clear what he expects from you.  its not an easy class, but if you do what's required of you and study hard you should get a good grade.  he sometimes forgets that not everyone wants to be a meteorologist but his passion really shows in class.  relates material to every day life making it easier to understand

Great professor.  Passionate and energetic lectures.  Attend class, pay attention, ask questions when you have them and you'll do well.  Not tough but a lot of material so you've got to pay attention for an A.

Prof. McCauley is a great teacher. If you are looking to take out a PAS pillar, he is the teacher to take. Gives a lot of extra credit. I got in the high 80s on every test and with the amount of extra credit I still make a 98 in the class. If you are looking for an easy science course. TAKE HIM.

His tests and weekly quizzes are straight from the power points that he posts on blackboard. That being said, there are always about 25-40 slides for each chapter and the tests are usually over 3-4 chapters so it is a lot of memorization. He's very nice and has extra credit opportunities, but this class is not easy.
Inconsistent grading between classmates, similar quality essays graded wildly different. Condescending during conferences.
only likes the guys in class

Dr. Johnson was a great professor! Instructions felt clear, and it was very easy to go to her for help. I think I went to office hours three or four times for additional help with essays, and it helped.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I thought Dr. Johnson was a great professor. The WRTR classes are an annoyance for sure but I thought she did a good job of teaching the class. If you participate lots and contribute to the discussion I think you will do fine. 3 papers that had clear criteria and I met with her to conference for each and I thought my grades were justified.

Took her for both 1312+1313 thinking it would be good to have her again, NO. Harsh grader w/ little feedback. Classes only should be 30 min as the rest of the time ur writing essays. Most importantly, if you ask for feedback in class, she'll say that your paper is god and looks good but then when u get the grade back, it is the complete opposite.
She is super nice and class is chill but sometimes it is hard to tell what she wants in your paper but she is super easy to go in too but goo with questions and she's helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: As another review said, she's incredibly condescending unless you're on her good side. She's a nice teacher, it's just evident she likes some students more than others. Average grader, if you try you will get an A on essays. Don't ever expect a 100 though. Attendance is incredibly important and some assignments require you to be there.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She was the most condescending and rude teacher I have ever had. I did well in the class, but I had to fake being woke in order to squeeze by. If she likes you, your golden. If not, pray.
By far the best teacher I have ever had. She's pretty young and trendy but also very easy to talk to and super encouraging. If you participate and show up to every class you will do well.

She is super sweet and as long as you are on her good side you will be fine. Her paper topics are straight forward and she would always do a brainstorming session before we started writing, so literally just write what she talks about. She was helpful during conferences and genuinely cares about her students. Would take her again.

Prof Johnson is honestly a really nice woman and she runs her class well, but she can be very rude and unprofessional at times. I ended up with a good grade, but I honestly dreaded going to this class because you did not know what side of her you would get: the mean, the funny, the woke. I would probably take again, but get on her good side.

She is quite quirky! Can get lost in our own thoughts a lot, but she means very well! She is extremely sweet and truly wants everyone to do well. I think she grades tougher than her personality shows, but certainly not a tough grader by any means. If you write a decent paper you'll get at least a B+. She does not have much HW either.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: By far one of the worst professors I have taken at SMU. I took this class for fun, but we had to know the smallest details for exams. McCrossen talked about other professors, was passive aggressive when students asked questions, and ran class like a daycare. She ran over time and added extra recorded lectures. Very difficult and unprofessional.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: As long as you do the readings and participate in class you should be good. Its difficult if you're not used to reading as much as you will do in this class, but overall, she's very nice and wants the students to succeed. I would definitely take her again if I could
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is a really nice woman and super invested/interested in what she teaches. She will only respect you if you give her respect but once you get to know her she is really forgiving. Lots of readings but I actually learnt a lot and she tries to make her lectures really interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Nothing is ever good enough. She finds ways to trick her students on every assignment (even the SYLLABUS QUIZ). It's sad because I am interested in the content, but the assessments are impossible to do well on and too abstract. Also, she is very condescending to students when they ask questions in class and gives out bad participation grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Hoooorriiibbbbllleeee !!!! She's insufferably rude and boring, she's even rude to other teachers but especially us, can't teach at all, treats us like 5th graders, and makes exams that are meant to trick you and hurt your grade. The WORST.

If you can get over not being allowed to eat or use the bathroom during class (I'm serious) then you should be fine. Personally, she's not a horrible professor but she isn't great either. Other than the fact that she treats us like we're still in high school, the course content is interesting. Her exams are tough and she doesn't provide a review.
Not understanding and will not accommodate students. She refused to excuse absences due to SERIOUS HEALTH conditions. Will not take her again.
You never know what to study and she just rambles during class. When signing up for this class don't take HER, don't even take the chance that you will get her....it is not worth it.

Her delivery of the material was relatively organized though the lecture slides could have been more detailed. There were 3 exams and one essay due at the end of the semester. There was a ton of reading in preparation for upcoming class times, which could have been toned down. She seems to care for and about her students to ensure comprehension.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Insufferable lectures, tests are ridiculous and she knows it, doesn't care about students and is condescending to us
Objectively a terrible teacher.

Prof McCrossen is great. She makes lectures entertaining and enjoyable. There is a lot of reading but you can get by just paying attention to lectures and trying to get as much reading done as possible. Her tests aren't easy. Take her if you can. I promise you will learn something new.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: McCrossen is one of the best professors I have ever taken at SMU. She cares about her students deeply and wants us to succeed. It is clear that she loves what she does and it motivates students to be engaged. She teaches in a very structured way and makes all of her material actually make sense. I respect her and encourage everyone to take her!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The best professor I have had at SMU! She was understanding, accommodating and entertaining! Lectures/readings were interesting and engaging. A few assignments based on lectures/readings that are fairly easy if you take notes. There are extra credit assignments based on films. Final exam is a paper or presentation on any topic you choose.

McCrossen is super knowledgable and gives good lectures, but they can get a little boring at times. There is quite a bit of reading for this course, but doing it will help you a lot in the open note exams. I loved having a research presentation instead of a final as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took Prof McCrossen for Jan Term. She definitely cares about her students and about the history of sports itself. Make sure you keep up with the reading or you will struggle with the quizzes. Would take again.

She is a very difficult teacher with extremely hard tests. All together though, she is an excellent teacher, knows the topic very well, and truly cares about her students. If you have the option, take her at all costs. She's a top of the line professor.

Think she gets a bad rep. For my semester, extremely involved, interested in class discussions/willing to clarify whenever needed. Was genuinely interested in our sports news and presentation projects. Not easy class by any means, but she makes it very interesting and fun to learn about. Would 100% recommend if interested in sports, but no easy As.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. McCrossen is very knowledgeable and therefore her lectures a very interesting, she keeps you pretty engaged but they can get long sometimes.  There is a LOT of reading so if it's not your thing don't take this class.  Your grade consists of two tests and a research paper.  It's a tough class but very rewarding and you learn a lot!!
Great lady and great teacher. Class is very enjoyable, test arent aren't bad at all and she curves. Just stay on top of your reading

Great professor! Honestly, I could say a lot about how she was nice, patient and intelligent but the real reason I enjoyed her class was because she made it interesting. If you want an easy A, she isn't the teacher for you but if you're willing to put effort into your work I highly recommend taking one of her classes
Very interesting and engaging class. She really knows her stuff and is pretty clear in her presentation. You have to be really engaged and do the reading. However, I found her a bit condescending.

US Cultural History was one of the best history classes I have taken, even though it was a summer school class. Super smart, relevant and interesting readings, and we had a lot of fun in class every day. Even brought us snacks on occasion and let us watch a movie to better understand certain time periods. Midterm and a final only.

I loved her! I had her in Taos and HAD to take her class on main campus - it was History of Advertising I think. She is a hard professor but even 5 years later, I still remember so much that she taught me. I recommend taking any of her classes if you want a challenge and to learn a lot. A lot of work but worth it!

She's a smart lady. I'll give her that. But I will not take her again. She just isn't very helpful and doesn't seem to really care...She's a Harvard grad and she made sure we all knew it! Seriously, unless you're a history major - I wouldn't recommend taking her..hard tests, hard class. Pulls her test questions from random, obscure lecture details
Very demanding teacher, but very good. Will challenge you. Can come across as cold or snobby, but is very knowledgeable about the subject.

She was a smart teacher, unfortunately she was less than helpful, only self interested, and ice cold.  While you will learn about the writing process, her papers are on only the most obscure of topics.  It is a horrible class and you should run from her at all costs.
Very intelligent professor, but very demanding about comments and insights. Papers are very tough. Worth taking if you're interested in American culture or history.

Professor Johnson is the whole reason I'm switching my major to English. She is so helpful in conferences and cares about each student individually. Participation is a huge part of class and she wants everyone to understand the content. I couldn't recommend her more and these negative ratings are SO far from the truth.
Don't take her. Can't stand her voice anymore, drill in the skull. Weird grading, think twice before picking.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: DONT take her if you want a good grade. She doesn't assign much work which is nice, so the grade depends mostly on essays. I have had nothing but A's in every one of my english classes but if she doesn't like your writing style she will nitpick in order to tank your grade. If you get in a car crash, good luck! She wont care, ur grade will suffer.
Would recommend other classes if available

She obviously grades based on how much she likes you. None of the grading is truly based off the rubric and she'll take off points wherever she chooses. It's easy enough to get a good grade in this class, but I would recommend a different professor if the choice was given.

Had to put in a little more effort than i expected for a mandatory class, but she is a caring teacher and forgiving. Late work is not accepted but it is extremely easy to get work done on time. Just put the work in and you will get a decent grade.

She is a harsh grader, the class average was around 70 for the first essay. You'll get a 10-minute conference to discuss a 5-page essay and receive condescending feedback. She bases her grades on whether or not she likes you and can come across as rude during lectures. Take a different professor if you can.

She can have an attitude and is an awful grader for papers, but she really does want you to do well and offers multiple times you can go to her for help. Her lectures are also extremely engaging. But, late work isn't accepted and don't fall asleep in class or she will flip out.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I loved her! She was great and gave amazing feedback. She really knew how to engage our class in discussions and gave the perfect amount of work. She was pretty funny and very much accessible outside of class. She was really sweet and made my first semester. I would take her class over again any day, and the best part is my writing improved.

A large portion of your grade in this course is based on whether she personally likes your writing,  and it is clear she does not grade solely off an objective rubric and will add/subtract points wherever she pleases. If you have to take her you will probably be ok, but I would not take it again for any reason beyond credit.

She is an angel! I loved her and her class! She gives very constructive feedback and as long as you work hard, you will do well. She makes class super fun and interesting, and is super funny and sweet. I would 100% take this class again. Very good class for freshman or sophomores who need a WRTR. Absolutely loved and will miss this class.

Please do me a favor and don't take her. I got a 5 on the AP Lang exam and am a strong writer. I got an 80 on the first essay and then 3 90s on the next 3 essays and completed all the classwork and still only got a B+ in the class. The class is solely based off essays. she will never give anything above a 95. The best grade she gave out was an A-
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I learned absolutely nothing in this class. In order to get a good grade you basically have to say exactly want she wants you to say or you won't pass. For paper conferences she only offers online visits for 10 minutes when its a 5 page paper giving not enough feedback. I would avoid this class at all costs but if you have to take her best of luck!

I've had her for two semesters now, and she really does grow on you. She's incredibly understanding if you communicate hardships, and overall a great professor. She has really positive energy and I would keep taking her courses if I could! She has flexible office hours and gives helpful feedback. Follow it, and you'll get a good grade.

She is the worst. She'll talk down to you and make you feel stupid publicly. She doesn't teach what's on exams/projects. Her attendance policy is horrific, only 2 absences allowed, including illness even with doctors note. I was doing well in the class and ended with a 90, then she dropped me 2 percent for missing one more class than the 2 allowed.

The worst teacher I've had so far at SMU. Has no respect for students and is in a constant state of being rude and off putting. Does not help at all, feedback is very sparse and she won't give good grades even if you follow instructions. Has more negative things to say than positive at all times and it honestly gets so exhausting to be around.

Asks for creative assignments then picks at your grade for every little thing. Will literally take points off for creative choices that you make on projects. Has nothing to do with the actual content of learning the course. Horrible class and did not learn anything but am just given assignments constantly on platforms that she doesn't help on.

She's so sweet and helpful when you talk to her, but lectures are insanely boring. You don't learn a ton in class, you just do 3 mini design exercises in the first half of the semester and 3 larger projects in the second half. There is little guidance beyond the prompt, so you have to already know what you're doing with graphic design and software
GOATed

The blind leading the blind. Spends most time in class teaching herself how to use the tools. Students feel discouraged from experimenting due to her grading policies. The class is at 8 am, and she will start before 8:00, and exactly at 9:20, rushes out. Does not care for her students and clearly doesn't want to be here.

Quite a shame. Uses online tutorials created by others for our projects. Doesn't foster a learning environment due to harsh grading when most students are learning the software for the first time (1000-level class). Takes 15 min in class quickly showing how to use tools, rest of the time she rambles. Worst part- shes the chair of the department.

Such an encouraging professor-- Cheryl is super helpful and personable. It's not difficult to learn the techniques and as long as you pay attention and try, you'll probably do really well in the class. Her class policies are also pretty understanding. She's a gem.

She is one of the sweetest professor at SMU. If you show up to class and participate, you should have no problem mastering the course materials. The projects can be time consuming but are really easy. Highly recommend taking her classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She really cares about you as a student and a person. As long as you put in the effort, she will give all she has to help you become a better musician. Her class may be challenging, but it is challenging in order to make you better!
Tries too hard to be our friend rather than a mentoring professor, not very good at relating to us, can be passive aggressive when you ask her questions. Ok experience, better ones out there.

Professor Murray is absolutely wonderful! She's very kind and eccentric and will always be there for you. 

Some tips: 
--get to know her outside of class; it will serve you well.
--attend as many of her classes as you can.
--DO NOT be late. 
--don't be afraid to ask her for help.

Hands down, one of the worst professors I have ever had. Her instructions are always unclear, class lectures are unprepared and make no sense, and is not accessible after class. While I was considering majoring in this prior to taking her class, I am no longer- she should not be a teacher.

Professor Murray (or Mamma Murray) is one of the best at SMU. She is quick to respond and help you out wherever you need it. Her classes are challenging but incredibly rewarding. Not only will she help to guide you through your classes, she will readily give you career/life advice because she takes the success of SMU music students so seriously.

Prof. Murray is my favorite prof I've ever had, hands down. She's tough, no doubt about it. She makes you work. But she's also incredibly kind and cares about every student on a personal level. So much so that her nickname is "Mama Murray". During office hours she is so encouraging and helpful. Also she gives career advice and acts as a mentor.
She's so nice and caring. She's really good at explaining things in different ways and is willing to work with kids from different educational backgrounds.

My favorite professor at SMU. She's so nice and caring that she's not just a professor but she's also family to everyone she teaches. She's really good at explaining things in different ways and is willing to work with kids from different educational backgrounds. Not to mention she will email you back in like 2 minutes which is super convenient.

Class was ok. I like the professor's personality, but that's also the problem... She seems preoccupied in trying to win over students as "buddies" rather than actually focus on teaching the material at hand. Too many of us came out of class with skills that were barely adequate, especially compared to the other classes.

MY FAVORITE PROF FRESHMAN YEAR.  She was always willing to help, and she teaches the material in a way that everyone can understand.  She is a big fan of using the keyboard to put what you learn in theory into action.  SHE IS WONDERFUL.  GET READY TO SIGHT SING!

Melissa is literally my favorite teacher that I have ever had. You learn an undeniable amount of theory and musicianship, while gaining her as a friend. Stupid comments yield getting a beanie baby tossed at your face! Get excited!

Such a wonderful teacher.  She engages her students and explains music in a way all her students can understand.  She made waking up at 8 AM every day for theory enjoyable...but she will challenge you.  You must do all of the assignments even if she doesn't check them, or you will fall drastically behind.  SIGHT SING ALL THE TIME.

This course is a joke a worthless as a whole. No final because he didn't feel like doing one. We get the same grade as those turning in items from feburary now. he doesnt' care about anything. The whole class is "conversating" with chatgpt. that's not ai. nobody thinks he knows ai. Easy A, no need to attend, lets us out way early - only positives

Watching him try to teach AI feels like watching someone explain the internet who just discovered email yesterday. Half the class is spent fighting the projector or asking us how the software works. He crashes out over tech daily and somehow still thinks he's the expert. It's honestly painful.
Gets off topic, forgets about assignment, and stayed on the same chapter for half the semester. He's a nice comprehensive professor, but you really won't learn much in the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Bare is a man with a good personality, but his teaching style leaves students very confused. He will go off on tangents, and will never finish explaining what he starts the class with. He will assign short papers with reasonable grading criteria, and he has been lenient on submission deadlines. He takes a long time to grade, but allows revisions.

His lectures are really confusing, don't bother paying attention.  His test are made to confuse you and the class was just disorganized.  Try to take a different professor but if you have to take him just study the book. Attendance is a huge part of your grade.
Lectures are not well prepared and everything is confusing

Honestly one of the best professors at SMU. Very knowledge and you can tell he loves what he does. He cares about effort - if you show him that your learning matters to you, he will work with you! Show up to class, don't be afraid to speak up and get stuff wrong, and go to his office hours. He is such a kind professor and wants you to succeed!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I am very bad at finance, failed every single exam, but still was able to pass. I engaged in class and did the homework. I also started going to office hours which helped a lot. The class is difficult especially if you're not a finance major but the cox curve helps so much. I don't believe he failed anyone either

A lot of comments start with not an easy teacher, I don't agree he tries his best to make it easy for students but he's just not good at explaining things. I felt he doesn't prepare you well for other finance courses.

Homework at least twice a week. By no means an easy teacher, if you want to do well, listen in class often and ask questions if confused. 3 Tests and optional extra credit test before final. Good teacher but cold calls and drags out class from it.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: By no means easy and you will have to work for your grade but gives generous partial credit on the midterms and follows a curve. He is really a nice guy outside of class, always willing to help outside of class with questions. Put in effort you can get at least a B. He does cold call but don't worry about getting things wrong, he wants ppl to try.

A pretty nice dude, but definitely makes the class a little more difficult than an intro finance class should be. Follows cox curve so a good grade is definitely attainable, but you gotta put in the work.

NOT an easy A, but the guy cares a lot about students. The class in general is hard and the tests are pretty bad (our averages were on par w Walcott). He cold calls, but doesn't expect u to get it right. You have to work really hard but he is willing to work with you. He does explain things well and really wants u to learn the material

Probably the best teacher/professor I have ever had. I knew the class was going to be difficult, and it is, but if you go in wanting to learn about finance, Seeligson is the best teacher. It is by no means an easy grade, so if you're looking for an easy A, don't take it, but if you're willing to try, you will actually learn so much.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is one of the nicest professors I have had at SMU. He truly cares about his students and wants them to succeed. He gives generous partial credit on exams and really tries to help you understand the material. The class content is challenging, but he does his best to make it engaging and supports you throughout the learning process.
The best professor I have had at SMU. He cares about his students and really wants them to learn finance. He will always find a  way to meet with students to give them extra help.

Tests are very hard, but you do receive a lot of partial credit. Stay up to date on the chapters and study a lot for tests. He makes the class hard on purpose to push kids toward success. If you come in wanting to learn you will do fine. He does cold call but not as bad as it sounds.

Seeligson is a super smart guy who really wants students to succeed. You will need to work in his class (exams are by no means easy), but it is possible to do well if you are willing to work! He is accessible outside of class and wants to help. He's also funny and will keep lecture very interesting! Take him!

Worst class I've taken at SMU hands down. He gets too in the weeds of explaining examples, and we spend 10-15 mins on one thing. If you're a business minor or not super skilled in finance, don't take his class. He's better one on one, but makes things challenging in class and cold calls. First test he told us the review is “30% of the test.”
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Not the best at explaining material. I am surprised with 5 ratings. Other profs seem a lot better but his timings suited me. Don't make that mistake.
easy A. those who found it difficult just didn't understand concepts from prerequisite finance courses.

Seeligson is a super smart guy. He takes the time to explain things well during his lecture. Fair warning his tests are challenging, but you will get plenty of partial credit points back. If you don't mind a challenge you will love this course and learn a lot from him. If you are looking for an easy A, not the class for you.
His attitude comes across as overly confident and dismissive, which makes it hard to feel comfortable asking questions or seeking help.

Professor Seeligson was tough but I personally really liked him. He is very knowledgeable and very forgiving when it comes to extra credit on the exams. The exams were difficult and took quite a bit of time to study for but again very forgiving with his extra credit.
Good professor. the class is tough, but so are all the rest of the sections. He's a nice guy who cares and his lectures aren't bad. Id take him over a lot of people any day

Test are extremely hard do not study the review he gives you it will only make your expectations worse. The questions are not relatable for what is on the test. Good luck. I heard the other finance teacher exams are easier. Worst grade I have gotten in college so far. I got an A in calculus, so that gives you an idea of how hard it is

The exams are SO hard, everyone always did so bad and the averages were so low. This shows he never taught us anything. He calls on people every class to solve the problems. Also, the homework makes no sense and takes forever to complete and is not even the types of problems that are on the exams.
He is very egotistical in my opinion. He cold calls multiple people per class.
Can be rude to students
I actually believe he is the worst professor I've ever had. Take someone else, do not understand how he has such a high rating
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He sometimes has an attitude. He also makes everything complicated and hard.

One of my favorite professors at SMU, he does a great job at making the complicated parts of this finance course simple through making comparisons to real world situations which helped me really understand the information in the course. I can confidently say that I retained most the information from this course and didn't just forget it after exam.

I enjoyed this class. Professor Seeligson puts a lot of effort and care into his lectures and I think that was reflected in the amount that I found myself learning this semester. As a non-finance major, the content didn't come naturally to me but Professor Seeligson was always happy to work with students.

He is one of the only professors who GENUINELY wants to see you succeed. He makes sure that everyone in the class understands before moving forward and is accessible outside of class. As a math major and corporate lawyer, he tends to focus on 'why finance' rather than how to solve actual practice problems but is always ready to help when needed.

This professor is down to earth, and will help you find your way out of a trouble spot if you ask. He will call out those that haven't answered but doesn't care if youre wrong. Heavily graded on tests but you should know his practice tests have everything you will need.

Professor Seeligson is really proficient and teaches this course very well. Highly recommend! 

He makes sure you grasp the concepts and taht is crucial in Finance!

This professor is very knowledgable about this subject. It is clear he has real world experience and is not afraid to share how finance will personally impact you as a student. His lectures are fast paced and he uses a heavy amount of finance jargon. It is hard to fully understand what he is lecturing about unless you read or do the homework ahead.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super interesting lectures and overall a great professor. Always available for extra help and wants to make sure his students do well. Participation matters and be prepared for lots of cold calling.

Amazing professor!! Keeps his lectures interesting. He does cold call and makes an effort to get to know his students so pay attention. His tests are extremely fair and if you know everything on the study guide you will do well. 10/10 recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Senior —I've taken multiple of her classes. She doesn't really teach or listen, and relies heavily on her TA. Most work comes from textbooks she wrote and feels unnecessary. You will get an A if you turn everything in, but skipping class can drop your grade a full letter.

Took her authentic leadership class in Taos during May term. One of the easiest and most interesting classes, super easy to satisfy HD and CE requirements. You become very close to your classmates and take some awesome field trips. You meditate a lot and just do a lot of in-class discussion. She is so sweet and cares about her students. Take her.

This class has so many assignments that are thrown at you last minute and she does not explain them well even if you ask clarifying questions. I do not feel like I really learned anything at all, and repeatedly felt disrespected in class.

I took this class as a graduating senior who needed 3 more credits. I hated it. The work was so lengthy and she is not very good at explaining what she's looking for. The syllabus didn't reflect all of the projects we had, and she often sprung stuff on us with little time to get it done.

There are a lot of in-class and outdoor activities, such as visiting neighborhoods and performing service in a low-income neighborhood in South Dallas. Having really only lived in North Dallas, seeing the struggles in South Dallas was eye-opening. Be ready to write reflective papers as HW almost daily and participate in group activities in class.
I'm just here to say Dr. Minsker is a great lady. She really cares, and if you have a real issue she is the type of professor to accommodate you.

Minsker was a decent professor, but I think it is the class that she teaches that makes it so boring. It was very easy, and it all seemed like things that you randomly threw into papers. The only thing that I really learned from the class is how to get your life on track. But the learning process didn't exist.
he just needs to quit

Professor Moore is a great teacher. He knows what he is talking about and clearly shows interest in the class. His class is extremely interactive, and the material focuses on real-world problems. If you go to class and participate, you will do great in the class. I highly recommend taking this class.

In my opinion, Professor Moore is a good option to fulfill a CC credit. The content is not the most exhilarating, but the course itself did not stress me out. Go to class as there are random attendance days. There are about 4-5 group projects which he allows correction for and labs help boost your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: never let him teach this course again
He gets kids to enroll because he's easy not because he's good.

Dr. Moss is truly an expert in his field, and he makes the class very exciting, regardless if you are excited about the subject before. He is an easy grader with lots of feedback, and there are no tests, only participation, projects, and essays. Really fun class, and he is a very funny professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Way too hard and there are better options.

He talks the whole time and the beginning of class is 20 minutes of "updates" that do not matter. Most people scan in and don't actually go. I went to every class becasue I was actually interested, but the midterm and final were just so difficult for no reason. It's an interesting class if you're interested in Shakespeare, but not easy A.
Doesn't update your grade on canvas throughout the semester. Extremely hard final. Nice guy but hard to get an A in unless you are a Shakespeare genius. Not an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Moss is such a chill guy! His World of Shakespeare class is super easy to get an A in if you just do the reading and participate a little. The quizzes and midterm/finals are super easy, and he gives lots of participation opportunities. 10/10, if you need an easy English credit, he's the guy to take!
Great Professor, super chill and funny. Genuinely enjoyed and looked forward to his class.
He is the best English professor I have taken
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: A super nice professor who cares about you. Makes himself available often. Be ready to read though, you normally go through 1.5 plays every week, they're usually pretty interesting and easy to read. Attend classes and you'll have no problem with the two exams. Works with you to get things turned in. Good amount of writing is required for the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Truly an amazing professor. Turns what could've been a boring class into something engaging. He is so funny and caring and a very understanding professor! Him and his class convinced me to add an english minor. Definitely would recommend taking a class with him!

Professor Moss convinced me to add on an English major to my Fashion Media major; I loved the class and the subject matter that much. Extremely funny and kind guy, cares a lot about what he teaches. Shakespeare can get dull but he made it fun and engaging. Quizzes can be hard, but pay attention and take notes and you'll be fine. Great teacher!

Avoid this class if possible. The topics are interesting and relatable to real life situations, but the teacher doesn't want you to succeed. My whole class was struggling.The grading criteria is not clear at all and there is no way to do well, so just don't take it with this guy. Don't know why + reviews other than maybe he's gotten a lot tougher.

Honestly Professor Moss is just an amazing professor, always available to meet to ask questions, very approachable, not condescending at all. Will explain things if needed and will work with you as long as you ask for help.
He's a cool dude, the class wasn't too difficult. I didn't read a single page of Shakespeare all I did was listen to what he said in class and took good notes and I was fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took Moss for Renaissance Poetry, which he hasn't taught for about a decade. The early modern period was daunting for me with all the Greek God references and archaic language. But he made the material accessible and relatable. I expressed concern about whether I would do well a month into the class; he encouraged me. An awesome dad type of prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is extremely understanding and willing to work with students as long as they are willing to work with him. Read and understand his syllabus and you will do fine, seriously the most clear grader at SMU.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took this class to fulfill a basic english credit and Mr. Moss made it extremely difficult to learn. He was often late and unprepared for his classes, not going on what the syllabus said whatsoever. He also assigned a quite long eight page paper at the end of the semester with just two weeks of notice.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I absolutely LOVE professor Moss. I genuinely enjoyed his class and he's highly accessible outside of class. He cares about his students, even if it's a lecture of 90, he meets with any student that asks and provides amazing feedback. 10/10 would take another one of his classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Moss truly cares about students and he genuinely cares about your grade. His lectures are easy to follow and he really appreciates it when students are willing to participate in the discussion. He makes Shakespeare super easy to understand and quite enjoyable!!!!

Professor Moss cares about the students and doesn't want you to fail. If you reach out, he will help you. Make sure you read in advance though, if you don't, you will get woefully behind. When in lecture, he asks engaging questions to get the class thinking and will tell you if something has a high chance of being on the weekly quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Moss's "um" comment is very true. He is the best WL prof., but he is destroyed by other professors that co-teach. Let me make it more simple: he gets put in the background by other profs that are clearly worse, because Moss is a nice guy. The darn teachers don't respect him. Sad! The diff. rating is due to the class, not just for DM. Take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Moss is a super nice guy and a good teacher. He just says "um" so much that it becomes hard to follow what he actually says! Definitely happy with taking his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Moss is so nice, and I love his class. He is very understanding in terms of due dates, and if you go to office hours, he will be more than willing to help you for what ever you need. "Treasure every word he says!"

Professor Moss is amazing. I was not very interested in poetry, nor did I know how to read or interpret it. He requires one large Norton Anthology textbook that you must bring to class every time, and he prints all other assignments for you. He is thorough and will explain something until everyone understands perfectly. Such a helpful professor.
Great professor! Very understanding, will to help. Discussion-based class. Doing the reading for class is necessary.

Dr. Moss is a great teacher! He does not make a huge deal of trivial stuff like a lot of english professors. His grades are very fair, and he takes his time in reading your papers. Always really willing to help in office hours. Class is set up as a discussion. Lots of books to read, but thats really rewarding in the end.
He is really understanding when it comes to missing class, due dates, and grading.

Great material but also very hard material you have to really focus. Definitely not for some with low IQ or quant skills. You have to be really motivated. For me this was only course that challenged me intellectually and I enjoyed it.

AVOID HIM! WILL BE THE BEST DECISION OF YOUR LIFE! He does not care about his students, and his teaching is something like giving out a complex worded packet, and blurring out some even more confusing verbiage, and expecting the students to understand. This guy needs a reality check in life. If you want to turn your semester into hell, take him...
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This teacher has ruined this subject and has made me rethink what the point of it was. It is very hard for someone to dislike a class so much, but this professor has this talent. It is a shame because i know he is super intelligent and a good person, just not fit for this role.

Sad that the department has let this individual be at the school as long as he has. Do not take him is a understatement. No quality in teaching (although he probably believes he does) and he will not compromise or accommodate you as its his way or the highway. I imagine he will be teaching a a city college soon but in case.. be careful
Terrible! Do better, Cox!

Dude is a nice guy but he looks down on you if you are confused. Office hours are a joke as he tells you to read directions. Some people are not fit to teach and he is one of them. Take this class in the spring so you can avoid him

No connection with students, says whatever comes to his mind, and I do not understand how someone with his personality would ever consider teaching. No matter how smart you may be, teaching is not for everyone.
