Hard to understand sometimes because of her hearing issue, but get used to it. Really nice and definitely grades on improvement, had a B+ for 1312 and went up to an A in 1313.

I liked her, but she is a tough grader.  I'm not sure if she gives out A's because I've never seen her give an A or anyone with higher than an A-.  Make sure to go to class and definitely go to her office hours.  It helps if you email her too.  She is definitely a teacher that participation REALLY matters.  Not much work-3 papers and no final.

She is very alright. I have always received high grades on my papers before, however, she rarely gave A-'s on anyone's papers. I do not consider myself a bad writer and in her class she gave me B's and 1 A. That being said, english is very subjective. I never did anything in class though and never read and did fine.

Dr. Newton is a very good professor for this class. She helps a lot and if you go to her office hours she is more likely to grade your papers easier. Lectures are very long and seem to drag on but she encourages participation and I would take her again.
very sweet, but not an easy english teacher. if you want a good grade, go to her office hours and let her check your papers

This class was my favorite English class I've taken at any level (not my favorite class). The readings were not too long and we only had a couple books to read during the semester, and they were pretty interesting. She gives good feedback on papers and isn't the most strict grader, but you will still have to work decently hard for a good grade.

I took a required class of hers on comic books. Don't really know why this is even in the curriculum, but the class was structured around students presenting on the reading from the night before for 10-15 minutes, and then her summarizing and going over what had just been said for the remaining hour. all students lost interest in the second week.
Professor Newton really cares about teaching! She is always happy to be in class and discuss the text. There is a fair amount of reading, and she is a pretty tough grader. I enjoyed her class.

This class was interesting, she picked good texts, and while she tried to make the class fun sometimes some of our discussions were irrelevant.  Also, she is a TOUGH grader on essays!  Don't expect perfect grades the first time.  But she's very nice and tries her best to make the class fun.

I took her travel themed class. She assigns 3 papers and one final project. I love travel so I found the class wonderful. If you do not pay attention in class I can understand how she will not like you. Many groups only received Bs on their final projects. Do your work and stay on her good side and you should get an A.

I had Prof. Newton for 1301 and 1302 and it was so worth it. The class schedule she puts on Bb is your best friend.  Observe it fully and you will probably do well.  The essay topics are usually straightforward as well. Take advantage of her office hours and conferences, they help a lot. If you like class discussions, this is the ENG class for you.
Class can get a little tedious but over all it is interesting. There is a decent amount of reading but the class is pretty easy.

She really doesn't ask much from her class. She assigns 3 0r 4 papers thoughout the semester, and one presentation at the end of the year, but it's not difficult to make an A. She's really cool to talk to, and she tries to make the class interesting and involving. You have to take freshmen English, so I would definitely recommend her
Very good teacher. Actually cares about her class and if you know how to write it is an easy A

You don't have to read the books to do well. Just read some summaries of them. Participate in class discussions (all discussions end up being about random morals/values in our society) and she will like you. Offers help on papers if you ask... papers topics are easy and straightforward. she DOES notice if you are on facebook the whole time

It is a class that she takes attendance in everyday. All work is done on the computer, so playing internet games and surfing becomes a main focus during class time. Get on her good side early and you will be pleased with your grades for the entire semester.
This teacher sucks, stay away.  Take Channel's class she is the best.  That's Carolyn Channel.  She is the only good rhetoric teacher at SMU.
she is one of the better english teachers. she really wants to teach and is helpful about everything if you put the effort in.
I have Professor Newton for English 1301, and I gotta say this; she's one of only two professors who actually seems to care.
Great professor.  Nice and Very Helpful

Newton is hard to understand. She does not help with revisions and when the changes she tells you to make are ocmplete it is stil hard to get an A.Her intro course is boring and requires many papers and inclass writings. She requires more work in Engl1301
So nice! Expects you to try your hardest
Totally wasted our time and is self obsessed with her techniques when she's not really that impressive.
Great professor. Had her for ASDR 1300 and 3300. Very helpful and kind.

Nishiki is a great professor. Like every studio class, your attendance matters. When you show up and do your work she will notice. Yes, she doesn't like headphones, but its also a good way to just take a break from your phone. Be respect full and you'll do just fine

Professor Nishiki is a kind teacher that cares about you getting the techinques down well.Theres not a lot of structure to the class which can be frustrating at times. She doesn't like you listening to music, so you can go ahead and put your headphones away. Her english is not perfect so you have to be patient. Overall, I enjoyed this class greatly

mediocre class. I think she thinks that everyone taking her class is some extremely talented Picasso type artist. as in she expects you to be super talented from the get go. its an intro class... the class is also super long and tiring (3 hours long and she'll use every second of it). she gives like a 5 minute break sometimes. messed up my GPA.
Class is LONG 3 hr night class is a drag but lecture is good. Tests are straightforward and pretty light.

Could tell that he is a very knowledgeable professor coming with an international background. Recommend taking for all the Political Science Majors, long lectures, but you can take the best out of it. Fair grader and a lot of extra credit.
Best PLSC teacher. Three hour night class every Tuesday. Every test is canvas and final is a lockdown take-home. defiantly  recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This is the worst class ever. I hated it so much you never know what to study and he just rambles during class. When signing up for this class don't take HIM, don't even take the chance that you will get him....it is not worth it.

you can tell he has trouble managing his emotions and he uses his lectures as an outlet. definitely somewhere on the lower end of the spectrum. otherwise loved the class and his talks as long as you are completely agreeable with him and his teachings you will be fine. coursework is light and easy.

One of the best Political Science professors at SMU. His lectures are long but interesting. If you are a Poli Sci major, I highly recommend taking him. Quizzes online every week and Exams that are very fairly based on the material you learn in class.
wasn't hired for his teaching skills, you figure the rest out

can't tell from plsc1320 how knowledgeable he is bc it's such base information but he was informative and up to date on current events. pretty funny. only teaches at night but usually ends class an hour early. extra credit if you bring a current event to discuss to every class!

He was an amazing professor. There were three test and no final. It was a night class which was kinda tough but honestly one of the best classes I have taken. Very interesting. Def recommend this professor and class.
The most arrogant professor I have ever met. A quick google search will show you that this guy has a god complex and has zero business teaching at SMU.

This is the worst professor I have ever met and everyone I have talked to in person agrees that he is a bad person. You cannot understand anything he says because the lectures are all over the place. Severely opinionated, angry towards students.
His class is very easy and the content is not too difficult to digest. If you read the textbook and pay attention in class you should be able to do all of the quizzes and tests without trouble.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's very chill and makes the night class worth it!

I would recommend him as a professor if your dont taking a 3 hour lecture. I got stuck with a night class and it was so long and brutal. Very essay heavy in the beginning but once you complete those the class is a breeze. The lectures are so brutal though and he tends to go off topic a lot.

This guy is the GOAT. Im so glad I took a chance on this class. He is extremely knowledgeable and a really great guy. The class itself is easy as long as you turn in all the assignments and study for the tests. He is a funny guy who will even argue with you on political topics. Tons of extra credit takes you from an A to an A+. Loved this class.
Total mess of teaching is you can call it that.
Total disaster. Steer clear. Lectures were disjointed and ill prepared. Sometimes she didn't show up. Some days she had no plans for us. So messy.

One of the most wish washy/undecisive professors that was difficult to work with. This is from a Capstone course in UTD. She is also one of the toughest graders that doesn't provide the best feedback for success. The only pro I can give her is that she's a nice person but that about it.
Do not take do not take do not take do not take do not take do not take do not take do not take do not take do not take.
Always makes things way more complicated and chaotic than they need to be. Blatantly rude and condescending to students. Never will

DO NOT TAKE HADDAD! Docks you points if you are even a single minute late. Assigns useless assignments and expects you to spend 6-9hrs a week on them. When I told her I work 30hrs a week and the busy work assignments aren't helpful, she told me to manage my time better. Learned absolutely nothing abt digital media marketing. Worst professor ever!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Read all the reviews and thought the class would be great - it is not. LOTS of dumb busy work and she added knowledge checks and tests. Believes you should have 6-9 hours of work outside class/week and stands by it. She is a nice lady but always scattered brained, doesn't know how to work technology well (ironic for a class on digital media).
GOATed

Professor Haddad is super sweet and funny. No real lectures, we usually had guest speakers, group projects in class or group discussions, or would watch documentaries that pertained to what we were learning. No tests or quizzes, but lots of activities in or out of class. One big semester long project that you decide on individually. Fun class!

Learned more from the textbook than being in lecture. Sometimes class would be cancelled and you wouldn't know until you showed up. I had her for class a year prior and she repeats activities. She grades complete/incomplete and it can really mess with your overall grade even if you miss one/turn it in late. Sometimes it's not even her, it's the TA.

Professor Hadadd sparked my interest in Digital Media. She is a great professor and her classes are fun and interactive. There are reading quizzes that are easy if you just follow along and read the book. She is very sweet and cares about her students a lot. She also does self-grading which is helpful. 10/10 recommend.

She is an excellent professor who tries to make the class fun and interactive. There are many group assignments, but the work is simple, and you will do well as long as you participate. The class is slightly scattered, but she is open to discussing any late assignments or errors, so reach out to her if needed. Overall, a solid choice.
She wants you to succeed. Go to class, and you are halfway there. Stay on top of deadlines, and pay attention during class. A short lecture and then group activities.

She was a great professor. She really cares about her students. If you show up you will do well, and she is very accommodating if you can't be there. The work isn't too difficult but it requires attention. The only suggestion I would have would be to use class time more efficiently sometimes.

I love Professor Haddad, this was her first year i think teaching the class and she did a great job. She was extremely organized and helpful. The assignments are interesting and not difficult. Her classes were always enjoyable and not lecture heavy. 100% would take her again. She cares a lot about her students and wants everyone to succeed. LOVE!
We did a lot of in-class assignments in small groups. If you show up to class and complete the assignments you will be fine.

Professor Haddad is a good teacher. The class is a lot of small assignments but they are not difficult or very time-consuming. On Fridays, she has play days which is a nice relaxing break at the end of the week. It's easy to get a good grade in this class if you do the assignments.

I really enjoyed taking Nicole Haddad's class. She is super easy going and accommodating and you can tell she really wants all of her students to succeed. Some assignments didn't have the best instruction and guidance but overall she cares a lot about her students and I would definitely recommend this course to friends and acquaintances to take!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: She is very helpful and open to questions and conversations. She learns with you and is motivated to help you understand.

Relaxed environment. Hands-on activities every class to see how we're feeling or how the current topic that we're learning is important. Very straightforward with what she wants and is organized. No tests, just straightforward quizzes through the online book. Interesting class and super nice professor!
Professor Haddad is kind, flexible, and sets clear expectations. There's assignments due every class, but they are very doable and a lot of the time gives class time! definitely recommend!
Super nice! Not a lot of assignments, just online assignments that you can look up the answers to. She's super sweet and loves to just chat and hang out. We all love her!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved taking this class! It was very interactive and hands-on. She really thought of creative ways for us to learn the class content instead of "normal" lectures. In-class participation really matters so make sure you show up are engaged in small-group activities. She really cares about her students and is invested in us and how we are doing.
Professor Haddad really cares and wants to know how everyone is doing. Her class isn't too hard and it's a really relaxed environment. Would definitely take again.

Professor Haddad's class was my favorite of the semester. She does not believe in tests and the class is set up to be very interactive. She cares about her students and always has a great attitude. Group projects are the source of assessment grades but they are not too difficult! Overall I really recommend this class!

Doesn't believe in tests, is the sweetest human ever. I love her so much and she really just cares about her students learning. All group project-based and little to no stress with this class. Super easy and just fun and enjoyable
She is super laid back and is a great professor. Grade is only made up of in class assignments and group projects. No tests or quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: One of my favorite teachers I've had at SMU. Very fun and understanding, cares a lot about her students. Class is mostly in class work with a few group presentations/projects. If you go to class, you can get an A.
A really sweet and understanding woman. She's a new professor, but enjoyed having her as a teacher. Easy A

There are no exams in this class. The grade is based off of group and solo projects, simulations, online reading quizzes, daily assignments. There were several unplanned extra credit opportunities such as presenting assignments and tasks similar to that. Overall amazing professor and would love to take another of her classes.
good teacher, a lot of group work, no exams
Great teacher! Easy class, lots of in-class assignments so showing up will help.

Class is easy; just read the book, do your quizzes/simulation, and go to class. There are in-class assignments every day. A lot of the assignments and the final are group projects, which can suck if you end up doing most of the work. Prof was nice and cared about how we were doing, which I appreciated, but I learned more from the book than her.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Caring

reviews.comment: She is very laid back and the class doesn't have any tests. Your grades are based on in-class participation (heavily), group presentation, quizzes, and a simulation. If you don't go to class and do the assignments it will hurt your grade because that is what it mostly is. But super easy class and she is very nice
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Awful class, most students dropped out. The class was poorly explained and planned, with the tests not being based on what he said they would be.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I meant to do 1/5 on past rating.. lol

This man never taught a single day I was in class, instead he would give about 2 examples of the content we were learning and would then delve into a useless lesson of "where did math come from". There's a quiz everyday over content that you learned by yourself the night before (which flipped learning may work for other subjects but NOT Calc 2).

Dr. Norris made Calc. 2 topics understandable; infamous Word Problems became manageable. He found fun real-life applications of the concepts we were learning about. He is sometimes aloof but otherwise it's easy to talk to him. Grading depends mostly on 8 mini-exams, but one of 4 class days is dedicated to review sessions covering those topics.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors at SMU. The lecture has always been enjoyable. Homework and projects may take hours but they are fun to do. It feels like unraveling a puzzle box. Very open to questions in class. Office hour is very helpful if you struggle with HWs. Take him if you are passionate about learning new things.

Used to be a great professor, has now become very political in some lectures. The class was very comp sci heavy compared to other math courses, you have to know python pretty well. Homeworks and projects are much harder than material covered in class. Can't say that I would take him again.

Nothing has been graded in the past 3 months and his tests are insanely hard and theoretical. The examples and homeworks assigned differ from what we get on exams. If you cant grade stuff on time and dont test off of what you teach, youve got to add a big curve. Its just frustrating.
His lectures are helpful with homework problems. The exams are extremely hard and are not similar to the problems in the textbook.

The homework problems are a bit challenging but can be done if you have good time management. The exam problems are not based on the textbook problems or examples in his lectures. The in class examples after lecture notes only apply to textbook problems and not exam problems. His test prep sessions are too vague to help students out on the exam.

Most disorganized professor I've ever taken. Did not have his lectures prepared (or even syllabus for that matter), so classes reguarly ran late. If you go to class, material can be understood at the basic level, but his exams were impossible and not based on any previous problems. I kid you not he changed the syllabus on the LAST day of lecture:/

Dr. Norris' class was a mess this semester. He decided to change the class structure and ending up teaching the 3 different styles throughout the semester, which was very confusing. Some of his course material was out-dated. I had to teach myself most of the material. He is into the theory side of math and did very few examples on the board.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He tried to implement new methods for more effective math learning, but he ended up teaching the class three different ways in one semester. He is helpful during office hours, hw wasn't mandatory, and he provided extra credit problems. The lectures largely weren't helpful. His videos were somewhat helpful. The semester was, overall, average.

His Calc 3 class (can't speak for the others) is flipped. You watch videos before class that are essentially his lectures. He goes over 2 examples per class and is not helpful, as he walks around the classroom helping each person with the problem. Final is 40%, two midterms, homework every week. I consider myself a decent student and I got a C.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Good Guy, but not the best professor. He does "flipped classes" where his lectures are online, and he does some examples in class. Be prepared to be confused in class more often than not. Personally, I wouldnt take him again, but I am picky when it comes to math professors.

Tests are pretty difficult, but if you do the homework and the extra credit problems it is perfectly reasonable to get an A. You WILL have to put in the work to pull it out, but he is very fair and an extremely great and caring prof.

Very, very great professor, but his exams are very difficult. You have to have a very thorough understanding of the material to get even a B+. He is very sympathetic, he just assigns very difficult questions.

Best math professor ever. Must work hard, but class is very doable and he is very available to students during office hours. Also very kind and cares about students' learning. 11/10 would take again... and again, and again.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I'm surprised I passed this class - Dr. Norris has no real sympathy with students who are not inclined to math and thus, does not explain problems or concepts well. He spends way too much time discussing theories and real-world applications, and not enough time talking about the actual concept. Do ALL of the practice problems for the +5 at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Very understanding guy; material is posted online in a lot of different formats, so if you miss a class you're perfectly fine. If you do not do the homework, you will fail the class.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: Your ability to do well in the class is very dependent on how many of the extra practice problems you do. If you do virtually all of the practice problems, then you'll get +5% onto your final grade along with any other points you would've gotten on the tests by doing them. If you don't expect to have a rough time. Good all around, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Norris is a great guy, but a below average professor. He does a flipped class, and his videos are subpar, and you can just print his notes. In class, he only did one or two basic problems per day, and bored everyone. His HW and review problems do not prepare you for the test, so be prepared when your HW and test grades do not correlate.

tbh this is a hard class and norris is a hard grader with hard tests but if you want a genuine guy who cares about his students and his subject then this is who you need. do not take this class if you are looking for an easy A. norris is so sweet though and invites students over to his house at the end of the semester for a meal and final studying
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: We love Prof. Scott! His Math 3334 is a lot of fun!  You will be doing so many group projects with your team. Matlab and script language is needed.

Norris is a really great math professor. He is very passionate about the subject and wants students to truly understand what they're doing. The class was definitely a lot of work but Norris is good about answering questions and helping students raise their grades if they work for it. His test times are inconvenient but the extra time is worth it.

Dr. Norris cares a lot about his students. He will make the effort to make sure you understand and get the homework. He admits mistakes he makes and will always grade extremely fairly. Surprise, college is hard, but Dr. Norris is a rare professor that makes the class rewarding and fun.

He's clear and helpful. His tests aren't as bad as people say, and he'll curve the tests if the class does badly.  Do the homework and the review questions, and you'll be fine.  Aside: If you're on crutches for the whole semester and ask stupid questions, you're likely to be hated by everyone in the class.
Dr.Norris really cares about his students. Although some of the coursework may be challenging, he curves and gives opportunities for grades to be pulled up.

Not a bad guy and he's fairly understanding.  Cal lll is about as easy as math will get in college and he certainly helps with that.  His tests get harder throughout the year but are still easy.  There is homework everyday but you can slip it in late and still get full credit
His class was super hard. All his exams were in the evening after class and would take four hours to complete. Had to curve because half the class wouldn't pass. Awful!
Tests are difficult but the professor is helpful and curved a lot.
She is not a good teacher, very biased in her topics approach, chooses to get political in the classroom where none of that was needed, making for an uncomfortable learning environment.
Best professor I have had at SMU by a long shot. So caring and accommodating, she wants you to get an A. Teaches touchy subjects with elegance. Overall, am amazing person and professor.
The class is overall simple and has a clear grading system. Some of the prompts are extremely broad and difficult, which requires a lot of time to complete.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment:
she is so unprofessional and tries too hard to be liked by her students like she's in some kind of sad popularity contest. literally marks you absent by mistake sometimes and does not account for her mistakes. She makes countless 
mistakes during her lectures too.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There was a performative quality to his lectures that sometimes felt forced or cringey. It became distracting how much effort seemed to go into impressing a few select students instead of fostering a collaborative class experience.

Didn't teach—just assigned stuff and criticized it after the fact. No guidance, no support, just judgment. The worst kind of “sink or swim” setup and she makes every lecture about herself, total main character energy for a woman who has no vibe appeal
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Insufferable lectures, insufferable teaching, and someone who thinks they're the smartest person in the room despite being state school educated.
so full of herself it is gross, can't teach, spends the whole class period talking about her personal life, which is so unprofessional, take someone else
Main character syndrome hard here, desperate for student approval, teaches nothing but babbles all class long, sad

Not a hard class, but her attempts to be “cool” are exhausting. She's too focused on entertaining students instead of teaching, being the "nice guy" trying to use pop culture instead of actual lessons. The result? You leave class having learned little. She is also very rude when you ask questions, do not take her when there are so many other better

Not a good teacher, acts like a sorority girl trying to be popular and “cutesy” while coming across as ignorant. Grades people based on how much she likes you or how much you parrot her ideas back to her. Totally unprofessional. Find someone else.
Great teacher who really cares about her job, best WRTR teacher at the school. Is incredibly understanding and will put in as much as you need to make sure you do well.

Dr. Norman is the best professor I've had at SMU. She is super kind and caring to all of her students. While her essay prompts may be challenging to approach at first, she always thoroughly reviews them in class so that you understand. She also gives incredible feedback on essays and preaches that she wants you to make an A in her class.
Thinks very highly of herself and none of us know why. Talks too personally to us. Not a good teacher but easy. Would not take again becuase her talking is insufferable.

There are only 4 big essays for WRTR 1312. The final is doing corrections on your worst paper. You need to show up to class every day but it's honestly pretty fun and interesting. One of the best WRTR teachers to take as a freshman.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Spends way too much time trying to be liked rather than teaching, talks way too much about her personal life which was awkward, an easy class but you learn nothing and are treated like a child.

Such a bad course taught by the worst professor I have ever come across in all my years of education. She is so unprepared for class time, I am not sure she even knows what course she is teaching most days.
Professor lacks basic communication skills. Can't explain concepts clearly. Doesn't answer questions, brushes off concerns. Makes learning unbearable.

While this is a challenging, required writing course, Dr. Norman's teaching style makes the course load manageable. She breaks down the assignments into chunks and is available outside of class to answer any questions. If you meet with her outside of class, she works with you to earn an A. If you can, definitely take this professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Norman is a good teacher overall but the essays are lengthy and very specific in terms of what she is looking for. I would recommend meeting with her to discuss specific aspects of your essay as she does not do conferences like other teachers.

Dr. Norman was the best. I highly recommend you take her. She helped me become such a better writer and I really enjoyed her classes. She is super nice and friendly and totally understands our lives and work load. She is super chill.

Dr. Norman was a phenomenal professor! She ACTUALLY cares about all her students and wants us to succeed. Take her if you want to meet a good person and a have low-stress semester: she's probably the most generous WRTR prof gradewise. However, the feedback isn't the best, and it takes her A WHILE to grade your essays. I will always advocate for her
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I would say she is one of the most generous graders. She truly cares about her students and goes out of her way to help us understand the texts. She is very abstractive in her prompts but that is an english class. She's also super nice and good to talk to.

Dr. Norman is amazing! She is 100% the best Hilltop Scholars professor. If you follow the rubric for the papers, you're pretty much guaranteed to get at least an A. Her lectures and class discussions were also really interesting. I loved her class!

Dr. Norman is really sweet and great teacher. Her grading is pretty easy, there has to be something seriously wrong with your essay to get below a A- and is very generous with extensions, etc. There was quite a bit of reading at some points, but she did her best to reduce it and it's not really her fault more the general curriculum. Def take her.
Took her for both semesters. Dr. Norman is the best, take her if you can. She makes the effort to know every student personally and her lectures are incredible.

Professor Norman is one of my favorite professors ever. She is incredibly kind, accommodating, and clearly wants all of her students to succeed. She strongly encourages discussion and participation. 
For papers you do have to work pretty hard, but ultimately, her grading is fair and reflects the fact this is an honors class.

I loved Dr. Norman!! She made lectures interesting and actually taught what we needed to know for our essays. Dr. Norman is definitely the best Hilltop Scholars WRTR professor, so her classes fill up quickly. The readings and essays aren't too bad, and if you put effort into the work then the class is easy.

Dr. Norman is THE BEST professor at SMU!! The class consists primarily of 3 papers. The final is a rewrite of the 2nd paper. Other grades are simple assignments. She only makes you read what is directly relevant to the papers, and she never makes you do any busy work. This class challenged my thinking and writing, but I loved every minute.

Professor Norman is a very nice professor who gives very thoughtful lectures. She helped make me enjoy writing again after hating it throughout high school. She gives good feedback on papers, and tries to help out by giving 100s as much as possible for grades. I highly recommend her.

If you can get into her class- take her!!! Dr. Norman is truly the best. Her lectures are thought-provoking and profound; I could listen to her all day. She regrets having to give grades and gives you automatic 100s in certain sections of grading criteria to help you out. Her feedback is helpful and clear. Favorite professor here.
Dr. Norman was awesome for HSP writing. Need to read the texts, but she makes discussions interesting and impactful. Very kind and intelligent. I enjoyed having her this year. Definitely a must take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: i can't even express how much i love professor Norman. if you are in hilltop TAKE HER!!!!! she cultivates such a friendly environment and i have become a better writer because of her. she genuinely cares about her students and is extremely helpful if you ask her for help. truly going to miss this class shes the best please take her over other profs

I absolutely love Dr. Norman! I had her for WRTR 1401 and chose to take her again for 1402. She is super understanding about grades and wants you to succeed in her class. It is a course where you need to be a good writer, but if you are, you will have no problem doing well. She is the sweetest and the course was totally manageable.

This professor is helpful and wants students to do well. Assignments are few & far between, but graded heavily. As long as you read the text I'm not sure why you wouldn't do well. If you're that concerned, I would take advantage of the ALEC writing center so that someone can review it. You can also do this in her office hours. Most text is provide
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Loved this class. Prof. Norman is such a great teacher and so understanding and helpful. She really wants you to learn and is always accessible if you need extra help. Gives extra credit, and quizzes were easy. Papers are worth a lot of the grade, but are easy to do well on if you meet with her and listen to her feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Not an easy class-- very complex essays. The prompts are difficult and will force you to think in a way you never have before. However, she tries to help all students succeed. If you work hard, ask questions and spend a significant amount of time on the essays, you'll be okay. Dr. Norman is a great lady and a great choice for WRTR.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Took Professor Norman for the hilltop scholars WRTR series. Essay prompts are complex and require a lot of nuance, but Prof. Norman details exactly what she expects and is more than willing to help students. You will come out of this class a stronger writer. if you pay attention, do the readings, and ask for help when you need it, you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took hilltop disc with her my first semester freshman year. I am not the best writer but I thought I could at least compose a decent argument. I guess I was wrong since on every paper I received a B despite working on them for two weeks, going to ALEC, and even her office hours. If she likes you and you participate in class, you will do well.

Dr. Norman's incredible. I saw her more than once a week. Insightful in what she taught, encouraged us as both critics and writers, and showed us a wide range of material to inspire. Always found something nice to say and her critics were spot on. Be able to read the stories assigned because participation is a large part of the grade. Love her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Norman is amazing. She genuinely loves what she does and it shows. I would take her again no questions asked. She taught me so much and is ready and willing to help her students out.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Contrary to some of the comments on here, Norman isn't a walk in the park. The majority of papers written are generally B's. With a little effort, however, an A is attainable. She really enjoys students who contribute in class and know their grammar well. She also maintains neutrality whenever contentious topics arise in class - which I appreciate.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Norman! She's a tough grader but wants you to succeed and gives really good feedback on your papers to apply in the future. Participation is a big part of your grade!! But I would definitely recommend.

Easily one of my favorite teachers at SMU. Would highly recommend her for both DISC 1312 and 1313! Got an A- in both whilst putting in fairly minimal effort. Take your paper to her before and she tells you what you need to change to get an A.

I really liked Professor Norman's class. She is always willing to help you and appreciates everyone's creativity. She is very lighthearted and fun. If you are looking for a less stressful DISC class she is the teacher to take. Very few papers and all are a reasonable length.
Interesting discussions and pretty chill.

Professor Norman has been so helpful this semester. She grades fairly and is very clear on what she expects from her students. She is always available to go over papers before they're due during office hours. Not a lot of homework, and gives significant amounts of time for papers. Papers are fairly short.
She's fine but nothing more. Cancels class alot and has mental health days but that also gives us a break. Easy grader, personally okay but nothing special.
Jen makes every class so fun; she's always willing to help you and makes a point to care for her students. She's amazing, everyone should take her :)
Professor Nollkamper is the best. She cancels class a lot and there are a lot of "mental health" days. The xams you can take home and there aren't that many assignments. Take her.
If you are male. Do not take this course. She is very sexist and will treat you with blatant rudeness.

Professor Nollkamper is amazing! The content in her class is a little challenging but she is always available for help outside of class and will go over the quiz questions in class. She understands that this class is a requirement for APSM majors. She gives lots of extra credit and cancels class often. 10/10, definitely take this class.

Prof. Nollkamper was an awesome professor. She was funny and understanding, but it was not a BS class either. You still have to do the work. However, she was very understanding. I rlly enjoyed the class overall. Prof. was very straightforward to about expectations and understood us as students and our outside lives. Would def recommend to anyone.

Professor who cares about her students and realizes that many of her students are student-athletes and are going to be absent. Have 5 quizzes that are worth most of the grade and a final that is hefty but not much homework. Plenty of classes cancelled which was nice. You're able to miss classes and get most of the notes online.

The best prof! She really cares about her students and really tries to work with the student's schedule. Gives really good feedback on essays and has one on one essay reviews during office hours where she gives you a sample grade and tells you exactly how to make it better. Highly recommend!

Are you a freshman that needs your WRTR requirement, and wants a professor that is not only great at what they do but genuinely cares about their students? Professor Nourani is easily one of your very best options. She is one of the kindest and best professors at SMU. Go to her sample grade review days. She's slightly disorganized, but it's okay.

Shes nice, but she might be the most unorganized person I have ever met. She gets months behind in grading, making it very difficult to know where you are at the end of the semester. Her class is largely participation based with completion grades. I dont like this because I dont get anything out of the class. Shes a tough essay grader!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Nourani is super sweet and caring. She goes out of her way to include students in discussions and makes sure everyone understands the assignments. She is always happy to help and will spend a lot of time making notes on your papers for what exactly to improve on. She is always happy to help if you express to her you want to increase grade
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Nourani is an amazing prof! She is one of the nicest people you will ever meet and gives a lot of great feedback on your essays! There are a lot of reading assignments for this class, but the reflection assignments are very straightforward. As long as you do the assignments and make it clear that you are doing your best, you will do well!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Nourani is crazy nice. She is also really understanding and will always let you turn in work late if you need it. Attendance is very important though.

Professor Nourani is super sweet, kind, and cares about her students. There is homework you have to do for every class that usually takes at least an hour but is usually graded on completion. She also allows for late work to be turned in without point deduction so that also helped a lot. There are four essays and they count a lot so do good on them

Best professor ever! I was lucky enough to get her for DISC 1312 and DISC 1313. I've had some of the most interesting class discussions in this class and was able to learn a lot! She cares about her students and is very understanding!

Professor Nourani has been my favorite professor at SMU. She is so sweet and makes her classes interesting. If you have the opportunity to take her, do it. I am taking her again for Disc this semester and think she is great. I feel my writing has improved and she is encouraging and a good grader.
She's the BOMB. Best disc teacher here at SMU. She's so sweet and will make you laugh every class. She definitely puts a smile on all of our faces and isn't the harshest grader at all.

I took her at SMU her first time here. She is so kind hearted and nice. There are 4 online essays and one in-class essay. No exams or quizzes. Easiest A while still learning a lot. Lecture heavy but worth the class to take her. Don't need textbook or books assigned
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Its super easy to get an A in her class but she takes forever to grade things and shes super disorganized. But shes really nice and pretty much all you have to do is show up and at least try a little bit on assignments and youll get an A

Absolutely the worst class I have ever taken. He is extremely unorganized, goes on random tangents in class, and does not post anything on Canvas. He makes the classroom an uncomfortable environment and he denied me of my learning accommodations. I am usually an A-student and I ended his class with a C. I STRONGLY advise you not to take his class.

Professor Noble is a truly strange guy who is extremely unpredictable. One day he can be nice supportive and another absolutely terrifying. The class is problematic because there is nothing on canvas and hardly any grades other than 4 tests on a scantron which have completely random content material. Just a weird class probably avoid if you can.

I saw the bad reviews and was scared, but took him anyway. He is not the nicest and kinda sucks, u can only miss 2 classes and there are no assignments besides like 3 things, and the rest are tests. If you read the chapter then you will do well but don't rely on his in-class teaching. It is manageable but not my favorite class.

Was his student WAY back in 1999, which (I think) was his first year at SMU. I liked his class, and he liked me. He introduced me to a company that launched my career. Within 3 years I was making >$200k. I now make in the high 6 figures every year. All thanks to him. Peter Noble is a good man. Sometimes the class itself is only half the story.

He only uses the powerpoints from the book and the lecture is always extremely unclear. Four tests make up 80% of your grade and he gives a sporadic and hard-to-follow exam preview that does not help. He cold calls daily and is low-key mean to the class and TA.

I highly recommend NOT taking this teacher. Very arrogant, relies way too much on TA, and cold calls extremely frequently. No grace whatsoever and his "teaching" is choppy and talks straight from PPT instead of giving clear examples. Extremely old-fashioned with no plan to educate himself on present-day technology. Made this class very unenjoyable.

Prof. Noble can be disrespectful & rude to his students. The actual content was interesting but the tests were hard and he is so scatterbrained I never knew what was going on. He makes the TA's do everything and he also ghosted us after the final so I have no idea why I got the grade I did. He knows a lot about the industry but not a good teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I thought this would be a straightforward advertising course as it's an intro class. There is no homework, so you are graded based off your tests scores. No extra credit unless you win the extra credit competitions. Tests do not match up with the book. Noble is a very nice man, just is a tough teacher. Does not give great study tips. I had to drop.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly he is the WORST professor I have had in my life. His exams are impossible. He takes 3/4 exams for your final grade. There are not many other assignments to help you raise your grade. You will have to memorize small details out of the chapters. Literally the class test average this semester was 74%. Help yourself and do not take his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Literally the worst professor Ive ever had. I tried so hard and never did good. Terrible test maker. Zero compassion. Dont ever consider taking this class. It has ruined my life

Although he seemed strict at first, he loosened up after the first few weeks. He genuinely cares for his students. The lectures a lot but if you just review what he has on the slides and some quizlets online you'll be prepared for the test. Be prepared to be engaged though, he grades participation very seriously.

Terrible class. He reads verbatim from the PPT when he bothers to lecture at all. 50% of class time is watching groups present, but attendance is mandatory. WORST PART though was grading. The tests are MC on a scantron but he takes a month to get grades back?? Only plus is option to skip final. Tests are too challenging compared to his teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Let's put it this way, I didn't wear a seat belt while driving to class because I'd rather get clapped in an accident than attend this class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He gives test "previews" which aren't that helpful, but the material he teaches is straight from textbook, so if you memorize that you'll be fine on the tests. lots of memorization. lectures are boring but mandatory. lots of studying. each test is equal including final, so if you're fine with your grade you dont have to take final.

Peter Noble was the worst professor I have taken at SMU. He barely goes over any of the material that is on the tests and dedicates the Thursday classes to pointless presentations. Do not take this class if you actually want to learn something or want a good grade. I worked hard to study for the exams and barely pulled out an A-.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Amazing guy that wants people to truly learn about the industry-the class isn't meant to be an easy A, so idk why people go into the class expecting that. If you act like a jerk and continuously disobey basic classroom rules, don't expect someone to give you an A. Pretty straight forward.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: He is one of the nicest professors I've ever had. Definitely get to know him and see him outside of class. He wants you to do well in his class, so you have to make an effort to show him you care.

Noble's class was fine. Lectures on Tuesdays and group presentations on Thursdays. Group presentations weren't bad, if you show up and do it you get full credit. Tests are manageable, there are tons of quizlets out there with exact test questions. If you like your score on the first 3 tests, you don't have to take the final which is nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Noble was such an awesome guy and a great prof. We had lectures on Tuesdays and groups presented on Thursdays. Hes always there for you if you need him. His class is also super interesting. If you pay attention and study, youll get an A.
Literally show up to class and watch commercials most days. Skim the chapters, make some flash cards, youre bound to get at least a B+.
Really great guy but the tests are a bit too hard given it is an intro class. Participation is huge, so if you like to skip don't take him. He knows a lot about the advertising industry.

I took this class just to see if I'm interested in advertising. The tests are very difficult but at least he curves them a little. It'll probably ruin your gpa, so if gpa matters to and you are not trying to major in advertising don't take it. It doesn't even count towards the UCs. I personally didn't learn much in this class.

veryyy boring lectures and just overall really unorganized class. high expectations for intro level class and tests cover a lot of material which requires hours of studying. noble is a really nice guy just has high expectations and super unorganized
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: There are four exams that are kind of tough but you get one dropped, meaning that if you get 3 A's you can skip the final. There are two group presentations as well as a creative project. He's not a tough grader and surprised me with how open he was in accommodating the class. Solid class to take for sure.

Noble was the worst. All he does is read off of the slides. Two presentations that are automatic 100%. He is patronizing and blatantly favors girls over boys in the class. Moves the schedule of the class every two weeks. Was easy but Noble was obnoxious.

Cool guy, pretty hard tests. He isn't great with spacing out a semester, so it might be really slow and then really fast. My friend missed one class and her attendance grade was dropped 3 points. Presentations are easy 100s. He lectures a lot using a PowerPoint.
I had to take this for my major and minor. Professor Noble is very arrogant and just rude. He treats everyone like 1st graders. You can't even leave to use the bathroom during class, its stupid.

DO NOT take Peter Noble, I truly don't see what people see in him. The one positive is that he is very knowledgeable in advertising and has a lot to teach. As a person he is rude, intimidating and runs the huge lecture like a dictatorship. He is not afraid to kick people out of class for using phones, or ruin grades with his crazyattendance policy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: These comments really baffle me. Noble simply doesn't teach. This is one of the few classes you need to read the textbook.3 Tests account for 84% of your grade and are  mc and t/f. Most of the questions are fairly easy but basically you will get B's on the tests unless you put in unreasonable amount of work.I skimped out an A- by the grace of God.

This is a cool class, but it is a lot of work. None of it is too hard, but all the reading and journal assignments add up. You also have to do two group presentations. I still enjoyed the class, it was just a lot of work.

He is awesome! I agree- loves his field.  He is ethusiastic and helpful.  Will do anything he can to help you.  All around a great teacher, anything he teaches will be good- I've taken two of his classes.  If you can take his class in London DO IT!
No Comments
This guy is great. He loves his field, and it shows. He brings the field of advertising alive.
No Comments

BEST teacher ever, actually learned something. Attendance not mandatory, BUT GO, it's super helpful and she usually gives a lot of test hints. Do the homework, it's not hard, use the workbook to study for the tests, the paragraphs are much more clear. Final not required if you're happy w/ grade, if not, final grade can replace lowest test. SO NICE

Prof. Nuchereno is engaging, funny, and gorgeous, if thats your thing. Her Money and Banking class is easy, with little math involved. Expect 3 exams, some online homework, 1 simple term project, and a final, which you can skip if you have an A going into it. Some of the exams are scantron based, others short answer. Extra credit may be available.
Super boring lectures but super easy grade. I barely showed up and didn't get the textbook and only used the workbook and Khan Academy.

Nuchereno is a very caring and educated adjunct professor who is very accessible and is very fair. Her grading criteria is obvious, and the material discussed in class is relevant and understandable. Her lectures are relatively entertaining and she's never too busy for questions. She's always available for office hours, but not really by email.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Nuchereno gives great lectures that are heavily attended by her students even though she didn't make attendance mandatory this past semester. She gives 4 exams including the final, and you can drop your lowest score. Taking good notes on her lectures and doing the online quizzes and homework will lead you to do very well in her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Easy A! She is so kind and caring. Just make good notes and do the review questions before each test. (3HW3 quizzes 3 exams through the whole semester )Would recommend.

Organized lectures, but helpful if you read the book before class. The homework helps you to understand the material. All materials used in the class help with studying for the exam. All quizzes are open note/take home. Optional final and it replaces your lowest test score. If you study and do the homework and practice exams, guaranteed A.

Prof. Nuchereno should be your clear choice for ECON 1312. Her expectations of you are very clear from day one, so there's no confusion when it comes to her grading criteria. She offers extra credit opportunities for each test, and there's an optional final. If you need an easy A (econ. is usually tough for me) for your business subset, take her!!!
Best ECO professor !

One of my favorite classes, even though I'm not a Cox major. Prof. Nuchereno is so sweet and really understands what she's teaching. She's always available for help and wants everyone to succeed. Doing the homework thoroughly and memorizing the online practice tests will help you a lot on the tests. Taking her again for macro!

Professor Nuchereno is really passionate, not only about her subject, but her students too. She clearly cares that everyone learns the material, and if you come to class she will teach it in a way that you will learn.  Although it would be really easy to skip her class because it seems easy, I STRONGLY recommend you go.  Test material  class notes

Really dedicated to making sure every student learns the material. Doesn't use powerpoint or hand outs but instead writes and goes through everything slowly on the white board to make sure every one understands. If you go to class and take advantage of all the resources she provides econ suddenly feels very manageable. Also gives extra credit
favorite professor in the econ department. absolutely impossible to fail. also really engaging professor- she makes econ interesting.

Nuchereno is a great professor! She's really committed to making econ something obvious for students. She was always willing to work with people after class on stuff that was unclear, and her grading scale is easy to work with. All tests are multiple choice, and she stops taking attendance after a while. Highly recommend!

She wants every single person in the class to do well. If you go to class take notes and listen you will get an A on every test. I never bought the textbook and just used the workbook to study and got an A.
TAKE THIS CLASS! She gives tons of opportunities for extra credit, so as long as you put forth effort you will get an A.

Great professor. She gives a good amount of extra credit (an extra 2% to your grade) in the form of optional online test reviews that you can take as many times as you want (and it shows you the right answer when you submit, so you can easily obtain all extra credit points). She gives an optional final that can take the place of a bad test grade.

Great professor. Three tests and an optional final that can replace your lowest test grade. She also drops the homework and goes over quiz questions in class. Macro can be a tough subject but her class gives you tons of opportunities to do well.

Easily the best macroeconomics professor at SMU. Clear, fair, and friendly. She wants you to do well and her lectures make macro understandable. She gives you the opportunity for 2% extra credit boost which is incredibly helpful since ECON can be a tough subject for many people.  Highly recommend!!!!

She is an extremely nice lady.  It is almost like having your mom teaching you economics, that is if your mom knew economics very well.  Do not miss lectures, they are extremely helpful.  Tests are all multiple choice and there is not very much homework.  She also offers extra credit which is roughly two extra points to your overall grade.

Angie is the sweetest funniest most caring teacher you will ever have. She wants her students to be successful and that shows everyday. She will make you love the language even more and help you get a good grade in the course.

Angie is hands down the best professor I've had at SMU. The best part about her is that she has the unique ability to make a Spanish class feel like a family! She provides a safe, fun, funny, and interesting classroom environment and makes sure that every student is engaged and understands the material. It's a shame I can't have her again for 2401!
Very caring and understanding professor. She is also very organized and knowledgable about what she teaches. She is great at explaining hard verb tenses and is very approachable in office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Angie is the best Spanish professor I have ever had! she really cares about everyone participating and feeling comfortable speaking Spanish. She expects you to learn, but is very fair and works with each student. She is also the sweetest lady and so funny! I could not imagine a better teacher and I would recommend her to everyone.

Angie is an amazing Spanish professor.  She is extremely approachable, caring, and knowledgable. Very smart but has a huge heart and motivates every student to put forth their best effort. I learned more from her in one semester than I did in three years of high school Spanish--and I enjoyed every minute of it!
Definitely take Angie, she's the best. You must be involved during class time, but if you do that you'll do well.

By far my favorite Spanish teacher taken so far.  I took her ways of knowing Spanish class in Spain over the summer and she inspired me to continue in my spanish minor.  Really cares about her students and if you show her that you are putting in effort you can easily get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: TAKE HER TAKE HER TAKE HER TAKE HER TAKE HER. She's awesome. Great teacher, great person. I actually felt productive with this class and that had a lot to do with the fact that she likes to keep things fun and exciting, so it keeps you engaged in the class/lectures and assignments. I wish she taught more classes. I would 100% take her again.

Angie is an incredible educator. She genuinely cares about the well-being of us! At the same time, she expects hard work and the most out of her students. She is a refreshing break from the cookie-cutter, "check the box" style teacher. Because of this, she has inspired me to continue  on with Spanish as a minor and possible double major!

Angie really has a passion for languages, and she wants her students to feel the same. Very down to earth teaching and will be happy to explain things to you if you put in the work to try to learn it. Highly recommend this class.
angie is great, explains things as well as she can, small classes, and she's hilarious. definitely take

Angie was an absolute blessing as a first year. She's hilarious, friendly, super sweet, and really cares. Does tease but if she thinks she crossed a line she apologizes, but it's all in good fun because she'll poke fun at her own accent! Cancels class a lot & once dropped a test and re-explained material instead of letting us all fail. Love her!!!

Profe Nozaleda is honestly such a treat to have. She's extremely nice, very understanding, and always open to help. I've spoken with her personally about non-school things and she's just a genuine person. Sometimes difficult to understand because of language barrier, but usually not an issue. I would do whatever I could to have her as a professor.
Angie really cares about her students and students love her. She gets easily distracted which makes class interesting.

Sometimes she was not very clear but if you ask questions she will explain everything. She was a great help with everything. She says you can't turn things in late but sometimes you can scoot around that.
Angie is such a kind professor. She keeps class incredibly entertaining and engages students with the material. Take her class! Angie is always there to help and I recommend taking her class!

She keeps you on your feet with participation and calls people out for not paying attention. The one time I missed I told her I didn't feel well and she made an example of me! It got to the point where we didn't have class every other Friday and the other Friday classes lasted 20 mins. She acts very flirtatious and fun as well. Tests are doable.

Learning should not be a chore. Her class makes this clear. Ive never learned so much without realizing. Do the reading and show up to speak and you will be fine. She is flexible about the syllabus so shifts things around as we go (may not work for everyone, but I didn't have a problem with that). I would suggest her class to anyone!

She's so hot. But that aside, she is awesome at teaching your spanish. She is incredibly personable. If you take her class, speak to her as another human being that you joke and have fun with and you will have a ball in class everyday.She will negotiate about moving quizzes to certain days and homework and all. She is very flirtatious and fun.
Easy teacher but extremely unorganized, never follows the syllabus but shes hilarious

Luved Spanish, til Angie ruined it 4 me. She is AWFUL!So mean! Schedules test day b4 tgiving break so you can't leave early.Unclear in assignments,emails u that day about tests&hw.My aunt was dying from cancer&she yelled @ me in front of entire class about missing class.Then said I didnt do hw&I showed her all my complete hw&never apologized.Awful!

Angie is soooo sweet and helpful! She can be a teaser, which seems to embarrass kids, but if you keep up with your homework, you'll be fine. She's a fair grader although she does expect everybody to work their hardest. Can't wait to have her for 2401!
Angie is an amazing teacher. She is helpful and kind. and If you have something going on and talk to her so is totally understandable!! Take her FOR SURE!
Great teacher. She is so cute and fun. Best spanish teacher ever. She is my favorite professor at SMU. Class is so fun and interesting.
she's the best spanish teacher I've ever had
Best Spanish teacher I have had.  Throughout the class she has been a great help.
She seems nice but if you actually ask her for help she will call you stupid and tell you to figure it out yourself. Nice lady but horrible professor. Chooses favorites in class as well.
The cutest woman ever. She is so funny, always smiles and laughs and keeps the class fun. TAKE HER!!

Great professor--very helpful, clear and entertaining.  She does her job to prepare you for quizzes, tests, and is fair.  Class is interesting and easy, and she cares about her work and her students.  Take her for SPAN 1402
She is the best teacher I have ever had. She loves to laugh and class is really fun. Shes awesome.
Angie is the best Spanish teacher.  If you have a question about anything..she will help you out.  She also cancels class frequently.

Dr. Armeanu is a great professor. Her class is difficult, but I think mostly this is because of my lack of knowledge about current events. Her lectures require you to know about things going on in the world or else you will be lost. Barely any homework, just quizzes every week and the reading. I definitely recommend her!

I agree with some things people above have said but disagree with how much she knows about the subject. She is full of knowledge it is just difficult to get it out of her. I am usually interested in the lecture and she is very genuine when it comes to conveying the information. I am not a PLSC major but for other majors... I wouldn't shy away.
Has a hard time speaking english. easy class. VERY boring. Does not seem very knowledgeable, but that may be a result of her inability to speak english. I woud not take this class again.
she is a nice person, but her class is very borring

shes reads strait from the overhead.  you have to go to class or she takes points from your average.  its insanely borring.  but i usually daze into space and i wrote my research paper the morning it was due and i still have an A.
No Comments

Olga is so sweet, she loves teaching and is so kind to students. She is also extremely knowledgeable about the class material, which comes across in her lectures. Her class isn't necessarily hard, it's just super work-heavy - there is a research paper, 2 tests, HW every class, pop quizzes, and attendance is mandatory. But in the end, you'll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Colbert is the sweetest lady ever! This class was a bit boring and participation definitely matters. In fact, she has you rate your classmates at the end of the semester...interesting choice. She also is a rather quick speaker, so if you have trouble catching on quickly, you might be a little bit behind in terms of class discussions.

I took her for SPAN4302, which is a requirement for the major. I wouldn't have taken the class if I didn't need to, but Professor Colbert made it somewhat enjoyable. The material isn't the most interesting and attendance grades matter, but it's not very hard to do ok in the class. Do your homework and study a bit for each test and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Colbert really wants her students to succeed and if you do the reading and go to her outside of class she'll really tell you everything you need to know. The only thing is she talks really fast so if you're not already basically fluent in Spanish, understanding her in class may be challenging. But she's the sweetest lady ever.

So sweet, so caring, so funny. She wants you to do well and to participate, but she isn't rude about it and won't call you out if you don't (unlike some other professors). She allows for a lot of freedom and flexibility with assignments and projects, but do know you'll have to read (but not that often). Would take her again. One of the best at SMU
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: By far one of my favorite teachers at SMU! She is so sweet and truly cares so much about each and every one of her students. I've had her for 3 different classes. She is very understanding and she really appreciates it when students work hard!
So sweet and really cares about students. If you show improvement and contribute in class its an easy A.

This class is horrible, I found it extremely frustrating. Should not be taking Cornell notes as a grown adult in college. That's something I did in middle school. She also assigns way too much work, I had more homework in here than all my other classes a this course isn't even a core class. Save your GPA and time and take a different class I beg!

reviews.comment: Took this class for fun, but regret it. Way too much material to memorize, super strict grading, and constant assignments. Exams are stressful and overly detailed. Over half the class got a 70 on the second to last exam, so she had to curve it. She is nice, but the class is so overwhelming that it's not even fun to learn.

reviews.comment: HORRIBLE. if you want to be treated like a ten year old and told how to take notes with a billion articles assigned, then get poorly graded in everything, step right up you have found the class for you. She's. Horrible.
I don't care what anyone else says, this professor is so nice and easy.

This professor assigns far too much homework for a 1000-level course and grades it much more harshly than expected. Tests are also overly difficult and feel like upper-level exams. The workload is unbalanced and far heavier than what an intro class should require.
Avoid this class at all costs

This class is horrible. There is so much homework, most of which is cornell notes and if you don't take two full pages of notes on readings she gives you a bad grade on the homework. Homework is due every single class period and its way too much work for a breadth class. Tests are harder than they should be, and its tough to get a good grade.

reviews.comment: This is one of the worst classes if not the worst  I have taken at SMU. There is an unbelievable amount of work for an entry-level class. She makes students do Cornell notes like they are in Junior High. Stay away. Tests are extremely difficult with little material to study and all around a waste of time and money.

reviews.comment: She gives so much homework and it is all busy work. Exams are more difficult than they should be and there is always a paper due the same week of the exam. Avoid this class at all costs
So much homework and tons of reading due every single class period, way to much work for a CC credit class

reviews.comment: Incomprehensible amount of work

Super strict on attendance and way too much work for a 1000 level class that everyone is taking for a CC credit. Also not an easy A, just dont take it, complete waste of time.

Dr. Purcell herself is very nice and friendly. The class isn't hard in terms of content, what makes the class difficult is the overwhelming amount of assignments. Between notes, quizzes, mandatory attendance, and multiple papers all throughout the semester, do not assume this is a blow-off class. My advice, go to office hours, maybe that will help

reviews.comment: Way too much reading for a 1000 level intro class when all of us are takin it for the CC tags, lecture totally unengaging and child-like, did not enjoy her moving us around in groups, the cornell notes and the inquizitive assignments seemed like just busy work with no real purpose behind them. She should learn how to teach college or go to HS.

Getting a good grade is easy and she seems like a nice person. But come on, the "lectures" are a joke. It's literally ice breakers all day, every day, for the whole semester. She pretty much refuses to answer any questions about religion to avoid offending people; a considerate thought, but goodness gracious...we are PAYING to hear your expertise.
Her form of helping is staring blankly at you when you ask questions. AI the damn paper and be done with her, waste of time and money.

Very kind person but we had so much reading and so many assignments -- more than an intro class should require. Tests were pretty hard in my opinion. Final paper topic was given to us less than a week before it was due and was 4-6 pages. She kept class engaging with group activities or partner work.

reviews.comment: if you do not like to attend class (like me) this class is not for you. each class is worth 4 points on her grading scale and if you show up 10 mins late she will give you 2/4 on your attendance. not worth it

reviews.comment: It's not that she's easy it's that students are cheating their ases off and there's no possibly way not to if you want to keep up with them and not get iced on your grades. What a joke, not even trying to keep her classroom fair, you want a course you can literally ace in an hour w gpt, this is the one, the whole class is robots talking to each other, such a shame bc religion as a discipline is already on its way out

If you need na easy course you can gpt ur way through this is your person doesn't care don't check all work is done online she's calling it it all day all long lol literally everyone is cheating in here

Her class is the most pointless exercise of wasted time, she is unorganized and infantilizing, she has no clue as to how to maintain standards and bc the entire class ai's their work, you end up doing so too cause why bother being the only one working for the A when everyone gets As. She needs to be pulled up seriously bc she is such a dampenor

Sweet and caring woman who wants students to do well. Hard to argue with some of the critiques of her on this page, as her classes can come off as a bit intellectually undemanding, but she is obviously a professor who has good intentions and a warm heart.
Comes off as more of a human resources officer or middle school teacher than a college professor. Easy A but can't say I learned much.

Literally incompetent, the whole class was cheating on their homeworks and she seemed clueless. If you want a useless course with an untenable workload that you can AI your way through instead, this and she is the one.

She's a nice person and makes some parts of the class interactive with group discussions. My only grievance is that for an introductory class, she requires lots of writing. Weekly discussion posts have high word counts. The exams are easy multiple choice. Textbooks are needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Her class felt disorganized, with assignments not graded on Canvas and cmmunication was often dismissive, making it hard to ask questions. The strict attendance policy felt excessive. I recommend taking someone else.

Her class felt disorganized, with assignments not graded on Canvas and communication was often dismissive, making it hard to ask questions. The strict attendance policy felt excessive. I recommend taking someone else.

Definitely would never take again, she is so boring in class and can be irritable depending on who you are which is also how she grades. There is no point to this class and most of us are taking it just for credit but she grades and makes it so hard that it is nowhere near easy enough for the kind of course we signed up for. Bad all over.

reviews.comment: This class was jargon-heavy and difficult to succeed in. I would think twice before taking it just for the CC's, as it is genuinely hard for a core class. The lectures are boring and hard to digest, and Dr. Purcell isn't a fan of feedback. If you're not religious, she might grade you differently based on the class.
