Tests are out of 125 points and are extremely difficult, you can't just memorize things, you have to be able to apply them.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Jones is a good professor, but definitely more of a researcher. He's nice and will help you if you need it, but you have to put in the effort. This course was harder than some of the upper-level biology courses, and the tests didn't leave much room for error (missing two questions is an A-). Do the HW, go to office hours, and read the textbook.

Do not take this class unless you absolutely have to. Dr. Jones and Dr. Norris are two of the worst professors I've had in my time here at SMU. They are unapproachable, unhelpful, and do not care about the success of their students. The class is based almost entirely on tests that hardly address the material covered in class. My first C ever.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class sucks. Material is very difficult and lectures are extremely boring. Jones is also not very approachable which makes the touch material even tougher.
He is a very intelligent person but cannot explain things well. He was very unapproachable and made me feel stupid for asking normal questions. The test averages were always in the D range.
Is helpful to answer questions during office hours. Much more application based than memorization so need to understand and apply the material. Don't really need the textbook.

Definitely the worse of the two genetics profs & isn't the best at explaining things and doesn't really seem to like conversing with students. Def more of a researcher than a teacher. know all the lecture info and be able to apply it to comprehension questions (tends to throw quite a few curveballs in there). Genetics is tough so get ready to work
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Jones is a brilliant guy, but just not a good teacher at all. His tests are ridiculously hard especially given the time constraints. Not particularly friendly or approachable and doesn't seem to care as much about students as much as the other genetics professor. Just be prepared to knJow every single detail from lecture inside out and backwards.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Class is hard. Lectures are not interesting but all of the information on the exams are from the lecture so pay attention and study those slides until you have them memorized. Exam questions can be tricky so you really need to know the information. Be prepared to STUDY.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I did better in the second half of the course than the first half. I got a 100 on my third exam and a 94 on the final, which was the highest grade. Here's what you do: take audio recordings and re-listen to them. Read the chapters, and do detailed quizlets. Memorize EVERY slide for the final. Warning: some will be out of order/go to office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Jones teaches the more difficult half of Genetics. The tests are very specific and the PowerPoint slides are difficult to use for preparation because they don't have very many words. He isn't a bad professor, and his lectures are decent. But the course could be adjusted to make it more feasible to prepare for exams using the course material.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very smart guy, all around terrible teacher. He mumbles through every lecture, his lecture slides are jumbled, disorganized, and contain very little wording in general. If you are pre-med and care about your gpa don't take genetics. If you have to, then do well on the first 2 tests with Dr Orr because he's a homie and its way more clear.

Dr. Jones is a very smart man who knows what he is talking about, however he is definitely tough. His exams may seem simple but you need to know the material really well to understand the difficulty of it . His final was very difficult so you better hope you have an A+ cause u might drop a letter grade after it.

Jones is an overall average teacher. He's not as bad as the other people make him seem. Lecture is not very interesting but his exams are 100% lecture based but he clearly states what you need to do in the beginning of his part of the semester to get an A in the class (readskim chapters, do suggested problems, etc.) so he does try to help you.

This was one of the worst teachers I have ever had. Not helpful, unnecessarily difficult and only goes to class to ensure his students do poorly. He is insensitive and one of the worst people I've ever met. Surprised this guy can wake up in the mornings and be content with himself.

Sometimes I wonder why I'm at SMU when I could be learning biology from top professors at MIT for free (open courseware). Dr. Jones' lectures definitely make me think so.  He's bad at explaining things in class, and he rarely understands what I'm trying to ask during office hours. Clearly he's a researcher before a teacher. Easy tests though.

Jones teaches the second half of the genetics course. He?s much harder than Orr because his powerpoints and lectures are not as clear since the slides are pictures and have very little wording. His tests are somewhat difficult, and the final is hard. The class is not impossible, but you need to study a lot to do well for his half of the course.
He's a great professor! I highly recommend him. He is easygoing, and my writing has improved significantly.
Rickey is the goat
One of the best professors at SMU. Easy going and willing to help outside of class if you have questions.
Good class. Even if you aren't a naturally gifted writer, he helps you catch up. Taking his class for 1313 as well.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Take him. Makes class interesting while keeping the class on topic. I've felt like I have become a better writer and person, seriously, from his class. He is extremely willing to work with students and brings energy to every class. Best teacher I've had in my time here.

I'd highly recommend taking his class. The course challenges you but it's engaging if you're interested in media or the environment. Offered extra credit with an environmental group and let us rewrite our essays as well.
My writing improved a lot over the semester. He lets you do rewrites if you don't do well, which my other WRTR prof didn't allow.

Pretty laid back, funny guy. WRTR 1313 has more focus on critical thinking, but that's the same for all the 1313s. His class focuses on media and the environment, which I found interesting. Definitely helped my writing to be less paint-by-numbers.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great class. As long as you work on your papers, it's not hard to get an A or A-. Most of the people in my class also did well.

We wrote four papers in WRTR 1312. No quizzes or tests. Ricky was great. Very helpful in giving comments to fix the drafts. Just go to the conferences and pay attention to his suggestions. Taking his class for 1313 as well.
Excellent. Considered myself a good writer before taking this class but can say I improved a lot. Others I know had the same experience. Accommodating if you have a personal issue and contact him.
Best writing teacher I've had.

One of the worst professors I've ever had. All he does is read off paragraphs and notes and expects you to understand what's going on with little to no explanation. The grading is over the most minute details and don't pertain to the big picture. When you visit him in office hours, he is of no help.
Recommended. All in all I didn't find the class overly difficult. Like somebody else said he lets you fix your essays to go up one grade level. You have to write good essays, but his feedback helps.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Ricky is great our whole class loved him. Make sure you write good papers because it is not an easy class, but he is really fun and lets you take the papers any direction you want.

One word to describe this man is hilarious. Constantly had me laughing with his sly jokes while also keeping a professional standard on teaching. Definitely a great teacher to have as a freshman for he makes me feel very comfortable. Work load is not terrible but you still feel educated from his class.

He is wonderful. He does grade slightly more harshly than other WRTR profs. but he is very kind and gives you the option to correct your papers and resubmit them for a higher grade. Be prepared to have an awesome experience, but also to work for a good grade. I have had wonderful conversations with him. TAKE THIS PROF. YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT!

Ricky is overall a good professor. His guidelines are clear, though, some of his gradings don't make sense. He is accessible outside of class and his conferences help a lot. He does favor students though, so I suggest you get on his good side.
He is the best. My favorite class Ive taken at SMU so far and I didnt consider myself a writer. The class helped me to do better in my other classes.
Very good teacher. Not hard to get a good grade if you put in the time and work on your essays. I think I improved a lot. He will help you if you go to his office hours or go to the conferences.
Good class.

he makes an easy class extremely difficult. his feedback is not good because even when I did what he asked I ended up getting bad grades. I had an A and the day before school ends he started taking old grades down so I go to a B. No explanation was given at all. Do not take him.
Excellent professor.
One of the best professors I've had at SMU.
Really good professor. He gives clear instructions and helps you a lot with your papers.

Although Prof.Ricky is funny, he is too strict about giving good grades. The feedback he gave is only useful for improving grammar mistakes not how to rewrite the sentence better. The essays are too hard to get A, and it is a big chunk of the grade. Even though I revise all the essays, I still cannot get an A.

Prof. Treat was p funny, our class was kinda dead but he still made it entertaining. 4 papers and 1 presentation, easy grader on the presentation as long as you put in the effort, papers a bit difficult but you can get points back by editing and turning edited paper back in at end of year.

Good teacher, caring, funny, talks a lot, maybe too much sometimes, hard essay grader. He is very picky with works cited and word choice in essays. You have to put a lot of work into your essays. Will rarely give a 100 for an essay. Generally, there are 4 essays and 1 presentation in a semester.

He is one of the best professors Ive ever had. He is very nice and respectful. He cares a lot for his students and his instructions are always very clear. He is very understanding with any issues or problems. Answers emails quickly and he is always willing to help. He is awesome. You should really take him, you wont regret !!

Professor Treat is the beat English teacher that I have ever had. He made class very fun and really got the whole class involved. I dont think that Ive ever improved in a class more that his. I just wish that I could take his class again!
Best!
Funny and informative, you won't get a better DISC professor than Mr. Treat.

Dr. Rim was an amazing professor for CHEM 1113. Her quizzes were not extremely difficult and she helps answer any questions you might have. The pre-labs can be pretty long but there is only one a week. She drops the lowest lab and lowest quiz grade!

Great prof for Gen Chem 1 Lab! Each lab required a pre lab done before class which was somewhat tedious, but you have to do this for every professor. Quizzes taken before the lab, each if you do the homework and read over lab instructions. Had the BEST TA'S, and you should score well on the lab section if you ask her to check your work.

She really cares for you success and is actively open to communication over anything. In class, she walks around making sure everyone is doing the experiment properly and answering every question. Outside of class, she is quick to respond to emails and allow makeup exams in case of emergency.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Such a laid back lab. Don't get me wrong, you still have to do work, she just made it significantly more bearable. Lab reports are simple, just make sure to show your work for everything because that's what dropped my grade down to an A-. Dr. Chinwon is also incredibly patient and easy going. Love her and her gucci shoes

She is only available during his office hours where she is rude when talking about not being able to pass the course. Topics are all over the place, noncohesive talks, and nothing important is covered, refuses to answer questions she never covered, rude when asked for clarification. There's never response to emails, do not take her.
my glorious queen

Dr. Rim is truly amazing. It shows that she cares more about student success/understanding over grades. She is helpful and will explain in a way that helps you learn, and she is very accessible outside of class. The final practical was pretty difficult but it all worked out in the end. Will be taking lab with her again next semester.

Professor Rim is very sweet and is always willing to help with labs and anything you don't understand. Super approachable to ask questions or for procedure clarification. She really makes it as easy as possible, but it's a difficult class to begin with. I would definitely recommend her!
She is super sweet and is very approachable when you're confused or need clarification.

A good choice for lab. Super helpful and happy to explain any topics or procedures. Very reasonable workload for the course. It is ochem so don't expect a pushover. A real gem for lab students. Do well on lab reports/quizzes to cushion your grade for the practical.
He makes things hard for no reason.

This class is difficult and will require studying as the grade is based on the exams. Professor Santanu is very fun and his lectures are as interesting as they can be. You can get partial credit for the exam questions.

This class is very challenging. It is a lot of conceptual application. Dr. Roy is very knowledgable, though, and his lectures are good. Your grade is an average of your best 2 tests out of 3, so if you're a bad test taker it could be challenging. There is optional homework, but you have to do it to succeed. Overall, Dr. Roy is a very nice professor
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Roy is an amazing teacher. Not only are his lectures very interesting, but they are also hilarious. He gives out optional homework assignments, but I highly recommend you complete them. If you study and drill the homework questions, you will do fine. Do not come into this class thinking you can skip the homework and succeed.

Fantastic Professor, Dr. Roy cares so much about his students. He is funny and tells you exactly what you need to study and learn for the test, the material is a bit challenging but if you put in the effort and work with Dr. Roy you will most likely do fantastic.

Good professor with interesting lectures, but TA grades inconsistently and not much information is given regarding grading and class procedure unless professor is asked. He does a good job, but the heavy involvement of his TA makes it a risky endeavor for your grades.
The grade is from the midterm. So far it goes great!
Lecture heavy, but he follows Atkins so it is easy to prepare if you miss a lecture. Very clear style of teaching. Three midterms
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I liked his lectures a lot, but I already had taken math and thermo classes so it was easy. If you don't have math background you will struggle

Excellent lectures! He was able to answer any question during class with ease. The material was heavy and many students struggled in his class, but mostly premeds and bio majors who didn't have the math foundations.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Runcevski is one of the few professors that would hold a perfect lecture and derive all equations on the whiteboard without any sideshows or notes. That was impressive! Physical chem is hard, but his explanations made it a bit easier. The book helped a lot and he followed the material. Test heavy, no extra credit!

Bro was super condescending, a confusing teacher, and put on a derivation not mentioned on the exam guide, and then proceeded to say how he didn't care if we were mad because he "had just become tenured." Although he was generous on the grading, I honestly wouldn't have missed as much anyway if he were clear on what material we needed to study for.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pchem was terrifying for me, but Runcevski was an excellent teacher. Try to pass it on midterms the final is much harder
I had an excellent experience! Great lectures! Highest level possible, but also hilarious
Excellent professor! I truly enjoyed the class

PChem is never easy, but Dr. Runcevski makes it understandable and manageable. He told us at the beginning that it was his goal to make the class bearable, and he held to it throughout the semester. He is very open during office hours and will do everything in his power to help you succeed. Tests are the only grades, and they're derivation-heavy!
PCHEM is so difficult, but he makes is bearable

Dr. Runcevski is AMAZING. He is so approachable outside of class (go to office hours!). He is honestly the most caring professor I have ever had. His class is ALL tests so study well but don't get scared, his tests are totally doable if you study well and read the material. This was his first semester teaching and honestly he's rocking it.

He's a very nice man, but the class could be really boring. The tests were just essays based on the readings and he wasn't a super tough grader. The presentations weren't hard to do and as long as you put in some effort he gave you above a 90. Like every advanced Spanish class, there's a decent amount of homework reading. I would recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Such a weirdo fr does dancing and singing for no reason, mental concerns very real, does not teach normal language methods, grades the ladies a little nicer and it became very obvi

This professor was so bad, I never wore a seatbelt to class because I wanted to die before making it to his class. Genuinely one of the least respected professors I have ever had the displeasure of encountering (and I speak Spanish). 

DO NOT TAKE.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Sanchez-Godoy is an awesome guy who really cares about teaching Spanish literature. If you're willing to work, you will get an A in his class. But beware of the homework load; there is a boatload of homework, which borders on unreasonable for a Spanish class. If you can handle lots of HW, 100% take Prof. Sanchez- Godoy
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: An amazing teacher, he gives a lot of homework but it really helps raise your grade significantly and if you do not do it it will hurt you. As long as you pay attention and do the work, you will get an A and ask questions. I hate poetry but he made it not so bad and I would recommend taking him!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: A lot of homework, but he grades it super easily so its honestly like a completion grade. A few papers that he lets you make corrections on and exams are all free response and you know what will be on it. He is a super nice guy and is helpful in office hours. Really improved my spanish level in the semester I took him and I'd definitely take again!

Professor Sanchez Godoy does have a lot of homework in his class BUT this is helpful because if you do bad on a test or paper you have a cushion. You just have to go to class, listen, participate and turn in your homeworks. He is very knowledgeable and very nice and respectful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: At first, Ruben Sanchez-Godoy seems like a teacher who is passionate and loves teaching. However, upon a further glance, Ruben just piles ALOT of homework for EVERY class. I am not talking about 15-20 minute homework, I mean work that takes 1-2hours at least. It's exhausting and do not get me started on his grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: One of the best professors at SMU. He cares so much about his students and what he teacher. If you put effort into the class, you will get an A. There are a couple 2-3 page essays and reading assignments and problems due every class. Very manageable. I would take this class all over again if I could!

I actually took 4 classes with Professor Sanchez-Godoy because he's amazing at teaching! He's a nut. haha He's super animated and quirky but also so passionate and good-hearted. He wants to make sure that you improve your Spanish skills. Do your homework (not a tough grader and he gives great, helpful feedback), show up and be respectful. Take him.

Professor Hamilton is really great. His lectures are engaging, and he does his best to make sure you understand the material. The midterm is ridiculously hard compared to everything else. Quizzes aren't bad if you pay attention and study a little. This is hard material, but Russ makes it as easy as possible to understand. Take him if you can!

Actually for ACCT 6248. Russ is very good at communicating what is expected. Quizzes are relatively easy if you study. Discussion posts are graded on participation, not content. Midterm is very hard for some reason. The final group project is a 4-6min group presentation and is fairly simple. Overall, other than the midterm, this was a great class.
Total GPA demolition. If you're happy, they will fix that.

Quizzes, Exams and Group project is what you'll be expecting to do in his class. He does provide his own slides which is easier to read than the book. He doesn't really go into depth and makes you memories most of the formulas for the quizzes and exams. Mandatory attendance and both quizzes/ exams are taken in-person on your laptop.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This is for 4315 federal income tax. your grade is only based on quizzes that are only 3 questions and 3 exams. Some people seemed to do really well in this class. But the slides were quite confusing to me and I did not learn well in this class. I really tried and studied hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Here was the key for me in Russ's class. He tests on theory more than actually being able to assemble the Financials in 6201. I really blew it on the midterm but was able to salvage my grade with the final group project. The quizzes required that you do the reading before class and have some level of understanding of the material.

Professor Russ is super nice and his curriculum is honestly pretty straightforward. The only thing I would note is that his homework will take a lot of time, quizzes are during class so attendance is mandatory, and his lectures are very off the book - not super interesting. But then again, it's accounting.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Hamilton takes the idea of taxation and somehow makes it even more boring and complex. While working problems in class he's very unclear as to what he's actually doing and more importantly WHY. He just goes through and chugs along with calculations without properly explaining whats going on. Overall be prepared to be completely lost.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Partnership Taxation is one of the most complicated topics in the world of tax. However, prof. Hamilton makes it simple and more interesting. His slides are the best material to study for the exam after youve done your reading of the chapters. Its definitely a lot of work for one class but trust me, its all worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Course is useless and so is the instructor. People only take him bc free As but they're doing a disservice to the field and make me embarrassed to say in a major as everyone sees us as a joke.
Smart professor, clear guidelines.
the course is so unorganized, do not take unless you want your gpa to take a hit from an elective nobody cares about, he told me that maybe i should find another major, repulsive
A tool.

One of the best profs. Caring. Inspirational. Uses pop culture references in lectures (movies, slangs, etc). Creates an encouraging environment for students to discuss their own writing. Passionate about his subject, which I think is the most important quality in a prof. Going in, I was scared about creative writing; he made it enjoyable.

Professor Rubin is very well-spoken and even more understanding of any extenuating circumstances. Though it was a 3-hour class, he kept it light and engaging and gave us breaks every hour. Make sure to do the readings, but they're not terribly hard. There are very few assignments, but he gives great insight and uplifts you. I'd take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: 10/10 professor. Best reading list of any English class so far, though some weeks have a lot of reading so be prepared. Hilarious, very smart, and great discussions. Definitely take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Rubin is a phenomenal professor. 10/10 would recommend. He has a great sense of humor and really cares about his students. He is good at giving helpful, constructive feedback and is a pretty light grader.

Professor Rubin is one of the best professors. Class is 2 hours 50 minutes and he goes the entire length but everything we do is pretty interesting. He cares a lot about his students and the work/effort they put into their class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: I took this class for credits and dreaded it because I usually don't like writing but ended up really enjoying this class! Professor Rubin is a great professor and gives good feedback. You have to read stories, participate, and a write few stories but it's not terrible at all and the readings are pretty interesting. Totally recommend this class!

One of my favorite professors! If your interesting in writing fiction, his classes are a must. Is extremely knowledgeable about writing and it shows; his advice and feedback on the stuff I turned in made my writing so much better! The pieces he picks for the class to read are always super intriguing, and class discussions are enlightening.

Prof. Rubin is a wonderful professor, and if you are interested in creative writing, you should definitely take his class at some point. He teaches the classics from the perspective of a writer, and you can learn so much from him.

Do not listen to the bad reviews on this page. If you just have clear writing, follow his rubric, and go to office hours you will excel in this class. He does not lecture himself but rather wants the discussion to be led by the students. Once you get past the first essay it is easy to figure out how he grades and what he is expecting from now on.

Dr. McConnell is a very passionate professor and thoroughly enjoys discussing the texts that we read. He provides in-depth context to the works and fosters group discussion. Only 4 essays and the final make up the grade and he is a bit of a tough grader at first, but it's easy to get used to his style/preference.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: NOPE NOPE NOPE, can't teach, tells you your work is great, then grades you down, f him

DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE He acts like he's going to be nice then grades you harshly for THINGS HE TOLD YOU TO INCLUDE.  One bad grade and you're toast. He's apparently gotten harder or was told to get harder.
Can't teach, spends the class time talking about his personal life, then grades randomly on essays even if you do to conference, what he says won't be reflected in your final grade.

I do not understand these reviews. Each lecture uses the same robotic tone and follows a script. Graded on 4-5 essays and if you screw up on one you will pay heavily. I went in for office hours and then got docked points for ideas that he specifically told me to include. Got the class lowest score on the final that prevented me from hitting an A-.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor McConnell is great but you definitely have to put the work in the essays to receive an A. He gives good feedback on them but the prompts can sometimes be a little tricky/confusing. Overall, I would definitely take him again and recommend him to others as well! As long as you try and send him the essay to look over, you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was just a seminar discussing the reading(s) for each class session. There are four essays and an essay for the final, all of which concerning the readings. I like McConnell because he doesn't try to prove a point by giving out low grades (if you are a good writer, he will actually give you 100s, unlike many professors).

Fun, participation-based classes. Essentially impossible to get lower than a B if you try, but it can be difficult to improve your grade on essays even with going to office hours. Participation grade isn't a gimme 100 so be sure to show up participate and do the readings if you care about having an A.

McConnell is an okay teacher. The class is mostly just discussion which really has no impact on your grade. I felt like I could never do what he wanted on papers, even with discussing with him on drafts. A lot of hype around the teacher that isn't deserved. He isn't bad, but don't walk in expecting the easy A you will hear people talk about.
He is a very nice prof and gives helpful feedback when writing essays for the class. He also is very informational when we talk about the book/film for the day.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very fair grader, very helpful. Just attend class and do draft conferences and you will be just fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. McConnell was a great teacher for WRTR. He never called people out in class to participate if they didn't want to, he grades fairly, and gives good feedback on essays. I would highly recommend taking him for writing if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor McConnell is probably one of the best professors I have had in terms of his ability to interact with students and help you learn. Being an Honors course it wasn't easy, but putting in effort and consistently showing up to class will show you care and that's all he asks for. Take this professor for DISC!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He was a great teacher, most of the classes he would talk and we would contribute if we wanted, never called you out which is nice in a discussion based class. 3 out of class papers, you revise one. The two other grades are easy As if you put in effort. Attendance and participation is 20% so show up. If you don't read you will still be fine.
WAY harder than being suggested, when we do well as a class, he makes it even hard so we get punished rather than rewarded. Not available and is rude when students ask questions. AVOID.

Prof Russ was an ok teacher, but she honestly had some emotional issues. She was very scattered, unorganized, and had memory loss. How did she get so far? I was glad to earn my A and get out of that class!

She hands out essay grades like I pick my limes at the supermarket: randomly. The essay prompts are completely wack. Directions and clarification are given the night before due dates. Reading assignments are overwhelmingly too much. And the monster final exam is plain unnecessary. The class is wildly boring and repetitive. Avoid at all costs.
Great professor and class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I love this professor she is super nice and her class is not hard at all. But you do learn which is the main thing!

I had Russ for both 5375 and 4395 and she is just wonderful. She is sweet and caring and really tries to help you. There is a lot of reading for 5375, but if you make the effort you will really enjoy the class. She is easy to talk to and has fun with her job. Great professor. A+++!
The sweetest person, good professor, interesting material, her classes are very easy, the homework is easy.
Loved her as a teacher.  She was great and extremely helpful!
Class is easy.  You can basically do other work while in the class.  A lot of busy homework though.
He is so tough to understand. Whatever he do in class will not prepare you for test at all.

He is the literal kindest prof ever. 1st day of class he shook every student's hand. Grading is clear and he gives extra credit for corrected exams. Homework is on a strong curve so hard to ruin that grade. He gives a lot of examples and shows exactly what he expects us to know. He also gives mini history lessons to show the importance of Diff EQ.

He's insanely smart so when he teaches he only teaches the applications and does not give examples. He has a good curve and is a pretty entertaining lecturer. Homework every week, 2 tests and a final - but he doesn't really teach how to do any of these problems.
He was a great professor, straight forward class outline. Only had homework (12%), two midterms (22% each), final exam (44%). Really nice.

Best math professor I've had at SMU so far. Homework grades are curved, cheat sheets allowed for exams, lots of office hours availability, practice tests prepare you well. The only things to complain about are a very exam heavy grading criteria and unengaging lectures, but the pros far outweigh the cons.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super caring. Know practice tests by heart and you'll do well on regular tests. Final is 40% of the grade but basically is just changed up numbers from previous tests and practice tests. Not a good lecturer though, so learning the concepts are a little difficult until you realize DiffEq is like 80% plug and chug.

even though I dropped my math minor I stayed in this class, I genuinely enjoyed it. he's super nice and he applies the differential equations we learn to real world examples. The homeworks are kind of hard bc you don't learn them in class and he also uses really complex integrals. But he allows test corrections for points back and a cheat sheet

Rumpf is a really nice guy who is passionate about the subject and cares about his students. His lectures can be a bit awkward and confusing, but he's always super helpful in office hours. Tests are a huge part of the class, but he always gives a detailed review and lets you use a formula sheet.

Lectures are not mandatory and you get to make your own formula sheet for each exam. His exams and grading are fair. No quizzes and homework is only 6% of your grade. He is brilliant, but kind of awkward in lectures. If you need diff eq for your major, take it with Rumpf.

Grades are based mostly from exams, but he gives practice exams that are a good gage of how the actual exam will be. Sometimes during lecture he give the history behind a certain math concept which is alright, i guess. But he is a really good professor if you are majoring in mathematics.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Best prof ever hands down

Prof. Rumpf is an INTELLIGENT man and it shows, but has difficulty turning calc into layman's terms. During lectures, he would talk about the history of calc and facts. HW due weekly, no calculators allowed but can use a homemade formula sheet for tests. Accessible outside of class.

Both in class and during office hours, Professor Rumpf is helpful, enthusiastic, and patient. Lectures consist mainly of derivation w/real world application. Tests -cheat sheet allowed- correlate directly to reviews and weekly homework. He also posts solutions to reviews and tests. Overall, a good professor with a love of math and a clear rubric.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Cool guy, knowledgeable and explains the theoretical side very good. You'll need to go and do some work to prepare for tests, but they are usually pretty similar to the practice ones he gives out.  Pretty helpful outside of class too.
The practice tests are very helpful when studying for the tests.  The lectures aren't necessarily important - you can get all of the formulas from the textbook

He is a great professor and explains things very well.  He is a bit awkward, but that's what makes him funny.  If you can take his class, take it.  He is very helpful and holds office hours before tests.  One homework assignment a week, and he is forgiving if you don't turn it in on time.  Highly recommend.
He is super nice and really wants students to ask questions. Holds long office hours and is very helpful. Lectures are really clear. Allows cheat sheet on exams and gives credit for test corrections.

Dr. Rumpf is a pleasure to have. He has an eccentric demeanor that is amusing and inviting rather than distracting. Attendance is not taken, and the class is barely a quarter full during lectures and packed for tests. His lectures can be hard to follow, but are always helpful. Use his office hours, he is happy to help out.
Shares advanced mathematical concepts along with their historical context. Clearly walks you through the proofs. If you appreciate math, you will love this professor. Favorite math class in college.
This guy is awesome. He made diff eq make sense to me. I could not recommend this guy more. Take him for sure.
Attendance not mandatory, and definitely not required. Lectures are impossible to follow, but tests are easy and very similar to the practice tests he gives out before.

Best professor for diff eq. His homework is assigned once a week, and there are 3 tests and a final. You get a full sheet of paper, front and back, for notes for every test. I couldn't recommend him more, his lectures were hard to follow, but during tests it felt like it was extremely easy. People who barely went to class also got As

His class isn't too easy nor is it too difficult. He moves very quickly so it can be easy to get lost sometimes. You can always ask him to explain something in further detail and he gladly does so. His accent is only a problem if you let it be one.

His accent and quick explanations make it hard to understand what he is talking about, but once you go back and read it you will get it. Tests were much easier than I thought. 85% is an A. Easy A. Take this class!

I am an A student all the way and this is the first class that I ever made anything below an A. He is HORRIBLE as a prof, ridiculously rude when you ask a question or are confused, leaves out all details that he purposely grades on, seems like he doesn't know what he is supposed to be teaching on daily, uses rude nicknames to us.

This professor is a GOD SEND. So funny and made the class laugh. He was a great professor to have in the morning because he always had great energy and was super positive. He's always happy to give feedback and help out students on essays. He even gave us donuts for our last class! AMAZING take this

One of the best teachers taken at SMU. He is so genuine, kind and funny. Gives amazing feedback. the class is only 4 essays and the books are really interesting. So sad to see him leave. If I could switch my major to english and he were the teacher in every class, i would do it in a heartbeat. Sweetest man ever!

Cole gives amazing feedback. If you are not interested in Fiction - this is still a good class to take for credits because he is very understanding. If you communicate with him, he will do his best to help. Readings and attendance are required- but you can still get through without doing the readings. No exam- just papers and written discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: The class will be difficult, but if you put in the effort and study, Professor Stroynowski will try to help you and gives some extra credit for attending class. For the final, he tries to help all the class pass.

Professor Stroynowski is actually the worst professor I've had at SMU. His grading criteria is VERY unclear, he does not teach concepts well and is unwilling to help students and/or answer questions. He refuses to do examples in class. He puts concepts on tests that he explicitly states will not be on the exam. DO NOT TAKE.

Dr. S has been the worst professor I've ever had. Does not care about his students and is irritated when they ask "foolish questions". Lectures pooly put together, doesn't answer questions in class/solve practice problems. Solved the answers to our practice test incorrectly. Tells students something won't be on the test then puts it anyways.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Stronowsky does examples of a lot of the stuff he teaches so it keeps you really interested.
Poor teacher, boring lectures, short tests. Gives you an A if you get above a 90 on the final. Not the worst professor, but far from the best. Has this strange fascination with Usain Bolt.

Would NOT recommend. Not helpful to students. Writes very confusing quizzes. The material is NOT difficult, he presents it much harder than it should be. He never explains ANYTHING in class, attending is pointless. He also allows cheating which is ridiculous. People use resources (phones, previous tests, others) that shouldn't be allowed.

Prof Stroynowski, despite being a brilliant particle physicist, is quite terrible at teaching undergrads basic physics. His explanations in class are over-complex and irrelevant to the quizzes/tests, which mostly take examples from the book. Do your homework, even though its optional. With decent practice, you'll be fine.
a little hard to understand sometimes, class is set up well, nice guy that makes quizzes and tests straight from the book and reuses questions semester to semester

Very Very good teacher. He really cares about the student learning the material. The person above must have not tried at all and is just mad about his grade. If you keep up with homework you will do very well in his class. His lectures are important even if they are not mandatory. He is easy if you put the needed effort. Try and get him if you can.

His lectures are completely useless. His tests and quizzes come straight from the homework, so study that well. He talks about theory in class, but EVERYTHING goes from the homework and the textbook. Avoid him if you can
Useless teacher. He can not teach and you can not understand him during class. The test aren't too bad, but you will have to teach yourself. Probably the worst teacher I have ever had.

This professor sucks badly! He covers theoretical **** in class, which will not help at the time for exams and quizes. You may do the homework but the problems are so easy that once you get to the quizes you will realize that homework is not preparing you well. He is not good at explaining anything outside of class. Go to the help sessions.

He is not a very good teacher.  He goes over the theory of everything and then never goes over an example problem.  The only way to pass this class is to go to the help sessions.  The TA makes all of the tests and quizes and he grades them.  The teacher doesn't do much of anything.  The class is only easy because of the TA, go to the help sessions!

Professor Sanderson is extremely knowledgeable in the field.  I found this course to not only be informative about the finance sector, but also informative about my personal finances towards the back half of the course.  His tests are very easy if you study the lecture slides and do his practice test.  Best finance elective choice.
Such a sorry excuse for 'teaching'
Extremely caring professor who wants his students to succeed. Grade is based on 3 exams, one final, and one project. Attendance/participation is worth only 4%.
Prof. Sanderson is the best! He is very reasonable and accommodating. We love him!

Sanderson is awesome, take him if you can. SUCH a nice guy- plus extremely smart & caring. He works at Citi but teaches at night, & still has more enthusiasm than most other professors. Not an easy class, but if you pay attention & skim readings you will be fine. Final is a group project that is long, but not hard. Do what he asks & you'll do great

Feedback on assignments was not helpful because comments were extremely short and often unrelated to the work submitted. Lectures lacked engagement, examples were confusing, and i spent more time decoding instructions than actually learning material.
People giving her bad reviews are just not very smart. She's a very nice and easy professor.
Just not a very good teacher or compelling speaker.

This professor thinks she's a comedian, but the jokes rarely land. Very little to none experience in research, just a teacher, yet acts like the ultimate authority on every topic. She's dismissive of other viewpoints and comes off as arrogant, making discussions one-sided and unproductive. This was not the caliber of education expected rom SMU.

Easiest class, just go to class and pay attention and you're good. 2 exams that are open note, all material is from lectures tho. Chill grader, she's lenient and understanding and will allow late work if it's a credible enough reason.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
Do NOT take this class. Worst teacher I have ever had. Not only is there so much reading assigned, but 
attendance is mandatory.

Great teacher. She teaches her subject very well, but definitely pay attention in class because it is a lot of information. She's is so nice and always willing to help outside of class as well. Put in the effort and you will do well!
Awful awful awful hated her sm
She's really nice and was a good teacher. Very unproblematic. The online textbook homework was very easy. She gave me a really good grade on my final research paper after I went to her office hours.
Tests are ridiculous. Class was a mix of disorganization, indifference, and the occasional passive-aggressive announcement. Inspirational!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: For what should be an entry level class, this class was so difficult. The midterm was terrible. The lectures was disorganized and did not cover the depth of what was asked on the exam. Sweet lady but did not learn anything compared to the amount of time and work I put in. Kept me from getting a 4.0.
Not the move
extremely tough grader. no curve. boring lectures. wouldn't take unless necessary coming from good student

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!

She is a nice lecturer, but is horrible when it comes to grading. PAINFUL attendance policy that doesn't allow for any unexcused absences. DOES NOT CURVE ANY GRADES in relation to the rest of the class. No one in my class got a perfect score on the midterm/ research paper / final exam. Everyone's overall grade dropped.

I had to take this class for credit and didn't mind it. It is very lecture heavy and attendance does matter. The midterm was extremely difficult and nearly impossible. It was all short and long answer questions (nearly 15 of them) to complete in a 50 minute period, which just isn't practical.

Professor Johnson is nice, and the class is a very basic overview of the US government. There is a long research paper at the end of the semester as well as a group presentation project. Other than that, there are two exams, and there is typically a weekly homework assignment from the textbook. Lots of work, but it's very straightforward. 7/10

She kept us every class until 9:20 but class wasn't hard. don't have to do the readings, listen to the podcasts before exams. Fair grader but doesn't give a lot of feedback on writing. attendance isn't big,  let her know before. Classes can be dense you can not participate. Overall she was great and I would recommend!

Her class felt disorganized, with assignments not graded on Canvas and requiring submissions at inconvenient locations. Communication was often dismissive, making it hard to ask questions. The strict attendance policy, even with notice, felt excessive.  I recommend taking someone else.

I wish Prof. Johnson didn't teach a night class, but if you're passionate about politics and want to learn, this class is enjoyable. She did a great job facilitating discussion, maintaining classroom respect, and introducing new concepts. I wish she posted the slides and graded things faster, though.

Professor Ryan, or JCR, is the BEST professor I have ever had. Genuinely so passionate about the subject and loves her students. I took 2 of her classes this semester and had an absolutely wonderful experience. She's so understanding (I missed a week of classes, and she let me vent about why in her office for 2 hours). Such an inspiration!!!!
She is the most boring person I've ever met and her topics are ridiculous.

If you're passionate about these topics it should be an easy class. She' s a very sweet and understanding person and professor. She reminded me to complete assignments and extended deadlines without me even asking multiple times. It just is kinda hard to study bec there are a TON of sources and its abstract concepts you have to take a position on.
Don't take her. Unorganized and rude. Cane be condescending when you ask questions.

Professor Ryan is an incredible person outside of class. With that said, her as a professor definitely has cons. She does not answer any email, so very hard to reach her. Her lectures can be boring which can make it hard to study for exams. But overall, shes a sweet lady whos passionate. If you aren't passionate about these topics, dont take her

No matter how many classes I went to, nothing could bring my B up. She is a terrible lecturer, awful with personal relations and passive aggressive when you dare ask her a question. Completely not understanding of personal emergencies with your family or illness, so don't have either of those if you take her class.
Professor is a disappointment. Shows up unprepared, rushes through material. Doesn't engage with students, creates a hostile learning environment.
WAY harder than being suggested, when we do well as a class, she makes it even hard so we get punished rather than rewarded. Not available and is rude when students ask questions. AVOID.

JCR is an amazing professor and wants all her students succeed. Human sexuality is not even remotely close to being difficult, unless you are putting in no effort and not keeping up with the readings. There are a lot of opportunities for extra credit and she is a fair grader. Take her, you will learn so much!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Way too much work, did not like her teaching style. Too much reading, quizzes and other factors throughout the semester for her class to be worth so much and so difficult. Learned very little and wanted to be interested but her style ruined it for me.

A huge disappointment, she is terrible, unorganized, and never updates us on homework, sssigns a lot of reading and the test were not open note and the tests are not online. I wanted so much to take this course and am sad becuase i learned nothing all because of her poor teaching. Worthless course and wasted time.

Ryan was a good professor, funny, and pretty sweet but, this class is really heaving on reading. the modules are filled with tons of readings that will be brought up on the tests and final so there's no way you'll really pass without reading them. Grades are not really put in on time so it is hard to know your grade by the end of the semester.

My final is in less than a week and I still have not received most of my grades in the class, including papers, my midterm and final project. She is a nice person, but her class is so boring. She always went the full three hours, sometimes even over time, and most of the time she wasn't even teaching. She made us do so much work outside of class.

Professor Caldwell-Ryan is a great professor. She is knowledgable about the course and is a great lecturer. She's very lenient about deadlines and is very understanding. One midterm, a final, and a current events project. This was a fun class and I would definitely recommend.

I loved her! Class was so eye-opening and fascinating. She is soooooo behind on grading and it can get pretty frustrating, but the upside is she will give you an extension if needed! She's very understanding and caring. Do the readings while you can because it will catch up to you for the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Josephine is a great teacher and explains subjects so clearly. You will learn a lot. Highly recommend you to take her class.

TONS of reading-ridiculous amount, but need to for tests. Very unorganized canvas page. Tests weren't too bad, if you took good notes in lecture / read. Very boring lectures, reading is more than I had in a literature class. She is nice and very lenient on deadlines though and very interested in the subject, she cares a lot..
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Ryan is a little all over the place, but overall a really great professor. Deadlines are lenient and she will love you if you speak up in class. Do not take advantage of her, but she responds well when asked for help.

Dr. Ryan is very sweet and nice but I would not take her again as a professor. She is very unorganized and never would update us about assignments. Assigns a lot of reading and the test were not open note and the tests are not online. I feel like I have not learned much in this class which is very unfortunate because I was excited to take it.

Dr. Ryan is so sweet, cares for her students, and is very knowledgeable about gender when it comes to human rights. The material is very interesting and there is a lot of reading/films but you really don't need to do it all. Deadlines are wayyy lenient but don't save until the last minute (it'll hit you at the end of semester). Exams are open note!

As a person, she's kind, understanding, interesting, and handles disagreements well. As a professor... Canvas and syllabus never matched, so you gotta guess what reading is required. Never went over assignment instructions unless asked. Kept pushing back due dates until we had a pile of assignments and projects due in April. Grades came super late.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Do not take this class unless you are truly passionate about gender and human rights. She is a very caring professor but it was very unorganized and almost too lenient. There would be multiple due dates for the same thing and all of a sudden everything was due at once. LOTS of reading. Very discussion heavy as well. Lots of writing as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: If you try(as you should at college) you will fly through this class. Show up. Participate. Do your homework. You will get an A. Everything is interesting in this course, but some things learned are rather disturbing but important. Prof is BEYOND lenient, understanding, and makes exceptions depending on your circumstance. Take her class.
She is amazing. She really cares about her students. As long as you put in the effort, you should be fine.

This prod is very kind, however do not take this class if you are not interesting in women and gender studies. I took this class for a UC credit and struggled as I was not very interested in the material, thus struggled to complete the large amount of reading assignments. It is easy to feel overwhelmed with the amount of info that is on each test.

She is a great and caring professor who clearly cares about the topic she teaches and her students. If you participate in class she will like you, but overall she is very kind and understanding. There are lots of readings and books for this class, but hey are pretty interesting. graded based of 2 exams, some quizzes and a final paper/project.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: I started SMU in the Fall of 2019 & this happened to be one of the best classes I had ever taken. Be prepared to read, but don't let that scare you! Her lectures are amazing and shes one of the few professors at SMU that actually cares for her students. If you ever have the chance to take her, do yourself the favor and do it!! you wont regret it!
10/10 take this prof!! she truly cares about her students' success.

I took Human Sexuality with Professor Caldwell Ryan and she made the class interesting. She assigns A LOT of reading (from the textbook and other sources). You have to pay attention and read if you want to do well in this class.

This is my favorite teacher I have ever had in my life. She really wants you to succeed and does everything she can to help you out. She is funny and personable. I really learned a lot in this class and found the content very interesting. She doesn't make talking about sex awkward at all. 10/10 recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lectures are very engaging and covers a wide range of topics, so you definitely get a lot out of the class. She assigns a lot of readings, so be sure you take the time to actually do them and you'll be fine. Material isn't difficult, but there's just a lot. Caldwell-Ryan is fantastic and I would def take her again!

Dr. Ryan seems to throw busy work off to UTA since she's a full time professor at SMU. On top of reading your textbook everyday in class she assigns dense article and other novels you must read for future test. She gives long study guides and 90% of the material on the guide is not on the test and is also a tough grader. I don't recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This was an overall AMAZING class to take. I had this teacher at UTA and she is very informed and logical in her explanation of the textbook. Her tests are a combination of multiple choice, T/F, and free response-- you must read if you want to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The class discussions are over the readings that were assigned for homework. There's a take home midterm and a few papers. If you're interested in human rights, then you'll the enjoy the class.

There is A LOT of reading required for her courses, which includes an ethnography, a small textbook, and another book.  Each class, you have to had read 2-4 LONG and DENSE articles.  When she grades, she is also very subjective.  If she does not like your opinion, she will not like you, and you won't get very good grades.

(Summer 1) This class is a TON of reading. You read an entire textbook, a novel, chapters on blackboard, plus various other things from books. She does give a study guide so make sure you know everything on it. You do read a book about transexual prostitutes, so be open-minded. Don't be scared though, she is nice. Just a lot of studying/reading
She'll like you as long as you speak up in class. There's a lot of reading, but you also watch a lot of movies which is really nice. Easy class overall as long as you do the readings
Took her for Human Sexuality. Not a super easy class but she is an awesome professor. She's extremely knowledgeable so classes are always interesting.

I took 2 CFs and did an Independent Studies with her. She is HANDS DOWN the best prof I had at SMU. She's a great prof who makes the material interesting and easy to understand. She'll help you with anything, She's also funny and nice! There's a lot of reading, but she made me WANT to read the books and attend class. TAKE HER BEFORE YOU GRADUATE!!!

I took 2 CFs and did an Independent Studies with her. She is, HANDS DOWN, the best prof I had. She is a great teacher who makes the material interesting and easy to understand. She'll help you with anything, She's also funny and nice! There's a lot of reading, but she made me WANT to read the books and attend class. TAKE HER BEFORE YOU GRADUATE!!!
Wonderful faculty member who enjoys conveying knowledge to students.  She provides various points-of-view and allows the student to come to their own conclusions

Certainly no blow-off class, but really interesting. Prof knows what she's talking about and manages to be both informative and entertaining. Fair bit of work for the summer, though not impossible, and she's really clear about what she wants from assignments. I'd definitely recommend this class.

Took her Human Sexuality night class. If you do the assignments and study for the tests you will be fine. Its not a blow off but as far as CF's go its very fair. Classes are really fun and interesting. She is really funny and a very nice professor, makes the class very entertaining and makes you actually want to go to class! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!
Run, run, run....grading is not fair. She grades 25% on each exam and only 25% on the rest! An A student will only get a B most of the time. So if your gpa matters to you run.

RUN!!!!!! she is unorganized never on time and just complains about how much money she doesn't make! Gives a review but doesn't really help on the test. It was all useless memorizing. She just reads straight from her notes. I am an A student and have a D in her class!

took it for the summer session --- TONS OF READING and the tests are by no means easy....you gotta do your work but the material makes up for the difficulty of the tests - its interesting stuff, and the professor is pretty cool. you'll fall in love with her pretty quickly - great class, extremely challenging
she is SO nice and the class is very interesting.  it's not super easy but nothing to stres  about. just an average amount of work.

This class doubles for two GECs. One of the reasons I took it. For a summer class, it was a heck of a lot of reading - 5 days a week for 28 days.  It was a very interesting, entertaining and enlightening course.  I would recommend Prof Ryan but plan on reading A LOT!

Professor Mabry is amazing. I am so glad that I got to take her for both my WRTR classes. She tells you want she wants out of each essay and if you follow that you will get an A. Spots in her class get filled quickly, so make sure to enroll in her class early.

Mabry is a pretty straightforward and easy grader. Make use of her one-on-one conferences before submitting papers- you will most likely write an A paper with her feedback. Class itself can be boring, but during conference times before paper, there is no class. She is super kind and gives a lot of feedback on the papers after grading too.
She is ok. I mean kinda annoying and makes snarky comments but she does grade fairly easily on assignments. She also cancels class often which is super nice.
This professor is a disaster. Shows blatant favoritism, ignores struggling students. Assignments are unclear, expectations are unrealistic. Save yourself the frustration and drop this course.
Horrible grading, worst professor I have had yet (and that's saying a lot), treats some students better than others, talks poorly about her colleagues becuase SHE'S "published".

Avoid this class. Professor's teaching style is chaotic, lacks structure. Assignments are unclear, grading is inconsistent. Save yourself the frustration.  Plenty of other better teachers to select from.

You will improve your writing skills with Professor Mabry! She is a tough grader but will work with you to improve your paper. Sign up for a conference for each paper and make sure you understand her feedback! If you go to conference with a full draft and apply her feedback you will do well.

Professor Mary is a great professor. There are 4 papers and the occasional homework. During conferences, she's extremely helpful and tells you exactly what to fix to get a good grade. She's a bit of a tough grader but helps you write better. I would definitely take her again!!

She somewhat is a tough grader, but she is trying to help students write better. Go to conference with a full draft of your essay, she will tell you what you need to fix and it's at least an A-. Not a lot of class participation is required but do everything cause it's an easy 100.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: I got to take Prof Mabry for WRTR 1312 and 1313 and I couldn't have had it any other way. Every piece of feedback is intentional and helpful. Four essays but its the same in every WRTR course. The difference is the structure. She has made the class engaging and fun, and that's something you don't get often in writing courses.

I absolutely adore Professor Mabry! I have taken her for WRTR 1312 and 1313 and I genuinely enjoyed going to her class. There are 3 or 4 major essays but she makes sure to help you along the way. She has thorough notes on all essays and has truly changed my writing for the better. I couldn't recommend a professor more!

Professor Mabry is a must for freshman writer. She was always engaged and you can really tell that she enjoys her job and helping studnets which is hard to find at smu. Her feedback truly helps as sometimes I was completely lost but got back track for my essay with her help. You write 4 papers during this course fyi. Plus seeing her dog is a plus

I loved having Prof Mabry for my wrtr class freshman year. She gives great feedback when we do papers, and helps fill in those gaps. I love to attend her office hours to chat and see her dog! This class has definitely become helpful in my other classes, I couldn't have done that without prof Mabry.

She is a very caring professor, gives great feedback. My writing greatly improved after taking her class. It was interesting as well. She takes time to conference with you and allow you to fix mistakes prior to turning in your essays. I would definitely take again. Just learn how she grades and you will be set!
Professor Mabry isn't a tough grader and gives amazing feedback especially during conferences. She is a sweetheart.
Great teacher. Super nice during class and very open to meet whenever it's needed. Highly recommend taking.
Cares about her students and helping you become a better writer. She takes time to meet with you individually multiple times a semester to review your papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher, ready to help you whenever. Gives really good feedback on your papers and wants to help you be a better writer. If you pay attention and care about the course, you will do well. Lots of creative freedom to write about something that interests you. Take her class if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The assigned books for class are good if you can stomach reading a good story.  There are writing assignments obviously which are no longer than 6 pages at the most.  Nice professor, probably makes a writing course as interesting as it could be.  In my small class, it was mostly just discussion of what we had read.

Mabry is a really good professor but does require some work. Its not an easy A, but if you follow the prompts and USE THE WRITITNG LAB you will get at least a B+. I ended up with an A- in her class and I definitely enjoyed it also

Good professor. I made a A in 1301 and am a pretty good writer yet I could not find a way to make an A in this course. Only 5,6 assignments throughout the whole semester so little room for mistakes. Ended up with a B in the course.
Its hard to get an A but almost impossible to not get at least a B.  Most people will get a B+ if you put in minimum effort

She's fun and you'll like her until you start getting grades back. It's impossible to make an A on anything. I got an A+ in 1301 and I'm barely making a B right now in her class. She's not very helpful when you go into her office and when she doesn't like you she'll let you know it. overall I was very frustrated with this class.

Not my favorite English class, and conferencing with her on essays as helpful as I would have hoped. You have plenty of time to work on the essays though. She's not into literary anaysis, but into comparing stories to if they accurately depict history. She's nice, but I don't love the class
Overall class is easy, as long as you do all of your work.

I took her Rhetoric 1301 class in the Spring of 2009 and thoroughly enjoyed it.  I wouldn't pay any attention to the people who are proclaiming she's a stringent grader; in fact, I found her to be quite fair in her grading methodology.  Take her class: you will leave with an invaluable appreciation for the art of written argument!

She's very different. I would say she is very subjective in her grading. an A is attainable but you will most likely get a B. She doesn't really give you feedback on what she wants and you will get very frustrated when you keep getting your papers back and their still B's. She is also very difficult to listen to with her speech pauses

Professor Mabry challeneges you, but it makes the class interesting. Essays are complicated but makes you think. I enjoyed her class. Class is enjoyable and isn't extremely hard but definitely a lil challenging

Horrible first impression of her, she is kind of all over the place with her ideas.  It is hard to follow her sometimes and she doesn't talk in complete sentences.  However, as the semester goes on her personality comes out more and our class ended up being really fun!  Fairly easy to get an A, for sure a B.
Great prof. Cool person, doesn't really get boring. I definitely enjoyed the class.
Professor Mabry is VERY helpful and sweet. I agree about the "fragment... pause... fragment" issue - that tends to get annoying. However, I highly recommend her class. An A is very attainable.
No Comments

The one thing that annoyed me about Prof Mabry was the fact that she never completes her sentences. It is always "fragment...pause...fragment." With that being said, she is an interesting professor otherwise. Her class is pretty easy IF you put your best effort forth. Tons and Tons of reading. No final exam. Grade based on three essays & a project.
Literally the GOAT, such a lenient grader. If you did badly in his class that's on you, bro.

Professor Sedman's tests were not like what he said they would be. He gives you a sheet to study from but does not tell you that half of the questions on the test are not on the sheet and not on the slides. Some of the questions on the test are things he tells us will not be on the test when they actually are on the test.
Professor Sedmans tests were horrendous. He gives you a sheet to study from and half of the stuff on the sheet isn't on the test. Not worth my attendance at 9am every morning to just fail the tests.

He is HILARIOUS. He cares so much and really tries to make it entertaining for you. He's also super knowledgeable yet humble in his field. I took this class for technological advancements cc and it was perfect. 3 short papers, 1 presentation, 3 tests but he basically gives you 100s on the papers & tells you exactly what's on the exam. Take Sedman!

honestly not hard of a class, but he gets super behind on grading and is super rude when you ask him to update grad books, I had an A all semester, then it went down because of one assignment from the beginning of the school year.

I plan to take Prof Sedman again, he's great! Interesting lectures. He tells you if a topic could be on the exam so attendance is key. Studying is manageable if you go over the lecture slides and your notes weekly. Graded on: 3 exams (not comprehensive), 3 monitoring reports (fun, not time-consuming), 1 marketing presentation/paper (more lengthy).
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took this class for a CC requirement and loved it. He makes class super fun and as long as you study and take notes in class the tests are easy. Monitoring report assignments and the marketing kit assignment was very fun to do and was not time consuming.

Prof. Sedman is kind and very funny! His lectures can be long but you can tell he tries to make them interesting. A few short papers, a midterm, and a final. Listen very carefully to lectures as that is what's on the exam, he asks very detailed questions. Gives hints all semester about what will be on the exams so just listen. He is great!

I HATED this class. extremely annoying person. the only prof ever who refused to accommodate me despite having religious commitments and family commitments after my grandma passed away and insisted I come back from Europe to take his final in AUGUST or next semester instead of taking 2days early. A student overall, just got my first B. DO NOT TAKE.

The teacher was nice but a hard grader. He never explained well enough how to do the assignments for class so when it came time to grading he would be extremely picky. He can be hard to communicate with and his 3 hour lecture class was boring.

He is nice and is passionate about film but his assignments are extremely unclear on canvas, he barely puts instructions, no rubric etc. The midterm and final are super hard coming from someone who got an A, very detail oriented on random facts or clips he shows maybe once in class. Participation is a grade also so talk every once in awhile.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This sweet man had one too many classes on his plate this semester I think. His lectures are really great, funny, and engaging, but he was extremely disorganized and we never got grades on Canvas. His prompts/instructions for assignments were very vague, and he was hard to reach via email. Tests are specific, but if you KNOW the slides you're fine.

Dr. Sedman is an engaging and interactive professor, though he can be disorganized with course materials and rubrics. He's generally an easy grader. Success in his class involves regular attendance, attention to his lectures, and studying examples from class and PowerPoint presentations, as these often appear on tests.

He was disorganized, never utilized Canvas, never explained assignment criteria/due dates. He barely knew his grading scale and when assignments were due. His office hours were scattered, I found it difficult to reach him outside of class. He would not respond to emails for weeks. I would not take him again and wouldn't recommend him or this class.

One of the most unorganized teachers I have ever had. Does not even know his grading system, and what each assignment and test is worth. Tests are incredibly detail oriented, and almost impossible to do well in the class. Do not take or else your GPA will tumble.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Your grade is only based off two papers + the midterm and final. He gives you no rubric or guidelines on how to write these so you basically have to figure it out. The test questions are all over the place and unexpected. He is also not lenient or understanding or helpful and it's his way or the highway. He does not care if you fail his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Sedman's a very enjoyable professor with amusing and knowledgeable lectures, but he is very scattered: expectations for assignments, tests and the course in general are often not clearly stated and feedback can be delayed. Stay on top of notes/assignments bc class material can't be found after the lecture and assignment dates may not be posted.

Dr. Sedman is AMAZING. He is so funny and knowledgeable about the class content. 3 1-page monitoring reports which were fun to write. He is very accessible outside of class and genuinely wants his students to do well. He is the best!! Take FILM 1302 if you need tech credit.

If you need to take a class to fulfill a CC requirement or are a film major, take Professor Sedman's Contemporary Media Industries course. He makes every lecture enjoyable and makes each new topic easy to understand. There are only three exams, three papers, and one project. Study for the exams and try on the papers, and you should be alright.

Took professor Sedmans class Contemporary Media Industries to fulfill a UC and dont regret it at all. He was a great guy and his lectures were never too boring. 3 very simple papers and 3 exams for this class. Make sure you study for the exams and just do the monitoring reports and youll get an easy A.

Dr. Sedman is a pretty great professor. He is extremely funny and makes class super enjoyable. There aren't that many assignments, so you do have to try hard on all of them to end up with a good grade. His tests are super specific and cover a lot of concepts, so you do need to review the entire unit to get an A on tests.

Honestly such a sweet dork of a teacher. I ended with a B, but through no fault of him. A respectable guy who loves what he does. Participation is a grade though! 3 easy "monitoring reports" and 3 major exams are basically his entire class so make sure to do your work accordingly. A joy to learn from.

His tests were a little tricky because they were incredibly detail-oriented. However, I definitely would be willing to take another class in another life when I'd need to take other classes in this area (only needed the requirement for creativity & aesthetic)

Prof. Sedman is such a great professor. He makes the lectures fun and entertaining so class is always enjoyable and youre more likely to pay attention.
