Class should be a place where you come to learn and feel comfortable doing so. The whole point of her class is to embarrass those who don't know the answers. Not teach the material, and that is sad

Take Susan if you want to feel anxious the entire class. No one can even actually learn or pay attention to the material in class because Susan calls you out at random to answer. If you dont know the answer she humiliates you in front of the entire class. Obviously someone might not know the answer yet thats why they are in class to learn?

Susan is a great Prof. She is extremely well prepared for her lectures and expects the same of you. She will make youwork pretty hard for your grade but its worth it. I found it overwhelming in the beginning with the amount of prework and prep needed but as time went on, I began to appreciate the effort she put in. It was certainly worth the effort

Advanced topics in accounting class is as difficult as it sounds. The class requires your commitment to keep up with homework assignments and class preps. There are many of them. Exam is extremely long and it seems like she tests everything you learn. Prof Riffe is very sweet and helpful but I don't think her teaching style works for me.

Susan is the best teacher in the MBA program.  All incoming full time MBA students are required to take her class in the Fall.  Read the textbook, print and fill out the notes, and pay attention in class.  Accounting is not hard, but time consuming.  This class should take up 50% of your time in Mod A.
Wasn't available outside of class for additional help.  I will avoid taking this professor in the future.
I would not recommend taking any of her classes at SMU.  There are plenty of other professors available who will benefit your education.
She is extremely unclear about material and assignments.

Let's just say, at first I was not a huge fan of her numerous assignments. As time went on I became okay with them, because they did give me more practice. I became a big fan of hers by the end of class, because she really cares about her students. She makes herself constantly available to help with questions.
Susan is great at explaining how all the moving pieces fit together to form the financial picture of a firm.

She is firm but fair.  The shortcut is doing the homework and the reading.  She is a nice person and really cares but will not give an easy grade because you're a nice guy/gal.  Do the work and you'll be fine.
Excellent teaching

Excellent Prof. I took her for 6201 and 6202...I wish that she taught 6210, 6211, and 6212...If you pay attention in class you will be well prepared. These two classes were among the best taught courses in the curriculum.
Excellent Professor. If you keep up with the work you will do well. This class is the basis for ACCT 6210, 6211, 6212
I would not recommend taking this class or any of her others if you can get out of it.

The work is hard, but if you come to class and keep up with the work, there is no reason for you to not do well. She is very helpful, and although the homework may be hard, it prepares you for her tests. I enjoyed her lessons thorougly.
Like everyone said before, she is very organized and if you do the work and pay attention, you will make good grades
Do not take!
Most organized core PMBA class.  Classes after hers are a letdown in terms of organization.  She is very fair and helpful but expects a lot from her students.
No Comments
She knows her stuff and is excited about helping others understand.  Very well prepared.
Not a good teach and can cop attitude with students when you upset her.

Spanish is usually challenging for me, but Dr. Solera made learning a second language less intimidating. She was my favorite teacher this semester. She is a fair grader, the expectations of each assignment are clear, and the class is easy to follow. I feel that I learned a lot in this class, and I 100% recommend taking her.
Not as good as I heard, not very interesting and not nice at all. Doesn't grade equally or consistently, have to suck up for good grades, she gets frustrated easily then can become rude.
Very average professor, nothing special in her teaching to help, must teach yourself everything.

This Professor had a super clear grading system, 4 Exams, 3 TalkAbroad conversations, 3 projects, but get ready to do a lot of online textbook homework, and make sure to make time for it. Professor Fernandez-Solera deeply cares about her students and even leaves clear feedback so that all students can succeed, and she is so communicative too 10/10
She's fine.

She has to be the BEST professor in Spanish. Dr. Solera is incredibly caring and she treats all of her students with empathy. Very interactive class and you can tell that she is passionate about the class. She is very understanding and forgiving. If you show effort in the class she'll move the world for you. She's such a sweetheart. 100/10!!
Super understanding of late work, and overall pretty straightforward class

Took Psycholinguistics over May Term. It is essential to read the textbook and put effort into the homework reading assignments as they directly relate to each day's quiz, which is extensive, closed note, and tests comprehension of the reading material. The Midterm and Final exams are based on the quiz and homework questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: very nice lady. lots of homework. class isn't hard but have to put effort to study to succeed. complete all assignments, don't miss class, and don't miss a quiz

wonderful lady and not strict or haughty. intermediate span 1 is definitely doable, but there is so much work for the class. it is ll easy to do, just time consuming and follow the rubric. quizzes are relatively easy and outside support and questions are welcomed so you actually understand. class often ends early or gets canceled. highly recommend

MY FAVORITE TEACHER. I had her during my first semester of college and she was so welcoming. There was definitely a lot of homework, but she grades are reasonably easy. There are 2 tests that are straightforward, and a final that was relatively harder. If you can definitely take her.

Solera is an angel! This class is rather easy and while there is a good amount of homework, it is all very easy. Grading scale is very nice and she even gives extra credit if everyone fills out the course evaluation. Take her class!!!!

Took this course during the summer online. 6+ hours of homework every day and we did not get weekends off. Solera was very caring and she was always a huge help in Zoom sessions. As long as you put in the work, you will do fine. Make sure you just do all the assignments and study for the tests. She is awesome!

She's a super great Spanish professor. I loved taking her class. There's a lot of homework, but because there's so much homework, it's not a big deal if you mess a few up. She's also super chill and won't make you sit through unnecessary class. She made the class super interesting. She's funny, sweet, and caring. You've got to take her class.
Could not be more unhelpful and uncaring. She may come off as nice but when you need help or are struggling, she does not offers not solutions or help you improve in any way.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is the best teacher! She makes class fun and is very understanding. The workload isn't bad just study the material from the book and class and the tests won't be hard. Try not to skip class bc participation will help your grade. There are a lot of assessments asides from tests that are easy if you complete them on time and put effort in.
One of my favorite teachers, however, lots of work and can be difficult. Not an easy A Love her to death though!

By being generally responsible (showing up, doing the brief online hw, learning the vocab, etc.) you're most of the way towards an A. There are easier teachers but she's great in terms of giving clear criteria and rewarding you for following those criteria. Does not nitpick b/c she doesn't like your style. If you do what's asked, you'll do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Susana is a great professor. She makes learning Spanish easy and enjoyable. Participation is graded pretty heavily, so don't skip class. She is very caring about the students. I'm not entirely sure how prepared I would be for a semester of Spanish where I didn't have her however because her class is that easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Susana is the BEST! She is passionate about the language and explains the grammar topics in an organized manner. She is enthusiastic and loves to interact with her students. She understands that we have lives outside of class and if you have any issues she is more than happy to work with you. She is the reason I am majoring in Spanish!

Solera is honestly great. Very funny and upbeat. Loves engaging the entire class in discussions. Class is very straightforward and you know what she expects out of you from day 1. Do your work, study, and talk to her! She's a really sweet person!

Best teacher ever. She tries to make class easy and enjoyable and when she thinks the students are just too tired she lets you go take a "siesta". If you have her do ur connect assignments as early as possible because a lot of class time is devoted to completing them. I'd definitely recommend this teacher she is great!

She's a really great professor and certainly knows Spanish well, but to be completely honest I didn't feel like I learned anything from her all semester.  especially being in an upper level span class, all the homework(theres a ton) was in the book and we didn't do anything in class.  she grades on hw/projects/tests

Lectures were never too boring, and normally she would let us out of class within five minutes once a week.  The workload is never too much, and she is very flexible and understanding with homework.  The course is easy, and with moderate studying an A is very possible.  I would definitely recommend her.
really funny and upbeat. Not a hard lab as long as you show up prepared

She is the best lab teacher ever! Since Lab is sort of pointless, its nice that she lets you out early! This happens all the time! She is really helpful if you ever have any questions, but really doesnt help you out unless you ask. I recommend her for an easy lab! Shes really nice too!
No Comments
very cool teacher... super chill. VERY HARD GRADER SO YOU BETTER BE GOOD AT SPANISH OR DONT BOTHER
Doesn't know what she is talking about

She's amazing. No doubt she's a hard grader, but she's incredibly experienced (Masters in English at Oxford!) and will go out of her way to meet with you outside of class (even if it means staying a couple hours late).  Aside from her willingness to help you succeed, she loves just getting to know you as a person. Definitely recommend.

The material is intense. There is a lot to read and you will spend at least 4 hours a night on answering her reading questions. You will have a quiz everyday and you will have tough papers. This class will prepare you for grad school so the hard work is worth it.

One of the best. She teaches an incredibly rewarding class, and you'll be better for taking it. She has daily quizzes, which are easy but make class mandatory. She's deeply invested in her field of study, making her lectures both valuable and exciting. I highly recommend!

She's very nice and while she can sometimes grade strictly, you can earn points back if you redo your work. Her accent makes her hard to understand at times, but she provides you with a lot of material to help. This is a good lab course and covers a broad range of topics that are relevant to medical school in particular. Take this with the lecture!

Dr. Radyuk's class is interesting and she's nice, but she's difficult to understand at times. Tests are open note, but all of the questions are "select all that apply". Reading the textbook to understand the details behind general concepts was useful. You can see exam answers right after you finish, so there was a lot of cheating going on.

Seems like a sweet lady but, her accent is a bit hard to understand. She seems to put a lot of information on her lecture slides and she's very difficult to follow during the lecture. This class was heavily recommended to me due to it being "easy", I honestly don't find the class easy at all. Her tests are very confusing and not from the lecture.

A very nice person, but a terrible professor. It's clear she is very knowledgable but as far as explaining concepts to students, a terrible teacher. Textbook is the only way you'll actually understand the material.

Took both lab and lecture. She is amazing. Exams are open book and if you read the book before the exam week, you will do good. Lab was easy, fun, and we learned a lot. She does have accent but if you read the book, you will be able to learn everything.

The lecture for immunology may be easy but the lab most definitely is not. The quizzes are very tough and are worth 20 percent of your grade. Other aspects of the lab are easy but the class is very tedious.

If you're a bio major who needs an upper level bio class, take this class. If you go to class she gives extra credit assignments. Each assignment adds 2 points to each test so you can get up to 10 extra credit points per test. Tests are open note, open book, and not on lock down (so you can search the internet too).

This was his first time teaching STAT2331, so there's room for improvement. He's super nice & approachable, willing to Zoom with me at 7:30pm one day. His lectures are not very engaging, partially due to the class's size and refusal to participate. Lectures are slideshow-based but any confusing concepts can be explained better in office hours.

Zoltan was super chill. Attendance not required and he posts notes and lectures on canvas. As long as you do the homeworks (flexible deadlines) you'll do well on the exams. Lectures were sometimes dry because he just reads off the notes, but overall he's a really nice guy and wants everyone to succeed, would take again.
He wasn't bad, per se, but also wasn't great. He has a quiz every single class and the grading for things is super easy, especially for labs. A really easy class to knock out two CC credits.

This is a review for STAT 3304. I stopped going to class after i realized he didn't take attendance in class and posted all his lectures lol, but you can tell Professor Zoltan is a really nice guy. His lectures can be pretty boring, but the content is pretty rich for data science. SAS can be a little tricky but R isn't too bad. Chill guy, ez class.

While I was registering for DS1300, there were no reviews on this site for him, so I didn't know what to expect, but it turned out to be the best decision I made. He's so willing to help you and very approachable. If you go to class you'll do great on the tests! online short quizzes for every class day, lab every week, midterm, final, and project.

Literally the goat. Best international finance professor by far. Especially compared to the other professor, he's an angel in hell because international finance material is really hard and he tries to simplify it for you as much as he can!

Excellent professor, but a challenging course. Go to office hours to make sure concepts click, and it may take a while before it does. The course starts off as more quantitative, and ends up more qualitative.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The goat, one of my favorite classes I've taken

Professor Patel is very knowledgable in the course. Personally, I don't think I would want to take another course taught by him. He grades the exams very hard; therefore, if you don't actively prepare, you won't do well.
One of the easier ones but terrible at his job. Makes things overly complex and doesn't like being asked questions. Can be rude.
I thought he was fantastic. Nothing bad to say.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best finance professor at SMU with a real passion for the subject matter. 1 midterm, 1 final, in-class assignments (graded randomly, but free 100s), and quizzes (unlimited attempts). Available outside of class often and takes time to get to know the students
Caring and very knowledgeable. The class is hard and will take a little while for the topics to click. Very appreciative of those coming into his office hours and will help you with the material.

Really nice, passionate guy who will know your name by the 3rd class. Clearly wants to impart knowledge. The no partial credit is actually not as bad as you think. Grades were better than expected but you need to put in the work. One of the best Finance professors imo.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great lectures. Funny. 3 exams and final paper. Exams are challenging but his reviews are exactly like the exam but with different numbers. Would recommend

Dr. Patel's International Finance class is challenging yet engaging. He gives interesting lectures and cares for his students. The course involves quizzes, three exams, and final paper. He allows double-sided cheat sheets on the exams (include vocab. I'd recommend preparing by solving lecture problems and completing multiple practice exam versions.

Professor Patel is truly one of the best professors I've had in Cox. While the content of his course is challenging, he makes the unfamiliar topics attainable through engaging lectures and deep explanations. His care for international finance and his students is evident. I would definitely take his class again!

Sometimes he gets frustrated when you ask questions which is a little odd but he is well spoken. Some of the concepts could be explained a little better. They're somewhat explained in a over complex way that inhibits understanding.

Great professor. Really puts effort into lectures and will help you if you go to office hours. Weekly quizzes that you can take unlimited times, and medium-hard tests. He does cold- call during class though. But one of the best professors i've had in Cox.

Great professor, favorite FINA class. Practice exams given which are essentially the same as the real test. No surprises. All information needed is on the powerpoints. Really cares about knowing his students. Final paper instead of final exam. No homework except 8 quizzes on canvas that you have unlimited attempts. 10/10 recommend

Prof. Sverdlik is an all-around good person. He actually cares about his students and their ideas whereas some philosophy professors just teach to stroke their own ego or practice their indoctrination skills. His expectations are clear, and his class is great for anyone remotely interested in criminal law and the justice system. 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: He's a very intelligent professor and also a very sweet man. You'll enjoy this class if law is your preference. The class wasn't too hard, 6 quizzes, 1 midterm, 1 final, but 4 papers. One paper doesn;t count towards your grade, they're not too bad except the last one(10 pages). I'd suggest starting that paper as early as you can. I enjoyed a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very arbitrary grader

Sverdlik is knowledgeable about the material, but isn't pedantic. He was open to hearing the differing opinions of his class, and genuinely encouraged good discussions. He is all around, a genuinely good professor. I recommend taking him highly. (Not an easy A, though; which I think is a good thing.)

I am unsure why he gets such a bad rap here, he is a very enthusiastic professor with a lot of energy and full of humour.  I was not very interested in the course prior to the class, however he makes the topic vividly interesting intriguing for everyone. Do the (short) readings and pay attention, Im taking another class of his next semester!
I like him as a person quite a lot, but as a teacher, I really feel like his class would be much better if he did it differently.

This is the worst professor I have ever met. Not only is he a horrible teacher, he is the hardest grader. Study as hard as you want it does not matter because you will fail. He contradicts himself and the reading and is unclear. Does not give extra  help and does not let you know your grade until it comes out at the end of the semester. DON'T DO IT
absolutely the most boring class I have ever taken. So hard and questions on the test literally come from nowhere.. DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS

Dr. Sverdlik is a really great guy, and his lectures are interesting. He always makes an effort to get to know his students. However, his grading is often seemingly arbitrary, and it's difficult to know what he wants on quizzes and exams. This can make it difficult to get top grades, even if you know the material quite well.

Dr. Sverlik is a clear lecturer, a fair grader, and a very nice man. Take the time to do the readings, attend the lectures, and ask lots of questions. He teaches with enthusiasm, and his class is well worth your time.

Avoid this class and try to get with another teacher. He takes off major points on quizzes for little stupid things. Isn't a good lecturer and I often asked myself t why I was sitting in class because I wasn't learning anything. What we go over in class is rarely on the quizzes (which was awkward)

He is an okay teacher. He will make time to meet with you after or before class but that is not always helpful. He isn't a bad lecturer and his class can be interesting if you like the subject. He is a really hard grader and takes lots of points off for silly little things.

He's a good professor. I took the honors section. There is a small reading assignment every night. On quizzes and tests, if you write what he said in class, you will do well. I learned a lot in this class. He expects his students to work hard.
Dr. Steve is a great professor. Extremely friendly and engaging. Really tries to get to know his students. He even has lunch with students once a week. Not too hard.

Dr. Steve is an awesome professor! Really knowledgeable on the subject and very interesting. He encourages class discussion and really tries to get to know his students. He even has lunch with students once a week. 2 papers a couple quizzes, a midterm, and final. Not too hard if you study.

Dr. Steve is a good professor overall. His lectures are interesting (largely discussion based) and he takes time to get to know students outside of class. However, his grading methods, while not overly hard, can be frustrating, and it took me much of the semester to discern what exactly he was looking for in an answer.

Nice guy and this class is very interesting without going too deep into philosophical jargon. Topics vary from very interesting (torture, etc.) to boring (animal rights). Grading is fairly easy, just watch out for your word choice, he docks for silly things like missing one or two words in a definition

Dr. Steve is a really nice guy but he is just a really hard grader. Kinda disappointed that I got a B+ for the class when I got A- on almost everything. Take him only if necessary--I needed a CF so that's why I took his class and take him if you know that your GPA won't be destroyed as much.

Worst professor I've had thus far at SMU, and I'm in my 5th semester. Stuck in his own ways, extremely unhelpful. Vague with his papers but then grades them hard and based upon how much you speak in class and whether or not he likes you. HIGHLY do not recommend this professor. Avoid at all costs.

Overall his class was okay, his grading method is strange and frustrating. Its nice how he tries to get to know his students. Probably will not take him again though, it took me the entire semester to finally understand what he was looking for when grading and messed up my gpa in the process.
I will not be taking a class with him again, he wasn't clear or helpful. Hard to get a high grade since he takes points off for very minor things.
he is such a nice guy and a great lecturer. he can relate to his students well and is always willing to help. got an easy A
SO BORING.  change teachers there are so many better professors to take than this guy... and it's really really hard to get a decent grade

The work is pretty easy for an advanced elective class. She is really chill in class and is not overbearing about participation/no computers, like some Spanish teachers. You have to do 10 hours of community service for the CE credit but she makes it really easy to do. She didn't grade anything until after the semester ended but she graded kindly.
Best Spanish teacher i've ever had. She is super understanding and caring. We had Spanish subs takeover our class when she was out and she was way better than both of them.
I love her so much, she is an amazing person and her class is amazing. I cannot give a higher recommendation.

Honestly just take any other class, way too much work outside of class. So many assignments and outside things you need to do just for her to never grade it. Waste of time. She's very nice but this class has more work than my required classes.

SPAN 4329: If you want it to be mid April and not have a single grade entered into Canvas this is for you! She is super nice and caring but not knowing where you stand in class with 3 weeks left in the semester is so frustrating. We have done discussions, papers, reflexions and we still have 0 grades in.

There needs to be more professors like her. She is very down to Earth professor, very caring, funny, and makes the class super likeable and fun to enjoy/learn. Do not listen to that one star rating, Homework is super short and easy to do it. The longest will take to is a good 20 minutes. You have to take her classes. you will not regret it!!!!!

TWC is a great professor. The class itself has a LOT of homework and busy work, but the quizzes and tests are easy if you are willing to study the grammar. Lots of group projects. Definitely avoid if you have anxiety about talking in class, she calls on you a lot and you are forced to respond in Spanish on the fly. Other than that, she is so nice.

I love TWC!! She is a great prof and she's a great Spanish teacher. This course was really interesting and she really motivated me into feeling like I was capable and good at Spanish. There's a lot of busywork type assignments, but I get that that's how you learn the language. She's a great prof - I would definitely recommend!

I considered minoring in spanish just so I could have Talia again. she makes assignments fun and homework only took at most an hour and a half every night. she is super sweet but not a pushover, she obviously knows what she's doing.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof Weltman-Cisneros is the best!! She truly cares about her students and wants you to get better at Spanish. I feel I learned so much this semester. There is homework everyday, but you get used it and it is not that bad. As long as you put in effort into the class, you should be good. Class is conversation heavy.

While she does give HW everyday on VHL/other assignments from the book they are never too hard and go by pretty quick. She does give tests, writing assignments and 3 convos with native speakers, but if you're learning a language it's what you have to do... TWC is a great professor and really wants you to succeed. Take her if you can!

She is the best for 2302 lots of projects and a couple tests, but she grades really easily. she tries to make the class applicable to real life and engaging, cares so much about her students. she really just wants to help you improve at spanish. homework was a lot of busy work but not hard. definitely take her if you're not the strongest at spanish

Ignore all other reviews. Seriously. Shes beyond annoying. Always slightly passive too. The homework and tests/projects are unbearable. She assigns 3HW assignments per 2 days regularly. Then there are quizzes every 2 weeks. And 2 convos with native speakers. Plus tests. She also requires reflections for all assignments. Hw is ridiculous. AVOID

She gives a decent amount of homework but its not too hard and its really just to improve your reading and writing skills in spanish. She is a really understanding professor and shes makes assignments interesting. It is project based, some are group projects like the final, and there are quizzes you need to study for. Overall i would recommend her
Our class loves Dr. Cisneros. If you can get in, take her class. She will go out of her way to make sure her students succeed. Also, her class is interactive and is never boring.

She is amazing! Really cares for her students and encourages you to participate. Online homework is tedious but easy. The content, format, and expectations for tests/quizzes are very clearly laid out. Gives opportunities for extra credit!

Dr. Cisnernos isn't a native speaker of Spanish, so she speaks slowly and clearly and doesn't ramble which was helpful for me because I actually understood what she was saying. The online homework is tedious but should be easy 100s.

Absolutely loved her class! I learned so much even though half of our semester was conducted over Zoom. You do have to try to get a good grade, but it's definitely manageable. Participation matters a lot, and most of the class is focused on discussion of opinions. She always emphasizes that "you get out what you put in," and I completely agree!

I had to take Spanish to fill a requirement, but this professor was really great! If you like teachers that are easy going and not afraid to joke around with her students, you should definitely take her class. She mostly lectures with the occasional worksheet, plus online homework everyday that takes about 20-30 minutes to do. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Class focuses on current topics, very woke. Class is all in Spanish, but she makes it easy to follow along. Participation is important, but she doesn't call you out on mistakes, she just wants you to be able to voice your opinions in Spanish. Highly recommend her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Honestly the sweetest friendliest man. His class was pretty easy. There was an open note quiz once a week, no midterm, and a final that you get 2 double paged cheat sheets for. His lectures are incredibly organized and easy to follow. Very detail oriented and super super nice
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tom Tan was hands down the nicest professor I have ever had at SMU. I took a night class and he was always energetic, positive and a supportive teacher. He genuinely cares about his students and wants everyone to do well. Absolutely a fantastic professor.
He is the worst prof I've ever seen

I too was worried based on these past reviews. However, Tom has been one of the best teachers in the program. Highlights - EXTREMELY organized: Provides a course roadmap he reviews each class - PERSONALITY: Very affable, will take all of your questions - RESPONSIVE: On Canvas and e-mail, fairly quickly. Helps you succeed - RESOURCES: Good book/ppts

When I read these other comments, I was terrified to take him; HOWEVER, I have never been more PLEASANTLY surprised by a professor. He constantly checks up on the class, offers extra office hours and extra credit, and always finds a way to make everyone laugh. ITOM is no easy A, but if you put in the work, you can definitely get one in Tan's class.

This class is confusing & hard. The lectures make it seem simple & easy, yet his tests are on nothing we cover in class. They are 10x more difficult then the lecture material. The whole class is on the grade curve so you never know where you stand with regards to your grades. HOWEVER he is a VERY sweet professor who genuinely cares for his students

It is very obvious that he is a new professor. He has no idea how to effectively teach a class. You have to learn everything by yourself. And he is not generous with grades, incredibly rigid with everything.

Im about to drop this class... The midterm is tomorrow and I have no clue what is going on. the HWs take anywhere between 4-6+ hrs and he doesnt give partial credit. Plus he belches in class all the time. EWW! but the class is so hard, take another professor!

Impossible!! He is the worst teacher I have ever had at SMU. He has a really strong accent and said in class our homework assignments should take us 4-5 hours each! He also picks on people in class if you do not know the answer. I had to drop because I did not want to waste my time with a failing grade. Take with a different professor at any cost!!
I enjoy her lectures, but she grades impossibly hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment:
Assignments: 1 group project, 10 reading reflection papers, midterm, 1 annotated bibliography, 1 research paper (7-10 pages).
She never posted the rubrics for anything so assignments were always unclear and I couldn't tell why I was graded certain ways. She never gave out 100% and would give around a 93% with the comment "nice job".
The lectures are boring and all she does is read off the slides.

Her lectures were interesting, but her grading criteria is SO unclear and gives seemingly arbitrary scores with no explanation why. Had to write like one 2-page essay  based off of a 20+ page reading per week, and she doesn't really give out 100s, but if you don't get a good grade she won't explain why. Not the worst, but take a different ARHS prof
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Getting an A is impossible. Although she's nice, I would not recommend this class (ARHS 3380).

Prof Thomas is a smart teacher, but I found it difficult to succeed in this class. I worked hard on assignments and took diligent notes, but it was hard to get good grades. Prof Thomas also tends to take off points without giving feedback or constructive criticism, making it hard to improve. Don't take this class unless you are a Photography major!

I genuinely love prof Thomas so much. Many people on here are complaining about the essays and lectures— but it's nothing out of the ordinary for an academic class. She is super passionate during her lectures. Grading on essays is good. Don't disrupt class— give this poor woman a break 😭 she is so sweet, just direct essay/exam questions to TA
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Thomas's class was very interesting to me, but I can understand why some people may not want to listen to long lectures on artworks. Tests were laughably easy, but papers were a bit annoying as I never received feedback or even a rubric. Dr. Thomas was great but wasn't a huge fan of my TAs who were entirely in charge of grading and attendance.

I completed an extra credit assignment and received no grade for it whatsoever. I took this class to cover one of my breadth requirements, but it felt harder than it should have. The TAs check the papers and are terrible at giving feedback. Prof Thomas isn't bad, but sadly the TAs don't do her justice.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If only taking the class for breadth, don't take it. Had to do three reflection papers with long articles. Final paper had to be in Chicago style, which nobody knows how to do. Is a harsh grader, doesn't give feedback, and can't turn in the papers late. Her lectures are boring, and uses a QR code in every class. When she gets upset, she is rude.

bubble. Assignments are irrelevant, lectures are uninspiring. Don't waste your time.

reviews.comment: I wish I had taken these reviews more seriously when signing up for classes. Thompson is one of the most condescending and rude professors employed at SMU. reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: One of the best SMU professors. The bad? He's not clear sometimes on what he wants in essays. However, the guy has a wealth of good knowledge and 100% cares about his class. He also makes little jabs at students which people take personally, but they are either in good humor or meant to make you better. I highly recommend if you're here to learn.

reviews.comment: By far the worst professor I have ever had at SMU. Grade is determined by only 4 assignments: midterm, final, and two papers. The papers are very confusing. reviews.comment: Professor Thompson is not compassionate, caring, or nice by any means, and he openly admits trying to work on being "nicer." Thompson is by far my favorite professor at SMU. Hes a straight shooter and will jokingly pick on you, but he genuinely cares about the well being of his students. Theres a lot of reading, but skimming works as long as you pay attention in lecture. ALWAYS meet with him before writing because he helps a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof says he wants his students to be better, but constantly tears them down in class and generally isn't helpful during office hours. His PowerPoints can be confusing. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He's passionate about Political Science, but is not cut out for teaching an intro level course. The hardest class I've taken so far, but worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof. Thompson is one of the most honest professors ever. While he quickly forms opinions of his students, if you are on his good side he will push you to be your very best. reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Sorry folks but DISC essays wont fly here. Solid professor who takes his class seriously, knows his audience, and grades fairly. reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof. Thompson is an awesome professor, but this class is difficult. People are often misled when they see "international relations" and think its about current affairs. reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Thompson has very high expectations for all of his students. He calls students to answer from the reading at random, is very detail oriented, and there is incredibly tough for an intro professor. However, it is because he wants your absolute best. If you do the work, you will be a much more critical thinker when you leave. Be prepared.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Incredibly smart guy... maybe too smart to be teaching an intro level class. A lot of his stuff goes right over your head, can be condescending. A lot of reading, but very little of it is actually from the textbooks. Lecture heavy, two tests and two papers. Loved the concept of the class, but his teaching made it harder than it should have been.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Thompson has a "know-it-all" attitude that can be difficult to handle at times. He has the knowledge to back it up, but prepare for him to expect a similar level of understanding. This class is not as easy as a traditional intro class but not impossible. 90 pg. of reading a class. 1 Midterm, 2 Essays (7 pg) and a final is your grade
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Thompson is my favorite professor at SMU. While the class requires a lot of reading and can be difficult, Thompson is extremely helpful if you just go and talk to him. Contrary to belief, he is not scary and is insanely kind and funny. IR is a difficult topic to begin with, but he's helpful and provides you with every opportunity to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The readings aren't necessary if you pay attention in class. Seriously, everything you need are in his lectures. He always has powerpoints which are really useful. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: A curt Rhode Island native, Thompson is still new at teaching. He masks this fact with booming tones & generously curved grades. Expect a scantron/short essay midterm and comprehensive final, two 5-7 page essays, some attendance quizzes, & weekly readings  sometimes more than 90 pages/week  which are not necessary as long as you pay attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: DO NOT take this professor. Clearly a graduate level class with roughly 70 pages of antagonizing reading a night. Also, you do not gain anything from the lectures what so ever, but you also don't gain anything from the readings either so you are in a bind. 10/10 would not recommend so stay away. Two Test and Two 7 plus page papers.

reviews.comment: He's a really nice guy outside of class but his lecture's are very confusing and 90% of the class clearly has no idea what is going on. He assigns a lot a lot of reading as well and expects you to know it backwards and forwards (asks really specific questions to random ppl)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Super hard class with a lot of reading. The guy is really smart but you can tell he is new to teaching and doesn't quite know how to explain all the info he knows. reviews.comment: only 4 grades for the whole class and its an intro class. WAY TOO HARD. also 1 million pages of reading. dont take. ur welcome
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I have almost nothing good to say about Professor Carr. Dynamical Systems is a rigorous course and he isn't taking it seriously whatsoever. The only thing he has going is that he is an easy grader. Do better.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He has a great personality and is very friendly. I just didn't think his lectures were structured enough, often making it difficult to follow along. I've never had this issue before but I thought the way he worded exam questions was really confusing, lack of clear questioning and instruction. Pretty stingy about partial credit on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was supposed to be an easy A. This class was harder then all of my other engineering classes. There are literally NO numbers,  none. It's a math class without numbers.  Professor Carr is a good professor, I have no problem with him. Just expect to be confusing 90% of the time. The homework are nothing like the class problems

I really enjoyed his class. He is helpful in and outside of class and will go over exams if you have questions. there are extra credit quizzes once a week. He is clear on grading. It is a tough class so make sure to review calc 1 and 2 thoroughly before.
He is quite good at giving instructions, but kind of "awe" during office hours. Exams are pretty straight forward
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: When you ask for help he just tells you to look it up and not help at all. Lack of clear material, gets extremely offended if you make any teaching suggestion at all. When lecturing makes constant mistakes, provides incorrect info repeatedly, which is repulsive for a professor. Avoid this professor do not take. Does not help at all.

Awesome Prof. He clearly covers all topics. He expects his students to already know Calculus 1 and 2 completely, so come prepared. He is caring and will go over any grade that you have questions about. Definitely would take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is incredibly difficult. There are quizzes every week and homework every class, but he doesn't take the homework up. I don't suggest taking it unless you really need to. Professor Carr is a great professor but this class just is really tough.

Funny dude. His lectures were good for setting you up for the homework, which was slightly more difficult and specific application. The tests were reasonably difficult; nothing too bad. Overall a great guy and would definitely take again.

Professor Carr is a great option for Calc 2. He tries to explain things so that you understand them and gives good lectures. My only complaints are that he often times does not finish problems to the end answer and that looking back on his notes is a tad confusing. Do the homework and quizzes and you'll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great professor, had him for differential. Makes classes enjoyable and worth attending in person. Has so many great stories and real life applications. Don't ask him about chaos theory unless you want to hear about his entire education background, lol.
Professor Carr is hilarious he always made the class laugh at 8am. He is a great professor & very helpful. Be ready for a quiz every class period so make sure you understand the chapters

In my top 3 professors I've EVER taken. His examples and way of explaining made DiffEq interesting. Uses anecdotes and funny little stories to keep your attention during class. Quizzes every class. Labs due weekly that are take home. Doesn't assign "busy work", won't have a zillion hw probs but know the ones he assigns. 100% take him!!

Her lectures (although virtual) were fantastic. This prof knows her stuff, but be prepared to put in effort. Don't expect to just float by, but definitely enjoy this course. Also, ask her about her drosophila research. She's humble to a point of not talking about it, but she was definitely a big influence on genetics research in the 80s and 90s.

She's not a bad professor, just a little boring to listen to. Had her during the fall, so the class was completely online. As a result, made listening to lectures even more difficult. It's not hard to get an A. Everything was open book. Her video lectures were mandatory to watch.

Her class straightforward and simple. Just watch the lectures and memorize the slides and you pass. open book tests, the final is heavy on your grade but if you do well on the tests you do well overall.

If youre at SMU looking for a lab to take, skip this one. Im a graduating senior that had to take a BIOL lab. I messed up. This is supposed to be 1 credit hour. I spend at least 7-10 hours per week doing nothing but busy work. This lab is pointless, I am learning nothing except how to rephrase a lab manual. Take a lab with Dr. O, not Strecker

Great professor. Very organized. She handled a fully online semester well. Must watch the 2-3 lectures per chapter or you'll get points off but her lectures are good and easy to follow. 4 tests (3-4 chapters per test) and a final all open notes. You still have to study for them because they're application based questions. Overall great class
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I really appreciated that Professor Strecker's class was very organized. All the material and due dates were provided beforehand because it is an online course. reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: It was clear to see Dr. Strecker did a great deal of premeditated work on her online course. She has prerecorded, clear, and engaging lectures available to view any time. She does review sessions and has office hours and is even super helpful when you email her. Her course had the perfect balance of flexibility and structure.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: she made this class boring and the lecture extremely heavy, I mean heavy is like when you feel like you done reading and you been studying for 3 hours, congrats, you have finished 1/3 of the ppt. You need to learn everything on your behalf, and the actual test is not straight forward questions. I used to enjoy take biology, but not anymore.

Take notes on the PowerPoint, watch the lectures, read the textbook chapter, and do the study questions. Do this every week for each chapter and you will get an A. Tests can be challenging if you don't know the material well. Lots of work but very interesting. Definitely possibly to get an A with good studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: heavy lectures, each ppt over 70+ pages. I don't think she cares about the workload, you need to spend the least 8+hrs each week to learn everything yourself because she pretty much only read each PPT page. Her final is a joke, 90 questions for a 1301 bio class, she needs to understand most students are not only taking one class.

You have weekly videos during your class and then quizzes that are not worth that much. The videos are a little boring but bearable. Exams are incredibly hard and have to be studied for even if though they are open note.

hardest 1 level course, If you are a non-bio major, don't take her bio 1303, class is extremely boring and lectures are extremely heavy. some PPT over 80pages, the funny thing is the lecture has more materials than those 3 or 4 level classes. easy B or above but you are junior or senior, you don't have time study for other classes.

Dr. Strecker, as some of the previous reviews suggest, is really looking out for you. Her course may seem complicated at times, but if you put in the effort, you will TRULY be rewarded with invaluable knowledge regarding rudimental biology. But her course does require work. Take notes, read, prepare. It is worth it. She's great!

She is literally one of the sweetest people you will ever meet. It is very hard to not do well in her class, she so clearly just wants all of her students to succeed. She drops your lowest quiz and lowest exam and she also curved everyone's total grade by 3 percentage points. For example, if you had a 95 as your overall grade, she gave you a 98.

Lectures always lasted the full hour of class but it felt much longer and she's very hard to pay attention to. Definitely do all of the practice she puts online and pay attention on test review days because she will write questions that are the same or very similar to those.

Strecker is a pretty good biology teacher and cares about her students. However, the nature of the class makes it hard to care about it. The lectures are tedious and have little outside work to hammer them in, and while the tests are open note, they can be very difficult and stressful due to the time limit. Attendance is a grade, come to class!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Lectures tend to be difficult and fast-paced, but she really loves the content and is always extending office hours.
